name: Boutique Marmier Betina Lou
address: 6510 Av. Henri-Julien, Montreal, Quebec H2S 2V2, Canada
reviews: I always find beautiful pieces at Betina Lou. Beyond the clothes, I love their courage to speak up, it makes me want to keep coming back and supporting them even more.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Betina Lou is a gem in Montréal! Beautiful, timeless pieces made locally with care, and the boutique itself is bright, welcoming, and thoughtfully curated. The staff are warm and attentive, making the shopping experience feel personal and enjoyable. A must-visit for anyone who values quality and slow fashion.

Most of the wardrobe pieces that I cherish the most come from this shop. I bought a Diarte merino wool cardigan over 5 years ago and it still looks brand new and frequently has strangers ask where I got it. Friendly staff, amazing soundtracks and great clothes. An absolute gem in little Italy!

Always happy to visit local brands that support the same causes as you and share your values. Got keffiyeh scrunchies for my friends and I, and excited to go back and try the new Fall collection soon. Betina Lou is beautifully curated store and you can see how each item was intentionally selected for their clientele. Love it!

Beautiful store with amazing service! The owner stands for justice and kindness, which makes supporting them even more meaningful. ❤️ Please ignore the negative reviews, they don’t reflect the truth or the quality here!

I love visiting this local store. It’s conveniently located at walking distance from Beaubien metro and sells ethically sourced clothing built to last a long time—much needed in the age of fast fashion that’s destroying the environment. The owner and staff are also very nice!
The best clothing store in Little Italy!! Always very beautiful and ethical! The service is also incredible the owner is super welcoming and has the best advices!! A must try!

A real neighborhood gem! You can tell that so much care has gone into this place, every piece of clothing is ethical down to the last fibre!
The people who work there are also so knowledgeable and will answer all your questions about what they carry. Merci d’être là Betina Lou! ✨✨✨

name: STUNNING Women's Fashion + Accessories, ByWard Market, Ottawa
address: 6 York St, Ottawa, ON K1N 5S6, Canada
reviews:
I ordered the Spaghetti Strap Multi Coloured Maxi Dress
made in Italy. It’s absolutely beautiful and just as described.
I love it and would order from this small local business
again. I’m in the US.

They fit great, beautiful colour...( Barel pant)they feel comfortable and cozy all in one! Went threw my closet and found a funky abstract shirt with black, olive green, turquoise and other colours with a splash of sequins in the pattern.. I can't wait...
You have a lovely shop by seeing your videos.
Keep it up, it's always fun seeing what you ladies put together!
Cheers
Nanci ☮️

I absolutely adore Stunning and the owner. The styles are so fun! As soon as I saw the unique tshirt with a satin jungle print panel in one of her posts, I knew I had to get it. I love the personal touch with the hand written note! 😍

A Little Gem for Something Special
If you’re looking for something special—or you simply love to browse beautiful things—this is a store you must visit!
It’s filled with wonderfully curated pieces that can instantly level up an outfit, with enough variety to suit all kinds of personal styles. I’m so happy I discovered this gem, and I already know it’s going to become a regular stop on my favourite Ottawa shopping route.
Definitely worth a visit!

I loved my first time at Stunning! I walked in 2 mins to close and was welcomed warmly. I found the perfect gift for my daughter, and had a great chat with the owner who was very attentive and helpful.  I promise I'll be back to look more thoroughly,  there appeared to be lots of gems. Thx again!!

I bought 3 pieces last year and still love them dearly, and it was hard to pick just 3! It’s a little shop, but every piece is beautiful, and great quality, Mandy has a great eye. If you are tired of going to big stores and being disappointed go here. I’m going to Ottawa this week and I can’t wait to see what's new.

I moved to the market and was curious  to check out more unique local businesses. I would see the shopkeeper often in the mornings with the cute little dog, so I decided to drop in. She was talking to other people and acted like I wasn't there for a good 10 minutes lol. It was super awkward because the store is so small and I wasn't greeted, acknowledged, nothing. I never returned after that. To her credit, I find a fair bit of market vendors to be standoffish, probably due to the nature of the area, so she's not the exception here.

Big fan of this shop and of the owner (the entire team is amazing)! I've only popped in a couple of times, but I haven't left empty-handed yet! With only 2 visits (and following their TikTok) Stunning is really helping me amplify my personal style <3

name: Era Vintage Wear
address: 999 Rue du Collège #41, Montréal, QC H4C 2S3, Canada
status: Shop for updated vintage women's clothes
reviews: By far the best vintage in Montreal, high quality, clean showroom - she also has alterations on site. Some of the most unique & chic pieces I own I owe to Era 🤍 would reccomend if you are looking for interesting and true vintage - everyday and formal wear !

Amazing store. When visiting Montreal Era is a must go! Era’s clothing have a vintage flare without without feeling outdated. The owner is wonderful, when the pants I was purchasing had a missing snap she gave me a discount and some fabric to fix! Highly recommend this store for any vintage lovers!

Amazing hidden gem in St-Henri. Went there for vintage prom dresses and found exactly what I wanted. The owner is so lovely and very passionate about what she does. What I love about it is that they're very size inclusive. Everything is undone so they can make future adjustments. Lovely setup too.

Wow what an amazing store! Gorgeous clothes and amazing customer service.
The owner is so friendly and a joy to talk to.  She didn't bother me while I was browsing which I appreciated, and when we did chat she was so lovely!

This is not a regular vintage shop. All the clothes have been almost totally taken apart, cleaned and put back together again, or restyled.  Everything can be worn straight off the hanger.  Considering this, the prices are also amazing! The alterations, cleaning and repair required for many vintage pieces would cost the same alone, and you would have to find them first!

Also, amazing customer service! I bought a dress 40% on sale, and she totally re-sized the dress for only $20 of alternations.  Addditionally, I am from out of town and she offered to mail the dress to me for free. When I called and told Elaine I had a formal event coming up, she sent it express post the next day at no charge!

The shop owner also encourage me to email before I come next time so that she can put some things aside for me in my size before they get snapped up.

I have a new favourite store, it is too bad I don't live in Montreal.

Loved it! Great steals at great prices and a unique shopping experience where the owner gives you the attention you need.

As for the question of the originality of her clothing brought up in the previous review...obviously the owner alters them, like duh! That is precisely her business model: she finds beautiful vintage pieces in need of TLC and restores them to bring them up to date. If you're looking for untouched pieces in their "original" state with signs of wear, then look elsewhere. The attention to detail allotted to each and every piece is what makes shopping at ERA so special.

This place is a wonderful little secret. The clothing is beautiful and unique and masterfully tailored by the owner, Elaine. She will take a vintage piece that is perhaps unwearable in 2022, and transform it so that it is.
Very environmental since it’s all pre-owned. My favourite clothing store. Prices are reasonable. Service is excellent.

This is my new favorite vintage shop and I'm so happy that I finally went! I adore the fact that the owner is all about upcycling clothes and even better that they are true vintage. There is a ton of selection from 30s-80s and they will rework pieces for you if they don't fit. This is truly a gem of a boutique ❤️

Hands down, the best vintage store in Montreal! The pieces are so unique. The store is gorgeous, like a beautifully curated treasure chest. A lot of pieces are upcycled and nothing looks dated. A very inspiring place.

name: Gilded Cage Boutique
address: 303 Ottawa St N, Hamilton, ON N1L 0P5, Canada
reviews: When I discovered this gem boutique in downtown Guelph, I wondered what took me so long! Everything fits and feels like a dream, especially since the garments are often curated for their natural fibres and craftsmanship as well as ensuring ethical practices. I have worn so many pieces and everything is beautiful. Plus Sandy, the store owner, is so friendly and attentive and really cares about her clients' satisfaction. A must visit!

Sandra is the absolute best! She supports ethical brands, supports communities in need, and curates beautiful clothing and other products in her store. I have purchased several beautiful items from this shop.  My favourite is this wrap dress.  I get so many compliments on it every time I wear it.

The Gilded Cage is a boutique with beautiful clothes. Every time I visit Guelph, I make sure to visit this shop. Sandra is a lovely person and looks good in every one of the items in the store! She is really helpful in putting together outfits for you and is very patient and generous with her time. It's nice to know too that she works with women's collectives and helps them earn a living. The only negative is that there are too many things I want to buy when I'm in the store! I will be back for sure. Thank you Sandra.

I had a very positive experience with Guilded Cage. I did an online order and Sandy went above and beyond to help me with it. Im out of town but look forward to visiting the boutique next time I'm in the area. It has a really unique assortment of nice items. Thanks Sandy!

Beautiful store and great size options! Absolutely loved the experience. I sit at a 16-18 in sizing right now and I had no issue finding a perfect dress for a wedding this summer. I messaged in advance and Sandra  had gone out of her way to set aside a bunch of dresses for me to try on. Fell in love with all them and committed to a blue kimono-inspired dress, up-cycled from a sari!  Truly one of a kind store. I will for sure be going back!

Gilded Cage Boutique offers a delightful selection of beautiful clothing! I love the ethical roots in the products. From the African leather collection, to the upcycled saris, each item is purposefully selected to lead a more sustainable "slow fashion". I have bought so many unique and gorgeous pieces from Sandy's shop, and am always excited to see what's in store. I always loved visiting the boutique and having a lovely experience trying on new clothes, and feeling great in them! I moved away from Guelph but still order online. Sandy is very thoughtful with her customers (thank you!).

Gilded Cage is a boutique like no other!!  I'm not even kidding when I say as soon as you walk in you feel you are somewhere exotic.  It feels like you've walked into a little piece of Heaven.  Everything is GORGEOUS!  Everything you see and touch is the utmost in quality.  Everything there you just won't find anywhere else it's all so unique.  I fell in love with everything.
Including Sandie!  She is absolutely wonderful.  She goes over and above to help you with anything you need and even the things you didn't even know you needed. She's so sweet and kind and has the best dimples ever!  You truly want to be her best friend!
What an amazing experience you will want to have over and over and over again!
Thank you Sandie!  Your stunning boutique is truly my favourite ever!

We found this store by accident yesterday in beautifully restored downtown Guelph.  What a find!!! I can’t stop thinking about all the unique, stunningly beautiful items of clothing!!  And so many options from gorgeous silk  shorts to classy straw hats for women and everything in between . After checking out their website, I plan to return today to purchase an outfit! Their website doesn’t begin to show the quality and striking items they sell. The shop itself feels like you’ve walked into an authentic high end market in Morocco  or India with all its best pieces.  The silk !!!!  Worth the drive!!

name: Escape Women's Clothing Store
address: 703 Bank St, Ottawa, ON K1S 3V1, Canada
reviews: After just moving downtown, I discovered this shop and I will be back. After days of looking for an outfit for a backyard wedding, I came here and found something within 20 minutes. The owner of the shop is lovely and very helpful. While I was there, there were several customers who they knew by name so obviously have regular clientele.

I have been a client of Escape Women‘s Store for many years.  It‘s always a pleasure to visit the store.  They have a wonderful selection of clothing and the staff is friendly and very helpful.  On my recent visit I noticed the mention of face masks.  I appreciated this as I have members in my circle who are immune compromised and I am very conscious of staying safe for them.

It's been almost 2 months since the mask mandates have been lifted in Ontario and this store is not only posting a request in the door for patrons to wear a mask but they also harass clients as they walk in if they don't have one. This is absolutely ridiculous. It is clear that Escape has a complete disregard for provincial health recommendations and city by-laws. The lady was also rude to me when I expressed my discontent about her oppressive expectations. I will never walk into this store again. I do not support this kind of discrimination.

Escape has a great selection of clothing and as importantly very helpful staff who work there. The store and the people who work here are terrific. Thank you for keeping us all safe. Really appreciate the signage up front re preferring masking at this time! Thanks!

while visiting Ottawa we came upon Escape store; this was our worst experience in all the fashion stores we visited so far,  rude welcome, mask requirement harrasement (though for 2 months masks not longer requiered), rude staff; we walked out very quickly ending up in a much more welcoming stores; so NO for us Escape is definitely NOT  a store to go to

reviews: Great staff and amazing curation of cute clothes! Love shopping here on a day off, it feels like a treat. Shout out to Jilly who went above and beyond to help this girl out for a last minute wedding guest dress.
SASH WAS SO FANTASTIC! She had such a great personality and sense of style. I ended up leaving with the cutest items and I will 100% be back. She really made my day!

Always have the best experience shopping at Lee and me. The girls are very helpful with finding clothes that suit my style and body shape. I only buy my jeans from Lee and me since finding them a couple years ago!

I don't think I've ever purchased anything here I didn't get constant compliments about. They have phenomenal taste and their peices are both stylish and comfortable at a fair price point given the high quality! Not a new customer but was so impressed with the new storefront. Jill was super helpful in picking some pieces out for me I didn't know would suit me and I'm so grateful!

We loved the maple view location, and this new location in Hamilton has exceeded our expectations! Such warm, welcoming and knowledgeable staff, and the store had a wonderful selection of clothes and accessories. Definitely recommend 😊

name: Damas
address: 1209 Ave Van Horne, Outremont, Quebec H2V 3S5, Canada
reviews: We visited Damas on a Saturday evening for a double‑date to celebrate our wedding anniversary, and from the moment we walked in, the staff made us feel genuinely welcomed. We ordered a range of dishes, with the cheese borek and lamb hummus standing out as clear favorites. The mixed grill is essential if you want to sample their different meats, each cooked beautifully. And don’t hesitate to ask for extra bread as it arrives warm, soft, and impossible to resist. Throughout the meal, the attentive service really shone, from changing our plates between courses to keeping our water glasses filled. It made the whole evening feel thoughtful and special.

Food was very yummy! And the atmosphere is great. Gotta get the mint tea... the best.
Special shout out to the girl who tended to us while we waited for our table, her personality was outstanding and she came and checked on us a few times after we were handed over. The wine connoisseur also gets a shout out, paired very nice wines with our meal and we had fun learning about it.

First time trying Syrian food and I was completely blown away with the food.  It was fresh, aromatic, healthy and absolutely delicious.

Service was absolutely amazing. Tessie our server was phenomenal.  She explained the components of each dish.  Made some really good recommendations.  Even though it was a fixed menu, accommodations were made based on individual preferences.

The wait staff were absolutely fantastic.  Every time we completed a meal, the servers came by to switch out our dishes, cutlery and clean any crumbs off our table.

Overall an amazing experience and would definitely recommend this restaurant as a must stop when visiting Montreal

Life changing experience. I have been to a lot of good middle eastern places around the world but this is by far one of the best. I did the tasting menu and every dish was incredible. I heard the guy next to me say that the food reminded him of his mom’s cooking, that’s how you know. I think my favorite was either the fattoush or the pastirma. If you sit at the bar you definitely gotta try to strike up a conversation with Amjad (not sure if I spelled his name right) - he’s a really great guy.

Damas was quite the experience.
Take a look at the pictures for an impression of the ornate interior.
Lots of love in every detail.
But of course the food is the star, once you have made peace with the price tag of $160 for the six course (9 items) tasting menu, which gives you an amazing tour of Syrian flavors as interpreted by Damas.
Everyone of these comes with a thorough description by the server that gives you the details.
I discovered something I had never tasted before, a caper berry I thought was a pickled pepper.
I'm not a food expert and this was unforgettable. Try a smoked cocktail, which you can also get without alcohol.
Our server, Nick, was a local foodie who happily answered my hundred questions. At the end he gave us a list of recommendations for other places to try, for experiencing the amazing Montreal food scene.
Come and be impressed!

WOW! We are not professional restaurateurs, but this was the most amazing experience we have ever had.
The food was phenomenal. The hummus platter was perfection for an appetizer.
You MUST get the cheese borek. Their warm flaky pastry stuffed with creamy cheese was mouth watering good.
For our mains we had the Fattet Mozat, which my fiancé said was the best dish he has ever had.
I was looking for something a bit lighter, and throughly enjoyed the Shish Taouk. The chicken was flavoured and grilled to perfection and the sauce under the potatoes was just the right amount of spice.

The most amazing thing we experienced and witnessed was how well the establishment was ran. From our server who was welcoming and very helpful with the menu and drink selections , to the staff who kept our waters filled, cleared our plates and cleaned our table in between each dish. To the staff we witnessed walking around making note to the status of each table to ensure everything came out in a timely manner. It was quite the spectacle and to everyone who made our evening special we thank you!

Damas offers a brunch experience that is as curated as it is flavorful, blending influences from both Eastern and Western cultures for a unique culinary adventure. The restaurant operates on a set-price menu, starting at $55, with additional charges depending on your selections. While it would be nice to see an a la carte option, the structured menu ensures each dish is thoughtfully prepared and cohesive.

The coffee is a standout, beautifully brewed and aromatic, setting the stage for the meal ahead. The dishes themselves are vibrant, richly spiced, and layered with flavor, making for a wonderful introduction to Syrian cuisine. Each bite is carefully balanced, showcasing both boldness and nuance without ever feeling overwhelming.

The ambiance enhances the experience: warm wood tones, magical lighting, and cozy decor create a welcoming and almost enchanting atmosphere that complements the food beautifully.

Overall, Damas delivers a brunch that is flavorful, memorable, and culturally immersive. For those seeking a thoughtful introduction to Syrian cuisine with a touch of cross-cultural flair, it’s a satisfying and elevated way to spend the morning.

BRUNCH.  We ate dinner here one night and brunch 2 days later.  The front of house and the wait staff were amazing both visits.  Very friendly, just as helpful, and food recommendations that were extremely enjoyable and right on point.  As amazing as the entire series experience is the food is even still the star.  The flavors are creative and well put together.  I highly recommend this place if you eat, and you’re in Montreal, you need to try it!

I wish I took more pictures of the food but it was just that good we couldn’t be bothered.

address: 140 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5C 1X6, Canada
status: Upmarket cafe in a venerable building
reviews: Really nice atmosphere and a beautiful place to have coffee. The coffee was slightly above average and overall I enjoyed it. It gets very busy, so finding a seat can be difficult, and it can be a little noisy. Still, I had a good experience and would come back. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Very cute and cozy coffee shop. Their breakfast sandwich is great! Lattee is amazing. Nice little neighborhood gem

Such a cute coffee shop! The Americano was delicious and the patio is perfect for a nice summer day. There is great wifi and prices are super reasonable- I got a large drink and coffee for about $10! Would definitely recommend!!

Is this the best Dineen location?

I’m not sure, but it is for me.

Is this the best Bay st. Adjacent spot to close the deal over a Cortado after lunch at Sud Forno?

I’m not sure, but it is for me.

In this one of the most aesthetic delight per-square-foot cafes on Yonge with Carrot Cake?

I’m not sure, but it is for me.

I was looking for a nice cafe to grab some caffeine and a snack while I was touring Toronto and found this place. I needed a power outlet to charge my phone which this place thankfully had. The interior was very cool aesthetically and the location is nice - around Yonge Street. My latte was delicious and although they did forget to give me my carrot cake at first, the barista who looked like a young Val Kilmer was very apologetic about it. The rest of the staff were very work focused and kind and one even complimented my camera when he came to pick up my empty plate. Overall would definitely come back if I’m in the area.

name: Art-Is-In Bakery
address: 250 City Centre Ave #112, Ottawa, ON K1R 6K7, Canada
status: Bakery-cafe for baked goods & light fare
reviews: We had a great breakfast at the Art-Is-In Bakery! The Eggs Benedict, sandwiches, and desserts were all delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere is unique and full of character, making it one of the most memorable breakfast spots in Ottawa. Highly recommend!

Absolutely loved our breakfast here. The drip coffee was hands down the best coffee I’ve ever had. The breakfast plate with the potato cake was to die for, and the almond croissant was on another level, not just a normal croissant, genuinely the best I’ve ever had.

The service was also 10/10. They were insanely busy but still so friendly, fast, and attentive. You can tell they really care about quality. Will definitely come back if I’m in Ottawa again!

Stopped in during lunch on a Sunday not realizing they limit their menu for specific days of the week.  The only menu items available at 1pm were pizzas or breakfast items, none of their sandwiches.

They are a bakery and we have been here before.  So among the burgers, pizza, my husband got the saddest order of French Toast ever.  This is an artisan bakery and he got 2 sad thin as chips, slices of French toast, cut in half with more whipped cream than was necessary for the sad 30$ portion. They literally make bread here and they made their French toast from thin sliced toast.  So no custardy centre.

The service was sporadic.  We never had our waters refilled or check in on.  We ordered a coffee after flagging someone down after the gentleman putting in an order at the POS, put the "I'll be there in a mo" finger up and then NEVER came. Well our coffee literally never arrived so I got up to leave after paying but my husband wouldnt leave until he got it.

We have been here a few times and I think it will be our last.  It was busy but not that busy.

Spent over a hundred dollars for lunch with 2 kids and yes... that French toast.

Hidden gem. Great spot with free parking for 90 minutes. Order at counter and then take a number for table service. The food is very delicious! The atmosphere is rustic with a steel roof so sounds are bouncing everywhere and it's very noisy.

I’ve been coming to Artisan Bakery for quite a while, but somehow never got around to leaving a review. Today I decided to write one after trying another highly rated brunch place that honestly didn’t live up to the hype. It reminded me how much I appreciate this place.

The food here is consistently delicious, and the portion sizes are just right. You can tell that real thought and care go into the flavors; the goal isn’t just to serve a huge meal, but to create something you’ll actually enjoy eating. The staff are always friendly and welcoming, and every visit has been a positive experience.

This is one of those places that’s absolutely worth coming back to again and again. Highly recommended.

It can get pretty busy here on the weekends! Lots of cyclists like to stop by because it's right off the path! Delicious food and pastries as well as coffee. Would recommend going on a weekday morning for a quieter experience or on a sunny day when they have their patio seating out!:)

As a visitor to Ottawa, my local friend took me here for lunch, but unfortunately, we went too close to the closing time, and couldnt order & dine-in the menus we wanted to get. So we ended up just getting a blueberry cronut (croissant & donut) to go, which was amazing! I wish I got more than 1 of this if I knew how good it was.

Even though we went in late, the staff was nicr enough trying to give us recommendations for alternate restaurants for late lunch.

I would love to come back to dine-in for their lunch next time I visit, as their lunch menus seem amazing (ex: hot honey chicken burger)!

Show them this picture and order this(forgot the name of it) but it was the yummiest brunch i had in a while. They also have homemade tomato sauce that tastes nothing like i have ever tasted before very flavourful.
The service is ok and atmosphere doesn’t have much to offer but the food was yummy.

name: Lazar Famous Deli & Bakery
address: 325 Central Pkwy W Unit 12, Mississauga, ON L5B 3X9, Canada
status: Shop & cafe with European baked goods
reviews:
i’ve been coming here for years, and it’s still one of my favourite spots. they open really early, which is great if you’re looking to grab breakfast or coffee before work, and they also have a nice patio along with indoor seating. it does get really busy, but there’s a reason it’s always packed. they have a huge selection of fresh breads, pastries, desserts, deli meats, cheeses, imported groceries, and hot prepared foods, so it’s a great place whether you’re grabbing breakfast, shopping, or picking up lunch. my favourite is the portuguese custard tarts. everything always tastes fresh, and the pastries aren’t overly sweet. the staff are also friendly, and even when it’s busy, the service is efficient.

edit: after taking a closer look at a photo of the custard tart, i noticed what looked like a small particle on top. i’m not sure if it was a hair, dust, or something else, but it wasn’t something i expected to see, so i just wanted to mention it (photo at the end)

Lazar Famous Deli & Bakery is one of those places that immediately leaves a positive first impression. From the moment you walk through the doors, you're welcomed by the aroma of freshly baked bread, pastries, and espresso. After hearing many good things about this bakery, we finally visited, and it certainly lived up to its reputation. If you're looking for authentic Portuguese and Italian baked goods along with a quality deli and café experience, this is definitely a place worth visiting.

The bakery specializes in Portuguese and Italian breads and pastries, and it truly feels like they use fresh, high-quality ingredients in everything they make. The display counters are beautifully stocked with an incredible selection of freshly baked products. Whether you're looking for artisan breads, croissants, cookies, donuts, pastries, or desserts, there is something here for everyone.

One thing that immediately stood out was how busy the bakery was. Despite being packed with customers, the atmosphere remained organized and welcoming. That alone says a lot about the popularity and consistency of the bakery.

During our visit, we tried several items, and every one of them was freshly baked and delicious.

The Portuguese Custard Tart was outstanding. The pastry shell was crisp and flaky, while the custard filling was smooth, creamy, and perfectly balanced in sweetness. It tasted authentic and is easily one of the better custard tarts we've had in the GTA.
The Pistachio-filled croissant was another highlight. It had beautifully flaky layers with a generous pistachio filling that wasn't overly sweet. Every bite tasted fresh, buttery, and satisfying.

We also tried one of their chocolate cookies, which had a soft texture with rich chocolate flavor without becoming overly sugary. Their pastries strike a nice balance where you can actually appreciate the ingredients rather than just tasting sugar.

The croissant itself deserves special mention. It was light, flaky, buttery, and baked exactly the way a traditional croissant should be. Paired with one of their cappuccinos, it made for a wonderful breakfast. The cappuccino was smooth, rich, and complemented the pastries perfectly.

Their espresso coffee was equally impressive. Strong, aromatic, and authentic, it is exactly what you would expect from a traditional European-style bakery cafe.

Beyond the bakery, Lazar Famous Deli offers much more than pastries. The store carries a wide variety of Portuguese and Italian grocery products, fresh breads, premium deli meats sliced to order, cheeses, pantry items, and a large hot food counter serving freshly prepared meals. You can also order freshly made hot or cold sandwiches, making it a great stop for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
The dining area is spacious, cozy, and comfortable. We really enjoyed the relaxed cafeteria-style concept. You simply choose whatever bakery items or food you'd like, find a table, and the staff take care of the rest. It creates a casual yet welcoming atmosphere where people can enjoy coffee or desserts without feeling rushed.

Customer service deserves special recognition. Every staff member we interacted with was friendly, patient, and helpful despite how busy the bakery was. They greeted with smiles and happily answered questions, making the entire experience even more enjoyable.

Considering the quality of the food, the freshness of the baked goods, the generous selection, and the reasonable prices, Lazar Famous Deli & Bakery offers excellent value. Whether you're stopping in for a quick espresso and pastry, picking up fresh Portuguese bread or shopping for specialty groceries, this bakery delivers an authentic European experience.

I went to Lazar Bakery in Mississauga to try their famous treats, and it was worth it.

They have a great variety, including cakes, cookies, puddings, cheeses, and other dairy products. But the standout for me was the Pastel de Nata. It has a wonderfully creamy custard, a beautifully baked caramelized top, and crisp, flaky tart edges that really bring it together.

It is so dangerously good, which is very darn easy to keep eating. I enjoyed it a lot and will definitely be back soon!

Excellent Portuguese / Italian store with wide variety of goods including grocery items, fresh meals and large variety of baked goods. Doughnuts are delicious and always fresh. Portuguese bread rolls are great as well as the brioche buns and wholewheat bread loaf. Great place to grab a quick bite. Coffee is super good with something for everyone. Highly recommended!

Excellent customer service from Adriana she answered all of our questions about the cakes and pastries that were on display   and on how much time is needed to place an order for one of their custom cheesecakes. Their pastel de nata is the best I’ve ever tasted in the Mississauga area. Please come and see for yourself you will not be disappointed!

Love this bakery/ cafe.It is very  charming. There are many options of food. The cafe bakery has  a huge varieties of pastries,  cakes, breads, ready to eat meats and sandwiches,  warm food, and so much more. Love their hot beverage options too.
I like the comfort of
selecting  the food.  I plate it on a plate or in a box. You can pay and eat..or inform the staff that you are dining in.  They will note down the food and beverage and can you pay later.
We  always sit in their cafe, enjoy the food and beverage.  Next go to the bread section, select the breads and pay for everything together.
My family too loves Lazar Deli & Bakery. Its always busy, buzzing with energy,  lots of smilng happy faces.. Its busy,  but we always find a table quickly.
Service is great, helpful staff.

Everything looked amazing but didn't live up to the expectations. The brownie was too dense and sweet, the cream in tiramisu cup was heavy and not fluffy like it should be, the lotus cake tasted kinda stale as as well, eclair not pictured here was super disappointing too! The dough was chewy and the chocolate topping fell off when you try to bite it. I was soooo excited when I saw this bakery as its close to my work but I dont see myself returning here, at least for the sweet things.

This place is insanely good and the service is INCREDIBLE! I’ve been here 4 times now and each time was amazing. Finally a bakery where all of the staff are very nice. It is such a welcoming atmosphere and I can’t wait to go back. I almost hesitated writing this review because I don’t want it to get overcrowded with people once all of Mississauga realizes this is the best bakery ever. But I couldn’t help but write the review as I wanted to help the bakery out, too. ❤️🎂

name: 7 Spice Bistro
address: 30 Gillingham Dr, Brampton, ON L6X 4P8, Canada
reviews:
Really nice place for some great food... The service is good but I wanted to highlight the drained employees working tirelessly I don't know for how long... They seemed too tired tbh!
The food on the other hand was really delicious, we got the chilli chicken, chicken and paneer momos..
Also the mushroom stuffed was really nice.. everything was on point... The hakka schewazan noodles were decent as well .
Also chilli cauliflower was delicious... Loved it and would like to try the other things later as well...
The order took a lot of time seeing the crowd that was there...

7 spice bistro is one of the best Indian n Hakka Chinese joint I have visited in Brampton. We even got catering services multiple times for large gatherings200+ people and the food n quantity was beyond expected. Maan Singh ji is an exceptional chef and host I must say. Highly recommended for all your party needs👍

Ordered Chicken Lababdar. The chicken was NOT cooked properly - it was raw / undercooked inside.
I brought it back and spoke to the chef directly, expecting they would fix it. Instead, the chef completely refused to admit there was any issue. I told him lam not eating for the first time in my life, I know when chicken is not cooked.
I was honestly one of your biggest fans and always recommended your food to others, but after this attitude, not anymore. Food safety is not a joke.
You lost a loyal customer today.

Myself and my family had the pleasure to dine at this establishment here in the heart of Downtown Brampton! We had excellent service by both staff and manger who provided warm hospitality and paid attention to detail to accommodate our needs. The food was hot, perfectly flavored, and a generous portion with affordable pricing! My favourite was the vegetable spring rolls as it had a fresh flavor with a lovely kick of ginger! The fries on the kids menu was crispy and delicious!

10/10 food, drink, and service! Wonderful work to your team, I'll definitely be back again!

Went there during our visit and liked the ambience and food. Our server Ayush was very good and courteous.

Liked the food there. Will go there again definitely.

name: Union Social Eatery
address: 6986 Financial Dr Unit 6, Mississauga, ON L5N 8J4, Canada
status: Casual gathering place with varied fare
reviews:
The food was HORRIBLE.

We ordered through the app to avoid waiting, but when we arrived at the scheduled pickup time, the waitress told us our food hadn't even started cooking yet because they were overwhelmed with orders. We ended up waiting another 20 minutes.

I ordered the Seoul Steak Bowl and Parmesan Truffle Fries. The steak bowl was missing the avocado, and the steak was so chewy that one piece actually got stuck in my throat, making it painful to swallow.

As for the fries, there was no truffle flavor whatsoever. They had no salt, weren't freshly cooked, and were cold, dry, and oily when we opened the container immediately after receiving our order. Even the waiter admitted that our food had been sitting on the counter for at least four minutes before it was handed to us. Based on the condition of the fries, it felt like they had been sitting around much longer than that.

The presentation didn't help either. The Parmesan cheese looked like little maggots scattered across the fries. They really need to find a better way to grate and serve the cheese!

Overall, this was one of the most disappointing takeout experiences I've had. Long wait, missing ingredients, poor food quality, and cold fries. I won't be returning for sure. And btw my order is $46. Find a better way to use your money instead of throwing them to the garage.

This was our 2nd visit and we tried their steam whistle fish n chips, nachos with guac which comes with half nachos and half the pita bread. Also tried the chicken bowties. The food was amazing. The pasta had a little indian touch to it. Their cocktails are also great. On our previous visit we tried the almond crusted chicken tenders which was also nice.

Server was very attentive.
Calamari was good
Food was below standards especially the bowls. Not sure what happened this time, not usual for this restaurant

Union Social is the place my wife and I celebrate special occasions.  We do it quietly just enjoying our company, the food and service.

I had the pleasure of taking my work team for a well deserved evening out.  We were placed under a fantastic server named Mackenzie.  She was so attentive, really watched out for our table and others, watched her all over and smiles on all her customers faces.

The food as usual was top tier.  I raved to my team I’ve never had a bad meal.  They all left full and happy with our evening out.  I wanted to thank Union Social for proving me right and now on the list for 5 new customers.

And last of all Mackenzie, thank you so much for taking care of our group.  It made for a great evening that we were long overdue for.

I've been to another Union Social Eatery and didn't really like this one.  The sandwich I got, had two chicken breasts practically falling out of it with some avocado thrown on top, which was also falling off too.  Just very sloppy all around.

name: Musafir Kitchen & Bar
address: 156 West Dr, Brampton, ON L6T 5P1, Canada
reviews:
Amazing food and excellent service! We were served by Gunweed, who was very friendly and attentive. He specifically pointed out that the dishes were made with mild spices, which was perfect for us since we can’t handle very spicy food.

Every dish was delicious, flavourful, and well-balanced. We really appreciated the thoughtful recommendation and great service. Definitely one of the best Indian dining experiences we’ve had. Highly recommend! 😊

Had a really good experience here! The food was great, but honestly the service made the visit even better. Riya was so friendly and welcoming, and she made sure we had everything we needed. She was really nice and attentive the whole time, which made us feel comfortable and taken care of.

Really happy with the experience overall. Riya definitely deserves a shoutout for her great service! I’ll definitely be coming back.

We had an incredible experience celebrating my son’s birthday here! The service is truly top-level—Sonia and Gursimran were both so polite, professional, and attentive throughout the lunch.

The food was delicious; the Dahi ke Kabab and Chicken Rara were definitely the highlights of our meal. We also really enjoyed the cocktails, which were tasty and perfectly balanced. To top it all off, the staff surprised my son with a birthday cake, which made his day so special. Highly recommend this spot for great food and even better hospitality!

Had a wonderful dinner here recently! The restaurant has a lovely warm and cozy vibe that makes you feel welcome right away. I was particularly impressed by the service—it was incredibly quick, and the staff was very polite and attentive throughout our meal. A special shoutout to Mandeep, who was very helpful and made sure we had everything we needed!
The food was the real highlight. We started with the Veg Tandoori momo and hara bhara kebab, both of which were delicious. For the main course, the garlic naan was exactly how I like it—thin and crispy—and it paired perfectly with the Paneer Lababdar. The paneer dish was exceptional in both quality and quantity. To wash it all down, my kid really enjoyed the mango shake while I had a fresh beer on tap. Overall, a very satisfying experience. I’d definitely recommend friends give this place a try!

Cannot fault this place. We ate paneer pav slider, tandoori momo and hara bhara kabab and all 3 were excellent. The Paneer Tikka Masala is the best i’ve had in the GTA. Do order the Pineapple raita - it had no artificial sweetener taste and the yoghurt was so fresh. Definitely visit here, the staff is so friendly & welcoming

status: Comfy cafe for coffee, pizza & more
reviews: Stopped by for a coffee after work on a Tuesday night and ended up staying way longer than planned just to photograph the light coming through the front windows. The espresso tonic was excellent and the barista was happy to chat about the roast when I asked. It's not huge inside but the exposed brick and low lighting make it one of the better spots in the city for a moody shot. Definitely coming back on another weeknight when it's quieter to try more of the menu.

Very disappointed with the brunch I had! Not only was the presentation mediocre, but the taste was just bizarre. It honestly felt like it was made by an amateur chef. What a waste of money. And keep in mind, this was the first item on their brunch menu, not some random choice!

I have to admit, though, the ambiance and interior design were vibrant and unique. Not sure if I want to give it another chance.

Very lovely cafe, I was very pleasantly surprised by the brunch menu and the distinct flavors present in each dish.

This place was recommended to me many times, and I have to say it absolutely met my expectations.

The decorations was gorgeous, with many plants and wooden furnitures giving a casual but elevated look. Very comfy, very nice.

The food was albeit a bit pricey but absolutely delicious. My friends and I got the poached eggs, the corn tortillas and the waffle green olives, and we all loved our dish. I took the waffle green olives and I found it to have many flavors while being well-blended. It was honestly impressive!

I also found that it had many vegetarian options. It was not particularly well labeled on the menu but there are many!

The staff were also quite friendly and quick, all good on that front too. There was a lot more space than I expected; the place is quite spacious and can accommodate rather large groups. I would recommend making a reservation.

Very lovely place, will be back!

wow. lots of places to sit and eat! we had a reservation beforehand and it went smoothly. we were a group of five.

the food portions were appropriate and so very tasty, we all loved our dishes!

they use seasonal veggies as well. i got the ragout legumes and it was sweeter than i expected and filling.

the salmon salad , the salmon was cooked and had cream cheese which was well received.

the presentation of the food was magnificent. lovely staff and lovely place.

recommend!

Very nice spot for lunch, drinks or supper.
Big inside. Nice size terrace too.
Food menu changes and always pretty delicious. Some pizza options as well.
Gets busy during lunches and 5-7 hours.

Great spot. Unique pizza toppings and fresh amazing salads.

Had the pizza with shrimp. And shredded lettuce... Reminds of a green goddess salad and a big Mac but with shrimp.

Good service and nice decor.

Food was good, the white marguerita was a little bland, I wish there had been lemon zest or something to make it pop. My friend’s watercress pizza was very good, salad was nice. Decent prices for the big servings and quality. A bit too loud

I love the style, original paint crumbling decor. The antiques everywhere are just beautiful. I had the poached eggs with spinach and it was delicious. The waitress was very nice and courteous.  A place to come back.

name: BOUILLON BILK
address: 22 Rue Sainte-Catherine E, Montréal, QC H2X 2W5, Canada
reviews:
An outstanding dining experience at Bouillon Bilk. The service was exceptional, the food was delicious and beautifully presented, and the ambience was refined and inviting. Each dish was carefully explained, which added to our appreciation of the meal and made the experience even more enjoyable.

The linguine was flavourful, although I found it a little saltier than my personal preference — that may simply be my palate, as I am not used to heavily salted dishes. Overall, the quality, creativity, and attention to detail were excellent.

A wonderful restaurant and a memorable dining experience in Montreal. Highly recommended.

8-course tasting was delicious start to end, no misses.

The beef tartare was a big surprise for me and my husband. The addition of clam and kimchi really made that memorable.

The duck, will be dreaming of it, love the addition of rhubarb, oh and that duck wonton!

The crab, the white asparagus - such great flavor pairings on the plate.

Highly recommend!

The service is amazing and very attentive.. cutlery are changed after every course, that's something you find see in many places these days.

Food presentation was great, every course looks like an art piece and tasted perfectly balanced.

Definitely a place to check out in Montreal.

Ate at the bar for the tasting menu as a solo diner. Inconsistent is the best word for this place. Each dish either impressed or disappointed.  Stand outs was the pasta, but duck was chewy and the fat undercooked.  Desserts were one note. I chose the discovery wine pairings and the somm pouring the wine was dispassionate and disengaged.  They require a physical card and not tap phone wallet for purchases over $250, which is ridiculous because a tasting will surpass that amount. As a tourist in another country I find it safer to not bring physical cards with me. So they had to do two transactions…it wasn’t that they had to do that, it’s that it goes to show Bouillon Bilk doesn’t think about the experience. I recommend finding somewhere else.

Still my favorite fine dining restaurant in Montreal. The food, service, and atmosphere are always exceptional, which is why we keep coming back for anniversaries and birthdays.

One dessert in particular has stayed in my memory for years: the lavender dessert I had during my first visit to Bouillon Bilk (photo attached at the end). It was one of the most elegant and unforgettable desserts I’ve ever had, delicate, smooth, creative, and genuinely surprising in the best way.

I still think about it today, and I truly hope the chef remembers this masterpiece and might consider bringing it back to the menu someday. It would be such a joy to experience it again.

name: Best for Bride - Bridal Store for Wedding Dresses and Tuxedos in Hamilton
address: 865 Upper James St, Hamilton, ON L9C 3A3, Canada
reviews:
I had the most incredible experience finding my wedding dress, all thanks to Helena 🤍
From the moment I walked in, she made me feel comfortable, heard, and genuinely cared for. She took the time to understand my vision, my style, and even the little details that mattered most to me. What I appreciated most was how patient and encouraging she was — never pushy, just completely supportive throughout the entire process.
Helena somehow pulled the exact dress I didn’t even know I was dreaming of. The moment I tried it on, I just knew. She made the entire appointment feel so special and memorable, and I’ll truly never forget that feeling.
If you’re looking for someone who listens, understands, and truly wants you to feel beautiful on your big day, ask for Helena. She is amazing at what she does and made saying “yes to the dress” the most magical experience!

My experience at best for bride was wonderful from beginning to end. Amanda welcomed me and worked with the budget I proposed. She was patient and accommodating. I rang the bell and said yes to the dress. Amanda explained everything in detail and was very transparent. Overall, it was an amazing experience. Thank you, Amanda

I had the pleasure of having Gordana & Gloria help me find my dream wedding dress AND on a time crunch. Gordana was an amazing consultant and was super helpful in finding and suggesting the right style/fit for me. I’m so grateful for them and this amazing store!!! Definitely check it out, you won’t be disappointed. Lovely ladies, lovely atmosphere, 5 stars!!! Thanks for helping me say YES to my dream dress!

Thank you thank you thank you!!! I came to Best for Bride with less than a month before my wedding and was paired with Helena. As soon as I entered the store, Helena was immediately there to assist with everything and anything and was absolutely incredible throughout the entire process. She answered all the many questions we had, give guidance on styles and sizes that fit what I was looking for, and made the entire process feel calm, effortless, and so so special.

From the moment our appointment started, Helena made me feel like a true bride and made sure that my Mom and Dad were included in the full experience. She was there to walk us through all kinds of accessories, and gave invaluable advice for the big day that made it truly feel so much more real. I left Best for Bride with the dress of my dreams, and more importantly feeling confident, supported, and like a true bride. I will continue to be grateful for and treasure this experience - thank you Best for Bride and especially Helena!

Edit from May 2026 - Added some photographs of the truly incredible dress from Best for Bride. A million thank you’s again for everything❤️

I travelled from Montreal, Qc to visit this Bridal shop in Hamilton, ON for my Bridesmaids. Upon entering the shop our party was warmly greeted by Amanda and we were treated with such kindness.
The vast selection of gowns to choose from is top tier level. The range of designers is impressive and every gown is meticulously made and displayed with great pride. I was impressed by the entire line of designs available for fittings. From the sparkly to the elegantly understated, it was so much fun exploring the gowns. The Bridal gowns were also so stunning and beautiful, with an accessories selection that was heavenly.
The service is impeccable and we highly recommend this gem of a Bridal shop to anyone looking for their dream wedding dresses with a fabulous experience! Best For Brides isn’t just a clever name, it’s an honest and perfect statement  that lives up to its promise.

Thank you to Amanda for helping me find the perfect dress when I was feeling like I wasn't going to find the right one! Your expertise was so important in helping me find what I was looking for, would not have found my dress without your help. Thanks Gordana for warmly welcoming us back for an appointment to show my dress to the group!
Everyone we have interacted with at Best for Bride has been professional and friendly, making a very warm and comfortable environment to try on dresses.
Thanks again!

Amanda at Best for Bride was absolutely fantastic! From the moment we arrived, she was incredibly helpful and seemed to understand right away what we were looking for. She took such great care in helping my daughter into the dresses and made her feel comfortable and special throughout the entire appointment.
Amanda also did a wonderful job selecting accessories that perfectly complemented each dress. Her eye for detail and genuine enthusiasm really made the whole experience unforgettable.
Thanks to Amanda, what could have been a stressful process turned into such a joyful and memorable moment for both my daughter and me. I would highly recommend Best for Bride—and especially Amanda—to any bride-to-be!

After a couple lackluster experiences at other stores, I had an amazing first visit with Gordana! She understood what I was looking for right away and made me feel so comfortable and special. This was definitely an experience every Bride should feel during the wedding planning process! I can’t wait to come back and hopefully say yes to the dress - they were all so beautiful I couldn’t pick just yet!

name: Qamaria Yemeni Coffee Co.
address: 271 Queen St S, Mississauga, ON L5M 1L9, Canada
reviews:
Qamaria Yemeni Coffee in Mississauga delivers an experience that feels thoughtfully curated rather than simply trendy. The assorted pastries are a particular highlight—fresh, delicate, and well-balanced, with textures and flavours that pair beautifully with the coffee selection.

The Pistachio Latte is exceptionally well executed: aromatic pistachio notes, a smooth espresso backbone, and just the right level of sweetness without overwhelming the coffee. The Adeni Chai is equally impressive, offering a wonderfully fragrant spice profile with a depth and warmth that lingers elegantly on the palate.

What stands out is the attention to balance—nothing feels excessive, and each element complements the next. A sophisticated take on Yemeni coffee culture with genuine character.

A destination-worthy café and an easy five stars.

I came here for the first time today and the drink was excellent- worth the price as it is a bit more upscale here. I got the iced Qamari latte & I can clearly taste the cardamom it’s a clean proper iced latte. I can hear the staff giving recommendations to customers as well which is always nice & helpful. the vibe inside is really nice & it’s very clean, plenty of seating options and cool art. The staff are friendly & polite! I am enjoying my overall experience and will be back!

Perfect place for coffee/tea and hangout with friends. They serve drinks very fast and has lots of delicious dessert options. I tried Adani tea, very good. Neat and clean with max 84 capacity. Highly recommend.

Come for the Dubai Croissant, stay for the vibes!
I’m convinced the bakers here have a PhD in crispiness. 🥐✨
I ordered their Dubai Croissant, and oh my god, it is an absolute game-changer. They actually heat it up for you until it achieves maximum crunch. The filling? Absolute perfection—super crunchy, and thank goodness it’s not too sweet, so you don’t feel like you're getting an instant cavity. Easily the BEST Dubai chocolate product I’ve had so far.
Now, let's talk about the drinks. Flavor-wise? Perfectly up to standard. Wallet-wise? A little expensive for me (my bank account shed a tiny tear 💸).
But honestly, given the gorgeous interior design and the overall aesthetic, it’s well worth a try! Plus, they have a cozy little seating area upstairs where you can actually sit back and enjoy your food.

Qamaria was one of the most unique and memorable additions to our wedding, and I cannot recommend them enough!

From the very beginning, they were an absolute pleasure to work with. They took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and even allowed me to customize the drink menu, creating a personalized tea station package that perfectly suited our wedding. They were incredibly accommodating, responsive, and genuinely invested in making sure everything was exactly how I envisioned it.

What really impressed me was the care and dedication they put into ensuring everything would run smoothly on the wedding day. Before the wedding, they even visited our venue to meet with the venue owner and familiarize themselves with the space so there would be no surprises on the day itself. That level of preparation and professionalism gave me so much confidence and peace of mind.

The tea cart itself was absolutely beautiful and became one of the standout features of our reception. So many of our guests were surprised and excited to see Qamaria at the wedding. It was such a unique touch that made our celebration feel even more special.

The drinks themselves were absolutely delicious, guests kept going back for more throughout the evening, and even now people still talk about how amazing the tea station was. It was truly one of the biggest highlights of our reception.

If you're looking for something unique that your guests will genuinely remember long after your wedding, I cannot recommend Qamaria enough. Their professionalism, flexibility, attention to detail, and outstanding service made them such a joy to work with. They exceeded every expectation, and I would absolutely hire them again for future events.

Thank you for helping make our wedding so memorable!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely amazing experience at Qamaria! The atmosphere is beautiful, warm, and welcoming, and the service was excellent from beginning to end. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome.

The desserts and drinks were outstanding—fresh, flavorful, beautifully presented, and clearly made with quality ingredients. You can really feel the care and attention they put into both their products and the overall experience.

Qamaria is a wonderful place to relax with family and friends and enjoy authentic flavors in a beautiful setting. Definitely a place worth visiting again and again. Highly recommended!

Love coming to this place when I get a chance. Such a beautiful hidden gem. The staff are incredibly friendly, and great place to get a coffee right when they open, grab a coffee break with coworkers at noon, or catch up with friends after work. Overall, phenomenal atmosphere.

The coffee, drinks, and pastries served is also delicious, always a great place to keep coming back to.

One of my favorite coffee spots 🩷 No matter how many times I come here, it always hits just right. The staff—including the owner—are genuinely so warm and welcoming. Maya has taken my order a few times, and I was honestly surprised she remembered me! It’s little things like that that make this place feel special and keep me coming back every time ☕✨

name: Cafe Aunja
address: 1448 Sherbrooke St W, Montreal, Quebec H3G 1K4, Canada
status: Arty nook for Persian tea & coffee
reviews: Amazing drinks and great atmosphere! Small wooden tables, books, and plants create the perfect setting for this cozy cafe. I had the Persian Fog, which was absolutely delicious, very sweet. The pistachio foam and saffron make this a unique and flavorful drink. The pastries were also excellent! Limited seating outside and there was a no laptop policy when we visited. Hoping to return here on our next trip to Montreal.

I can absolutely see why this café is so popular. The atmosphere is warm, cozy, and full of character, with great music that makes you want to stay longer. It’s the kind of place where you can slow down, enjoy a conversation, or simply relax with a good drink.
The staff were genuinely friendly and welcoming. I tried the Persian Fog, and it completely lived up to the hype.m. I also ordered the Mountain Omelette, which was fresh, flavorful, and a great brunch option.

Such a unique café , it honestly felt like it had a Persian soul to it. The decor, the books, the atmosphere… everything felt so thoughtful and special. The food and drinks were good too, but the vibe and aesthetic were definitely the highlight for me.

This is an outstanding and unique place to visit in Montreal. The ambiance is fantastic and while it does get busy as the day goes on when we arrived at 10:00 a.m. for breakfast there were plenty of seats. The specialty drinks they have are wonderful, I had a Persian fog and my dining companion had a Persian delight. Both were superb. The Persian fog is like a London fog but with rose syrup. We had the Iranian breakfast and the combo breakfast. At first I thought this is not much food for the price but I was wrong. It is very filling. Although there are many signs that say no laptops there was one person using a laptop, the staff did not say anything perhaps when it gets busier but be mindful that you are not supposed to use a laptop in this cafe as seating is limited.

I really wanted to like this place. It looked cute and artistic. The vibe felt nice.

But I came hungry from overnight flight from Calgary. One coffee, dessert and full breakfast cost 50$ with 15 percent tips.

Food was awful. Super salty potatoes, 2 general eggs, 3 slices of tomatoes that tasted tad bitter. The sausage were store brought full of salt. Bread and dessert didn't feel fresh

Didn't mind spending the money but expected atleast an okay meal at that price point. The decor, ambiance felt nice but it just felt bad overall experience.

name: Alo
address: 163 Spadina Ave., Toronto, ON M5V 2L6, Canada
status: Upscale spot for French tasting menus
reviews: Exceptional 10 course tasting menu. The diversity of the courses made it a unique and robust experience. Refined and authentic. Monica and the whole service team is excellent. Special shout out to Christopher, for the remarkable wine pairing experience. Extensive and distinct.

Had an absolutely amazing experience at Alo Restaurant celebrating my husband’s birthday and our first anniversary! The evening was truly memorable, and the food was exceptional.

Michael was incredibly knowledgeable about the dishes and ingredients, and his passion for the menu added so much to the experience. The service was outstanding and precise throughout the evening, with every detail thoughtfully taken care of. The food had incredible depth of flavor, with each course offering a unique and memorable taste experience.

The only aspect we felt could be improved was the repeated offers of an additional 7th course after we had already selected the set menu. While we appreciated being presented with options, it felt a little unnecessary to be asked multiple times, given that we had already committed to the 6-course tasting experience.

Overall, Alo provided a wonderful celebration and a dining experience we will remember. I would highly recommend Alo for special occasions or anyone looking for an exceptional fine dining experience.

The food at Alo was very good, and both the presentation and ambience were excellent. However, the portions were surprisingly small. Even after the six-course tasting menu, I left feeling hungry, which was disappointing given the price and overall experience. Having visited other Michelin-starred restaurants, I understand that tasting-menu portions are meant to be smaller, but the full meal should still leave guests satisfied. Everything was beautifully executed, but the portion sizes prevented the experience from feeling complete.

I would give the food and service six stars if I could. Absolutely amazing dining experience something I will always remember.
Went for my brother birthday and could not of enjoyed ourselves more.

We did the 10 course food tasting along with a 6 course wine tasting (and Christopher the Sommelier was absolutely wonderful and made the experience that much better)

Our server joydeep was attentive and really blew us away with his attention to detail.

This was the best food we have had in Toronto and will be coming back.

A truly memorable experience from start to finish. The atmosphere was elegant, warm, and inviting without feeling overly formal or pretentious. The staff were welcoming and professional, and the service was attentive throughout the evening.

Each dish was beautifully presented with great attention to detail, and you could really see the thought and creativity behind the menu. Overall, it was one of the more unique and memorable dining experiences I’ve had in Toronto. Definitely worth visiting for a special occasion or simply for an elevated night out.

name: FAT FORK
address: 2200 Dundas St E #1, Mississauga, ON L4X 2V3, Canada
reviews:
went here for lunch as i came to know it is the old zet people
the portions are massive as always and the food is cooked from fresh which i really do appreciate. the service was okay they did not seem very enthusiastic when i was asking what should i try. the price point is high but the portions are massive two people can easily share one meal.
if i am in the area i may or may not go back as the area has many better options but it was definately fun to try. The place is absolutely immaculate and they also have an atm in the place for good convenience. they accept cash, debit, and credit here which is also good.

Quite like the cafeteria style ordering and table choosing.

Staff is super efficient and friendly.

Fries were meh. May have just been an off batch. Fish was not memorable. But to be fair, that’s not what this place is an expert in making. Happy to try the souvlaki next time!

Pictured as well are the pork chop and gyro dinners.

It's my first time here. Heard so much about it. We got the pork souvlaki dinner and the gyro on a pita. Everything was large portions at a good price. Unfortunately my potatoes were cold and the rice was light in seasoning to my taste. Otherwise everything was good. The service was fantastic. The dining room was very spacious. You need to eat here! Have a look at my pictures and press the like button!

Had the chicken and pork souvlaki dinners plus the hamburger plate. Food was okay overall with generous portions. A little too salty for our taste, especially the potatoes, rice, pork, and gravy, but still a decent meal.

This place is great to go to if your really hungry. Big huge monster portions of Greek food on your plate! I love the food here. Amazing comfort food 😋 At times there could be very long lines up but Sometimes its not so busy.. depending on the times you decide to go there. If your looking for some hardy Greek food this is definitely the spot to try out. Food is always tasting  fresh. Try it out guys! Its worth it 👌

FAT FORK deserves an even higher score than 5 stars!! I drive for one of their suppliers, Gordon Food Service, and delivered here a few months ago. I was surprised at how big their order was and how big the restaurant is. I noticed that the back of house/kitchen is clean and modern. I figured that they were ordering so much because they are busy. I decided to come back as a customer to try the place for myself and I was not disappointed! The place was packed because the food is awesome, the service is quick, the value is good, and the dining room is clean, spacious, and comfortable. The pork souvlaki dinner was delicious - and HUGE! I am so excited to come back here in the future. I might even return to try their breakfast menu.

Loved the food, everything was so good.  Absolutely amazing.  The lemon potatoes, thick chunks of perfectly seasoned and cooked chicken, amazing tzatziki, just great. Knocked off points for the hair on my burger though, that part sucked.

A popular greek spot in the neighbourhood, but I don’t see the hype.

I’ve passed by Fat Fork multiple times and always wanted to try it after finding out it was a greek spot. After entering I was surprised at 1. How big the place was. 2. How busy this place can get.

This place is a takeout spot with a large dine-in area, but it can get quite packed both at the ordering line as well as for finding a table so expect that when you come.

Service is decent and quick from what I experienced, so not notes there.

My main confusion is the food. I don’t see anything special about it. I’ve had plenty of greek spots all across the GTA, and I can’t seem to understand what all the hype is about. The chicken was run of the mill souvlaki style chicken, nothing special, not juicy. The salad and rice are your classics, and the potato may have been the best part, but nothing about this dish made me want to come back or think back about this dish. And to make it harder to like, the cost is really high for what you get, but I will say that the portion size is large.

If you want to try a greek spots in the west-end, give this place a try, but don’t expect anything special.

name: La Finca Café | Café, Marché Local Lunch De Quartier Dans La Région De Montréal
address: 1067 Rue de Bleury, Montreal, Quebec H2Z 1N1, Canada
status: Airy coffee shop with light eats
reviews:
Stopped by La Finca Cafe for brunch and really enjoyed it! We had the Croque Madame, focaccia sandwich, canelés, and macchiatos, and everything was so good. The cafe has a really nice, cozy vibe, and the service was super friendly.

The canelés were especially amazing — so good that we ended up ordering another one to take with us on the way out. Definitely a spot we’d come back to if we’re in the area again!

Great food, it was all fantastic,the foccaci bread was the best sandwhich I have eaten in years. Coffee was very good, service was really fast as well. I will go.back soon very reasonable prices. Nice pastry as well

Excellent shop. Super friendly, great coffee, and nice atmosphere for working. I also had shakshuka which was great-on the mild side but tasty. The fact that they have some good food options makes for a great place to work a while which is what I did.

The only place I stopped by twice on my trip to Montreal. Staff is friendly and helpful. But we need to talk about the bagel blt! I am still thinking about it now months later. I like the bagel. I love the filling. Wasn’t loving the coffee as much as the sandwich. But I did have the sandwich twice! It’s that good. One of the best bagels I’ve ever had. And the best bagel sandwich I’ve ever had.

This place really needs to step up its service. From the moment I arrived, I waited in line for about 15 minutes just to place my order. After that, we were given a table but told we might have to move if a smaller one opened up — which didn’t make for a very relaxing start.

My friend and I ordered together, but our dishes arrived 15 minutes apart. He only got his meal after going back up to the counter to ask about it.

As for the food, I ordered the croque madame, which was unfortunately quite bland. Overall, I was really disappointed with both the food and the service. The atmosphere was okay, but not enough to make up for the rest of the experience.
Very good quality price. Recommend it for a breakfast / brunch in the area. Slightly loud inside but doesn’t bother too much.

Nice atmosphere and small terrace on the back. Unfortunately, the quality of the drinks was well below expectations. The chai latte tasted sour and overwhelmingly spicy and the cappuccino had a burnt taste.
Very nice cafe. Food was great. Ordered the bagel blt’s, 2 chocolate croissants and 2 iced lattes, very friendly and efficient crew working over the counter.

name: Alioli Ristorante
address: 350 Burnhamthorpe Rd W, Mississauga, ON L5B 0N1, Canada
status: Casual Italian standby with classic fare
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, China Union Pay, Diners Club, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, VISA
reviews: We celebrated a birthday and thought we’d try Alioli Ristorante, as it’s known for its fine-dining experience. Unfortunately, we were seated near the washroom entrance, which took away from the atmosphere a bit. That said, the food and wine were very good. Highly recommend the fritto and the focaccia bread..absolutely amazing. Thank you to the team for the complimentary birthday cake, it was a lovely touch.

Alioli is in a very convenient location and has a warm, inviting environment that makes dining here enjoyable. The food was delicious — we tried the Bellini, Rigatoni Al Forno, Spaghetti Alla Pescatore, and Risotto Ai Funghi, and everything was well-prepared and flavourful.

Service was good as well, and the person who took our order was especially warm and welcoming, which added to the experience. Overall, a solid spot for a nice meal with great ambiance.

First time going to Alioli, as it was for a special occasion. The prices are definitely on the higher side but food was delicious. Ordered 3 appetizers which were served on a charcuterie board. The flavours of all the food was on point. For the main course we had Fetticcuine Affumicata, Filetto di Manzo and Costolette di Agnello. All dishes were exceptional though the filet was a little over done and the potatoes could have been better. The staff was very friendly and helpful, we enjoyed the decor ans atmosphere however it gets very loud when the restaurant is at full capacity which makes it difficult to have a conversation at your table. There is a lot of free parking available.

I went to Alioli for a business dinner with a group, and it ended up being one of the most memorable meals we’ve had in a while. The staff and our server were courteous, attentive, and genuinely helpful from the moment we arrived. We started with a mix of appetizers — charcuterie, focaccia, and the mushroom bruschetta — all fresh, well-prepared, and perfect for sharing. They also offered plenty of vegetarian options, which was a big win since half our group didn’t eat meat.

I ordered the Gnocchi alla Veneta, and it was outstanding. As someone who travels to Italy often, I’m picky about authenticity, and this dish delivered. The gnocchi were soft and delicate, the crumbled Italian sausage added great depth, and the radicchio with the gorgonzola cream sauce brought everything together beautifully. It tasted like something you’d find in a small Northern Italian trattoria.

The food is on the pricier side, but the quality, freshness, and overall experience justify it. If you’re looking for true Italian fine dining and don’t mind paying for craftsmanship, Alioli is absolutely worth it. Highly recommend for business dinners, special occasions, or anyone who appreciates authentic Italian cuisine.

Alioli is an absolute gem in Mississauga. The focaccia alone is worth the visit—perfectly authentic with rosemary that hits like a flavourful bomb in the best way possible. The calamari is unbelievably tender and practically melts in your mouth. On top of the incredible food, the service is outstanding, and the atmosphere strikes that perfect balance between cozy and elevated. Whether you’re planning a romantic date night or a fun girls’ night out, this spot delivers every time. Highly recommend!
Omg! We went as a group of 5 and everything especially the service was fantastic! We got the seafood pastas and the halibut and mouth watering! Highly recommend.

Thank you To all last night for making our friends 65th bday memorable great customer service all around greeted at the door with big smiles and our waiter FRED made our experience amazing even though we spilled not one but 2 glasses of wine 🍷 on the table and floor 😆  Chefs in kitchen  👏🏻 you rocked
Will definitely be back !

Fancy Italian restaurant that’s great to go for a special occasion whether it’s a date night or birthday. Not cheap, but the quality is exceptional. Their burrata salad (special offering off menu) was amazing and the penne alla vodka was hot and fresh with a creamy sauce and perfect pasta texture.

Would come again for future special occasions. The buratta was $28 am the pasta was $30.
