name: L2
address: 71A Rue De la Gauchetière O, Montreal, Quebec H2Z 1C2, Canada
reviews:
I have passed this dessert and bubble tea shop more than a few times and while the advert at the entrance looks inviting, going up the stairs takes an extra effort.
I am very glad, I did this time.   The L2Lounge looks inviting with lots of seating places, looking very comfortable.   The seats are placed so that each group feels like their own private cubicle.  Drawing display on the wall is contemporary and jazzy.
I like when I see a place that looks to be bright, well maintained and clean.

We had just finished our lunch somewhere else and now ordered one “crème molle” of mixed macha and taro as we are fond of both flavours.   Instead of expecting the usual insolent remarks of many servers in that neighbourhood, being not entirely happy of ordering just one item, the question from the lady behind the counter was “do you want one spoon or two?”   This is what I call customer service at its best.   For this treatment alone, I will definitely come again and bring friends.   This is going to be my favorite dessert place in this area.

The ice-cream was just delicious, creamy and tasting all natural ingredients, with the price being very descent.   There are numerous bubble tea options that look very appetizing and would be on my next visit.   This is a dessert gem, worth exploring.

We ordered two boba teas. Both were delicious, the only issue was we had to wait in line for 15 minutes before ordering. It was crowded on a weekend noon. A bit difficult to find the location as it is upstairs but the atmosphere is very nice and plenty of options to choose your tea and snack from.

This place was upstairs of a building which I think adds a good lounge vibe and suits their name, L2 Lounge. It's a great environment for sweet drinks with friends and chit chat. Has a good selection of bubble tea and other hot/cold Asian sweet tea drinks. The lounge offers a small selection of quick-bites food choices.
We got the Thai iced tea which was delicious. It tasted like the real Thai iced tea and wasn't overly sweet. It was refreshing. It was served in a large beer mug which added to the lounge experience. The poutine here could be better although we weren't expecting much from a bubble tea shop. The fries were thin, long, and definitely not freshly cut.. Most likely frozen bought. Gravy was okay and towards the edge of being salty. Cheese curds were not real cheese curds.

Brown sugar ice cream was not depicted like the photo. Promoted as brown sugar ice cream with tapioca for $5. But when we purchased it, they said you had to add the tapioca pearls as an additional topping. So even though it’s included in the photo, you have to pay extra!

Don’t promote the photo with tapioca if you have to pay extra charges for it! Total rang up to $7

Also the ice cream portion was so small

Came here for some bubble tea. The tea store is located on the upper level of a building in Chinatown which can be tricky to find. I ordered the mint lemon honey tea with tapioca pearls (boba) and reduced (50%) sweetness and less ice. It was very good as I could taste the lemon and the mint. They also have 3 different sizes (small, medium, and large). Seatings available!

name: Coffee Culture Café & Eatery
address: 1220 Eglinton Ave W, Mississauga, ON L5V 1N3, Canada
reviews:
I had a really great experience at Coffee Culture Café & Eatery. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and professional, which made the visit even more enjoyable. My order was prepared on time, and everything came out fresh and well presented.

The food was amazing—great taste, good portions, and you can tell that care was put into the preparation. Nothing felt rushed or poorly made. I also felt that the prices were very reasonable for the quality and portion sizes, so the overall value was definitely worth it.

I really appreciate the combination of friendly service, fresh and delicious food, and efficient preparation. It’s the kind of place I’d happily come back to and recommend to others looking for a good café with reliable service and good value.

Come at a not busy time. Drink are good, the cakes looks very fresh. Nice table and very comfortable booth. Music's are gentle and not loud at all, perfect for chatting, working and studying.

Giving 4 stars only because some table surfaces and floor are not cleaned. I am not sure if it's my illusion or not, there is a bit a smoking smell indoor. In addition, there is no wifi and charging outlet here.

Came by for an iced matcha latte with vanilla cold foam on top today and it is delicious and most definitely on par, if not better, than Starbucks. Excellent service, the barista with pink highlights was super accommodating and helped change my cup lid (I had a recent wisdom tooth extraction, so am staying away from straws). Atmosphere is warm and inviting, perfect for coffee chats, brunch, getting together with friends.

We are a group of coffee lovers exploring local coffee shops as a way to socialize, and this was a wonderful choice! We especially loved the large round table—it made conversation easy and allowed everyone to feel included.

I enjoyed the Salted Caramel Latte, which was both beautiful and delicious. The atmosphere was welcoming, and it was the perfect place for our group to relax, chat, and spend time together. We look forward to coming back!

Great coffee place with an amazing lunch menu! The coffee is always fresh, rich, and perfectly brewed. Their lunch options are just as impressive — flavorful, well-portioned, and made with quality ingredients. It’s the perfect spot to relax, grab a bite, and enjoy a great cup of coffee. Highly recommend!

name: Manpuku Modern Japanese Eatery
address: 105 McCaul St, Toronto, ON M5T 2X4, Canada
reviews: Visited late afternoon on Saturday after the lunch crowd.  The izakaya was still a little busy, yet, there was no problem finding a seat.  Service was pretty quick and I went for the beef bowl with rice called the shigure don.  The beef and rice were well cooked and I enjoyed the flavours. The price was pretty reasonable. Waiting staff were friendly and you have the opportunity to practice your Japanese if you like.  The facilities are clean.

I ordered the Curry Beef Udon. The curry was rather diluted (see video), where I would have expected a thicker mouthfeel. Otherwise, I have no complaints as the thinly-sliced beef was tender and well-seasoned, the portion size was sufficient with a lot of noodles, and the dish was well-priced.

Always a bustling place, but got a table pretty quickly. I ordered the Niku Udon w/ pork (beef was sold out) as the server said it's a popular item. Pretty tasty; the broth reminds me of bugolgi, but not as sweet. Price here is extremely fair and service is fast-paced. It could get a bit stuffy as the ventilation is not the greatest; there is no AC, just a table fan. I'd still come back to try their other items. Such a gem in this city!!

Had a great experience at Manpuku Modern Japanese Eatery! Ordered the takoyaki, tofu nuggets, and kitsune udon. Everything was good and super affordable. Definitely a solid spot for a quick, satisfying meal downtown. Most definitely a hidden gem 😝

The quality of the food for the price is unmatched. I got the ramen and the flavour is up there with some fancier restaurants but with a fraction of the price. The broth was super rich and savoury and the ramen noodles had the perfect texture. I never thought i’d find such a delicious dinner for under 10 dollars in downtown toronto.

name: lobby Hamilton
address: 151 James St S, Hamilton, ON L8P 2Z5, Canada
reviews: Come here for a nice dining experience. Good food. Vibrant atmosphere. Great customer service. Very busy dining on a Saturday, so be sure to book your reservation. We were a group of ten for a special occasion and had a good time here. We were allotted a certain amount of time for our group and that worked out great for us. The food was kind of slow to come out, and that's why they get 4 star rating from me. But when the food came, it was great. The Happy hour starters were a hit. We ordered every listed item and they were ALL amazing. Of the ten meals we each ordered, there were zero complaints. We shared and tasted each other's meal, and our tastebuds delightfully danced in our mouths. Mouthwatering good food that was worth the wait. (Mind you, the restaurant was super busy, so maybe that's why there was the delay). I love that they didn't go stingy on the servings. My group was hungry and the portions were just right that we all left very stuffed. Im a picky eater so trust me, they can cook! Special shout out to the wait staff and servers who were all very attentive and warm. So Thankful they kept checking in and kept our table updated on the status of our food AND made sure we had all the drinks and food we needed. The refill of my tonic water kept me well hydrated 😊. I will definitely come back here when I visit Hamilton again. Im definitely getting that truffle mushroom and truffle fries again. And that caesar salad. I'm especially looking forward to sitting on their patio when weather gets warm enough. Special mention: I love the gender neutral washrooms.

Went here for Ladies night with my best friend. They provided complimentary focaccia bread that was incredible! Our meals were delicious (chicken parm - their signature, and the burger). Our Server Hannah was attentive, prompt, full of great suggestions, and lovely! It was a great experience. Highly recommend!

We attended for a much-needed date night and had mixed feelings about our experience. The food itself was very enjoyable. We shared the chips and guac, roasted beet salad, tiramisu, and had the Salmon Romesco and Lobster Ravioli as our mains. My wife also enjoyed one of the mocktails. The atmosphere was great and had the kind of ambiance we were hoping for on a rainy Saturday evening.

Unfortunately, the service experience overshadowed the night for us. Because it was raining, I dropped my wife at the entrance while I parked the car so she wouldn’t get soaked. Almost immediately after she sat down, our waitress began pushing to order and repeatedly asking questions like “When is your husband’s ETA?” even after my wife explained that I was simply parking the car.

Throughout the evening, we felt consistently rushed despite mentioning that we were parents enjoying a rare date night with a sitter and that we weren’t in any hurry to leave. Even when dessert was discussed and we agreed to see the dessert menu, the waitress returned with the bill before actually taking our dessert order.

We were honestly on the fence about writing this review because the food and atmosphere were genuinely good.

However, when several friends later asked if we would return, our answer was unfortunately no. It felt more like an effort to flip the table quickly than to create an enjoyable dining experience, which was surprising given that the restaurant wasn’t particularly busy at the time and we appeared to be the only table in her section for much of the evening.

We came in expecting a relaxed night out and did everything we could to slow the pace down, but the constant pressure to move things along ultimately spoiled what was supposed to be a special evening for us.

I had a fantastic experience at The Lobby! The vibe is modern, stylish, and super welcoming — perfect whether you're grabbing a casual bite or meeting up with friends.
The food was honestly top-tier. Everything tasted fresh and well thought-out, with great presentation and even better flavor. You can tell there’s real attention to detail in both the menu and the execution.
The service was just as impressive — friendly, quick, and attentive without being intrusive. It really made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable.
Overall, The Lobby is definitely one of the best spots in Hamilton. Great food, great atmosphere, and great people. 100% worth checking out — I’ll definitely be back!

Food was really great.  The Birria tacos were very flavourful and not too oily like some other Birria tacos. Burger and Truffle fries were good as well. Very filling. The chicken parm was also great too.  Pasta was al dente, which is not my preference, but sauce was flavourful.  Our server Leticia was very attentive and super friendly. We will be back eventually.

name: French Corner Patisserie
address: 1224 Dundas St W #114, Mississauga, ON L5C 4G7, Canada
reviews: Been coming here for about 7 years. One of the best bakeries when the pastries are fresh, but frustrating when you get home and take a bite into something stale. When fresh, the mille-feuille, tiramisu, and carrot cake are unbelievable, as if they should be served in the most high-end patisseries in the world. They are refined, delicate, scrumptious, beyond delicious. The almond croissant, the pain swiss, the custard tart, everything is unbelievable. The mango cheesecake is a burst of flavour in your mouth. It's amazing to have such a patisserie here in Mississauga. I think the only item that wasn't too my preference was the pistachio cake. However, a few times I've been quite disappointed to have been served stale pastries where the flakiness and crunchiness of the mille-feuille is non-existent or the the cream in the tiramisu is tangy or the cream cheese icing on the carrot cake is stiff instead of creamy. And I've returned to the store and they've given me a different slice in return, both a disappointing and  frustrating, time-consuming hassle. I now always ask the server to receive a fresh cake slice which I don't feel should be necessary; it should be expected that what you're buying is fresh. But when they are fresh, the patisserie made here are world-class.

Why visit:
1)Want to visit an European style patisserie in Mississauga.This is the place to be.

2) Great options for delicious cakes,cookies and sandwiches.l love their unique cakes and cookies and they both look n taste great.

3) Wonderful place to meet for coffee with friends and colleagues.

French Corner is one of the store I have been visiting a few times occasionally.

Every time I visit they were able to bring good taste and surprises.

I ordered a Chestnut Crème Croissant (forgot the name), Walnut Roissant, Pistachio Coissant? With Cafe Latte and Hazelnut coffee large.

They all taste great.  The coffee would be a little too strong for myself but I do not blame them.  I should be ordering small because I am still getting used to my new stomach after my minor gastro surgery.

French Corner has been a place around Mississauga neighborhood for a long time.  My wife and I are still enjoying the Corner from time to time.

Only thing would be the place is a bit small.  This would be the only thing too cramped during winter.  But hey, good food worth the wait.

——-
Update 2026-03

Well must try Brioche Pudding.  Sometimes the most ordinary food comfort your spirit at the time of need.

My recent surgery requires me to eat something light.  This fulfills all the craves I have for sweet!

Quaint little bakery with authentic French desserts at reasonable prices.

Every item I purchased tasted as expected, the tiramisu was a stand out, and their mozzarella & tomatoe panini was delicious with their pesto.

Their cappuccino was excellent, probably the best in Mississauga, I'd return just for the coffee.

I don’t know what happened to this place. It used to have the absolute best almond croissants. Came here today as I was in the area to stop and have one and it was stale, with very little almond paste. In fact they were so hard that the cut the top of my mouth. There was no butter taste, no sweetness. The staff were two young girls, very friendly. However, this place needs a major renovation, the tables were dirty and had scratches and the paint was chipped on the walls.

I went yesterday morning to pick up some desserts for my birthday. I was really looking forward to trying out this bakery since I’ve heard numerous good reviews, but unfortunately I was pretty disappointed.

I went right about when they opened and they were still setting up some items which is fine, but the asian lady who was at cash just had a horrible attitude. I understand it’s the morning and it can get pretty rough, trust me I work at a deli, I get it. But damn. I was planning on getting some small raspberry desserts, macarons, croissants & cake but I only got 2 of the 4 items because I felt a bit rushed and she seemed like she couldn’t be bothered. Which is whatever, I guess. There was only like 2 other people in the line but it’s alright.

On to the actual desserts, the raspberry cake I got was straight up trash. Maybe I’m more accustomed to Polish & Ukrainian sweets because they’re more delicate but the raspberry flavour was so bitter and just tasted “off”? Not really sure how to put it. It was incredibly sweet though, a bit too sweet, but if you have a sweet tooth then this is the place for you. Needless to say my family and I were pretty disappointed to say the least.

Will I come back? Probably not. Hopefully they can improve on service though.

Came for the fruit pastries and was happy to give it a try! Light, fruity and yummy. I enjoyed the strawberry (lots of fruit in it, kind of jam like) and the mango was good but definitely not enough mango. The peach was not as good... It tasted like the canned peaches which I'm not the biggest fan of. The blackberry was good - the inside was kind of like a gelatin blackberry ball.. wishednit was fresh fruit instead! The other pastry I got was dry, not a fan unfortunately.

Overall, all the cakes have a nice sponge with mousse and chocolate hard shell. A decent price and good to try with friends!

We stopped in to pick up some items to go and were very impressed. We used to live in Japan, and the selection and quality here really reminded us of the Japanese bakeries we enjoyed there. We bought several different pastries and breads to try at home, and everything was excellent—fresh and well-made. They do a great job packaging "to-go" items to ensure delicate pastries don't get crushed on the way home. While we took our order to go, the shop does have a few tables available if you prefer to eat in. It is a great find for anyone looking for high-quality, authentic baking.

name: Daphne
address: 67 Richmond St W, Toronto, ON M5H 3V5, Canada
reviews: I had the Seafood Pasta, Rib Eye, Truffle Fries, King Salmon, Bread & Butter, and Beef Bolognese at Daphne Toronto and honestly, everything was outstanding. This place completely exceeded my expectations.Every dish was prepared to perfection. The seafood pasta was incredibly fresh and full of flavour, the rib eye was cooked exactly right tender, juicy, and rich. The truffle fries were addictive, perfectly crispy with just the right amount of truffle. The king salmon was beautifully done, and the beef bolognese had that deep, comforting, authentic taste you hope for. Even the bread & butter stood out with its quality.Absolutely deserves 5 stars. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an exceptional meal.

I came with my friends after the graduation. We were not that hungry but we did order some food and desserts and it was top notch. The service was so good. I forgot to get the name of the server but he was so sweet and so was everyone else there. We were in the patio. With having limited options for vegetarians, the pizza we got was so good. We even got a dessert on the house for the grads. The chocolate cake was so delicious. I am definitely going back to the place.

Been twice for brunch and it’s excellent!!! The food is spectacular, don’t miss the yogurt parfait - the menu definitely undersells it. It’s got some sort of cream mousse on top that’s soo good. Just perfect and unique. The ricotta toast was great too though needed some salt. The hashbrown was spectacular. Pancakes also amazing. The mango mixed juice was a bit too sweet, next time I’d get pure OJ. Vanilla latte was great.

Service was also great!! On our recent visit, Sara really took care of us. Everyone is so friendly and pleasant.

Vibes are great too.

Do not miss, can’t wait to come back for dinner!

Had such a great experience at Daphne. The oysters were incredibly fresh, and the pizzas were absolutely delicious especially the Fungi pizza and the Pepperoni pizza. Every dish was full of flavor and clearly made with quality ingredients. 🍕🦪

The restaurant itself is stunning. The interior design is honestly 10/10 beautifully decorated, stylish, and such a great atmosphere to relax and enjoy the experience.

What impressed me the most was the manager’s professionalism and kindness. She handled the situation so politely, humbly, and in such a friendly way. Truly 100/10 service. That level of hospitality made me feel genuinely welcomed and appreciated as a customer.

Definitely a place that makes me want to come back again. ✨

Daphnes is stunning. Gorgeous interior and patio. Came here with 4 friends to celebrate my birthday. We started with the dozen oysters, and squash tempura. The oysters were amazing, the tempura was okay, nothing to write home about. For the mains we ordered the branzino for the table, the clam pasta, the lobster linguine, the truffle pizza and beef bolognese. All of the mains were delicious. The branzino was beautiful and I can see why it’s a popular order, very delicious. I can understand the style over substance accusations the restaurant gets, but I actually found the food to be a pleasant surprise. Small portions however. Service was okay. Between the interior and patio I think our server was busy, so she was not as attentive as she could have been and so we had long wait times between asking for things and ordering. Would recommend for anyone celebrating a special occasion.

I was invited to Daphne last night for dinner, and from the moment I stepped foot into the restaurant I was treated well.

The server and staff were friendly, funny, and personable. We were supported by 3 people. I remember there were two Micheals, and there was also another gentleman, a Black gentleman, who was great.

Ordered their recommended seafood dish, as well as Truffle fries, the table also had various appetitiers (mushrooms, carrots, Brussels sprouts), and we had champagne as well. We also had the sorbet, although we wanted the sticky toffee pudding initially *they ran out of it*. The sorbet trio was delicious.  All of it was delicious. I saw a poor rating on here about food, a rare rating, and I do not agree with the person.

We were waited on with attention, care, and humour. I mean we were also a table with numerous gals.

Would highly recommend. This was the first time at Daphne, and I definitely will be back.

Side note: I hope Mikey does look into laser PRK. Whomever checks these reviews go holler at your boy and persuade him. :)

I hope there's sticky toffee when I go back, it seems very popular.

Had a fantastic experience at Daphne. I came for brunch to celebrate my friend’s birthday! I ordered the shakshuka along with a lychee mimosa, and both were excellent. The shakshuka was flavorful, comforting, and well-balanced, with a rich tomato base and perfectly cooked eggs. The lychee mimosa was refreshing, unique, and a great addition to the meal.

For dessert, we shared the sorbet and the caramelized brownie. Both were perfectly sweet without being overwhelming, and they were a great way to finish the meal. The brownie was rich (but not too rich), while the sorbet was light and refreshing.

The atmosphere was very modern and stylish, and I especially enjoyed sitting on the patio. It was a great setting to relax and enjoy brunch. The service was excellent throughout our visit, attentive, friendly, and professional without being intrusive.

Overall, a wonderful dining experience with delicious food, great drinks, excellent service, and a beautiful atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back and would highly recommend Daphne to anyone looking for a memorable meal in Toronto.

Beautiful place with a lovely atmosphere! The food was absolutely delicious. We ordered the burger and pizza, and both were incredibly tasty. The drinks were amazing too. We really enjoyed everything and would definitely come back!

name: Doctor of Fades – Barbershop • Unisex Salon • Spa
address: 1 Sidford Rd, Brampton, ON L7A 0R4, Canada
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, China Union Pay, Diners Club, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, VISA
reviews: Firstly i waited 20mins despite being on time for my appointment. And now I've been left with a cut on my forehead. Too deep a hairline. And uneven cut beard and some bruises. Didn't even apply aftershave after using a blade. Paid 60$ for this mess 🤦🏻 just noticed after getting home.

Paid a ridiculous amount of money to be treated like an inconvenience. No greeting, no professionalism, just rough handling and an attitude like I should be grateful he even touched my head.
The result? Uneven hair, uneven beard, and parts literally missed. Rushed, careless, and embarrassing. This wasn’t a haircut — it was a waste of time and money.
If you don’t value customers or your own work, it really shows here. Never coming back.

These guys are rip offs. The claim they did a fade haircut... and charged me high price  for fades, when it was clearly not a fade.. see pictures. Never going there again. The guy at the front desk is extremely unprofessional. Avoid this place at all cost.

Had an amazing experience at Doctor of Fades Barber Shop! The service was top-notch from start to finish. The atmosphere is clean, professional, and very welcoming.

Big shoutout to Rajbir — he is truly skilled at what he does. He understood exactly what I wanted and delivered a perfect fade with great attention to detail. One of the best haircuts I’ve had in a long time!

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for quality work and great customer service. Will definitely be coming back!

It was a satisfying experience for me and my mom. I am from out of the country and finding a reliable hair salon was a challenge.. Inspite of reading reviews I was nervous as to how my experience would be- I needed haircut and color. But it turned out great. Both Rajni and Kaval (I hope I got his name right) were very polite and patient in accommodating my requests. Very professional!!!  Would definitely come back next time I'm visiting.

First time visiting this shop. Rajveer was very professional and had great attention to detail. Would definitely recommend and will be coming back. Best part was he doesn’t let hair debris sit on your face, constantly making sure i was kept clean. Good work brother!

I visited this barbershop for the first time after seeing all the positive reviews, but unfortunately my experience was nothing like I expected.

I clearly asked for a high fade on both sides. The barber showed me a photo and asked if that was the style I wanted. I agreed, thinking the photo was just a reference for the overall look. However, there was almost no communication after that.

The biggest issue was that I was seated facing away from the mirror during the entire haircut. I had no chance to see the progress or give any feedback while my hair was being cut. After spending nearly 1.5 hours on my haircut and beard trim, I was finally shown the result—and it was not the high fade I had requested.

When I politely pointed this out, instead of trying to fix it, I was told that correcting it would take too much time. That was extremely disappointing. If a customer isn't able to see the haircut throughout the process, the barber should at least check in during different stages to make sure they're happy with how it's turning out.

The fade was barely noticeable and looked more like a regular trim than a proper high fade. I was also disappointed with the beard trim. It didn't suit my face, and it felt like very little effort was put into shaping it. it was not the way how one should have a hair cut with a professional barber shop paying amount which is conparatively high compared to others
its waste of my time and money and also never expect to visit again

I don't usually leave negative reviews, but I believe honest feedback is important. A haircut can take months to grow back, so getting it right matters. Unfortunately, this was one of the worst haircut experiences I've had, and I won't be returning. I hope this feedback helps improve the customer experience for future clients.

Kawal did an amazing job with my haircut and really cleaned up my beard perfectly. His attention to detail is on another level — sharp lines, smooth blend, and he made sure everything looked exactly how I wanted. Super friendly, professional, and you can tell he takes pride in his work. Easily one of the best barbers in Brampton. Highly recommend.

name: Le Majestique Montréal
address: 4105 Boul. Saint-Laurent, Montreal, Quebec H2W 1Y7, Canada
reviews:
Can I give it six stars? The food was amazing. I've never had so many memorable dishes at one meal! Fresh oysters from the maritimes. Wonderful scallops! A delicious bison tartare. And a whelk dish that introduced me to flavors I don't think I've ever experienced before! And don't skip dessert!

Staff was friendly and helpful, in a fun, vibrant atmosphere, with eclectic decor. An outdoor patio on a major Plateau thoroughfare provides ample people watching opportunities occasionally punctuated by an obnoxious exhaust, but connection to the area.
I can't wait to return!

Came here on a weekday around 7pm and it was quite busy. We got lucky that there was an indoor table for us but the outdoor patio was full. The food and service was amazing, they are very helpful with explaining the items on the menu as they had a lot of unique food options on there. Id say the dishes are a mix of Japanese and French which was very neat. We got their famous hotdog and the lobster spaghetti as mains.

Dinner here was the highlight of our trip to Montreal. The vibe of the place is super unique and special. The food is delicious, but unpretentious. We had oysters, white asparagus, and the hot dog. All were amazing. And don’t skip on the bread - it was unreal. Servers were so nice and helpful!

I would definitely recommend coming here. It’s so unique and the perfect mix of amazing food and chill vibes.

If you're from out of town, and you want to experience the Montréal foodie scene, this place does it really well.
It's vibrant, eclectic, somewhat chaotic and definitely fun.
The food is well though out and feels high end, but served in a non pretentious atmosphere. Power couples dressed to the nines seated next to hipsters with trucker hats. 😂
It's the kind of place where you're better off ordering many plates and serving family style.
The oysters were excellent, the steak impeccable and the risotto spot on.
Nice wine list, with a few great beers too.
Just a great night out in Montréal.

Food is so delicious!

Especially the carrot starter and the carrot cake, i was delightfully surprised.

The hot dog was also a fan favorite at our table! Would recommend if you’re looking for something to share.

Ambience is great, staff is friendly! Great spot for a little group dinner or date :)

I really enjoyed the food here. We got these PEI oysters that were actually really meaty but mild in flavor. It came with a really cute squeeze bottle that had hot sauce in it. I just had to look at it.  We ordered a double ravioli which was the highlight of our meal. I honestly wished there more pieces because 6 pieces was literally a tease. It was buttery and flavorful, and just a well executed ravioli. The sauce on the plate really added to it.

My only complaint was the bison tartare. I didn't really feel it needed that pastry shell? I'm not sure what it was. I also felt like the tartare could have been seasoned more. However, the grilled octopus came out and I forgot all about the tartare. The octopus was perfectly cooked and had a good texture. The sauce that it came with was also very flavorful. All in all, most of our food was very good. It is on the pricier side I would say for the quantity that you get, but I also feel like restaurants get expensive these days because of recession  etc. I would have been more upset if all the food was mediocre. But the food was cooked well, so I'm not totally mad about the price.

The overall vibes of the restaurant is very cool and somehow felt very Canadian? I'm not sure how to explain it. Just the overall look and the design and decor made me feel like I was in a Canadian place.

Loved everything about this cute bar! The food was delicious and the drinks were even better! Staff was super attentive and the interior was cozy and cute! I loved everything about it!

I had an amazing espresso martini and then split the ravioli and risotto! Highly recommend!
Came for dinner on Saturday night for a weekend away from Toronto. Le Majestique had such an incredible and very cool vibe, delicious food and great service. The octopus and carrots were a highlight!

name: Aroma Meze
address: 239 Nepean St, Ottawa, ON K2P 0B7, Canada
status: Cozy tapas bar with upmarket Greek bites
reviews: Came here with a group of 5, of which only 4 really ate much at all. The atmosphere was decent, although it felt a bit cramped. The bathroom was especially cramped. The menu was unclear. It would've been better had they just put a per-person rate next to each item, and then when ordering you indicated how many people each item is for. Service was good when our server came by, but our server was overwhelmed by the number of tables he was dealing with, so we were repeatedly out of water. The drink menu only had wine, and no one at our table drank wine (for various reasons), so we only had water to drink. The food was decent. The dip we ordered was lackluster. The beet tower was delicious, and the only dish they served today that I would be really interested in having again. Well, that and the creme brulee, but it's not hard to find good creme brulee. Every meat they served us was overcooked and chewy/rubbery, save for the seared tuna.

The highlight of this restaurant is the food, amazing flavours, fresh ingredients. Everything is so tasty, not just one thing I would recommend. However, the mushroom gnocchi I could an entire pot. The service is good, but this visit the timing was a bit off, since we weren't done one plate before the next came out, not a big deal. The building is small and therefore with a lot of people it can be loud, so not as intimate as other places with lots of space. Highly recommend saganaki just for the experience alone, so much fun. The servers are always top notch as well. Great stuff!

Perfect intimate dinner, small sharing dishes to share so you can order a lot to try various dishes. They have halal options, open faced chicken, and the lamb tacos were delicious! We usually order the ouzo shrimp, it is served with a fire presentation. Quiet atmosphere so you can enjoy talking rather than listening to loud music. Small venue but worth it! Cold in the winter so dress cozy if visiting during the colder season! We recently came back and tried out some more dishes and finally took photos of dishes that we absolutely love. Hopefully this helps when ordering as I am a visual person I need to see photos before ordering. I will say the last time we came in we dined in the back area. I never sat there. It was quite a different experience than the front, the back felt a little over crowded and I could hear everyone’s conversations. I wish there was speakers or something to dim out the conversations nearby.

First time trying this neat, small yet cozy place. Reservation is needed otherwise you won’t be able to get in. The staff is friendly and takes the time to explain the menu and order process. They recommend up to 6 appetizers to choose from that feed two people. Portions are small but consider that there are minimum six to go through so you will feel full by the end of the last one. Dessert is not included and can be ordered at the end of the meal.

Love the food! Especially the smoked salmon crisps! You think you won't get full because of the small portions, but honestly, by the 4th or 5th dish, you are stuffed. Drinks are also amazing, whiskey sour is absolutely delicious!

name: Buka Maranga Cafe & Catering
address: 6465 Millcreek Dr, Mississauga, ON L5N 5R3, Canada
reviews: I was looking for a late night cafe to get a decently filling meal and a tea to do some work. This place was seriously perfect. Lots of window seating for independent work and couches for shared work. The dinner and working sections of the cafe are separate too, so its quiet if you want to work, and you can enjoy a large party if you're there for dinner. My server Marcos was great, super professional and helpful. They also have cocktails if you want to unwind. Will definitely be coming back for more after day shift work sessions!

had an amazing experience at Buka Maranga! we found this place on a whim; we just searched bagel spots nearby and this spot came up. we came on a busy saturday morning. the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great meal.

the standout for me was the lox bagel - every bite was delicious. i also tried their iced matcha latte, which was smooth, rich, and not overly sweet. it paired perfectly with the bagel and i was not expecting it to be this good.

the staff were so friendly and attentive, and the overall quality of the food and drinks was excellent. i'll definitely be coming back to try more from the menu. highly recommend Buka Maranga for anyone looking for a great brunch or coffee spot! 🥯🍵

Food looks better than it tastes unfortunately. This cafe is very ✨ aesthetic but the food and drinks are very pricey. Drinks are decent but food was a bit of a let down. We ordered a hummus bagel, a four cheese omelette and a flat white, which came to almost $50 😱

The omelette was most disappointing bc it was very tough and overcooked. I have a suspicion that they precook the egg and then wrap in the ingredients to order bc the inside of the omelette was very cooked. The four cheeses were only par melted which resulted in very heavy chunks inside. The order came with home fries and a toasted bagel with butter, bagel was probably the best thing on the plate however for $17, the starring omelette was not very good.

Hummus bagel was tasty, good flavour carried by the fresh herbs and zaatar but $14 for a bagel with some cherry tomatoes, hummus and herbs is just a little too steep for me.

Flat white was good, nothing to complain about there. Service was also very nice, and the atmosphere of the cafe is buzzy, not too loud and not too quiet with half the place for dine in and the other half for people who want to work on a laptop.

I think this cafe has the potential to improve their food if they want to keep prices high but until then, I won’t be going back with so many other cafes in Mississauga.

Had the Sammy with added home fries, plus a lox bagel, power smoothie, and lavender blue matcha. Everything was delicious and clearly made with quality ingredients. The space is small and cozy. tables are a bit close together, so it might feel tight when busy, but we didn’t have anyone next to us and it was totally fine. You order at the front and they bring everything to your table. It’s a little on the pricey side, but the quality made it worth it.

First time visiting Buka Maranga located in Mississauga and I was really impressed. The food was delicious and the service was friendly Everyone was kind and made us feel comfortable right away.

Everything we ordered tasted great and the portions were good too. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers. I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!

name: RASA
address: 196 Robert St, Toronto, ON M5S 2K7, Canada
reviews: The tasting experience menu was delicious and had the wine pairing with it, which went ver well with all the dishes. Would definitely return to the restaurant and book in advance since it looks like limited seating indoors. The patio was wonderful and staff are lovely!

Amazing dinner! The two of us got the experience and wine pairing + the Bronzino. The wine pours were true glasses of wine which was so nice! And sherry for dessert was such a good flavour. All the food was incredible! Michaela was our waitress and she was so lovely and very attentive but never rushed us. After a 22% tip and taxes, the total was $280. It was $59/pp for the tasting menu, $49/pp for the wine pairing and $32 for the additional fish dish. We got seven dishes plus dessert and the wine pairing— I haven’t found another restaurant in the city with this quality and quantity for this price.

Service was great! And atmosphere is good too being on Harbord Street. Food can be better flavor wise as well as the cocktails. Spicy ceviche was great. Their award winning cocktail is really good. The chocolate coconut dessert that they made us try was great.

WOW! What a treat to have eaten at this restaurant. The food was incredibly delicious! The flavours combined really well with each other and weren't too overpowering. Each dish really shone on its own. The quality of each dish was excellent and I can understand why this place was given the Bib Gourmand award. On top of the delicious food, our service and our server was superb! She was friendly and detailed with the menu, which my friend and I truly appreciated. Highly recommend this place, would come back in a heart beat!

It was great to sit outside and watch the world go by.  Food and service was excellent.   I do have to be honest we sent the octopus back as it was very dry and tough however there was no question and our server took it off our bill without asking.  The salad and the short rib were the highlights for us.

Was taken here to celebrate my birthday and it definitely did not disappoint. Like its sister restaurant, the tasting menu is phenomenal value, really well executed, and all around delicious. I personally thought the concepts at SARA landed a bit better, but that could be a seasonality thing. Would love to return.

An amazing dining experience! Each bite was a wonderful explosion of flavors, with a combination of tastes that is truly difficult to describe. The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, and the staff provided excellent service. It’s the perfect place to enjoy a relaxing evening without rushing. Highly recommended!

Nice cozy spot in Harbord Village. We had the Classic Tasting experience for $59. Great selections, all the dishes were excellent. Food portions were great and every dish looked amazing and was full of flavour. Service was great, although we waited a bit past our reservation to be seated, we were offered a complimentary glass of Prosecco and an extra dessert! They were also very accommodating of all dietary restrictions. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a tasting menu experience for an affordable price and great portions.

name: BARROCO
address: 312 Rue St-Paul Ouest, Montréal, QC H2Y 2A3, Canada
reviews: Absolutely loved Barroco! We were in Montreal for 24hours and chose this restaurant. The place is small and classic with rustic vibes. Ambience was romantic and intimate. The porcelain plates were perfect and traditional. The service was excellent! Our server kindly improved the old fashioned we ordered! Last but not least, the food exceeded my expectations — the filet mignon was cooked to a perfect medium rare and the braised beef was soft and delicious…impeccable!!

What an amazing experience! The lights off the streets attracted us in and the vibe, décore and wonderful service made us instantly know we were in the perfect spot.
We sat at the bar and Marc was our host. he makes the best drinks and was honestly one of the most genuine great people I’ve met in a long time. The food was delicious and every item we saw come from the kitchen made us want to order even more.

Thank you Marc and see you again soon!

Returning to Montreal after 10 years,  I had to revisit one of my favorite meals ever.  The menu has changed, but the experience has not.   We had a wonderful evening.  Bavette and Duck Breast were both perfect.  I did feel 10 years older ;).

We'd been wanting to try Barroco for a long time, but as the restaurant isn't very large we hadn't been able to book a last-minute reservation until last night.  I'm so glad we did. Suffice it to say that every dish was a delicious symphony of flavors in your mouth.
Below is a pic of their braised beef in an aged balsamic and maple sauce (usually comes with mashed potatoes, but I asked for asparagus instead) which they've had on the menu since they opened.   If you haven't been yet, you have to check it out!
🩷😋😋

Marc is simply the bomb in terms of mixology! From a fresh twist on a hibiscus infused tequila based cocktail to the perfect vesper martinis and old fashions. We were treated to a show of his skills while seated at the bar and were privileged to enjoy the in-house prepared foie gras followed by a very fresh and flavourful beef tartar. The pavlova for dessert was also off the chart. We will definitely come back every chance we get. This place has never disappointed me through the many years and has gotten better with time.

name: GEORGE Restaurant
address: 111C Queen St E, Toronto, ON M5C 1S2, Canada
reviews:
Another of my irregular reviews of places we’ve been and want to leave feedback to help others.

Some context, we’re lucky enough to travel a lot and to eat in good restaurants across the world (we’re English but do appreciate good food!).

The George was disappointing. We had the seven course menu (effectively 14 dishes between the two) and what stood out was a complete lack of identity for all the dishes. The exception was perhaps the dessert course.

Our overall impression was that the chefs just threw things on a plate and didn’t really think about the taste profiles. Octopus and coleslaw anyone?

You’d expect reasonable variety but I had three fish courses all with citrus elements and two types of beef. Which might sound good but “protein” and “strong sauce” five times over doesn’t build a Michelin quality meal. The presentation of dishes was also lacking (one eighth of a tomato plonked down).

The restaurant had a good vibe, attentive servers but our section had a cold draft from the AC and you could clearly hear night club noise from elsewhere.

We were hoping for a high quality introduction to Canadian food and ended up leaving thinking .. that was a mess.

Nice restaurant, great service, fabulous old English style atmosphere.  We did the 10 course vegetarian tasting.  The food was pretty good; a few points of personal criticism: some of the food was too salty for my liking (although my wife found it to be fine), and overall there was no story or theme to the courses. At the same time, there were quite a few dishes I really enjoyed, and was pleasantly surprised by the flavors.

Came here for summerlicious.

The service was the star here. Both the host and our waiter were professional and welcoming.

I was having a bad day so I think that affected my taste buds. But I would give it another try. The zucchini tartar was cool.

I remember really liking the music being played. Just the right vibe at just the right volume.

Overall I was satisfied with the experience

Overall, the experience was disappointing, especially considering the tasting menu.
The appetizers used fresh ingredients, but nearly every dish was overwhelmed by overly salty sauces, making it hard to appreciate the quality of the ingredients.

The main courses were even more disappointing. They were not only excessively salty but also far too greasy, leaving the meal feeling heavy and unbalanced rather than refined.

Unfortunately, the dessert was completely forgettable. It lacked creativity and wasn’t a satisfying way to end the meal.

Another issue that stood out was the presentation. Several of the plates appeared noticeably worn, with visible scratches and stains that made them look dirty. While they may have been clean, the condition of the tableware did not match the standard I would expect from a restaurant serving a tasting menu at this price point.

The service was also underwhelming. Although the staff were polite, the overall experience lacked the attentiveness and professionalism expected for this type of dining experience.

Overall, the meal with overly salty and greasy food, an uninspiring dessert, worn tableware, and mediocre service, I left disappointed and wouldn’t return.

We had the 7 course dinner for two and they served us both different dishes. This was hands down the best dinner I’ve ever had 🤩 the dishes were so well executed and well presented. Every dish was a work of true culinary genius! The service was also amazing, overall excellent time here! Would definitely recommend for special occasions

name: Bakery On Mavis
address: 5700 Mavis Rd, Mississauga, ON L5V 2N6, Canada
reviews:
I barley do reviews but I really feel like this place deserves one.
The last time I was here it was a different name I believe it was Brazilian bakery, but today decided to pass by with my mom and im so glad I did!
The masa from here was fresh and it doesn't have a lemon flavor which is hard to find in alot of bakerys and my kids will actually eat this masa.
We decided to order 2 tosta mistas and 2 galaos and both were delicious. The galaos actually tasted like coffee, nice color to them and not piping hot, just perfect to drink. The mistas were perfect too, right amount of ham and cheese and perfectly toasted. I can also appreciate the put the serving paper under the sandwiches, this is not something you see often at bakerys.
It was quite busy but the wait wasn't long as they were fast. Even the section to get the pastries and bread there was long lines but would always be done fast! The employees that i did encounter were also nice and welcoming.
Cant wait to start coming back. Congratulations to the employees and owner of this bakery 👏
EDIT: Its 10:15pm and in eating the pao com chourico (bread with portuguese sausage) and its good, the bread is soft, taste is great but I find all the chourico to be to one side instead of spread out through. But its delicious.

I come here often to pick up the Portuguese custard tarts, pastries, & dessert items. It was the first time trying their hot sandwiches on the other side of the counter. They were out of the veal sandwiches (2pm) so we tried the Cheesy Steak Sandwich and the Bifana Sandwich. Both were delicious, the mini cheesecakes and chocolate croissant were also so tasty. There is a small patio to sit on the outside and a couple tables in the inside to enjoy the food. I will continue to come here and I definitely want to come back to try their veal sandwich.

Came here the other day and bought some sweets. The corn cake so good. 🌽  The Natas were fresh absolutely delicious. 🙂👌 also got mixed tarts all were fresh and delicious. Honestly I’m definitely coming back to this bakery again. Also got sweet bread 🍞 was fresh and so fluffy I loved it. Good customer service working here are friendly and helpful. My rating I’m giving this bakery is definitely 5 stars. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Loved it from the get go !  Such a huge variety of rolls, breads, pastries, cakes etc.

They have a number of tables for you to sit and sip coffee / tea or a drink and enjoy a bite too.  Ambiance was great!

Service was with a smile😄
Orders did not take long.  One can pick what rolls one wants and pick cold cuts on display and have a sandwich .

It’s in a strip mall so during busy times you have to look for parking.

These are the best chocolate Croissants in the GTA. I love the flakiness of the croissant and the rich chocolate filling. It's rich and delicious. The pound cakes are also amazing. Then the apple or plain one. So light and moist, perfect accompaniment to you morning coffee or evening tea.

Had a great experience overall!

The cold cut sandwich was really tasty—the Italian bun was spot on and made it even better. I also tried the shrimp patty, chicken patty, and cod potato, all of which had great flavor. The only downside was that they were served cold; if they had been hot, they would have tasted even more amazing.

For desserts, the cannoli and custard tart were absolutely delicious. The tart was perfectly flaky and generously filled with custard, and the cannoli was dense, rich, and very satisfying.

Also, if you love chocolate flavour, the mocha is definitely worth trying!

Definitely worth a visit.

Very good bakery on Mavis, tarts are good. Orange tart is a miss. Coconut and almond are hit and miss. Coffee is not that strong, if you like mild or medium it might be perfect for you. Their sourdough bread look nice, people were buying it.

I am a huge fan of Pasteis de Nata, and the ones at Bakery on Mavis are easily among the best I’ve ever tasted.
The crispiness of the crust and the flavor are just perfect. You also have to try their traditional 'tostas' and explore the rest of their fresh pastries, everything is incredibly well-made and delicious. 5 stars, without a doubt.

name: Jellyfish Montreal - restaurant
address: 626 Rue Marguerite-D'Youville, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 2E4, Canada
status: Trendy eatery with an eclectic menu
reviews:
I had wanted to visit this place for a long time, but I kept putting it off because I was worried it wouldn’t live up to the hype. I thought it might just be one of those trendy spots people go to mainly for photos and Instagram stories. I couldn’t have been more wrong. Looking back, I’m actually glad I waited so long — it felt like saving the best bite for last.

My boyfriend invited me here to celebrate our anniversary, and the entire experience exceeded our expectations. The atmosphere was warm, intimate, and perfect for a date night. We were seated at a cozy table by the window with plenty of space around us, which made everything feel private and comfortable rather than crowded.
(In some restaurants it feels like ur sharing a table with strangers. Glad i didn’t have this feeling here)

The service was exceptional. The staff were incredibly attentive and somehow always seemed to appear exactly when we needed something — often before we even had to ask. They were always one step ahead.

And the food was truly incredible. We’ve visited Michelin-recognized places in Montreal, but honestly, if it were up to me, I’d give all the stars to Jellyfish.

It was also such a thoughtful touch to receive a small dessert from the restaurant to celebrate our special occasion.

100% recommended
We love Jellyfish! Topnotch service: kind and attentive. The team took care of us were lovely in all ways. Food was scrumptious and fresh. We love that they serve the whole fish. Highly recommend!!

seems a bit expensive for what it is, maybe cuz of the location. service was super friendly and nice :) for food, burrata was probs my fave with the leeks and bacon but i just love cheese. the tuna crudo was p interesting and rly good too!! just hurts that its like $29 for 5 pieces loool. avocado carpaccio was interesting too but flavours felt too familiar/simple to me (avo, sesame, chili crisp). brussel sprouts sides was mushy not crispy which im ok w but ik some ppl dont like. rotelle bone marrow pasta was definitely tasty but felt soo heavy by itself ha. short ribs came with kimchi and fries. i loved the fries lmao they remind me of five guys fries but the ribs themselves were just alright

🍽️ Some of the best restaurants don't necessarily need a Michelin Star.

Jellyfish is proof that exceptional dining isn't defined by a guidebook. It is defined by execution.

Atmosphere: ✔️ classic and stylish without trying too hard, creating an elegant space that feels equally suited for date night or a memorable evening with friends.

Service: ✔️ Attentive, knowledgeable, and beautifully paced service and dishes.  The staff anticipated needs without hovering, allowing the meal to unfold naturally.

Food: ✔️  They're known for good reason for their crudo. Fresh, vibrant, and impeccably prepared. The star was the lobster toast smoky butter, sweet lobster, and an explosion of umami that lingered long after the last bite. So good we ordered twice. Don't overlook anything from the charcoal grill. Meat great char and flavor and vegetables smoky but still light and flavorful, every dish not competing but allowing the ingredients to shine.

The Extras: ✔️ Fresh seasonal ingredients, an outstanding wine list, and an atmosphere that strikes a beautiful balance between upscale and approachable. In fact, I think this experience will appeal to many people even more than some of Montreal's ultra-modern tasting menu restaurants.

Sometimes the best meals aren't about chasing stars they're about finding restaurants that simply get everything right.

Dining at Jellyfish Montreal was an unforgettable experience. The service was truly impeccable attentive, warm, and genuinely passionate about every detail. The surprise menu was the highlight of the evening, offering a creative and ever-evolving journey of flavors that felt both adventurous and perfectly balanced. Each dish arrived like a work of art, making the entire experience exciting, unique, and completely worth it.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Had a great dinner at Jellyfish Restaurant.

Beautiful ambiance, excellent service, and a great wine selection.We started with the oysters and then burrata salad, followed by the halibut special, and finished with the s’mores dessert. Every dish was delicious.

A great experience from start to finish.

Our waitress, Gabrielle was absolutely brilliant and helped us navigate a perfect food and wine selection for the night. Impeccable service and we loved every moment. Couldn’t recommend this place more!

We had such a blast for our two year anniversary! The server Dana (I believe) and the manager were amazing and very knowledgeable about my partner’s celiac disease and accommodations. They also surprised us with a dessert to celebrate at the end which was very nice of them!

name: Supply and Demand
address: 1335 Wellington St. W, Ottawa, ON K1Y 3B7, Canada
status: Elevated seasonal fare in a chic space
reviews: The appetizers were SOOO delicious. This place has become my fav spot in Ottawa! The pastas can be ordered as half portions so you could taste/share multiple which is great as well. The service was quick and the restaurant itself has great ambience! Highly recommend

I found Supply and Demand after Googling the top restaurants in Ottawa, and now I completely understand why it consistently comes up as one of the city’s best.
We sat at the bar, which turned out to be such a great choice. We had genuinely scintillating conversations with the two women working behind the bar, and the entire evening felt warm, lively, and effortlessly welcoming. Caitlin in particular was fantastic. She had such professional knowledge of the menu and gave us thoughtful recommendations on which appetizers to choose. There is a huge difference between a server simply describing dishes and someone who really understands the food and can guide you toward what you’ll enjoy, and Caitlin was absolutely the latter.
The restaurant itself isn’t trying to impress you with a huge, glamorous interior. Instead, it has something I actually value more: it feels intimate, cozy and wonderfully unpretentious. There was a warmth to the place—and to the people working there—that felt like Canadian hospitality at its best. You sit down, start eating and talking, and somehow the whole place just makes you happy.
And whoever came up with the half-portion pasta option deserves an award. If a full pasta dish is too much but you still want to try one, you can order half. Genius. It also means you can explore more of the menu without reaching that point where you’re too full to enjoy anything else.
Excellent food is obviously important, but the restaurants I remember are the ones where the food, atmosphere and people come together to create an evening you genuinely enjoy. Supply and Demand did exactly that. Caitlin and the team made our first visit exceptionally memorable, and we will absolutely be back.
I especially like that this praises Caitlin’s actual professional competence, rather than just saying “our server was amazing.” It sounds much more credible and flattering.

Absolutely fantastic experience! The food was outstanding from start to finish, and the service was just as impressive. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and accommodating, making us feel well taken care of throughout the meal.

The kale salad was absolutely amazing fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The Ricotta Gnudi was divine: soft, buttery, and beautifully lemony, with a delicate richness that made it one of the best dishes I’ve had in a long time.

I would highly recommend this restaurant and will definitely be coming back!

Supply and Demand has been our go to favorite for years.  It is excellent!!  You must have the oysters and the tuna crudo with olive and truffle oils.
The new shaved white asparagus with Parmesan and balsamic then the cod stuffed with scallop butter mmmmmm!!! We have never had a dish we didn’t enjoy.  ENJOY!!

Food was excellent.  Good spot for those looking for seafood or pasta.   We ordered  tuna from the raw bar that was delicious.    The warm buns and butter are a must as well.   The server/bartender was very knowledgeable about the wine selection and picked out a funky wine to pair with the early part of the meal (pictured), and another for the pasta later (not pictured).   Great wine selection, full bar, and a couple of nice craft beers.

I've been to Supply and Demand a few times over the past couple of years, and my husband and I decided to make a return trip for his birthday. I have to say this past visit was the best so far! We were warmly welcomed by the hostess at the door and our jackets were taken to be stored elsewhere. Our server was absolutely wonderful and she did a great job explaining the flavour profiles of the dishes we had questions about. She recommended that we order around 2 dishes each in terms of portion size, which ended up being just right for us.

Now for the food! Here is what we tried and my thoughts on each dish:

House bread and butter: Honestly, this has been a highlight every single time I've been here (which I never thought I could say about bread and butter). The bread is so fresh and fluffy and the flavours for the whipped butter change every once in a while to spice things up. This time, it was bacon butter (which, of course, was delicous).

Albacore tuna crudo with lemon: Every time I've been here, I've ordered this dish! It's so refreshing and by the time I'm done, I always wish there was more on the plate.

Fried Brussels sprouts with cashew cheese: Creamy, cheesy goodness!

Roast Duck breast: Perfect crispy skin and cooked perfectly! The jus has a deep and rich flavour that complements the dish really well.

Baked Cod: Flaky and buttery, delicious!

Queen Elizabeth Cake: Very similar to a sticky toffee pudding and just as good!

The menu changes seasonally, so we can't wait to come back and try more new offerings!

You will likely find this place on most dining guides, and there is a reason for that.  Their food is great and the service is impeccable. I would recommend 4 or 5 dishes if you are just two people. Their starters are great. We had the leek salad, tuna crudo, and the beef tartar. All these dishes were a knockout. Their pasta was great too. Sadly, we didn’t have room for their famous baked Alaska (which is gigantic!), so if you want to order that you might want to go lighter on the pregame.

I would 10/10 recommend this place to anyone visiting Ottawa.

My friend and I have been to this restaurant several times. It has become somewhat of a tradition for us because the food is consistently exceptional. Even the bread and the house-made butter are memorable, which says a lot about the care put into the menu. Every dish we have tried over multiple visits has been impressive, and the kitchen deserves recognition for that level of quality.

I also want to note that our bartender was very knowledgeable about wine. She took time to explain pairings and origins (France, Ontario county, etc.), and at dessert she offered us an exquisite amaretto and a high-quality spiced rum for my friend. Those details were appreciated.

During this visit, however, the service dynamic at the bar did not align with the overall standard of the restaurant.

While we were seated at the bar, the bartender and another staff member were at moments engaged in personal conversations. I have worked in hospitality management, so I understand staff communication happens, but in a high-end environment those conversations should remain discreet. Anything said at the bar can be heard from one end to the other, so what guests hear should ideally relate to service or the dining experience.

After we had already paid and tipped, I decided to offer feedback. I said to the bartender directly that staff should be mindful of what is said at the bar, since conversations can be overheard and misinterpreted. I was not trying to obtain anything; I directly expressed that discretion matters in environments like this.

The reaction was unexpectedly defensive and disproportionate. The bartender insisted that I was “accusing” her and demanded that I repeat exactly what she had said. Her tone escalated enough that other staff members paused to observe the exchange. At that point, I became reactive as well, which I acknowledge. However, the dialogue did not involve insults or raised voices on my end, and once I realized the conversation was becoming unproductive, I chose to end the interaction. I thanked her, my friend praised the food again and we said goodbye, leaving  respectfully.

I really enjoy this restaurant, and that is why we keep coming back. This feedback is not about the kitchen or the venue, but about the service dynamic at the bar on this particular evening. In a restaurant operating at this level, professionalism and discretion are part of the guest experience.

I hope management reviews this, because the kitchen consistently delivers excellence and deserves service that reflects the same standard.

name: Bar Caffettiera
address: 2055 Rue Stanley, Montreal, Quebec H3A 0B7, Canada
reviews: Straight out of 1990s Milan, everything from the drinks (w very strict rules) to the display of snacks and bottled drinks to the excellent Italian sandwiches and teal & pink color scheme. Love the macchiato, granita latte and anything with mortadella. Also, check out their EXCELLENT uniforms that make it look like a football team is working behind the counter. I love this attention to detail!! If you stay long enough, you will see waves of euro guys come in and out of this cafe with their espresso hydration breaks. The best!!

Cafe with focus on authentic espresso practices (many rules around preparation and what they will or will not do on drink modification requests listed at the entrance). I appreciate the strictness. I’m not well informed on all the reasonings why, but it seems to be for a respect of the craft - which I like the idea of.  Hopefully I can make it out again for another cup before our Montreal visit is over

In the heart of downtown Montreal, there are plenty of places to grab a quick caffeine fix, but there is only one Bar Caffettiera. This iconic spot doesn't just serve food and drinks; it serves a masterclass in authentic Italian hospitality and style.

Walking into Caffettiera is like stepping through a portal directly into a bustling Rome or Milan café in the mid-1990s. The vibe is absolutely insane—in the best way possible. From the retro, colorful Memphis-group-inspired decor to the energetic buzz of conversation, the atmosphere is incredibly vibrant and effortlessly cool. They have perfectly captured the Italian sprezzatura (studied carelessness). Whether you are standing al banco (at the bar) to knock back a quick espresso or lingering at a table, you feel like you are part of an exclusive yet entirely welcoming club.

While the aesthetic is a massive draw, the coffee is what cements Caffettiera’s legendary status. The coffee here is superb, adhering strictly to proper Italian traditions. Expect rich, perfectly extracted espressos with a thick, beautiful crema, and cappuccinos poured with exact ratios—no oversized, diluted drinks here. It is strong, smooth, and served at the perfect temperature to be enjoyed immediately.

Beyond the coffee, the authentic Italian snacks, sandwiches, and pastries (especially the cornetti) round out the experience flawlessly. It is the perfect spot for a quick morning start or a mid-afternoon pick-me-up that transitions smoothly into their famous aperitivo hour.

Bar Caffettiera is an absolute Montreal institution. It offers an uncompromising, joyful celebration of Italian cafe culture right in the middle of the city. For anyone who appreciates superb coffee served with an unforgettable, lively atmosphere, this is a non-negotiable must-visit.

Bar Caffettiera is hands down one of the best coffee spots in Montreal. The atmosphere captures the authentic feel of an Italian espresso bar, simple, lively, and welcoming. The espresso is outstanding, the cappuccino is perfectly balanced, and the pastries and focaccia are fresh and absolutely delicious.

What makes this place special is the attention to detail and genuine hospitality. You can tell they’re passionate about serving high quality coffee the traditional Italian way. Whether you’re grabbing a quick espresso or enjoying a relaxed morning, every visit is a great experience.

If you’re looking for an authentic taste of Italy in Montreal, Bar Caffettiera is a must visit. I’ll definitely be back!

We came back on a beautiful sunny Sunday and once again loved everything about this place. It truly feels like stepping into an authentic Italian café—right down to the imported products and the atmosphere all the staff is great. Even though it was very busy, everything still felt smooth and welcoming.
What really stood out again was the service from Michael. He goes above and beyond in a way that is so completely natural. He was exceptional. Despite the rush, he's friendly,  attentive and genuinely cares that you enjoy you're time there. He took the time to offer thoughtful suggestions, and every recommendation was spot on.
What impressed me most is how natural it all felt, attentive without being overbearing, friendly without being forced. He has a way of making you feel genuinely taken care of, which is rare, especially in such a busy setting.
Great café, incredible products—but service like Michael’s is what makes the experience memorable. We’ll absolutely be back. Thanks again Michael!

Stopped here for a quick coffee and treat. Very cute atmosphere, friendly staff, and yummy baked goods. The coffee was good, too. Not too much space inside, so getting it to go is probably a better option.

There are better options. The young woman serving us was unwelcoming and unwilling to engage in conversation. We wanted to buy some coffee beans and find out more about them, but it seemed she would rather chat with one of her colleagues than provide good customer service. We asked if it was possible to reheat the sandwich and were told curtly, “It’s not possible,” without any explanation as to why.

Focaccia sandwiches were super light, fresh and crunchy. Great coffee. Great bomboloni. Great atmosphere. They made this place out to be a typical trendy “bar” you would find in Italy. Including the all italian staff and typical italian service; a little slow, a little disorganized and a loudly chaotic. It gives you that feeling of being in the old country so for someone who is used to North American standards maybe its not the place for you! Small quaint coffee spot. Can’t wait to go back!

name: Le Boulevardier Restaurant
address: 2050 Rue Mansfield, Montreal, Quebec H3A 1Y9, Canada
reviews:
Food=amazing
Staff (Alexis and Tom)=even more so!

We went to celebrate my sister’s birthday and our whole experience was outstanding!  From the beginning, Alexis was friendly, helpful and professional.  Tom, the sommelier, was so knowledgeable as well as engaging—with him we discovered a new wine we loved that we probably wouldn’t have tried had it not been for him.

The seafood discovery appetizer was delicious and plentiful. It was a great way to sample different seafood.

My brother chose the 5 course tasting menu which was perfectly portioned and a way to try multiple dishes. My steak was delicious and the foie gras was some of the best I have had!  The strawberry dessert was a treat—wonderful flavors and not too heavy.

You will pay the price for an amazing meal here but it is worth it, especially if Alexis and Tom take care of you😊)!

They change the menu, so don’t be disappointed if something you have seen or heard about in the reviews are not available—you will be happy with the other options!

Craving for a foie gras last night, and this place delivers. Wanted to have a quiet anniversary date night with montreal city view. From the reservation, the host, to the waiters, to the sommelier, all excellent. Cheers chef, the menu tasting,  the desserts, and drinks delivers excellently.  Will definitely be back on my next trip!

We did the tasting menu with drink pairings, and it was absolutely amazing. They were accommodating and changed two of the courses for me and the sommelier even chose two new wines to pair with them! Amazing selection of Quebec and French wines. Service was great too, everyone was incredibly friendly. And the food was delicious! I don’t know if I can pick a favourite as all the courses were delicious! Will definitely be back!

Went there on a whim with a friend to celebrate the end of the semester. I was the only one who got the 7 course meal with the wine pairing. The food was absolutely amazing, and the service was perfect. Absolutely enjoyed the wine knowledge of the sommelier and the general courtesy of the staff. You cannot go wrong here. Will be back soon!

Really lovely French restaurant! Showcases classic French dishes prepared with careful attention to flavor and technique. From the appetizers to the mains and desserts, everything is well-executed. The sauces are rich, the proteins are cooked perfectly, and the ingredients taste fresh. The atmosphere is elegant yet relaxed, and the staff are welcoming and knowledgeable. Great place for a date night or a special dinner with friends. Prices are on the higher side, but the quality and ambiance make it worthwhile.

First time at Le Boulevardier, and I ordered the filet Rossini with the aligot replaced by vegetables. The presentation and overall quality of the food were excellent. However, the portion size was quite small, and the dish didn’t fully justify its CAD 58 price tag — I expected a bit more meat for that price. Overall, the atmosphere was lovely, and the waitstaff were attentive and responsive.

The steak and cheesy mashed were scrumptious. The only disappointment was when I ordered a small side salad and they brought a huge salad which I sent back or I would not have room for my main course. So they brought back 1/4 of that salad but still had the nerve to charge me $15. Also the waiter had very strong BO- very unappetizing for a hungry patron.

With Valentine’s Day approaching it was nearly impossible to find a reservation nearby. By chance Le Boulevardier had one table left so we booked it. The reviews and menu looked great and we were excited.

A few days before, we learned it would be a prix fixe menu which initially disappointed us, especially me, since I’ve never been a big fan of set menus. Still we kept the reservation.

We’re so glad we did! The atmosphere was fantastic, the music and service were excellent, and the food was absolutely delicious. It completely changed my perspective on prix fixe menus. Ending the night with an “à volonté” digestive was the perfect touch. An amazing Valentine’s Day, we’ll definitely be back!
