reviews:
Rame was absolutely amazing! He is incredibly meticulous and pays attention to every single detail. You can immediately tell he takes great pride in his work. He listened carefully to what I wanted and executed it perfectly—one of the best haircuts I’ve had in a long time.
The experience at James Barber Shop was excellent, and Rame truly stands out for his professionalism, precision, and skill. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a barber who genuinely cares about quality and customer satisfaction. I will definitely be coming back to Rame again.

We’ve been coming here since our son turned one, and now at 2.5 years old, the experience has been consistently amazing every single time. James is incredibly patient and calm, which makes such a difference when dealing with toddlers. He really knows how to keep them comfortable and at ease.

The haircuts are always flawless. The fades are clean, the styling is perfect, and we constantly get compliments on how great our son’s hair looks. People are always asking us who his barber is.

We truly appreciate the level of care and consistency. James and the entire team are outstanding and we highly recommend them.

Rami provided excellent service from start to finish. He took his time, paid close attention to every detail, and made sure my beard was perfectly shaped and everything was aligned evenly. You can tell he genuinely cares about the quality of his work and doesn’t rush the process. The final result exceeded my expectations—I walked out looking and feeling amazing. I highly recommend Rami to anyone looking for a skilled barber who takes pride in delivering a top-quality cut and beard trim.

First time at this place and got a hair trim ans beard line up from Basil. He did an amazing job, and I'll definitely be back. Worth the drive if your further away and everyone is nice and friendly in the shop. Highly recommend for all your hair needs.

I’ve been coming here for the past 4 months, and the experience has been consistently excellent. The barbers, including Jon, are professional and hold themselves to high standards. I appreciate the attention to detail and the clear explanations of what’s being done with my hair and beard. They use premium, well-sanitized electric razors, which shows the level of care they put into their work.

Jon also took my sensitive skin into account and recommended waxing my upper cheeks instead of using a blade this has made a huge difference for my skin. I highly recommend trying the facial exfoliating treatments as well!

I’m glad I was referred to James Barber Shop, and I would recommend it to anyone looking to upgrade their style.

Got my bald head and beard done by James, and now even my mirror is smiling 😂 Clean cut, sharp beard, great attention to detail, and awesome service. If you want to look fresh, James is the guy! Highly recommend! 👌🏽

Unfortunately I wasn't able to get my haircut with James Barber Shop as they didn't check their Booksy online booking system and had 2 people in my time slot, I had to get my haircut elsewhere at a place that is more attentive to their customers.

Reply to the owner below: I booked the appointment at 10:29 for a 11:15 appointment so that is 45 mins I gave you to see my appointment and prepare for me to arrive. Now everyone can see that not only are you negligent towards your customers in double booking their appointments but now you are a liar as well.

For anyone looking for a honest barber that respects appointments made I recommend you look elsewhere!

Got my haircut by Basid for the first time and I’m honestly impressed. One of the best haircuts I’ve had — super professional, detailed, and made sure everything was perfect. Definitely coming back again and will be recommending all my friends too. Highly recommend! 👌🔥

Such an amazing bakery.  Smell so good from the outside.  Smells even better on the inside.  Everything on the menu is so fresh.  Sandwiches are packed with meat.  Get here early.  Lots of items sell out quick.  Call ahead for any custom orders. Great.  Everything is at a great price point.  Amazing friendly staff.  Clean facility.  No Free WiFi.  Very limited free parking.  Time limited street parking otherwise.  Some free parking in the area.  Take Out Only.  No credit card surcharge.
Love this spot, such a gem! I've tried everything and I'm always left satisfied. It's nice to have a solid meal and not break the bank. Lovely staff, good quality.

Love coming here for their fresh deli sandwiches and pepperettes! The store is always nice and clean the staff here are very friendly and knowledgeable about their products. They offer a wide range of deli sandwiches, ready to eat food, pastries, buns etc.. their sandwiches are awesome and always filling! Great for a lunch! And reasonably priced! I'm always looking for the next best place to grab a deli sandwich and this place is definitely 1st on my list for taste, size, fresh ingredients, price, and service! Prices have gotten a bit ridiculous.  It went from a $2.00 sandwich to a $9.00 sandwich pretty fast. Used to be the place everyone had to go to to save a buck for good quality lunch to an expensive deli sandwich that your paying for nostalgia.

name: Flawless Hair Salon - Ottawa Balayage Expert
address: 6 Antares Dr Unit 4, Ottawa, ON K2E 8A9, Canada
reviews:
I had previously received one of my favourite haircuts ever at this salon from a stylist who is no longer there (picture following that appointment included). I spent a long time growing it out and maintaining the shape.
When I came in for this appointment (December 2025), I specifically asked for a small trim and stated that I did not want additional layers. Unfortunately, I left with significantly shorter layers than I had requested. For someone with fine hair, the loss of weight and shape made a huge difference, and the result was very different from the haircut I was trying to maintain.
I was extremely upset with the outcome because I had worked hard to grow my hair to that point and felt like I lost a style that gave me a lot of confidence.
To the salon's credit, they did not ignore the issue. The owner became involved, I was brought back for a correction, and I later received a complimentary trim to help improve the grow-out process. I genuinely appreciate those efforts and the professionalism shown afterward.
However, once length and layers have been cut, they cannot be undone. Even after the correction appointments, it has taken many months to grow my hair back toward the shape I originally had. It’s still not there. They layers cut up the my ears are still growing out.
I would recommend that anyone with fine hair who is trying to preserve a specific shape bring reference photos and be very clear about their preferences regarding layers and weight removal.

I absolutely loved my hair color! ❤️ Razan understood exactly what I wanted and did an amazing job. The color turned out even better than I expected, and I’m so happy with the results! She was professional, friendly, and made sure I was comfortable throughout the appointment.

If you’re looking for someone who is skilled, knowledgeable, precise, and genuinely cares about her clients, I would 100% recommend Razan. She is AMAZING!! ✨

I highly recommend Razan and the team at Flawless. If you're looking for a hairstylist who truly knows her craft and delivers exceptional results, this is the place to come. Thank you for such a wonderful experience, I will definitely be
back!

name: Boulangerie les Co'pains d'abord
address: 418 Rue Rachel E, Montreal, Quebec H2J 2G7, Canada
reviews:
Amazing. Hands down best croissants in town. Consistently good. Can’t go wrong with any of the it end because the croissant itself is done so well. Crispy and flaky and soft inside.
They sell out very quickly in the morning, weekday and weekends, so make sure to get there early. Friendly employees! No bathroom, only a few sitting areas so best to grab and go.

Lets start with the good. Amazing well executed pastries, fresh and really tasty. Pure heaven. Well priced as well.
Sadly their penini and Croque Monsieur were not done well at all. The ham was still FROZEN inside. Coffee was good and there were enough seats. Not the most inviting seating system. I would go there again for sure but only for their heavenly baked items. They also sell day old baked items for low prices which is very nice.

The weather was beautiful, and I found myself wandering aimlessly through the streets until I arrived at this legendary bakery. It’s tucked away in a charming little neighborhood at the foot of the mountain, yet somehow always full of people.

I originally came for their croissants — and they truly lived up to the reputation, with their delicate flaky layers and rich buttery aroma. But what surprised me even more were the desserts. Every pastry was made with such care and refinement; they were not simply sweet, but carried a kind of gentle elegance in flavor.

Sunlight fell across the street and through the windows, people sat with coffee chatting softly, and the air was filled with the scent of butter and freshly baked pastries. In moments like this, you realize that the feeling of a good life can actually be very simple: beautiful weather, a quiet neighborhood, and stumbling upon a bakery that makes you want to slow down and stay awhile.

We loved this little bakery café! The place feels cozy and welcoming, very local and full of charm. We had a pain au chocolat, a matcha latte, and a flat white, and everything was perfect. The pastry was buttery and fresh, and both drinks were really well made. It’s the kind of spot where you just want to slow down, enjoy the sunlight, and watch the street go by. Definitely a place we’d come back to. 💛
Delicious desserts and pastries, friendly staff, who explained to us about all the ingredients and flavours of desserts. They are from French originally which speaks for its quality 👌.

Whoa! Magnificent! Woke up early to watch the Canadian Olympic hockey game — it went into overtime, so the adrenaline was high. After... we werent feeling our best and stopped in for a quick bite.

From the moment you walk in, the aroma changes everything inside. The energy is super familiar and cozy. It turned our whole morning around. Sometimes you don’t expect much, and then everything just hits right. This place does that.

This is a top notch bakery! There is a wide variety of pastries, breads, sandwiches and more. I had a delightful almond chocolatine from here. I also tried the croissant sandwich with their interesting vege pate. I think I would have enjoyed another option more but the croissant itself was very nice. Service was cheerful and welcoming. Overall a great experience at this excellent boulangerie.

Lovely croissants! I was on a mission to find the best croissants in Montreal, and Boulangerie les co'pains d'abord came up on several lists and travel guides. It definitely lived up to its reputation -- the croissants were super flaky, buttery, and rich, and had a nice crispy outer shell. I had the chocolate croissant (my testing baseline for every new bakery), and I was quite impressed. There isn't a ton of seating inside, but if you're lucky, you can grab one of their stools by the window. I can't wait to come back to try out their other items -- the staff recommended trying out a few of their specialty croissants, so I'm very excited to come back to Montreal!

name: Tartelette Bakery & Cafe- Ottawa
address: 175 Main St Unit 7, Ottawa, ON K1S 1C3, Canada
reviews:
Tartalette Café is such a fantastic spot in Ottawa! Their croissants are absolutely incredible—super light, fluffy, and generously stuffed with delicious fillings. The tarts are also beautifully made, with just the right amount of sweetness and great-quality fillings. I especially appreciate that they’re not overly sweet.
The coffee and drinks are excellent as well, making it the perfect place to sit back and enjoy something delicious. Everything feels thoughtfully made and well balanced. Definitely a 5-star experience and a place I’d happily come back to again and again!

Pretty interesting spot for Ottawa, offering a huge variety of pastries. The desserts are a bit specific—especially if you've never tried saffron before. Croissants were absolutely delicious!  My only complaint is the presentation: they poured the coffee into paper cups and handed over the pastries in paper bags. I truly believe that even at the end of the day, service should be just as good as it is in the morning.

The drinks here are really great and some unique ones too. Fresh pastries and croissants seem to be made with quality ingredients and definitely left a lingering taste! Too good . Staff are kind and friendly. Everything tastes wonderful (whatever we tried!) and simple. Great spot for a coffee and a snack.kudos and truly deserves the best bakery in Ottawa awards that it has received! Will return for more.

This isn’t my first time at Tartelette Bakery & Café, and it definitely won’t be my last. I honestly love everything they do here—every visit has been consistently amazing.

Their croissants are my absolute favorite—perfectly flaky, buttery, and fresh every single time. You can really taste the quality and care that goes into their baking. Everything I’ve tried has been delicious.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it a great spot to relax, catch up with friends, or just enjoy a coffee and pastry. The staff are always friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even better.

Overall, one of my favorite bakery spots—highly recommend!

We (3) enjoyed afternoon tea on December 27 and it was exceptional.  Our servers were wonderful, the savoury and sweet were all divine! Sloane Tea is a personal favourite.  The little touches;  spoons, decorative toothpicks in sandwiches, beautiful big tea cups added to the exceptional.  Must go back for lunch 😋

First time trying this shop and it won't be my last. Chris the owner is passionate about what he does and it shows as soon as you walk in the door.

Tully was just amazing! Been forever since I appreciated how my hair looked right after a haircut. Really impressed with the attention to detail given. Had a great chat with Tully during the process too. All in all, the best experience one can ask for

I’m extremely satisfied with my experience with Tully.

I sat on this haircut for a day before posting, and the more I look at the result, the more I find myself appreciating the craftsmanship, texture, and attention to detail that went into this cut.

Tully is operating at an expert level. I’m not easily impressed when it comes to haircuts, and this one blew me away. His scissor work is masterful - the best I’ve had. It’s immediately clear that barbering is something he’s genuinely passionate about.

From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed. I was given the time and grace to discuss exactly what I wanted, and I felt understood. Tully described himself as a bit of a “nerd,” and that is true. He is incredibly knowledgeable and style comes naturally to him.

Overall, this was the best barbershop experience. Great conversation, exceptional service, and a result that exceeded my expectations - including Chris, the owner.

I highly recommend Tully to anyone looking for a barber who takes real pride in his work. King's Own reputation precedes them, and it's quite obvious why. I will be back.

Wicked service, Wicked Atmosphere, Wicked personality, and a Wicked experience. 10/10

reviews: I have been coming to BN for years. Came on the 24th for my birthday and had a phenomenal experience. Service was amazing (albeit we were the only two people in the restaurant lol) we had the tasting menu which will leave you with more than enough food for two people at a very reasonable price for all that you get. Stand out dish was the steak frites. The BEST cooked fries you will ever have will be here at Berkeley. Steak was also cooked perfectly to our liking. Cocktail menu is fun and innovative. We were also given complementary prosecco for the special occasion. I’d recommend this place to anyone looking to celebrate or just have a nice night out.

I, along with my very good friend Carol, visited Hamilton on September 13th for lunch at Berkeley North. We love going to different cities and restaurants.

The decor inside is light, bright and very modern with comfortable seating. The exposed brick on either side is beautiful and compliments the decor. A lovely outdoor patio compliments the front of the restaurant.

We had a truly distinctive and revitalizing beverage experience. My very good friend selected the pineapple frizz, made with pineapple, angostura, and ginger beer, visible in the glass on the right. My choice was the spiced mint and oolong, blending pink peppercorn, oolong tea, mint and honey. 👏🏻👍🏻❤️❤️

Our dining experience began with the kohlrabi salad, expertly prepared with shaved kohlrabi, cucumber, honey crisp apple, burnt chimichurri, marinated cheese, and pumpkin seeds. The combination was exceptionally delicious, light, and refreshing, leaving a lasting impression on our palates and ensuring it would not be our last. The bartender mentioned this salad is very popular, no wonder. 👏🏻👍🏻❤️❤️❤️

The bartender, waitstaff and kitchen staff are very personable.

A special thank you to Rebecca. She’s the sweetest, kindest, so very personable and a sweetheart. Great service as well.

MY FRIEND AND I 💯 RECOMMEND!!!!
A perfect spot for food and drink around downtown. Our server was so friendly, and the dining room opens right into the patio when the weather is nice. The food is really excellent.

Beautiful space with a warm atmosphere. Food was excellent and met expectations. I’ve been wanting to try this restaurant out for a while. Great service and our server (Robert) was very attentive.

My wife and I ordered from a fixed, gluten free dinner menu for two, so that she didn’t have to worry about what she could and couldn’t eat. Our server made sure to identify that there is some cross contamination with the deep fryer, which highlighted the attentiveness to customer allergies. So more gluten friendly than gluten free, but still an available option.

We had corn ribs, kohlrabi salad, and fried cauliflower as appetizers. Then I had the trout and potatoes, while she had a pasta dish. Dessert was strawberries and cream, and a Basque cheesecake (not GF).

Amazing experience and will definitely be planning another visit.

my friend & i visited last night - we thoroughly enjoyed our experience!
Leanne provided excellent service despite working solo in a full-house on a very busy monday evening.
at first she politely expressed reluctance to seat us & honest concern we may experience lengthy wait time but, she so very graciously allowed us to seat ourselves on the patio where my friend & i more than happily entertained ourselves in conversation.
our experience was well worth the wait.
dinner was delicious! i had the trout & prosecco and my friend had chicken & paloma cocktail. both dishes were beautifully plated and perfect in flavour - i highly recommend the trout w capers to other future diners.
Leanne was lovely and we enjoyed chatting with her at the end of our meal.
kudos to you, Leanne! we look forward to returning again :)
Thank-you, from Barbie & Lorraine

Had a lovely experience at Berkeley North yesterday. Had their set menu which is $120 and priced for 2 people. I did notice for $118 they had a gluten free option for the set menu as well. It was a lovely blend of vegetarian and meat options. The steak frites were amazing and honestly cooked to perfection, but I think the star of the show was the eggplant dish. They had just started their winter cocktail menu yesterday and they are worth trying! The winter colada was very crisp and delicious as well as the whimsical cup. The apertivi was a lovely take on a negroni. All around great atmosphere, service and food/drinks.

Been here many time but this my first time to leave a review. Very small menu. The tuna crudu was a hit. The steak was chewy. The cheese cake was a delight. Very nice service. The trout was very dry. The duck nice was very satisfying. Will not come back but I will leave a 5 star for all the other good times

Can’t rate the food yet because we have been here for 55 minutes for a 12:15 lunch reservation and have not seen a single bite… 5 tables of 2 and one of 6.
Maybe more than one server is needed… especially when he also has to make cocktails!! Not sure if he’s also cooking but we will keep you posted!
UPDATE - food arrived… wished we only the eggplant. It was simply amazing. Sadly the cauliflower and corn were very basic (corn was cold) and lacked flavour. This may be the first time I asked a server for salt at a Hamilton restaurant!
Glad we checked this one off our food bucket list but won’t be returning.

reviews: Wonderful coffee and bottling shop. Super wonderful place to sit in when the sun is shining in the early morning. In addition to great coffee options and pastries, they have a fridge stocked with beers from all over Ontario that are not easily found in your local LCBO. Certainly worth a visit!

Lovely spot. Great atmosphere, lovely coffee & tea, & incredibly diverse & well-made pastries. Big shoutout to Juan & Candice for taking such good care of my friend and I, despite having to deal with a brunch rush. They also have some lovely hip-hop records in the playlist here; I heard Slum Village when I walked in, and Common when I walked out. Definitely gonna be a regular here.

I can't remember the exact names, but I can absolutely recommend the goat cheese & caramelized onion (?) pastry (best dish on the menu in my opinion), the raspberry danish, and the chocolate & vanilla custard chocolatine.

This was one of the most disappointing coffee shop experiences I’ve had.

I ordered a large iced latte with oat milk and paid an extra $1.80 for an additional espresso shot because I was told that both the regular and large sizes come with the same amount of espresso. Since a large contains more milk, I didn’t want a weak, watered-down drink and paid extra for the additional shot.

When I received my latte, it tasted like milk with barely any coffee flavor. I asked whether the extra shot had been added, and the staff admitted that they had forgotten it. Instead of remaking the drink properly, they opened the lid and poured an espresso shot into the already-made iced latte. By then, time had passed, the ice had started melting, and the drink was no longer the same.

To make matters worse, I’m not even convinced that oat milk was used. The taste and texture seemed more like regular milk. At that point I had already left and didn’t want to waste more time coming back after dealing with the first mistake.

I ended up paying $9.20 for a drink that was made incorrectly, “fixed” in the laziest way possible, and still didn’t seem to match what I ordered. If a customer pays extra for modifications, the order should be made correctly. Forgetting ingredients is one thing, but failing to remake the drink after the mistake is poor customer service.

Very frustrating and not worth the price. I won’t be returning.

Cozy spot with communal seating, room for work, and delicious coffee. Enjoyed a Ghost Roaster pour-over and a “hot chocolate” cookie. Staff are friendly and knowledgeable and on this rainy day it’s full of happy caffeinated people!

Grabbed a coffee and a pastry here and it was solid. The chai latte was well made, tasted fresh, and the baked goods were actually pretty good. Just know going in that it's a bit pricey.

The place has a nice vibe, lots of different seating options which is cool, and they've got local art up on the walls. Staff were friendly. Only thing is it was packed when I went in and the line moved a bit slow, but I guess that's just how it is on busy days.

Good spot for a coffee break in the neighbourhood. Would go back.

address: 71 Duncan St, Toronto, ON M5V 2C5, Canada
reviews: Jacob is the best barber I have been to. His hair cutting skills are great, but what sets him apart is his ability to listen to what you want and make sure its reflected. I have thinner blonde hair, and he does a really good job with it.

Jacob was awesome, he took the time to understand what I wanted and actually stopped multiple times during the haircut to make sure I liked how it was looking. On top of being a great barber, he's also a really cool person and very easy to talk to. Can't recommend enough

Been coming to Manstop for little over 2 years, truly could not ask for a better haircut every-time I show up. If you’re looking for a true professional Melanie is your go to stylists, she truly takes her time to understand what you want and always delivers high quality cuts. 10/10!

While on holiday in the city I found this gem of a place
place. The service was friendly and of the highest order... I was really happy with the results as I had not had a proper haircut in 3 years. The girl who cut my hair was so good and very friendly
friendly If I lived here it would be my one stop for all my grooming needs.

Thanks, Ali, for the great haircut and professional service! I’m extremely happy with the result. Highly skilled, friendly, and pays great attention to detail. 100% recommended—I’ll definitely be coming back!

Nick is a great barber. He really listens and brings his expertise to make your cut suit your preference and your face shape so you enjoy your cut. Plus, hooks you up with some great aftershaves to finish off each cut. Price for a downtown haircut is average, but the place has a nice and cozy vibe inside.
Jacob really took his time to understand my hair type and what I was looking for. I have thick hair that curls when long. Jacob is very personable and I’ll be sure to return to his shop, thank you!

Jacob hooked me up for real. The cut is clean, the lineup is sharp, and he paid attention to all the little details. He actually listened to what I wanted and made sure everything looked right before I left. Super chill atmosphere too, makes the whole experience easy. Definitely one of the best cuts I had. I will be back for sure.

address: 3625 Rivergate Way, Ottawa, ON K1V 2A4, Canada
reviews: Mary did an amazing job with my dyed hair extensions! The service was incredible! Vince is an angle and each hairdresser has such an incredible attitude and personality! I highly recommend :)

I have to say that after more than one year having my colour and highlights done by Lee, this is my home. It is consistently an excellent experience where Lee always works with you and you come out looking beautiful each time with comments from colleagues at work reflecting the same even weeks later. After searching a hair salon for quite some time since moving from Montreal, this has become my new family as I once had. Amazing NYNY team! ♥

Mikayla did an incredible job on my blonde, I could not be happier with my results! Efficient and great colour, I will definitely be coming back. Salon is also super clean and all the staff are friendly and welcoming:) If you need your hair done in Ottawa definitely go here!

I had such a great experience with Maria for my very first visit to the salon! She did an amazing job colour matching my roots and blended everything perfectly. Honestly, one of the best root touch-ups I’ve had.

She took the time to really listen, explain things, and we even did a mini consultation for my next appointment which I really appreciated. It made me feel confident and excited about coming back.

Everyone at the salon was also incredibly friendly and welcoming from the moment I walked in. Such a nice atmosphere overall. Highly recommend Maria if you’re looking for someone talented, professional, and genuinely kind!

Everyone at this salon was so welcoming and helpful from the moment I walked in. The energy there is amazing and instantly makes you feel comfortable. They even made me cappuccinos, which was such a lovely touch. Everyone was genuinely friendly and kind.

My hairdresser, Jackie, is fantastic—she did an amazing job and made my hair look incredible. The owner is also very sweet and made me feel truly welcomed. I had such a great experience and would highly recommend this salon.

If you still have second thoughts about going just take a look at the before and after!! I showed her pictures and wasn’t really sure on what I wanted and this is what she delivered! A MASTERPIECE!

From the moment I arrived to the moment I left, I was treated with genuine kindness and care. I had the pleasure of a consultation with Marina prior to my appointment, where she offered thoughtful recommendations that immediately made me feel confident in her expertise.

Marina truly listened to my needs and skillfully corrected both my colour and the texture of my hair. Her approach was respectful, considerate, and tailored, never rushed. The entire experience felt smooth and professional, and I left the salon feeling very pleased with my refreshed look.

Jillian, her assistant, was equally delightful…gentle, attentive, and supportive throughout the process.

I would highly recommend Marina and her team to anyone looking for a meaningful upgrade and a positive salon experience.

This hair salon was recommended by our granddaughters and daughter. We travelled to Ottawa for our oldest granddaughters wedding May 30, 2026 and I booked a hair and makeup appointment here. I called and Reeph was extremely helpful booking my appointment. I was a bit worried if I would have enough time so Reeph had  my hair/makeup stylist Suzie come in 1/2 hour early so I had time to get to the wedding on time. The Salon has such a lively, energetic feel but also very calming, clean and peaceful. Everyone was amazing. My hair stylist was so kind, patient and talented. She did an amazing job with my hair and makeup. The staff is so nice, pleasant and friendly. The cost was very reasonable and I would definitely recommend this salon.

Maria was awesome!  I really appreciated how she checked in with me during the cut and style.  We had a great consultation prior to the cut, and I felt confident that she understood my wants and needs.  I’ve found my new stylist!

The salon itself was busy, but appeared quite efficiently run.  All staff knew their roles; everyone busy and doing jobs: sweeping, folding towels, attending to clients.

Looking forward to my next visit!

name: Restaurant e18hteen
address: 18 York St, Ottawa, ON K1N 5T5, Canada
status: Seafood & steak entrees in high-end digs
reviews: We spent New Year’s Eve at Restaurant e18hteen and had a wonderful experience. The atmosphere is warm and intimate, the food is thoughtfully prepared and full of flavor, and the service was excellent throughout the evening. Portions are on the smaller side, as expected for this style of dining — you come here to enjoy the experience, not to rush or overeat. It truly feels like a high-level restaurant with its own character. A cozy, charming spot in the heart of Ottawa that made our evening special.

A classic Night at 18eighteen — With Steak That Steals the Show

The Vibe: Cool, But Could Use a Glow-Up

18eighteen has that dimly lit, moody, upscale energy that makes it perfect for date night or celebratory dinners.

That said — and I say this with love — the décor could use a small refresh. It leans heavily into a darker, vintage aesthetic that at times feels a little… nostalgic. Almost like browsing the vintage section at the LCBO. It’s not bad, but a subtle modern update would elevate the space to match the quality of the food.

Because the food? Absolutely deserves a spotlight.
The Steak & Mash: Main Character Energy

The steak was phenomenal. Perfectly cooked, beautifully seared on the outside with that rich caramelized crust, and tender inside. Each bite was juicy, flavourful, and confidently seasoned.

But let’s talk about the mashed potatoes.

Creamy. Buttery. Silky smooth. The kind of mash that makes you pause mid-conversation because you need a second to appreciate what just happened. No lumps, no dryness — just pure comfort on a plate.

Together? Elite combination.

We had a fantastic evening celebrating our daughter's University graduation here.
The staff was friendly throughout the entire night. We tried a variety of items across the menu, including appetizers, meat, fish, and desserts - everything was delicious. We were also incredibly touched by the kind compliment from the chef!
Highly recommend for any special occasion and thank you for an unforgettable evening!

Pricey, excellent food and service. Best grilled octopus I've had. Steak was well seasoned, a bit over grilled for a medium rear steak. Overall, I am satisfied with this restaurant. Will visit again in the future.

We dined here last night and had a wonderful experience. The staff was so courteous and professional, thank you to Ovi for such a lovely evening. The food was perfectly plated and the flavours were rich. We ordered from the set menu and the plates came out at the perfect pace. Would love to come back for another celebration in the future.

name: The Alley
address: 1256 Rue Guy, Montreal, Quebec H3H 2S7, Canada
reviews: I recently tried bubble tea here and had a great experience. The drinks were absolutely delicious, with a perfect balance of flavors. We ordered one classic milk tea, which was smooth and  creamy, and one fruit tea, which was refreshing and light with just the right amount of sweetness. The tapioca pearls were perfectly cooked, soft and chewy. There’s a wide variety of options on the menu, from fruity to tea based drinks, so there’s something for everyone. Overall, everything tasted amazing, and I would definitely come back

From time to time, I pass by this shop. It’s a very small place with only a few seats, but it has a nice, cozy design with simple decorations. The cashier was very friendly, and my order was ready in less than a minute. The place is clean, and the background music makes the atmosphere even better.

The menu is quite large, so it’s worth taking your time to look through it. Some items are seasonal, so the selection can be limited depending on the time of year like the brown sugar. I had the melon punch and was good , you can control the ice level and the sugar level , especially for certain drinks. Overall, it’s a great spot if you’re looking for an upgraded coffee experience!

A small little shop for really fresh bubble tea! The store itself has a nice aesthetic, but there’s not too much seating. I tried the Deerioca ube puff. I enjoyed how strong tea flavor was still present while having delicious creaminess. If you’re visiting Montreal, this Taiwanese bubble tea shop is definitely worth a visit!

Favorite place for authentic bubble tea! The teas are always brewed to perfection! The tapioca balls are always cooked perfectly, as well. There's a great selection and I love that it's not all fake powders. You really taste the quality of the ingredients. Great, cozy place for a first date. I wish they had Earl Grey more often 😭

I wanted to try something new, so I gave the strawberry green tea a try, but unfortunately I didn’t enjoy the taste and wouldn’t recommend this one. That being said, the place itself was nice, clean, and welcoming — they probably have other drinks that are much better worth trying.

reviews:
One of my favorite places for manakish in Toronto. Everything is made fresh to order, so it's always served hot and fresh. I especially love the sujuk with cheese,it's flavorful and generously filled. The only downside is that it's a bit pricey.

Their ma'arouk is also delicious. It's like a soft brioche bun filled with a sweet filling. I highly recommend the Dubai chocolate flavor, which is filled with chocolate, pistachio, and crispy kataifi. It's rich and satisfying.

We have been getting Manakeesh from The Bakers ever since they opened in Ridgeway Plaza, and they have never disappointed!
The Manakeesh are always fresh, delicious, and perfectly prepared, with great flavour and generous toppings.It’s great to see a bakery maintain such consistent quality and taste over the years. The staff are friendly, service is good, and everything always feels fresh and well made.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic, delicious Manakeesh in Mississauga. Definitely one of my favourite places in the area! 👌

Absolutely phenomenal experience at The Bakers! From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is incredibly welcoming and smells amazing. The food was spectacular—fresh, high-quality, and beautifully prepared. On top of that, the service was top-notch; the staff was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond. Easily a 5-star spot and my new go-to. Highly recommend!"

If you’re looking for a premium manakeesh spot 😍 look no further than this place. The entire café has a beautiful sage-green theme with such a cozy, homey kitchen-inspired vibe. Everything feels thoughtfully designed, warm, and inviting. And the food? SO good 🤍 Definitely a spot worth visiting for both the atmosphere and the delicious manakeesh! 💚
Server was really nice and polite. The pastries dough are soft. The filings were delicious. Got manakish and other pastries. Sunday at 4 pm was a good slow time. Coffee was ok but limited options.

name: The House Of Mann Hair Design
address: 11 Centre St N, Brampton, ON L6V 1S6, Canada
reviews: I had an excellent experience with Himanshu. He did a fantastic job with both my haircut and beard grooming. He took the time to understand exactly what I wanted, paid great attention to detail, and delivered a clean, professional look. The haircut was sharp, the beard shaping was precise, and the overall service was friendly and welcoming. His skill and dedication to customer satisfaction really stand out. I highly recommend Himanshu to anyone looking for a quality haircut and beard grooming service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I recently visited House of Man for a haircut, and it was a really good experience. My haircut was done by Himanshu, and he did a great job. He was patient, understood what I wanted, and made sure everything looked just right. I felt comfortable throughout, and the overall vibe of the place was nice and welcoming.

I was happy with how my haircut turned out ,it looked neat and suited me well. It’s always great when you find someone who listens and delivers exactly what you’re hoping for. Overall, I had a positive experience and would definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a good haircut.

Trying a new place is not always easy for hair salons. I did my research and landed on HOM.  I was pleasantly surprised and very happy with my visit.  Staff are welcoming, and tended to me several times, water etc.  Music was playing but not overpowering, which created a fun environment.  The salon is a house converted which I love.  My stylist was Nhi and she was brilliant.  She explained every step of the process, and why. She listened, and gave me her expert advice and she was bang on! She is so sweet and very kind. I had pulled a muscle in my back earlier in the day and she kept asking me if I was comfortable and to take my time moving from chair to chair.  I had a root touch and cut - which I was nervous about, but she put me right at ease and the colour was matched perfectly.  The pricing is reasonable and affordable for what I had done. Definitely will be coming back to get my balayage done! Thank you Nhi! I really needed a good cut and style after a long time! 😊

I visited this salon for the first time and was a bit nervous about getting my hair cut somewhere new, but Nhi immediately put me at ease. She took the time to really listen to what I wanted, and when I asked for her opinion, she completely understood the look I was going for. She gave me an amazing new style, and I absolutely loved the result. I received so many compliments afterward — now I just hope I can recreate the look at home myself!  I highly recommend this salon and thank you Nhi!

I stopped in with my little guy for a hope someone would be able to do a walk in quick cut for him. The owner Manny said no one was available which was understandable being the week before school starting- but then he said he could do it himself quick before his next customer! He was wonderful with Callan- so patient and explained it all so he wouldn't be scared. Even showed me how to style his hair after the cut! It's not common anymore for this type of service and I was so grateful for it!

Manny, owner at House of Mann, is a warm, welcoming person, making my experience this morning a fantastic one. He listens to what the clients wishes are and teaches ways to style your hair after you leave. It's more than a cut! Manny, you made my day brighter and lighter! Thank you!!

It’s been over 6 years since I went for a haircut.

At first when they told me about the pricing I was very shocked as it wasn’t expensive compared to stories I’ve heard from people. I believe it was between the range of $45 and $90 just call and confirm.

I called and booked an appointment and got it right away but with Covid it is a bit difficult to get one immediately.

They did a great job since I walked in, the greeting, smiles and cheerfulness of all the team members. Not to mention they hype up their team members for the work they do and the constant compliments given to clients.

The place was very clean and And smelled amazing. I almost fell asleep while she chopped off my long hair. It was a very pleasant experience here and will definitely come back..

Thank you to the wonderful team!!

My hair looks and feels amazing!

I have been getting my hair done from a lot of places. But I must say I found my hair dresser for life- #Himanshu was really awesome. He gave me the prefect hair cut. Now I know I am not going anywhere else from today onwards. Perfect place to get your 💇‍♀️ hair done. 5 Stars for Himanshu.
Loved it.. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

name: Smash N Melt Best Burgers In Brampton
address: 332 Main St N #8, Brampton, ON L6V 1P8, Canada
reviews: This is an awesome place to eat, especially if you’re looking for halal options. We tried their beef burgers and smash patty fries which were full of juicy, flavourful beef and other fresh ingredients. The food was hot, fresh and very flavourful, nice service too. Would definitely come again!
🤩 Excellent service and pricing, best of all was the flavours. Hands down one of the best burger joints I’ve been to in a long time. Absolutely delish 💯 Thanks Abu for the great experience!

Came here late after work absolutely exhausted and starving and this place genuinely made my night 😭🔥

The food was INSANELY good. I got the Spicy Beef N Fry Fusion combo with cauliflower bites and everything tasted fresh, hot, crispy, and actually filling. The burger was massive, juicy, loaded with flavor, and the cauliflower bites were addictive.

The atmosphere was super clean too. Loved the red/black setup and the whole vibe of the place felt chill and welcoming.

But honestly the biggest thing was the service. Mohammad Ali was incredibly nice, respectful, and easygoing. You can tell when someone actually cares about customers instead of just rushing people out the door. That kind of energy matters especially when someone comes in tired after a long shift.

This ended up being one of those random food spots you try once and instantly know you’re coming back to.

Highly recommend. Brampton needed a spot like this 💯🔥

Note: I took the burger pictures after I got to my destination so it may look soggy.

I went here about 2 months ago but the experience was so great that I actually set it ask a task in my phone to leave a review.

I happened to be in the area and wanted something quick. Never heard of this place but it had great reviews so it was an easy choice. I get there, it's a small plaza but sufficient parking, though the restaurant unfortunately wasn't near capacity — when this place gets the attention it deserves, the parking will like get tough.

The restaurant was easy to find, well lit, inside was clean and well maintained, and I love the aesthetic in there. The food was made fresh to order. The customer service was exceptional. There was even the instance of me being 5 cents short cash and the associate was so kind about it. I ended up ordering more on the spot and paid the short change but just the fact that the associate was so calm and genuine and sincere... I'll always remember that and will visit whenever I can.

Have been wanting to try this place since it opened, and it did not disappoint. One of the best burgers I have ever had. Staff was extremely nice, and made us feel so welcome. Food was so awesome, Abu made us some incredible food

name: Java U Coffee House
address: 418 Burnhamthorpe Rd W, Mississauga, ON L5B 4M6, Canada
reviews:
Here’s a polished version you can post as a review or social media caption:

I found this hidden gem coffee shop in Mississauga called Java Coffee House near Burnhamthorpe and City Centre, and honestly… Starbucks has NOTHING on this place. ☕️✨

I came here because the Google reviews were incredible, and now I completely understand why. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm, cozy, clean, and welcoming. The owner is one of the kindest people I’ve met — genuinely friendly and passionate about the customers and the experience they create here.

The customer service is beyond amazing, the staff are so sweet and attentive, and the coffee and pastries are absolutely delicious. Everything feels made with care and love.

You can tell this place has heart. The environment, the comfort, the people, the vibe… everything about it makes you want to stay longer. Even the clients and regulars give the place such a positive energy.

I live in Scarborough, but whenever I come visit my mother in Mississauga, this is officially MY coffee shop now. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

If you’re tired of generic chain coffee places and want somewhere that actually feels special, PLEASE support this place. This deserves to become the next big coffee sp

❤️

We had a wonderful experience! They have a great variety of drinks, sandwiches, and baked goods to choose from. The gentleman serving us was incredibly lovely and friendly, and he went above and beyond to make sure we had a pleasant experience.

The coffee was excellent, and the sandwiches were absolutely delicious. We were also happy to find that they offer halal options, which was a huge plus for us! 😍 Highly recommend stopping by if you’re looking for great food, great coffee, and even better service.

Such a classic community spot (or more so, a keystone) in Mississauga with great coffee and tea options and quick eats including sandwiches, wraps and bakery goods. Me and my friend got a pesto sandwich, chamomile tea and a latte. The staff was also very friendly and inviting. Ample seating options from stools, group tables, one-on-one tables and some couches. Gives you a really nice view of the city while also providing cozy space for studying, hangouts, and just some nice coffee. It can get quite crowded in the noon/evening so come early if you want to get a good spot!

The new modern hangout space I found in Mississauga and a rugged look, with such polite and amazing staff and even better vibe and food. It's a nice cosy cafe allowing people to have a working space in the city while enjoying your coffee and snacks. The staff is so good and are willing to accommodate the needs of people in whatever way possible by them. Kuddos on providing an amazing overall fabulous experience. My go to spot in Mississauga. Keep it up guys and you will be seeing me often.

I recently tried Java U and got the J’ice. It was really good! It wasn’t too sweet, just the right balance, and the ice cream made it really creamy and smooth.
The customer service was great as well. They were really helpful in recommending drinks and helping me choose something I’d enjoy. I highly recommend the J’ice!
It’s also a really nice spot to hang out, and they have a good variety of sandwiches and desserts, which I’ll definitely be coming back to try. Super refreshing drink and a great overall vibe!

Stopped by Java U Coffee House on a rainy day after craving something warm, and I’m really glad I did. I’d browsed their menu online before, but the actual space took me by surprise — it’s a genuinely premium setting with comfortable seating and a relaxed, cozy atmosphere.

I ordered the Masala Chai Latte, and it’s honestly the best I’ve had anywhere in the GTA. Perfect balance of spice and sweetness. The sandwiches in the display case looked fresh and well put together, and I’ll definitely be trying them next time. This place has quickly become my new go-to spot for a morning coffee and breakfast.

Highly recommend if you’re in the area.

Followed a Google review to find this place. What a find!! The friendly co-owner, Leon, stepped in and helped me choose a drink when I couldn’t choose from the many delicious options. What he made me was a ‘dirty masala coffee’. You must try it - it was rich and delicious, but not too sweet. Thank you, Leon for the great experience. Will be back.

Absolutely love this coffee shop! It’s one of the few places that opens early in the morning, perfect for a peaceful start to the day. The coffee is excellent with plenty of varieties to choose from, and their croissants are fresh, flaky, and delicious. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot to hang out, catch up with friends, or just relax with a good cup of coffee. Definitely one of my favorite morning stops!

name: Pâtisserie Ol' Sweet
address: 767 Rue Rachel E, Montreal, Quebec H2J 2H4, Canada
reviews:
Amazing food!!
Went with many different options, pistachio, hazelnut, coconut. My favorite was pistachio chimney cake option
Tried a latte as well. Coffee was really good.
I highly recommend pistachio chimney cake.
Customer service is beyond amazing.

No free parking
Paid street parking can be found in that area

As a Hungarian, I can confidently say this is the best chimney cake I’ve had (aside from the one my grandma makes). The service was very friendly, and the whole experience really felt like home. I went for a traditional sugar and cinnamon chimney cake, while my Swiss friend chose the tiramisu filled one—and she said it’s definitely her new favorite dessert!

If you want to experience the joy that is eating a Hungarian kürtőskalács without leaving Montreal, this is the place.
Every single chimney cake is made fresh (so be ready to wait 7-8min), the outside is crispy while the inside is so incredibly soft. They have multiple flavours and even some special ones with ice cream and spreads, but if you want a closer experience to the real thing, I suggest just the simple classic ones.
My only complaint is that they don’t have my favourite flavour, which is vanilla, but the cinnamon sugar as well as the coconut one are absolutely amazing. I highly recommend this place!

We discovered this place through social media before our visit. The food and the experience doesn't disappoint. The staff is very helpful when deciding what to order by providing an explanation of what various options are, what is the traditional way and how various options are made. The chimney cakes are delicious. Definitely worth visiting.

You can smell the goodness before you even take your first bite! The whole shop is filled with this incredible sweet, freshly baked aroma that immediately puts you in a good mood. The chimney cake was delicious—warm, fresh, and seriously addictive. The staff were super friendly, and I was pleasantly surprised by how spacious and comfortable the shop is. It’s not just a place to grab a pastry and leave; you can actually sit down, relax, and hang out for a while. Great pastry, great smell, great vibe. Definitely a sweet little find!

name: FahadFadez Barbershop
address: 3015 Winston Churchill Blvd Unit 5, Mississauga, ON L5L 2V8, Canada
reviews: Fahad is hands down the best barber I have ever had. From the moment you sit in his chair, you can tell he is a true professional who takes immense pride in his craft. His attention to detail is unmatched, and he takes the time to understand exactly what style you want before he even picks up his clippers.The lineup was incredibly sharp, the fade was perfectly blended, and the overall experience was top-notch. On top of his elite haircutting skills, Fahad is friendly, welcoming, and great to chat with. The shop has an excellent atmosphere, and he keeps his station spotless.If you are looking for a barber who consistently delivers flawless results and a premium experience, go see Fahad. I will definitely be coming back and highly recommend him to anyone looking to level up their look!

I got an awesome fade and line up by Gabor. Last time I went into a barbershop was more than 10 years ago so I wasn’t familiar with the formal process of it all but Gabor was very informative and confident with what he thought would look best for myself and I’m very happy with how it turned out; I’m glad I got him and he’s a pretty chill guy so the whole process finishes pretty quickly

If you do end up having to wait for your cut, there’s a pool table to kill the time so that’s pretty dope; first time for me seeing one in a barber shop. The shop itself was really well kept; everything looks very clean and snazzy, I really liked the aesthetic. I didn’t get to try the pool table because I was seated as soon as I walked in but hopefully next time I’ll get the chance. Definitely check the place out

Hands down the best barber in the West! Fahad is incredibly skilled and pays attention to every little detail. The fade is always clean, the lineup is sharp, and the beard work is on point every single time. You can tell he genuinely cares about his craft and making sure you leave looking your absolute best.

The vibe is professional, welcoming, and comfortable. If you’re looking for consistency, quality, and someone who truly knows what they’re doing — Fahad is the guy. Highly recommend! 🔥

I had a great experience today 6th August 2026, Thursday.  I arrived almost an hour early, Fahad warmly welcomed me and made me feel right at home.

The shop located at the basement and had pleasant atmosphere. It’s not your typical commercial barbershop you find it here in Mississauga.

Fahad is friendly, professional, and truly cares about his clients. He took his time, paid attention to every detail, and made sure I was completely satisfied with the final result. His passion and dedication to his craft really show.

If you’re looking for a barber who provides excellent service, I highly recommend Fahad. Perfect experience—I’ll definitely be coming back! #SupportLocal

Fahad is easily one of the best barbers I’ve been to! He did an amazing job and clearly knows exactly what he’s doing. He understood what I wanted right away and executed the cut perfectly. Very professional, skilled, and pays great attention to detail. I’m extremely happy with the result and would definitely recommend Fahad to anyone looking for a great barber!

Good service from Fahad and Abdullah as well as rest of team.  My 6 year old came by for a cut on Sunday, first time and very welcoming.  Fahad walked us in as we didn't know the entrance and told us more about his studio.  Walked in,  Abdullah was assigned to my kid haircut.  He spent good time with my kid, not a rushed experience making sure my kid is also comfortable. He understood the challenges and provided style recommendation.    We moved forward with that style recommended and my kid was very happy.

Just got a fresh cut from Abdullah and I’m seriously impressed. The attention to detail was on point and he really took the time to understand exactly what I wanted. Clean fade, sharp lines, and overall just a super smooth experience. You can tell he takes pride in his work.

If you’re looking for a barber who knows what he’s doing, I highly recommend Abdullah. Definitely coming back 💯

I had a haircut today with Abdullah and he was fantastic. He gave me the exact haircut I was looking for in a timely manner. The atmosphere was lovely as well as everyone was chatty and friendly. Definitely would recommend others to come check it out.

name: café léo
address: 1215 Rue Berri, Montreal, Quebec H2L 0H6, Canada
reviews:
I had a nice experience at Café Léo in downtown Montreal. The place is quite big and the vibe is really pleasant. There are many tables, which makes it great whether you just want to enjoy a coffee or sit down to work. They also have larger tables if you want to work with friends or in a group.
I ordered a latte with coconut milk and it was good. I also tried the cheese croissant, which was tasty and nicely crispy on the outside, with good cheese inside. It was a little pricey for a croissant, but that’s understandable for a downtown location.
The staff were friendly, and I also noticed they sell a few items like tote bags and T-shirts. Overall, I recommend this place.

Stopped in here to kill some time before my flight and I couldn’t have made a better choice. Super cute, spotless, and great AC during the heatwave. The people working behind the till were friendly and my drink was served up in what felt like seconds! Delicious pastry and drinks. I doubly appreciate the non-dairy options being available. 100% recommend for studying, working, or just taking a break from your day.
Super cute lots of seats to study and work. The strawberry matcha tasted a lot more like strawberry milk than anything else. Light green drink.
The homemade cookies and matcha latte were absolutely divine. The earthy, vibrant notes of the tea paired perfectly with the rich, buttery sweetness of the treats.

I came in for a latte and left with dessert in a cup.
A s’mores latte with rich chocolate ganache, crunchy graham crackers, and toasted marshmallows. Cozy, nostalgic, and dangerously delicious. ☕🤎 #CafeLeo #Montreal

name: Jet Black Hair & Studio
address: 386 MacLaren St, Ottawa, ON K2P 0M8, Canada
reviews: Amazing experience at Jet Black! First time having my hair cut in 3yrs and I booked with Izzy for a shag/wolfcut. She was very friendly and honest with what I would be able to achieve with my current hair. I had some very split ends and she gave me a realistic amount of length I was able to keep and it made the cut look so much better and my hair feels healthier. Very knowledgeable and shared some useful tips on how to style my cut so it looks salon fresh! Definitely will be coming back! They even offer bang touch ups between cuts🤩

I love coming here. I have been coming for two years and I love my stylist. I have difficult hair and have made stylists cry. My stylist matched my natural hair colour and I get braids done every visit. The staff is amazing and the owner is a sweetheart.

I adore my stylist, I always feel completely at ease in her chair and she understands exactly what I want and need every single time.
Came in for my daughter’s first cut and colour. Hanna not only did a phenomenal job with both, but was also just a lovely person for us to spend a few hours with today. 10/10, we will be back again!!

I’ve been visiting Jet Black Hair Salon for almost a year and have always had a great experience. Ilona created such a friendly and welcoming salon with amazing energy.

Thank you to Kyle for my recent short haircut! he gave me exactly what I wanted while keeping my hair healthy. Alexis, Katie, and Silver are always so kind and welcoming. My daughters also visit this salon and we all love it. Highly recommend!

I’ve been going to Jet Black for close to 10 years now, and it’s such a great salon—cool vibe, beautifully decorated, and always a nice place to spend time.
I’ve been seeing Jess for over 3 years, and she’s honestly amazing. She’s incredibly talented and really understands my hair and personal style. I always leave with a cut I love, which says a lot because I can be picky! I took her advice to go shorter, and I’m so glad I did because my hair looks great!
Highly recommend Jess if you’re looking for someone talented who really listens and delivers every time.

I have been a client of Ilona’s for well over eight years, and I can honestly say that she is one of the most talented, professional, and kind people I have ever had the pleasure of working with.

From the moment you walk into Jetblack Hair & Studio, you are welcomed into a warm, positive, and professional environment. Ilona consistently goes above and beyond for both her clients and her staff, creating an atmosphere where everyone feels valued, comfortable, and cared for.

Her expertise, attention to detail, and dedication to her craft are truly exceptional. She takes the time to listen, offers thoughtful recommendations, and always delivers results that exceed expectations. Over the years, I have trusted her completely with my hair, and I have never been disappointed.

What sets Ilona apart is not only her incredible talent but also her genuine kindness and commitment to ensuring every client has a wonderful experience. It is clear how much passion she has for her business and the people she serves.

I highly recommend Ilona and Jetblack Hair & Studio to anyone looking for outstanding service, exceptional skill, and a salon experience that consistently goes above and beyond. Thank you, Ilona, for more than eight wonderful years and counting!

Katie

I love the vibe at JetBlack and Jessica is a genius with curls and colour. She has given me several different looks and good advice about what suits me. She’s the only stylist I’ve ever had where I haven’t had to style my hair when I get home. She’s really gets curls! She’s also a great person. Highly recommend both the salon and Jess!

Izzy was amazing. She was patient and always checking in with my elderly mom to make sure she was comfortable and liking what was happening. The staff were also great at helping us out with a ramp and opening the doors for us to help with a wheelchair. A very great experience. We will return. :)

address: 1090 Barton St E, Hamilton, ON L8H 4A1, Canada
reviews:
I had an excellent experience at Golden Touch Barbershop! The two brothers are truly amazing very professional, skilled, and welcoming from the moment you walk in. Their customer service is top-notch, and you can tell they genuinely care about their clients.

What stood out the most to me was their punctuality. I booked an appointment and was seated right on time, which is rare and very appreciated. The attention to detail and quality of the haircut were outstanding.

Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great service, professionalism, and a clean, sharp cut. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I cut my hair here once and developed very bad bumbs at the back side of my head, I even tipped this dude, I’ve been treating this for almost a week now. This is definitely not what I expected, good haircut, but damn clean your clippers. I washed my head after the cut and still developed this.

I walked into this shop and right away it felt different from a typical barbershop—warm and welcoming. My barber, Mohamed, was patient, friendly, and incredibly detail-oriented. He listened carefully to what I wanted, offered great suggestions, and convinced me to try a modern mullet that I ended up loving. He also trimmed my eyebrows, gave me a facial, washed my hair, and really took care of every detail. The service was amazing from start to finish. I highly recommend Mohamed and the whole team for anyone looking for a skilled, attentive barbering experience.

Great place to go! Not a long wait for walk in. He did amazing job on my step grand boy. He loved it looks amazing they really put there own touch on what they want and made it his own ! I highly recommend this place.
If you want to experience the best treatment, then go to this barbershop! You will never regret it. I am beyond impressed with my barber’s skills.

The barbers are good and make sure your looking fresh and the face wash and hair wash are awsome, only issue is the wait time. I had to wait an hour and 10mins before my haircut and other people went ahead of me even though I made an appointment. At this point there is no reason to make an appointment just walk in and wait till you get picked I guess.

The service here is amazing, the quality of the work is phenomenal and these guys are amazing. I did a haircut and face shave all at affordable price and the experience is worth it. I would totally recommend

I booked an appointment for my son, showed up early and they were closed. My appointment was at 10am, they open at 10am so I waited another 25 mins outside with my 3 year old before leaving. I called multiple times and dm’d them on Instagram and never heard back until I got a text asking for a review of the place… why have the option to book at 10:00, 10:15 etc if you don’t open until closer to 11.  I’ve been told by a few people “they make their own hours”.

name: Meow Tea
address: 279 Elgin St, Ottawa, ON K2P 1M1, Canada
reviews:
I ordered their sakura coffee here a while ago it very pretty tasty! I like the atmosphere, i see some people coming to study here sometimes.
The interior decor is very cute as-well.

Overall i would recommend!
The regular milk tea doesn't have a lot of flavors to choose. Tarot milk tea and milk tea with strawberry popings boba was mideum tasty.

I wanted a cold drink and got their Sunday special of Lychee black tea with lychee jelly for $4.99. I did half sugar but with the jelly sweetened too i would do 30% sugar.

They have a daily special for $5 so I might come back for the taro milk tea next week.  I tend to like the fruity ones and so so on the milk teas so it is an easy way to try it.

One of my favorite bubble tea shops in downtown!! I really love the variety of flavors to choose from. They have super cute Tiny Bear cups and it was well presented. Love the cat themed shop, overall cute vibes and friendly staffs. Service was quick and i always enjoyed my teas from here!

There’s certainly no shortage of bubble tea shops around downtown Ottawa but this one really stood out to me. The meow meow milk tea I ordered was well balanced in terms of flavor, sweetness and toppings. I prefer the smaller size, less guilt and most ones without the brown sugar can be made hot which is perfect for the weather. The store is well kept, clean and had some good seating. Loved the cat theme and decor they used all over the walls. I’ll recommend at along with the likes of Sip Tea and da Alley. If you go or plan to go here often, definitely make sure to get into their loyalty program.

I went into this boba shop on 11/15/2025 the lady working that night is very sweet ! The best customer service I’ve ever had! Not only are the drinks tasty but the service was amazing! I got the Taro cheesecake drink 10/10 recommend!

During a long day of walking around Ottawa, I stopped in grab a cold drink. I got the meow meow tropical fruit tea and did it ever hit the spot.
Thé flavour was incredible.
The service was fast and friendly too.
Glad I stopped in. Highly recommend.

Cute little bubble tea shop located in downtown Ottawa. We weren’t familiar with the area and decided to try something new. I ordered the brown sugar with oat milk — it was delicious, and the server was so kind and patient.
snippet: Meow Tea Ottawa Skip to content HOME ABOUT US OUR SIGNATURE TESTIMONIAL CONTACT US About us Meow Tea was founded in May 2019, is located on Elgin Street, the golden triangle of Ottawa, Ontario. To be better accepted and liked by locals, including our wide range of customers that possess Canadian culture. name: Evolve Hair Studio
address: 40 Fort York Blvd, Toronto, ON M5V 3Z3, Canada
reviews: This was my second time coming back to see Iris and she’s literally the best! I came in with horrible brassy tones and she completely transformed my hair. She got the tone looking SO much better right before a wedding too, which I was so grateful for. I usually have a hard time finding a hair dresser who can manage thick hair but she’s amazing at what she does and I always leave so happy with my hair :)

I had such a wonderful experience with Melissa Betkhoshabeh! She did my roots touch-up and toner, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Melissa took the time to make sure the color matched perfectly, and my hair looks fresh, healthy, and beautifully blended. She is incredibly talented, professional, friendly and made me feel comfortable throughout the appointment. I truly appreciate her attention to detail and the care she puts into her work. I highly recommend Melissa to anyone looking for a skilled hairstylist,I will definitely be coming back!

Had such a great experience with Mel! She was so sweet, professional, and really took the time to understand what I wanted. I absolutely love how my balayage turned out — the colour is exactly what I was hoping for! ✨ She did an amazing job and I’ll definitely be coming back! 🤍

I had the pleasure of visiting Evolve for the first time and it was a wonderful experience. Everyone there is so kind and welcoming. It can be scary trying out a new hair spot but this place is amazing. The studio is beautiful and you’re immediately greeted with such kindness you feel like you’ve been going there forever.
I had Sarah do my hair and she was so knowledgeable and asked me the right questions to figure out exactly what I wanted. I made a big change and she was amazing! She not only cut it the exact way I wanted but also styled it perfectly. If you get a chance definitely check this place out!

My hair cut was good, but was seriously disappointed with being casually asked if I would like a drink and then being charged afterwards. There was also an “ ECO-CONSCIOUS” charge which I had no idea was being added on. For the price paid usually these are complimentary or should at least be communicated to the client when offered that this is not included. I feel like this is nickle and diming clients. I will not be back. For a $130 uncomplicated cut, there are place that offer better customer service than charging an extra $3.50 for a beverage that I again was offered…and a random $4 eco-conscious charge that I wasn’t notified about.

I wanted to try grey blending as I am South Asian and have dark hair but did not want salt and pepper. Cassia did a wonderful job and gave me even better hair than my expectations. Everyone praises my hair colour wherever I go.

I was very nervous before my appointment but staff was very helpful too as they asked me about my day and my feelings towards this new change I was going to try.
Cassia helped me get me my new look which I can carry with confidence everywhere. I am so glad that I went to Evolve and all credit goes to Cassia for it.
My daughters also want to go there now.

Thank you Cassia for giving me the look I wanted from last so many years.

It was my first time at this salon, and I had a wonderful experience with Cassia. She did an amazing job and really took the time to listen and understand exactly what I wanted, including how I style my hair on a daily basis. She explained every step of the process as we went along, which made me feel very comfortable and well taken care of. I’m so happy with the results and would definitely recommend her and Evolve.

I highly recommend Sarah; she gave me a beautiful haircut and is also a lovely and very kind person. Above all, she was very patient, as my English isn't very good, and she managed to understand me and try to communicate with me (which was very kind of her)

name: LA LA Bakeshop (Bay)
address: 761 Bay St. Unit 2, Toronto, ON M5G 2R2, Canada
reviews:
Nice and clean coffee shop. We ordered trà vải and it was good. The tea itself is really strong so make sure you love the way strong tea is before ordering
Also, we ordered salted egg cake and it was amazing. The cake was soft and the salted egg was really tasty. The combination was just perfect.
Highly recommend and we’d def back

Could have been a perfect experience!
We visit La La on June 28. Great dessert, love the salted egg cake, drinks are good too, I love their matcha, quite strong.
Interior was so nice, especially the long table with tree.
The only downside was that fly on the display croissant. It was there quite a long time and no staff noticed.

​A Hidden Gem! 🍃
​I’ve walked past Là Lá Bakeshop several times without realizing it was a Vietnamese café, but I’m so glad I finally stepped inside! The atmosphere is fantastic, bright, modern, and super cute, with really unique and thoughtful seating layout (including a tree growing right out of the main table which i thought would be great for a larger group gathering or even team meetings)
​I ordered the Matcha Raspberry Pistachio drink, and it was absolutely delicious and so well balanced. On top of that, the taller girl working at the counter was super sweet, polite, and welcoming.
​Such a lovely spot to drop by. I’ll definitely be coming back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

More spacious than I thought, with a lot of tables around!
The matcha latte and raspberry pistachio matcha latte were great.
Nice staffs, clean space. Look forward to trying their dessert lines!

There's so much I want to try here is how I want to start this review. Aesthetically pleasing atmosphere although limited space / always gets packed quick it seems. The staff here are very friendly. The food items are truly unique with pricing slightly above average but given the quality, it's worth it too. I haven't yet tried the drinks but no doubt that they'll be good as their pastries and desserts. Tried the salted egg cake and it is not overly salty nor too sweet - the ultimate Asian treat to have. Will be back to try more!

Amazing drinks and desserts. Very surprising durian dessert that is actually nice like the ones you'd find in Asia.

Lots of hotties visits this bakery, the inside of the cafe is nice to hang out but limited-ish seat, I was outside during this visit.

Verdict: definitely come!!!

LÀ LÁ Bakeshop on Bay Street, a modern Vietnamese bakery offering a wide range of cakes, croissants, buns, bánh mì, and specialty drinks, all made with flavours like pandan, jasmine, salted egg, taro, and Vietnamese coffee; that are usually lighter and less sweet than typical pastries in other bakeries. The staff are very friendly and the shop is bright and cozy, with a clean, minimalist feel and stays open daily from morning to evening.

We ordered from their March March selection: “Tofu Pudding Matcha Latte”, “Pistachio Cream Raspberry Matcha Latte”, “Matcha Pandan Mini Cake”, “Matcha Jasmine Bun” and “Durian Salted Egg Croissant” from their regular menu.

The Tofu Pudding Matcha Latte was smooth and comforting, and the Pistachio Cream Raspberry Matcha Latte had a nice balance of nutty and fruity flavors that made it feel special.

For pastries, the Matcha Pandan Mini Cake and Matcha Jasmine Bun were soft, fragrant, and not too heavy, which we really liked. The Durian Salted Egg Croissant was the most unique one; rich, bold, and perfect if you enjoy those classic Southeast Asian flavours.

So yummy! The drinks here are pretty delicious. I got the Pandan Iced Matcha and it was surprisingly good (especially as a matcha hater). My friend found got the Pistachio Raspberry Matcha which was also quite delicious. The atmosphere is quiet and perfect for studying, though a tad hot.

name: Ryan's Chai
address: 13 Queen St W, Brampton, ON L6Y 1L9, Canada
reviews: I tried the Veggie Aloo Bun Burger and it was absolutely delicious! The crispy aloo patty was flavorful and perfectly cooked. The bun was soft and fresh, making every bite enjoyable. The combination of spices, vegetables, and sauces created a tasty and satisfying burger. It was filling, affordable, and a great option for anyone who enjoys vegetarian fast food. I would definitely order it again!
We tried their New Gulab Jamun Shake and Karak Chai. Both were great and staffs were so friendly. Atmosphere was great too for a quick hangout

Absolutely the best chai spot in Brampton! The chai is rich, fresh, and full of authentic flavor. Every sip is perfect, and the food is equally outstanding—fresh, delicious, and made with care. The staff is incredibly friendly, welcoming, and provides exceptional customer service. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect place to relax with friends and family. Highly recommend Ryan's Chai to anyone looking for extraordinary food and the best chai in town!

Lovely venue, lovely atmosphere with a local unique authentic vibe! The staff is very friendly and welcoming. Had freshly made Kashmiri chai which was delicious. The location is also very convenient, it's my go to place whenever i am downtown Brampton. The woner is very supportive as well, supporting local talent by providing a space for open mics on wednesdays

Tried Ryan Chai with my friends and absolutely loved it! We had adrak chai and paneer bites — both were perfect. The chai was freshly made and tasted amazing 😍. Customer service was great too, really friendly and welcoming. Such a cozy little place to hang out and enjoy some good chai and snacks! ☕✨
