name: The Barber Shop (formerly The Barber House)
address: 791 Bathurst St, Toronto, ON M5S 1Y6, Canada
reviews:
Great experience at this barbershop! The barber was friendly, professional, and took the time to make sure my haircut came out exactly how I wanted. The shop was clean, welcoming, and the service was excellent.

It’s also really convenient if you’re in the Bloor and Bathurst area, especially since it’s right next by the subway station. Definitely a great local barbershop if you’re looking for a quality haircut and good service. I’ll definitely be back!

Alix is truly a once-in-a-generation, supremely talented barber + stylist. Apart from this, he is bright, friendly, easy to talk to, and an exceptional human being. This part of the city is lucky to have him around. He is a perfectionist. Every time I sit in his chair, I feel confident that I’ll leave looking sharp! He pays attention to detail, listens to what I want, and delivers exactly that — if not better. Highly recommend Alix to anyone looking for a top-quality haircut and great service. You won’t be disappointed.

I was looking for a barber close to home and visited a friend who lives at Bathurst and Bloor. He pointed to  “The Barber Shop” located close to that intersection. I went in a few hours later and experienced an amazing treatment coupled with an amazing haircut. Thank you David for an amazing experience! You have my business!!!

Cheer!

I’ve been getting my hair cut by Alix for the past year, and I’ve been back around 7 or 8 times now. Great price and service, Alix is consistent, pays attention to detail, and always gives me one of the best haircuts I’ve had.

If you’re looking for a barber who’s skilled, professional, and reliable, I highly recommend booking with Alis
Alix is the best! We have been going to the barbershop for 2 years! We wouldn’t trust anyone else.

It can be challenging to find a barber that can advise on what works best while working with what you request. Alix does just that. He consistently delivers excellent service offering his expertise while listening to my requests. I trust him to give a good cut and for that reason I come back.

It's a no frills, all business shop that doesn't have extraneous services that aren't necessary. I think that in turn helps make the place a really reasonably priced barber shop. Go see for yourself.
Excellent barber shop! The staff is friendly and professional and the prices are quite reasonable. Also, Alix is a fantastic barber!

Service at The Barber Shop is top notch!

I’ve been getting haircuts from Alex for 5 years now. While I have generally stuck with a fade (my go-to haircut), my friends have experimented with their preferences which the team always delivered on point.

FYI my brother gets to flaunt his mullet thanks to the crew!

name: City Side Cafe
address: 8 Queen St W, Brampton, ON L6X 1A1, Canada
reviews: I recently visited the cafe on Valentine's day with my sister. The atmosphere was so good. The service was quick and very well. The servers greeted us in a very pleasant way. We ordered a veg sandwich, one spanish tea latte and biscoff cofee. The sandwich was so delicious that I didn't imagine. Moreover, they presented the food in a wonderful way that they made the day special. Also, we got one complimentary coffee which they gave us as a mistake but I liked their behaviour how they deal with the situation and gave it to us as free. I recommend this cafe to everyone.

City Side Café is such a hidden gem in Brampton! We stopped by to try a few of their drinks and snacks, and everything exceeded our expectations. The Nutella latte was absolutely divine, and the coconut matcha was so creamy! You can really tell they use ceremonial grade matcha. We also tried their viral pistachio croissant and the buffalo chicken grilled cheese. This grilled cheese was so unique and had the perfect little kick.
The café was so aesthetic, making it a great spot to relax or catch up with friends. The service was also wonderful, and we will definitely be back ❤️

The food and drinks are absolutely delicious. The staff is always welcoming and kind and they were very sweet to my two kids. A great place to work, study, read, go as a family or with friends or even as a date or with friends. Highly recommend this beautiful cafe. I can’t wait for my next visit!

As someone who loves exploring cafés, I was excited to try this one. The ambiance was beautiful, peaceful, and definitely the kind of place where you can sit back and relax.

We ordered the Biscoff Latte, Pumpkin Spice Latte and Spanish Latte. The Biscoff Latte was absolutely delicious—well-balanced, flavorful, and easily the highlight of our visit. However, it was initially served without the Biscoff cookie, which was a bit disappointing because a Biscoff coffee just doesn’t feel complete without it.

Unfortunately, the Spanish Latte was quite underwhelming. It tasted bland and lacked the rich Spanish flavor we were expecting. Pumpkin Spice Latte was good.

I’d also like to mention that the staff member at the front, Harvi, didn’t come across as very welcoming or friendly. A warm attitude can make a big difference to the overall customer experience.

Another small disappointment was that neither latte came with latte art—it may seem minor, but it definitely adds to the café experience.

Overall, I’m giving this café 3 stars for its calming atmosphere and the excellent Biscoff Latte. I’d happily come back for that drink! ☕️🤌🏼

After Second Visit:

I honestly don’t even know where to start because the management of this team has completely won my heart, and I think it’s finally time for me to update my review.

The way they responded to my feedback was truly impressive. They considered every single detail I mentioned and genuinely worked on it. What a management team—hats off to you all! 🎩

It’s not about the fact that they invited and offered us food and coffee without charging us because we weren’t satisfied on our first visit.

It’s about how genuinely caring and dedicated they are when it comes to customer satisfaction. They really put in the effort to make things right and completely change our experience.

We are beyond happy with the way we were treated and the respect and hospitality we received. A special shoutout to Kiran, who told us she is the manager. She attended to us so wonderfully and made us feel truly valued.

Once again, we absolutely loved the Biscoff Latte ☕️🍪 and the Veggie Paneer Sandwich. Oh my my—the Veggie Paneer Sandwich was so delicious! 🥪🤤 I genuinely haven’t had a veggie sandwich this good since moving to Canada🇨🇦

I think now I owe 🙌🏻 these guys you for their amazing food, outstanding management, and exceptional customer service. 🥹🤌🏼

such a cuuuute little cafe in dt brampton! the atmosphere gives rlly good vibes, and their food and drinks are just as good. the spinach and artichoke pastry is my favourite!! the cafe is nice for all ages, i come here with my 1yo often. and i must say their staff is super sweet too, always so welcoming and give very kind service, shout out to lidya! :))

name: Tea One Bakery & Cafe
address: 900 Rathburn Rd W E4, Mississauga, ON L5C 4K5, Canada
reviews: Walked in without expecting much. Walked out, only to go back again and again. Great little coffee shop in this part of Mississauga with a very nice selection of food, sandwiches, snacks, bagels, cakes, buns, hot and cold beverages. We ordered the fish sandwich and bagel. Sandwich was delicious, fries were fresh and crisp, serving size great. Coffee strong. Bagel fresh and flavorful. Owners are super nice. They also have a small outdoor seating arrangement. Peaceful environment to have a meeting or grab a quick bite. Now WiFi.

Everything was excellent, from the food to the service. We ordered the Tomato Shrimp Soup, and it was absolutely spectacular—full of flavor and definitely one of the highlights of our meal.

The coffee was also hot, large, and really delicious. The service was great, and overall we had a wonderful experience.

Definitely a place we would come back to! Highly recommended! 🙌

Wifey and I met up with my daughter and good friend on Friday night. This place is amazing. It's relaxing, quiet and they have no fi-wi, they want their customers to talk with each other not on the phones. The food and service are the best. They have really out done themselves with the variety of food, drinks and desserts. The cheesecake is the Bestest.  I think better than New York style cheesecake. Very nice place to meet and talk and have some enjoyable food. I had the potato and bacon soup with garlic bread on the side. Both very delicious 😋. Will we go back again, that's for sure, would i recommend this place most definitely. Thank you again for everything. Your the Bestest. Bubba.

Came to this cute cafe with my boyfriend after work and was so pleasantly surprised! The man who took our order and brought out our food put so much care into our experience like setting the table for us and bringing extra plates. The food was absolutely amazing, the Korean beef breakfast sandwich is too good 😍 After we ate, I bought a bunch of pastries to bring back to my family and this time a woman took my pastry order. She was extremely kind, offering my boyfriend tissues as he was a bit sick and sniffling, packing my pastries nicely, and she was so warm to speak to. Amazing food and amazing service, thank you guys!! 🥰❤️

Today wasn’t as coincidental as usual, I had to go to Mississauga for work. I planned to check out a place called Tea One Bakery & Cafe for some light bites after I finished, and it turned out my friends also wanted to take me there. Finally got to try it, and it didn’t disappoint.

Tea One is run by a couple from Hong Kong. They offer a wide variety of coffee, tea, desserts, baked goods, sandwiches, and simple lunch options, definitely a lot to choose from. You could say it’s like an upgraded version of Hong Kong-style cafés. It has its own style, and you can tell they put genuine effort into what they make.

I tried their coconut tart and Portuguese egg tart, both were very tasty. The mushroom chicken pie was also well done. The bread for the sandwiches is homemade and has a great texture. The only downside is that while the sandwiches are creative, they’re not very easy to eat. I ordered the fried shrimp sandwich, but the batter was a bit too hard, and the shrimp itself could be better, there’s definitely room for improvement there.

The shop isn’t very big, but the layout is comfortable, with a simple and fresh design. There are large windows, and with the bright sunlight today, the whole place felt really pleasant.

The owners are very friendly and welcoming. The lady owner recommended the coconut tart, and it was excellent. I’m usually not a fan of coconut tarts, but their version completely changed my mind. If you get the chance, it’s definitely worth a visit. Support sincere local small businesses! 👍

I would like to give 4.5⭐️ instead of 4

I ordered cake from here b4. It’s so good, highly recommend the sesame one. The first time coming in person, which is great. The drinks is good, especially the matcha and the caramel crispy latte. I would say their sweet dishes are better than savory, but both are great. Highly recommend the French toast and the toast with pistachio dip. What’s add on to it is the environment, comfy, warm and good for talking. And very good pricing!!!!!

It's been a long time since I've been so happy with a cafe discovery!! What an amazing place!
We were a group of 7, and sat at an incredible cozy spot. We all ordered different food, and everyone loved what they were having. We kept tasting each other's foods and drinks.
I personally had the Sesame Latte, and blueberry cheesecake. I loved trying a different drink (I usually just have a latte). Different and delicious!
The service was also outstanding. Not only did they treat us all very well, but also there was a curious and energetic child in our group that they were so patient and kind with.
The place is cozy overall, and even the bathroom is cute!
I'm already looking forward to go back!

Absolutely stunning environment and workers. They fulfilled all the request that were made and was truly caring. They made sure the place was cleaned soon after the Customers left. Definitely a place I would come again to visit

name: Aiana Restaurant
address: 50 O'Connor St, Ottawa, ON K1P 6L2, Canada
reviews: Me and my family just came at this beautiful restaurant and it was so lovely. We had Oliver as our server and he was outstanding and gave us great recommendations! He even gave  a free cook book as I go off into my first year of university. The restaurant is super cozy with nice music and calm lighting. I would absolutely come again. The food was outstanding with an outstanding presentation as you can see in the photos. If you like wine (which I’m too young to have) there is 600 different kinds of wines to choose from, my parents loved it! Best restaurant!!

Honestly super impressed with this restaurant. The food was great but the service was just phenomenal. I loved how knowledgeable the servers were in explaining each item and refreshing the table setting after each course. My father absolutely loved his dish and said it was the best pasta he’s ever had. Everything was incredibly elegant and stylish. They have little maple candies at the front too which I thought was super cute. I have their recipe book as well and it looks amazing. Would definitely recommend trying this restaurant out if you’re looking for a nice dinner.

Everything was fantastic! It's a higher-end restaurant so don't expect large plates of fries. Plus it's not cheap, but not exceedingly expensive for this type of restaurant.

The server (I think it was Marika) was great, very polite and attentive, constantly ensuring our water was refilled and our questions answered.

First they offered small amuse bouche which was nice - many flavours packed into a tiny spoon.  We then shared the Bison tartare, really nice. Never had bison this way, plus the crackers were home made and delicious.  My main was the Arctic Char, cooked perfectly and the accompanying sauce and veggies complimented perfectly.  We were too full for dessert, so when we politely declined we were offered mignardises instead which was a small after-dinner mini dessert.

They have a massive wine list if you're into that, plus inventive sounding cocktails. I love that many/most ingredients were Canadian and often locally sourced - including herbs from the chef's mother's garden ( I asked since I was curious)!

The ambience was modern and relaxed, the music wasn't blaring, and the seating was super comfortable. I don't normally do 3 hour dinners but I was not stiff or sore at the end - which often is the case given my ahem advancing age.  Oh and the washrooms were exceedingly clean.

Well done, I'll be coming back and will be recommending to friends.

Before anything, I should mention that the portion sizes for the food, desserts, and drinks are not very large. However, that is quite expected for a restaurant in this luxury category, so personally I didn’t see it as a negative point.

For the main course, I ordered the 8 oz steak and it was excellent. The quality of the meat was great and the side options paired very well with it. I also tried the truffle chicken, which unfortunately wasn’t my favorite. It had a very rich and strong flavor, and since it was something quite new for my taste, I didn’t enjoy it as much. The chicken also had a stuffing in the middle that wasn’t really to my liking. That said, this is probably just a matter of personal preference.

The ice cream dessert was delicious and a perfect way to finish the meal.

Another highlight was the staff. They were extremely friendly, professional, and attentive. For every dish they served, they took the time to explain the ingredients and preparation, which added a very nice touch to the overall experience.

Overall, it really depends on what you are looking for. If you are very hungry or planning a casual outing with friends, this might not be the best choice due to the portion sizes. However, if you’re looking for a refined dining experience, a place to enjoy a drink, or a nice spot for a date, it is definitely a good option.

A really lovely spot in a great central location. I stopped in after work to unwind, sat at the bar, and had a genuinely nice time. The ambiance is beautiful and the wine list is extensive — I had a couple of glasses of white and they clearly have a thoughtful, well-curated collection.

I started with the scallop and saffron as an appetizer, plus a complimentary soup, and had the Pacific-caught halibut with arborio, English pea, fennel, and allium. It’s fine dining, so the portions are small as you’d expect, but I actually found it filling. Everything was nicely executed — good, though not quite a destination on its own for me.

My one honest critique: for a place that positions itself at this caliber, I found the service at the bar a touch too casual. Friendly, but a little more polish would match what the restaurant is aiming for.

Overall a great place to relax with a good glass of wine. I’d absolutely come back for drinks and the atmosphere.

name: Golden Grains Bakery Cafe & Deli Ltd
address: 389 Main St N, Brampton, ON L6X 3P1, Canada
reviews: I enjoy passing in this local Portuguese bakery whether it be for a quick espresso, some bread & buns for the house, or a satisfying lunch. The service has been great & the girls here show a lot of passion towards the customers. I gather the sense of the average person becoming a regular patron at this establishment which means they are keeping everybody happy! Prices are super reasonable, there is dine-in accommodation & the desserts are also a big hit. I often grab a Tosta Mista for a quick snack/lunch but after I tried the Turkey Dijon Sandwich..it has become my new Go-To!! Give this spot a try, I highly recommend it 👌

🌿 Golden Grains Bakery Review
We’ve been to Golden Grahams Bakery twice now specifically for their Dubai chocolate strawberries… and honestly, they are SO good 🤍
If I could have them every day, I probably would (even though I know that wouldn’t be the best idea 😅). The flavor, the texture — everything about them is just really well done.
They offer two sizes:
Small ($8)
Large ($18)
And I would definitely say the large is worth it. The portion is generous — I usually don’t even finish it in one sitting. I’ll have half and save the rest for later or the next day, and it still holds up really well.
If you’re in Brampton and looking to try Dubai chocolate strawberries, this is absolutely a place I would recommend.
The space itself is also really nice — clean, quaint, and thoughtfully set up. They have a bakery, grocery/deli section, and even a small seating area, which makes it feel like more than just a quick stop. They’re also open until 8pm, which makes it really convenient.
Given that this item may not be ordered as frequently, the current made-to-order approach makes sense. However, as visibility and demand increase, there’s a great opportunity to refine that process to maintain both quality and flow during busier times.
Overall, definitely a spot I’ll be returning to 🤍

Golden Grains Bakery is honestly one of my favourite bakeries in Brampton. The biggest thing that stands out is how fresh everything tastes, especially their breads. You can really tell that the bread is freshly made every day like soft, flavourful, and nothing like the packaged bread you get from a grocery store.

They also have a great selection of pastries, buns, cakes and other bakery items, and everything is great. The staff is super friendly too. Must try their Pistachio Cannoli.

The pastries here are out of this world! Super light and fresh. Customer service is superb and they really care about your experience.

Lady at the front was so kind!

This is our favourite place for lunch. The whole team is amazing, they go above and beyond with elegance and smiles. The owner is always friendly and engaged. Thr design of the place is also lovely. Their coffee is the best, and they make beautiful salads, sandwiches and soups. At times it is too busy here, but it also shows that the place is popular. Thank you very much for your excellent customer service and making us feel at home, although we do not speak Portuguese.

name: 1 Elgin Restaurant
address: 1 Elgin St, Ottawa, ON K1P 5W1, Canada
reviews: WOW! What a beautiful experience. The tuna tartar, flawless! The veil dish had a lot of ingredients on the plate that all had distinct flavours, textures and aromas. And they all complimented each other beautifully making the flavours dance in the mouth. The bread basket, amazing! The seasonal beetroot and lemon butter was delightful and light. Service was really fast and our server Godfrey was super charismatic and a great host. Really one of the top restaurants in Ottawa! Bravo!

Came here for my mother’s birthday dinner. The food was excellent. The brushetta appetizer with goat cheese and potatoes was exquisite! The mango coco and strawberry mint drinks were amazing. And our mains were just as delicious as the rest of the meal!! But most importantly, the service was beyond compare! Georges, you were truly an angel and your service was immensely appreciated!!

We enjoyed our dinner at One Elgin before a show at the NAC. Very convenient and accessible location from parking to dining to getting to your show. Made for a seamless evening out! Service at One Elgin was excellent. Great options. Food was tasty, reasonably priced. We left fully satisfied and will definitely go again and pair it with a show.

This review is not about restaurant  experience but how a restaurant located right in the most prestigious and historic landmark of Canada's capital city of Ottawa the Rideau Canal and the National Arts Centre would be cheaply decorated with tacky artificial flowers. It's very unsightly and unacceptable that we dont recommend this place to our guests visiting Ottawa. I live near the Canal and proud of my City hence this commentt from a neighbor. Simple green foliage plants and flowers can bring more elegance as befitting to the national capital. Please take this comment seriously from a proud Canadian living in the capital ... your next door neighbor.

The most delicious dinner I’ve had in a while in Ottawa. We went just around the time the show in the theatre started, so the place was mostly empty - perfect for a person who enjoys a calm and quiet restaurant. Food was absolutely scrumptious and we absolutely loved the spotlighted chef.

Reviewing a reviewer!  Attended Peter Hum's Opening Night banquet as Resident Chef.  It was a delightful evening hearing about his family, heritage and food.  For almost everyone, food is as much about relationships and associations as about flavour.  Flavours and memories are thus closely linked.  This dinner was memorable for all of it.
What a tricky job to "elevate" traditional Chinese "comfort" food.  For example, adding truffle to the wontons adds distinction, but not necessarily elevation.  That being said, you can't go to 1 Elgin and expect to taste childhood staples as good as Mom's, but at least it can remind you of her kitchen.  The canapes, especially the shot-glass of soup, definitely had that reminder, as did the congee and gai-lan.

The distinctly non-Asian Pannacotta was delicious which is something I never say for traditional Chinese desserts, so a brilliant departure there.

The wine pairings with Chinese-style food is always difficult and i found it more confusing than anything.  Again, the wine was totally fine, but I didn't think it was necessarily complementary.  Tea probably would work 100x better.
The service was attentive and friendly, and the setting in the Canada Room was top-notch.
Overall, an exceptional evening.  Thank you, Peter et al!

From the moment we made our reservation until the moment we left, 1 Elgin delivered an outstanding dining experience.

This was a particularly special evening for us—it was our first date night after welcoming our second child—so we were hoping for something memorable; the team exceeded our expectations.

Everything felt incredibly thoughtful and personalized. We were seated at the table we’d requested, and the service was simply outstanding. We had come specifically to experience Chef Stephanie Pangowish’s menu during the final week of her residency, and our server immediately understood exactly what kind of evening we were hoping for.

Rather than simply taking our order, he guided us through the menu with genuine care—splitting a starter for us, helping us choose complementary dishes, timing everything perfectly, and quietly elevating the experience in dozens of thoughtful ways. It never felt scripted or transactional—it felt like he was genuinely invested in creating the best possible experience for us.

Overall an outstanding experience!

My husband and I were recommended this restaurant by a friend. We were especially interested in this restaurant due to the indigenous cooking style and ingredients used in the dishes by the chefs. I had the wild rice salad and he had the venison. Both were delicious, but what truly made the night for us was the service! Our server Justin went above and beyond for us, and so did the hostess. Truly impressed!

reviews:
I've been seeing Nicola for the past 6 years, and I honestly wouldn't trust anyone else with my hair. She's incredibly down to earth, honest, and genuinely cares about the health of my hair. She always takes the time to listen and somehow manages to nail the exact tone and look I'm after every single time.

As I've started getting some greys, Nicola has been doing fine highlights to blend and camouflage them, and the results are amazing. The colour looks so natural that no one would ever guess it's covering greys. Her attention to detail and expertise are second to none.

've had Fab cutting and styling my hair for years, and she's always done an amazing job. She always takes the time to listen to what I want and somehow makes it turn out even better than I imagined. Whether it's a cut or a new style, I always leave feeling so happy with the results. She's incredibly talented, friendly, and makes every appointment such a great experience. I can't recommend Fab enough if you're looking for someone who genuinely cares and does amazing work!

I am writing this review to detail a deeply disappointing experience from a year ago that has continued to bother me. I booked an appointment two months in advance for a premium service, only to be charged $650 for an experience that felt neglected and rushed.

The level of professionalism was non-existent. I was left waiting 15 minutes to be seen because the stylist, Nicola, was busy performing a service on a family member instead of focusing on her paying clients. Nicola only handled the foil application, and for the rest of the color process, an assistant had to keep running back and forth to grab her to check on my hair because she was otherwise occupied. After the color was done, the actual haircut was performed by a different stylist named Priya. The final result was a messy cut that completely lacked the face framing I had requested, and the color itself left me looking washed out.

I felt completely neglected throughout the entire process, and it was so underwhelming that when I left, no one even noticed I had my hair done. Paying that amount of money to be treated like an afterthought, and having the stylist I booked not even perform the work I paid for, is unacceptable. This experience was so poor that it has caused me genuine anxiety about visiting a salon again. If you are looking for a service where your time, your specific requests, and your significant financial investment are respected, I would strongly advise looking elsewhere.

I had an amazing experience here at Educo Salon with Mia! I came in for a trim, wash and blowout on my long curly/textured hair and she exceeded every expectation. Mia is incredibly skilled, knowledgeable and truly understands how to work with textured hair. She listened to what I wanted treated my curls with so much care, literally brought my hair back to life. The results were flawless—healthy, smooth and beautifully styled. I felt so comfortable and confident in her hands. Highly recommend Mia to anyone with curls or textured hair! 🥰🥺
Check out her Instagram: @hair_by_mia.d

I had the best root retouch, trim and wet balayage with Fab. I came to Fab after trying to do grey blending and the blonde was killing my hair. In just six months I’ve gotten inches of length back and I love a salon who does what is best for your hair, even if it doesn’t benefit them. I’ve streamlined how I do my greys and Fab is always so much fun. You can see my colour here.

name: Simply Italian Bakery (SIB)
address: 212 Ottawa St N, Hamilton, ON L8H 3Z6, Canada
reviews:
Simply Italian Bakery is a true hidden gem, great recommendation from a friend. It delivers an authentic European bakery experience right in the neighborhood.

From the moment you walk through the door, you are welcomed by a bright, beautifully designed space that feels warm, modern, and inviting. The clean presentation, rustic shelving, and carefully displayed breads and pastries create an atmosphere that reflects both craftsmanship and attention to detail.

The décor, including the charming Italian touches and the open, airy layout, makes the visit feel relaxed and enjoyable.

The bread itself is absolutely exceptional and clearly made with traditional techniques and high quality ingredients. Each loaf has a perfectly balanced crust that is crisp and golden on the outside while remaining soft, airy, and full of flavor on the inside.

You can immediately taste the difference that comes from proper fermentation and authentic preparation methods. Their wood oven baking process adds a distinct depth of flavor that truly sets them apart from standard commercial bakeries.

Beyond the bread, the selection of pastries and baked goods is equally impressive, offering fresh, beautifully prepared options that pair perfectly with their beverage menu. The display and freshness of the products show genuine pride in their craft.

The staff are friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall experience and making customers feel valued.

Simply Italian Bakery is more than just a place to buy bread; it is a destination that celebrates tradition, quality, and authentic Italian baking culture. It is clear that passion and expertise go into every product they offer, making it a place that is easy to recommend and one that customers will want to return to again and again

Food and Italian beverages are delicious. Great place   Hard to find a unique place like this in Hamilton. A must try place especially if you’re Italian like myself. This is a pic of their Pistachio Gelato

We had heard that the Simply Italian Bakery was selling pizzas, so obviously we had to check them out. The pizzas are wood oven cooked, they came out cooked perfectly. The cheese and toppings were great, high quality ingredients used. The sauce was nice, simple and fresh. The crust was nice and airy and still had a nice chew to it. Overall a great pizza, and friendly staff. They had many other sweet treats, pastries and sandwiches available as well. The staff was very friendly and accommodating. We will definitely will be back to try some of their other item. Highly recommend you try out Simply Italian Bakery if you’re in the area.
very nice place , the food is also good and the prices were ok i’d say a lil cheaper then the average cafe . you know it’s good when you hear nonnos talking in italian !

The service is excellent. The staff are all kind and helpful. They assist you in every way they can. They are very attentive, friendly, out going and overall an asset to this place. Especially the woman behind the cash till near the bread and the gentleman who is working the pizza. They both went above and beyond. The pizza was perfect in every way! Definitely your moneys worth! I’ve never had better food let alone pizza in my life. Truly a great place for any occasion and for everyone!

I’ve loved this place since they opened but just had an unfortunate experience ordering a cappuccino. I was upsold to a large ($8.48) then handed a cup of burnt oat milk with what I was told was a double shot of espresso but was just a longo. I burnt my tongue and had to ask them to remake it with less milk, more foam - a cappuccino and as I was handed the second cup (made exactly the same way) it was blamed on the oat milk not steaming properly. Shame to pay $10 to burn your tongue and have to leave the coffee on the counter after waiting 10min. Great sandwiches! Not sure it lives up to the $17 takeout price tag but the bread is fresh.

"I got a great vibe and tons of pastry options 😊. This was a quick stop for my family as we were enroute our breakfast place. I love Italian cuisine and once I saw it on my map, decided to stop, peek and do a grab and go. My sandwich was a bit salty, but hey, mistakes happen!

Kudos to the staff for cutting it into 4 pieces so my fam could share (and complain about the saltiness 😅 ).

The view of the street is 🔥 and sipping your fav coffee option by the window will have some nostalgic effect for sure.  Will definitely be back for a more relaxed visit to try more sandwiches and sip my cappuccino.

Also, love the staff's swag - that 'Italians are everywhere' tee made me smile 😊. Overall, solid spot, looking forward to my next visit! 👍"

We were absolutely thrilled with our wedding cake! It was a beautiful two-tier cake with buttercream icing and a strawberry vanilla center, and it tasted just as amazing as it looked. The cake was incredibly moist, the flavors were perfectly balanced, and every bite was delicious. The bakery did an amazing job, and we couldn’t have been happier with our choice for such a special day. Highly recommend!

reviews:
Great service from Charlee and Alex! The food was fantastic, we ordered the Portuguese Shrimp to start, Cornish hen and steak frites, all so good! The glass slipper drink was great, but I love a smoked cocktail and the poison apple drink was to die for! Tastes like fall in a glass, and a funky cinnamon skull on top which was a neat touch. Alex the manager showed us his other stencils for the top of that particular drink and I think that’s such a thoughtful way to add character to a drink, in of course a restaurant called Brother’s Grimm.
Also, they had authentic fairytale plates on the wall which I think is pretty cool as well.
I would absolutely recommend this place and will definitely come back! Something a little different, and such a cozy and classy atmosphere.
And a bonus, live music from a guitar player/singer. He was awesome.
Check out Brothers Grimm!!

This was a crazy experience. We came on Saturday with live music and it was so much fun. Right when we entered, the owner was there to greet us and took our coats to coat check. He came around to check if everything was ok and made us feel so special. But he was like this with everyone and it was nice to see him give everyone such a warm welcome. The food was absolutely mind blowing. A lot of food and flavours you could not get anywhere else. We got the venison pie and the hunters sausage board which consisted of rabbit, venison and duck. The food was phenomenal. Everything is a little pricier than your normal restaurant but you’re paying for the wonderful atmosphere and unique flavours and dishes. We were also celebrating our wedding anniversary and they give you a free chocolate cake desert if you’re celebrating. 100 reccomend this place if you’re looking for a nice night out.

Really nice ambience. Nice Latin and soft jazz music. Service was very attentive and gracious. Food was delicious. I had the wild game pie with generous bone with marrow which was delicious and my wife had Steak frites which was also amazing.

A cosy place in the cellar, with great drinks and delicious food. Great spot to bring the wife for a date. Couple good non alcoholic drinks as well, that stand on their own, not like ughhhh here’s a cocktail with no booze. We had tuna sashimi, very yummy. I had the surf n turf, if I could complain at all- the potatoes and kale were very salty, otherwise delicious. Wife had Cornish hen and it was very good. The sauce with it was perfect, and hen was tender and juicy. We shared the thousand layer dessert, super light and fluffy. General manager came by to introduce himself and make sure everything was ok. We were well looked after. Maybe portion sizes are a tiny bit small for the price, but sometimes I think we all eat too much nowadays anyway.

Amazing place with spectacular service!
The atmosphere is unique, cozy and on point for a dinner date.   The singer/guitarist performed retro folk style tunes from the 60s era  that complimented the vibes of the place perfectly.   Hats off to the entire team behind the scenes in the kitchen... Your food and drinks were impressively presented and even better tasting👌🥂

Our server was 5 star alone even before the food came out! Small little area that would be perfect for musicians to look into!  My 2nd time here, i ordered the same thing as the first time becauae it was so good: steak frites :)

Beautiful decor, great ambiance (just tricky to find the door & narrow entrance). The manager came by personally and introduced himself, as well explained the background and ingredients of his masterpiece cocktail. The waitress was nice too and checked on us often. The menu is unique. The appetizers (brussel sprouts, duck sausage), mains (perfectly cooked soft steak) & dessert (milhoja) were scrumptious.  We had a very  nice time. Definitely going back, when in town.

Date night with another couple before heading to the theatre.  I love these privately owned, bistro type restaurants and Brothers Grimm is a unique, cozy restaurant with excellent food and French inspired dishes.  Our meal was very good and I would recommend the steak frites and the ceviche to start.  However, on this occasion there were a few areas that could be worked on for a better experience.  1) Our waitress was polite and all, but seemed preoccupied and rushed through our order and service.  No matter how great the food is, the service can make or break the meal.  This is what we ended up talking about. 2) we ordered cocktails to start but the bar was backed up so she served our wine first.  A minor point but for a nice restaurant, this was weird. 3) at 5:30pm on a Saturday they were out of the surf n turf option as it was "sold out" from a busy Friday night.  Again, this is a nicer restaurant, and I would think this could have been better planned and finally 4) this was a special occasion and I called ahead about a corking fee for a bottle of wine I had been saving.  They offer this, but it was $60!  That's just excessive when their own wines start at $65 and other restos typically charge $25-30 for a corkage fee.  This was off-putting.  That said, I like this restaurant and am only making these points to help.  I will give the restaurant another try on a similar night out.

name: BSH Toronto
address: 473 A Church St, Toronto, ON M4Y 2C5, Canada
reviews:
I had my first haircut at BSH last week. I told Ryan my plan to transition from very short hair to a bob but the length is not there yet, so I was worried that it would not look good. What I really like is he listened, gave advice and explained. He assured me it's going to look good, that I'm almost there. So much positivity. My hair is very straight and have to be cut really well so it doesn't stick out. Ryan is an expert and gave me such a lovely haircut. I already booked my next appointments.

Btw, his studio is a welcoming space, filled with his vibrant artworks which I love.

Ryan is incredible, I went to him on a whim because my old stylist changed locations and am I ever so grateful! He immediately diagnosed my hair issues, fixed it in the same session, explained clearly what was happening and why, and gave me 1-2 new things to change. You can tell Ryan is a person who cares about his clients, and isn't just after the money. He is well worth what you pay for (and more)! Highly recommend

Ryan is the best in the game. I got a cezanne treatment and haircut with him and had a fantastic experience. He is extremely thorough and knowledgeable, blended my layers flawlessly, and my hair has never looked or felt better. Could not recommend enough!!

Ryan is a fantastic stylist and colourist. I have curly, fine hair and have struggled to find stylists who know how to cut it, and who know how to do blonde highlights without damaging my hair. Ryan can do both. He is a master with using high lift instead of bleach to ensure my hair is brighter, but not damaged. He is the only person I trust to cut and colour my hair properly (and not just so that it looks fine - it always looks fantastic after). Highly recommend Ryan if you have curly hair or are looking for colour services!

I walked into the salon not really knowing what I wanted, other than a cut that would make me feel good. And I’m so glad I went to BSH.
Ryan took great care of my hair and me, with the utmost kindness. I left the salon with a stunning new look and feeling completely pampered. Ryan is a magician with  an expert eye for bringing out the best in your hair, as well as the heart of an angel when it comes to looking after you.
I can’t wait for my next appointment !

name: Lavender pastry& Cake shop
address: 1338 Wellington St. W, Ottawa, ON K1Y 3B7, Canada
reviews:
Lavender Pastry on Wellington Street is a fantastic spot for anyone who appreciates artistic, high-quality baking. The atmosphere is charming and welcoming, making it an ideal place to indulge a sweet tooth.

What truly sets them apart is their dedication to unique and sophisticated flavor profiles. The pistachio saffron cake is a standout masterpiece—the earthy, rich nuttiness of the pistachio pairs beautifully with the luxurious, subtle floral notes of saffron for a taste that is incredibly well-balanced. Beyond their individual pastries, they also offer an exceptional high tea experience, making it a wonderful option for a special afternoon outing or a relaxing weekend treat with friends.

Whether you are looking for a stunning custom cake or a perfectly crafted pastry, this local spot delivers impressive quality and creativity in every bite.

Today I went with my friend for lunch to check out this cute little spot and it did not disappoint. It’s a small space, with welcoming decor and variety of treats. We had the turkey sandwich for lunch with lavender lemonade.. the sandwich was great but I’d rather they don’t grill it with the lettuce in it (got cooked lettuce) and add the lettuce later. Lavender lemonade was very refreshing ( maybe add a little more lavender) and then we ended with pomegranate cheese cake which was light and tasty. We enjoyed our time it was quiet.. and would definitely come back again

Sponge was Dry, icing or cream was lacking. I must say for $57 this is far  below the average. Design was beautiful.

Response:
Firstly Even though the cake was made fresh the ratio of sponge to cream makes the experience very dry. For the Depth of the cake many bakeries utilize multiple layers of sponge and cream to create an even ratio or balanced bite. Your cake has 2 large layers of sponge and 1 layer of cream hence the result is very dry.

Secondly I am sure you make many excellent pastries as your reviews mention. However in my experience your cake fell well below the mark for a Chocolate cake experience.

Lastly the writing  on the cake was not the best. There was huge gap in skill between the esthetic finishing of the cake and the writing. That being said you cake for presentation is definitely very appealing but for actual taste did not meet the other 30 bakeries I have tried.
We wish you a much success!

I couldn't have chosen a better place to have my wedding cake prepared. From start to finish, everything was perfect! We hade a tasting beforehand and the flavors were so delicious, that we ended up choosing two: pistachio and saffron on one tier, and Biscoff on the other. It was beautiful and the taste was amazing! Everyone loved it! I highly recommend Lavender Pastry. They exceeded my expectations! Thank you!

I ordered a birthday cake and the Lavender team did such a great job. We were all amazed not only by the look of the cake - which was exactly what I gave them as reference- but also the taste! The cake was fresh, the cream was light yet very delicious. The filling was tasteful (walnut and banana). All and all I 100% recommend Lavender pastry ❤️

For my graduation picnic, I ordered 30 mini cakes from Lavender Pastry, and they completely exceeded my expectations. The cakes were absolutely beautiful, and somehow, they tasted even better than they looked. Everyone was so excited that all the cakes were taken before I even had the chance to get one final look at them. Every single guest was impressed and kept complimenting both the presentation and the taste.
The service was also amazing. They were incredibly friendly, professional, responsive, and quick to prepare my order. Everything was handled smoothly, and the cakes were ready on time, which made the entire experience stress-free.
I truly cannot recommend Lavender Pastry enough. From my mother’s 50th birthday to my graduation and many smaller celebrations in between, they have always delivered delicious, beautifully made cakes that make every occasion feel even more special and memorable.
Lavender Pastry is now my go-to place for celebrations. Thank you so much for your incredible work and consistently wonderful service!

First time discovering this beautiful pastry shop on Wellington Street.I ordered a blueberry cheesecake for a birthday and it is one of the best cheesecakes I’ve ever had! Light and very tasty! They have a nice assortment of mini cheesecakes, swiss roles, cakes and an extensive drink selection. There is seating so would be an awesome spot to stop in for a cappuccino and treat! Thank you for the amazing cake, I’ll have to stop in again to try some of the pastries!

I really love Lavender Pastry. Everything always looks fresh and beautiful, and the people there are so kind and welcoming. You can truly taste authentic Persian pastries here. Every Nowrooz, I order from them and I absolutely love everything. This is honestly the place for Persian pastries—the quality is unbelievable. It feels very close to home and truly tastes like home. By far the best Persian pastry in town. Highly recommend!

name: Knight & Rose Café
address: 236 Queen St S Second Floor, Mississauga, ON L5M 1L5, Canada
reviews:
Really disappointing experience overall. Definitely not a good date spot unless you want your date to be disappointed.

I specifically stayed in the cafe because I asked if they had outlets for laptops and was told they did, but none of the charging ports I tried would actually charge my gaming laptop. I was about to do work on my laptop but I couldn’t because it couldn’t charge.

The menu listed 5 different chai option both hot or iced, but when I ordered iced, the staff said they didn’t know how to make it. If it’s on the menu, it should be available or removed from the list.

I ordered a Blush Rose instead but was initially given a Blue Mirage. They offered to remake it, but drink the Blue Mirage and I ordered the Blush Rose again. The drink looked completely different from what was advertised. I was then told they were out of the syrup/purée and had substituted it with Sprite and lemonade after it was given it to me. Paying $6 for what was essentially Sprite and lemonade is pretty disappointing, when I could have bought the drinks at a grocery and made it myself.

Spending money is not an issue because I’ve spent a lot on cafes. However, most times the money was worth the product and service.

The menu also claims this place is “Instagram-worthy,” but honestly the only thing worth taking pictures of was the decor near and inside the washrooms.

Lastly, the dessert portions are tiny for the price, and overall everything felt overpriced for the quality and experience.

Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ll be coming back.

Stopped by Knight & Rose Café in Streetsville and had a fantastic experience. Our server, Ishfaq, was friendly, attentive, and made us feel very welcome throughout our visit.

I tried the Vietnamese coffee, and it was honestly one of the best cold coffees I've had in a long time rich, smooth, refreshing, and perfectly balanced. My wife ordered the Mango Matcha Fusion, which was equally impressive. The mango flavor was subtle and complemented the matcha beautifully without overpowering it.

A nice bonus is that you can also order delicious halal food from Blackstone downstairs, making it a great spot if you're looking for both excellent drinks and a meal. They also serve shisha, so it's a perfect place to relax and spend time with friends or family.

Great drinks, excellent service, a cozy atmosphere, and plenty of options to enjoy. We'll definitely be coming back to try more from the menu. Highly recommend!

Really disappointing experience.

Even before arriving, the experience was frustrating. About 20 minutes beforehand, I called to ask whether the café accepted walk-ins or was by reservation only. The person on the phone didn’t seem to understand what “walk-in” meant, and I had to explain it before he understood my question. After that, I was told they accepted reservations only. However, when we arrived, the café was completely empty, making that information even more confusing.

Once seated, we expected a normal dine-in experience, but our food was served in takeout containers with plastic forks. There was no explanation whatsoever. It honestly felt like the staff simply didn’t want to use proper plates and cutlery. This was especially disappointing considering the food is advertised online with an appealing dine-in presentation on actual plates.

The service was equally unprofessional. While taking our order, the server didn’t write anything down. A few moments later, he shouted across the café to ask us to repeat our order. Even though we were the only customers, a basic level of professionalism and attentiveness is expected, especially at these prices.

Ordering drinks was also frustrating. I asked which Barbican flavours were available and was told that all flavours were in stock, so we ordered two pineapple Barbicans. The server then returned and said pineapple wasn’t available. We switched to two strawberry Barbicans, and he agreed. Then, while walking back toward our table, he shouted from across the café that there was only one strawberry left.

The entire experience felt disorganized and unprofessional from start to finish. The food itself was decent, but the poor service, confusing communication, and lack of a proper dine-in experience completely overshadowed it. Unfortunately, I wouldn’t return unless there are significant improvements to the service and overall customer experience.

The mango matcha and the tres le ches was good!
Ambiance is decent.
Doesn't have a wow factor but overall fine.
Seems a cozy place more suited for winter also the offerings more align with the cold weather and cozy environment. May be will try in winter. Entrance could be confusing.

Was glad to finally come back to visit this beautiful hidden gem. The service is amazing and the gentleman who served us made us feel special. The latte was great and so was the creme brule. Will definitely be back with my friend who also enjoyed it. Must visit for those who have not been

Knight and Rose Café offers an exceptional experience from start to finish! The atmosphere is elegant yet inviting, and the customer service truly stands out ,we were made to feel like friends rather than guests.

Our latte and dessert were absolutely delicious, beautifully presented, and perfectly crafted. We were greeted and served by Ariz, who is warm, personable, and attentive. Meghan is a wonderful server  friendly, thoughtful, and even offered to take a photo of us, which made our visit extra special.

A classy café with heart  we’ll definitely be returning!

IG Handle: coffeedatewkev

Had a wonderful experience at Knight & Rose Cafe. I tried the Rose Silk Latte and the Lotus Tres Leches, and both were absolutely delicious. The latte was sweet, floral, and unique, while the cake was rich and flavorful without being too heavy.

What really stood out was the kindness of the staff, big shout out to Rahmeen, she was welcoming and made the café feel warm and inviting from the moment I walked in.

Whether you're looking for a cozy spot to relax, catch up with a friend, or enjoy a quiet coffee date with yourself or someone else, I would definitely recommend stopping by. I'll be back!

Place is located on 1st floor in streetsville building. Nice location. Its a cozy cafe and shisha lounge.  They have a very nice service and hospitality attitude. Very accomadating.
Coffees are nice and they are ready to customize as per your prefrence.
We tried latte and rose silk latte. Both were good. And a tres leches cake which is the only dessert or eating option in entire cafe. Which is definitely a downside. But its was nicely made.
Good experience overall

name: BossArts Salon and Spa
address: located Beside Sonders, 161 Laurier Ave W, Ottawa, ON K1P 5J4, Canada
reviews:
I am absolutely in love with my hair! Going into my appointment, I was very nervous about having to do a big chop, but Amy made the entire experience so comfortable and reassuring. From start to finish, she took the time to guide me through the process, answer my questions, and ease my concerns.

Amy is incredibly knowledgeable and helped educate me about my curls in a way that was both informative and empowering. Her passion and expertise truly shine through in her work.

The service was absolutely worth it, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Thank you so much, Amy, for your patience, kindness, and amazing work. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a stylist who genuinely cares about their clients and their hair journey!

I got the curly creative cut 2A-3B from Amy and it was worth every penny! Will definitely be going again for a trim/maintenance. If you want someone who knows what they’re doing with wavy/curly hair, she’s the stylist to go to! I’ve never been happier coming out a salon appointment and she’s one of the few stylists I happily trust with my hair.

Boss arts was clean and calming. Everyone was very friendly.

I absolutely loved my curly cut experience with Amy! She was knowledgeable, down to earth and gave me the confidence I needed to wear my hair naturally and embrace my curls!
We are on week 2 post cut, and I’m still loving my hair. Cannot thank her enough!
HIGHLY RECOMMEND 😊

It was my first experience at BossArts & I absolutely LOVED IT! Rajaa did such an amazing job doing wavy curls (I got the what is called an Occasion Hair), exactly the style I’ve been wanting.

+ Staff is very sweet, highly recommend!

Finding this salon was one of the best things to happen to me. From the moment you walk in, everyone is so warm and welcoming, and Sarina’s energy instantly makes you feel right at home.

Amy is truly one of a kind. Before finding her, I hated getting my hair cut and would put it off for as long as possible. Now, it’s the complete opposite. The second I leave her chair, I’m already looking forward to my next appointment. She’s completely transformed my curls and my confidence in them.

What sets Amy apart is that she doesn’t just give you an amazing haircut - she takes the time to educate you about your hair, how to care for it properly at home, and rebuilds a spark of confidence within you! Every appointment feels like you’re learning something new, and to double down, she’s the kindest, sweetest soul.

I always say her hands are magic, and I genuinely recommend her to everyone. If you’re considering booking with Amy, do it. You won’t regret it!❤️

I had a hair cut and full highlights with Rajaa who was absolutely amazing. She took her time and explained different colour options. My hair was very blonde and I thought it was just way too bright and she agreed and recommended that I get high and low highlights. I love how it turned out and the cut was also exactly what I was looking for. I found the best hair salon and the best hairstylist. Highly recommend this gem of a place and I plan on telling ever I can.

I had Amy for my curly cut, and it was my first time ever getting one, she was absolutely amazing. She walked me through every step of the process and gave me really helpful advice on how to take better care of my curls. The whole experience was incredible, and she made me feel so comfortable the entire time. She’s also super kind and easy to talk to. I 100% recommend her if you’re looking for a curly cut

I went to see Amy for all full curly haircut service. I have never had a good haircut experience and after seeing Amy I have never been more happy with my hair. She did such a good job cutting my hair and styling it. She is very honest and she is very knowledgeable on what would look good and bad based on your curl pattern. She is worth every penny and I am definitely booking with her again. 10/10

name: Beyond The Batter Bakery
address: 1791 Stone Church Rd E, Hamilton, ON L8J 0B4, Canada
reviews: The owner and the service was so friendly and kind. Extra helpful staff. The treats are endless and they're DELICIOUS!! They now have their version of a Dirty Sodas, in lots of unique flavours. I tried the one with coke, vanilla and cherry in it and it was great! They also carry local Milk products from Station Dairy and I love it. Especially the coffee milk. They make a really good Banana Pudding and of course the cupcakes are delicious. Can't wait to go back.

Having a peanut and nut allergy there is a very select places you can find to actually eat safety. I’ve been coming to the bakery since they opened. Just knowing it’s safe to eat for me is all I need to know. Absolutely love the lemon cupcakes but I’ve tried handful of different flavours over the years and all are just as yummy. It’s over a 3 hour drive for me so we always order the dozen cupcakes so we can freeze them when we get home. They taste just as good defrosted weeks later, well if they last that long. Everything is always delicious and I look forward to visiting the area.

I go to beyond the batter often for my cupcake fix. They have a great selection of options that change weekly. We more recently tried their banana pudding which was one of the best I have had recently.

I do not have any photos of the cupcakes but their other treats are amazing as well. Sweet treats done right and with enough variety you can give something to almost anyone, inlcuding gluten free. Cinnamon buns, cookies, cheesecake cups, and of course the cupcakes. All of it is delicious.

I ordered cupcakes for my son’s birthday, and I couldn’t be happier with them! They were absolutely delicious, incredibly fresh, and tasted truly homemade. Every single kid at the party loved them!

The cupcakes were decorated exactly the way I had requested, and they turned out even better than I imagined.

I was beyond happy with my order and will definitely be coming back for future celebrations. Highly recommend!

Guys I sent my nephew here to get some sweets for the family. On the call I faced timed my nephew to find out what I was wanted. I was greeted with a lady in pink named Candace. She literally was the sweetest cute lady that is passionate about pink and sweets. We had a little chat where she helped my nephew pick out some treats for the family. Just amazing customer service. When I finally got the eat some of what was brought back, literally I loved everything. The cupcakes where sweet but in a way you could eat two at a time because the flavour is balanced with the butter cream and nothing over powers it was just a masterpiece. Fluffy and very interesting flavours. I am not sure what I had but it had a fuzzy peach on it and this one was my favourite. Everyone I gave a treat to asked me if I had another the disappointing thing was I ran out of things to eat! Please visit this bakery and Candace, thank you for our Sunday treat.

This was my second time coming here, first time was gender reveal cupcakes that came out beautifully. Girl working the counter was pleasant & quick. Cupcakes were reallyyyyy good, my only complaint would be the dirty sodas, I got a Shirley temple and it just tasted like sprite. It was still good but I just feel like the dirty sodas could be a tad better, & I’m only saying this so I have a reliable place to get dirty sodas LOL

Went in to get a few things to bring as dessert. I asked to have the brownie cut in half. She proceeded to butcher it with the BACK OF A PLASTIC FORK! I asked her if she had a knife and she replied by saying she did in the back but didn’t want to wash it! I can’t make this up! $19 for two cupcakes and a brownie and no class to cut it with a knife! Never again!

Update:
After leaving my initial review, the owner reached out personally and handled the situation with genuine care, professionalism, and generosity. She reviewed the interaction, took the matter seriously, and made a sincere effort to make things right.

reviews: eclair was bad, the frosting tastes like premade jarred frosting, and the cream was over whipped and greasy. brownie was extremely dense, lacked real chocolate flavour, and was the frosting also tasted like artificial grocery store ones. lemon bar was okay.

A small bakery that carry delicious baked goods. We loved every pastry we bought. I highly recommend the eccles. They were so good. The cherry danish is also great along with the scones.They sold out on the different flavours so only got the oatmeal one. Pastries were lightly sweetened which is perfect. I was also amazed of the prices which are more affordable than other bakeries I have been to. They also sell coffee which was also just perfect, not watered down like other places. The lady who served us was kind and accommodating. This place is a perfect spot to grab baked goods and a cup of coffee. Definitely my new go to place when in Hamilton.
We enjoyed a spread of cookies, cupcakes, chocolate squares, and crisps. Everything fresh and flavorful.

It was okay, but the flavours were not balanced correctly, in my opinion. The brownie was quite oily (but extremely moist because of that), and didn't have a strong chocolate flavour. The icing was tasteless. The eclair pastry was fresh and homemade tasting, but the icing was super sweet and the filling under sweet. The icing was like chocolate cake icing, not like an eclair icing. The meringues, I tossed after trying. The white one with chocolate chips was way too sweet. The lemon one wasn't, but it wasn't worth eating. I came to this place because of the great ratings and because I wanted to try their sticky buns or cinnamon buns. The sweet buns were not available when I arrived. I hate to give this star level for a bakery's review, but it is my honest opinion. I would try this place again (if I was in the area) to try their sticky buns because I enjoyed their eclair pastry, but I wouldn't rebuy the sweets I already purchased.

Products: pies (dessert), pies (dinner) like chicken pot pie, bars, cupcakes, cake, butter tarts, meringues, eclairs, mini cheesecakes, croissants, scones, sticky buns, banana bread, loaves of bread, pop, juice, and water bottles.

Tips: If you want a jaw dropping brownie, try Eric the Baker's or Decadently Yours caramel brownie in Guelph.

She found florals and greenery that matched our colours to a tee. And of course the Weil’s cakes — carrot cake, lemon cake and vanilla with raspberry buttercream — and donuts were delicious. I can’t get over how light and flavourful the lemon cake and the vanilla cake were and yet still supportive enough for a three tier wedding cake (the proper dowels were inserted in). address: 5425 Creditview Rd #4, Mississauga, ON L5V 2P3, Canada
reviews:
Here’s a polished, firm, and professional version of your review:

I visited your Heartland location yesterday morning for a full arm, full leg, and underarm wax. Before the service started, I requested that the esthetician use a spatula to apply the wax instead of a roll-on, as that is my personal preference and the method that has always been used for me at your Bristol & Creditview location.

I was then told that I would have to pay an additional $25 on top of the regular $50 service because using a spatula is supposedly more time-consuming. I explained that I have never been charged this fee at your other location. Rather than argue, I decided to leave and go to the Bristol & Creditview salon instead.

Before driving there, I called to confirm the pricing and was told the additional charge would only be $10. However, when I arrived, I was informed that the Heartland location had already called them, and after speaking with the owner, they would now also be charging me the additional $25.

The issue is not simply the extra charge—it’s the inconsistency, poor communication, and the way the situation was handled. If there is an additional fee for using a spatula instead of a roll-on, it should be clearly disclosed and applied consistently across all locations. The method of wax application is a customer’s personal preference and should not result in customers receiving different information depending on which location they visit.

To make matters worse, I was the first customer of the morning, yet the experience left me feeling unwelcome and undervalued. Instead of trying to resolve the concern professionally, it felt like both locations coordinated only to ensure I would be charged more.

I originally came to your salon through a recommendation, but unfortunately this experience has completely changed my opinion. I’ve already shared what happened with several friends who also visit your salons, and they were equally disappointed by how this was handled.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously. Better staff training in customer service, transparency, and consistent pricing policies across locations would go a long way in improving the customer experience. Unfortunately, you’ve lost me as a customer.

This version keeps the criticism factual, emphasizes the inconsistent pricing and customer service, and is more likely to be taken seriously by both management and other readers.

Both my 6yr old and I of us got our haircuts together today, and Maheeda and Manpreet did a fantastic job. The whole atmosphere was very calm and both of them were quick in their work. The prices were also affordable. Overall a nice experience. Will definitely go back and recommend.

I arrived at the salon today for a haircut and was asked to wait initially, which I understood. However, multiple customers who came in after me were served ahead, including two walk-ins with no prior appointment. I waited over 1 hour watching others go first, with no communication or apology from the barber or owner.
When I finally approached, no explanation was offered—it felt dismissive and frustrating, especially as a loyal customer expecting basic fairness. I left without service, deeply disappointed. Salons should prioritize fairly and communicate; this was my worst experience ever. Avoid if you value your time.

The WORST experience ever !!!
I went there for my 4 yr old sons hair trim.
I specifically told him only to trim his hair. and THIS is what i got! the guy did such a bad job! and when i politely told him that he made them crooked, he was so rude and blamed it on my son moving all the time which was a lie. He messed them up in the end from the front when my son was calmly sitting and not moving...

Any kid will move a little, if youre unable do a decent job with kids, just DONT take them! Please deny your service for kids and save us the money as well as the bad experience of having a sloppy haircut for our children.. It matters to us!!

Never going there again!
Really nice hair looks healthy and feels very soft, exactly what I was asking for. I was treated w kindness and the process wasn’t unprofessional in any way! 😍😍

If you’re looking for someone who knows exactly what they’re doing and makes the experience just as good as the result, Julien is it.

From the moment I walked into the salon, the experience was nothing short of amazing. I was warmly welcomed, felt completely at ease, and knew right away I was in great hands. The atmosphere was inviting, professional, and full of positive energy.
Julien is truly an artist. He took the time to listen, understand what I wanted, and offered expert advice that made me feel confident and excited. The transformation was absolutely stunning — my hair color turned out even more beautiful than I imagined. The tone, depth, and shine are flawless, and the color suits me perfectly.
What impressed me most was Julien’s attention to detail, skill, and passion for his craft. It’s rare to find a hairdresser who combines technical expertise with such creativity and care. From the moment I sat in her chair, she really took the time to listen and understand exactly what I wanted. I told her that I didn’t want to cut too much length, and she completely respected that. Instead of pushing for a big change, she suggested small adjustments that would keep my hair healthy and fresh while still maintaining the length I love.

What I appreciated the most is how attentive and thoughtful she was. Luisa makes you feel comfortable, almost like you’re talking to someone who truly cares—she even gives advice the way a caring mom would give it to her daughter. She explains what would work best for your hair and why, which makes it easy to trust her recommendations.

Her technique is excellent, and she clearly has a lot of experience. My hair came out looking natural, healthy, and exactly how I wanted it just better. It’s not easy to find a hairdresser who really listens and respects your preferences, but Luisa definitely does.

I highly recommend Luisa Di Nitto at Christopher Salon if you’re looking for someone talented, professional, and genuinely attentive to her clients.

Thank you 🤍

Hands down the best men’s haircut I’ve had. Gianna at Salon Christopher absolutely nailed it. She really listens to what you want, understands head shape and hair texture, and delivers a cut that looks sharp the day of and still grows in perfectly weeks later.

The attention to detail, precision, and overall experience are next level. No rushing, no guessing — just pure skill. If you’re serious about a great men’s cut, ask for Gianna. You won’t go anywhere else after.

One word: perfection. From the accessibility of the location, to the decor, to the quality of the products used, the superior service provided by the staff… I wish I could go back every week! Hands down the best hair salon in Montreal. The staff is very attentive and results are breathtaking. Thank you team for the great work! Thank you Julien!

reviews: An unexpected experience that is a nice change.  It was my first time we had sevice from hearing-impaired staff so after a few moments of self adaptation I was pleased with their kindness and attention ro detail.  The fiod was very good.  Excellent tortellini and my friend enjoyed his hamburger.  The quantity of food  in the plate was perfect.  We were outside on the patio.  Washrooms are on their way second floor.  Good service and food.

If you've ever thought about possibly trying a dining in the dark experience,  do it.  Of course there's no photos from the meal.  It is a great sensory experience and exercise in awareness to eat your meal in Complete darkness.  Tried the three course option to have dessert as well.  Everything was very delicious and two pleasant surprises for the starter salad and dessert. There was only the one veggie main of pasta,  and the veggies were excellent (and taste heightened by the darkness?)

We came to Dark Fork on a date night last week and it was an entirely different experience. We dined inside and have never experienced pitch black dining. We chose the 3 course meal and asked that every meal was a surprise dish. This meal choice option was so exciting. The dishes were so flavourful and my boy and i had a fun experience trying to navigate our dining since we are so use to seeing everything around us. All senses were heightened and our waiter Dave was truly helpful and an amazing guide. Really interesting experience, I didn’t even mind not having my phone or an light source whatsoever. 10/10 loved

The menu was designed for the experience, and absolutely delicious. Our waiter Dave was kind and funny, charming and detailed. He explained everything clearly and made the whole dark experience really enjoyable. It ended up being such a memorable night. Highly recommend.

I tried both the ASL patio and the indoor dark experience. First of all, I have allergies and the staff were really fantastic about accommodating. I appreciated that. The food was delicious both times. I loved being able to use my ASL with the patio staff, and my waiter indoors was fantastic. The experience really gave me insight into what it must be likr for my blind students. I would absolutely recommend!

Came here with a friend to try out the ASL patio, the courtyard area is such a nice atmosphere. I enjoyed my Caesar and the mac and cheese. The fries turned out to be reheated from frozen McCain fries, so I wouldn't recommend those.

Another time, I hope to try out the dining in the dark experience indoors.

Really unique and unforgettable experience! The team here was awesome, and we all enjoyed how much you could notice while dining in the dark. I wish the food had been better, but otherwise, you’ll have to try this, at least, once!

Ate on the patio to celebrate my anniversary with my partner. The vibes were top tier. Kessi served us and they were so wonderful. They were kind, attentive, and quite forgiving of my attempted sign language. They gave us some ice cream at the end of our dinner which made the service that much better. Thank you Kessi, it was a great way to celebrate for us!

name: Haven Barbershop
address: 3289 Rue Saint-Jacques, Montreal, Quebec H4C 1G8, Canada
reviews: Been a loyal client of Jeremy’s for the last 4 years. He’s not just a barber who knows exactly how I like my hair, but a great person to chat with. The atmosphere at the shop is always welcoming. If you want a barber you can trust long-term, look no further than Jeremy! Don’t forget to grab an espresso before leaving!

Ryan is hands-down the best barber around. Every visit is a great experience from start to finish. He takes his time, pays attention to every detail, and consistently delivers a sharp, clean cut exactly how you want it. The atmosphere is always welcoming and relaxed, which makes the whole experience even better. Professional, talented, and genuinely passionate about his craft—Ryan never disappoints. If you’re looking for a barber who combines skill, great service, and an awesome vibe, Ryan is the one to see. Highly recommend.

Booking was easy and staff was very friendly. It was my first time going to this shop, I would have gone to my regular guy, but I was a long way from home and needed a cut before my trip. The barber was very attentive to what I wanted, often providing good suggestions before going forward with the cut. I've seen some barbers just ask a few questions here and there at the start and just run through the whole thing. I mean, it's fine if your aim is something simple and generic. But you can tell the difference between one that can cut versus someone with skill and passion.

I had Jeremy as my barber for the first time, and he did a great job! I’m not the best at describing what I usually want, but despite that, he was quickly able to figure out what I like while also throwing in a suggestion or two. I can definitely recommend Jeremy for anyone looking for a new barber!

Beautiful space, and professional stuff, despite the delay in my scheduled appointment time.
The barber was very friendly, and asked a lot of questions. However, the final result wasn't the desired one. Despite the good intentions, there was a lot to be desired in the produced hair symmetry & flow.

I'm definitely rating this business a 5 star. I booked my appointment just a little over an hour before my appointment, ran late, but was still well received by Ryan. This barber was extremely friendly, professional and gave me a classic scissor cut. To my liking, I walked out satisfied and would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for an impeccable service.
Best barbershop in the city! Professional guys, on-time, and the price is right. Book with Chris! (All the guys are good!)
I’ve been going to this shop for 2-3 years now and there are no regrets. All the barbers are friendly, the shop has a great ambiance and my barber Angelo is top tier. Highly recommended this shop!
