name: Sage Hair Studio
address: 188 Queen St S, Mississauga, ON L5M 1L3, Canada
reviews: I had such a great experience with Nicole! She’s incredibly honest and genuinely cares about the health of your hair. She takes the time to explain everything, listens to what you want, and makes sure you understand the process. She’s also super sweet and easy to talk to. I’m so excited to continue working with her to achieve my dream hair colour while maintaining the health of my hair. I highly recommend Nicole if you’re looking for someone who truly puts your hair’s health first!

I LOVE MY HAIR!!! I was so over what I had and when I went to get a bang trim from Nicole she gave me a quick consultation and helped me figure out a style for my hair. She was so helpful with all my questions and even helped me work out a budget to save for. She really went above & beyond. I wasn't nervous walking in to my appointment because I trusted Nicole and when I say she did the best transformation ever on me, I mean it. I'm so in love with my hair & can't stop looking at it. Nicole is the absolute sweetest and I had the best day ever at the salon because of her and the rest of the staff. They gave me compliments and I felt so pretty walking out. Even just seeing how they interact with eachother and other customers makes me forever want to come back here. Thank you so much Nicole❤️

I met with Layla for a consultation and booked an appointment right away I hadn't had anything done to my hair for over a year. Layla knew what to do right away and understood what I was looking for the trust was instant. She did an amazing job with toning back to my original color with a hair cut/style that I love and compliments from many. I would recommend Layla to anyone.

I visited your salon for a haircut and was assisted by Layla. Unfortunately, my experience was very disappointing from the very beginning.

While washing my hair, she was pulling it quite hard. I politely mentioned that it was hurting, she smirked and said, “Oh, I didn’t realize I was pulling your hair.” Her response came across as dismissive and unprofessional.

Before the haircut, I clearly explained that I am a hijabi and did not want to lose any length. I specifically requested long layers while keeping the overall length intact. She even showed me how much she was going to trim, and I confirmed that the length was fine.

However, after blow-drying my hair, I noticed that she had barely added any layers. My hair looked flat and almost identical to how it did before the haircut. When I pointed this out, she told me that because I didn’t want my hair to be shorter, she couldn’t give me layers. I politely asked if she could add some long layers while keeping the length, but she refused, saying she had another client waiting. She walked away to her next appointment, left me sitting there, and told me to book another appointment if I wanted my hair fixed.

I then spoke to the receptionist she told me the studio will be closed in 30 mints then I  explained that I was only visiting Mississauga for the weekend while staying with a friend. I live in Toronto and would not be able to return on a weekday. Despite explaining my situation, I was told there were no appointments available the next day, and no effort was made to accommodate me.

I was still charged $90 for what was essentially a simple trim something I honestly could have done myself at home. I felt extremely uncomfortable and overwhelmed at the time, so I didn’t know how to speak up and simply paid and left. Later, when I told my friend what had happened, they asked why I paid for a service that wasn’t completed as requested.

I am very disappointed with both the quality of the service and the way the situation was handled. I came in with clear instructions and reasonable expectations, but I left feeling ignored, rushed, and dissatisfied. I would appreciate it if this matter could be reviewed and an appropriate resolution could be offered.

Recently got my hair cut and colored with Janice and I absolutely LOVE both my cut and color.  I showed her pictures and explained what I was looking for and the color turned out to be an exact match and the cut so sharp and stylish!  My favorite thus far!  The staff are so warm and friendly there too!  If you're looking for a salon that is welcoming, not stuffy and pretentious, but gives you the same quality cut and treatment then give Janice and her a team a try!

name: Priska & Co
address: 4em étage, 4030 Rue Saint-Ambroise local: 400, Montréal, QC H4C 2C7, Canada
reviews:
Second time I go, first time I had a haircut with Genevieve and I loved it, plus she was super nice.
Second time I had a color treatment with Nicholas, and I love it so much as well. Is even getting better with the days. He was super kind too :)
I totally recommend this place

Beautiful salon. You feel good in the space.
The staff is kind, down to earth.
Ladies, if you want a memorable experience and incredible result, book Anouck and you’ll thank me later!
This is my second time coming to this salon for blonde highlights! A wonderful space. Nicolas was super professional, friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommend!

I got my hair cut by Genevieve and she did such a fantastic job! She was amazing at listening to what I wanted and checking in with the length etc. throughout the process. Plus she was lovely to chat to!! Highly recommend!

What can I say? Pure perfection! Joel styled my hair for my wedding. It was everything I wanted and more! It held all day and night, not a single bobby pin budged. His fun and outgoing nature also helped breakdown my pre-wedding nerves. Highly recommend, can't wait to work with him again! Merci Joel.

I fell upon priska salon on a whim looking to get a bob cut, i originally had an appointment with another stylist but there was a bit of an issue with time and my hair texture which made me feel disappointed in the moment but fanny approached me with a  “I’ve got time” I had met with Fanny and she has a caring energy and wasn’t intimidated by my hair texture which made me feel safe  in her hands and she understood exactly what my expectations were even with a small language barrier (my French isn’t the best) she didn’t sweat it. I left feeling happy even rebooked my next appointment in advance.

The secretary was also super kind easy going and was enthusiastic about helping me when I was having trouble finding the right building.

Overall a beautiful salon space with a great look 10/10 recommend 😊

I've been here 3 times and had a different stylist each time since I was booking the same day. I had a great experience each time- with Henri, Fanny, and Genevieve. They listened to what i wanted and provided great results. I would gladly book with any of them again, and I wouldn't hesitate to try anyone else in the salon, because I think they are all great :) ♡

It was my first time at the salon & I booked with Genevieve (I read the reviews before booking my appointment). The salon is beautiful and spacious, everyone is friendly and great atmosphere. I’m writing a review because Genevieve is the stylist that cut my hair; I showed her my inspo pic, she listened to what I wanted and helped me achieve a new look. She was super professional and kind. It was such a nice experience, I’ll be returning for sure! I’m so happy I tried this salon and booked with her. You won’t be disappointed:)

name: Star Glow Boba & Coffee
address: 880 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M6G 1M5, Canada
reviews: The boba is so amazing. I loved it so much I finished the drink in under 30 minutes it’s addicting. The place was clean. No dust in sight. Not only that but she is the most sweetest person alive. Trust me she’s make you feel welcome. GET BOBA FROM HER.

Had such a nice time in this café! I got the Meatball Banh Mi and the Taro slushie. The slushie was one of the best that I’ve had as they make all their fruit shakes with real fruit, including the taro! The owner was also really nice, bubbly and sweet. If you ever want to have good Vietnamese food, visit here. You won’t be disappointed

Really LOVE this place! The owner is such a warm and friendly lady, and she's always so welcoming and kind. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxing, and the prices are great too. It's always a pleasure coming here.❤️❤️❤️

I've tried their Coco Matcha Smoothie several times and experimented with different toppings. Honestly, it's delicious even without any toppings, but after trying a few combinations, pearls are definitely my personal favorite.

I especially love the coconut smoothie base. The coconut flavor is noticeable without being overpowering, and it blends beautifully with the rich matcha flavor. It's delicious with or without syrup, my personal favorite is less sweetie with a serving of pearls. The rich, creamy smoothie combined with the chewy texture of the pearls is just perfect! Just make sure to enjoy the pearls sooner rather than later, because they can get pretty hard once they get too cold.

After a long week of work, I love coming here for a smoothie. It's cold, refreshing, and just what I need to feel refreshed and ready for the weekend.

I really enjoy coming here, and I'll definitely keep coming back!)

I love this place!!!

Star Globe Boba and Coffee is honestly one of my go-to spots now. The customer service is amazing, everyone is super friendly, and the owner is so sweet.

They have sooo many options and you can customize your drink exactly how you like it, which I love.

The flavors are really good and not overly sweet, which is perfect.

Highly recommend if you’re in the area and craving bubble tea, you won’t be disappointed! 😊

Cutest cafe ever with the friendliest customer service! When it comes to supporting locals, I’ll happily come to places like this! I ordered the soy milk - they make it daily and the quality shows, it tasted really fresh! 10/10 recommend coming to this place as their menu has so much to choose from!

Service was fast and friendly and the bubble tea was delicious! They have tons of flavours. They use real fruit for their smoothies and they look super pretty. I got the strawberry smoothie! Highly recommend, such nice people. Thank you Star Glow! I'll be back :)

Lovely family owned small business, quiet space, very clean including the spacious washroom. The person at the front works alone I think so I'd be understanding towards time it takes but honestly today was not too busy so she was quick! You can tell lots of love was put into the space. The menu is large and versatile, mainly focused on fruit based items.
This place is so adorable with the best boba! A generous amount of toppings and such a sweet owner 💘💘

name: Keyto Your Heart Bakery
address: 475 Somerset St W, Ottawa, ON K1R 5J7, Canada
reviews:
I ordered a cake and desserts from this bakery for a celebration, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. The quality was truly exceptional. Everything was incredibly fresh, beautifully presented, and absolutely delicious. Knowing that the desserts were sugar-free, gluten-free, and keto-friendly made them even more impressive.

The customer service was outstanding from start to finish. Every guest at our party loved the desserts, and many couldn’t believe they were healthy as well as delicious.

I also had the chance to try their new drinks, and they were absolutely amazing! They’re the perfect addition to an already incredible menu.

Freshness, amazing flavor, beautiful presentation, healthy ingredients, delicious drinks, and outstanding customer service—all in one place. That’s my definition of dessert heaven!

This place has definitely earned a loyal customer. I can’t wait to order again. Highly recommended!

Try the Swiss raspberry roll - it is scrumptious and very fresh!  Melt in your mouth smooth flavors that mesh perfectly.  You can't even tell it is sugar and gluten-free.  Our guests were amazed at the quality and freshness too.  This bakery goes above and beyond for their customers.  Delivery was also the very next day.  Try them out!  A true gem of a bakery :)

Absolutely wonderful keto bakery! Everything we've tried has been fresh, soft, fluffy, and incredibly delicious. The desserts don't taste "keto" at all—they're rich, satisfying, and honestly quite addictive!
I ordered the pistachio cake for my birthday and it was fantastic. We've also enjoyed the chocolate cake squares, which were equally amazing. I can't wait to try the strawberry shortcake next. It's such a treat to find a bakery that creates keto-friendly desserts without compromising on taste or quality. Highly recommended!

I’ve ordered different products from this bakery several times, and their quality is truly amazing. What really impressed me is that everything is made in a healthy way, so you can enjoy as much as you want without feeling guilty.
Keto, gluten-free, grain-free, sugar-free — having all of these together is honestly the best combination possible.

On top of that, they are very customer oriented, and their service is just as good as their 100% quality products. You really get a great feeling every time you buy from them.
I highly recommend everyone to give it a try.

We placed an order for a variety of items that was supposed to arrive on July 5. Luckily, we were home because it showed up a day early on July 4.

We brought everything to a gathering the next day and were embarrassed to serve what tasted like old baked goods. The donuts were so hard they were difficult to cut in half. They were more like stale bagels with sweet toppings.

The "chocolate cake square" was crunchy from the erythritol, and that's all you could taste—so gross. At least we powder our erythritol at home before baking with it.

We emailed them to let them know the order arrived early, and their response was to offer us 15% off our next order... seriously?

The six panini buns were all baked differently, and three of them were burned on top.

Now I know why they list only the net carbs and not the calories. The donuts are pushing 700 calories each, keep that in mind. Each one weighed 155 grams, with most of that weight coming from coconut flour (one cup of coconut flour has about 525 calories). The same goes for all of the baked goods. The panini bread alone is around 700 calories before you even add any sandwich toppings.

You can keep your 15%.

Been dealing with this business for more than 2 years. They have the best cakes and service , today we were able to celebrate my son turning 1 year old with the help of this wonderful cake and cookies they made for me.

We had an amazing strawberry shortcake as a topper for our wedding dessert tower! That cake was to die for good! So moist and beautifully put together, my bride barely was in time to have a slice!  You would never think this was keto! Highly recommend! Over time we tried many items and were always amazed at the quality and service!

I've tried a lot of their baked goods and am very impressed with the quality. As someone who has a sweet tooth but have to be on Keto for pre-diabetics conditions, this bakery is life saver. The staffs are also very kind. Will definitely come back again

name: Orange Turtle Bakery
address: 285 St. Patrick St, Ottawa, ON K1N 5K4, Canada
reviews:
I went to Orange Turtle Bakery countless times while I was filming in Ottawa, and it quickly became my absolute favorite spot in the city.

Majed, the owner, is truly one of the kindest, most genuine people you’ll meet, and his passion comes through in every single pastry. There’s something really special about what he’s created here. The flavors are unlike anything I’ve had before, so unique, and beautifully balanced. I love the scones, the pistachio shortbread is to die for, all of the gluten free deserts are incredible, but my absolute fave- the cheesecake! Hands down, best cheesecake I have ever had in my life!!

You can tell everything is made with care, and a real love for the craft. It’s not just a bakery, it’s an experience.

If you’re in Ottawa, this place is a must. I already can’t wait to go back.

I bought the esspresso chocolate cookies and they were really good. An older gentleman was running the counter and he was nice; I had a bit of small talk with him.

They are only open a few days of the week, with the rest of the days dedicated to baking. It's a hidden gem that's a bit out of the way but it's worth it. There isn't much seating and the place is small and cozy, but it is worth finding this place.

I don’t know how they do it but nothing is dry, I’ve never had a scone that wasn’t super dry in the middle, i honestly thought that’s just how scones were, dry.

Not only do they have awesome scones but their cookies, brownies and everything else is really good, I’ve always been impressed.

They also don’t do fads or trends, just staples

Lovely owner who takes his craft very seriously. The scones are "real" scones not the hyper sweet variety you get most places. They are beautifully made and should be served with some jam or butter (or both!)

We stumbled upon orange turtle because of their gluten free options and ended up discovering such a gem. You can tell the owner puts an immense amount of thought, effort, and care into every aspect of this establishment: connecting with customers, meticulously testing recipes, expanding the menu, etc. My mom has celiac disease, so she’s used to getting a subpar, token gluten free option, but the gluten free cookies we had here were some of our of all time favourites.
Such a cozy, intimate space with the most kind and welcoming owner. Would definitely come back for more of those amazing treats and delicious coffee. Highly recommend!!

Finally got a chance to go into Orange Turtle this morning and I'm so glad I did! I got a blueberry & almond scones and it was still warm - delicious!! And good portion sizing & notably quality ingredients. Their coffee is a nice roast and not too pricey. I got each shortbread cookie offered today to go and I'm excited to try.

I have followed them on Instagram for a bit and their tarts & other baked goods are always meticulous. I wasn't expecting the friendly charming atmosphere as well. I'll be back for sure.

Quaint and cozy neighbourhood cafe & bakery. The owner is very friendly and the place is dog-friendly. No pic of the cheese & chive scone I ate because it was still warm and fragrant when I got my hands on it. I tried the fig apricot bread last time and have my eye on the shortbread next :) Happy to see they also make cakes on special orders, including gluten free options (chocolate almond + orange almond).

name: La Bakeri
address: 935 Fennell Ave E, Hamilton, ON L8V 1W9, Canada
reviews: Best bakery in town, I've been going here since I was a kid and it's been consistently amazing. The Sicilian cannolis are the best, better than in Rome and Florence (I tried and there's no comparison). The staff are sweethearts and just a dream to deal with.

So far I have only tried the traditional cannoli but they were very good. I am a bit of a cannoli expert, having tried them in Sicily and locally in the GHTA. The filling is creamy and delicious, the shell is light and crunchy. I’ll be back for more.
Our favourite little bakery in the city. We got our wedding cake here!!! The staff/owner are so friendly and helpful. Everything tastes amazing and it's an absolute must stop if you are in the area.

Very disappointed in baked goods. I bought traditional cannoli, a brownie and a piece of carrot cake.  Did not taste like carrot cake or brownie, oily and indistinguishable flavours. Cannoli filling was not ricotta and bland.  Unfortunately will never go back.  I’ll go back to Fortinos for my cannoli. Very disappointed.
Great little bakery with a nice selection of baked goods . All the treats we tried were delicious.  They also had a selection of gluten-free options

This was my second time trying their pastries and I totally recommend them. Everything I’ve had so far strikes the perfect balance: not too sweet, just smooth and full of flavor. The service is always warm and welcoming, and the best part? They’re only 5 minutes from my place. A local gem!

While the carrot cakes and mini cheese cakes I got were delicious, the main reason for visiting (birthday cake) La Bakeri was disappointing.

The ordering process (in store) and pick-up was smooth (had everything waiting for me on time), the store is bright, clean and staffed by very friendly ladies.

The birthday cake itself (must be an European thing), was overly light, lacked any flavor and the frosting was terrible. A birthday cake IMHO should be  a little sinful.. decadent. Not this one. I have no clue what the sort of custard (correct word?) center was, as it wasn't sweet nor had a real flavor to it. BLAND?

It was a beautiful cake to look at, just not to eat. We blew candles, sliced and dumped.
Amazing prices and the best quality Italian sweets!

name: Palgong Tea
address: 5468A Av. du Parc Unit 1, Montreal, Quebec H2V 4G9, Canada
reviews:
Just got the original milk black tea here and it tastes just as good as what I get in Asia (I live in Taiwan, the country of bubble tea!👀💗) The tea tastes great, and you can also choose your own ice and sugar level!

If you’re looking for good milk tea in Montreal, I definitely recommend this place. Plus, the Korean lady (probably the owner) is very, very friendly! <3

Actually tasty drinks with a nice variety of options.
Location is easy to access for the most part.
The price is very reasonable especially compared to other beverage places. My own drink was 6.80 after tax and that's the median price here.
They also offer snacks but I didn't get any this time around.
The lady is very kind, so I can very easily recommend this place for when you feel like grabbing a drink on your walk or your trip.
5/5 stars.

I've only tried the place once since I didn't like my drink. There's so many options to choose from but to my personal taste they're way too sweet/dessert for someone who enjoys a simple "traditional "bobba like me. No tapioca was available so I had to ordered the grass option and it was not pleasant on the texture or taste (muddy). I might have to go back to try another flavor again. Prices are decent and there's only one size, friendly staff.

Awesome Latte!!Love Love. There is very nice smell of great roasted coffee inside that the store.
Of course it's very very tasty of bubble tea
#the blueberry macaron was very creamy inside.

I ordered brown sugar, cheese strawberry, taro, tiramisu bubble tea and all kinds of 6 macarons.
I forgot the name what is the kinda cheese cake.tasty for me.

What all pretty and services are kind. The korean staffs 😍 💕

Hands down the best asian dessert place in Montreal! Palgong Tea has a diverse range of beverages with unique flavours :) I got the strawberry cheesecake milk tea and taro milk tea with pearls. The pearls were fresh, chewy, and not too sweet! I also got their silvanas (original and ube) and macarons (thai milk tea and cotton candy). All items were extremely tasty!!

Furthermore, the owners are super friendly and welcoming. I always end up leaving their shop happier :) They really make the effort to get to know their customers! Looking forward to trying more flavours! (They also have more items on their menu - cake and ice cream)

Stopped by for some bubble tea. I think this store franchise from Korea(?). I had the Litchi-ade with the tapioca pearls (boba). It tasted like a lychee flavored soda  and I did like it. The tapioca pearls were also good. There were only like 2 tables inside, but I assume during the summer they also have seatings outside. Recommended!

I got to try out Palgong Korean Bubble tea on this rainy Halloween day. They have a very nice and clean store with very friendly staff. It’s nice to have a bubble tea shop in the area as there aren’t any yet.

Many choices of bubble tea with various toppings. They currently have a BOGO promotion for their opening, where you can get either a traditional milk tea or taro drink with toppings for free (add 1$ for a large) with the purchase of a drink at regular price. Here in the picture is the black sesame milk tea with soy milk and grass jelly and the taro drink with bubbles, both larges.

Palgong also offers cookie dough, Korean sushis and bowls, as well as Korean style macarons as part of their menu. I’ll definitely try those out in my next visit.

This is one of bbt brands that I enjoy.
I tried this branch yesterday and was greeted with very kind employees.
They also offer paper straws.

The drink was nice, but the ice chips covered all the tapioca pearls that I had to dig them out. It was hard to drink the toppings.
Maybe you could put less ice?
Anyways a good bbt shop!

address: 239 Queen St W, Brampton, ON L6Y 1M6, Canada
reviews:
Vivian did an incredible job on my hair. I came with salon-dyed black hair and asked for a copper red brown balayage. I think any other salon / stylist would’ve laughed in my face and told me to leave 🤣

but Vivian patiently explained to me all of the challenges that we might experience along the way, which made me feel so supported and understood, and then took on the challenge anyways even though we knew it might not be perfect!

And it turned out absolutely gorgeous!

I love the energy in the salon - all of the other girls are super sweet and helpful.

I highly recommend getting your hair done here if you’re considering it :) they’re also very fairly priced.

My girl Sara is literally a magician. I had come in with a botched balayage done 2 days prior and she fixed me up so good you couldnt tell. She genuinely gave me my dream hair and ive been getting compliments since. I love her so much, my go to from now on. The atmosphere was also so friendly i didnt feel any ounce of awkwardness. She also explains everything she does and double checks with colour, style etc.

Koi Hair Salon The Worst Haircut Experience I’ve Ever Had

Unfortunately, my experience at Koi Hair Salon was one of the worst salon experiences I’ve ever had.

My hair was very long, almost down to my waist. I specifically asked for lots of layers starting from the top of my head and continuing down, while keeping most of the overall length. I clearly explained that I did NOT want my hair cut too short.

During the haircut, the stylist repeatedly pulled the comb very hard against my right ear, causing me significant pain. I told her several times, but unfortunately, she continued. She even suggested that I might have a piercing causing the pain, although I explained that I don’t have one and that the comb was hitting my ear very hard.

I was also very disappointed with the cleanliness of the tools and the area around the stylist. The comb and equipment being used on my hair appeared dirty, and I did not see them being properly cleaned before being used on me. This made me extremely uncomfortable.

Most importantly, despite repeatedly explaining that I wanted to keep my length, my hair was cut much shorter than I requested. I decided to wait until the haircut was finished before judging the final result. Unfortunately, the finished haircut looked nothing like the layered style I had asked for. The layers were not done properly, and the overall result was extremely uneven and disappointing.

I had a party to attend that day and unfortunately had no time to go to another salon to fix it. I didn’t want to create a scene, so I simply left. However, since then, several people have commented on my hair and even asked if I had cut it myself because it looked so poorly done.

I paid $100 plus a tip expecting a professional haircut, and unfortunately, I was extremely disappointed with the result.

Based on my personal experience, I would not recommend Koi Hair Salon for a haircut or hair styling, and I personally will not be returning.

I’ve been coming to Koi Hair Studios for the past 15 years, and Jorge has been cutting my hair the entire time. Every visit, my hair turns out exactly how I wanted. He’s incredibly talented, always listens, and consistently does an amazing job. I wouldn’t trust anyone else with my hair. Highly recommend Jorge and Koi Hair Studios!

I called this hair salon specifically looking for someone who not only cuts short hair but who would be able to correct the botched up haircut that I had received prior.  Boy did they ever deliver.  They set me up with Jorge.  He took the time to chat with me beforehand, looking at my hair, talking about my vision and looked at pictures of what I wanted.  He did advise me that he may not be able to deliver exactly but it would be close and better.  He took his time, his skill set was nothing short of masterful and you could tell that he has a real passion for cutting hair.  I quickly felt very comfortable in his chair.  Not only did he deliver,  but I can honestly say , that it is the first time that I came home from a salon and did not immediately wet my hair and restyle it.  It was perfect the way he did it.  Thanks to Jorge, I have now found my favourite new hairstylist:)  And many thanks to the Koi staff for listening to my request and pairing me with the best match.  You totally made my day.  Jorge is a genius!!!!!!

name: Salon Fiorella
address: 90 George St Ste 201, Ottawa, ON K1N 5W1, Canada
reviews:
BRIDAL HAIR: @hannahshaiir on IG 💖

Hannah has been such an important part of my bridal journey. She styled my hair for my engagement photos, bachelorette party, wedding trial, wedding day, and day-after portraits, and every single look was absolutely perfect. No matter what inspiration photo I brought her, she executed it flawlessly while making it work beautifully with my hair.

What sets Hannah apart is how much pride she takes in her work. She never rushes and takes the time to perfect every detail, making sure the final result is nothing less than amazing. I always left her chair feeling confident, beautiful, and excited to show off my hair. Her talent, attention to detail, and dedication to her clients are truly exceptional, and I couldn’t recommend her more highly!

BRIDAL MAKEUP: @mina_pnejad on IG 💖

Mina was absolutely incredible! She created the perfect wedding day look and made me feel so beautiful and confident. My makeup stayed fresh and flawless all night through tears, laughter, hugs, photos, and hours of dancing. I also loved the convenience of having such a beautiful salon right downtown near our hotel, it made getting ready stress-free without having to worry about clutter or mess in the hotel room. Mina’s talent, professionalism, and attention to detail are outstanding, and I couldn’t have asked for a better makeup artist for my wedding day!

- Chloe Renaud @lessthanthree97 on IG

After finishing our HYROX race, my best friend and I wanted to treat ourselves to a little recovery and self-care … and finding Salon Fiorella was truly the perfect ending to such an intense and rewarding day. From the moment we walked in, we felt welcomed, relaxed, and completely taken care of. This experience was so much more than a hair appointment … it felt luxurious, thoughtful, and like the best girls day and self care after pushing our bodies to the limit during our fitness race today.

A huge thank you to Fiorella, the owner, for creating such a beautiful space and such an incredible experience. Although we didn’t get the chance to meet her in person, it’s so obvious that her care, vision, and attention to detail are reflected in every part of the salon. The space itself is absolutely stunning .. beyond elegant, so calm, and bright all at once. Every product used felt high-end and intentional, and the entire atmosphere made us instantly feel relaxed after a long race day. You can tell Fiorella has built an amazing team and environment that makes clients feel special the moment they walk through the doors.

Also, a huge thank you to Phoenix from the spa next door for recommending this hidden gem to us. Honestly, how amazing is it to have a massage and hair experience all in one shared space? The whole concept feels elevated, seamless, and incredibly luxurious. It turned our post-race recovery day into something really memorable.

Thank you as well to Jessa at the front desk for being so welcoming and kind from the second we arrived. First impressions matter, and she made us feel comfortable immediately with her warm energy and professionalism.

And the biggest thank you to Kayla, who completely brought my hair back to life. After sweating through a HYROX race, my hair desperately needed some love, and she absolutely delivered. My wash, hydration treatment, blowout, and styling felt incredible from start to finish. She took such care with every step, explained the products she was using, and somehow made my tired post-race hair feel soft, healthy, shiny, and beautiful again. I walked out feeling refreshed, confident, and honestly like a whole new person. I will be driving to Ottawa any day to get my hair done by her again!

A huge thank you as well to Alisha, who made my friend’s hair look absolutely stunning. Her blowout was gorgeous, polished, and full of life, and my friend couldn’t stop smiling afterward. It was so nice for both of us to be able to sit back, relax, and feel completely pampered together after such a physically demanding event. She was so full of smiles and so warm and bubbly.

This experience was exactly what we needed after HYROX … relaxing, rejuvenating, and so thoughtfully done from beginning to end. Every single person we encountered was kind, talented, and welcoming. We left feeling refreshed not just physically, but mentally too. We will absolutely be back and cannot recommend Fiorella Salon enough for anyone looking for an elevated salon experience in downtown Ottawa. Thank you all for making us feel so cared for and beautiful!

Excellent Haircut, but Unclear Pricing!

I was very happy with the haircut Anna gave me. She communicated with me throughout the service, and I was very pleased with the result.

Unfortunately, I was disappointed with the pricing. I booked a haircut listed at $86, and the online booking estimate also showed $86. At the counter, I specifically asked if it was $86 plus tax, and the receptionist confirmed that it was.

I was ultimately charged $99.44. Afterward, I learned there was an additional mandatory $2 'GREEN CIRCLE ENVIRONMENTAL FEE'. My concern is not about the $2 itself, but that this fee was not clearly disclosed during booking or when I specifically asked to confirm the price.

When I contacted the salon, I received a receipt showing the fee, but my actual question—why I was told the price was $86 plus tax—was not addressed, and my follow-up communication was not answered.

The haircut itself was excellent, and I would happily recommend Anna. My concern is entirely about pricing transparency and how the issue was handled. If there is a mandatory fee, I believe it should be clearly communicated before payment.

I had such a great experience with Cassandra! She was so warm, kind, and easy to talk to from the moment I sat in her chair. She really took the time to make sure I was comfortable and did an amazing job with my hair.

The scalp massage was honestly the best I’ve had since moving to Ottawa, it was so relaxing! You can tell she genuinely cares about her clients and loves what she does. I left feeling refreshed, confident, and already looking forward to my next appointment.

If you’re looking for a talented hairstylist who is both skilled and genuinely caring, I can’t recommend Cassandra enough. Thank you again, Cassandra!

I absolutely loved Jess! She listened to what I wanted and executed it perfectly. Great conversation and overall a lovely person. Very skilled. Would recommend her and will be back again!
The salon itself is very clean and staff are very nice.

This is my second time getting my hair cut and straightened by Mina, and I’m so happy with the results! My hair stays smooth, straight, and beautiful for a long time. I’m completely satisfied with her work. If you’re looking to get your hair straightened and silky smooth, I highly recommend seeing Mina! She’s amazing! ❤️

The most amazing duo you need in your life is Hannah for hair and Mina for your makeup. These women are so wonderful to work with. I recently had them doll me up for my wedding day and they did not disappoint! I love the vibe when I’m with them. So easy to talk to and made me feel so beautiful with their amazing skills. They will be my forever stylists for hair and makeup needs!

I came to Salon Fiorella a couple of weeks ago for a booked appointment with Christa and left feeling very happy and satisfied. Firstly, the atmosphere was very welcoming. For my hair, I gave her a few pointers of what I wanted and she was able to deliver exactly what I was hoping for. She also gave me tips on how to keep proper colouring until my next appointment. I got a balayage, hair trimming, layering and face framing, and she styled it beautifully before I left. I’d definitely recommend!

reviews: I stopped in for a slice of veggie pizza, and you can definitely tell they use good quality ingredients. The pizza was fresh, flavorful, and tasted great overall. The only issue was that it wasn’t heated long enough, so part of the slice and some of the toppings were still cold. Other than that, I really enjoyed it. I’ll definitely be coming back I’ll just ask for it to be heated a little longer next time. Overall, it was a good experience and worth another visit.

I’ve been wanting to come to this bakery for long time and finally got here! So many beautiful, fresh breads and pastries for my eyes to enjoy. I loved all the different sourdough breads and even loved the different sizes of burger buns.

I decided on their croissant & coffee deal for $3.99 and got the pistachio croissant. It was very fresh and delicious. The place itself had a warm vibe to it especially with the fresh bread smell in the air. The service was also fast and friendly. I look forward to my next visit!

Every time I come here, I’m welcomed with a smile and such a positive atmosphere. The staff are always incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely make you feel appreciated as a customer. It’s rare to find a place where the service is consistently this warm and welcoming every single visit.

You can really tell that they care about creating a great experience, not just serving food or drinks. The environment feels comfortable, relaxed, and inviting, making it a perfect spot to unwind, meet friends, or simply enjoy your day.

If you’re looking for a place with amazing customer service and great vibes, definitely come check it out — you won’t be disappointed at all!

This place is so underrated. Literally where else u can find a legit pistachio croissant full of flavor, crispy n decent portion for $3 in downtown To. Also shout out to all the gentleman behind the counter. They r the best. A huge sourdough loaf for $6? I feel like this spot was open to promote for their bakery appliances. Cus unbeatable deal is available right here. Also dont skip their danish. I love danish now thanks to em. The custard is just awesome. Also scone is fireeeeeee. I got a huge pistachio croissant, peach scone, n blueberry danish for $10, Panemor is a killer hidden gem.

I’ve been here any time and bought their sourdough for $4.99 and various pastries like the pistachio croissant which is a nice portion size, as well as so flaky and oh so delicious and filling! And the price? You can’t beat it! $2.99 per croissant/pastry. There usually isn’t a line but if there is it moves fairly fast plus they’re open everyday. Oh and they have a coffee+croissant deal for $3.99 - which I haven’t tried yet but will soon!

Every time I come into the city, this place is a must stop and pick something up
The flavours of the croissants are to die for the breads taste absolutely amazing. The aroma walking into the place is a nice gentle smell of sourdough and sweets.

100% satisfied every time

I got a lot of bread and pastry from tgtg bag, I didn’t really know what the pastries were and they were all broken so I ended up chucking them out but the bread was quite nice, a little on the dryer side for the most part though. But the quantity was great!!

Hidden gem! A must stop in Toronto, the bakery has fresh bread and incredible pastries all at very reasonable prices. Coffee was good too however it was very strong especially the espresso shot which I honestly loved but might not be the case for everyone. Highly recommend.

reviews:
UPDATE: She replied to my Instagram message after I posted this 1-star review. (She still maintained that she wasn’t the owner.. but anyway!) Having had to chase for a response later, she eventually offered to repair the dress but confirmed it wouldn’t be restored to its original condition. Since it was practically new, I wasn’t willing to accept a visible repair. I ended up paying $112 for a replacement, and she didn’t offer to cover any of the cost (not even responding to what I had to incur). Based on how this was handled, I won’t be supporting this business again.

REVIEW: Unfortunately, I can’t recommend this shop. While buying a hijab, my new dress was torn by a sharp screw protruding from a table that customers have to pass to reach the hijab section (see photos).

I asked the shop to take responsibility for the damage. Although I believed replacing or compensating me would have been appropriate, I only requested that the repair costs be covered. Despite trying to contact the owner via Instagram, I received no response until after I posted this review.

In my opinion, the exposed screw was a safety hazard in a customer area, and I was very disappointed by the lack of follow-up. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this shop.

Wonderful experience from start to finish!

The team at Heba Boutique was incredibly kind, professional, and accommodating. I needed alterations done on short notice, and they were able to complete everything the very same day, which I truly appreciated.

A special thank you to Shereen, who went above and beyond to help me. She welcomed me warmly, was incredibly patient, and took the time to help me find exactly what I was looking for. Her attention, kindness, and genuine care made the whole experience enjoyable and stress-free.

Thank you to the entire team for the exceptional service. I highly recommend Heba Boutique and will definitely be returning in the future! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had such a wonderful experience with Heba Boutique while choosing my daughter’s wedding dress.
Their service was truly amazing from start to finish.
They were patient, professional, and made my daughter feel so special during every appointment.
The attention to detail, kindness, and care they showed made the entire experience stress-free and memorable for our family.
The dress was absolutely beautiful and exceeded our expectations.
Thank you for helping make my daughter’s wedding day even more perfect.
Highly recommend!

Absolutely amazing staff and product. I found so many nice abayas for ramadan and matching hijabs i couldn’t pick one. Heba was so nice and patient helping me find the perfect one for an iftar i have coming up. So nice to see a store that sells clothes like this in ottawa. Quality is worth the price for sure.

I found the atmosphere at this boutique to be incredibly off-putting. While the shop tries very hard to project a 'high-end luxury' image—frequently comparing itself to brands like Louis Vuitton—the actual experience feels hollow and overpriced.
The owner’s attitude is the biggest deterrent; there is an air of superiority and an obsession with appearing 'rich' that makes the environment feel unwelcome rather than elite. It’s hard to justify the couture prices when the service lacks genuine class and humility. Most times I pass by, the store is empty, which isn't surprising given how many people feel alienated by the owner’s persona. There are plenty of other places to find high-quality fashion without the 'Lala Land' ego.

A wonderful experience from start to finish! A warm welcome upon arrival, followed by a fantastic haircut and blow dry by Clarissa with a great attention to detail. The atmosphere is quite relaxing, and the service was excellent throughout. Highly recommend this salon and will definitely be back!

What a pleasant experience at this salon!

Tina listened to my needs and understood right away what I wanted. She did an amazing job with my straight hair and since then, received so many compliments about my new style.

reviews: The best store!  We had tried so many places looking for a dress for my 17 year old daughter. We could not find anything and then we walked into Revelle and there were SO many options. We found the perfect dress  I absolutely love it and am excited to shop there again in the future - Linda

This a lovely shop in Yorkville with a great selection of high end vacation dresses, I really enjoyed my shopping experience there, my SA was very knowledgable.  One slightly frustrating thing is their hours - they're only open 11-5 and closed on Sundays, it is really challenging to shop there if you work.

Overall I really enjoyed my shopping experience there and would return, their customer service is very fast and responsive, however I had a very terrible experience with their alterations; it wasn't at all what my SA and I discussed, and I live in the UK so I didn't have time to give them a second chance to fix it.  It was a $650 + tax dress that actually looked worse than it did pre-alterations, but wasn't returnable because of the changes.  They gave me $80 CAD to compensate me for tailoring in the UK, but as I told them, $80 CAD would not cover alteration costs in London - sure enough, to get it fixed again, it's £95 GBP ($180 CAD). Recommend the shop but highly suggest you go elsewhere for alterations.

name: Cameron Hair Studio
address: 169 James St N, Hamilton, ON L8R 2L1, Canada
reviews:
Promised transformation, but ended in damage and poor handling
Review:
I don’t usually leave reviews, but this experience needs to be shared.

I initially came in for a consultation with Cameron (manager), where I was told that achieving the blonde result I wanted would require a 3-visit transformation process. I was reassured that this would be done properly and professionally, which is why I trusted the salon and committed to the process.

During my first visit with Cameron, I spent approximately 7 hours in the salon and paid around $700 plus ~$100 in products. Based on the consultation and the trust built, I returned for the second visit expecting continuity and expertise.

However, during my second visit, my transformation was handed over to another stylist (Taylor), who did not appear to have the same level of experience for this type of continuous hair transformation.
This fact that (Taylor worked on my beautiful long blond hair was never clearly discussed with me beforehand.

During that appointment, I spent about 5.5 hours (again, recorded as less), and paid approximately $560 plus ~$170 in products. I was also unexpectedly asked to pay an additional $100 for a blow dry.

What concerns me most is the condition of my hair after the service. The top section of my hair was clearly overprocessed
over bleached, and now it's severely damaged with extreme brakage. my hair length from scalp to bottom is approximately 54 CM . And now on the top of my head my hair broke down about 35 CM and more. It is severely damaged.
My 7 years of hard work to keep my hair nice and healthy now it is gone
I can't even put it up in a pony tail .

While the service was happening, I raised concerns multiple times and specifically asked if Cameron could step in and take over. This request was refused. Instead, I was reassured while my hand was being held that I was “in good hands” and that Taylor was even better than the manager himself ( Cameron )

Unfortunately, the final result did not match what I requested or the reference images I provided. The color is uneven, patchy, and the roots are not what I asked for.

I trusted the original plan and the salon’s professional judgment, and that trust was not met.

I hope this feedback will help to those women who fears hairstylist exactly for this type of reason.

The first 3 pictures is after my second visit 4th picture when I was in the salon with beautiful healthy hair and 5th picture is the one I wanted originally and Cameron the manager promised that I will see this exact colour after my third visit.

Be carful with this hair salon.
Me personally had the worst experience I can not thing about it every single day I look in the mirror . .

Abby did an amazing job with my hair! She is so talented and skilled - also she was a wonderful communicator, listened to what I wanted, and really did excellent work. Bonus - she was friendly and easy to talk to. The team was so friendly and helpful. Knocked it out of the park! I left feeling like a million bucks! Thank you so much!!!

Nina is greaaaaaaaaat.
She listens carefully and does exactly what you want.
I had a short curly hair that due to uneven cut elsewhere was annoying me. Nina did magic with my hair.

I went to Trish....
SUPER BAD EXPERIENCE.

Hair was over processed and nothing like the pictures I showed.
I was told by Cameron I could get a 200$ card from them but  then was blocked aha.
I was going to give a 5 start just because Cameron's attempt to fix the situation but the situation was not solved.

I simply asked if Cameron could fix my hair and was declined and told to go back to Trish. I refused because she ruined my hair colour in the first place and she told me all she could do is re-tone it?

So now my hair extreamly damaged, I have to now fix it myself, I never received any money back or a correction for her mistakes. I also didn't recieve the card which I don't even want because a 200$ card to buy there hair products will not solve the problem.

This has cause me so much stress. I honestly am never going back to a salon after the experience.

The first picture is the colour I showed for reference of the colour I was hoping for. The second picture is the style of balayage I was hoping to achieve. The pictures after the first 2 is how my hair turned out after the "colour correction" and balayage.

Everyone I encountered at Cameron Hair Studio in Hamilton was beyond nice and accommodating. It was a great experience! Trish brought my vision to life and checked in with me several times throughout the process to make sure I was comfortable and satisfied. I will be back, and I definitely recommend!! Well worth the price. :)

I can’t praise Cameron enough !! I went in with very long, very unruly curls and asked Cameron to cut my hair off in a very short, edgy style. He spent 30 minutes talking me through the process, asking if I was really ready for such a drastic change and going through multiple potential “styles”. I was super nervous but put my myself in the hands of his expertise!!Absolutely blown away by the results - all my friends, family and work colleagues have been shocked by the drastic change but have said it looks amazing !!! Thank you Cameron !!!

This was my first time at Cameron's. My most favourite and talented stylist/artist, Pavielyne recently moved to this salon. I was there for just a bang trim so the experience was very much what one would expect.
UPDATE:  I've now been a client of Cameron's for a few years.  I get the most stunning and perfect haircut and style EVERY SINGLE TIME. My stylist is a magician!

I really enjoyed my experience and 10/10 recommend Cameron Hair Studio, and their junior stylist Abby. Abby is so sweet and has a lot of knowledge. She takes her time to understand what you want and was great at bouncing ideas/recommendations. She's inclusive when you're sensitive about skin/hair issues. She precisely gave me the cut and styled I wanted but made it look better than I could have imagined.

I felt super welcomed by everyone working at the studio, not just my stylist. Everyone is really kind. They also offer espresso, tea, water, etc. the Flat White was amazing. Can't wait to come back!

reviews:
Had an amazing experience at On Edge Studio with Johnny. Booking was super easy, I emailed them, got a quick response, and they were flexible with timing. The location is also great, right on Wellington with plenty of street parking.

Johnny himself is awesome. He’s fast, punctual, very friendly, and seriously skilled. He gave me a great haircut that everyone around me loved. Definitely recommend him!

After a few bad haircuts at various places in Ottawa, I looked online and read reviews decided to go try again at On edge, and I finally got the hair cut I've been wanting,  I didnt have to go home and shave my head after my haircut. Its absolutely perfect.  Donna's attention to detail is impeccable.  My hair looks better than the reference picture I showed her. I'll never go anywhere else now.

Writing on behalf of my wife who came home crying after getting a bob cut. Be weary, they might cut your hair up to two inches shorter than the reference photos you provide (of yourself) and leave you with a bowl cut. She was really happy with her previous cut at this location but after the massacre that took place this evening, will not be returning again.

Update: On Edge response to my review is deliberately misleading. She has not been to the salon "multiple times", only once before. Beyond having the hair cut shorter than the reference, the issue is the uneven, choppy feathering. The stylist cut the ends very uneven. My wife mentioned not wanting layers to the stylist, requested a straight across cut and was ignored, gave a choppy bob with multiple lengths.

I have been going to Amanda at On Edge Studio for years, and she proved once again why she is an absolute master of her craft.

After a disastrous DIY hair mistake left me with horrible, wide, 'front-mullet' bangs, I was completely devastated and thought my hair was ruined. Amanda didn't just fix it—she transformed it. She strategically texturized the cut into an incredibly cool, high-fashion micro-fringe that completely fits my personality.

She is a true artist who understands hair structure and bone structure perfectly. If you want a stylist you can trust with your life (and your hair emergencies), look no further!

When I came home from my first appointment with Sarah at On Edge Studio, my sister told me it was the best haircut I've ever had in my life! Sarah did a wonderful job, and she is so lovely and pleasant to interact with. I will be going back regularly! Would highly recommend!

This was my first time going to On Edge and all I have to say is that this salon is awesome. Here you can find talented and kind artists who are all so clearly invested in their work and their clients. Especially Sarah—she did a great job on my hair!!

I seriously recommend this salon. It makes for a relaxing and lighthearted experience!

My girlfriend goes to on edge and Carly does her hair. Carly is the best in city for anything colour related and does an amazing job with cuts. Care attention to detail and is amazingly talented at what she does.

Had the most amazing experience at OnEdge. From start to finish, the team went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and cared for. Robin was absolutely incredible, so patient with my hair. She worked wonders on my curls, gave me a beautiful balayage with subtle highlights, and a perfect haircut.

The attention to detail was impeccable, especially when it came to carefully brushing and handling my hair. The finger coiling we chose instead of a blow-dry was truly the cherry on top. Mcurls have never looked so defined and gorgeous!

The atmosphere in the salon was so warm and festive. The owner even had a tray full of delicious food to share with everyone, which added such a personal touch to the experience.

I can’t recommend this salon enough. thank you, Robin for making my hair look and feel amazing. I’ll definitely be back!

reviews: Absolutely amazing experience at this salon! I had some root growth, and sadly my hairdresser moved, so I tried out this salon and it exceeded all expectations! Matthew is exceptional - so knowledgeable, talented, and friendly. I was nervous to try a new colourist that specifically specialized in copper, but I’m SO glad I chose Matthew to do the job. My hair looks soooo fabulous. I also got my bangs trimmed by Anna, and I love the result! The salon is clean, and everyone I interacted with, from reception to the hairdressers, made it such a welcoming experience. Can’t wait to return.

I had such an amazing experience with Alysha! She didn’t just give me a haircut — she really took the time to listen to what I was looking for, how I wanted my hair to feel, and the kind of style that would make me feel like myself again.

I came in wanting to change my hair colour along with a bob haircut. Between fixing the colour and giving me the perfect textured wavy bob haircut, she transformed it beautifully. She has such a great eye for understanding what suits someone and creating a look that feels natural and confident.

Thank you, Alysha, for your talent, patience, and for making me love my hair again! I’ll definitely be coming back. ❤️

I had such a great experience at this salon, the team here are very friendly and helpful.
I felt very welcome as soon as I walked in the door.

The stylist who did my consultation and hair cut was very professional, polite and incredibly talented.
I loved the cut she gave me and she did a beautiful blow out!
I would definitely recommend the salon and to book ahead to get an appointment.

I am extremely disappointed with the experience I had at Fifteen Twelve Salon.

I booked my appointment around 10–15 days in advance with Chris for a bleach service, and I was specifically told to reserve a 3-hour appointment slot. I even confirmed multiple times that 3 hours would be enough for the service. Because of how important this appointment was to me, I arrived almost an hour early after travelling from far away.

When I arrived, Chris suddenly told me that another client had been booked an hour after my appointment and that he would not be doing my hair anymore because there was not enough time. What makes this even more upsetting is that he had already touched my hair, brushed it, and completely messed up my hairstyle before casually telling me to “reschedule.”

The entire interaction felt cold, dismissive, and deeply disrespectful. There was no accountability, no effort to fix the situation, no attempt to prioritize a client who had booked far in advance and travelled a long distance. The receptionist simply repeated “we are sorry” without offering any real solution or showing genuine concern.

What shocked me the most was the lack of professionalism and basic customer care. Nobody contacted me beforehand to inform me about scheduling conflicts, nobody attempted to rearrange appointments, and nobody seemed to care about the inconvenience, time, money, and emotional distress this caused me.

I have never experienced customer service this careless and rude from a salon before. As a customer, I felt humiliated, ignored, and completely disrespected.

This experience left a very negative impression of your salon and the way clients are treated.

Thank you for your response, but it still doesn't address the main issue. I confirmed the appointment details beforehand, travelled a long distance, and was only told there was a problem after Chris had already touched my hair. If there was a booking error, it should have been caught before I arrived.
I also received an email offering me money and products in exchange for removing my review. I find that extremely unprofessional. My review reflects my genuine experience, and I stand by it.

Chris has done my hair three times and I have been obsessed with the results every single time. I get a full bleach out and colour and the results are AMAZING every time. I get so many compliments all the time about my hair. Chris is so creative and thinks of really cool colour ways but still listens to my ideas and I’ve never left a hair salon that happy every time. He really is a bleach magician.

I used to bleach my hair myself but since going to Chris I have noticed it is so much healthier, thicker and longer! I could not be happier! Thank you Chris ✨

name: Vie Tea Café
address: 598 Upper James St, Hamilton, ON L9C 2Y8, Canada
reviews: We have visited 3 times in the last 2 months. The staff is so friendly, and the drinks are always so consistent and tasty. My eldest daughter always gets the iced matcha milk tea with tapioca, my youngest gets the double mango slush with tapioca. They give you a loyalty card, a min. Spend of $5 gets you a stamp and the 10th drink is free. I am sure we will be visiting again in the near future. :)

Went here with my girlfriend today and got the ube cloud coffee and strawberry matcha latte. Both drinks were amazing with the ube cold foam tasting amazing. Recommend checking out Vie Tea if you love cafe’s.

The customer service was fantastic, the store was super clean. I ordered the UBE matcha and I got another matcha with the crème brûlée cold foam and both were fantastic. Definitely a great spot for matcha.
Fantastic Drinks. Real Matcha and then their coffee is also strong! Great service and cute cafe!

I never post reviews, but for this one I had to: their quality is incredible and their prices aren't bad. I will say though; they need to update their menu prices because I paid a dollar extra than what the menu stated (which I didn't mind).
Now about the quality: I got this drink at around 1:30 in the afternoon and, since I was fasting, I couldn't drink it until exactly 6:12 in the evening. I expected the drink to taste off and the tapioca pearls to be an odd texture while chewing but surprisingly no! It was as if it were fresh out of the store. I'm impressed. Well done.

Very friendly staff, amazing options and the drinks are really good. They are known for fresh and delicious Matcha and I can verify it's awesome!!!! A must try if you are in the area!!!! Very clean and relaxing seating inside.

Delish! We go here with our kids and we all love it! From the coffees to the fun kid friendly drinks, its all great! I love the brown sugar latte and the double mango. The staff is so lovely and the place is spotless!

I had a wonderful experience at Vie Tea! The staff were incredibly friendly and patient in helping us choose our drinks. The boba had the perfect soft and chewy consistency, and the sweetness level was just right. Our favorite was the ube milk tea with brown sugar pearl, a smooth blend of creamy and taro flavour. We also tried the caramel flan, which was delicious—rich and silky, definitely a must-try!

The atmosphere was aesthetically pleasing and calm, with plenty of seating to enjoy your drink. I highly recommend giving Vie Tea a try! I can’t wait to return!

name: Painted Hair co.
address: 897 Merivale Rd, Ottawa, ON K1Z 6A1, Canada
reviews: I am truly grateful to have stumbled upon Angie through reddit and instagram research - I wanted someone who had experience in creative colour ( in case I do that in the future as I love to switchit up) BUT also has an understanding in babylights/teasylights and keeping things natural and grow out well - WOW! She absolutely killed it (in a greatway!!!) my hair looks brighter (my blonde is popping more!) I feel blonde BUT she also added dimension and corrected lots of banding from my previous colorist. My previous colorist is so chill and an amazing person that i've been hesitant to make the leap elsewhere, but too many highlighting faux-pas and over processing have happened in the past, loads of hot root bleeds from highlights into other areas. etc. ANGIE saw the inconsistencies and wanted to fix them (I'm so grateful I sort of brushed them under the rug for a while convincing myself highlights are imperfect overall but look good altogether). BUT NOPE, you can and should heighten your expectations of your hair! Angie was able to reaaaalllly blend things. She used a 7 and weaved that as well as bleach throughout my hair with teasylights. My hair is  just prismatic, so much shine and that effortless did-she or didn't she? blonde transition and blending with my  natural roots and some scandi hairline money-pieces bits.LOOOONG review, but if you're on the cusp, debating a better experience, you are worth it and go for it! Angie was so focused throughout the experience, you can tell she loves what she does and is imaginative as well as she is technically skilled. Babylights/teasylights are NOT easy nor offered everwhere but she has the skillset for this service. I'm also really happy with the conversation that preceded the colour service, where we discussed exactly what we'd be doing and Angie had some great suggestions while also listening to what I wanted. She overdelivered! I'm 100% coming back. THANK YOU.

I’ve been going to Angie for ages, and there’s a reason I keep coming back. She truly knows what she’s doing! Her expertise, attention to detail, and passion for her craft show in every appointment.

She always takes the time to understand exactly what you’re looking for and somehow makes your hair look even better than you imagined. Beyond her talent, she’s warm, welcoming, and makes every visit feel like catching up with a friend.

If you’re looking for someone you can trust completely with your hair, Angie is the one!

Found this gem just through online searching and I’m so glad I did! I booked with Sam.

First off, the salon itself is adorable. Cozy but also chic. The atmosphere is really laid back and I felt comfortable instantly. I’m a really awkward and socially anxious person, so this is a big deal for me.

I got a balayage done and I am thrilled with the results! Even with a few layers of home colouring underneath, Sam achieved exactly what I was looking for.

Sam herself was great. She’s friendly and professional, but also fun! She seemed really knowledgeable about hair and I felt like I could trust her to achieve what I wanted. She asked the right questions and she was thorough but made it feel like a natural conversation.

The pricing is more than reasonable and worth every penny for the work that’s done.

I will absolutely be going back and will be adding pictures when I remember to take some!

Thank you for the great work, Sam! So happy I found this salon.
I love my haircut! Courtney was amazing and very friendly. The whole experience was wonderful, and I will definitely be coming back. Thanks, girl!

My stylist Sam was friendly and professional, and she did a great job on my haircut (trim, layers, and curtain bangs).
The environment was clean, relaxed and welcoming.

As a new client, I do wish there had been more consultation and discussion about my hair history, colour goals, and overall hair care before the service. My natural roots had grown out and were a different tone from the previously coloured sections, and the roots ended up more red/warm than the overall blended chocolate brown result I was hoping for.

I had also mentioned that I’ve recently started blow drying my hair more and wanted to learn more about how to protect it from heat damage and maintaining hair health overall. I left feeling like I didn’t gain much education or guidance beyond asking if I wanted to buy the one they had.

My first visit to this salon. I had the pleasure of having Courtney work her magic on me. Im shy and quiet,she totally respected that. Made me comfy. So happy with how everything turned out. I went in wanting to get rid of red… which is a big challenge. Left with no red and a big smile.

Chantal did an amazing job with my hair. Beautiful highlights, love the blonde. Everything blends smoothly. I’m very happy with it. It was a nice experience for me tonight, I enjoyed being there. The hair products smell very nice. My hair is super soft. She was gentle with my hair, I have a sensitive scalp. This was nice.

I have been going to Painted Hair Co. For years now. They are amazing! Beautiful salon and great staff. I have been seeing Angie for the last 8 years and she always does amazing. My hair always looks beautiful and healthy leaving the salon.10 out of 10 recommend this place.

address: 1036 King St W, Hamilton, ON L8S 1L5, Canada
reviews: Giselle did a fabulous job! Currently she’s a junior stylist and I am beyond impressed with her attention to detail. She made sure I was happy and took her time to create the vision I had for my hair. I asked for a blonde balayage/root smudge with colour correction. Highly recommend you come see her!!

AMAZING experience at Sokie & Co. I went in and saw Sokie the owner and she did an incredible job on my hair. She was very accommodating on my schedule given that I am 1.5 hours away from Hamilton. It’s definitely worth the drive because she didn’t disappoint. I initially sent her photos of what i want my hair colour to look like. She definitely knows her craft as you can see on the photo below. I couldn’t trust anybody but Sokie to do my hair. Also on the side note, her salon looks sooo chic and all the staff who work there were very friendly and down-to-earth. Please go check them out!

Super happy with my experience here! I go to Steph and she has always been helpful during the whole process. She gives me tips to maintain my hair colour (light blonde) and as I’m asian, it’s very hard to achieve a super light blonde but she did it after a few sessions (I was told by other stylists that it wouldn’t become as light as I wanted). My hair colour is still really bright! The last time I got my hair coloured at a different salon, the colour faded super fast (after a couple of weeks) and it’s almost been 2 months and the colour is still really blonde! Steph and staff are also very caring - I get anxiety and claustrophobic when I have too many foils in my hair and they were so understanding and made sure I was comfortable! Highly recommend

I’ve been to Sokie and Madie multiple times for balayage, cut and style. I have honestly been incredibly impressed every single time. They truly are experts at their craft, and results have been consistent and even better than expected. I’ve brought my 6 year old daughter for cuts and curls, and they’ve done such a great job! Highly recommend :)
Courtenay is a phenomenal hairdresser! She revived my hair back to life, and provided   suggestions when asked that helped me get a great cut I wanted. Highly recommend!

I had such an incredible experience here. Mekiah was my stylist, and she did my highlights so beautifully. She was so attentive during our consultation, and provided advice and recommendations that ended with me loving my hair. She was extremely meticulous and left me with a result that was exactly what I was wanting and more. She also blended them so beautifully to make them look more natural, especially when it grows out. I can’t recommend her more!

I had an amazing experience with Sokie! She gave me a beautiful collarbone-length cut with layers and bangs, and it completely transformed my hair. It feels so much healthier and easier to style now. I’ve been getting so many compliments on it — I’m beyond happy with the result. Sokie is so talented and really knows how to bring your vision to life!

Went to see Sokie the owner for a simple haircut and she did amazing! great attention to detail, i showed her one inspo photo and she tailored it to my hair without any difficulties, I absolutely love the cut!! Would highly recommend, worth the price.

address: 3615 Dixie Rd Unit 6, Mississauga, ON L4Y 4H4, Canada
reviews:
This was my second visit to Boss Vibes Barbershop,  and once again, I had a great experience. I walked in without an appointment, but the staff were able to get me a spot without any hassle or long wait, which I really appreciated.

I got my haircut done by Mo, and my beard was groomed by Chris. Both of them did an amazing job. They were professional, friendly, and made the whole experience very comfortable.

I especially want to give a big shoutout to Chris. He was dealing with a bad knee and was clearly having difficulty walking, but he still took the time to groom my beard with great care and professionalism. His dedication and attention to detail really stood out to me.

Thank you, Mo and Chris, for the great service! I’m definitely coming back again. Highly recommend Boss Vibes Barbershop  to anyone looking for talented and friendly barbers! 🔥

I had a great experience with Sourav today. He was friendly, professional, and took the time to understand exactly the haircut I wanted. His attention to detail and precision really stood out, and the final result exceeded my expectations. The whole experience was comfortable and unhurried, and you can tell he genuinely cares about his clients. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend Sourav to anyone looking for a skilled barber!

Absolutely loved my experience at Boss Vibes! The haircut came out clean, fresh, and exactly how I wanted it. Big shoutout to Mo super friendly, professional, and really knows what he’s doing. You can tell he actually cares about getting the details right. Definitely recommend Mo and Boss Vibes to anyone looking for a proper haircut! Also, the receptionist was super welcoming and helpful from the moment I walked in. She made the whole experience feel comfortable and organized. Great customer service all around. Definitely recommend Boss Vibes

Went today and saw Mikey, who was amazing!  Went in to get my beard trimmed up and faded, and he did an awesome job!  This was my first time going there and had no idea what to expect.  Mikey and the rest of the staff there are extremely welcoming and friendly. Definitely going back in the future to see Mikey. That dude is my beard barber moving forward. Cheers

Took my dad here for a haircut and was a great experience. The barbers were friendly, professional, and really paid attention to the details. My dad left smiling and said it was one of the best that he will always be coming back. The shop has a welcoming vibe, clean setup, and the service was quick but never rushed. Highly recommend if you're looking for a quality cut and a comfortable atmosphere! Very talented barbers, clean shop & fantastic customer service! Management is excellent with great communication!

name: Le Trunkshop
address: 251 Mont-Royal Ave E, Montreal, Quebec H2T 1P6, Canada
reviews: We had a wonderful shopping experience at Le Trunkshop boutique with Emily. They have perfectly curated items and lots of fun pieces to browse. Emily was so friendly and helpful when I was trying clothes on, pulling different sizes and suggestions when needed. This was by far our favourite boutique experience shopping in Montreal! We will be shopping online once we're back home.

Le Trunk Shop is hands down the best clothing store in Montreal. I discovered it a few years ago, and ever since, I haven’t shopped anywhere else. They carry a perfect mix of everyday pieces, and the style is absolutely impeccable.

What really sets them apart is how much they care about their clients. They actually listen to your feedback when selecting collections for the next season, and their styling services are incredible. I recently revamped my entire fall wardrobe, and Emily and Leno spent over an hour helping me curate every look.

The customer service is unmatched, and you can really feel how much they value their clients. I constantly get stopped on the street by people asking where my outfits are from because everything looks so unique and stylish. If you’re looking for elegant yet affordable fashion, Le Trunk Shop is an absolute must.

I have never had a more comfortable and amazing shopping experience. The employees and owner have a passion for clothing and for helping their customers find the “right” fit. Thanks for being awesome!

I visited Le Trunkshop yesterday on a brief trip to Montreal. Emily was relentless in her pursuit to help me find the perfect pair of jeans. It was the best customer service I have recieved in retail in a long time and akin to a mini session with a stylist which I have done in the past. The owner was very friendly too. Overall a great experience. I will be sure to visit again when in Montreal x

Had an absolutely phenomenal experience at Trunkshop in Montreal last weekend. Went on a girls shopping spree and we didn’t want to shop anywhere else after stopping here. Lino and Ophelia were incredibly kind, helpful, and just plain fun to shop with! Would recommend stopping here to anyone looking to shop in Montreal and will definitely be coming back in the future. Thanks so much!

I have done a lot of shopping in my time, and the time I spent at Le Trunkshop was without question The Best shopping experience of my life. Not only was the cut, fit, and quality of clothing exceptional - but the Team there was wholeheartedly warm and welcoming, it felt like having a small team of experts whose purpose was to make me look as good as possible - and have fun while doing it. My husband got in on it too, and was totally disarmed and comfortable in the store- by the end of the shopping experience we felt like old friends. One of the Team showed us the app he uses to dispense treats to his cat while he's in the shop. It was magical! I wish I lived in Montreal and could shop here in person all the time.

Thanks for your amazing customer service, Emily!

xxoo,
Sheila & Todd
Love shopping at Le Trunkshop. Since it’s been open I believe I began going over there. The owner Lino has amazing taste. Brings in very different clothing for women mostly.

Lino is wonderful and the store has beautiful clothes. He was very helpful with suggesting just the right items for me and my style. I would travel back to Montreal to shop from him. Highly recommend him and the store to anyone.
