reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful shopping experience at this clothing store! The clothes are beautiful, stylish, and high quality, with a great selection of designs and sizes. Everything was well-organized, and the staff were very friendly, helpful, and welcoming.

I was especially impressed with the quality of the clothing and the attention to detail. The prices are reasonable for the quality you receive. I will definitely be coming back and recommending this store to my family and friends.

Highly recommended! ❤️✨

Amazing store with great modest fashion.  Very organized and clean. Amami and Dana were amazing. They knew what i would look good in. If your looking for modest and good quality clothing please visit them or the online store.

I just bought this lovely skirt with the help of this sweet staff member Aseal I couldn’t get the size I needed and so she promised to get it for me the next day. Customer service is really good here and their designs are aesthetic. Glad to have shopped here. I will recommend this shop to my friends as well :))) 💕

I visited Dana Fashion and had a great experience. Their prices are very affordable compared to other stores, and they offer amazing discounts on many items. The customer service was outstanding—everyone was kind, welcoming, and helpful. I found beautiful pieces at great prices and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended

I’ve been to one of their previous locations before and the kindness in each and every one of their stores is priceless. They could tell that I’m a recent wearer of the veil so they always throw in extras or give me a little discount even when they don’t need to! Every interaction with their staff makes me want to bawl my eyes out when I get home (in a good way). I think in this store, the girl who helped me style my hijab (my first time ever wearing a styled hijab btw and it was during Ramadan AS IFTAR WAS NEARING and I LOST TRACK OF THE TIME) I may have forgotten her name but her name was Jannah and if I misremembered (I’m so sorry that I misremembered how could I misremember) it’s probably because I think she was so kind and caring that I pray that she is granted the highest ranks in Jannah.

Dana Fashion truly exceeded my expectations. The collection is absolutely stunning — every piece reflects high quality, attention to detail, and a beautiful sense of style. The fabrics feel luxurious, and the designs are both elegant and unique.

What made the experience even better was the exceptional customer service. The team was incredibly kind, helpful, and genuinely cared about making sure everything was perfect. They made the whole process smooth and enjoyable.

Highly recommend Dana Fashion for anyone looking for quality, style, and a great shopping experience!

This store has such a beautiful variety of modest clothing. Aseel truly is the kindest soul MashaAllah, you can really see how dedicated she is to helping and assisting with anything we need. A must visit for anyone looking for modest wear paired with the sweetest customer service experience!

I absolutely love this place! The fabric and the finishing is on point.. The vibe inside the shop is very warm every one is nice and so helpful, from the moment your in until out you feel welcomed.. Thank you ladies

name: KaleMart24
address: 2025 Rue Peel, Montreal, Quebec H3A 1T6, Canada
reviews:
Founder and CEO Oussama Saoudi [ Sam] has built a company around a vision of health and sustainability. KaleMart24 has completely changed my expectations of a convenience store. The locations are always clean, bright, modern, and open 24 hours, making them incredibly convenient no matter the time of day. I especially enjoy the excellent organic coffee, which I honestly prefer over many of the larger coffee chains, and the Club Kale subscription is a fantastic value for anyone who enjoys coffee regularly. The staff have always been friendly and welcoming, and every visit has been a positive experience. From what many customers are saying, people appreciate the fresh food options, clean stores, excellent coffee, and the convenience of having a quality neighborhood market open around the clock. KaleMart24 has become one of my favorite stops during my walks, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for great coffee, healthy food, and outstanding service.
Michael Pokocky / Author
Incredible experience thanks to Zoe at the cash register, had some issues with produce and she handled everything efficiently and professionally. Love having a healthy food option late at night

I grabbed a hot sandwich from a "natural" convenience shop. Inside, it was frozen and uncooked. They said it was hot, but after arguing, they offered to switch it for a chilled one. In summary, a beautiful idea without substance.

I had a great experience at Kalemarket24 thanks to Walid. He was incredibly helpful, friendly, and attentive from the moment I walked in. He took the time to answer my questions and made sure I found exactly what I needed. It’s rare to come across such genuine customer service these days. Walid really made the difference—I’ll definitely be coming back!
9/10 experience, would’ve been a 6/10 however that white girl with bangs absolutely carries kalemart. She was extremely helpful and made my whole day! Will be coming back soon.

address: 226 James St N, Hamilton, ON L8R 2L3, Canada
reviews: What a great find in downtown Hamilton! The store has such a cool vibe, and the staff is super helpful. You’ll find everything from formal gowns to trendy, eclectic accessories, there’s truly something for everyone. Don’t miss the basement level, it’s full of even more hidden gems. Bonus: this weekend they’re celebrating their 5-year anniversary with special discounts.

This was only my second time visiting - if I lived in Hamilton, I would certainly be here weekly! This is my ideal type of second-hand store - it has a mix of styles, brands and reasonable price points, with clothing that leans contemporary, with some great vintage pieces as well. You can find something special and unique, while also finding everyday, simple basics. The clothes are well vetted - you are not sifting through items that are stained, ripped or otherwise damaged. Both times I visited, service was delivered by one of the owners (whom I recognize from Reloved's social accounts). She was so friendly, welcoming, and low pressure to everyone who came in. I felt very comfortable just sifting through the racks, taking my time - attended to, yet not made to feel I must purchase something. This trip I bought 2 reloved items, and my previous trip I purchased 1 item - however, I could have gone home with many more as I found so many gems. If you are anywhere near the area - it is very much worth a visit and supporting this small, local business.

Truly love Reloved Boutique! I’ve both consigned with them and purchased from them, and every experience has been amazing. They always have the best finds, with such a curated, stylish selection of pieces. I’ve brought many friends and family members in since discovering the store and everyone ends up loving it just as much as I do.

Tish, Lex, and their mom (owners of the shop) are all incredible — so sweet, welcoming, helpful, and genuinely lovely to chat with. It’s one of those places that feels special every time you walk in. I always leave excited about a new piece (or two! or three! or four!) and looking forward to my next visit. Couldn’t recommend them more!

My partner and I decided to talk a stroll down James St and check out the Reloved Boutique after perusing their social media accounts and we're very glad that we did.

The staff were super helpful showing us changing rooms and where things were located as well being very kind and welcoming with small talk while we shopped.

The store was beautifully kept and a perfect temperature controlled recluse from the over head sun during the lunch hour.

What an interesting boutique with something for the shopper in all of us.

Delicate and robust candles, intricate and bedazzling jewelry combined with the incredible fashion finds make this place a must stop!

I would recommend this place to any aspiring fashionista.

This store has brought consignment to a whole new level! The Integrity and enthusiasm of the owners and staff is amazing! Their sense of giving back to community and saving the environment is to be admired. This is what James Street North and Hamilton is all about. Brava ladies💖

The fade was clean, the lineup was sharp, and the overall experience was great. Super professional and easy to talk to. I’ll definitely be coming back and would recommend Ibrahim to anyone looking for a quality barber.

Grabbed a haircut at this location as it was new and I wanted to try it out… let me just say Sophia was awesome. She gave good tips and advice about my style and haircut over which would look best… she was right. Very sociable and easy to talk to. It was a great experience overall.
Sophia did an amazing job with my hair, took her time and made sure it was done perfect. Super friendly staff and very clean location. Definitely recommend!

Had an amazing haircut done by Ali!

Great service, took great attention to detail, and got me looking fresh!

Definitely recommend!

“I just wanted to take a moment to thank you. The shop is absolutely beautiful, and the service was fantastic. I loved everything about my experience, and I’ll definitely be back. Thank you so much Ibrahim

Community driven business! Happy to have them in our neighbourhood and supporting our local events!

I went for a haircut and received a spectacular skin fade, head wash and massage from CJ! Definitely recommend it!
Tina was friendly and professional. My son and I are very happy with our haircuts. Highly recommend!
Excellent attention to detail on cut ,hot shave on point!  Highly recommend Sofia ! Amazing job

name: Scaddabush Italian Kitchen & Bar Square One
address: 209 Rathburn Rd W, Mississauga, ON L5B 4C1, Canada
reviews:
We had such an amazing experience at Scaddabush thanks to Raman! 🤩 His service was exceptional. His timing was perfect throughout the entire meal. We never once had to try to get his attention or worry about asking for anything. Everything just flowed so smoothly and we were able to relax and genuinely enjoy our meal.

He was also incredibly friendly, attentive and especially wonderful with the kids ☺️His recommendations were actually so good too, everything he suggested was delicious! 😋 It’s rare to have service that feels this effortless and thoughtful. Raman made our experience here so much better and honestly made our day.
10/10 service! 😊👍🏻👍🏻

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

After a long and busy month of July, my wife and I decided to spend a quiet evening at Scaddabush, and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences we’ve had in Mississauga.

From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed by the reception staff. The restaurant has a beautiful Italian-inspired atmosphere with red brick walls, wooden shelves, warm lighting, elegant chandeliers, and thoughtful décor that makes the space feel both cozy and authentic.

Our Dining attendant , Minhaj, truly made the evening special. He greeted us with a genuine smile, patiently explained the menu, and recommended the Fried Polenta and Shrimp Pistachio Caserecce. Both dishes were absolutely delicious. The polenta fries were perfectly crispy and paired beautifully with the fresh tomato and basil sauce, while the Shrimp Pistachio Caserecce was rich, flavorful, and comforting—every bite felt like a taste of Italy.

One small detail that caught my attention was the glass jar of black-eyed beans on the table. Curious about its purpose, I asked Minhaj, and he happily explained that it’s inspired by Italian dining traditions. I really appreciated him taking the time to share that with us—it added a personal touch to the experience.

Before leaving, I ordered a cheesecake to take home for my son, who was already asleep when we got home. It was the perfect ending to a relaxing evening.

Great food brings people into a restaurant, but exceptional service is what makes them want to return. The chefs created wonderful dishes, and Minhaj’s hospitality completed the experience.

Thank you, Scaddabush, and a special thank you to Minhaj for taking such great care of us. We look forward to visiting again!

Had a great dining experience at Scaddabush! We ordered the Rigatoni Bolognese, Lemon Garlic Shrimp Spaghetti, Polenta Fries, and an Espresso Martini.

The Polenta Fries were crispy on the outside, soft inside, and made a delicious starter. The Espresso Martini was smooth, strong, and a perfect way to end the meal. They have a great selection of cocktails to choose from.

The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, and the service was excellent throughout. A special thank you to Namir, who was attentive, friendly, and made our dining experience even better with his great service.

Overall, a very enjoyable experience and I’d definitely return to try more dishes!

Ola provided excellent service! Appreciated the greeter went out of her way to get a bowl from the kitchen for water for my dog. I found the food to be better than expected. The menu had a number of very good choices. The patio was very pleasant, we were able to find shade on the one side and the music wasn’t so loud that we couldn’t easily carry on a conversation.

My brother is low vision/blind, and they were very accommodating of him which I sincerely appreciated

We had a great experience at Scaddabush! The food was delicious, the atmosphere was warm and inviting, and everything exceeded our expectations. A special shoutout to MANI, our server—he was incredibly friendly, attentive, and gave us excellent recommendations that made it so much easier to decide what to order. His service truly made our visit even more enjoyable. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

name: Tikka Junction
address: 295A Queen St E Unit 26, Brampton, ON L6W 3W9, Canada
reviews:
This restaurant exceeded every expectation we had. We recently hosted a private gathering in their party hall, and everything was absolutely perfect from start to finish.

The venue was beautifully set up, creating the perfect atmosphere for our event. The staff and manager went above and beyond to make sure every detail was taken care of, and their hospitality was truly exceptional. They were attentive, accommodating, and made us feel like valued guests throughout the entire evening.

The food deserves special recognition—every single dish was outstanding. Everything was fresh, flavorful, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. It was one of those meals where every item on the table impressed us.

To make the evening even more memorable, there was live music, which added such a warm and enjoyable touch to the overall experience.

We highly recommend this restaurant for both private gatherings and a regular dinner. If you’re looking for outstanding service, incredible food, and a welcoming atmosphere, this is the place to go. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for making our celebration so memorable, we’ll definitely be back!

Had a fantastic experience at Tikka Junction! The food was absolutely delicious—the flavors were authentic, bold, and perfectly cooked.
​A special shoutout to our server, Neha, who made our meal truly memorable. She was incredibly warm, attentive, and polite, ensuring we had everything we needed without any delay. Excellent food paired with top-notch hospitality. Will definitely be back!

Tikka Junction in Brampton is a solid spot for Indian cuisine. The food overall was delicious — flavorful, well-prepared, and satisfying. However, the malai kofta curry fell a little short; it was noticeably too sweet for my taste, which threw off the balance of the dish. Everything else on the menu was enjoyable and hit the right notes.

What truly elevated the experience was our server, Monica. She was exceptional — attentive, warm, and professional throughout the meal. Her service made the visit genuinely memorable.

Despite the one dish missing the mark, I'd happily return to Tikka Junction Brampton. With a slight tweak to that malai kofta recipe, this place could be a perfect 5-star dining experience.

How can a restaurant send chicken when a customer orders Veg 65 Manchurian? I am a pure vegetarian, and this is completely unacceptable.

When I received the order, it was clearly chicken instead of the vegetarian dish I had ordered. To make matters worse, I had to provide video proof before the issue was taken seriously. In the end, the restaurant admitted that it was chicken and simply said "sorry."

A mistake like this is not minor. For vegetarians, whether for personal, religious, or ethical reasons, receiving meat instead of a vegetarian dish is a serious issue. Customers place trust in restaurants to serve what they order, and that trust was completely broken here.

If you are vegetarian, please be very cautious when ordering from this restaurant. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend it. I will be sharing this experience with my friends, family, and community groups so that others are aware of what happened.

Customer trust should matter more than popularity. A simple apology is not enough when such a serious mistake is made.
And if you need more proof I to send your owner pls contact me anytime as you said my owner will take strict action against chef pls let me know what you took

I had a wonderful experience.The service was excellent from start to finish, and the food was absolutely delicious. I ordered two Amritsari Kulchas and one Aloo Tikki, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The Amritsari Kulchas were especially amazing and full of authentic taste.

Susan was friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. Great food, great service, and a welcoming atmosphere. I thoroughly enjoyed my visit and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for authentic and tasty food!

Loved the vibes and the food! Our server, Pawan, was amazing—so attentive and checked in on us throughout the night. Everything we ordered was delicious, and they even surprised us with a free birthday cake! Such a perfect spot to celebrate a birthday. We’ll definitely be back.

We had a wonderful experience at Tikka Junction! The food was delicious, and everything we ordered was full of flavor. We especially enjoyed the non-veg platter, the lamb chops, and the chaat—each dish was fresh, well-prepared, and tasted amazing.

A special thank you to Komal for her excellent service. She was welcoming, friendly, and attentive throughout our visit. She checked on us regularly to make sure everything was perfect, which made our dining experience even more enjoyable.

Great food, great service, and a warm atmosphere. We’ll definitely be back!

Arshdeep gave us a warm welcome. We had such a lovely experience today, all thanks to our server! She was incredibly warm, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we walked in. Her recommendations were spot on, and she handled everything with such a positive attitude and professionalism. It’s rare to come across someone who truly enjoys what they do, and it shows in the way she treats her customers. Thank you for making our visit so memorable—we’ll definitely be coming back!

address: 380 Bovaird Dr E, Brampton, ON L6Z 2S1, Canada
reviews: Paid $29 for a small supposedly mango cake which didn't even taste like mango. It was simply a yellow colored, overly sweet, frosting heavy cake. If you eat with your eyes closed it'll taste like nothing. For that price I would expect at least trace amount of real mangoes in it. The staff wasn't much helpful either when I need some assistance with choosing flavor. Wouldn't recommend.

The cake was absolutely amazing! It looked beautiful and tasted incredible. When i brought the design I wasn’t even sure if it would be even possible but Every detail was perfect, and you truly made our special day even more memorable. Thank you for your hard work—we couldn’t have asked for a better cake. Highly recommend!

We visited for getting a freshly baked cake for a 3 year old kid and very much impressed by the quality of cake, service and staff. The staff is highly professional and friendly and they helped us choose the right cake and size based on our requirements. They also followed special instructions for custom made cake. We also tried their patties (aloo, paneer and noodle) while waiting for the cake and we couldn’t control our happiness as the taste was outstanding. I highly recommend trying their food if you visit.

Would like to especially thank Jalak for her help and overall customer service. Must visit.

I ordered a 6-inch Gulab Jamun cake for delivery, and I absolutely loved the service they provided.

They made our day extra special with their excellent service. The cake was incredibly delicious and tasted authentic.

I requested a customized cake, and they made it beautifully—better than I had imagined!

The prices are very reasonable, and the quality is outstanding. I highly recommend this place. Must visit! 🥰🥰❤️

We ordered our baby's first birthday custom cake and these guys created it so perfectly. Not just the design was awesome, also the taste was very delicious. And their prices are comparatively lesser than other well known bakeries in the area, but quality is the best. Thanks Red moon bakery for making our occasion more special with the best cake.

name: Duc de Lorraine
address: 5002 Chem. de la Côte-des-Neiges, Montreal, Quebec H3V 1G6, Canada
status: Veteran French pastry shop with a patio
reviews:
We went for brunch, although apparently we decided brunch needed a little rebellion: French onion soup, because why not? Followed by a classic croque monsieur and a salmon croissant.

The bakery side definitely shows. The bread and croissants were exceptionally well made, fresh, and exactly what you’d hope for from a French restaurant that also happens to bake its own goods. 🇫🇷🥐

We also really enjoyed the terrasse. On a beautiful day, it’s relaxed, comfortable. And it’s pet-friendly, which meant we got to meet a whole collection of very good doggos. 🐶❤️
The atmosphere is very down-to-earth for a place with such a prestigious reputation.

The service was equally fitting for the setting. Attentive, polished, and professional.

Overall, the quality is fantastic, the portions are filling, and we absolutely understand the reputation. Worth it? We think so. But, this is one we’d probably save for a special occasion rather than an everyday brunch.

I recently visited Duc de Lorraine, a classic French-style patisserie and bakery in Montreal, and overall it was a great experience.

The prices are definitely on the higher or expensive side, especially for pastries and menu items, but the quality of the food helps justify it to a certain extent.

Everything I tried was fresh, well-prepared, and clearly made with attention to detail. The taste really stands out, especially the pastries, which feel authentic and high-quality in a traditional French bakery style rather than Québécois comfort food.

Some of their best sellers really show why the place is so popular—things like their buttery croissants, éclairs, macarons, mille-feuille, and a variety of beautifully crafted cakes and pastries all stand out.

What really makes this place special, though, is the vibe. It has an elegant, classic European café feel that makes the whole experience enjoyable and memorable. The atmosphere alone adds a lot to the visit.

Even though the prices are steep, the combination of authentic French bakery flavors, well-known signature pastries, and the overall ambiance easily makes it feel like a five-star bakery experience overall.

Very nice restaurant with cozy atmosphere and excellent choice of pastries. We went here for brunch and I had a chance to try their brunch menu, peach mimosa and multiple trompe l'œil. I had buyourdi which was delicious and I tried my friend's avocado toast which I found to be burnt. I also found that brunch potatoes packed seasoning. The bowl of fruit though was perfect. The mimosas were good, but I didn't taste much peach in it. Nevertheless, I did enjoy it. The best part for me was the desert which in my case was the mango trompe l'œil. It was absolutely delicious and I am looking forward to coming back to have it again! I also tried the pear and lemon trompe l'œil and both were great. As for the service, I found that it was good but not very attentive. Once we got our food, there was not much follow up, even if we wanted to order more. Overall, I liked the restaurant but I do think it's overpriced for the food and service that you get.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We had an excellent experience at Duc de Lorraine. The food was outstanding from start to finish. I had the steak and fries, which were cooked perfectly and absolutely delicious. The desserts were beautiful, creative, and tasted as good as they looked.

A special thank you to Sajjad for his friendly, attentive, and professional service. He made us feel very welcome and ensured everything was perfect throughout our visit.

The dessert presentation, complete with singing from the staff, added a fun and memorable touch to the experience. We will definitely be back on our next visit to Montreal!

Thank you, Sajjad, and the entire team for a fantastic dining experience.

I had heard so many great things about Duke de Lorraine, from the quality of the food to the impeccable service, so I was genuinely excited to try it for brunch, BUT…

Unfortunately, the experience did not live up to the reputation. I ordered the smoked salmon Eggs Benedict, St Joseph, a dish priced at $47. At that price point, expectations naturally become much higher. You expect something memorable, whether through exceptional presentation, outstanding flavors, flawless service, attention to detail, or simply a dish served hot and within a reasonable amount of time. Instead, after a fairly long wait, my plate arrived cold, with only the potatoes being warm. I asked for a replacement, and while the request was handled professionally, it took another 30 minutes before the second plate arrived. Disappointingly, it was cold as well. At that point, I chose not to complain again.

What made the situation even more frustrating was that the dish itself was very ordinary. There was nothing particularly wrong with it, but there was also nothing that justified either the price or the restaurant's reputation. The presentation was basic, the flavors were standard, and there was no creative touch or special seasoning that made it stand out.

One detail that left me puzzled was the three small jars of jam placed on the table. They look attractive, but no bread or pastry was served, which made them feel more decorative than functional.

Overall, I found the experience overrated for the price. The setting is beautiful, the staff are pleasant, and the dessert display is impressive, but the food simply did not meet my expectations. I might return one day to try the pastries and desserts because they looked exceptional, but based on this brunch experience alone, I would not personally recommend it as a brunch destination.

Date night at Duc de Lorraine and I get the hype 😮‍💨✨
The viral desserts?! 10/10
That mousse was so creamy — not too light, not too heavy… just PERFECT 🤍🍫
The calamari? Crispy, flavorful, absolutely yummy 🦑🔥
Had an amazing blond beer recommended by Oksana (who was incredible btw 💛🍺)
A bar + dessert spot in one is elite behavior for date night 💫

Husband rating: 9.2/10 — MUST TRY ✔️

I had a great experience at Duc de Lorraine in Montreal. I ordered the beef tartare and mentioned that I’m gluten sensitive, and they were very accommodating, swapping out the bread for radishes and cucumbers without any issue.
The portion of beef was quite generous, and the flavour was absolutely on point, fresh, well seasoned, and really well balanced. Overall, a great spot with thoughtful service. I’d definitely come back.

Visited Duc de Lorraine and had a very nice experience! The outdoor terrace is definitely better than the indoor seating, especially with the beautiful direct view of Saint Joseph’s Oratory. The place is very clean, and the waiters are elegant, welcoming, and always greeting guests with a smile.

The desserts and croissants looked absolutely delicious . we tried the Paris brest dessert and the crème brûlée, both were excellent. A bit on the expensive side, but overall a lovely experience and worth visiting for the atmosphere, pastries, and view.

name: PunjabLand at Kennedy
address: 50 Kennedy Rd S, Brampton, ON L6W 3E7, Canada
reviews:
We went here for an impromptu date night and were delightfully surprised at the great service, food and overall atmosphere. We ordered tandoori chaap, methi malai mutter paneer makhana, daal makhni and lachcha parantha. Everything was spot on and super delicious. The chaap in particular was very flavorful and perfectly seasoned and marinated. The complimentary dessert was also very good !

Special word for the service. Nilakshi and Arman were very courteous and polite and made sure we were comfortable. The whole staff is well mannered and very helpful. Loved the overall experience and will be back !

We went on a Tuesday night after 10pm and it was busy and lively. Our servers Armaan and Tanveer were super nice and efficient.
Never tired a dish with makhanas and paneer and it was so good. Will definitely come again with friends.

Had a really enjoyable meal today! The Virgin Mint Mojito was incredibly refreshing, perfectly chilled with a crisp burst of mint and citrus that made it very revitalizing.

The Paneer Lababdar was rich, creamy, and full of flavor, absolutely delicious. Paired with the chilli garlic naan and butter naan, it made for the perfect combination, soft, aromatic, and indulgent.

Also tried the chilli veg momos, and they were fantastic, nicely spiced, flavorful, and cooked just right with a great kick.

Overall, a wonderful experience with great taste and satisfying flavors. Would definitely recommend!

Visited this restaurant on a sudden plan after searching for Indian restaurants nearby on Google, and decided to give it a try.

We ordered Baingan Bharta, Kadhai Mushroom, and garlic naan. Since the Baingan Bharta was unavailable, it was replaced with kofta.

The gravies were flavorful and well-prepared overall. However, I personally felt that the mushroom pieces and vegetables in the Kadhai Mushroom were cut a bit too large, which slightly affected the texture and taste of the dish. The kofta also seemed a little undercooked from the inside, almost as if it had been reheated after being taken out from the cooler.

The garlic naan was decent, though nothing particularly standout. Overall, the food experience was satisfactory, making it a good place for a one-time visit.

One of the strongest positives of the restaurant was definitely the service staff. The team was attentive, active, and always on their toes, which created a welcoming and positive atmosphere throughout the visit.

A few small observations from my side:• The cutlery felt slightly oversized compared to the crockery.• Extra chairs placed along the walkway did not blend well with the restaurant’s theme and ambiance. It may look more organized if they are kept aside and only used when required.• The black-colored butter paper used for serving did not feel very appealing from a food presentation perspective. Personally, lighter serving paper would create a cleaner and more appetizing impression.

Overall, a decent dining experience with good service and a pleasant environment.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Hidden Gem for Punjabi Food & Late-Night Dining in Brampton!

If you're looking for authentic Punjabi food, a great atmosphere, and a place that's open late, Punjabland Restaurant is definitely worth a visit! 🍛🔥

From the moment you walk in, you're welcomed by a warm and vibrant atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The restaurant is spacious, clean, and perfect for family dinners, gatherings with friends, or even a late-night food craving. 😊

The food is absolutely delicious! 😋 Every dish is packed with authentic Punjabi flavors and prepared with fresh ingredients. Whether you're enjoying buttery naan, flavorful curries, sizzling tandoori dishes, or classic Punjabi favorites, you can taste the quality in every bite. The portions are generous, giving you great value for your money. 🍗🥘🫓

One thing that really sets Punjabland apart is its bar and late-night service. 🍻🌙 It's one of the few places where you can enjoy great food and drinks well into the night. For those planning a late outing, the restaurant accepts last alcohol orders until 1:45 AM, making it a fantastic spot to relax and unwind with friends after a long day. 🎉🍹

The staff is friendly, attentive, and always ready to help with recommendations. Their hospitality adds to the overall experience and makes every visit enjoyable. 👏

Overall, Punjabland Restaurant delivers the perfect combination of great food, excellent service, a lively atmosphere, and late-night convenience. Whether you're a Punjabi food lover or simply looking for a fun place to eat and enjoy drinks with friends, Punjabland is a place you'll want to visit again and again.

🌟 Highly recommended!
🍛 Authentic Punjabi Cuisine
🍻 Full Bar Service
🌙 Open Late
😊 Friendly Staff
💯 Great Food & Atmosphere

Best restaurant to have authentic Punjabi food. We tried the Veg Hakka noodles, Gobhi Manchurian, Paneer Tikka masala and Delhi wala butter chicken. All dishes were delicious and piping hot. Their butter chicken was authentic! Service by Bhawan, Tanu and Arman was excellent. They took good care of us and catered to all our needs. We will definitely be back. The atmosphere is great too!

The food here is great, with a rich ambiance and solid customer service. My order was delayed, but they kindly included gulab jamun to make up for it without me even asking, which was a nice touch.

They also have a bar, which adds to the overall experience. I only did pickup this time, but it seems like a good place for dining in as well.

The location itself is a bit industrial, and the smell outside isn’t the best—but once you’re inside, the atmosphere is much better.

Loved the food here!  We ordered tandoori chicken , delhi butter chicken, goat curry , naan and drinks.
Tanveer & Manpreet did an awesome job with  quick service and i found it top notch.

Will be looking forward to come back 💕

name: Bombay Bakers
address: 375 Howden Blvd, Brampton, ON L6S 4L6, Canada
reviews: Fav. place to grab some quick bites like vada-paav or paav-bhaji or if you want birthday cakes. Snacks are very reasonably priced and have good taste. Sometimes it gets too busy, but that tells us that people like the food.

Bombay bakers has been our go to place for years  now whenever we are craving for Indian street food. The menu includes all vegetarian dishes.

Their Bombay sandwiches and paninis are amazing and my favourite. Very delicious and well made. The other dishes are great too!

They also have mixed veg and potato patties along with a variety of different pastries. Pricing is pretty reasonable compared to other places.

The bakery has a decent dining area. Due to it’s popularity, it is quite busy over the weekends.

I’m yet to find any other bakery/fast food place that offers this kind of taste and quality.

Definitely worth trying if you’re looking for some tasty Indian street food along with their hot tea or coffee!

I have tasted almost everything from their menu but our favourite is puffs and cream rolls .
Their sandwiches are also good to try .

I have to rewrite my review because the owner's reply came across as arrogant rather than addressing the concerns I raised.

To be clear, I have never failed to pick up an order after placing it. Recently, the restaurant started asking for Interac e-Transfer deposits, whereas previously you took customers' credit card information. I have always paid for my orders and have no issue paying by either credit card or Interac e-Transfer.

My concern has never been about the payment policy. It is about the poor telephone etiquette and customer service.

Instead of listening to the customer's feedback, acknowledging the issue, or offering a simple apology, the response was defensive and argumentative. Calling a customer at 11:00 a.m. when no one answers, and then continuing to argue about it, is not professional. The wait time for pickup orders is also quite long.

Good customer service includes listening to customers respectfully, communicating politely, and apologizing when appropriate. If an entire day had passed, I could understand that staff might be tired. However, this happened around 11:10 a.m., just after the restaurant had opened, so that explanation does not apply.

Unfortunately, I experienced the same phone attitude about three years ago and even raised a complaint at that time. It is disappointing to see that there has been no improvement in the behavior or professionalism of the person taking phone orders.

I genuinely hope this feedback is taken constructively so the restaurant can improve its customer service experience.

I recently visited Bombay Bakers with my friends, and we had such a great experience! We ordered a variety of items—paninis, the Bombay sandwich, vada pav, and aloo papri chaat—and everything was absolutely delicious. The flavors were spot on, especially the vada pav, which was authentic and packed with just the right amount of spice. The Bombay sandwich was a perfect mix of freshness and spice, while the aloo papri chaat was tangy, crispy, and incredibly satisfying. The paninis were also a big hit—warm, cheesy, and perfectly toasted.
The only downside is that the space is a bit small for the number of customers they attract, so it can feel a little crowded at peak times. But honestly, the amazing food and overall experience more than make up for it.
Overall, it’s a fantastic place to enjoy flavorful Indian snacks and treats. I’d definitely recommend it, especially if you’re looking for a spot to catch up with friends over some amazing food!

The customer service was extremely poor. My friend and I were given our food and had just taken it to our table when we noticed it was stale. We politely informed the staff about the issue; however, instead pav bhaji  of addressing our concern or offering any solution, they responded rudely and dismissed us, telling us to just leave it as it was. No replacement or proper response was provided.

Excellent place for Indian style fast food. Most of the items are great. My favorite is Paneer Tikka Panini. Price is very reasonable. Ambiance is not great. Bit crowded at times. Overall excellent place, highly recommended.
I ordered paneer panini. Lettuce in sandwich is moulded. Looks like they used too old lettuce.

name: Man O'Clock Barbershop
address: 3662 Hurontario St #1, Mississauga, ON L5A 4A1, Canada
reviews: I needed a Haircut very urgently so I booked with this shop, as it looked like a good barber shop, and im glad i picked it. I didn’t get any fades, just needed a lineup and Scissor work done to maintain my hairstyle, and the barber really listened and dod a great job. I would recommend this place highly especially if you have straight asian like hair, as the barber LP knows how to cut it properly. I will definitely be coming back.

I recently got my haircut from Kartik Adi, and I had a really great experience. He is very professional, friendly, and takes the time to understand exactly what style you want. The haircut was done with great attention to detail, and the final result looked clean and perfect.

What I liked most was his patience and skill — he made sure everything was done properly without rushing. The overall atmosphere was comfortable, and the service was excellent from start to finish. I’ve received a lot of compliments on my haircut since then.

Highly recommend Kartik Adi to anyone looking for a talented and reliable barber. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

This is the first time I went to a new place with no recomendation and was honestly pretty nervous. I didnt know who was going to cut my hair. When I got there, Natalie greated me with a kind smile and asked me to sit. She was super cool and made feel at home. Her skills with hair are unmatched and she even washed it. After the wash she dried and styled it. Overall a very good experience. Thank you.

Completely Unprofessional - Avoid This Place

Absolutely terrible experience with their scheduling and basic customer service. I booked an appointment well in advance with a specific barber for a reason. When I arrived, they completely disregarded my booking and tried to force me to see a different barber, casually claiming they were running short on time.

If a business is running behind, the bare minimum requirement is to be respectful enough to call or text the customer beforehand not blindside them at the door. Why even offer a selection option on your booking platform if you are just going to pass clients around like objects? It makes zero sense.

To make matters worse, there is a glaring, unacceptable double standard in how they treat people here. It is highly disappointing to see that they treat white customers with proper professionalism and respect, but think they can treat Indian customers with subpar, dismissive service. It feels like modern intra-racial bias, and it is disgusting.

If you want your time respected and your booking honored, do yourself a favor and go somewhere else. They do not deserve your business.

I had a great experience at this barbershop. The staff were friendly and professional, and I really liked the haircut they gave me. The fade on the sides was clean and well-done, and the length on top was exactly what I asked for. The barber paid attention to detail and made sure everything looked perfect. I definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a quality haircut. I’ll gladly come back for my next trim...and the coffee was delicious 😋

name: Junction - Indian Street Food (Brampton)
address: 2 County Ct Blvd Unit#165, Brampton, ON L6W 3W8, Canada
reviews: We were welcomed with amazing smell of bhakhri pizza and we instantly got hooked to it. We tried their bhakhri pizza and loaded puff and loved it! The place is spacious and bright with Bollywood songs playing in the background. We would definitely come back to this place.

If you’re visiting Junction in Brampton, their Veg Hakka Noodles and Methi Gota are definitely worth trying. The Veg Hakka Noodles are well-balanced with good flavor, nicely stir-fried, and not overly oily, which makes them enjoyable and light. The portion size is also quite satisfying.

The Methi Gota stands out with its crispy texture on the outside and soft, flavorful inside. It has a nice hint of methi (fenugreek) that gives it an authentic taste, especially if you enjoy traditional snacks.

Overall, a good spot for Indo-Chinese and Gujarati-style bites. Worth a visit if you’re craving something flavorful and comforting.

We always love coming here for our usual Vada Pav and Masala Chai.

We tried Pani Puri at the Live Counter and the Bhakhri Cheese Pizza.

I didn’t miss India and Mumbai for a bit.

The food was super yummy and tasty.

Coming back soon 😋

I’m really disappointed with my recent order from this restaurant. I ordered Manchurian with gravy, but what I received had almost no gravy at all. On top of that, the food was overcooked and tasted burnt. The flavor was extremely off and far too spicy, making it very unpleasant to eat.

Overall, it was a very poor experience and definitely not what I expected. I hope the restaurant improves its food quality and pays more attention to orders in the future.

This place truly impressed us! The cuisine was amazing, with bold flavors and beautiful presentation. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere was spotless and inviting. We had a fantastic time and will definitely return.
Must try Bhakhri Pizza 🍕
Maskaban
Veg. Noodles
Junction special sandwich 🥪

Loved the methi gota, loaded puff - masala chai and the gol gappe !! Pls also include the sooji gol gappe as well!! Himanshi is extremely gracious and recommend the best options !! Definitely give it a try!

Visited Junction in Brampton and tried their Dabeli and shake. The Dabeli was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, fresh, and perfectly balanced with the right amount of sweetness and spice. The shake was thick, refreshing, and tasted amazing. Great quality food, friendly service, and a nice atmosphere. Definitely a place I would recommend to anyone craving authentic street-style snacks and tasty drinks. Looking forward to visiting again!
We had a great experience here. All the food was so good. They gave us free daal vada and bhajiya for testing and both the items were so delicious. Must recommend place. Love the food and service. ❤️

reviews: Highly recommend Don! My boys' haircuts turned out amazing. Don was professional, patient, and took great care to make sure everything was perfect. The attention to detail was excellent, and my boys left looking sharp and feeling confident. They told me they want to come back to Don. The trip from Barrie to Toronto was worth it we'll definitely be coming back. Thank you for such a great experience!

Johnny is hands down one of the best barbers I’ve been to. He pays attention to every detail, makes sure you’re happy with the cut, and never rushes the job. My haircut came out exactly how I wanted—clean, sharp, and fresh. He’s professional, friendly, and makes the whole experience enjoyable. If you’re looking for a barber who consistently delivers amazing results, I highly recommend booking with Johnny. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Went in for the first time couple days ago, amazing environment and atmosphere. Exactly what any man wants from a barber shop. Henry was my barber and he was excellent, took his time with the details and paid close attention to them. Consulted me about what sort of haircut would look good on me and what I could do with it. Overall 10/10 experience would definitely recommend to anyone.

Just got my second haircut with Waasi. Both times he made sure to ask me exactly what I wanted, made sure we were on the same page and delivered perfectly!
Honestly the best experience I've had with a hairstylist in a long time.
Always a great chat too!!

First time at Brazykuts, and I have to say—we’re beyond impressed!

For the first time in 12 years, my boys absolutely loved their haircuts. A huge thank you to Johnny and Mason for being so amazing with the kids. They were patient, friendly, and knew exactly how to connect with them.

I highly recommend Brazykuts, especially for kids and teenagers,they even speak their “LEGO language”! 😄

Let’s support these hardworking young barbers. We’ll definitely be back!

reviews: My family and I went to Mesa for dinner on Mother’s Day. It was our first time there, thanks to a friend’s recommendation. The food was incredible, and our server was incredibly helpful.  Since we were first-timers, she explained everything we needed to know about the menu. We were all so full afterward! The portions were generous, and we even had to take some leftovers home. I highly recommend Mesa to anyone looking for a great dining experience.  One tip: avoid eating anything beforehand.

Went here on a whim with my brother, and it was honestly the besttt!! I had the chalupa and he had enchiladas. Thought the portions were going to be small but they were enough to make us full 😊 Alejandro is so friendly and super great with recommendations :) Will come here again !!

1st time dining here thanks to a recommendation. Our hostess was absolutely the sweetest, I'm terrible for not getting her name. She was friendly, patient and not overbearing as most servers tend to be. My only complaint is that I used the men's washroom to wash my hands since the womens was occupied for quite some time and the soap pump was broken 🫠 Aside from that, the food was incredibly delicious, the spice was just right and still flavorful. The establishment was clean, the music was just right. I would recommend this place to anyone visiting downtown Hamilton.

We made a reservation for dinner at Mesa during Hamilton’s Art Crawl and were extremely pleased with our meal. Despite being jam packed with customers, the staff at Mesa were friendly and attentive. We ordered two taco plates (one with lamb birria and one with shrimp as the protein - medium heat) and both were perfect! The portions were generous and the sides were well done. I would recommend Mesa to anyone looking for delicious and reasonably priced meal in the area.

MY FAVOURITE PLACE IN DT HAMILTON!! Mesa is so good! I’ve been many times and I always get the nachos with chorizo and extra spicy!!! Their drinks are big and tasty, really good money for the size. The food is delicious and for my birthday I even got a free cake and little sombrero hat! They are also very good with allergies and dietary restrictions which I appreciate.

name: John's Family Restaurant
address: 1 Fisherman Dr, Brampton, ON L7A 2X9, Canada
reviews: We decided to try John's for the first time yesterday. This place did not disappoint! We were greeted at the door with warm smiles and pleasantries. We were allowed to sit anywhere we wished. The speed and quality of service was that of a small town dinner, but the food was unreal! The portions are HUGE! And we love that the eggs are locally sourced. This is such a hidden gem in a city like Brampton.

I am honestly very disappointed and upset with our recent experience. During our visit, I found a hair in my meal. The staff replaced the dish, but when we received the new one, we unfortunately found three more smaller hairs in the replacement food. This is beyond unacceptable and made us completely lose our appetite and trust in the kitchen’s cleanliness.

When we asked to speak to the manager, Vicky came over and tried to joke about their hair being in our meal twice. This is not something to joke about. Situations involving food contamination should be handled seriously and professionally, and the response we received felt dismissive and disrespectful.

To make matters worse, the only resolution offered was half off the meal, when this situation should have been fully compensated. After finding hair in two separate dishes, we expected accountability and proper customer care, not a partial discount.

Our family has been coming here for over 8 years, which is what makes this even more disappointing. We supported this place for years and never expected such carelessness and poor handling of a serious issue. This experience was honestly shocking and has really changed how we view this restaurant.

My family and I had a bad experience today. We were a table of 10, one of us ordered a steak with egg, as we began to eat, she found a hair in her food. We told the waitress and they said they will give her a new meal, we were fine with it, we understand that these things happen.

When we received the new steak and eggs, we found two more pieces of hair. One long dark hair underneath the eggs and another short dark hair underneath the “new steak”. We called the manager Vicky, and stated what had happened and this was the second time this happened and now there was more hair than the first time.

She started laughing and said “everyone wears hairnets but you know stuff happens haha” . We did not appreciate the jokes, we didn’t find it funny. Apologizing would have been better. She said she would take care of it and gave us half off the steak. It’s not about the money, it’s the way she was joking about it. I found that to be very rude as if she was blaming us. After the meal, she said the half off was not her decision, someone higher up told her to do it. After looking at past reviews, this is not the first time. If anyone goes here, check your food throughly or else you’ll have a nice full mouth of curly dark hair .

Have been my go to place since last 5 years. I wouldn’t want to change anything about it, since the moment you walk in to the whole experience is just amazing. Never seen better customer service and how they go above and beyond for a customer, always ready to go an extra mile. Food is just out of this world, be it quantity and quality. Taste has been consistent throughout the years. The waitstaff is so helpful and knowledgeable about their and menu, absolutely adds more stars to the amazing place. Owner is the most down to earth person and always ready to listen and accommodate as per customers. I wish i could give it 10 stars, all my friends and family has same experience. must try 💯

I have been living in Brampton for 18 years but only discovered John's for the first time today. I had breakfast with two friends and we were all impressed by the quality, taste and presentation of the food, the excellent service and attention to detail. The price was also super affordable and the portions were the perfect size.
I had the French Connection with fruit on the side and asked to replace the sausages with bacon. The French toast was so good, I poured the syrup and fruits on top. My only complaint is that they didn't have real maple syrup, I was ready to pay extra for this option. Will definitely go back with the family, what a gem!!

name: Golden Cuts Barbershop
address: 3480 Platinum Dr Unit 95, Mississauga, ON L5M 2S4, Canada
reviews:
First time at Golden Cuts, I had a great experience. Everyone was very welcoming, the atmosphere was nice.

Moe did an amazing job with my haircut and beard. He’s really patient, pays attention to the little details, and actually listens to what you’re asking for. At the same time, he’ll give you suggestions based on his experience, which I really appreciated.

Definitely recommend Moe and Golden Cuts. I’ll be coming back for sure.

I got a haircut from Khlaid. The Cut and Wash. Very happy with the experience! This barbershop continues to provide me with great service and I plan returning to this barber for my next haircut. I came in for a trim and I got my hair styled the way I wanted- just what I needed before my upcoming event. Confident in a 4.0 Rating. His choice in music during the cut was a good bonus. so 4.5

Peter did a fantastic job with my fade haircut. He took his time, paid attention to every detail, and gave me an excellent haircut that exceeded my expectations. The staff was very welcoming and friendly, creating a great atmosphere from the moment I walked in. The level of professionalism was outstanding. I highly recommend Peter and the entire team to anyone looking for a quality haircut and great service.😎😎

After making the trip from Oakville to GoldenCuts Barbershop in Mississauga, I had the pleasure of getting my haircut by Sleiman, and I can confidently say he's the best barber I've encountered. He gave me a sharp, clean cut with remarkable speed and professionalism. On top of that, Mr. Sleiman is incredibly kind, welcoming, and hardworking.
I highly recommend GoldenCuts Barbershop, and especially Sleiman he’s a true master of the craft. Ask for him when you go; you won’t be disappointed! 💈✂️

It was my first time getting a haircut here and I had a great experience. Khalid did an excellent job and was clearly very skilled. He was patient and did not rush at all. Everyone was friendly and the shop was clean. I would definitely recommend this barber shop and Khalid to anyone. Overall amazing haircut and experience.

Peter is hands down the best barber in town. His attention to detail is unmatched, and every cut is precise and consistent. He takes his time to make sure everything is perfect, and you never feel rushed. If you’re looking for a barber who genuinely cares about the quality of his work, I can’t recommend Peter enough.

I’ve been getting my hair cut by Khalid, and every visit has been a great experience. He’s professional, friendly, and pays close attention to detail. He takes the time to understand exactly what I want and always delivers a clean, sharp cut. The service is excellent, and I always leave feeling confident with the result. I highly recommend Khalid to anyone looking for a skilled and reliable barber!

Khalid did an excellent job with my hair cut, took alot of care of me and was very professional and thorough! He also was good at chatting to make the experience more comfortable. Would definitely recommend his services

name: The Chase
address: 10 Temperance St, Toronto, ON M5H 1Y4, Canada
status: Fine dining destination with a terrace
reviews: We just hosted our wedding at the Chase and I cannot recommend it enough! They provided an upscale, classy and chic atmosphere which is exactly what we were after. The food was phenomenal and our guests won't stop talking about it!! They allowed us to customize our menu to accommodate items we love most (mango sticky rice, banh mi late night) and also gave plenty of vegan and veg options (for me + guests). The beverages were delicious, the staff were SO on it, we had fast service, quick turnaround at the bar (never a line in sight), they provided the perfect ceremony space, always made us feel heard, kept the bathrooms immaculate. I really don't have anything negative to say, their level of service and excellence puts other venues to shame. A huge shout out to Michaela, our amazing coordinator who made sure everything ran smoothly, all the waitstaff, Vlad the manager, the so kind (& fun) bartenders, the amazing chef and kitchen staff, the hostess - every single person played a big role in making our day a success and we are forever grateful. If you're debating hosting your wedding here, do it!! You won't have any regrets!

The food here is absolutely delicious—every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service was just as impressive; the staff were attentive, friendly, and made us feel genuinely welcomed. The atmosphere of the restaurant is warm and inviting, with a great balance of comfort and style. Overall, it’s a place I would definitely come back to and recommend to others.

A night worth chasing ♡
Perched high above Toronto’s Financial District in the historic Dineen Building, The Chase redefines upscale dining by effortlessly blending luxury with a cinematic atmosphere. From the moment you arrive, the elegant décor and glowing skyline views set the stage for an unforgettable night.

​What truly sets this rooftop gem apart is its ability to balance sophistication with genuine warmth; the service is impeccably polished yet entirely unpretentious.

The culinary execution matches the stunning visuals, delivering bold flavors across a menu of pristine seafood, prime steaks, and artisanal cocktails. As night falls, the breathtaking rooftop patio comes alive with soft lighting and a vibrant, exclusive energy.

Whether you are hosting a business dinner, celebrating a milestone, or planning the ultimate date night, The Chase doesn’t just serve a meal—it delivers an experience you’ll talk about long after the final course.

The food at The Chase is so fresh and delicious! I went Friday evening to celebrate a friend’s birthday and although I haven’t been in about 10 years, it was just as beautiful as I remembered. The Steak Tartare was prepared beautifully and the Petite Pearl was a sweet succulent treat! My only complaint would be the service was slow and our server kept leaving our table without asking if we needed anything else… but aside from that it was great.

I hadn't seen my friends in a long time, so during my visit to Toronto we decided to eat at The Chase. One of my friends made a reservation for the 4 of us and it turned out to be a great choice. The restaurant was warm and cozy and everyone who worked there was really nice. It wasn't very busy, which was nice, and we were lucky to have great seats with an amazing view of the city. The food and drinks were excellent. The shrimp cocktail was fantastic and our mains, including the steak and two pastas, were all really enjoyable. We spent a lot of time just chatting and catching up. For dessert we had ice cream which I absolutely loved. Overall it was a really pleasant experience and I would definitely come back.

We stepped down a narrow brick alley, guided by overhead lights into the quiet elegance of Chase the Frederick. The space is a beautiful study in light and shadow, rich with textured brick and an inviting atmosphere. Though we only stopped for a brief pause, the staff welcomed us with genuine warmth. They seated us in a booth beneath a striking illuminated framework of books and vintage records, letting us sip our dark coffee under the watchful eyes of musical legends. At their kind suggestion, we shared the Sundae pie, which was an absolute delight. It is rare to find a place that treats a modest visit with such grace, turning a simple afternoon treat into a lingering and beautiful memory.

Had a great experience here. The atmosphere is elegant with beautiful views, making it a great spot for a business lunch or special occasion. The food was fresh and well prepared—we especially enjoyed the salmon, which was perfectly cooked and full of flavour. Service was attentive throughout the meal, and there are plenty of vegetarian options as well. Looking forward to coming back and trying more of the menu.

Attended Winterlicious and really enjoyed it.  Rest assured that if you pick the outdoor seating option, the terrace is enclosed and really warm with overhead heaters. Great service too! Out of the entrees, I would suggest the pasta. I was happy to visit and would like to return again during regular times.

name: Garde Manger
address: 408 R. Saint-François-Xavier, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 2S9, Canada
reviews: Exceptional dinner at Garde Manger! The service was warm and personal, and the music and atmosphere were lively but comfortable. There are 4 choices of chef’s menus based on number of courses and premium ingredients, and we chose the smaller premium menu which was $165, adapted for a pescatarian. All of the courses were shared plates and it was a huge amount of food. First was a chilled seafood platter with oysters, lobster, shrimp, mussels, sturgeon pâté, and smoked char rillete. Then we had 3 appetizers, including the signature snow crab on brioche. Two seasonal mains included halibut with morels and scallops with peas, accompanied by roasted carrots with stracciatella (could have been a vegetarian main). We finished with 2 desserts. Everything was amazing!

Solid seafood, but a fairly disappointing Chef du Menu.

Came in on a Monday night for the Chef du Menu. They don’t list the dishes upfront, but given the restaurant's focus, I naturally expected a heavy lean toward seafood. But not exactly. This wasn’t a traditional tasting menu, but rather a standard array of small plates you’d find at any generic New American spot. Barely any creative inspiration, no unique ingredients, and honestly, surprisingly little seafood.

It did start strong with a massive seafood tower. Snow crab, lobster, mussels, oysters, and sturgeon dip. My favorite part was honestly just the local oysters. Sweeter and less briny than the typical New England or Maine oysters I'm used to.

The rest of the evening fell off a cliff a bit. Not a single memorable dish. All I can really remember is a blur of creative-looking, over-engineered vegetable plates.

Overall, a tad overpriced for what you get. Rolling the dice on the Chef du Menu was probably the wrong call. I've hit a lot of tasting menus across Montreal, and this was the only miss. No idea what the kitchen is aiming for with this format, but if you go, absolutely stick to the à la carte menu.

One of the most memorable seafood meals I've ever had. You know a restaurant is amazing when they can make a carrot so flavourful and interesting you savour it as slowly and carefully as every other bite. Our server was fabulous and brought us perfect wine pairings for our courses. The cheerful person bussing our table was delighted to see that I had scraped up all the horseradish on my cocktail sauce which she proudly shared she had prepared for the prawns, which in itself was amazing--super thick, rich and tomatoey. It was a pleasure seeing staff taking pride in even the little details. Presentation for every dish was beautiful! I loved the clams on rocks! Every bite of each course had so much flavour, I had to lick the plate when no one was looking. We had the lowest tier chef's tasting menu, which included a seafood platter, clams, tuna, beets 4 ways, swordfish, turbot, the carrots, and two kinds of desserts. I only wish I lived here, I could come back on the regular! Thank you for a spectacular meal!
I only gave 4 stars for ambiance because it was maybe not my favourite choice of music playing a little too loudly in the background, though I guess it was probably the vibe they were going for.

Stopped by for a weeknight dinner and grabbed a seat at the bar, which turned out to be perfect for shooting the open kitchen without getting in anyone's way. The bone marrow was the highlight of the night, rich and smoky and clearly the dish most people at nearby tables were ordering too. Service was relaxed but attentive, and the bartender took the time to explain a few things on the menu without ever feeling rushed. Exposed brick and low lighting made for a great atmosphere, even if it meant bumping my ISO up a bit to get decent shots.

Highly recommend Menu Du Chef. An amazing 7 course and dessert dining experience. The seafood preparation was incredible, with every course a delight! The wine pairing married so well. It is a seafood focused restaurant but the hanger steak... also perfection. Truly an unforgettable meal! Very much appreciated the service staff -an equally huge part of this review. Thank you!

My favorite cocktail and seafood place in Montreal, maybe the eastern seaboard. Don't skip your vegetables, as their sides are as great as their mains. The service is the most attentive I've had in a while, but never oppressive... perfect meal all around.

Have been waiting to go to this restaurant for over 15 years since I started watching Chucks Day Off (Chuck, will you marry me 😉?). It has been a bucket list goal for so many years and man it did not disappoint. The service was impeccable. Staff were friendly, knowledgeable, and kept us engaged and entertained throughout our meal. We decided to go with the tasting menu and they went above and beyond to make sure we got everything we could want. The food was exceptional and definitely one of the best meals I have ever had. The vibes were on point and after the food service ended the music was turned up and everyone was dancing and having a great time. I cannot recommend Garde Manger enough. 100 stars out of 10. We will be back every time we visit Montreal.
What a fantastic dining experience! The staff were amazing and very attentive. The food was so amazing and we really liked all the options we received from the Chef's menu option.

name: Sukoon Ghar
address: 6131 Mayfield Rd Unit 41, Brampton, ON L6P 4R9, Canada
reviews: Tucked away in a busy plaza in Brampton, a serene little cafe……Sukoon Ghar. As the name suggests A house of peace. This magical little place actually brings you peace and calm. Tastefully decorated and cozy furnishings add to the whole vibe of the place.The menu is not huge but it has all the perfect pairings to tease your palate. The owner and amazing host Yukti made sure to tailor the food according to our restrictions. The Spanish Latte was delicious and the Mango Matcha drink absolutely yummy. I highly recommend the Mozzarella cheese sticks for a savoury treat. The cafe is definitely worth a visit and I cant wait to go back again.

True to its name, Sukoon Ghar offers absolute peace and great vibes! The coffee was top-notch, the presentation was beautiful, and the atmosphere was super cozy. Easily one of the best spots around Caledon and Brampton to relax or catch up with friends. Highly recommended!

Sukoon Ghar is really a place where sukoon and taste meets. It’s such a serene and calm space with beautiful lighting and comfortable sitting.

I went with my friend and we spent around $25 on a Pistachio Crossiant, Mango Macha, and Tiramisu Iced Latte. Loved all three but my favourite was croissant and iced latte. If you’re a mango or matcha fan and want something refreshing and not too strong taste you’ll probably like the Mango Matcha.

Loved loved the staff. They all were very nice! 🌸

We had such a wonderful experience at Sakoon Ghar Cafe! We actually drove all the way from Kitchener just to visit, and it was absolutely worth it.

A special shoutout to Sneha, Tanveer, and Mehak — they made our visit truly memorable. Their service was warm, attentive, and genuinely caring. They didn’t just serve us food, they made sure we felt welcomed and comfortable throughout.

The vibe of the place is beautiful, the food is amazing, and the hospitality is top-notch. You can really tell the team puts heart into what they do.

Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and even better service. Will definitely be coming back again!

Absolutely loved this cafe .The ambience is warm, cozy and beautifully designed perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. The food was fresh and delicious, and the coffee was smooth, rich, and perfectly made. Such a great vibe overall, definitely coming back

Sukoon Ghar in Brampton is such a gem of a café! The atmosphere is incredibly cozy and peaceful—perfect for relaxing, catching up with friends, or just enjoying some quiet time.

The food and drinks were amazing—everything tasted fresh and made with care. You can really tell they put effort into quality. The staff were also super friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better.

Overall, everything about this place was great. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a chill and beautiful café spot!

Absolutely loved my experience at Sukoon Ghr Cafe. The food was fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. The creamy pasta paired with the garlic bread was amazing, and the drinks were just as good. The cafe has such a cozy, peaceful vibe—perfect for relaxing and spending quality time. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and provided excellent service. I’ll definitely be coming back and would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for great food and a comforting atmosphere!

Had a wonderful time at this café with my family. The beverages and coffee were really good, and the atmosphere was warm, relaxing, and inviting. The café truly lives up to its name—it gives you that feeling of sukoon (peace and comfort) while spending quality time with loved ones. A perfect place to unwind and enjoy great drinks. Highly recommended! ☕❤️😊

name: Restaurant Bonaparte
address: 447 R. Saint-François-Xavier, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 2T1, Canada
status: Fine French fare with pre-theatre menus
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, Diners Club, Discover, MasterCard, VISA
reviews:
We stayed at the Hotel Bonaparte and decided to dine in for dinner downstairs.

We ordered off the menu a la carté instead of doing the tasting, which also seemed delicious.

Started off with the soup of the day which was a celery and leek soup that they served to us in 2 plates as we were sharing.

For apps we ordered the homemade smoked salmon and the mushroom ravioli, both were so tasty. I'm a bit biased for any dish that has mushrooms and salmon haha.

For mains we shared the scallop delight and one of the specials, which was a hanger steak. You can never go wrong with a buttery scallop and grilled veggies. The steak in it's jus was 👌👌.

For dessert we ordered the chocolate soufflé, which takes about 20mins to prepare. The servers and manager were so accommodating of our baby and even offered to bring us our dessert while we went upstairs to feed our baby. We ended up coming back down and finishing up the soufflé there but it was a nice offer from them.

Ended off the night not being overly full, which is always a great feeling!

10/10 from the staff and kitchen!

10/10 for hospitality

Would come back for the hotel and the restaurant!

We went here at the recommend of our friendly. We opted for the tasting.

The best dishes that we would order again were mushroom ravioli and duck breast.  Everything else was quite disappointing.  Lobster bisque.  Lobster vanilla. Foie gras. Etc.  overall the dishes were slightly under seasoned and under flavored.  lacked the richness and nuance of French cuisine.   Overall food was three stars.

The quantity of food was adequate.  If you are a normal size male then you probably won’t come out full.  Though they serve the same dishes from their à la carte menu the portions are quite a bit smaller.   The number of course doesn’t make up for the portion size.  So just heads up.

Service was attentive and friendly. Definitely five stars there.

Amazing restaurant in the heart of old Montreal. We loved the food, the cocktails were great and we couldn't have asked for a better table. Top this off with literally perfect service and you have one of the best restaurants we have ever been to. We went two nights on a three night visit to Montreal. We will definitely be back. The Grand Marnier Souffle was the icing on the cake. Absolutely amazing.

Wonderful experience catered by a professional staff, the menu although being very stable, has had a rework in how the plates are served. Some great discoveries with their new dishes, overall eating at this restaurant is a very pleasant experience. The setting is a quaint dining room in old Montreal, white aesthetics and quiet.

Attention to detail is unique and precise, if you want to treat yourself and your loved ones I recommend the restaurant Bonaparte! In the area you will find the old port of Montreal, a theatre, group activities, on top of being great, it has amazing things around it
It was a wonderful experience! We ordered the course menu, and every single dish was delicious. The entire staff was friendly and attentive, and we had a fantastic time.

Restaurant Bonaparte is nice but unremarkable—nothing I ate was offensive, but nothing really impressed me.

Cocktail options are fun, and the cream of mushroom soup was very good.  The plating on the entrees seemed a little tacky and unrefined.  The lamb was well cooked and had good texture, though lacked flavor to me, and the chicken with brie similarly tasted like… chicken and brie, and nothing else.  The duck was pretty good though in a very sweet sauce.

The desserts were standard, the chocolate mousse was a little disappointing as it didnt taste like they used real chocolate in it as opposed to powder, and was simply piped into a bowl.

The interior ambiance is very nice, and the service was good.  While I think the food here is good, I believe there are better options around both for flavor and presentation of dishes
Wonderful experience. Juliette provided such warm and informative service and made this meal even more special. The food was delicious and the ambiance was perfect. Merci beaucoup.

We highly recommend duck confit, lamb shank, catch of the day (walleye) and rabbit confit. The terrine and wine was not super impressive but was still good. Service was good and they treated us very well for my birthday. This was the second visit for one of us.

name: Aux Merveilleux de Fred
address: 224 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1Z6, Canada
reviews:
Super delicious sweets! Everything we tried was fresh, light, and really enjoyable. The puffs were definitely my favourite, they were so light, airy, and perfectly balanced without being overly sweet. I really appreciate when desserts aren’t loaded with sugar, and these had just the right amount of sweetness.
The chocolate chip brioche bun was also really good. It was soft, light, and had a nice chocolate chip flavour without feeling too heavy. Overall, everything was delicious and well made. Definitely a great spot if you’re looking for sweets that are light, fresh, and not overly sweet!

Last evening we were looking for a quick savoury snack to have before our 7pm event nearby. And we stumbled upon this lovely patisserie! The beautiful huge chandelier was so recognizable that I knew immediately it was the same place I went for freshly baked brioches every morning when I was visiting Brussels.

We had the salmon sandwich and the chicken curry sandwich. Considering we were getting them at around 6:30pm, almost around closing time, these sandwiches still tasted fresh and very delicious! I had the housemade hot chocolate and it was the perfect indulgent sweet treat.

The two female staff working there were very friendly, warm and patient so made our experience even better while we were eating there.

Since we had to rush to our event we had to buy the brioches to go. We got the pearl sugar brioche and the chocolate chip brioche. Both were my absolute favourites from the Aux Merveilleux de Fred in Brussels. I have to say even warming them up this morning in my mini oven for breakfast, they did not disappoint at all! They were equally scrumptious, and I'm so thrilled to know there is a location now in Toronto that I can go when I have a craving for these brioches!! 😁

Definitely check out this wonderful patisserie & café when you're in this area! 👍😊

Aux Merveilleux de Fred is one of my favorite bakeries and the perfect place for a coffee break.
I usually order a coffee with a small savory snack, and my favorite one is the smoked salmon and fresh cucumber sandwich. It’s always fresh and delicious!
When it comes to desserts, my absolute favorite is the chocolate meringue. It’s incredibly light, creamy, and perfectly balanced, making it a truly amazing treat.

The space is absolutely beautiful. Stepping into Aux Merveilleux de Fred feels warm, elegant. A charming European bakery shop.

The service is friendly and fast-paced, with staff who are efficient, welcoming, and clearly experienced at keeping things running smoothly, even during busy moments.

I ordered the raisin cramique brioche, chocolate cramique brioche, and the meringue from Aux Merveilleux de Fred, and every bite was pure comfort.

I ordered the raisin cramique brioche was soft, buttery, and generously studded with plump raisins, perfectly fluffy with just the right touch of sweetness. The chocolate cramique was just as indulgent, rich with chocolate pieces that melted into the pillowy brioche without being overpowering. And the meringue? Light as air, creamy, and delicately sweet, it truly melts in your mouth.

A place worth returning to again and again.

We had coffee here and it was ok. Though I had high expectations but it wasnt very unique as coffee overpowered the flavour I asked for so it felt like a normal latte. But I have heard good things about their sweet items so will try it next time. But its location is really nice and you wouldnt feel much gloomy in the Canadian winter.
