name: Twilight Cafe & Bar DT (Dundas)
address: 252 Victoria St, Toronto, ON M5B 1V8, Canada
reviews:
Had the twilight platter and chiken katsu bowl.

Some of the fries on the platter seemed a bit wilted as opposed to being crispy. The ret of the wings and sides were brilliant.

Rhe chicken katsu was rich and flavorful although I'd have loved a bit more curry on it as it felt a bit dry in the end. A non issue really since some people like it dry.

Overall a great atmosphere, lots of noise from people having a good time, great place to be with friends with the added bonus of the place being open late.

We were planning on going to a different location but since they were busy, we decided to go to this location instead. Luckily, it wasn’t too far and they had a lot of available seats. They did get busy towards the end so we were asked to switch to a smaller table to accommodate for a bigger group that walked in.

They had different selections of board games and their food was delicious. Their drink selection was also diverse. I love that they also serve cocktails which sets them apart from the other board game places I’ve been to.

I had the smoked salmon salad which I thoroughly enjoyed. The salad was fresh and the smoked salmon paired well with their roasted sesame dressing. The salad portion was not the biggest which reflects the price so I suggest ordering their burger with fries if you’re hungry.

Their sea salt rose matcha latte was good. The matcha was not as earthy as I would’ve liked but I did like the hints of the sea salt and the rose.

I had such a great experience here! Roshan truly made our visit special. He was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and went out of his way to suggest drinks for us and honestly, his recommendations were amazing. We loved everything we tried!

You can tell he genuinely cares about giving customers a good experience, which made the whole vibe even better. Big shoutout as well to Nima, Cho, and Jowana for being kind and helpful throughout.

Overall, such a warm and positive atmosphere. I’ll definitely be coming back again!

Great atmosphere for a fun outing. Great location - reserve before you go. A variety of food desserts and drinks to choose from . Pasta was delicious!!! You can also reserve a private space. Extremely clean . Lots of game selection and clean !! I always  feel so taken care of with the call button .

Amazing place to hang out woth friends. Lot of board games available to kill the board time. Amazing and superb customer service with nice music playing in the background. The food was amazing and tasty and the atmosphere was energetic as well from other tables.

reviews:
I had an important graduation ceremony the next day and needed a haircut on short notice. I was able to book a late 6:30 PM appointment quickly at Khalil Barbershop, which was a huge relief.
A special thank you to Nidal for the excellent service. It was my first visit, but he immediately understood the look I wanted and gave me a clean taper fade along with a much-needed beard trim. His attention to detail, professionalism, and skill left me looking sharp and confident for graduation.
I was also impressed by the shop's customer service and staffing. Even close to closing time, there were multiple barbers available, making it easy to get an appointment without a long wait. The atmosphere was welcoming and professional throughout my visit.
I highly recommend Nidal and the team at Khalil Barbershop. I'll definitely be returning

This was by far my favorite experience at a barber shop. I saw Nidal and he was wonderful. He was very patient with me and listened to exactly what I wanted. He gave me a complete transformation and I was very impressed with his attention to detail. There is a reason he has the nickname Picasso he makes art! As for the shop itself its a very warm upbeat atmosphere with very friendly staff and a nice look and vibe to the place. If youre looking for a haircut as a man this is the spot you should go to 10 out of 10 highly recommend!  Look at the change he did for me! Let the guys there take care of you!

I’ve been coming to Khalil Barbershop for a while now, and every visit has been a great experience. The shop is always clean, welcoming, and has a friendly atmosphere.

A special thank you to Sam, who has been cutting my hair! He’s professional, pays attention to the details, and always takes the time to make sure everything is just right. I never feel rushed, and I always leave happy with the result.

Everyone here is friendly and makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. I highly recommend Khalil Barbershop to anyone looking for a quality haircut and excellent customer service. Thanks again, Sam—I really appreciate your great work!

Great barber shop! Friendly staff, great atmosphere, and an excellent haircut by Adam every time. They take their time, pay attention to the details, and make sure you leave looking your best. Highly recommend!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Absolutely outstanding experience at Khalil Barbershop. Ahmed Ahmed Ahmed is beyond incredible, his attention to detail, precision, and professionalism are on another level. You can tell he truly cares about his craft and makes sure you leave looking your absolute best.

The entire team is just as impressive. Sam, Ahmad, and Nidal are all incredibly talented, welcoming, and professional. The atmosphere is great, the service is top-notch, and the quality is consistently excellent.

Hands down the best barbershop experiences I’ve ever had. Highly recommended! #1

Nidal is an exceptional Barber.

I just had the best barber and hairstyle experience of my life.

I’ve been fortunate enough to have spent time all over the world, especially Asia and more specifically the Middle East where being a barber is still a very serious profession and craft. My best barber experiences were in Lebanon and Baghdad some years ago…until today.

Right from entering I was warmly and professionally greeted. I decided to take up an offered espresso (normally I wouldn’t b/c I am a coffee snob). It was a high quality coffee and I came to realize that everything in this Barber Shop is aimed towards becoming the highest quality experience possible.

Nidal was my Barber. I am almost hesitant to ‘share’ him as he literally gave me the best haircut and Barber experience my life.

As I stated…I’ve spent a lot of time in Iraq, Lebanon and Turkey where being a professional Barber is an extremely serious and respected métier.

Nidal is an artist. How he was not booked solid for the next 6 months is beyond me. He is exceptional. The entire Barbershop is exceptional.

%100 worthwhile experience. Make Khalil your ‘go-to’ Barbershop

Thank you Nidal !

Nidal is the best barber/hairstylist I've ever been to in my [redacted] years living in several cities. He's friendly and incredibly talented.

Everyone else at Khalil seems great too. And it's a lovely, inviting atmosphere.

If you’re looking for the perfect mid fade, look no further than Nidal. I’m usually pretty picky, but the blend he gave me is absolutely buttery—completely seamless with no harsh lines.
He didn't just stop at the fade, though. He took the time to texture the top exactly how I wanted it and lined up my beard with surgical precision. It’s rare to find a barber who has that level of 'eye' for both the clippers and the shears. The shop has a great vibe, and Nidal is a true professional who clearly takes pride in his work. I left the chair feeling like a new man. 10/10—highly recommended!

reviews:
I had a wonderful experience at Croissant Café 🥐. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, making it the perfect spot to relax or catch up with friends. Their croissants are absolutely delicious—fresh, flaky, and clearly made with care. You can really taste the quality in every bite.

The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the service was quick without feeling rushed. I also loved the variety on the menu, with plenty of options to pair with a great coffee.

If you’re looking for a cozy café with amazing pastries, Croissant Café is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for sure!

Visiting from Toronto. The Coconut Chia Pudding is out of this world good. Flat White with oat milk is 10/10. Also got the chocolate-almond croissant, looks great, best-seller, but haven’t tried it yet. Cool little spot in an industrial area of Montreal, recommended.
Amazing food and coffee - pastries were fluffy and fresh. Cafe staff super friendly and helpful. Beautiful space with high ceilings.

I was really looking forward to visiting after seeing so many positive reviews, but unfortunately the experience was disappointing.

The service was slow from the start. We specifically asked if our croissants could be warmed, but they came back burnt instead. The avocado toast was also underwhelming—the bread was cold, the avocado was cold, and it felt like very little care had gone into preparing it. My flat white had an unusual taste and wasn’t what I’d expect from a bakery and café with such a strong reputation.

To add to the experience, we asked to dine in but were still served our drinks in disposable to-go cups, which made the experience feel impersonal, especially given the premium prices.

I don’t mind paying higher prices when the quality and service justify them, but in this case neither did. There seems to be a disconnect between the reputation and the execution.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously. Small improvements—paying closer attention to food preparation, serving customers as requested, improving quality control on drinks, and being more attentive to the overall customer experience—could make a significant difference. I genuinely hope my visit was an exception, because the café has the potential to be much better.

We went here a few days ago and we liked their pastry and breads. I can say we liked it and not loved it as I’ve had better ones before so I give it 4 stars. The sandwich was delicious and I saw them cutting good provolone cheese at the kitchen, so i would say the material quality was good too. I would be happier if the sandwich was cheaper.
My wife got a creme pistachio pastry she loved.
I also got a olive and tomato bread that was awful! 😖

The entire experience was wonderful, and I highly recommend this salon if you're looking for a stylist who takes the time to understand your vision,  knowledgeable, honest, and truly cares about both the final result and the health of your hair. Thank you so much!

reviews:
SO RICH IN FLAVOUR!!!
I love love love the pasta. Thought it would be watered down, but it is the MOST RICH in flavour pasta i’ve ever tasted! Servers were very nice and helpful, atmosphere felt amazing, and highly recommend if you’re going to watch a show at the rose theatre after eating here. Why? Well, because it is really a short walk from the restaurant to the theatre! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

Let’s align over some wine. 🍷
Yesterday, for an impromptu visit with my mom we decided to pop in to this wine-bar located downtown Brampton. Service was impeccable ,location rustically beautiful.We shared a bottle of local wine (reisling from Niagara),snacked on some truffle fries & ended with a sweet treat:gelato.We’ll be back to try the dinner menu items in the near future. 🍽️🍨🇮🇹🍇☕️

I have tried to stay loyal to this restaurant but I have given up. From how they great
You at the front door to slow service and no consideration on where you sit. Appetizers came out late. Terrible Father’s Day experience. Never going again.

Visited for valentine’s day. The staff were welcoming and friendly despite being super busy. Food was yummy, ordered fried calamari, truffle fries, chicken parm, and cannelloni. Parking was a bit tricky as there weren’t too many parking spots nearby so had to wait a bit for a free spot.

Went here for a work training a couple weekends ago and the food here was absolutely mouthwatering! The portions are so huge, I was full by the second course. The servers were super friendly, kind, and caring. They even explained any questions we had with the menu. The restaurant looked really pretty inside and home style/ cozy. Would definitely come here again one day!

Were there for an impromptu lunch on a Thursday. Had the goat cheese topped salad- it was delicious! Our host/server was so pleasant and helpful. The atmosphere was not the greatest - no fault of the restaurant - it just happens to be a construction zone outside at the moment. If you are in downtown Brampton this is definitely a great spot to stop for a bite.

We walked in just because we were so tired looking for a good place to eat in the neighborhood, we were not even dressed nice and asked to look at the menu before sitting down to see the prices. But the staff there DID NOT discriminate us! They have the best customer service and most of all served us really well despite knowing we won’t order expensive food. The hostess was even kind enough to split the single pasta order for us even if we did not ask her. She was super nice! I will definitely come back with my husband for their delicious italian dishes! One of the best restaurants that I would recommend repeatedly!

We enjoyed our first visit to Fanzorelli's to celebrate my birthday and Valentines Day.

Although the ambiance was lovely, I would've loved if we were seated closer to the back of the restaurant. We sat close to the front, and with the cold breeze from -10 weather outside, I had to bundle up with my scarf the entire evening.

Our waitress was amazing. Our drinks and appetizers were served promptly. However, there was a long wait time for our entrée.

I thoroughly enjoyed every bite of my appetizers, main course, and dessert. We had a great evening overall, and we'll likely go back.

reviews: Amazing experience! Arshad was incredibly friendly and helpful, and his recommendation and knowledge was unmatched. Really genuine people running a great business I would definitely go back to purchase more Islamic gifts and books.

Marhaba Bookstore is hands down the best place to go! The owner is a truly noble and incredibly generous soul. I stopped by looking for a Quran, and since it was the holy month of Ramadan, he went out of his way to gift it to me for free, seeking nothing but the reward from the Almighty. This kind of selfless hospitality is so rare to find these days. I highly recommend everyone support this amazing shop, the energy and the service are absolutely top-tier!

I had such a beautiful experience at this store. I’m a recent revert and came in looking for a gift for a friend who has been helping me on my journey. The owner was incredibly kind , welcoming, and generous  he truly went above and beyond. He helped me find meaningful gifts and even gifted me a prayer mat, a scarf, and a book for myself. You can really feel the sincerity and care here. I’m so grateful and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend !

I recently visited an Islamic store and had a wonderful experience. They had an excellent collection of kids’ Islamic books, AHadith books, and many other educational materials. The books were beautifully designed, easy to understand, and perfect for children to learn about Islam in an engaging way.
The store environment was very welcoming, and the variety of authentic Islamic literature was impressive. I highly recommend this store to anyone looking for quality Islamic books for kids and families.

Mashallah the book variety and selection very nice. I liked the fact that the prices were amazing.

Unfortunately, my only complaint is that the Pakistani uncle, he always acting like he doesn’t care and he doesn’t respect us. He is always just sitting on his phone, and makes it seem like we are an inconvenience for him.

The service was very disappointing. The owner was completely occupied with his phone and didn’t make any effort to assist. I recently came by and bought a book from here - the guy at the counter helped me pick the item out. He was super helpful and nice! I appreciated his help. My kids love the books i got them as presents 😂
Really good owner. Gave me a Miswak free of charge with my purchase even though I came in the shop to buy a Miswak. Great place, great shop.

We chose the lemon raspberry flavour, and it was delicious — light, flavourful, and perfectly moist.  It was just as wonderful on the inside as it was on the outside. I ordered my bridal shower cake from Irene and I was positively blown away. The cake was aesthetically well done and beautiful. Picture taken by Helen Christou Photography.

We ordered our wedding sfoglia cake from Irene's Celebrity Cakes, and it was absolutely incredible! From the very beginning, Irene was friendly, helpful, and professional. address: 204 R. Notre Dame O Ste 100, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 1T3, Canada
reviews: Took a trip to Montreal and decided to get a balayage during my visit. The salon was near my hotel, so I popped in around 6pm with low hopes of getting a last-minute appointment. Ionela did a quick consultation with me and had me seated right away. Ionela listened to me when I described what I wanted done, and did exactly that. She was thorough and extremely sweet during my entire visit. If I lived here, I would come to this salon regularly. This is the first time a stylist did exactly what I envisioned. I could not recommend this salon and Ionela enough.

Good professionals overall. If I were to suggest one improvement, it would be to focus on one client at a time rather than working on multiple clients simultaneously. The pricing is also a bit on the higher side. That said, they’re great at taking on challenges and are willing to fine-tune the color to your liking. The environment is friendly, the staff are kind, and Corina is a great business owner. I’m happy with my new hair

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Corina was absolutely wonderful! We were visiting Montreal to celebrate my friend’s 50th birthday and needed a last-minute blowout before our evening plans. She was able to fit us in, and from start to finish, the experience was fantastic.

My blowout turned out beautifully, and Corina’s attention to detail was incredible. She even took the time to do some touch-ups afterward to make sure everything was perfect. Not only is she talented, but she’s also warm, professional, and genuinely cares about her clients leaving happy.

Thank you, Corina, for helping us look and feel our best for such a special celebration. If you’re looking for a stylist in Montreal, I highly recommend booking with her!

I had an amazing experience at En Vouge. Gökay did a fantastic job with my haircut — precise, stylish, and exactly what I wanted. Yonela curled my hair beautifully, giving it the perfect finish. The entire salon staff was welcoming, kind, and attentive from start to end. I left feeling super happy and confident. Highly recommend this salon for anyone looking for great service and talented stylists.

Mixed feelings! But for sure I won't go back there for my hair color.
For I take full responsibility of my hair "fault" 😅

Although I have been to this Salon couple of times for different services: hair cut, blow drying, hair botox and balayage! Yes they have a Great Team but for hair color it's quite disappointing.

Even though I would start by showing the picture of the balayage/color I want! ( and those I don't want) I end up with a complet different result.

Last December, I went there to do a balayage. The result was literally choking: blond looking like white gray hair in the front and darker at the ends more then at the racine!

The day after, I warped  my hair the whole day and went back to the salon directly afterwork!

Corina helped to fix the color and I was happy with the result at the end! Also she did not charge me for the correction.

It took couple of weeks to restore my hair healthy look for as much as it was treated.

Today I went there for a simple gloss! I also ended up with a darker and more dull hair color 🫤

Her explanation was that my color originally was poorly made! And it's my hair "fault".

So when the result is good that's fine! And when it's not good it's the hair fault 😅

It would have been much easier from the begging, to be clear and accept or NOT to proceed with the desired color.
Not say " We will try" and end up with a random (if not choking) result.

=>Their work is pretty good! But not consistent!

Make sure to be Clear and Precise about the color/balayage you want from the beginning and to Confirm that with their team.

name: Tomah
address: 242 King St W, Hamilton, ON L8P 1A9, Canada
reviews:
Very good authentic Syrian food. My friend who was raised near the Syrian border nearly cried after eating the real authentic Syrian food here, after not having any since she was 8 years old. Everything here is handmade, and it is delicious.

The atmosphere is wonderful, and makes you feel nice and cozy.

I had the Turkmani cheese chicken shawarma with fries and it was very, very good. The labneh was wonderful -- it's what made my friend nostalgic, after she's been searching for it ever since she moved to Canada.

The service is lovely, and the workers are very friendly. We also got free kunafa afterwards.

Overall, I could see myself coming back here every time I visit Hamilton. Very wonderful place, one of my favourite restaurants!

Excellent Syrian food and great atmosphere!
We had a wonderful experience at Tomah. The food was incredibly fresh and full of authentic flavor.
• Hummus: Beautifully presented with pomegranate seeds and olive oil—very creamy and delicious.
• Warak Enab (Grape Leaves): Perfectly cooked and served with a tasty dipping sauce.
• Chicken Shawarma: The wrap was toasted perfectly and came with a generous side of fries, salad, and their amazing garlic sauce.
• Atmosphere: The restaurant has a lovely vibe with beautiful patterned tablecloths that make the dining experience feel very traditional and welcoming.
Highly recommend if you are looking for authentic Middle Eastern cuisine in Hamilton!

Don’t forget to drink their Tea 👍👍👍

Updated review: I've eaten here several times now and the quality remains consistent. It is one of my favourite restaurants. I keep adding new food photos to help support a great place. :)

Original review: I felt like I was a guest in someone's home. It reminded me of what dining out could be. The server was caring, helpful, and present. I didn't feel like an inconvenience. We were given lots of space and time to relax after we were done.

Lovely little local place for shawarma which is what I had - the chicken shawarma with salad. 🥗 very tasty and warm and I enjoyed the warm, sweet refreshing complimentary tea as well. ☕️ Come for a date, on your own or with friends!

Fantastic spot for authentic Syrian food. Brought my mother here after going a few times and she said it was like eating back home. She only had good things to say (a rare feat).

We got the kibbeh, falafel, labneh, and hummas to start. The kibbeh was fantastic; crispy outside and moist inside with bits of beef, onion, and pomegranate. The pom added a little burst of sweetness that helps to cut through the richness of the meat. Falafels were very cute shaped like hearts and had a really good texture to them. Labneh tasted fresh and tangy with a generous amount of black sesame and olive oil. Hummus was very smooth and silky; a perfect compliment to the fried falafels and kibbeh.
We shares a shawarma with fries entree. The toum garlic sauce was perfect, I liked that it was so overbearingly garlicy but still zippy enough to add plenty of flavour. The shawarma was lovely and the chicken was juicy. They barbecue their chicken which retains a lot of moisture. My only gripe was the side salad in the entree was slightly underdressed, but alas, everything else was fantastic.

The service is very friendly. Family owned spot and you can tell they care about their product and the community they serve. Not overbearing and responsive when requested.

The atmosphere is cute. It feels like a restaurant back in Syria with decor and design sourced from there.

I highly recommend Tomah for anybody looking to try an authentic Syrian take of some middle eastern classics.

name: Byward Café
address: 55 Byward Market Square, Ottawa, ON K1N 9C3, Canada
reviews:
The breakfast croissants were dry and seemed old, good thing we asked for extra mayo to add in. The bagel sandwich was decent as well. Their presentation pictures on the board were all clearly AI, not representative of the real deal.
The atmosphere was cute, a little Cafe, clearly visited by locals, plus it opens much earlier than any other place around the market, so it's perfect for a quick breakfast.

Coffee was really good and up to the mark. I tried the quinoa salad and really liked it—fresh and tasty. The vegetarian sandwich was a bit dry and slightly salty for me, but overall the place is still great.

I frequent this spot for the beautiful morning sunshine and nice patio!  The staff are always positive and friendly, coffee is very good and so is the food! My go to spot on during a morning bike ride!

Best place to visit!!! The staff is all family and they are very very kind. I was having a really bad day and the staff cheered me up. The food is also really good, multiple healthy options for reasonable prices. All of them are so fresh even the pastries, I wanted to buy everything! I reccomend the chocolate croissants and the pesto pasta

Staff is very nice but the food is very sad. I ordered what was labelled as Chicken Caesar wrap on their menu. 9.50$

And this is what you get. Photo is half of it. They serve it in a panini which you know it's fine, I don't mind. Where is the caesar part of it, though? No lettuce/salad, no dressing/sauce that I can actually taste. The chicken is dry and you can tell it was refrigerated for a while before being put on the panini grill to warm up. The inside was still cold when I opened it. The bacon doesn't taste anything which is kind of impressive considering the flavor profile of bacon in general.

For the price I would have hoped my sandwich would at least taste better and feel a bit fresher. 15$ for a small hot chocolate and this sandwich is too expensive. Byward is known for its touristic pricings and as a local it is clear I am not the target audience.

I hope they improve their sandwiches. Staff is very nice and they're not far from success if they make it better!

Omar is an amazing barber — very professional, friendly, and detail-oriented. He takes his time to make sure everything looks perfect, and the results are always clean and sharp. Barbers were amazing, especially my boy S A, haircuts were definitely the best in Ottawa. Environment was relaxing and very welcoming. 100% a 10/10

An incredible experience with Omar! He delivered excellent customer service and created a fantastic environment and experience. One of, if not the best haircut I have ever gotten. Will absolutely be coming back!
I came in to have my hair cut and wasn’t expecting anything special. They fixed my hair and also gave me some pointers on style. Amazing staff great atmosphere. Very friends and knowledgable staff

I found this gem of a barbershop by searching on old school barbers with great reviews, and I'm so glad I checked them out. The shop itself has a great vibe. The music is good. The tech is good. The waiting area is good. But best of all, the staff are fantastic. They're down to earth. You can have easy conversations with them. And they're fast and efficient. I lucked into getting my hair done by Omar and I now go back to him everytime. He's a master at his craft. Plus, what I really appreciate, is that he takes direction well but gives guidance and recommendations proactively. Because of him I've found some great hair product to replace my old product that was no longer manufactured. With all of that said, the ultimate test of their skills and services is "the wife test". My wife doesn't hesitate to tell me when the hair cut wasn't done well but she is consistently impressed with the job Omar does. name: Edessa hair salon and spa
address: 4100 Living Arts Dr Unit 4A, Mississauga, ON L5B 4M8, Canada
reviews:
The ladies here are so sweet but I think I’ve never in my life had a haircut this bad.
This was my second time coming here. The first time my haircut was slightly below average. Very choppy layers but for $40 I didn’t fuss too much about it.
Today, on the other hand just went terribly. I had to ask her multiple times to fix the blunt cuts she had made that were also completely uneven. After a while I just stopped asking because she kept making it worse. Now I have what looks like two different haircuts, a rat tail, and half the volume I came in with.
I booked an appointment with them to get it fixed but I don’t think I feel comfortable going back in because I cannot afford to lose more hair. Going to have to go somewhere else to get it fixed. I would avoid this place for women’s haircuts

**Very disappointing experience — not worth the money**

I went to Edessa Salon for hair coloring and a keratin treatment and paid the full amount they asked for. Unfortunately, I was left with a large, very noticeable black patch on one side of my hair.

When I went back to explain the issue to Enas, I was told, “I will do it next time.” I trusted that and returned as requested. However, my second experience was even more disappointing.

The salon was extremely dirty, and I was very concerned about the lack of proper hygiene and cleanliness. The hair-washing sink in particular was extremely dirty and did not appear to be properly maintained.

When I tried to explain my main concern about my hair, Enas simply walked away and said she couldn’t do anything more. The way I was treated made me feel as though I was asking for a free service, even though I had already paid for the original service.

I tried to speak directly with Enas, but she did not even come to discuss the issue or listen to my concerns. I was simply told that  “can’t do” anything, without any proper explanation or attempt to understand the problem.

Unfortunately, I also did not find the staff to be very professional, and based on my experience, I was not satisfied with the hair-coloring service or the way my concerns were handled.

Overall, I would not recommend this salon. For the price I paid, I expected much better quality, professionalism, cleanliness, and customer service. **Definitely not a value-for-money experience.**

We've been bringing our kid here for the past 3 years, and Krance is hands down the best stylist around. He's incredibly patient, friendly, and knows exactly how to make kids feel comfortable and relaxed during their haircut. His approach is always calm, professional, and engaging, which makes the whole experience enjoyable. Krance consistently understands the style we're looking for and delivers great results every time. It's clear that he genuinely cares about his clients and takes pride in his work. Highly recommend Krance — 5 stars all the way!

I had the worst experience at this salon.
I asked the stylist for highlights and was very clear that I did not want my roots to be made any darker. She assured me she wouldn’t, but she did exactly the opposite. On top of that, the highlights were very harsh, with obvious straight lines and blotchy sections instead of looking soft and blended. The darkened roots created an unflattering contrast that made the colour look even worse.

I also asked for a bob haircut, but even that wasn’t done properly. When I got home, I realized one side was noticeably longer than the other.

The worst part is that I didn’t notice all of these issues until I got home, and honestly, I didn’t feel comfortable going back to have them fix it because I was afraid they would make it even worse.

In the end, I paid $360 to have my hair ruined. I’m extremely disappointed with both the service and the final result. I would not recommend this salon to anyone, and I will never be returning.

I have been going to Edessa for blowouts for years. The women staff doing a great job 90% of the time.

However sometimes they make faces when you book an appointment at 7pm. The salon hours are until 8pm. They allow bookings at 7pm but the staff look annoyed when you go at 7. My blow dry is done in 30mins. I understand it’s end of the day and they are tired. But the salon needs to change their hours or hire staff that can work till closing hours without getting upset. They have customers walking in after 7pm all the time.

Yesterday they booked me at 7.30pm as they did not have 7pm slot. I received a call from the stylist Evon at 6pm asking me to come at 7pm. I told her my appointment was confirmed and I have another appointment prior to coming there. Yet I rushed my prior appointment and made it to Edessa at 7.10 pm, just to make it a little easier for her  as she has child at home. When I went in she did not seem glad that I came early. Anyway, she started doing the hair wash roughly, scrubbing my sensitive scalp with nails even though I told her to do gently multiple times. Again while blow drying, she did it too close to scalp hurting my scalp multiple times. And you could tell she was gossiping about me with her colleague. It was a very unpleasant experience. Made me feel like I’m a burden.

Another stylist Franka who is new does a good job. But she can’t understand English and she rubs conditioner into the scalp. It’s hard to explain not to do that. But I’m just glad she never makes annoyed faces when I go at 7pm, which is the only time I can go on weekdays.

Another issue is- they don’t clean the common hair tools like detangling comb and hair brushes. There’ll be a clump of other people’s hair on the brush which they use on others without so much as removing the hair.

My favourite stylist was Rajaa who is no more with them. Enas and Rana are good, but   It’s hard to get their evening appointments.

name: Rogues Restaurant - Fine Dining Restaurant
address: 1900 Dundas St W, Mississauga, ON L5K 1P9, Canada
status: Italian fare in a warm, elegant setting
reviews: My partner and I throughly enjoy our visits to this restaurant. The staff always remember who you are, they also go above and beyond. We were there on an evening that was busier than expected and its wonderful to see how the staff all work together to create a great experience. I often have the specials and tried their grilled calamari which was delicious! They always cook the food exactly as you request. We will absolutely be back, again and again.

Rude Tenured Waiter.
This was one of my favourite restaurants in Mississauga. Period. The last time my wife & I went for dinner and had a waiter who when I told I was there to celebrate my birthday, he reacted as if he couldn't have cared less. He brought us a dessert at the end but his attitude throughout the entire meal was that of someone who was doing us a favour by waiting on us, which can damper your entire experience.

I assumed he was a new employee but was shocked to hear from the host that he had been there for 20 years or something.
With that being the case, it's unlikely they will train him any better or replace him. It's not worth the risk of having him wait on us again.

I brought this experience up to someone at work and they mentioned they had the exact same experience and we swapped horror stories in detail.

Rogues - if you can fix this situation please respond to my review as I would love to one day happily return to your restaurant. If not, it was fun while it lasted.

Wow!  Been here many times going back to when they opened early ‘80s. We went for lunch, party of 6. It was a special occasion and they gave us a room to ourselves. We had a dedicated server who was knowledgeable and very friendly. Food was great, his suggestions were right on. We had champagne and he recommended shrimp cocktail as an app which he said “goes well with champagne”. I asked if we could just get 3 orders for the table while we decided what to have. Not only were they an excellent size and perfectly cooked, but the presentation was wonderful. Normally you’d order for yourself but I asked for a sharing service so they had to present/seeve it differently than they normally would. Vg wine list too. I can’t really make any suggestions re menu because it was all good.

Went for a birthday and what an excellent time! The ambiance was wonderful,  the food was exquisite but even more impressive was our server Anthony!!! A true gentleman who is a master of his craft, was on point the whole evening and very interpersonal.  (He deserves a raise)

Would recommend this place for an intimate date night or business gathering.

We held a private event for our daughter's baptism, and we are so grateful that we chose Rogue's Restaurant. From the very beginning, the owner, Bevan, was incredibly kind, welcoming, and accommodating, making the entire planning process stress-free and enjoyable. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was truly exceptional—without a doubt some of the best we have ever experienced. Everything exceeded our expectations, and our guests had nothing but wonderful things to say. We highly recommend Rogue's Restaurant for any special occasion and look forward to returning in the future.

name: Odyssey Hair Salon & Spa
address: 1575 Upper Ottawa St, Hamilton, ON L8W 3E2, Canada
reviews: Ellie is absolutely amazing! Both of my daughters see her, and have been coming to her for a while now. She always does such great work and pays attention to every little detail. She’s friendly, professional, and genuinely cares about making sure they’re happy with their hair. We’re always so pleased with the results. Highly recommend Ellie! ❤️ 💇🏻‍♀️

I have been a loyal client at this salon for a long time and always had an excellent experience with Suzette. Unfortunately, since she moved, my most recent visit left me extremely disappointed and shocked by how unprofessionally my situation was handled.

Before my appointment, I emailed reference photos of what I wanted versus what I currently had. I was very clear—both in writing and in person—that while colour was important, the health of my hair was my top priority, as I have been working hard to grow it. Ally was recommended to me, and during the consultation she also showed me reference photos, so I felt confident we were aligned.

During the service, my hair was bleached and I was told to wait 45 minutes. Throughout that entire time, Ally did not check the foils even once. Every hairstylist I’ve ever been to checks on the hair every 10–15 minutes, especially when bleaching. When my hair was finally washed, my scalp began burning, which immediately raised concerns that the bleach had been left on too long.

When she blow-dried one section and asked for feedback, I honestly said it was not at all what I had asked for. She became visibly upset and insisted we finish drying first. At this point, my scalp was still burning, but I didn’t want to cause a scene as I’ve been a regular client.

Once finished, I clearly stated that my scalp and forehead were burned and that the colour was not what I requested. Instead of acknowledging this, Ally became angry, raised her voice, and denied that my scalp was burned, insisting she had done exactly what I asked for. I showed the burns to two other stylists, who made conflicting comments—one even suggesting there may still be colour left at the scalp.

What was most upsetting was not just the outcome, but the refusal to acknowledge something so obvious. A simple acknowledgment or apology would have gone a long way. Instead, excuses were made and responsibility was avoided. Despite this, I paid the full amount for the service with no discount or resolution offered.

When I got home, I discovered that not only my scalp, but also my forehead and ear were burned.

I will not be returning to this salon. While I previously had wonderful experiences here with Suzette, this visit was handled in an extremely unprofessional manner. I hope this serves as a warning to anyone considering bleaching services at this location.

Julia seriously saved my hair!! After having such a bad experience at another salon the day before, she fit me in last minute and completely worked wonders. I’m absolutely obsessed with my hair now and couldn’t be happier with the results. She is so talented, kind, and genuinely cares about making you feel good. I’ll definitely be continuing to go to her from now on 🤍

I had a pedicure with Doh today…it was wonderful! She is kind and takes great care throughout the service. Her fluidity of movement especially during the massage portion of my pedicure nearly put me to sleep ☺️ I will be going back for sure!

Vanessa did such an amazing job on my blonde highlights! She took the time to really understand what I wanted and made my hair look even better than I imagined. The color blends perfectly and looks so natural and bright. She’s so talented, professional, and made the whole experience enjoyable. I’ve gotten so many compliments already! Highly recommend Vanessa if you’re looking for beautiful blonde highlights and someone who truly cares about their work.

reviews: Kal is incredible! He did such a beautiful job on my hair. I’m beyond happy with the results. He’s so talented and really pays attention to detail. The whole salon was really friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend Kal!

I give two stars because my hair was styled nicely, but it is far from what I asked for. I’m confused on how I ended up with this hair style. At the beginning of the appointment DJ and I discussed my desire style and length, and I expressed I want to keep my length as much as possible. Also, I specifically said that my hair is wavy/curly, and pointed out how long my hair actually is before it is wet, to show why I don’t want too much length taken off. We settled on the amount to cut off, which was absolutely no more than 2 inches. He specifically showed me how much he’ll take off, and I approved it. So, I’m confused on how I ended up losing almost 5 inches of my hair. I knew as the cut kept progressing there was more than what I wanted being taken off, but I tried to rationalize that maybe it was the layers that he was cutting so it’s best not to freak out. I understand that he is passionate about his work, but there is absolutely no reason to cut off that much hair, especially when preserving length was discussed. My hair was healthy and long, and I just wanted to restyle it. There’s no reason to have the consultation in the beginning in the first place if I’m going to get the opposite of what I asked for. After three years of growing my hair and keeping it at my desired length, I now have to restart the whole process because my stylist got way too happy with his scissors.

I’m in love with my haircut! 😍 I came in with a PDF of photos for a very specific cut I wanted—a mix of three different styles—and it turned out even better than I imagined.

Dino was patient, attentive, and checked in throughout the haircut to make sure the length and texture were exactly what I wanted. He also helped me figure out which products I’d need for the different ways I wanted to style it, so I felt prepared and excited to have fun with it.

The whole team was excited with me about my new look (I especially loved the skin-fade sides!), and I left feeling confident and happy. Since this was my first time at a hair salon, I really appreciated how comfortable and stress-free the experience was. I loved it and will definitely be coming back! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I would recommend this salon, they make sure to understand what the client wants and they have the skill to deliver.

name: MySweeTooth
address: 301 Main St W, Hamilton, ON L8P 1J7, Canada
reviews:
If you are looking for a “not too sweet” dessert spot in Hamilton or nearby, look no further than My Sweetooth. Every dessert we tried was fresh, balanced, and full of flavour without being overly sweet.

We ordered the coffee Basque cheesecake, sesame mochi donut, strawberry choux cream puff, and coconut cream ube cake roll and honestly, they were all perfect!

The choux cream puff had such a crispy outer shell that it almost makes you swallow your tongue. The chiffon cake roll was light and smooth, while the coconut cream was fragrant and the ube cream had a lovely nutty flavour. The coffee Basque cheesecake was rich and aromatic, with a slight bitterness from the cocoa powder on top that made the baked flavour even deeper and more satisfying.

What stood out the most is how well-balanced the sweetness was. Nothing felt heavy or overwhelming, and you can really taste the freshness in every bite. Everything is made fresh daily.

Beyond the desserts, I had a chance to chat with Jia, the owner and baker, and she was so friendly, thoughtful, and accommodating. When she found out I had a 2-hour ride home, she kindly offered me an ice bag to keep the cakes fresh, though I jokingly told her not to worry because I’d probably finish them all on the way home.

You can really feel the care and passion behind this shop, both in the desserts and in the service. Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to.

I ordered the strawberry cream puff cake and it was absolutely delicious. The cake was light, fluffy, and perfectly balanced—not overly sweet. Everything tasted fresh, and the quality really stood out. The service was excellent as well, making the whole experience even better. Highly recommend!

The best cream puffs, perfect amount of sweetness, dough and cream! The cake slices and boxes are also delicious!

I love the strawberry and yuzu flavors, Vanilla, earl grey are also note worthy! The ube icecream is a good sweetness and creamy - tty it on a hot day.

The ladies working there are extremely sweet and kind - always fun having a chat and getting their recommendations for desserts!

I had such a lovely experience picking up my cake here on Tuesday! Liyah was incredibly warm, friendly, and helpful. She gave me great advice and recommendations about the cake. Even though it was close to closing time, she still kindly helped prepare and finish the cake for me on the spot. While I was waiting, she offered me complimentary tap water and made sure I was well taken care of throughout the whole visit.

The cake turned out great, and all of my friends really enjoyed it! I truly appreciated Liyah’s patience, kindness, and thoughtful service. Thank you so much, Liyah! 😊

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 100/10 Experience!!

I am so sad I’ve slept on Sweet Tooth Bakery for so long, but I am *so* glad I finally walked through the door!

From the second I walked in, I was greeted by Jia (with a J!), who was absolutely full of life, welcoming, and gave me a full breakdown of the entire menu. Her confidence in her products is completely justified… she is a queen at work who clearly loves what she does, and her incredible energy literally put me in a great mood for the rest of the day. She made me feel like a friend, not just a customer.

Jia let me sample the Earl Grey cream puff (incredible!), which helped me decide on my mini pastry haul:

Vanilla Cream Puff: (10/10) You can tell she uses supreme, real ingredients. You can actually taste the real vanilla bean. The pastry was light, airy, and fluffy with a perfect little crumble on top.

Strawberry Cream Puff: (100/10!) This one absolutely blew me away. Same amazing pastry, fresh whipped cream, a strawberry on top, and real strawberries mixed right inside.

Chewy Dubai Chocolate Cookie: If you love Dubai chocolate, you will *love* this. It has a chocolaty, marshmallow like exterior with the perfect crunchy kataifi/khanafeh filling inside.

Strawberry Matcha:  Phenomenal. She makes the strawberry portion in-house and uses premium, ceremonial-grade matcha (she even showed me the vibrant color to prove it).

Because these are Asian-style treats, they aren't overwhelmingly sweet but they just have the absolute perfect balance of flavour. Hats off to Jina. Bragging rights well deserved!

Jia with a J is a queen at work and you can taste the quality of her work in every bite. I will be back again, and again, and again!

This is one of my favourite places in the city. Nothing on the menu is overly sweet, which I love! The focus is always on capturing the flavour of each ingredient. I love ube and pistachio, and the ube Basque cheesecake, ube coconut cake roll, and pistachio cream puff delivered those flavours perfectly. The raspberry lychee mochi was an absolute delight! And when I removed the lid covering the mango passionfruit tiramisu, the alluring aroma that hit me was equivalent to the scrumptious taste awaiting inside the box. Finally, the chewy Dubai cookie was both delicious and aesthetic. Everything in the shop is obviously prepared with love and expertise. Run, don't walk!

I ordered a cake from Sweet Tooth, and overall, I really liked it. The cake tasted very good — it was freshly baked, not overly sweet, and made with fresh cream and quality ingredients. The flavor was light and pleasant, which I truly appreciated.

The only small concern I had was with the filling. I ordered a 5-inch serving cake, and the cream inside felt a bit less than expected. Because of that, you could taste the cake layers and the cream separately rather than having a smooth, well-blended bite. I feel that adding a bit more filling inside would make the cake even more enjoyable and smoother to eat.

Overall, it was a good experience, and I would definitely consider ordering again.

I called to ask a few questions and also reccomendations for a birthday cake, the girl who helped me out was so lovely and kind! I saw her again when I picked up my order in store and she was friendly.

The cake itself was the best I’ve ever had, and my boyfriend (birthday boy) said it was one of the best too! Fluffy and soft cake, icing that melts in your mouth with just the right amount of sweet and savoury, and the lychee was so fresh it paired perfectly with every other flavour! Presentation was also very cute and I have no regrets choosing to buy from this shop, I will definitely be returning as well!

Ignore the fact that I accidentally glued on the “happy birthday” sign upside down LOL. I didn’t realize until candles were lit and he pointed it out.

Average bubble tea taste for the money value. The store standard design and graphics are not attractive (to me). I almost missed it as I walked by the streert. Boba is not cooked well, it was mushy outside and hard inside, really destroying the flavor of the bubble tea. I ordered brown sugar boba, the cup bottom was so hot when it was served. I asked them if I made wrong order, I did not order hot drink, it should be cold or cool. The staff said it was hot sugar but I did not appreciate their attitude when they answered me, as if I didnot know bubble tea. Then I realized it was not sugar but the hot boba/pearl that was just cooked. Overall, it is pnot my favorite brand.

New bubble tea shop in Chinatown. Drinks were good but somehow missing some flavours. Felt a bit watery although they looked delicious. Few drinks were not available on the menu. I personally prefer a stronger taste like Presotea’s.
Ordered the matcha strawberry it tasted like water! Its strange because I've been here before and it was good the time before but unfortunately it disappointed me very heavily.

I had one of the best haircuts I’ve ever had here. The team is incredibly welcoming, friendly, and highly professional. They pay great attention to detail and truly care about customer satisfaction. An amazing experience every time! Thank you for your professionalism and incredible talent. I always leave more than satisfied. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the service is outstanding. Best cut ever.
I only needed a touch-up and it was done perfectly.

Absolutely fantastic.

Excellent experience! I've been a loyal customer for a long time and have had more than five haircuts with Ali. He also cuts my son's hair, and we're always very happy with the results. Ali is the best barber I’ve ever been to and he is also a very kind person. I’ve had several hair cuts with him and he does an excellent job. Couldn’t recommend enough

One of the best barber in town. You can't go wrong with him. It's a nice experience.  The barbers are very friendly and do an excellent job. The place is run by the barber himself so he values the customers. Very clean and organized. Highly recommended.

address: Tour A, 1470 Rue Peel local 352, 3e étage, Montréal, QC H3A 1T1, Canada
reviews: Karima does my hair like no one else. Every time I leave her salon, I feel amazing and look wonderful. She takes such good care of my hair and does it so skillfully and lovingly, like she does her own hair. 100000% recommend this salon.

I’ve been regularly seeing Karima for the past two years and I absolutely trust NO ONE else to touch my hair but her!!! She is such a sweetheart and one of a kind — always a pleasure to chat and catch up with her. Her smile and energy is contagious and makes me want to come back each time. She always amazes me with her talent on my hair, whether it color, cut, and/or style. She knows EXACTLY what’s best for her clients. 10/10 always for Karima — anyone would be blessed to have her as a hairdresser!!!

I had the absolute pleasure of visiting Art's Hair Coiffure on Peel Street in Montreal, and I cannot say enough wonderful things about my experience! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and cared for. The salon has a warm and inviting atmosphere, and the team is incredibly professional and attentive.

A special thank you to Karima, my amazing stylist, who worked absolute magic on my hair! I adore and love her, she is truly a master of her craft. She took the time to listen to exactly what I wanted and then exceeded all my expectations. My highlights are stunning, so beautifully blended, I couldn't be happier!

I would also like to thank her wonderful assistant Anna who is awesome.

If you're looking for a top-tier salon experience with a stylist who genuinely cares about making you look and feel your best, Karima at Art's Hair Coiffure is the one to see. I have been coming here for many years and as usual I am beyond pleased with my results, I always get compliments on my hair and can't wait for my next appointment. . . Highly recommend!
They have great service and they give you exactly what you’re looking for. I dyed and cut my hair with jimmy and it turned out amazing!!

I had the most incredible experience with Karima yesterday! She colored my hair and I am absolutely in love with the result. From the moment I sat in her chair, I felt completely comfortable and confident that I was in expert hands.
Karima truly listens. She took the time to understand what I wanted, offered thoughtful guidance, and created a color that is rich, dimensional, and so beautifully blended. The tone is flawless, the shine is stunning, and it feels completely elevated yet natural. It’s exactly what I envisioned — but even better.
Beyond her talent, Karima has such a beautiful presence. She is warm, attentive, and clearly passionate about her craft. You don’t just leave with amazing hair — you leave feeling uplifted.
If you’re looking for someone who combines artistry, precision, and genuine care, Karima is the one. Highly, highly recommend! ✨

name: Silver Fox Barbershop
address: 6 Murray St, Ottawa, ON K1N 6Z4, Canada
reviews: Angie is my stylist, and she does and amazing job at the services requested. The vibe of the place is relaxed, yet professional. Having an espresso while my hair is being cut is the icing on the cake!

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is welcoming, professional, and full of good energy. The attention to detail here is on another level — every cut is precise, clean, and tailored exactly to what you want.

The owner brings a real passion for the craft and sets a high standard for the whole team. You can tell there’s a strong culture of quality, consistency, and respect for clients. Whether you’re going for a classic look or something modern, they take the time to get it right.

Highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for a top-tier haircut and a great overall experience. Definitely one of the best spots in the city.

Silver Fox is my go-to haircut place in Ottawa. The owner Ross is eccentric but very nice, and he's an absolute artist at his craft. I don't micromanage, I just say "make me look good please!" and then I sit back and relax.

Pro-tip: I always go in the morning since they offer tasty complimentary espresso.

For a 8 mos I grew my hair so that I can have my dream haircut. Bought quality shampoos and conditioners and treatments to grow my hair to achieve what I want. I was confident to get it when I entered the barbershop but so little I know a horrible experience is about to unfold. Showed a picture of the style and I repeatedly saying that I want to keep the top length and just to get the bottom layered, no fade. The hairdresser held my top hair and with no hesitation she cut it to the extent that I end up having a fringe like a kung fu master. I wanted to shout but it wouldn’t change a thing. I told her that it was too short and she keep saying that it fits me better than having a long hair. I don’t see why her preference matters when it’s my hair that she butchered. The owner was kind to acknowledge my defeat and didn’t ask me to pay. How can anyone brings back what I lost for a free haircut?  It’s a depressing experience.

⭐☆☆☆☆

One of the worst barbershop experiences I’ve had. I paid $46 for a haircut and left looking almost exactly the same as when I walked in. I specifically explained that I wanted my long hair shaped, layered, and styled into something more modern. Instead, the barber barely did anything.

What frustrates me most is that there was almost no effort to understand what I wanted or provide any professional recommendation. The entire appointment felt rushed and careless. If you’re charging premium prices, customers should receive a haircut that actually shows skill, attention to detail, and value for the money.

I don’t usually leave negative reviews, but paying $46 for virtually no visible result is unacceptable. I left feeling disappointed, frustrated, and like my time and money were wasted.

name: hair by banks & co.
address: 783 Queen St W F2, Toronto, ON M6J 1G1, Canada
reviews: if you’re reading these reviews and wondering if you should make an appointment, don’t hesitate and book it. I went in after having a bad box dye job and a rough grow-out and Rhianna and Britt saved my hair. I was really nervous about how it would turn out, because of bad experiences in the past with different colourists and stylists, but those nerves faded quickly after my experience. I had an initial consultation with Britt and she really listened to what I wanted to do and was very patient and kind, and provided suggestions on how to execute it. I had my appointment with Rhianna and she absolutely slayed my hair. She took the time to answer all my questions, explain each process to me, and took such good care of my hair. The colour and the cut are top notch and I will be a forever client going forward

I am so in love with my hair! Martin is one of the best stylists I’ve ever had. I came in with my hair cut to a bob with 3 drastically different colours from root to tip (red, blonde and brown) and Martin was able to make it all one colour to match my light brown extensions. Martin spent around 10 hours fixing my hair and stayed super late to make sure everything was exactly how I wanted it.  He is a perfectionist and pays attention to every detail! He is so polite and funny, I loved spending all day with him! I couldn’t be happier with my experience with Hair by Banks and I would recommend them to anyone!

There is no one else I trust with my hair.
I have been a client of Gillian’s for 5 years and have followed her wherever she goes because I know I'll receive top-notch service and walk out feeling fabulous.

She seamlessly combines her knowledge with her artistic flair, leaving me thrilled with the results after each visit. Her warm and welcoming personality matched with the awesome atmosphere at Hair by Banks makes it feel more like a visit than an appointment.

I highly recommend her!

the stylist i originally booked with had an unexpected situation come up but the team at the salon quickly stepped in to problem solve and i felt really taken care of from start to finish. i ended up getting my hair cut by Britt and you can really tell how passionate she is about her craft and her salon. this is the best haircut i've had in a long time and i'll definitely be back!

I've been getting colour services with Marie-Eve for 5 years now. We've gone through many hair colour transformations together, from coloured/marbled roots, to all over fashion colours - and since I'm now living 4 hours away from Toronto - we decided to work in a nice balayage over several appointments so I can deal with the grow-outs (up to 16 weeks out). Despite the long distance travel, I still manage to make it down here and treat myself to some Marie-Eve magic. The salon itself has great energy, lovely aesthetic, and the staff are really kind. It's a great experience every time!

I feel bad making this review because I felt that I had a good experience in the moment and my hair looked gorgeous immediately after my appointment, but a few days and a couple washes later, I’m feeling super bummed about my hair. I had a haircut with Martin for a trim and some curtain bangs. I mentioned that I had previously had a bad experience at a different salon with short, uneven layers that I didn’t ask for which had taken me over a year to grow out. He said that he could add some slight layers which I wouldn’t be able to notice. I told him that I trusted him, which maybe is my fault for not being explicitly clear about what I wanted as my hair ended being thinned out quite a bit which I wasn’t expecting. I previously had thick, full ends which now look thin and wispy. I feel like I’ve left with half almost the thickness I had going in. I have layers throughout my hair that are about half the length of the rest of my hair, and I know from experience will take a year+ to grow out and regain my thickness. I’m feeling devastated that I have lost so much volume in favour of giving my hair some “shape”. I also have some face framing layers which are quite uneven, and overall I feel that the haircut has left my ends looking messy and shaggy. I had such high hopes for a salon with such amazing reviews, but now think I’ll have a hard time trusting any salon going forward. :( at the end of the day, my hair looks okay, but I feel that it wasn’t what I asked for and I don’t feel that my concerns were heard.

I won't go anywhere but Hair By Banks for my color, cut and style needs! I've been working with Tiff since 2017 and she's done a beautiful job helping me achieve the balayage hair of my dreams. She's also the only stylist I've been to that cuts my hair in a way that I'm happy to let it air dry.

Because of their skill, I worked with Hair by Banks for my wedding. I loved the work that Tiff and Lea for all 9 women, ranging in age from 6 to over 60! I especially love the classic glam look that Tiff helped me achieve. I cannot recommend HBB enough for your everyday and special occasion hair needs!

Best salon in Toronto, hands down!!
From the second you walk in it feels welcoming and comfortable (sometimes salons can be awkward and daunting but this is the complete opposite!!). Always greeted with a smile and a big hello.
Been going to Hair By Banks for years now and I wouldn’t have it any other way. Love the vibe and all the stylists are incredibly talented!
Their patio in the summer feels like a little oasis and I love how they serve drinks so it feels like a little vacay every time I get my hair done. Nothing like a little self-care with a side of Prosecco ;)

If you haven’t checked it out yet, YOU MUST!!
Wish I could give it 100 stars!

reviews: I cannot say enough wonderful things about this dress shop! As The mother of the bride/groom, I was hoping for a special experience – and they exceeded every expectation. From the moment I walked in, I was absolutely blown away by their spectacular and extensive selection. The inventory is truly unmatched – so many styles, colours, and sizes to choose from, making it easy to find something that felt both elegant and perfectly “me”.  What really set this dress shop apart, though, was the exceptional care and attention from the staff – especially Reena. She took the time to listen, offered thoughtful suggestions, and made me feel completely comfortable and confident throughout the entire process. It never felt rushed or impersonal – just genuine, knowledgable guidance, every step of the way. Even after the purchase, the after-sale customer service was outstanding by Reena.   If you are looking for a dress that makes you feel elegant, confident, and celebrated – and a sales representative that truly cares, you’ll not find a better place. Highly highly recommend!

On  April 28, I went to Cavery to find a dress for my May 1 birthday event( my online dress was delayed and would not arrive on time). Reena and her team were amazing and was able to find the right dress and color. The service was excellent and professional. They also helped with the right jewelry selection and a great seamstress to modify the dress for a perfect fit.
Thanks Reena!

My mom and I had an incredible experience at Cavery while shopping for her mother-of-the-bride dress. She had previously purchased her mother-of-the-groom dress here, so we knew we were in good hands, but this visit exceeded our expectations.

The level of care, attention, and honest feedback we received from Reena was exceptional. The staff took the time to understand what my mom was looking for and helped her find a beautiful, high-quality dress that made her feel confident and special. We had looked elsewhere and simply couldn't find the same selection, quality, or service.

My mom even travelled from Ottawa to shop here, and it was absolutely worth the trip. I highly recommend Cavery to anyone looking for a special occasion dress, especially mothers of the bride or groom. The customer service is truly outstanding.

Bought a dress for a wedding I’m going to and had such a great experience. The care and patience by the entire staff made me feel right at home. Reena was helping us. She was so kind and made me feel so seen, she really took the time to listen to me to understand what I was looking for. I found a dress I feel amazing in and I can’t wait to wear it!! This will be my first stop when looking for event dresses from now on. Thank you to all the ladies at Cavery.

I had a wonderful experience at Cavery Dress Store while searching for my wedding dress. Although it's not a traditional bridal shop, Reena went above and beyond to help me find exactly what I was looking for. She was helpful from start to finish, taking the time to understand what I wanted and answering all of my questions along the way.

When I found the dress I loved, Reena was able to order it for me at a very reasonable price, making the whole experience easy and stress-free. Her customer service was exceptional, and I truly appreciated her honesty, kindness, and dedication.

I would highly recommend Cavery Dress Store to anyone looking for great service and someone who genuinely cares about helping you find the perfect dress.

name: Town Talk Bakery Cafe
address: 206C Queen St S, Mississauga, ON L5M 1L3, Canada
reviews:
I recently visited Kate's Town Talk Bakery and honestly, it’s one of those hidden gems that completely lives up to the hype. From the moment you step in, it feels like a true neighborhood treasure—simple, authentic, and full of character.
What really stands out is the quality of everything they make. You can tell it’s all done fresh and with care. The butter tarts are absolutely incredible—rich, perfectly balanced, and easily some of the best you’ll find anywhere. The pastries, cookies, and sandwiches all have that homemade touch that’s hard to find these days.
There’s something special about this place—it doesn’t try to be overly fancy, but delivers a level of quality and consistency that rivals much bigger names. It’s the kind of spot locals keep coming back to, and once you try it, you understand why.
The service is warm and genuine, adding to the overall experience. It really feels like a place built with passion, not just business under new management.
Overall, Kate’s Town Talk Bakery is a must-visit if you’re anywhere near Mississauga/Toronto. A true local classic that delivers comfort, quality, and unforgettable flavors every single time. They also mentioned that ice cream will be available in spring/summer.

I've been meaning to stop by Town Talk Bakery for a while, and I'm so glad I finally did. Everything looked so fresh that it was hard to decide what to get! The pastries and sandwiches were delicious, and you could really taste the quality. The staff were genuinely kind and welcoming, which made the visit even better. It's one of those places that makes you want to come back and try something new every time. Definitely recommend checking it out if you're in the area.

I honestly loved everything I tried here. Everything was so fresh and delicious. The butter tart, raspberry cheesecake brownie slices, and the chocolate pecan coconut cookie were my favorites. The drinks were great too. The place has such a cosy, relaxed, and welcoming vibe. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I bought a ginger cookie and a raisin butter tart from here. The ginger cookie tasted ok but was a bit too dry for my taste. However, the butter tart was amazing! It had a wonderful chewy texture and the flavour was delicious. It’s the best butter tart I’ve ever had. I highly recommend this bakery for butter tarts!

An absolute 💯 rock solid favourite in Streetsville long before it became Kate's Talk Town...that's how long I've been a customer 👏🏾

Katie did an absolutely fabulous 👌🏾 job keeping with the core components of the OG café while adding her own signature mark to further personalize it to her vision.

It was sad to hear the shop was for sale but after 15yrs one can understand when it becomes time to hang up one's hat and pass on the baton so to speak.

Popped by this week to check out the bakery under it's new owner. When you walk in you immediately still feel that authentic small town Cafe vibe. It's still homey and pleasant and one look at the pastries 🍰 😍 and you feel comforted that some small piece of the past is there.

The staff were very friendly and welcoming. Glad to see this has also stayed the same.

Grabbed some cookies 🍪 to go including a gingerbread one for my son (he said it was delicious). The prices are reasonable. No sense complaining about it, it's the times we live in and the bakery uses quality ingredients which is reflected in the price point.

Was introduced briefly to the new owner. He seems ok...perhaps still wrapping his head around everything including expectations of long standing customers who will no doubt have opinions 😉

Will be back, hopefully smashed buttertart cheesecake bars will be on the shelves and it would be nice to see a couple signature pastries from the owner to fully personalize the place to fit his vision.

name: Bloom Hair & Nail Salon
address: 1160 Upper Paradise Rd Unit 2, Hamilton, ON L9B 2N9, Canada
reviews: The salon itself was really nice, and the front desk staff were very friendly and welcoming. Unfortunately, I wasn’t happy with how my shellac nails turned out. The service felt very rushed, the color was applied with too few coats so my natural nail shows through, and there were messy edges with lint cured into the polish. I wish more time and attention had been given to the actual nail application. I had a good first impression of the space.

I have been booking nail appoints at Bloom Hair and Nails for 3 yrs. Linda provides professional service and I am always happy with results! I've always left happy and with a smile .AND,  always recommend friends to book an appointment with her. All the staff are friendly and proessional! The atmosphere is very relaxing too!

Worst experience getting a manicure and pedicure I’ve ever had.. do not go here! I’m going away for vacation and wanted to try this new place to get my nails and toes done with shellac. I called ahead of time and was advised that there was a Combo deal for $75. When I came in I reconfirmed with the hairdresser that was working the front desk that it was $75 she confirmed it was. I just asked for simple French tips on my toes and fingers. My toes were done horribly they are uneven and no length was added. Now for my fingernails they are incredibly thick and also uneven as you can see in the photos. The thickness of the white tips don’t even match with my fingernails and toenails. I had surgery on my leg a few years ago and had bolts and plates put in place. The lady doing my nails without even asking me placed hot rocks on my ankle which is exactly were the surgery hardware was placed (something I’m not supposed to be having around that area and something I’ve never had done at any other place I’ve been) it obviously hurt as you cannot place hot rocks on a area that underwent surgery I politely educated the lady with the following and advised she should be asking people before doing so for future reference. Lastly the worst part is after everything was done they advised me I owed them $140? I was very confused as I was told twice that the deal was $75? They explained they charged me for extra gel ( which I did not want or ask for. ) the hairdresser that quoted me just walked away and let the receptionist explain. The receptionist said she could not confirm that I was quoted $75 even tho the person who did so was right there? Overall I ended up paying $100. The customer service from the receptionist was okay as she was trying to resolve the misunderstanding on the salons behalf however the nail tech who did my nails was yelling at me not fully knowing they have me the wrong price. 0/10 overall for the customer service, the work and the prices.

First visit here-easy to book and lovely admin staff. Linda gave me the BEST pedicure I’ve had in a long time. Exceptionally clean salon with disposable files. Included a foot and leg massage and hot stones. Spectacular!Also a very calm environment and able to really relax.Definitely will be a returning client.

Bloom never disappoints!  Friendly staff and very clean salon!  Helen is my go-to nail tech and she really outdid herself this time for my cruise vacation mani.  I received so many compliments on her beautiful work.  My pedi was just as wonderful.  Highly recommend!

name: TATIANA HAIR - Best Balayage & Blonde Salon Toronto
address: 1360 Queen St E, Toronto, ON M4L 1C8, Canada
reviews: As a preface, I have never left a review for anything in my life, good or bad, but my experience with Tatiana was SO incredible, I couldn’t not share. A few weeks ago I visited an experienced colourist and requested to go slightly darker, but to maintain my lived in cool toned balayage, and I left with solid brassy dark copper and extensive damage (the before photo is much more complimentary then it actually looked). I was so distraught thinking that my hair was ruined, especially following two colour correction consultations in which I was told my only options were to dye my hair solid black, start to slowly bleach balayage over top and to cut it to my shoulders. I was so discouraged until I came across Tatiana. From the very moment I reached out, Tatiana was warm, knowledgeable and kind. She went to great lengths to schedule me in as soon as possible. On the day of the colour correction I was expecting a few highlights at best, to break up the solid copper and to make a correction plan consisting of multiple appointments, but never in a million years did I think it was possible to not only erase the terrible botched color, but to restore the quality and colour of my hair back to what it was prior to the botch job in one appointment! So much so, it brought me to tears. I do not have the words to describe how incredibly talented Tatiana is, she is truly in a league of her own. That combined with her exemplary customer service is almost unbelievable this day in age. I cannot recommend Tatiana enough, I can confidently say she will be the only person to touch my hair moving forward. I highly highly HIGHLY recommend Tatiana Hair! Thank you for bringing my hair back to life Tatiana! 🩷

My first session of grey blending was March 2026. I was very nervous and anxious about starting the transition. I’ve been colouring my roots for over 20 years. I found Tatiana to be reassuring and confident. With her skills and knowledge, I’m happy with the progress of my hair journey.
My 3rd session was on July 28th, the salon atmosphere is very relaxing and she works 1 on 1.
I appreciate Tatiana’s opinions and her support.
If you’re considering grey blending, I highly recommend Tatiana.

After years of harsh grey lines and very obvious banding, I couldn’t remember the last time I was genuinely happy leaving the salon.
I felt hopeless as the banding happened with multiple colourists and I needed to root spray from week 1 (of course my greys are concentrated at my part!).
I did a lot of research on grey blending & soft coverage and funny enough ChatGPT led me to Tatiana.
She colour corrected, softened my colour & broke up years of banding. Then she used a gloss on my roots to soften my grow-out even further. I was also able to keep my length! My colour suits me so much better now and for the first time in a long time, I left the salon loving my hair.
It’s obvious that Tatiana is super knowledgeable when it comes to colour correction and grey softening/blending. It’s also obvious that she loves what she does. She explained the process and made me feel comfortable & confident (changing hair dresser isn’t easy, even when you’re unhappy). She’s also super nice & easy to talk to. I can’t recommend her enough!

I found Tatiana on Instagram and I’m so glad I did. From the moment I arrived, the environment was incredibly welcoming and comfortable. She took the time to really understand what I was hoping to achieve and explained the process clearly.

I went in for a grey-blending appointment and the result is phenomenal. The blend looks so natural and the colour is beautiful!

It’s clear she’s very skilled and thoughtful in her approach, and  I left feeling fantastic about my hair. Highly recommend!

I don’t usually leave reviews but feel like Tatiana deserves a great one! I have been to her salon multiple times and every time I leave the appointment, I feel like a whole new person (see pics). She’s very meticulous, experienced, and knows what she’s doing and knows what’s best for your features. Not only that but she’s thoughtful and kind, and I always enjoy chatting with her. If you are looking for a salon, search no more - you will not be disappointed! 🤍

I ended up having to go to another business to purchase True Loaf bread at a marked up price due to them not having their own breads. And on top of that, the bread I was able to find was not the type I was looking to purchase either, but it is still very good.
