status: Cozy bakery for housemade bread & sweets
reviews:
I had such a wonderful experience visiting this spot on Danforth Avenue. The atmosphere is lovely, and the outdoor seating was the perfect place to enjoy a cold drink on a sunny day.

I was really impressed by their selection of grab-and-go meals. The fridge is stocked with so many options, including different types of lasagna and stews, which makes dinner planning much easier. I also picked up a key lime pie that looked absolutely perfect, topped with a single slice of lime. It tasted just as good as it looked. I will definitely be coming back soon to try more of their offerings.

I met up with a friend here in May. The place us cozy and cramped.  The coffee was good. They also had a decent enough selection of snacks to go with your coffee.

As you can see from.my pics they have other items they sell.

The service wasn't great, nor friendly.  They didn't even try to promote any if the pastries.

I was disappointed in that they served on a paper cup rather than a ceramic cup one would expect. I find that paper cups negatively affect the taste of coffee and the whole experience.

Being on the Danforth, paid street parking is available if you can find it. Also, you get the added entertainment bonus from the eclectic range of pedestrians.

Check this place out if your strolling the area.

We ordered a custom cake for our daughter's 5th birthday and it was perfect. She loved the k-pop demon hunter theme, and we loved the perfectly sweet buttercream and fluffy cake. Also, their peanut butter confetti bars are my all-time favourite sweet treat.

Dough is the most lovely local bakery - everything is made with care. In particular, my family loves their breakfast sandwiches, pizza dough, hallah bread, and all of their sweets especially the lemon squares. We pre-order their cakes for special occasions and are never disappointed. Highly recommend!

This is a cute and cozy shop in the Danforth with super tasty food.  I love the different bread choices, take away premade meals handy in a pinch.  The breakfast sandwhich are amazing, fluffy and tasty croissants.  I love the Nanaimo Bars, perfect texture and mouth watering taste, carrot cake is almost as good as my mom’s and it’s moist cake.  The date square is my hubby’s go to, and the staff is amazing.  Reasonably priced, because let’s be real it costs money to buy quality ingredients.  I love the staff, and family run business and the love they pour into it.  Nothing is perfect, but this place is a slice of heaven and built to last with a community vibe and  a small but mighty army of returning customers which speaks volumes against the “other” 1 star posers.

address: 633 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M6G 1K8, Canada
reviews:
This is hands down my favorite bubble tea stop in town.
The drinks are great.
But what really makes a huge difference is the staff.
I think I met all of the people who work there and they are very professional. The quality of the product is always top, and the staff always goes out of their way to be helpful, welcoming, very precise with the order, very fast in preparing the drink.
I really appreciate the whole environment, and love their bubble tea!

I’ve visited several Kung Fu Tea locations around the city, but the one nestled along Bloor Street, right in Koreatown, is by far my favorite. It might be easy to pass by among the other storefronts, but it’s absolutely a spot worth stopping in. The café is always pristine and welcoming, and it has a really warm atmosphere that keeps me coming back regularly on my lunch breaks.

What truly sets this location apart are the wonderful team members, especially Rachel and Jasmine. Rachel was the one who introduced me to my now-favorite peach oolong tea, and she always remembers my order with a smile. She’s incredibly kind and has a natural way of making every customer feel right at home.

Jasmine, with her bright smile and friendly vibe, is equally wonderful. She’s quick, efficient, and always brings such a positive energy to the café. Their dedication and the genuinely welcoming atmosphere they create truly deserve recognition. If you’re ever in Koreatown, this is the place to go for a fantastic tea experience and outstanding customer service.
The staff were very friendly, and the drinks were always good. I went here most of the time when I wanted bubble tea, and I really recommend their signature lite fruit tea.

Visited today and ordered the original milk tea with no ice, less honey, and added agar bubbles, along with waffles. The tea was outstanding—perfectly balanced with the milk and honey—and the waffles just melted in my mouth. Milk tea and waffles here are the perfect duo that keep me coming back whenever I’m downtown. The staff are always so polite. Thank you for the sweet experience!

Visited today and ordered original milk tea with no ice, less honey, add agar bubble. Order waffles, too.  The taste of the tea is outstanding, and it blends in with the milk and honey, the waffle melts in the mouth.  Milk tea and waffles are the perfect duo that make me visit every time I go downtown. Staff are very polite.  Thank for sweet experience.

While I wanted to give a good review because the owner and girl who cut my hair seemed nice, I unfortunately did not have a great experience, and left feeling insecure.

I’ve put a lot of effort into growing my hair and maintaining it, so it’s extremely upsetting to now have to wait half a year for it to grow back.

While it can be healthy to cut more hair, what I asked for was to trim 1 inch not 3. It’s not great to pay for a service, only to have your request ignored. Unfortunately I’m unsure if I would go back here.

reviews:
I visited Abby's bakery on Monday April 6th (Easter Monday) for the first time. I was super  excited to try their Dutch butter tarts. I also ended up getting their refresher drinks and a tiramisu cookie (best cookie I've ever tasted). The drink was great no complaints, the customer service was amazing although I noticed when I ordered the Dutch pastries, I was given a box pre made to the side. Thought nothing about it until I got home and realized I was given 5 which leads me to believe someone returned this box and probably ate one. I was actually really upset cause these are not cheap and I didn't follow my gut asking for a fresh batch. Although everything tasted amazing my overall experience was worth a 2 star because there was no way to be reimbursed since I got home late.

I'd advise everyone to check their boxes before walking away or provide fresh packages where the customer can see.

Cute place in the mall. All the pastries looked so good!
I got the strawberry mojito and the chocolate chunk cookie, warmed. That thing was so thick. I didn't get a change to take a pic of it. But it was everything a chocolate chunk cookie should be!

They have lots of drink options to wash it down with as well!

Abbey's Bakehouse features a menu centered on cottage-style comfort baking, renowned for its award-winning butter tarts, artisanal cookies, and homemade granola. The menu includes muffins, scones, vegan brownies, gelato, and savory pastry options, along with a wide selection of "dirty sodas" and coffee here at Square One Shopping Centre, 100 City Centre Dr Unit #2a-815, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

Great service and great drinks

Lea was very friendly and had such a warm smile and positive energy. She really listened to us and helped us choose the right options. The happy hour from 2–4 pm is a great way to try a variety of drinks at a good value. Overall, it made the experience even more enjoyable

Love the expansion of the new menu! Theres so many different drinks I want to try. I started with a hazelnut latte and it was great! Definitely good for mL size and price!

Hira was very kind and patient! Her service is really excellent. :)

super cutesy inside. the staff were nice but not overly personable. the cookies look AMAZING but they taste mediocre and are super sickening. I wouldn’t go back but glad I tried. I had the apple pie, celebration and smores.

reviews: I’m here every weekend (and for years!!) This salon is warm and cozy, friendly, and never pretentious. I love the entire team. They truly listen and adjust until everything is just right. And the scalp massages are next level. I always leave feeling taken care of and loving my hair. Thanks gang, you guys are A+.

I had my haircut on April 22nd and even though I’m a bit late writing this, I just had to share how great my experience was! Melissa did an A-MA-ZING job—honestly, the result was beyond what I was expecting 😍😍😍 She really understood what I wanted and made it even better!!! I absolutely love my haircut and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

Every time I go to L’Atelier, I leave feeling very satisfied with the service. Hanna is incredibly kind and professional. I get my manicure pedicure, eyebrow shaping, waxing, and everything is always amazing. Her positive vibe and great energy always leave me feeling happy afterward.thank you :)

I based myself on the reviews and photos I’ve seen of other people getting their nails done and I have to say I’m disappointed after being impressed. The person who did them was very nice, but the quality I received just wasn’t at all worth it for what I paid ($144-145). There are details when from far, aren’t noticeable, but from up close, are. If I had done this myself at home, I would be less or not at all upset and they’re already starting to peeI off. I received a shellac French manicure and a pedicure. My toe nails were cut way too short and I have some swelling on the sides from being nicked. I’m not happy with the turnout and will never come back.

My bridal party of six had our wedding makeup done at L’Atelier Coiffure, and the experience was both wonderful and stressful.

The makeup artists and hair stylists were incredibly skilled and professional, especially Philippe, who managed to do an amazing job under pressure. The makeup turned out beautifully for me and my bridal party, despite the time constraints.

However, one of the artists, Sofia, did not show up with no prior notice, which caused significant delays and added unnecessary stress on my wedding day. As the bride, I made the decision to stay calm and not complain to avoid adding more stress for others. With no other makeup artist available, I asked Philippe if he could do all the makeup himself, and he kindly accepted, stepping in to replace Sofia.

Due to the unexpected situation, some of my makeup steps—such as skin preparation, relaxation, and touch-ups—had to be rushed. We also sacrificed valuable time for photography and, most importantly, arrived late to the ceremony. While I understand emergencies can happen, in this case, Sofia's absence was simply due to a lack of responsibility, not an unavoidable circumstance. Her disregard for her teammates and her clients on such an important day was extremely disappointing.

A big thank-you to Jacinthe, Dylan, Marina, Charlie, and especially Philippe for their dedication and talent. Their hard work saved the day and ensured we still looked beautiful despite the challenges.

I’ve known this salon for years as Francesca was my hairdresser when I lived in Old Montreal. While I appreciate their artistry and professionalism, I strongly suggest the salon implement a backup plan for such situations in the future. This would ensure a smoother and more stress-free experience for clients on their special day.

Overall, I would recommend L’Atelier Coiffure for their talent and dedication, but better preparation for unforeseen circumstances would make the experience flawless.

reviews:
Visited on Saturday, October 11

I stopped by ITS TEA on 635 Mount Pleasant Rd and had an amazing experience. I ordered their Fresh Taro Matcha Storm, and it was absolutely delicious — easily one of the best bubble teas I’ve had in Toronto. The taro was fresh and creamy, and it paired perfectly with the matcha. The flavors blended beautifully, giving it a rich and satisfying taste that felt very natural and not overly sweet or artificial.

What I really liked about ITS TEA is that their menu isn’t just the same typical drinks you find at most bubble tea shops. They have a great selection of unique blends and creative flavors that make them stand out. You can tell they put effort into quality and presentation.

The customer service was great — friendly and welcoming, and even though the shop wasn’t too busy when I visited, the staff were attentive and kind. The ambiance is cozy and very well designed for a small café. They’ve done a great job making use of the space with thoughtful decor, good lighting, and comfortable seating. Everything looked clean, tidy, and inviting, which made the experience even better.

Overall, ITS TEA is a lovely little spot for anyone who enjoys good-quality bubble tea in a relaxed setting. If you’re around the Mount Pleasant area and want to try something fresh and different, I highly recommend giving them a visit.

I could tell she took her time and was very steady. Kept the cut neat and tidy, too, and ensured it fit my face frame. Exceeded expectations. Very talented. Love the atmosphere and vibe, overall.

I love this salon! Will definitely be going back! Can't wait!
Awesome stylist.  Gave me the best cut I’ve had in a long time.  Also gave me a glossy black dye to cover my greys.  So happy I found this gem of salon.

It was my first time visiting the salon. Kat was amazing at taking what I wanted and making sure that I had all the info, as well as giving her input. I had an amazing experience, love the end result. This was the first salon I’ve been to in years that didn’t constantly bring up how thin my hair was and how that limited what I could do. Kat worked with my hair, made suggestions when needed and didn’t make me feel like something was wrong. I absolutely love my hair, I haven’t walked out of a salon feeling this good in a while. Will definitely be back.

I wanted a perfect layered haircut, and she did it exactly the way I envisioned. My hair was very long, and she took the time to carefully create beautiful, well-blended layers without rushing.

Highly recommend her to anyone looking for a great layered haircut!

I was looking for a new stylist near me and saw all the wonderful reviews for Kat. Went for a cut today. It is exactly what wanted. She listened and made great suggestions for my particular hair. Needless to say, I have found my new hair stylist!  Very happy.

I’ve been searching for a great hairstylist in Hamilton for a long time, Kat was absolutely amazing. she took me in last minute and gave me the perfect haircut, exceeding all my expectations. I wanted a butterfly cut with lots of layers and bangs, and she executed it flawlessly. Every layer is beautifully defined and perfectly suits my face shape.

Kat is warm, welcoming, and incredibly knowledgeable, offering fantastic hair advice. Plus, her pricing is very reasonable for the quality of work she provides. To top it all off, there’s free parking available, making the whole experience even more convenient. If you’re looking for a stylist who truly understands your vision and brings it to life, I highly recommend her!

Jordan and Kat are gems  💎 ✨️ I happened to be there when Peter the Schwarzkopf professional was there!! So grateful to learn how to properly wash and condition my hair to prepare for the upcoming perm for wedding season. Don't mind my wet hair--it's freshly brushed, washed, conditioned, and feeling fabulous!!! 💖

It was my first time getting a haircut with Kat, and I chose her after reading so many amazing reviews on Google Maps. Her rating truly stood out to me - and now I completely understand why.
From the moment I walked into the salon, I felt welcomed and relaxed. Kat is not only an absolute professional, but also a genuinely warm and kind person. She has created such a beautiful atmosphere in her salon that you instantly feel comfortable.
She carefully listened to everything I wanted, answered all of my questions, and gave thoughtful advice about my hair. I felt completely understood. And the result? Even more beautiful than I had imagined. She made my haircut look better than I expected - it’s stylish, flattering, and exactly right for me.
The salon is impeccably clean, including all the tools and equipment, which made me feel even more confident in her work.
I’m truly impressed and so happy I chose Kat. I will definitely be coming back.

name: Joseph Head Hair Colour
address: 404 Queen St E, Toronto, ON M5A 1T3, Canada
reviews:
I visited for the first time, and as someone who has been bleaching and maintaining platinum blonde hair in Korea for years, my standards are pretty high. Because I was visiting the city during the time I needed my hair done, I came in for a routine root bleach. Not only were expectations met for the level of care I’m used to in Korea, but they also went above and beyond.

Jo and Jennifer/Jen(?) were both incredibly hospitable, thorough, and attentive from start to finish. They were personable, friendly, and easy to talk to, which made the whole experience even better. Jo has a clear depth of experience and knowledge when it comes to colouring hair. Since this was my first time getting my hair done outside of Korea, I was a little nervous, but Jo made me feel completely at ease. Maintaining hair health and minimizing damage is prioritized while trying to achieve the look you want.

The results were exactly what I hoped for. Whenever I’m in the city and I need touch ups on my hair, this will definitely be my go‑to spot. If you’re looking for a place to colour your hair, especially if you’re blonde or going blonde, this is the place. You won’t regret it.

I’ve been seeing Joe and Lena for many years now and having nothing but good things to say about their salon and the team. Joe and Lena know their stuff and know how to get you leaving the salon feeling like a million bucks. They spend a lot of time understanding your goals and are really great at managing expectations. My hair is naturally blonde and I like to stick to that so they add dimension to my hair… usually without the need of toner because Joe and Lena can achieve the “perfect lift” without it. I also see lots of other clients in there with fun colours and it looks great. Not to mention… they have beyond reasonable rates. They are the colour masters of Toronto! Definitely a Toronto hidden gem!

Lena, Joe, Liz, Kayleigh and Jenn are genuinely the best team of people. Warm, supportive and amazing at making their clients feel beautiful. I am thrilled with my hair, this place is a special spot In Toronto.

I got my haircut and color done here, and I absolutely love how it turned out! They took the time to really consult with me about my hair and what would work best for achieving the color I wanted. The result exceeded my expectations. Highly recommend! They were also super nice throughout the process :)

I went to Joseph Head Hair Colour for highlights after a disappointing experience at another salon, and I am so glad I found them.

One thing that immediately stood out to me was that they offer consultations before booking a colour appointment. As a client, this gave me so much confidence because it allowed me to discuss my goals, ask questions, and make sure we were aligned before committing to the service.

My consultation with Joe was incredibly thorough. He took the time to really understand what I was looking for, answered all of my questions, and explained the entire process in detail. I never felt rushed, and it was clear that he genuinely cared about achieving the right result rather than simply booking an appointment. I was honestly sold after the consultation alone.

My experience at the salon exceeded my expectations from start to finish. Joseph and his team gave me the exact blonde I had been hoping for—bright, dimensional, and beautifully customized to my hair. The attention to detail, expertise, and level of communication throughout the process were exceptional.

I’ve been to many hair salons over the years, and this was genuinely one of the best salon experiences I’ve ever had. Not only do I love the final result, but I also felt listened to, understood, and completely confident in their expertise every step of the way.

I highly recommend Joseph Head Hair Colour to anyone looking for a talented, knowledgeable colour specialist who truly takes the time to understand their clients and deliver outstanding results.

RECOMMEND THIS AWESOME PLACE TO GET TOP NOTCH HAIRCUT AS WELL AS BEARD FADES!! TOTTALY WORTHS TO VISIT THERE/

Came here for first time really nice people and great environment. Would reccomend it for sure

name: Vintagesoulgeek
address: 279 King St E, Hamilton, ON L8N 1B7, Canada
reviews:
Fantastic place. So many great vintage outfits you can find. Most are ready to wear or could be an excellent corporation to a costume.

They carry men as well. If you are looking for classy old fashion things - this is the place to go.

The business is privately owned and cared for. Most of the items are family-owned, and articles are collected from the same family shopping addiction over generations.

Very cool story behind all of this.

The owner who runs the show is always happy and ready to help to find the gem you are looking for

I went to this store for the first time because I needed alterations done and my coworker sent me their story on ig. They had an event going on where a person named Kali was doing alterations, you could pay what you wanted and all the money raised goes towards a great cause. The owners were super friendly and kind. I walked around the store as I waited and they had such beautiful jewelry and purses. I couldn’t help myself and bought the most gorgeous vintage purse. Will definitely come back again. They have cool stuff and you can tell that they’re genuinely caring people

In the time ive lived in Hamilton VSG has been a great spot to vibe in and has given me some of my wardrobe staples. Besides being wholesome, fun, and as lovely as human beings go, they also dont try to charge more than things are worth. Ive never felt unwelcome in their shops, and ive never felt they were doing anything other than offering authentic and fair vintag/antique clothing. Thanks Guys!!

If you're hunting for some vintage treasures, there's not better place to find them than at Vintagesoulgeek.  It's a wonderfully eclectic shop that is run by passionate folks with an eye for great pieces.

I’ve been going to Vintage Soul Geek for about 3 years now, and it’s still one of the few places I trust for buying my sterling silver jewelry. I’ve bought things like rings, pendants, necklaces, and bracelets, and the majority of my pieces are from their shop. I’ve even bought the jewelry box I use to store my jewelry from there. When you walk into the store, you instantly feel the welcoming atmosphere. There is no pressure, no attitude, just genuine people who really care about what they do. The quality is solid, the prices are fair, and the owners are always welcoming and friendly. It’s one of those rare spots that keeps you coming back.
My new favorite vintage shop in Hamilton. Great clothes and huge selection of jewelry. Plus the owners are awesome!
This is such a cute shop! Lots of lovely jewelry and eclectic pieces. The man was very friendly and knowledgeable. Definitely recommend thrifting here 😊

Best vintage store I have ever been to. Hands down, globally. I came here for the first time probably 8 years ago and it made me fall in love with shopping second hand and the value of quality vintage. Every time I come in it’s like a big hug of fabulous treasure. The owners are incredible and have so much talent for sourcing, the care they put into this collection is obvious and cherished by anyone lucky enough to step inside. There isn’t a shop in London, Paris, Rome, Berlin, Florence, Madrid, Toronto, etc that makes you feel as good and has a collection like theirs! Shop for yourself here, bring a friend, buy your gifts here, just go in and appreciate the wonder. I love VSG 🤩

name: Signatures Restaurant
address: 453 Laurier Ave E, Ottawa, ON K1N 6R4, Canada
status: Fine French dining in a renowned setting
reviews: We had our Valentine's Day dinner here and it was delicious. Service was incredible. Food was incredible. The venue is absolutely gorgeous. We had an incredible time here and would definitely come back.
The tiramisu was the best thing I have ever eaten. I highly recommend this dessert. Also, our server Catherine was delightful!

Amazing experience. Food was art! Chef is an absolute artist, menu changes every weel which is amazing. Everything was so delicious specially the dessert it was divine. Staff are so friendly and helpful. Even chef came and say hi and we had a nice chat. Overall so good

This is an incredibly desirable destination. I have visited Le Cordon Bleu during both lunch and dinner times before the pandemic, and currently, they provide a list of events during dining hours.
The restaurant is conveniently located not far from downtown, with a beautiful park beside it and parking on the side that features multiple embassies. The atmosphere is fantastic, and the service is excellent. The place is consistently clean and classically beautiful.
The quality of the cuisine is remarkable, offering food that is not only extremely good but also unique. The portion sizes and presentation are well thought out, initially appearing average or slightly smaller, but this is a clever strategy that enhances the overall dining experience, providing unforgettable and memorable tastes.
While the lunch menu may seem somewhat limited at first glance, it is regularly updated, guaranteeing better quality. The prices are more than reasonable, offering a comfortable dining experience for a restaurant with 12 Michelin stars, shared among five chefs.
I highly recommend visiting this place for an exclusive experience that will be hard to forget. Your personal experience will undoubtedly speak for itself.
I planned a date night and it was lovely. We had a wide variety of dishes, we didn't feel rushed and we didn't leave hungry. I'm really glad we went and I'd go again!

Very happy to find Signatures open again, on the terrace only for the summer but I see inside also very soon. Food was as amazing as I remember. Service was friendly and always some one around to make sure things went smoothly. Lovely to sit out on the terrace.

Went for the August Elegance: Superior Cuisine Thursdays series where the students from the different specialties cook. I thought the meal was well-structured and had a lot of good variety. Service was friendly and the atmosphere was welcoming.

We had visited this restaurant a few years ago but was recently here as part of a special event.  Cocktails and canapes in the bar area to start and then a tour of the facilities, followed by a three course dinner with wine service.  Service was good, food was amazing as usual.  A little gem, not widely known.  One of only 3 restaurants as part of the Cordon Bleu school and the only one in North America.  How fortunate for those who live in Ottawa.

name: Parma Restaurant
address: 17 King William St, Hamilton, ON L8R 1A1, Canada
reviews:
What a surprise! I stumbled upon Parma before heading to a concert at TD Coliseum, which is a 8 min walk from the restaurant. Learning that it was open for about two years, I really enjoyed the atmosphere and the quality of the food. Flavourful and perfect portion.

We had the seafood linguine, risotto, and a sharing meatball (comes in 3 pieces, took the Pic after digging in!). Highly recommend the restaurant!

Highly recommend this spot for homemade pasta, with beautiful presentation and atmosphere. We tried the agnolotti and the eggplant rotolo. Both were excellent. We also enjoyed the Sicilian red wine on the menu. The restaurant has a nice wine and cocktail list, for those so inclined. The semifredo was a refreshing way to end the meal.

Parking can be tricky in this area. Sometimes you can get lucky with street parking on King William. There is also a large (paid) parking lot right across from the restaurant. Or. Many HSR buses stop just a few blocks away. Or. If you are near downtown, it is pretty walkable.

Delicious night out! The burrata was incredible. We had it with some in house focaccia and it was the perfect taste of autumn. The gnocchi was good but the veal parmigiana stole the attention of all my taste buds. Next, I’d like to return for lunch, to try one of the yummy, massive sandwiches that everyone keeps telling me about.

We went mid day (around 2:30) and had apps, pastas and a main. Madi was a wonderful server and helped us select a bottle of wine that paired nicely with our meal. We had the sharable bruchetta which was nicely prepared. Kind of like a tartare topping but If you don't like anchovies or fish you may wanna avoid this but it had a lot of flavor. We also had the primi polipo. This was very well prepared. The octopus was not chewy or over done and the combination of flavors on the plate made this one of my favourites. The gnocchi was light and fluffy with wonderful tomato sauce with plenty of fennel sausage pieces. For the secondi we had the orata. Again the chef did an amazing job the seafood was perfectly cooked on all fronts. Juicy flavorful shrimp nothing over cooked or rubbery. The sea bream has a perfectly crispy skin with nice juicy meat. I lived our experience here we had a wonderful and an amaro selected by our server. Everything was great.

This was our first visit to Parma. We were attending the Juno Awards and I was looking for a place close to the venue. Amazing! We had lovely cocktails to start and the warm focacctia and olives. For the main we both had the Agnolotti paired with a beautiful wine. The food was so delicious. As amazing as the food was, the staff were by far the most amazing part! From the moment we walked through the door we were treated like royalty. The hostess was so lovely and kind. Our server Maddie was on another level. She made our experience that much more special. She was attentive, funny and just a good spirit. I just can't say enough good things about her. Our first visit will definitely not be our last!

I’ll start with information about the food.

My colleagues and I ordered the tuna Crudo to start. The night before we had the tuna Crudo at persona, which is right around the corner from Parma. So we had to compare the two.

We all agreed that the cut of the tuna was better at Parma. However, the seasoning was better at persona. Not to say that the Crudo was bad. We just chose the other one as the better one.

I Ordered the orata Which is a dish of Seabass, shrimp clams and muscles. It comes with some leaks. I understand that sides come separate, but I still feel like there should’ve been some more greenery on the plate.

Once again comparing to persona. I had fish at persona the night before, and the skin was not very crispy. The skin at Parma was wonderfully crispy. I definitely think the Fish dish that I had from Parma was better than the one from persona. The only negative I have is that a few of my bites were a little bit gritty so perhaps the seafood was not cleaned as well as it could have been.

My colleagues mostly ordered pasta, and everybody seemed very pleased with their dishes.

We shared the chocolate mousse for dessert. Again, comparing to persona we had the chocolate dessert there the night before. The chocolate dessert at persona was definitely a lot better. The mousse here at Parma could barely be called mousse it was so dense. It was also slightly lacking in flavor. In terms of dessert, I would say it was very middle of the road.

The one thing that I would like to point out is that we came into the restaurant just after 7 o’clock. When we were being seated, I did mention that two members of our party were not with us. We sat down and ordered drinks and appetizers and then just before 8 o’clock. Our server came by to tell us that the kitchen was closing, and we had to place our main dish orders. I understand that we had been seated for quite some time already, but there was never mentioned of the kitchen closing, plus the other two members of our party had still not arrived. If there was a closing time of the kitchen close to guests being seated, they should be notified so that they can tell their colleagues to hurry up. Or even place orders for their colleagues so that everything didn’t feel so rushed.

We were only given about 10 minutes notice.

The ambience in here is very nice. I loved our oversize booth. My only negative about the interior is the bathrooms. It’s a little bit of a trek down a weird corridor, and it doesn’t seem to match the vibe of the rest of the restaurant, but it’s not a huge setback. They do have a bathroom on the main level for wheelchair access which I appreciate.

Been wanting to try Parma since it opened on King William. We went for my birthday, and it did not disappoint. First of all, the vibe in there is perfect, moody and romantic, and the espresso martini was one of the best I’ve had in Hamilton. Food was 10/10, the kind of food you dream of days later.

Highly recommend having your next dinner out at Parma! Make a reso, because it did get busy as the night went on, but 100% worth the wait.

After speaking to the owner ai learned why the sauce was soo good. The have a kettle downstairs that they use to make many sauces from scratch..  upbeat atmosphere.  I had the seafood dish and my friends had steak and potatoes with sides. We had drinks also.  Super friendly spot. I love when the owner comes out and asks you how things are.  Guy is from east coast by me.  They have a huge menu and will return.  Price suits the servings!

reviews: Have been going to Mark for over a year now. It’s always been a great experience. He’s able to fit me in on short notice, which is nice with my busy schedule. His cuts are always on point and has a good memory for the preferences I have around my hair style. The aesthetic of the shop is great, I always find myself looking at all the amazing picture collection of iconic singers displayed nicely on the walls. I have never left feeling unsatisfied and always feel like a million bucks (2 million in this economy) when I leave. Thanks for your great service!

Jay was absolutely lovely - I need a haircut that can handle both curly and straight styles. I can tell from Jay's handling of my cut he is a pro and really good at keeping your needs in mind. And love Rocky the pup! Great place

I visited this studio for the first time today, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. From the moment I walked in, everyone was so welcoming, and the space was spotless, comfortable, and inviting. The complimentary coffee was such a thoughtful touch, and the adorable dog wandering around the salon made the atmosphere even more special!

I had my appointment with Jay, and he was fantastic. He really took the time during the consultation to listen to what I wanted, offered thoughtful input, and made sure I felt comfortable every step of the way. I never felt rushed, and I left with exactly what I had hoped for.

One thing I really appreciated is that the studio caters to both men and women, making it a great place for anyone looking for a quality haircut in a friendly environment.

This review means a lot coming from me because I had been going to the same hairstylist since I was a little kid. Changing hairstylists for the first time was honestly nerve-racking, but now I’m wondering why I didn’t make the switch sooner. I only wish I had found this studio years ago!

I’m so happy to support such kind, talented people, and I truly hope this review helps more people discover them. They absolutely deserve the recognition. I’ll definitely be back!

Went in yesterday for a haircut with a very specific style in mind. Marc was very kind, friendly and patient. He knew exactly what I wanted and cut my hair perfectly. Definitely worth making the trip from Brantford! Loved the vibes. Marc made me feel very comfortable. Marc has great taste in music, and is very knowledgable. I had a lot of fun chatting with him during the cut. The highlight was meeting Rocky, who is an absolute sweetheart, extremely well-behaved, and the goodest boy :) Looking forward to my next haircut!

This place is a Hamilton gem. The name Rhythm Hair Studio is spot on and you'll understand it the moment you walk in. I  immediately received a friendly welcoming by Marc and his shop dog Rocky when I stepped through the door. The great music playing and cool art on the walls made for a comfortable and chill atmosphere.

Marc was incredibly friendly and professional making me feel like a regular on my first visit. He's very knowledgeable and took the time to really understand the haircut I wanted and advised on how to make it work. I got an all scissor haircut, which for a guy rarely works out at traditional barbershops. However, Marc knew exactly what he was doing with the scissors and delivered. name: utamami restaurant
address: 65 King St E, Hamilton, ON L8N 1A5, Canada
reviews: Had an amazing experience dining here the other night! Everyone working there is friendly and inviting. It's a new restaurant, so everyone is still learning as they go, but we loved what we ordered and can't wait to try more. My particular favourites of the night were the caprese, the zucchini torta cake and the arancini onigiri. Everything was fresh, cooked to our preferences, and beautifully plated. They have a good combination of creative fusion dishes and some comforting classics like the steak with crispy potatoes. Highly recommend checking out this special place!

My fiancé and I had a great experience at utamami restaurant. The staff were attentive and friendly. The service was quick without feeling rushed and whenever we have questions about the menu, our server Claire (I believe that was her name) explained it very well.

We got the bread and Momo Buratta as our appetizer. Seafood Pomodoro to share. Manzo and Bincho as our main. Tiramisu and Japanese Black Forest Ice Cream for dessert. We were very full at the end! Haha. Then for drinks, we tried the Nami and Yuzu Kaze Beer. I also added the Okinawa Spritz to taste. They were all tasty and beautifully presented. I’m a seafood lover so my favorite was the Bincho! Highly recommended.

Overall, my fiancé and I are totally coming back!

Wow! This place was incredible. All the food was fantastic. We really loved the carpaccio, duck breast, and the torta dessert. The service was also so good! Very friendly and attentive, and the recommendations were spot on for food and drinks. This place is perfect for a date night and for small groups. Very highly recommend. We can’t wait to come back!

This fusion combination is a breeze. It is not forced but natural. It amplifies dishes in a very nice and adventurous way. Tried 6 appetizers with 2 desserts. This place is for those who appreciate taste. Prices are very reasonable and service is outstanding by Axel. Carpaccio was delicious. The chips was a nice surprise. Both deserts were delightful.

What an amazing addition to Hamilton’s food scene! We absolutely loved every dish, every drink, and the service was fantastic.

The carpaccio was our favourite—hands down the best we’ve ever had! The octopus was cooked to perfection; it cut like butter and the flavour was incredible. Every bite was packed with such amazing flavours.

I’ll highly recommend this place to anyone looking for an incredible dining experience. I hope everyone gets the chance to experience this beautiful fusion of flavours!

The restaurant Hamilton didn’t know it needed!

Delicious and creative fusion cuisine, with tasty twists on familiar dishes. Appeals to many different dietary restrictions, so nobody’s leaving disappointed. We had fantastic knowledgeable service from Jeffery, and the cocktails were top notch too! Great beer, wine and sake options to pair with that incredible food. Portion sizes were great - we left stuffed - and price was incredible value for money.

Can’t forget to mention the atmosphere- design, lighting and layout all 10/10. An amazing job from Max & the team, the bar has been set, and already dreaming about the next visit!

Such great food and service! I had been waiting for them to open since trying their food at the popup and it was worth the wait. I can’t wait to visit again soon.

Excellent experience. Been seeing the restaurant for sometime while it was a pop-up and finally had the opportunity to enjoy this unique Japanese-Italian fusion. The main we shared was this most incredible octopus, great blend of spices with a bit of a kick and most importantly cooked to perfection. If you enjoy octopus you must try this dish!

address: 100 City Centre Dr 2 - 237, Mississauga, ON L5B 2C9, Canada
reviews:
Dear Ever New Customer Service,

I am writing to share my disappointment regarding my recent shopping and return experience with Ever New at the Square One store.
I purchased two items online and later visited your store to return one. Unfortunately, one of the items I received did not have the outer tag attached when it was shipped to me. As a first-time Ever New customer, I had no way of knowing that this would become an issue during the return process.

What was most upsetting was the way I was treated by the store staff. I felt as though I was being accused of having worn the item and being dishonest about it. During the interaction, the associate inspected and even smelled the garment in front of me, which I found both humiliating and unprofessional. Rather than being treated as a valued customer, I felt that I was being treated with suspicion.

To make matters worse, I was ultimately told that accepting the return was being done as a “favour” to me. This comment left me feeling embarrassed and disrespected, as though I had done something wrong when I was simply returning an item that had arrived without the required outer tag.

I also raised a separate issue regarding the 15% first-purchase discount. During my online purchase, I was unable to apply this discount. In the email correspondence below, your customer service team advised me to inquire about it in-store. However, the store staff did not honour the discount or provide any assistance regarding it.

This experience has unfortunately damaged my trust in Ever New’s online shopping process. Customers should not be placed in a difficult position because items are shipped without the necessary tags attached. If a missing outer tag can create issues during a return, there should be better quality control to ensure customers receive products in the proper condition.

Most importantly, I believe customers deserve to be treated with respect and courtesy throughout the return process. I would encourage Ever New to benchmark customer service practices from brands such as Aritzia, where customers are generally treated with professionalism, trust, and respect. No customer should be made to feel embarrassed, accused, or as though they are asking for a favour when exercising a legitimate return.

This was my first experience shopping with Ever New, and regrettably it will likely be my last. However, I felt it was important to share this feedback so that future customers do not have a similar experience.

Sincerely,

Elham Mohseni

I had such a wonderful shopping experience at Ever New! The store was beautifully organized, and the clothing selection was stylish, elegant, and easy to browse.
A special thank you to Aimi, who provided exceptional customer service. She was incredibly friendly, patient, and attentive, taking the time to help me find exactly what I was looking for without ever making me feel rushed.

I came yesterday with my daughter looking for a graduation dress for her and Aimee was such a sweet heart helping us out.
She picked the best options for my daughter to try on.

She was amazing looking for the right sizes and styled her in different ways and always asked if she was comfortable which i think was exceptional service.

The store overall was nice and tidy. The other staff were also friendly and gave their best and honest opinions.

I recently visited Ever New at Square One Shopping Centre and had an overall okay experience. The store has a lovely selection of feminine, elegant pieces — perfect for events, workwear, or dressier occasions. There were definitely a few standout items that caught my eye.
The staff were attentive, though at times they felt a bit pushy while I was browsing. I appreciate helpful service, but I prefer a little more space to shop comfortably. That said, the overall visit was still positive, and I’d come back to check out new arrivals in the future.
Jessica at Sherway was AMAZING. we shopped for wedding guest dresses anf she made us more than comfortable! Like shopping with a new sister! So helpful, attentive, knowledgeable and fun!

reviews:
I’ve become a returning customer because every visit has been a great experience!

The team is always welcoming, and I really appreciate how thoughtfully they recommend pieces that suit my personal style, color palette, and preference for natural fabrics.

I’ve also discovered brands and fits that work beautifully for my body shape, which has made shopping so much more easy.

A beautiful boutique with a lovely selection. Highly recommend!

I had not been in Erietta in some time, as it had previously been a bad experience, no customer service.  I now work up the street and gave them another try.
It is nice having a neighbourhood boutique with quality items, but they completely missed out on a new customer.
Right from when I walked in, I felt as if I was intruding on a private get together.  Both sales reps were assisting one customer.  Another regular came in and the get together continued.  At no time did anyone ask if I needed assistance or if I was looking for something special.
When I did try something on, no one approached to see how it fit, or ask how I was doing. I ended up going to get a different size on my own.  Something that should not go unnoticed in such a small shop.
Right upon entering, I felt judged and was ignored.  They will never get my business, and it would have been a lot!

This is the most beautiful store! The unique and gorgeous clothes, the welcoming owner and staff. I have been shopping here for years and years. I highly recommend. Go and check out their creative and colourful display windows in the Carrot Common.

This is a nice little shop with some good pieces. Unfortunately, I had a negative experience with a sales associate today while shopping for jeans. As a plus sized young women, I left feeling worse about my body than when I entered. This is not a size (or financially) friendly or inclusive store.

The associate immediately tried to upsell me from $100 to $260 pants and when I tried to explain my body and sizing concerns, she brushed me off and said I would be "smaller" than I thought. She proceeded to bring me a half dozen or so jeans to try on. Only one ended up fitting me and I wasn't a fan. She immediately said "well, you wanted straight leg, so.." like it was someone's fault. The best part was the entire time this sales associate was shopping for herself and trying to serve me, too.

Ultimately, I felt overwhelmed and ashamed about my body and told the associate I didn't want to try on pants anymore. She went from being friendly to ice cold.

It felt bullied. Not only did I leave feeling ashamed about my body (after asking her to size me correctly), but I was also treated poorly when I expressed my financial boundaries to her. I know my body best, not her, and she completely negated my concerns in favour for her own personal style.
What's more, I felt pressured into buying something I didn't want or like.

I, unfortunately, will not try to shop here anymore as the quality of clothes and service has truly decreased over the years. Size inclusivity proved to be an issue, too. I might have been persuaded to spend the extra cash if I was given pants that actually fit me.

Jessie (sp?) was so friendly and helpful in finding me a dress. I really appreciated her honest feedback while I was trying dresses on. She wasn't pushy at all and quickly felt more like a friend than a sales person. She was also super knowledgeable about the designers and gave me some background about them which personalized the sale of buying local. I will be back! :)

I've bought a number of dresses here, surprisingly high quality and excellent taste for whoever is placing the orders in this wonderful little European-feel like shop. Thank you! So hard to buy a dress that's feminine and compliments woman's body these days... they all look the same and are ugly in other places such as Winners... thanks, grateful!!!

I live 50 miles away. I also wear a leg brace which restricts what I can wear. I needed a basic black pant. Because I couldn’t visit the store, my extraordinary experience began. The staff were sensitive, knowledgeable and ever professional - Erietta is a select boutique and a real GIFT!

Terrible customer service. We were actually asked to move away from and gently shoved aside from the mirror while trying clothes on to make room for another, obviously more "important" customer. A $300 dress obviously doesn't include service in the price.

reviews: This is my first time liking any bubble tea.  Most are too sweet and artificial tasting.  This place has many great options and you can modify your sugar level.  I love their cheesy mango slush!  The cheese cream is so tasty and fresh and a great combo with the mango slush.  My friends liked theirs as well.  Even this picky dog approved!

Visited this bubble tea spot yesterday and left scratching my head. The service system here is... interesting. Both staff members refused to take orders until they finished washing ALL the equipment - even with 3 customers waiting. Would it kill them to have one person handle orders while the other cleans? The real kicker? When next customers walked in later, they suddenly became a well-oiled machine - one taking orders while the other prepared drinks. Curious prioritization there.

Now about the drinks: Their "signature" jasmine milk tea tasted like someone dropped a teabag in lukewarm water. For a place that claims these are their star products, that's just sad.

Staff acted like they were doing me a favor by existing. No smiles, just robotic movements and dead-eyed stares. At this price point, I expected at least basic customer service skills. Save your money and go somewhere that actually cares about both their drinks and customers.

Best bubble tea place in Ottawa!!! Staffs are always so friendly and creative💓 Drinks are absolute gorgeous! Staff told me the pink comes from natural dragon fruit juice! Tried almost everything on their menu. Can’t go wrong 5/5

Favorite milk tea shop in Ottawa! Love all kinds of milk tea, fruit tea, and slush they serve. The cheese mousse is the best in town. The baristas are always friendly and efficient. I’m able to DIY my own sugar, ice and topping. Great taste and service! Sometimes go to T&T just for getting the drinks😍
I was waiting from 11:30 am for them to open. Only to find out they were opening at 12:30 pm today instead. What a waste of my time, they might not open at the correct time posted in Google.

Very friendly staff and one of the best bubble teas I’ve had in Ottawa. Ordered the cheese strawberry slush and it came with a big serving of cheese and fresh strawberries. I ordered this because I’ve had a similar drink at a few places in the city - this one was by far the best. They also have popping boba which most shops in Ottawa do not have. Highly recommend and will come back to try more teas.

Ordered here twice so far and all I can say is I'm blown away with this bubble tea shop. Super convenient for a regular T&T shopper to get some drinks after hauling groceries.

The is a huge selection of drinks available and they all looked amazing. The service was quick and the baristas were kind. The drinks I have at other stores is usually filled with sugar, but the one I ordered today (peach tea with boba and coconut) was not too sweet. Boba and coconut was chewy, tasted overall fresh. And the cup is also sturdy, cute, and reuseable! :D

100/10 would come back for more. Also would recommended to those who want to get bubble tea with fresher fragrance and a good balance of sugar.

address: 663 1/2 Fennell Ave E, Hamilton, ON L8V 3G5, Canada
reviews:
I recently had an appointment at levels with Gabby, where I got the haircut and blonde of my DREAMS.

I have fine, but dense hair that is somewhere between curly and extremely wavy. Because of my finicky hair texture, I have left my hair extremely long as it never looks right after a cut. I’ve also been blonde for a long time, but when wearing my hair natural the blonde sort of disappears and I feel very brown haired (not the goal).

Gabby gave me the most amazing cut, where my waves/curls have been more pronounced, healthier, and with more definition and volume, while still keeping most of my length (and my long hair is my security blanket so this is important!). She also gave me the most brilliant, cool toned blonde that makes me feel very bright and blonde, even when my hair is curly.

The atmosphere of this place is great— super comfortable, Gabby is amazing not only with hair but with her clients; we had some great chats, but there was no pressure to be talking 100% of the time which is a relief to me as I enjoy the mix of conversation and also relaxing. Other stylists were fun and kind, very positive energy in the salon. You can tell the stylist genuinely enjoy what they do and working with each other, as there was constant laughter and just good vibes.

11/10 would recommend Gabby and levels hair salon. I haven’t felt so confident in how my hair looks in A LONG time, and it will be back!

I rarely leave negative reviews, but after sending a couple emails to the salon and not getting any response I feel it’s important to share my experience.

I booked a full blonding service with Gabby and was very clear about what I wanted: a warm blonde tone. I brought inspiration photos, discussed them during the consultation, and left feeling confident that she understood the look I was hoping to achieve.

Unfortunately, the final result was nothing like what we discussed. Instead of the warm blonde I requested, my hair turned out very cool-toned, with beige and almost white shades. Once I saw my hair in natural lighting, it became clear that the colour was far from the inspiration photos I had shown.

The service itself was also uncomfortable. Throughout the appointment, the application and removal of the foils felt extremely rough. My scalp was being pulled to the point that it became painful. I mentioned this during the service because my scalp was hurting, and although I was told more care would be taken, the discomfort continued. My scalp remained sore for the rest of the day.

I understand that bleaching can cause some damage and breakage, but I was disappointed by the amount of breakage I noticed afterward and by the overall condition of my hair.

What ultimately led me to leave this review was the complete lack of communication afterward. I sent a respectful and detailed email explaining my concerns and included photos showing both the inspiration image and the final result. When I received no response, I sent a follow-up email to confirm that my message had been received. That email was also ignored.

Mistakes can happen. Colour results don’t always come out exactly as planned. What matters is how a business responds when a customer reaches out with concerns. I wasn’t looking for an argument or trying to cause trouble. I simply wanted a conversation and an opportunity to find a solution. Unfortunately, I wasn’t even given the courtesy of a response.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this salon.

As its hard for me to trust anyone with my hair I thought I'd give Levels a shot.First time at this salon and I'll be going back for future haircuts. Gabby did my hair and was great to work with. She greeted me with a smile and asked me what I was looking to get done.I showed her what I wanted with a few tweaks here and there and she did a great job.We talked about how my last hairstylist did my hair and she kept checking with me to see if I wanted something changed.

A wonderful experience with Gabby at Levels Hair Salon. I appreciated the ease of booking the appointment online, Gabby was such a pleasure to have as a stylist she really understood exactly what I wanted and I left the salon feeling amazing.
I love this salon.  My stylist Gabbie works with me every visit to be sure I get the look I want.  She takes the time to discuss what is working and what isn’t.  I don’t feel rushed.
Amazing experience! Beautiful salon, and Catherine did a fantastic job. I showed her pictures of what I wanted and she delivered. Very happy with my cut. Would definitely recommend Levels!

I have been going to Sargon for my hair appointments before he even opened Levels, when he worked at his previous place of employment. As soon as he opened his own business, I followed him as a client. He is the best hairdresser I've ever been to. Every time I get my hair done it comes out more than perfect, exactly what I am expecting. Thank you Sargon for years of perfect hair <3
The salon is lovely and Sargon is a skilled very collaborative stylist, willing to try my crazy ideas!

address: 96 Hinton Ave N, Ottawa, ON K1Y 0Z8, Canada
reviews:
I’ve been to salon after salon over the years trying to find someone I could trust with my hair, because you know, one bad experience can stay with you forever. At a certain point, I just stopped trusting anyone.

But my wedding was coming up, and I really wanted to look back at my photos and love how I looked. I started searching again and came across Roger at Salon My Place and everything changed.

I actually waited to write this review until I had multiple successful and happy sessions with him, because I wanted to truly speak to his consistency and talent.

When I first started seeing him last September (2025), my hair was in rough shape, falling out in the shower, full of split ends, dry, frizzy, and overall just unhealthy. Fast forward to now, and it’s completely transformed. It’s so much fuller, healthier, and shinier, and I notice way less breakage in the shower. I didn’t think I could get it back to this point, but here we are ✨

Roger is the definition of consistent. He actually listens, understands long layers (which is harder to find than it should be), and somehow always executes colour perfectly. Every time I leave, I’m smiling and my hair looks exactly how I envisioned it, if not better, which hasn’t been my experience in the past.

For my wedding, I wanted my greys covered but still have that soft, chic balayage look, and he absolutely nailed it. The blend, the tone, the placement, everything was flawless. It felt elevated but still like me, which was so important.

Even though I only see Roger, the salon as a whole always feels so warm and welcoming. It’s one of those places where you immediately feel at ease the second you walk in. You can tell they really care about creating a calm, positive experience, not just rushing people through appointments.

If you’ve been on the hunt for a stylist you can actually trust, especially for colour and long layers, Roger is it!

I visited Salon My Place for the first time today. The salon itself is beautiful and has such a fun and welcoming vibe ✨

I had the pleasure of having Valerie do my hair, and not only does she make sitting in a salon chair for hours fun, but she is also an incredibly talented human who was able to bring my inspiration photos to life.

If you're looking for someone who's attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do, I would 100% recommend booking with Valerie!

I had an exceptional experience at Salon My Place from start to finish. The warm greeting upon arrival immediately made me feel welcome, and the level of care only continued from there.

Lava was fantastic—her attention to detail really stood out. She took the time to understand my hair and worked with my natural curls in a way that felt personalized and thoughtful. I absolutely loved how my curls looked when I left—full, defined, and healthy.

Even better, the cut and styling were done in a way that I can easily manage my curls on my own every day, which makes such a difference. Highly recommend for anyone looking for skilled, attentive service!

I have had a cut and colour with Taylor and she's fantastic. Takes the time to come up with a plan together, is a perfectionist who wants to get it right, and I've had the best bob haircut with her. Incredibly thoughtful and patient, and the salon in general is a really welcoming and relaxing place to be in.

Got my hair done here by Valerie. I’ve been seeing her for years and by far, she’s the best stylist I’ve had! She is so much fun and great at conversation. When I weren’t to her and told her I wanted a buzz cut, she talked me through it and helped me make the decision! She gave me length options and made sure that I liked the outcome. I’m so happy with the result!!

I’ve been seeing Taylor for over five years now, and I can honestly say she’s the best hairstylist I’ve ever had. Her attention to detail is incredible, and she really takes the time to listen and understand what you’re looking for. I trust her completely—so much so that I often don’t even have to explain what I want anymore. She just knows what suits me and always goes above and beyond.

Beyond her talent, Taylor is such a kind and genuine person. She makes every appointment feel comfortable, fun, and relaxing. No matter what style or service I go in for, I always leave feeling like the best version of myself. She’s worth every penny and more. If you’re looking for someone who’s not only skilled but truly cares about her clients, Taylor is the one. Five stars, always!

Taylor did an amazing job on my hair! It was exactly what I wanted which was lighter brown balayage and a cut with layers. It turned out beautifully! She also consistently checked in with me throughout the appointment to make sure I was happy with the service which I appreciated! Taylor makes you feel right at home and the salon itself is super cute and the staff were all very welcoming. Will for sure be coming back to see Taylor in the summer to lighten up my hair!!😊

Roger is my curly hair guru, for years (since 2023) I had been searching for a good hairstylist without success until March 2026 when I came to this salon. From the very first appointment, Roger listened to me and worked his magic. 100% reliable and professional!

name: Restyle Boutique
address: 59 Main St N, Brampton, ON L6X 1M8, Canada
reviews: My friends and I came here during the farmers market. The owner and her daughter were so welcoming and such a vibe! They are so sweet and fun. I will definitely be coming back for those white shoes I saw 🫶 lily is also the chillest doggy ever

Lovelyy customer service by Emma and Evie! My mom and I had a great first visit at the shop! Their selections are very versatile from vintage, early nostalgic, to modern fashion. Walked out with my new everyday bag! Will be back soon!<3

Omg! Emma and Evie are amazing! My daughter needed a dress for a wedding engagement party so we went to Restyle first before hitting the expensive stores in Oakville, Vaughan and Sherway.
Both Emma and Evie picked dresses for her to try on.
She found 4 options that were AMAZING and for her perfectly! She had to eliminate 2, ended up with 2 options that are already pre-shrunk, gorgeous, contemporary styles for a 26 yr old, and each under $40!!
Not to mention, I bought 3 dresses including a silk slip dress with the tags still on all total under $100 for myself!
If you enjoy shopping in the States but don't love the drive, check Restyle out! The deals will feel like you're cross-border shopping with our good ole Canadian friendliness!
Oh and don't forget the free parking across the street at the Rose Theater!

I came here on a whim to look for a dress for a wedding and am so glad I did! I ended up finding the perfect dress that I'd have easily spent triple on elsewhere. This is such a lovely family-owned shop, and Emma was super sweet and helpful. Thank you!
A great condignment business stocked with a wide variety of designer and other high end ladies fashion clothing, shoes and accessories.

Restyle is such a huge staple in downtown Brampton for small businesses. Evie and Emma are beautiful people who truly care about their customers. They are so warm and welcoming and make you feel like family. It’s the best place to go for reasonably priced items for so many occasions.

If you are looking for something unique for any occasion Restyle is your hidden gem. The lovely mother/daughter duo make you feel so welcome and go out of their way to ensure you find what you are looking for! Amazing collection of clothes and accessories! Love their dresses section! Take the trip downtown to Brampton to visit them, you will not regret it❤️

I have purchased 2 amazing outfits from Restyle. The ladies at the shop were amazing at picking things out for me as I don't really like shopping. Within minutes both times, I was outfitted in some beautiful dresses, and I received many compliments on both. The second outfit was purchased while I was in treatment for breast cancer, and they were compassionate and supportive during the shopping excursion. I've worn that outfit several times, and highly recommend shopping here. You won't be disappointed!

address: 663 1/2 Fennell Ave E, Hamilton, ON L8V 3G5, Canada
reviews: LOVE this shop! So many cool finds and Debbie is a sweet soul! This place is a must visit. You won’t be disappointed ❤️❤️❤️

Thought they had gone out of business when I went looking for their store on Concession after the plandemic. I saw my friend Roslyn’s post on Facebook and found out the store was now on Fennel Ave E. I Goggled the address and went to visit a few days before going on my cruise. To my surprise and great pleasure Debbie and I got caught up on so much in a couple hours and I came out spending only about $100 because of the deals! I even helped a couple other patrons spend their money 🤣. One of my favorite purchases was a clutch-purse with a crossbody strap which I wore daily while on vacation!!!

I have been shopping at Linseeds for some years now, since Deb had her store on Concession Street.  This store is so unique and has so many beautiful trinkets and purses and gift ideas for friends and family and myself!  Deb is also a kind business owner who gives back to her community!  Just one of the best businesses in the city of Hamilton 🩷

As an older woman my body changed, I became a bit more top-heavy and thicker at the waist, it was difficult to find clothing that fit and clothing that I actually really liked that was fashionable that was hip, that looked like I had money.  Linseeds boutique was a rare find for me it's a small boutique that has everything I love and everything fit me to a T.  The boutique was geared towards the elder woman but the more fashionable woman.  They have casual to dressy clothing, the clothing feels great and they look amazing.
If you haven't checked out linseeds boutique yet and you're looking for something special I highly recommend this store.  I'm not sure if the owner still works in the boutique but she is always there when I go shopping.  She is an amazing woman and will totally put you in the right outfits.  You don't have to spend an arm and a leg to look great at this boutique.

Words can't express how wonderful of an experience I had. The service level is beyond expert. I called for a gift certificate and was delivered the most thoughtfully and well put together gift bag with tissue ....beyond my expectations.  Did I mention they delivered at no cost, and made sure that it was recieved, just beyond. I'll be buying from here again....and again, thank you.

Website doesn't list any prices or expand on inventory.  Sent message 3 days ago and never received a reply.  Called for price and was too busy and didn't know price of their product, did offer a call back
Friendly service, wonderful product!  If you're looking to give a gift or even want to spoil yourself, chances are you can get it here.
Great store with a friendly proprietress! Great selection of reasonably priced clothing and accessories for ladies! ( I wish there was a men's version!)

name: Arstyla
address: 356B Richmond Rd, Ottawa, ON K2A 0E8, Canada
reviews:
I’ve been shopping at Must Boutique for a few years and I just love it! The pieces are unique, comfortable, and so easy to mix and match. My closet has slowly turned into a little mini Must Boutique of its own :)

Jessica, the owner, is super friendly and helpful, which makes every visit such a great experience.

I love that it’s dog-friendly too, so I can always bring my pup along 🐾

If you haven’t been there yet, you MUST go!

I visited Must many times alone and with various friends last summer.  I was looking forward to visiting the store again today as I had bought a few unique well priced items before.   First of all it’s Saturday and after 10 I see a sigh that store not open until 11 and a different name.  No longer Must.  Not the variety of clothes or the friendly atmosphere.   Not a lot to see.   Sad as I really enjoyed the store last year.

I highly recommend visiting Must Boutique!  The shop is so cute. There are so many pretty and good staple pieces that you need for your closet at great prices. I just found an adorable lace top and a pair of the most comfortable jeans that I have ever tried.  Jessica the store owner is usually there and is happy to help you put together some really great outfits. She’s lovely & has a great sense of style!

I love this store! As a person with little spare time, I was looking for a store to shop and avoid the big shopping malls. This store is the perfect place to shop for stylish business clothing in Ottawa and your everyday essentials! Plus, the owner, Jessica, is amazing. She’s personable and always able to help style you for whatever occasion!
Clearly the owner loves what she does - the selection is curated beautifully.

My friend recommended this store and I went today,  most of the stores in Westboro are closed on Sundays so I was pleased to find that they were open.  I am a size small and I couldn't find anything for my size.  The prices on the tag are confusing and the one size concept is not for everyone.  The staff was not helpful,  not a good experience.
There are so many beautiful and easy to wear clothes at this boutique-for a wide variety of occasions. The stylish owner is often there to support clients, and is very kind and helpful.

My sincerest apologies to Must boutique I recently did a review which was meant for MUSE. My sister was in from Paris and tried to exchange a blouse  and it was a very negative experience not only for her than they called me it unravelled quickly I am truly sorry thank you for correcting my error. What a difference one letter can make. I’ll be in today face to face apology - you didn’t deserve that review again I am truly sorry.

address: 982 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1H1, Canada
reviews:
I loved discovering The Citizen Room. The store has such elegant and unique pieces, with a carefully curated selection that truly stands out. You can see the great taste and attention to detail in everything, along with genuinely warm and welcoming service.
This necklace came from there and instantly became one of my favorite pieces. Quality, style, and personality all in one place. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for clothing and accessories with a unique identity in Toronto.

I highly recommend this place—it's like stepping into a fashion paradise. With a divine selection of unique and fabulous items, it's easy to fall in love. The prices won't break the bank, and the customer service is truly heavenly. If you're in the neighborhood, don't miss the chance to uplift your style and leave feeling inspired.
Paola was very kind and helpful, beautiful unique pieces at reasonable prices from Portugal and Italy. Highly recommend!

I fell in love with the beautiful assortment of European designs and couldn't walk away without buying the perfect outfit. The staff was incredibly helpful, and I felt at ease while perusing the racks and racks of high end clothing. Coming in from Montreal I was looking for something of this caliber. I'm overjoyed I found this store, and will be back again soon.

Visited this store today and was very impressed with their unique, beautiful clothes that are high quality and well priced. The jewellery collection is especially fab! Bought earrings and a pair of trousers - love them! Staff is super friendly and helpful - it was a lovely shopping experience.

Paula at the citizen room has curated a perfect mix of well designed, edgy and unique pieces from amazing designers. Pieces you wont find anywhere else in Toronto.

It has been my go to place for my personal wardrobe but also for my job as a stylist. A must place to check out!! Tell Paula I sent you :)

The jewelry and clothing was really unique and the sales associates were really nice and helpful! I bought some unique jewelry that I’ll wear often 😊 and I also liked the fact that everything was hand made!

I fell in love with this boutique today.  I literally could have just hung out here all day.  NOT JUST super funky, unique, fun, sophisticated  and original pieces but such a 'laid back' vibe, fantastic music and the owner/designer of house EVANGELISTA label is wonderful! One of a kind designs from Portugal, Israel, New York...so cool!

I highly recommend checking out this beautiful shop, you'll feel the love.

name: Hair By David & Co.
address: 477 Richmond St W #501, Toronto, ON M5V 3E7, Canada
reviews: I’ve been going to Hair by David and Co for a few years now. Jhade Castillo has been my stylist for the last 5+ years. The team is extremely kind, accommodating, and well-versed in their art. All my experiences have been nonetheless than exceptional! The team creates such a warm and welcoming space, and truly takes the time to curate a look tailored to your desire. I’d highly recommend them; one of the best salons in Toronto!! 🇨🇦🫶🏼

Jamila was wonderful! She was fast with the cut and overall appointment, but still took the time to talk to me about my current routine and gave me helpful advice on caring for my hair without trying to upsell me any products. She was also super gentle during the wash and shampoo, and overall just a joy to have working on my hair. I felt like I was in good hands and would definitely recommend her services.

Good work by JAMILA MILLER. She has been great the 3 visits I've had with her. :)

Horrible customer service by Owner David. He asked me not to return because I gave a feedback to ask him to address the noise one of his stylist named
Jhade Castillo makes at the salon while having conversations with her clients she is loud and not courteous to her environment around.

Totally unacceptable and unprofessional handling of the situation by the Owner.

Sad to know, they rather loose ongoing business than correct the matter internally and accept constructive feedback.

My response to Owner David :
If a client has never complaint in last 10 years about Jhade Castillo, does not mean there would not be a complaint ever! Instead of accepting customer's feedback, your blocking them off to boost your male ego. Your place is noisy and is rightly said so after careful consideration of 3 visits. It's not necessary everyone likes to overhear loud, unnecessary conversations. We are paying for service and not to be treated inappropriately at your salon.

Lastly, stop spying into your customer's personal and professional life.

1. I work for a company. I don't own it.
2. Mind your own business instead of spying on your clients.
3. You have made the forum very unsafe by sneaking into my personal and professional life and this is not acceptable!
4. Accepting constructive criticism or feedback would have been beneficial to you instead of accusing and snooping your customers.

My stylist, Mai, truly takes the time to understand my hair needs. When I had my hair coloured six months ago, she recommended products that have helped maintain the colour beautifully ever since and they’ve worked especially well for my thick, straight hair.

I recently visited her at her new location near the intersection of Richmond Street West and Spadina for a haircut and a treatment designed to boost shine and reduce damage. As always, she customized the cut to suit the length and texture of my hair, and the result was excellent. Mai consistently makes my hair look its best.

The salon is located on the 5th floor and benefits from an abundance of natural light and a nice view, making the experience even more relaxing.

I’m so happy I found this salon, truly the salon of my dreams!! Jamila gave me the most incredible wash, cut and silk press and somehow did it so quickly. I walked out feeling like that girl. Already looking forward to my next appointment :)

I am so happy with my hair by Jhade.   My hair was terribly neglected after my old stylist moved away.  I made my first appointment with Jhade and showed her a picture of what I wanted.   She deftly went ahead and made it happen.  Couldn't ask for a better salon experience.  The salon itself is relaxed and non-intimidating.  And Jhade is a gem!

Type 4 hair ladies, you're in safe hands with Jamila. I emphasize safe because sometimes heat styling can feel risky for those of us who regularly wear our curls, especially if you've had damaging experiences in the past.

She takes the time to properly prep your hair for each step with top notch products. The blow out alone was incredibly flowy and straight, and the press was the silkiest my hair has ever been. Given how straight she got my hair, I was mentally prepared for serious heat damage like I've experienced previously from another stylist. But thankfully, my hair reverted back beautifully! I literally couldn't be happier and couldn't recommend Jamila more! She's super professional, friendly, and gave great hair care tips and product recommendations as well!
Really enjoyed my experience here! Jhade was my stylist. Great work, super accommodating to what I was comfortable with doing, and loved her energy too. Will be back!
