name: Andaaz Social Kitchen & Bar
address: 3900 Grand Park Dr Unit e1, Mississauga, ON L5B 4M6, Canada
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, China Union Pay, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, VISA
reviews:
We had a wonderful dining experience at Andaaz. The food was absolutely delicious — rich flavors, well-balanced spices, and beautifully presented. The Veg Galouti Kebab, Paneer Tikka Masala, and Dal Maharani were outstanding, and the garlic naan paired perfectly with the dishes. Drinks were refreshing and well made too.
What really elevated the experience was the service. Krishnam S, our server, was extremely polite, attentive, and professional throughout the evening. He made sure everything was perfect, explained items clearly, and checked in at the right moments without being intrusive.
Great food, great ambience, and excellent service. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be back!

Good food, mouthwatering drinks, and a great overall atmosphere. The ambiance is stylish, seating is comfortable, and the Saturday DJ night really elevates the vibe, making it a fun spot for dinner and drinks. Customer service was excellent throughout the evening. The restaurant is known for its upscale Indian dining experience and weekend entertainment, which definitely adds to the experience.

We had the Rumali Roti, Cheese Garlic Naan, Dal Makhani, and Rice, all were delicious and well prepared. The Punjabi-style main course dishes can be a bit hit or miss depending on personal preference, but they do deliver an authentic Punjabi homestyle flavor profile.

Overall, a great place for a night out with friends, family, or a date. I’d return for the atmosphere, drinks, service, and classic Indian staples.

If you’re going to Andaz for the ambience, presentation and live music, this place definitely delivers. ✨ The atmosphere is beautiful, the presentation is impressive, and the live music adds to the overall experience.

But when it comes to the food, I felt it fell on the expensive side. The pricing and portion sizes just don’t seem to go hand in hand. For the prices they charge, I personally expected more generous portions and better value for money.

For example, we ordered the Masala Chicken Chop Chop, and there were only two pieces of chicken in the main course. Whether you get boneless or bone-in, the quantity felt quite limited for the price.

We also ordered the Mutton Rae’s, which was honestly tasty and the quantity was okay. I still felt the food was priced higher than what the portions offered.

For the breads, we tried the Pudina Lachha Paratha and Ajwain Lachha Paratha. They were quite small and, honestly, didn’t feel like the best lachha parathas we’ve had. We’ve had much better ones in Canada. The Chur Chur Paratha was a total no for us. 😅

Overall: Great ambience, beautiful presentation and lovely live music, but for me, the biggest drawback was the food quantity compared to the price. If you’re okay spending more for the overall experience and ambience, you may enjoy it. But if you’re looking for good portions and value for money, I’d say there are better options.

I recently visited an Indian restaurant and had a wonderful experience. The food was absolutely delicious, full of authentic flavors and perfectly balanced spices. Every dish felt freshly prepared and rich in taste, making it a truly enjoyable meal.
What made the experience even better was the excellent service.
Our server, Hazel, was incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional. She made sure we were comfortable, gave great recommendations, and checked in just the right amount without being intrusive.

Overall, the combination of amazing food and outstanding service made this visit memorable. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great Indian dining experience, and I’ll be coming back again soon!

I had such a great experience at Andaaz. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was absolutely incredible. The decor is stunning, the restaurant is beautifully designed, and every detail creates such an elegant and inviting vibe.

The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure we were well taken care of throughout the entire evening. Their hospitality truly elevated the experience.

The food was outstanding—packed with authentic flavors, the perfect amount of spice, and beautifully presented. Even the desserts were just as impressive as the main courses.

One of my favorite surprises was the live saxophone player. I had no idea there would be live music, and it added such a sophisticated touch to the evening and made the experience feel even more special.

Everything about Andaaz exceeded my expectations. Between the incredible food, amazing service, beautiful ambiance, and live entertainment, it's definitely a restaurant I would recommend—and one I'll continue coming back to (which I already have!).

Absolutely loved our experience at Andaaz! A special shoutout to Dikshant, who made our visit even more memorable. He was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu and gave us the best recommendations.

He suggested the Tres Leches dessert and the pan-fried dumplings served on the chef's special magic sauce; and wow, they were absolutely delicious! Those recommendations turned out to be the highlights of our meal.

Dikshant explained every dish so well and was genuinely friendly and attentive throughout our visit. He's truly a fantastic addition to the team. Amazing food, excellent service, and a wonderful overall experience. We'll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

Really good atmosphere. Great service,  quick and smooth. The place is expensive but it's worth up to some extent. Just that DO NOT order sharing plate (veg galouti kebab) if you're more than two, it comes with onky 4 tiny pieces for $26, and it was average in taste too. For non-alcoholic drink, i would recommend chai patti coconut drink or something like that, it was good. Overall a good experience, will visit again but just not that often because quantity doesn't justify the price at all.

We had an incredible experience here! The Indian fusion menu is creative and the flavors are absolutely spot on. The ambience is excellent—the jazz music creates such a sophisticated yet relaxed vibe. I also tried the mocktails, which were incredibly refreshing. A special shout-out to our waitress, Ash, who was so polite and charming. She truly made our Sunday special. Krishnam’s service was great too. Five stars all the way!

name: Tandoori Flame Brampton
address: 8150 Dixie Rd, Brampton, ON L6T 5N9, Canada
status: Huge buffet & a menu of Indian drinks
reviews:
We recently visited Tandoori Flame Brampton for a family dinner to celebrate a birthday, and it turned out to be an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

The food was absolutely delicious, with an incredible variety of dishes to choose from. Everything we tried was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. From the appetizers to the main courses and desserts, there was something for everyone, and every family member left impressed.

A special shout-out to our server, Simram, who was incredibly warm, attentive, and courteous throughout the evening. She checked on us regularly, made sure we had everything we needed, and her friendly attitude made our dining experience even more enjoyable. Excellent customer service like hers truly makes a difference.

What made the evening even more memorable was the birthday celebration. The entire team gathered around our table with upbeat birthday music, sang for our family member, and surprised us with sparkling fire poppers that made the celebration feel so festive and exciting. It was such a thoughtful gesture, and they made the birthday person feel genuinely special.

The energy, hospitality, and teamwork of the staff were outstanding. It’s clear that everyone works together to create a welcoming and joyful experience for their guests.

Thank you, Simram, and the entire team at Tandoori Flame Brampton, for making our family celebration so memorable. Great food, exceptional service, and wonderful hospitality—we’ll definitely be back and will happily recommend this restaurant to friends and family looking for a fantastic dining experience or a special place to celebrate.

When your Indian family members tell you they are taking you to the best Indian buffet, believe them. This is the absolute BEST Indian food I've ever had. Our server SIMRAN was amazing too! This is a must for every visit. @TrevorNoah, the next time you're in Toronto, you must try their CURRYYYYYY! 😊😊😊

I visited Tandoori Flame in Brampton with high expectations, but unfortunately it was a disappointing experience.

The restaurant appeared to be understaffed. Our curries arrived well before the rotis, and we had to wait quite a while for fresh naan while our food was getting cold. It really affected the overall dining experience.

The chaat section also had flies around it, which was concerning from a cleanliness standpoint. To make matters worse, the staff member at the tandoori naan station was rude and seemed uninterested in helping customers.

The buffet itself wasn't as extensive as I expected compared to other Indian buffets. Overall, the combination of slow service, cleanliness concerns, and poor customer service made this a below-average visit. I hope they address these issues because the restaurant has the potential to do much better.

Tandoor Flame delivered an absolutely wonderful dining experience. The food was excellent, and the service was warm and attentive. The buffet offers a wide variety of options, making it easy for everyone to find something they love. The desserts were especially impressive — truly delicious and the perfect way to end the meal.
The pani puri and chole stood out and brought an authentic touch that made the whole evening feel special and worthwhile. Everyone in our group had a fantastic time. The restaurant is spacious, clean, and beautifully maintained, which makes it ideal for large group gatherings and office parties.

Suggestion For Improvement: The jalebi and malpua live counter could be managed better. When the items ran out, there was no refill for about half an hour, and no staff member was present at the counter during that time. Since it’s a live station, more consistent monitoring would make the experience even better.
Overall, a great place with amazing food, ambiance, and service. Would definitely visit again!

Great food and excellent service! Harshita served us with a warm smile, was attentive throughout our meal, and made sure everything was perfect. The food was fresh, delicious, and arrived quickly. Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience. Highly recommend!

name: Desi Bar & Grill
address: 341 Main St N, Brampton, ON L6X 1N5, Canada
reviews:
Today I Tried Desi Bar and Grill recently and it was a good experience. We ordered a few items and the food was really tasty and the dessert made everything worth it

Everything was fresh and served hot, which made it even better. The flavors were proper desi style with good spices, not too heavy but still very satisfying. The quantity was also decent for the price.

The chutneys and sides went well with the food and added extra taste. Overall, simple place but delicious food and nice vibe with live music and polite staff around you. Special arrangements for hookah and alcohol too.

Would definitely visit again and i would suggest you to visit once and must try kadhai panner and dal makhni, moreover drinks are a bit expensive when compared to quantity although is tasty.

No doubt, the service was excellent and the atmosphere was lovely. We truly appreciate the effort the staff put into making our experience comfortable.
The only suggestion I have is regarding the kathal biryani — it lacked the authentic biryani flavor and could use some improvement in the recipe.

Not to miss, their honey chilli potato is to die for!!

Other than that, the rest of the food was outstanding. I would definitely visit again! 😊

We had an incredible meal here. Everything we ordered was presented beautifully and tasted even better.

The highlight was definitely the dessert, especially the brownie plated with a unique chocolate lattice design and flower petals. It was the perfect sweet finish to a flavorful dinner. Highly recommended for anyone in Brampton looking for a fantastic dining experience.

Loved the vibes and the food is amazing. Had paneer tikka, malai chaap and the honey chilj cauliflower. The top notch drinks are so refreshing and yummy. Sunpreet was the DJ and it was such a wholesome night. Can’t imagine before in Brampton.

We were there to watch the World Cup final, and it was an amazing experience! Anchal was our server and provided excellent service throughout. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. Her great hospitality made the match even more enjoyable. Thank you, Anchal..we’ll definitely be back!

Great ambience. It looks like they put in a lot of thought and effort behind the interiors and did a very good job.
My personal favorites are the bhatti wings and tandoori chicken. They surely don't know how to make nihari and it should be taken off the menu, but overall the food is amazing and it's worth going back. The customer service was very poor, especially on a busy Saturday night. I thought they were understaffed. And each time we ordered anything the servers would forget about it and we would have to order it again after 10-15 minutes. That's the only reason I have given them a four-star. I do hope they earn a five star from me in the future.

Me and my partner absolutely LOVE this place. Often we have gone to Toronto and plan to eat downtown, we look at eachother and say " let's go to Desi"

The atmosphere is great,  the service is impeccable, food is out of this world with flavour and spices,drinks are made properly. The manager at the Brampton location is amazing and treats his customers as if they were his own family, and the staff is super friendly.

100 percent recommend!!!!!

Been going for 3 years now and will continue to go!!!
A true testament to culinary diversity where all are welcome!!!!

WE LOVE DESI BAR & GRILL!!!!

It was great experence, Siddhi was our food and drinks server. I loved the location and atmosphere. Service and background music was amazing... food was okie 8/10. One of the best fine-dine places I ever went to. Really want to complement the background music... different than every other Indian restaurants.
Will be back for sure!

name: Modavie
address: 1 Rue St-Paul Ouest, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 1Y6, Canada
reviews:
Tre Fantastic! AMAZING! The food here is 10/10 and the atmosphere is just a great! The staff was friendly and helpful. We made reservations for 5:30 Wednesday night and was able to beat the rush, too bad the jazz band didn’t start until 7… we stayed for 1 song then left.

We had the filet mignon, duck and lamb burger… everyone was happy with their meal. The creme brûlée was delicious too.

These five stars go to our server, Taylor! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I visited Modavie with my cousin last Sunday (July 26).

We got a wonderful table right in front of the stage, which made the atmosphere even more special.

For appetizers, we ordered the French onion soup and the bone marrow. They were a little too oily and salty for my taste.

For our main courses, we had the mussels and fries and the duck confit. The mussels were one of the best I've ever had! The duck confit was also delicious and cooked perfectly.

I went on vacation to celebrate my boyfriend's bday and made a reservation to listen some jazz. From the moment we arrived, the service was wonderful. Our server introduced himself and gave us his recommendations from the menu, which of course we followed and he did not dissapoint!
The food was spectacular. The french onion soup was one of the best we've ever had, and the cocktails were excellent as well.
We will definitely be back, and we've already recommended this place to everyone we know. It's absolutely worth it!

We had a lovely lunch here. The atmosphere was wonderful, and the live jazz music made the experience very enjoyable. The service was friendly, and the presentation of the dishes was beautiful.

We tried several dishes so we could share and compare. The shrimp was probably our favorite. The garlic snails were okay, but not especially memorable.

A small suggestion for future guests: the house salad comes with quite a generous amount of dressing, so if you prefer a lighter flavor, you may want to ask for the dressing on the side. I also ordered the duck breast. It was cooked nicely, but I personally found it a little rich because of the duck fat, the sweet berry sauce, and the mashed potatoes together. If you prefer lighter dishes, the seafood options might be a better choice.

Overall, we still enjoyed our visit and would happily come back to try other dishes.

Very unique brunch experience. The duck waffle was something special, and the croque madame with lamb was insanely tasty - I honestly can’t even decide which one I liked more. Beautiful atmosphere, live music, and such a nice attentive staff. Definitely a place worth coming back to!!

We were traveling and absolutely starving when we found Modavie. Choosing a restaurant in Montreal can actually be quite difficult with so many options, but in this case, the high rating and large number of reviews definitely made sense.

The foie gras was absolutely delicious. My husband kept saying how perfectly it was seared. We ordered foie gras at several other restaurants later during our trip, but none of them were as good as the one here.

The duck confit was also very well done, and my mother really enjoyed the risotto. I ordered the lamb chops, which unfortunately were not my favorite. I personally didn’t enjoy the slightly burnt flavor from the marinade or sauce on the outside of the meat.

The atmosphere was very nice as well, and overall we had a very enjoyable dining experience.

Excellent service from Iman, guided us through menu and wine selections.  Normandy sweetbreads and rack of lamb delicious.  Beef tartare slightly under seasoned for my taste.  Live music on first floor was great.   Really enjoyed our experience here.

Best steak frites and onion soup we’ve ever had. The steak was so tender and cooked perfectly. Onion soup was flavorful and took the soul for a ride. The mushroom risotto was not too heavy and cooked perfectly. The backstage cocktail was a delicious take on an espresso martini and I plan to try and recreate it at home.

The host was incredibly warm and inviting. He gave us a cozy corner table with an amazing view towards old town Montreal. Our waiter was so warm and friendly, and we were well taken care of. Highly recommend and 100% will be coming back. Merci Beaucoup!

name: Dhaba Junction on Queen
address: 1779 Queen St E, Brampton, ON L6T 4S3, Canada
status: Traditional Indian fare in a casual spot
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, Discover, JCB, MasterCard, VISA
reviews: Hello everyone, today I have find out new restaurant since 1779 and it’s the best Indian fine cuisine. We ordered Dal makhani, Malai methi paneer makhana, tandoori roti, bullet garlic naan, masala papad, veg biryani and it’s the one of the best food I have ever had. Oh, about drinks must try fresh lime soda, you will like it. Our hostess Baani and Reet brought us complimentary Gulab Jamun, which was extremely sweet of her. I highly recommend trying Dhaba junction. Thanks

We usually visit Dhaba Junction on Queen on weekends for lunch or dinner, and it’s always a great experience! 😊 The restaurant has a lively vibe with loud Punjabi music playing and LED TVs available, which makes the atmosphere fun and energetic. The decoration and lighting are really beautiful, giving the place a nice dhaba-style feel. It’s also a great spot for group dinners because the seating is comfortable and spacious. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦✨

The food is always satisfying. One of our favorites is the **tandoori momos** – they are flavorful with a nice smoky taste. The **paneer butter masala** is rich, creamy, and goes perfectly with the **garlic naan**, which is soft and fresh. 🧄🫓 The **mango mojito** is refreshing and a great drink with the meal, and the **Oreo shake** is thick, sweet, and perfect if you like dessert-style drinks. 🥭🥤

A nice surprise during our last visit was that they gave us **complimentary gulab jamun**, which was warm and delicious. It was a really sweet gesture from the restaurant. 🍮

The staff are polite and welcoming, and the service has always been good whenever we visit. Overall, Dhaba Junction on Queen is a great place to enjoy tasty food, lively Punjabi music, and a fun dining atmosphere with friends or family. We definitely enjoy coming here on weekends and would recommend it to anyone looking for a good Indian dining experience! 🌟

Honestly, I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve been to Dhaba Junction — probably 15–20 times by now! 😄 Whenever I’m around Brampton, Mississauga or Toronto and can’t decide where to eat, this is one place I can go to without thinking twice.

Recently tried their Tandoori Chaap, Amritsari Kulcha Set and Veg Biryani, and everything was really good as always. Their quality and quantity have always been consistent. They have plenty of veg and non-veg options, lots of snacks, and I’ve tried quite a few of their mocktails too — they’re really good!

One of the best things is that they’re open until 4 AM, so it’s a perfect option when you’re looking for good food late at night.

I’ve already been here so many times, and honestly, I can see myself coming back another 20 times! 😄 Definitely one of my go-to places in Brampton. Highly recommended! ❤️

The service was amazing, all staff working was kind and attentive. Food was good, we tried the shahi paneer (very sweet), and their special malai methi paneer. We requested hot sauce with shahi paneer as we prefer it more mild which they accommodated. The sweetest part was when we were surprised with complimentary warm Gulab Jamun. This definitely was the highlight of our evening! Thank you for your kind service and great food.

Visited Dhaba Junction on Queen with family, and it turned out to be a really good experience. We started with chicken tikka mint and chicken tandoori, and both were on point flavorful and well cooked.
For the main course, we had bullet garlic naan and dhaba chicken curry, which was rich, flavorful, and honestly the highlight of the meal. Everything just came together really well. We also had virgin mojitos for drinks, which were refreshing and a nice touch.
Overall, everything felt just right good food, good vibe, and a great time with family. Definitely a place worth coming back to.

Vegan approved 👌

It was a rainy Sunday in March when it was still cold and rainy. We were craving paranthas, so we came to Dhaba Junction.

We ordered Methi, Mooli and Aloo, which were all good. We could customize them to not include any butter. The Methi one was the stand out, so crispy and delicious. Mooli was so finely grated it was a delight to have it. We customized the Aloo on for our child and it came with the right level.of flavor but without chillies.

We ordered the Soya Tandoori Chaap, which the chef was kind to make vegan excluding their usual dressings and still managed to make it taste really good. One of the best Chaaps we've had in GTA. 😋

The ambience is really good, lots of space for groups/families of various sizes with ample parking. Their staff wear T-shirts that say Haanji in the back, there is a lot of Dhaba decor that adds to the ambience. Our hostess Simran brought us complimentary Gulab Jamuna, which was extremely sweet of her.

Highly recommend trying the Dhaba out.

I recently visited Dhaba Junction on Queen in Brampton, and the experience was outstanding. The food was absolutely delicious, with authentic Punjabi flavors and generous portions. Every dish was fresh, well-seasoned, and beautifully presented.

What truly made the visit special was the excellent service. The staff (Simran) were friendly, attentive, and welcoming, ensuring that everything was perfect throughout the dinner. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, making it a great place to enjoy a meal with family and friends.

If you're looking for authentic Indian cuisine, great hospitality, and excellent value, I highly recommend Dhaba Junction on Queen. I will definitely be returning for another visit!

A little run down (like a dhaba). There's no exit sign or fire exit etc. That was scary.
The food was great and the service was excellent

name: Black+Blue Toronto
address: 130 King St W, Toronto, ON M5X 2A2, Canada
reviews: Third time here; first time we tried the beef wellington and it was fantastic, later we found out they had a special for that on Mondays. Then the second and third time was for happy hour. The oysters are fresh and $2 a piece, they’re very delicious! The steak tartare is my personal favourite. The mini Yorkshire’s are delicious but one is definitely sufficient (a little heavy but worth it). Hand rolls are fresh and yummy, seasoned well; wagyu hot stone very delicious & quite indulgent (7 small pieces, though yummy- $34 is a lil pricey). Calamari is delicious, would order again. House wines (both red and white) 10/10. Lychee saketini(?) was good after the ice cooled the drink down. Don’t order the fried chicken or the lobster roll; not worth it and not good lol- otherwise 5 stars! Tristan is funny and provided amazing service during our third visit.

Despite the crazy storm raging across Toronto last night, stepping into Black+Blue was like entering a warm, vibrant haven. We gathered as two families to celebrate a truly special milestone—our kids embarking on their university journey at UofT!

The food was beyond exceptional. Highlights for our table of five:

Beef Wellington: Absolutely divine! Tender, juicy, and beautifully encased in flaky pastry.

47oz Tomahawk: A total showstopper—cooked to perfection with incredible flavor, perfect for sharing!

Appetizers: Both the Steak Tartare and Beef Carpaccio were super fresh, rich, and impeccably seasoned.

Desserts: We wrapped up with the divine B+B Butter Cake and Dark Chocolate Torte. A heartwarming detail was that the restaurant surprised us by writing “Good luck UofT” in chocolate script on the dessert plate, which meant the world to us and the kids!

Our server Alison was attentive, professional, and made us feel so well cared for throughout the evening. Thank you, Black+Blue, for making our celebration so memorable. We’ll definitely be back!

I had a fantastic experience at black + blue. My partner took me here to celebrate my milestone birthday so I thought I would review the dishes we tried:

1. Jumbo cocktail shrimp: Jumbo and quite delicious - especially if you are a big fan of the Costco cocktail shrimp (which I am!). Never seen a shrimp bigger than this and the flavours were fantastic. Perfectly grilled with great sauce pairings: The presentation was also amazing as it had a dry ice effect which I thoroughly enjoyed.

2. Beef Wellington: perfectly cooked, and it was my first time trying a Wellington and it did not disappoint: The servers carve/serve a big Wellington into two for a very satisfying dining experience. Great cook (medium rare) and flavour on the beef, and the pastry was perfectly crispy and it was a fantastic first experience. I expected the sauces to absorb into the pastry and become soggy, but that was not the case. Although the portion served was quite sizeable - I would have loved an entire one to myself.

3. While I enjoyed both desserts, the Soufflé was the star! It was a dining experience in itself, and I would pick it 10/10 times vs the chocolate cake. The chocolate cake was heavy would be my only critique , as it tasted more like a heavy ganache cake that didn’t have the same balance as every other course served.

The service was fantastic, the ambience was lovely and I would definitely return for another fantastic dining experience.

I have to point out how good the apps are here however the steaks on the other hand were extremely disappointing.
We ordered the oysters which were very fresh, the crab cakes and sushi which was absolutely amazing. All were absolutely delicious and fresh. Our sides were equally tasty with the lobster mac and cheese,  romanoff potatoes gratin and asparagus.
When it came to the steaks the NY strip and ribeye. The ribeye arrive burnt and very unappealing which by the time I ate half it was dry, I had ordered a medium rare. The NY striploin was cook perfectly however it was one of the toughest,  chewiest piece of steak I have ever had. My wife couldn't even finish half as it due to how tough it was. Although our server was extremely friendly she did not ask why my wife left half her steak with zero interest in taking the remaining home and also didn't take notice to all the burnt pieces left on my plate.
If you're going to Black and Blue for their wine selection or appetizers, I would recommend this location. If you're looking for a more upbeat environment Black and Blue will also satisfy. However,  if you're going for the best steaks in Toronto, I wouldn't put Black and Blue in my top 5. I snapped a few pictures of our apps but when our steaks arrived and I saw my sad burnt ribeye, I completely lost interest and did not take anymore pics.

Signature Butter Cake - 10/10. This was divine. Must try/get. If you like dessert and a sweet tooth.
Beef Tartare - 9.5/10. Delicious, had two. Try it for yourself.
Surf and Turf - 9/10. The mashpotatoe was absolutely stunning. It was creamy and smooth.

Dawn our server - 10/10 was super attentive and funny!

Really love how there was a welcoming cocktail.

Will come again.

name: Pickle Barrel
address: 25 Peel Centre Dr, Brampton, ON L6T 3R5, Canada
status: Diner fare made with local ingredients
reviews: Sam, the server in the bar area is fantastic! He was not only attentive to us but we noticed the service he provided to all neighbouring customers. The brunch is great value and affordable priced. Spacious seating including patio dining available.

Went to The Pickle Barrel for an early father's day celebration. Our server, Dhillon, went above and beyond to explain the menu and provide recommendations with a smile. They were attentive and ensured we had everything we need and made our evening incredibly special!

We were sat in a booth where the light was permanently on the lowest setting, so it was very dark (server said it could not be changed, and did not offer to move us to another table). Our server was generally kind and obliging. But they didn't come back to the table very often, and we usually ended up looking for them and trying to get their attention.
Some of the items seem overly expensive for the portion amount, like the cauliflower app (almost $20). It costs more than the Hoisin chicken app, but  you get like a handful of florettes?..... But the $7 chocolate milkshake was the size of my head....?? I also did not get to choose the temp on my burger. I am not sure if their standard is always a hard well done burger, but it came out overly done and REALLY dry. I didn't finish it (the server also did not ask about it). One of the other guests I was dining with said the wings they ordered tasted fishy and didn't really have any other flavor outside of the sauce. The fries were good.
Flavored teas and lemonades are not mocktails.
I'd previously dined at a different Pickle Barrel location in London where the food was great, so I thought it would be a similar experience. Unfortunately, I would not choose to dine at this location again.

calamari sauce was good, but the calamari itself is bland and tough. the steak was good, perfect medium rare (even though i ordered medium well). the mash potato is very bland i had to add pepper and salt. the ribs my partner ordered was bland and stale.

4/10 for the food. would we go back? absolutely not

First time here, quick lunch /snack before heading to airport with friends...  place is very nice, everyone was nice, very quiet it was just after 1pm on a Monday
Food was fantastic, my Ceasar was perfect and the pickle was a great touch
a server was cleaning off a table and dropped some cutlery right by us, the ringing was a bit irritating when it dropped on the floor but it was how she handled it. Just ignored it lol , I guess it didn't happen

We enjoyed our visit

name: Crew Collective & Cafe
address: 360 Rue Saint-Jacques, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 1P5, Canada
reviews:
I had a great experience at Cafe Crew Cafeteria overall. The atmosphere was welcoming, the food tasted fresh, and the staff were friendly. Everything looked well prepared and flavorful.

The only thing I would mention is that the portion sizes felt a little small compared to the prices of the food items. The quality is definitely there, but slightly larger portions would make the experience even better.

That being said, the pecan pie was absolutely incredible. Honestly the best pecan pie We’ve ever had. Perfect flavor, fresh, rich, and not overly sweet. It completely made our visit memorable and is something we would definitely come back for again.

One of the most stunning cafes I've ever visited!

Crew Collective & Café is housed in Montreal's former Royal Bank headquarters (built 1926). Walking in feels like entering a cathedral — 50-ft gold ceiling, marble floors with the original bank emblem, brass chandeliers, and old-school teller counters. Absolutely breathtaking.

We ordered avocado toast and smoked salmon bagel — simple, fresh, and perfect for a relaxed breakfast. Sitting in this century-old banking hall, sipping coffee and soaking in the grandeur, was such a vibe.

Pro tip: Check opening hours — they're closed on Saturdays!

This is a gorgeous cafe as it used to be a bank.  Good atmosphere and definitely photogenic.  In terms of food, it was so so.  Cold brew coffee is so weak, I feel like drinking colored water.  Chocolate croissant with very little chocolate. Almond croissant has good taste, but those croissants are not airy, no layers, not the type of croissant we expected.  For service, they only have 1 counter, 1 staff takes orders from every single customer. This staff also serves pastry and drinks.  That's why the line there is unnecessarily long.  The hostesses were busy chit chatting to themselves, waste of manpower of doing nothing.
Many people praise this cafe, probably due to the atmosphere and the stunning building.  I don't think it worth the time to line up for food there but worth to visit for pictures only.

Crew Collective & Café is worth a visit. I loved the concept and how they preserved the beautiful historic building. The space is stunning and has a really unique atmosphere. I had the pistachio latte and the amandine, and both were delicious. I would definitely come back but there is always a line up here.

Crew Collective & Café is one of the most beautiful cafés in Montréal, located inside the historic Royal Bank building in Old Montréal. The grand banking hall, huge windows, high ceilings, and ornate details make the interior feel more like a historic landmark than a café.

The coffee and food are good, but the architecture and atmosphere are the real reason to visit. Definitely worth stopping by even just for a coffee and to admire the building.

One of the coolest cafés I’ve ever been to. Set inside a beautifully restored former bank, the architecture alone makes it worth visiting. The high ceilings and grand interior create such a unique atmosphere.

The food was just as impressive. I had the turkey sandwich which was fresh and delicious, paired with an excellent iced coffee. It’s the perfect spot for a relaxed brunch, catching up with friends or getting some work done. A must visit when you’re in Montreal.

We went to the Crew Collective & Café, located in the historic former Royal Bank of Canada headquarters in Old Montreal. The building was completed in 1928 and is widely recognized for its stunning and intricate architecture, featuring high ceilings and opulent design elements. The space was adaptively reused, turning the grand banking hall into a combination of café and co-working space while preserving the original architectural details.

The Crew Collective & Café serves a variety of specialty coffee drinks like Classic Espresso, including Matcha Lattes and a selection of breakfast/ brunch items such as freshly baked pastries, Avocado Toast, Grilled Cheese Sandwiches, Chicken Ciabatta Sandwiches, Pecan Pie, Danishes, Bagels, Artisanal Cookies, Croissants and a range of delicious baked goods. We enjoyed our teatime moment here!

This is one of the best cafe I’ve ever been to. Be it food or ambience, this one is simply the perfect. We ordered:
1. Flat White Coffee: 5/5
2. Latte à la Pistache: 5/5
3. Danoise Epinard Ricotta: 5/5 : This one was savoury and not sweet. Must try.
4. Shokupan French toast: 5/5 : I want to eat it everyday now.
5. Avocado Toast: 5/5

As the cafe is in a historical bank building, the ambience is grand. There was a queue and we had to wait for around 25 minutes to place our order. The wait was totally worth it though. It’s not easy to get the seats but if you keep on looking, you can get it. Overall, I would totally recommend this cafe to everyone.

name: King's Chair Barbershop
address: 50 Bristol Rd E Unit 501A, Mississauga, ON L4Z 3K8, Canada
reviews:
Thank you, Kings Chair Barbershop!

I had a wonderful experience. The front desk ladies are very kind, respectful, and provide excellent customer service. Especially Sofia, who always does her best to accommodate customers and help in any way she can.

Barber Zeid provides the best haircuts with great professionalism, patience, and attention to detail. I truly appreciate the amazing service and highly recommend Kings Chair Barbershop!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
My husband got his haircut at King’s Chair Barbershop, and we had an excellent experience! The shop is brand new, clean, and has a welcoming atmosphere. The barber was skilled, professional, and paid great attention to detail. My husband is very happy with his haircut.

The owner was also very accommodating, friendly, and made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. You can tell they genuinely care about providing great customer service.

If you’re looking for a quality barber in East York, I highly recommend King’s Chair Barbershop. Wishing the team continued success with their new business—we’ll definitely be back!

I’ve been to a lot of barbers over the years, and this was easily one of the best experiences I’ve had. The attention to detail, professionalism, and overall atmosphere were top-notch. My barber  took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and delivered a clean, sharp cut that exceeded my expectations. The fade was smooth, the beard work was precise, and the service never felt rushed. You can tell they genuinely care about their craft and their clients. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable barber who consistently delivers quality work. I’ll definitely be coming back. Thank you Alyouesif

It was my first time visiting this barbershop, and I had a great experience. Adam was very friendly, professional, and took the time to understand exactly what I wanted. He gave me an amazing haircut, and I couldn’t be happier with the result. The whole experience was comfortable and welcoming from start to finish. I’ll definitely be booking with Adam again going forward. Highly recommend!

I had a haircut and a hot towel shave at Kings Barber in Mississauga, and it was honestly one of the best barber experiences I've had.

Muslum was my barber, and he did an amazing job. He was professional, friendly, and took his time to make sure everything was done perfectly. He paid attention to every detail, didn't rush the appointment, and made sure I was happy with the haircut throughout. The hot towel shave was excellent very relaxing and finished with great precision.

The entire team at Kings Barber was welcoming from the moment I walked in. Everyone was courteous and professional, and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting. The shop itself was spotless, with a strong focus on cleanliness and hygiene, which I really appreciated.

It's not often you find a barbershop where the service, professionalism, and customer care are all consistently top-notch. If you're looking for a barber who genuinely cares about delivering quality work, I highly recommend booking with Muslum. I'll definitely be coming back!

name: Serano Bakery
address: 830 Pape Ave, East York, ON M4K 3T5, Canada
reviews:
This is a superb Greek and Turkish bakery with an impressive and almost overwhelming variety of treats to choose from.

Walking into their section on the right side feels like stepping into a baklava wonderland, filled with beautifully layered, syrupy pastries and a wide range of traditional sweets.

There is also a wonderful selection of cream-filled sponge cakes that are rich yet light, making them very enjoyable.

The refrigerated section is equally enticing, offering Middle Eastern favourites such as galaktoboureko and loukoumades, alongside elegant French pastries like mille-feuille and éclairs.

Beyond the desserts, the shop also carries a thoughtfully curated selection of cheeses and European packaged goods, including coffee, spices, and pastas. Everything is well presented and inviting.

The overall atmosphere is warm, charming, and almost magical, honestly giving me the same kind of delightful feeling as meeting someone special for the first time!

Amazing bakery with a grocery area.  Long standing since 1994.  Place smells amazing.  Everything is so fresh.  Very friendly staff.  Some employees speak Greek.  There is gelato available as well.  Very clean store.  Call ahead for special orders.  Prices are okay.  No credit card surcharge.  Take out only.

This is the bakery of European pastries- not to be confused with the cafe, bakery operational since 1994 by Greeks and still the staff is greek speaking and same family.

Remember to pick up a number when you enter, they follow this order or it would be chaos

You will be distracted by all the cakes, pies, cookies, lukumades, frozen spanakopitas (even vegan) in the fridge

The staff is so friendly & helpful, just asks them what you need and they will find a similar thing- I can’t help but come by for a new treat when on the east side of town

Serano Bakery made the cake for our wedding. They did an amazing job of creating our dream cake based off of the design we wanted. They really out did themselves this time. The cake was so beautiful and very delicious. Great quality cake for a good price (we know how expensive wedding cakes can be). You cannot go wrong with Serano. Staff were very friendly and helpful.

What an actual gem this bakery is. Ethical business for pricing their cakes so well. I got a whole round mango cale for my friend’s birthday, and its not even taxed when its a whole cake. Love love love, will come back even though I’m on the other side of Toronto

name: Fran's Restaurant
address: 200 Victoria St, Toronto, ON M5B 2R3, Canada
reviews:
This was a great spot to grab an affordable and filling breakfast near the Pantages hotel that we were staying at. It was a lot of food that we got for $12.99 a plate! The atmosphere and vibe was great as well, especially being seated in a secluded and quiet area in the restaurant. Our server was extremely friendly and upbeat which also added to the experience.
My only note is that our seating looked dirty, but this was not a big issue.

This place reminded me of an understated allô mon coco. A great stop for brunch or lunch with a group. The pricing is good and portions larger than expected. I basically ate one meal for the entire day. There are some clearly marked vegetarian options available. I tried The vegetarian eggs benedict. It was excellent but I'd recommend it to be split for those who tend to eat smaller portions. The staff were super friendly and attentive. The experience was very enjoyable. Would return in future.

I tried breakfast at Fran’s today and it was a really nice experience overall. The food was good, and the whole place has a warm nostalgic vibe.

It was quite busy, so the service felt a bit fast-paced, but the staff were friendly and the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. The portions were generous, and the breakfast itself was satisfying.

It’s definitely one of those spots worth trying at least once for the nostalgia and unique diner feel. I’m glad I experienced it — a classic place that gives you a little taste of Toronto’s history..

Unfortunately,  this diner in the heart of downtown has seen better days.  No A/C and the restaurant feels like a construction site.  Warm water, eggs overcooked, waited a while for cutlery and a strange bathroom situation where you seem to be leaving the building. Better options available.

Popped in after our show because I've heard so many things about this place. It wasn't over busy so we were seated right away.

The atmosphere was good, relaxed and down to earth. Our waitress was good 👍🏾 friendly. The service was pretty quick foe our food.

My friend ordered a plain burger and asked for a salad on the side as she cannot eat potatoes. That was a 3.75 uncharge.

I ordered the chicken and waffle 🧇 and I have to say I was extremely disappointed 😞
The chicken should've been called batter with a hint of chicken and it's supposed to be spicy......still looking for the taste of spice anywhere.

The waffle was pretty thin. I spent more time stripping the batter down because it was all dough. My plate was picked up with a side of batter.

We ordered a slice of the colossal carrot cake and again super disappointed. The thinnest slice of cake, the price point for the cake is not worth it.

My friend and I thought it would be a big enough slice to share. Nope.

My friend liked her burger (she's on a special diet so she is limited in what she can eat) but my entire meal left me unfulfilled and eating when I came home later on.

name: Kyo Bar Japonais
address: 711 Côte de la Place-d'Armes, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 1K9, Canada
reviews:
We visited Kyo Bar Japanese close to closing time, and the staff let us know that we had about 10 minutes to place our order, which we appreciated.

I ordered the Yaki Udon because the photos online looked delicious, and it absolutely lived up to my expectations. It was incredibly flavorful, perfectly cooked, and pleasantly spicy. It was definitely my favorite dish of the meal. I also had hot sake, which was excellent.

For sushi, I ordered the Hokkaido Roll and the Rainbow Roll. The Hokkaido Roll was outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and my favorite sushi of the evening. The Rainbow Roll was also very good. My friend enjoyed the Chef’s Choice rolls, and another friend had the Unagi Roll, which was also delicious.

The food was beautifully presented, everything tasted fresh, and the overall ambiance of the restaurant was very nice.

The service at the table was good, but the first impression could have been better. The hostess at the entrance wasn’t particularly welcoming and came across as quite serious.

One thing that could be improved is the menu consistency. The menu displayed outside the restaurant didn’t match the menu inside, and it also didn’t seem to match the menu online. It made ordering a little confusing, so I’d recommend checking the restaurant’s website before your visit.

Overall, we had a great meal and would definitely come back. The Yaki Udon and the Hokkaido Roll alone are worth returning for.

Really enjoyed all the food items here. Everything was cooked to perfection. Hard to find places that can cook calamari to the right temp. The atmosphere was nice outside. Live music playing down the street. I really loved the lamb chops. Also cooked to perfection. Our server Margaux was also very nice. Warned us that we ordered a lot of food. We thought we would take home but everything was too good so we just finished it there. Sushi was good too. Creative and flavourful rolls. Highly recommend coming out here with friends

A cute Japanese restaurant in a very ideal location in Montreal! I hosted a big bachelorette dinner here with 15 girls, Kyo was very easy to communicate with, and they offered multiple menu options at varying reasonable price points. I really appreciate the ease of booking and how I didn’t have to think about what people were going to order. One hiccup was that I had indicated ahead of time that one of the guests had a seafood allergy, which I understand can be difficult for Japanese restaurant. I had expected them to tailor the $70 menu to her, however, they let us know that it was gonna be difficult and instead asked her to pick from the à la carte menu. She had no problem with this, but I felt bad and didn’t want her to think that I had an indicated ahead of time of her dietary restriction.

Overall, the meal was good. It was a little bit slow to start coming out. I think our total dining time was over two hours which was fine because we were celebrating something but for the first 30 minutes I feel like no food came out. A little bit on the salty side, but I enjoyed every dish. For the price point I think it was perfect.

I would recommend this for a group dinner again. The high top tables weren’t the most comfortable for such a large group as we were essentially split in two, but for a group of 6-8 it would be perfect!

Great atmosphere paired with attentive and welcoming service made for an enjoyable dining experience overall. The food was solid, with the udon standing out as particularly delicious—well-prepared and full of flavor.
The salmon poke bowl, while fresh, felt a bit underwhelming compared to others I’ve had. A few additions like kimchi, avocado and onion could really elevate the dish and bring more depth and balance.

Overall, a pleasant spot with strong service and standout dishes, with just a bit of room for refinement on certain menu items.

We happened to find this restaurant for dinner after visiting Notre Dame Church.
And since we didn't make reservations before, we got a table outside, but that's exactly what we expected! Haha.
We had dinner while looking at the beautiful Notre Dame church!

And the food we all ordered was delicious! Gyoza wagyu, pork ribs, tempura, even white rice is very tasty!

So happy to find this restaurant!

name: Brasserie 701
address: 701 Côte de la Place-d'Armes, Montréal, QC H2Y 2X6, Canada
reviews:
Okay I’m being generous with my 3, I have reviewed a lot of places good and bad. This is a reason I have 3.3million views of my reviews and am in the top 5% of global google reviewers.

1st the good
1) Taste of the food was good, well seasoned
2) Beautiful Atmosphere

The Bad -
1) I understand I was only one customer at the time of visit but that is no excuse for poor service, more in the breakdown.

2) Food came out cold, the butter didn’t even melt, clumped up on my steak and my veggies all cold.

3) Back to the service - Was missing a steak knife and the side sauce. Halfway through when a different sever saw that I was using a table knife and was missing my sauce corrected the issue then.

4) When ordering the most expensive thing on the menu and only being one person, it only takes 5 secs on your way past to make sure everything came out the way it was ordered.

5) As I’m being brought the bill is when I was finally asked how it was. Which I basically stated what I just wrote, I got back I will pass on your feedback.

So I too am just passing on the feedback. It was a shame, I was looking forward to this location.

This place was beautiful. The atmosphere is elegant and welcoming. The noise level is great for conversation. We really appreciated that it wasn't loud. They made my great uncles celebration very special. Service was excellent, she was attentive by topping up our wine when needed, a dish came out a bit cold they recooked the whole plate quickly enough, she also brought out a surprise desert with sparkler. Food was excellent! The food was seasoned perfectly and everyone in our party was happy with taste and presentation. We tried the duck, octopus, Arctic char and lamb, plus a few desserts. Pavlova is incredible. Thank you again for a special evening.

Stunning restaurant with beautiful decor. Unfortunately the good ends there like what many people said. We came here for brunch on Sunday and service was very slow and we had to follow up a couple times or go to the bar ourselves to get something . Drinks took 30 minutes to come and food was mediocre and not that impressive for hotel quality. The omelette was quite bland. The avocado toast was OK, but nice vinaigrette on the salad. The chocolate croissant was delicious though. Hopefully management takes this feedback & improve their service efficiency in the future.

We had an amazing dinner 🍽️ at Brasserie 701, right in front of Basilica Notre-Dame De Montréal. This is our second visit to this restaurant located inside the hotel. We always get thrilled with the ambience inside. Me and my wife ordered Beef 🥩 Bourguignon for the main course and a cocktail 🍸
The beef was well cooked and it was yummy. Nice aroma of the spices. We both enjoyed it. We highly recommend to make reservations in advance as it is always packed. In addition, I would also recommend to dress casually/professionally, rather than wearing shorts or junky-cut dresses (I saw some people wearing that, which I found a bit unethical). I always wear three piece suit for a candle 🕯️ light dinner 🍲 with my wife. Will visit again in the future. Merci beaucoup.
this was such a good brunch spot. our server adelle was so sweet and all the staff were so accommodating. the food was so good we loved the avocado toast and pancakes.

name: Canoe
address: 66 Wellington St W 54th floor, Toronto, ON M5K 1E9, Canada
reviews:
Canoe is one of those Toronto restaurants where the setting genuinely becomes part of the experience. The panoramic views over the city and CN Tower are spectacular, particularly around sunset, and the dining room manages to feel elegant without becoming overly formal.

The food matched the setting beautifully. We particularly enjoyed the oysters, which were exceptionally fresh, as well as the fish course, beautifully cooked and well balanced. Desserts were another highlight, both in presentation and flavour. The menu has a strong Canadian identity while still feeling contemporary and refined.

Service throughout the evening was attentive, knowledgeable and well paced, giving us plenty of time to enjoy both the food and the view.

A memorable Toronto dining experience and somewhere I would absolutely recommend for a special evening in the city.

Gorgeous seat at the window, extremely calm and high style room, comfy seating, and an attentive staff make this resto a classic. Lunch today from the summerlicious menu was terrific. Plated beautifully, interesting tastes, textures, colours, and choices.
I had a mushroom soup and loved the rich flavour and lovely texture, next  the tuna was heavenly. A bit too soupy for my taste, after a soup, but gorgeous flavour. To finish, I kept it simple with a cheese plate. Lovely.
Can't recommend the experience more highly.

A great visit for the views alone. Food was good but nothing really stood out for me. Steak was cooked perfectly for medium rare, but it lacked flavor. Would definitely recommend this for a summerlicious, but I don't know if I would go again

Outstanding restaurant for an enchanting evening. The view is simply phenomenal. A smorgasbord for the senses. Michelle, our server, expertly blended professionalism with approachability. Hats off to her. The food was fine but nothing knocked our socks off, although there was a traditional pie dessert that was sublime. The lamb and halibut were well prepared but not exceptional. That said I would return to Canoe. On balance it is a restaurant you do not want to miss.

Kristen in the front and Jesús at the table were extremely helpful as the rest of the staff. I came here with family (3 adults, myself, and a toddler) They were accommodating, the food was delicious. I came here as a celebration for my graduation, and they had customized notes and all staff had known about it and congratulated me. It's my family's first time in Toronto, and they loved it here.

We had an absolutely wonderful experience at Canoe Restaurant in Toronto. From the beautiful setting and stunning views to the exceptional service and incredible food, everything was outstanding.

Every dish was beautifully presented and full of flavour, and you could really taste the care and attention that went into each one. The asparagus and pea salad in particular was absolutely delicious.

The atmosphere was elegant without feeling stuffy, and our entire evening felt very special. The service was attentive, friendly and professional from start to finish.

Canoe is definitely one of those restaurants that lives up to its reputation. We thoroughly enjoyed our evening and would highly recommend it for a special dinner in Toronto. We will definitely be back!

One of Torontos most iconic Restuarant with a view! Went for the tasting Menu, was good, definitely couple dishes weren’t as tasty or fresh in the tasting menu in my opinion still, (Atlantic crab and the halibut) still unique overall. The mussels in the 2nd course and the beef tenderloin were incredible! Desserts were also good. The atmosphere and service was great, shoutout David my server. Would definitely still recommend this restaurant for the view, service and attention to detail when it comes to the food.

Canoe was incredible! We went to celebrate our anniversary and they had a nice little card on our table. All of the staff were friendly, knowledge about the menu, and made us feel very special. The food was incredible. We ordered the scallop en croute, which was the best scallop that I have ever had. For entres we ordered the stuffed lamb saddle and the wild bc halibut, with the chicken salt fries on the side, all of it was outstanding. And the screeched tarte au sucre for dessert was good. The experience was definitely worth the cost.

name: Byblos Downtown
address: 11 Duncan St, Toronto, ON M5V 3M2, Canada
reviews:
We had such a wonderful experience from start to finish. We ordered the Wagyu Lahmeh Pide, Pear & Arugula Salad, Crispy Stuffed Olives, and a glass of El Pedal Tempranillo.

Every single dish was outstanding, but the Wagyu Lahmeh Pide completely stole the show. It is honestly one of the best dishes I’ve ever had and easily ranks among my top three dining experiences. The flavors, quality, and presentation were exceptional.

The atmosphere was calm, elegant, and incredibly relaxing. We came here after a massage, and it was the perfect place to unwind and enjoy a peaceful dinner.

A special thank you to Alexandra, who was fantastic. She took the time to recommend the wine, helped us choose our dishes, and made us feel genuinely welcomed throughout the evening. Her recommendations were excellent and her service made the experience even more memorable.

I had mentioned in my reservation that we were celebrating a birthday, and the restaurant surprised us with a complimentary birthday dessert. It was such a thoughtful gesture and made the celebration feel even more special.

This was an unforgettable dining experience, and we will absolutely be back.

Wow. The food was phenomenal. One dish better than the other. As another reviewer shared - from the menu it seems you are ordering from just another mediterranean restaurant. But once it comes out, each dish is a work of art.

Everything was SO flavorful and well balanced.   We were even impressed by the persian carrot jeweled rice (and we are Iranians!)

Our favorites were the crispy shrimp, eggplant dumplings, sweet jeweled rice, tomato cucumber salad, and the baklava. Though it was all great!

I didn’t love the atmosphere - had a very modern feel to it and upbeat music. But our server was fantastic so I kept the 5 stars.

Byblos was a lovely experience. Great food, good atmosphere inside. Though outside there is construction, a hobo sleeping right out front, and they are tucked in behind another.. I think restaurant? So it was a little tricky to see.

We did family style and enjoyed multiple appetizers. The fried eggplant was my favorite! The drinks are a bit pricier than what I saw online unfortunately. But they did not disappoint. 4.5/5 I would say.

Wonderful experience at Byblos as always! I’ve been about 5 times already. Food and service is always amazing. Our server last night was so kind and very accommodating to dietary restrictions. Can’t wait to come back 💛

My fave dishes: beef kebab, grilled branzino, fried eggplant & truffle rice

Came here for a business dinner. Food is all tapas style and meant to be shared.
The pear and arugula salad and labneh appetizers are my favourite. The dumplings and octopus are good. For Mains , the branzino was not bad, just had quite a few bones in it. The short rib was delicious with a fantastic crust to it. The 2lbs lamb shoulder was tender and juicy and came with many different sauces to wrap it with. Drinks were good too. Overall great place to have a feast and we didn’t end up  finishing everything.

name: Grandad's Coffee and Donuts
address: 574 James St N #1, Hamilton, ON L8L 1J7, Canada
reviews:
Classic old school donuts shop. Feels like stepping back into my teens and going for a donut 🍩.

I got 3 different one's to try:

Old Fashion Peanut: this is pretty awesome. Would eat this again. I want to try to chocolate flavour next time.

Still have to try the lemon filled and the blueberry fritter.

I need to come back and try more options. Lines mores fast which is great.

Recently tried this place for the first time after having it on our list to take the kids for some sweet treats. The donuts were amazing  very soft, airy, and delicious. We enjoyed them so much that we already went back twice in one week and will definitely be coming again.
The only downside for us was the customer service. The staff seemed a bit stiff and not very talkative or openly friendly. For a donut and coffee shop, we expected the atmosphere to feel a little warmer and more welcoming. Still, the quality of the donuts alone makes it worth visiting.

If there’s one place that completely redefined what a donut should taste like for me in Canada, it’s Grandad’s Donuts. I’m not exaggerating when I say this was the first time I took a bite of a donut and genuinely felt overwhelmed by how insanely good it was. The flavor hits you immediately, rich but balanced, not overly sugary like the typical chain options. But what truly sets it apart is the texture. Soft, airy, perfectly structured, it almost melts while still giving that satisfying bite. It feels crafted, not manufactured.

And then there’s the donut I’ve been searching for everywhere. A proper chocolate dipped donut with peanuts done right. Not overloaded, not messy, just the perfect ratio of chocolate, crunch, and dough. You won’t find that at Tim Hortons, and that alone makes this place special. Every bite felt intentional, like someone actually cared about making the perfect donut.

This is not just a good donut shop. This is the kind of place that makes you pause mid bite and think, “wow, this is what it’s supposed to be.” I cannot recommend it enough.

Delicious and affordable! The donuts are very fresh, and at two bucks it's a steal for the quality. There's a great variety in selection, and they offer other treats such as danishes and eclairs. Definitely recommend.

1 chocolate walnut donut (walnut crunch?) + 1 éclair + 1 medium coffee for under $8.00.

I visited for the first time at 6:30 a.m. on a Sunday, and many people were grabbing boxes of donuts. It must be a local gem! 💎

I usually find that coffee at independent donut shops tastes very strong and acidic, but the coffee here was mild and really nice.

Donuts were very good!
So we decided to get six more in a small box! 👍👍

Bar seating with outlets available.

Delicious Donuts never disappoints. Their donuts are always incredibly fresh, soft, and full of flavor. You can really taste the quality in every bite. On top of that, the service is consistently excellent. The staff are friendly, attentive, and make every visit a pleasant experience. It’s the kind of place you keep coming back to because you know exactly what you’re going to get: great treats and even better service.

I've heard good things about this place and finally stopped by to see for myself. I got half a dozen donuts. They are delicious! I will have to bring my dad with me next time. My favourite one i tried was the toasted coconut. The apple fritters have big chunks of apple which I was happy to see! I'll be back next time to try some other flavors. I was shocked to know they are actually open 24/7!

Yummy 😋  just finished eating a couple of donuts as a treat and these donuts are truly as the reviews say,  delicious and with all the right flavours and styles that will take you back or introduce you to flavour country. The family is going to enjoy finishing these today 😊

name: Chez Lucien
address: 137 Murray St, Ottawa, ON K1N 7E3, Canada
reviews:
Sean is the best! He is energetic, upbeat, and even memorized our orders and got everything right. The atmosphere is super cozy and the food is great. We were blown away by the burgers and the steak. This is a great hidden gem.

P.S. There are a lot of stairs though.

We came with several friends on a Thursday and were happy to find that the wait for a table at 7 was only around 15 minutes. The place has a neat atmosphere! We ordered the Bourgeois Burger and the Grilled Salmon Sandwich. We split the side into fries and salad and for the other side, upgraded to poutine. The flavours in all were great! The salmon was nicely done and the dill sauce was flavourful and well balanced. The fries, and especially the poutine was lovely. The drink selection has a nice variety. The only regret was not getting to try others options on the menu!

Absolutely delicious pasta! 🍝
They ran out of mussels that day, but I got extra of the other ingredients instead🫶
The sauce was creamy and rich, the pasta was perfectly cooked, and the scallops were huge and tender in the middle👍
Also, won’t forget the garlic toast🧄-crispy, full of flavor, and even better when dipped into the sauce.
Overall, the staff are super lovely.
A 5/5 restaurant! 🙌🏻🙌🏻🙌🏻

It’s very deceiving from the outside but the minute we stepped inside, the vibe was charming and warm. It wasn’t busy as we went for a late lunch on a Wednesday but it has a homey comfortable feel. The menu is not huge, but you will not be disappointed. Burgers and fries and salad for about 25.00 is a total deal. Salad dressings home made and the fries hand cut. Whether it’s a group of friends or you want to stop in for a drink at the bar, you will be satisfied.
We ordered Escargot, seafood fettucine and Streak Frites. All good! Duck confit was sold out. I want to find another time to visit!

It was a rainy Monday night but the place was jumping. Took awhile but we got seats at the bar. Wait staff, bartender working hard but friendly . Seems like every meal coming out of Kitchen was a burger, so we ordered burgers, comes with salad and fries. Excellent! The place is loud so if your looking for a quiet space this is not the place. All in all a fun experience.

The grilled pork chop and Chez Lucien burger are amazing! The vibe is really cozy. The food took a little while to come out, but it was definitely worth the wait. We didn’t mind at all—we enjoyed our conversation in the meantime with some great local drinks.
The place had a great vibe walking in. People were mingling, having a time. The food was pretty in, burger that's medium as it should, crisp toppings, large portions and awesome garden salad.

name: La Maison Simons
address: 977 Sainte-Catherine St. West, Montreal, Quebec H3B 4W3, Canada
reviews: I’ve been going to this store for over 50 years and for being open for almost 200, it’s quite a feat especially considering that they are THE last department store left in Quebec and maybe Canada. Still family run and they do it better than most. Excellent selection of merchandise from affordable to eye watering. Highly recommended. Now Ontario is able to have a taste of Quebec.
Great suit buying experience! Way better than the awful suit store in front of them. The deals on Seiko’s aren’t too bad too!

It was a pleasant experience shopping in this bright, clean and spacious store. The staff were pleasant and the atmosphere relaxed. I will definitely go back.  I found that most of the clothing I saw was for younger people although I didn't visit the whole store!
Also, a lot of the items had to be hand washed, or gently washed by machine in cold water, 'hang to dry', also  'dry clean only' items, and others that have used recycled materials. A bit of a chore to keep all that in your head, and hardly easy care apparel. Oh, and sizing is wonky.
Still, I will return to the store or shop online as there is much I liked about the whole experience, the styles, store, selection, staff, etc., but will have to pay much too much attention to the labels.

Just love Simon’s flagship store in downtown Montreal. This store is beautiful from the moment you walk in seeing all their latest fashions at very reasonable prices. Such a wonderful layout of Men’s and women’s fashions with a wide selection of trendy items! This store is a much stop during every trip to beautiful Montreal. The staff are always helpful and very friendly. Simon’s really knows how to represent their customers with a welcome for the ages!

Simons in Montreal is an absolutely beautiful store and ended up being one of the highlights of my trip. I stopped by while on vacation and was so impressed by how big, bright, and welcoming it felt. Even though I did not end up buying anything this time, I really enjoyed walking through the different departments because the selection is so unique. They carry their own in-house brands like TWIK and Simons alongside well-known designer labels, which creates a mix that is both stylish and refreshing. There are so many funky, trendy, and cute pieces that stand out from what you usually see in other Canadian stores.

The layout of the store is spotless and thoughtfully designed. The women’s department is located on the lower level, the men’s department is upstairs, and there is also a dedicated suit shop. Each floor feels open, modern, and easy to navigate, and everything is displayed in a way that makes browsing enjoyable rather than overwhelming. It is the type of store where you could easily spend hours just exploring.

Being from Ontario, I have visited the Square One Simons and I am also happy to see the brand expanding in Toronto. The Yorkdale location has already opened and it is exciting that the Eaton Centre will soon have one as well. With Hudson’s Bay closing in certain malls, Simons feels like a much-needed addition to Canadian retail. Visiting the Montreal store reminded me why it has such a strong reputation, and I truly hope Simons continues to grow and thrive across the country.

name: Seau de Crabe Restaurant
address: #4, 670 Eglinton Ave W, Mississauga, ON L5R 3V2, Canada
reviews:
This has become our family’s favourite seafood spot in Mississauga. We’ve been here several times, and it never disappoints. The seafood is always fresh, the seasoning is packed with flavour, and the shrimp are consistently cooked perfectly, juicy, delicious, and so much easier to peel than anywhere else we’ve tried. We honestly enjoy it more than Captain’s Boil.

The fried calamari, dynamite shrimp, loaded fries, and seafood platters are all fantastic, and every visit has been consistently great. What really makes this place special is the team. Everyone is genuinely friendly, welcoming, and makes you feel right at home.

If you’re looking for an amazing seafood boil with outstanding service, this is the place. Highly recommended! 🦐🦀

The royal seafest bucket was delicious with the signature sauce! The lobster tails came cracked open so they were easy to eat and everything was tender. The medium calamari was also amazing, not oily, and a great portion for the price! Would definitely come back.

Everything about this place was amazing. The ambience, food, and services. Came here for my nephew’s bday and we ordered the summer bucket with an extra side of shrimps. The calamari, fried shrimp, fries, the signature sauce, Cajun sauce, and everything smothered in butter was a delicious treat. We also got to meet one of the owners who mentioned they do not use oil, they only use butter.
Would def come here again.

You will be greeted with a warm and friendly smile soon as you enter. The place is very clean and organize. We ordered the father’s day special on the menu and we thought it’s really worth it! They brought the appetizers first then the mains. The chicken tenders that I ordered for my son is also really good. It tasted like it was made fresh and not out from a frozen ready made. I just hope they asked for the variation of the fries next time for kids as not all kids eat it with flavour. All in all it was such a great experience!!

Everthing was amazing I wish I know this place before, the food was sooo good fresh, cleaned will and tasty! We ordered kids fish meal for my toddler and it was so big.. me and my hubby we order the 79$ crab seas mix I think this is the name with
Signature flavour was so so yummy! The services was very good so friendly and it is family atmosphere ..
Grab any of their signature buckets and they are too good!! We swapped mussels with crawfish. But the snow lobster is what I liked the most… Shall visit again.

My friends and I are visiting Mississauga and for our first meal after landing we went to Seau De Crabe. We got the festive ocean bucket with the Cajun seasoning and added 1/2 of crawfish to our meal. The bill amongst my group of 3 was just below 50$, including tip, which was so affordable for how much food we got. Every piece of seafood was very meaty and filled with the spicy Cajun sauce, and after a 4h flight it was totally worth every penny! The workers were all extremely kind and welcoming, which made the experience a whole lot better as well. Would definitely go again!

I've been here twice now and ordered the shrimp bucket (2 pax) and the shrimps and mussels bucket, and the quality blew me away. The seafood was fresh, the shrimp, and mussels were cooked great and the portions were as mentioned. I went with their house made Cajun sauce, and it was sour, garlicky, and packed with flavour. The sides are great like corn and rice. Also, the side of calamari was seasoned really well with a great sauce. I'm going to comeback and try other buckets and will probably like them aswell.

name: Holder
address: 407 Rue McGill, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 2G3, Canada
reviews:
We arrived about 30 minutes before our reservation time, but we were seated right away, which was a great start to the evening.

Our server, Philippe, was incredibly kind and welcoming throughout the entire experience. He took the time to explain the daily specials and made us feel genuinely cared for.

The food was absolutely delicious, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting.

To be honest, we had a very disappointing experience at another restaurant the day before, and it almost left a negative impression on our trip to Montreal. Thankfully, this restaurant completely turned things around. Thanks to Philippe and the wonderful team, we were able to enjoy a truly memorable evening and leave Montreal with great memories.

Please pass along our sincere thanks to Philippe. His professionalism, kindness, and hospitality made a real difference in our experience.

Great food can be found in many places, but restaurants that leave a lasting memory because of the people who work there are rare. Philippe made this one of those places.

We would gladly return the next time we visit Montreal.

We absolutely loved everything here! Every dish was delicate and full of flavor. Staff were all so nice. We brought our own cake to celebrate a birthday, they even helped plate the cake with a touch of raspberry sauce, which added an extra layer of flavor and made it look so beautiful.

Our server Joe was the kindest and provided amazing service. He was very attentive and truly made our experience special and memorable. We were so happy to have him as our server.💛

I made a reservation to this restaurant and am glad I did. It was dinner for Sunday night and the place was already busy. Loved my mussels, mule and creme brulee. My server was less than attentive but fully understand since it was a busy night. The price wasn't too bad either.

We had a wonderful dinner at Holder in Old Montréal. The atmosphere was lively and welcoming, and every dish was beautifully presented. The duck confit was crispy and tender, the beef was rich and flavorful, and the salmon tartare was fresh and well balanced. We also really enjoyed the house fries and sautéed mushrooms. Generous portions, attentive service, and a great overall dining experience.

We had a great experience at Holder. It was very busy when we went and a bit loud but we could still have an easy conversation at our table of two.

The gazpacho was very good while the calamari was not our favorite. It was a bit rubbery. For entrees we had the beef cheek and the mussels. Both were very good, although some of the mussels were a bit gritty. I preferred the beef cheek.

For dessert we had the chocolat crémeux and the sorbet trio. The chocolate was one of the best desserts I've ever had. The sorbet was extremely tart.

The service was excellent and very professional. Overall, we had a great time and enjoyed our food.

The French onion soup was delicious. For the appetizer, we had the salmon tartare—it was very fresh and refreshing.
For my main, I ordered a steak medium rare, but it came a bit too rare. That said, the steak itself was flavorful, with a nicely seared, crispy exterior. The cut was thick, and paired with the salad, the portion was just right for me. My partner ordered the duck confit—it was tender, flavorful, and not gamey at all, making it very easy to enjoy.

We were too full to try dessert. The staff were friendly and the service was great.

Had dinner with friends here. Ordered several cocktails and they were great! Had the beef cheeks with mash potatoes, very tender and flavourful. Mussels and fries were decent. French onion soup is a must have along with the calamari! Friendly service and ambience!

We came here thinking it would be an upscale dinner. It's certainly more casual than upscale. Food was mediocre at best, my gnocchi was swimming in grease and was basically inedible. The tables are tightly packed in - you can reach your arm to the table next to yours while seated; not very private or romantic. Service could be better. Was nothing special.
