name: Red Moon Bakery
address: 1098 Peter Robertson Blvd #23, Brampton, ON L6R 1G6, Canada
reviews: I got cake for my parents 50 th Anniversary. Nav help me in choosing the cake n giving me advise what can be best fit for the occasion. My family love the Rasmalai cake . It was very beautiful done n was soo yummy . Highly recommend. Delivered perfectly on time . Thxxxx

The pastries are pretty good when you can actually get them. They do custom orders and cakes, so they seem very busy, but it often takes a long time to be acknowledged. I also feel awkward taking up space with a stroller when I’m just trying to grab something quickly. 3/5 times, I’ve left without getting anything. Also, not sure why it’s listed as open 24 hours—it’s not.

I had a wonderful experience at Redmoon Bakery! I tried the Biscoff pastry and the mango mousse, and both were absolutely delicious. Everything was fresh, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The mango mousse was especially light and refreshing, while the Biscoff pastry was rich and indulgent.
What really made the experience stand out was the excellent service by Dil.The whole team were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and attentive, and they made me feel genuinely appreciated as a customer. The service was quick, professional, and pleasant from start to finish.
I highly recommend Redmoon Bakery for anyone looking for delicious desserts and exceptional customer service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I had a wonderful experience at Red Moon Bakery. We visited the bakery and purchased a cake, and the service provided by Sajan was excellent—very friendly, patient, and professional.
The cake was fresh, beautifully decorated, and tasted amazing. Truly satisfied with both the service and quality. Highly recommend Red Moon Bakery! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had a wonderful experience with Jagjeet Kaur. She was very friendly, helpful, and professional. Her positive attitude and excellent customer service made my visit to the bakery even better. She was attentive to my needs and made sure everything was handled with care. Thank you, Jagjeet, for your great service!

name: Qawali | Indian Restaurant & Banquet
address: 12550 Hwy 50, Bolton, ON L7E 1M7, Canada
reviews:
Wonderful restaurant, A little reddish interiors but good ambiance.
Service by Sunayna & Muskaan was excellent 👍 👌.
Best thing about this restaurant is that it's open 24 hours.
Food was tasty 😋.
But the Bhature were very thick.

Recommended by their staff @ Ratan Deep, we came and really enjoyed the food here.
Their Chef Mr. Ratan was very  accommodating & showed us their banquet hall upstairs,  which can accommodate about 50 to 60 people, and his fish pakora was super marvelous 😍 👌
Otherwise,  everything was excellent here.

Just had the most amazing experience at Qawali today, solely because of our server, Anmol. Consistently checked in on us throughout the night, ensuring that we had everything we need. The food was genuinely the best I had ever had. Highly recommend the Chaat Papdi, even though everything we ordered was phenomenal!! Thank you Anmol and Qawali for the best experience ever!!!

Have been here a couple of times, and I have both positives and a few things they can improve on to share. Let’s focus on the positives first …the playlist and choice of songs were great, and the vibe was amazing. Prices are reasonable too, so keep that up!We ordered dry Manchurian, malai chaap, and dahi papdi for starters, and absolutely loved them. For the main course, we had paneer makhmali and chaap, a really good mix of sweet and spicy flavors in the curry.

The only thing that could be improved is the waiting time. It was quite long, even though we visited during a less busy hour. If that can be managed better, the overall experience would be even better.

But overall, great food!!!

​We visited Qawali yesterday and were immediately impressed by the atmosphere!

🏠 The restaurant is very clean and has a really attractive, modern design. ✨

​Regarding the food, it was a bit of a mixed bag. 🍲 We ordered the Tandoori Momos, Paneer 65, Chana, Naan, and Honey Chilli Potato.

We really liked the Honey Chilli Potato, Naan, and Momos 😋, but unfortunately, the other dishes didn't hit the mark and the taste was disappointing. 😕

​On a positive note, the service was excellent! 🌟 The two girls working there were very welcoming, sweet, and polite. Great vibes, but I hope the food consistency improves! 🙌

I had a wonderful dining experience. The butter chicken was truly exceptional — rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced with just the right blend of spices. It is easily one of the best I have tasted.

The lychee cocktail was equally impressive — light, refreshing, and beautifully crafted. It complemented the meal perfectly and stood out as a delightful beverage choice.

A special thank you to our waitress, Sandeep, for her attentive and professional service, and to Chef Hasty for preparing such outstanding dishes. The combination of excellent food, refreshing drinks, and warm hospitality made for a memorable experience. I look forward to returning.

name: MANDYZ SALON
address: 830 Bd Décarie, Montréal, QC H4L 3L9, Canada
reviews:
I had a wonderful experience at Mandyz Salon! I recently got a keratin treatment and I’m really happy with the result. My hair feels so much smoother, softer and more manageable, with a beautiful shine. My stylist; Souad was professional, friendly and made me feel comfortable throughout the entire process.

I really appreciate the attention to detail and the care they put into their work. Thank you, Mandyz Salon, for making my first visit such a great experience! I would definitely recommend Mandyz Salon to anyone looking for a quality keratin treatment and will definitely be coming back! ❤️

I had a great experience at Mandyz Salon! Salma did an amazing job with my hair colour and haircut. Since it was my first time getting my hair coloured, I wasn’t sure what would suit me, but she was so friendly, patient, and interactive throughout the appointment. She took the time to understand what I wanted, gave me professional advice, and helped me choose a colour and haircut that suited me perfectly. I’m really happy with the final result and would definitely recommend Salma to anyone looking for a skilled and welcoming hairstylist. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!

I’ve been coming to Mandyz salon for almost three years now! Every time I have absolutely loved my hair. I usually get a black dye and a layered cut. We come all the way from upstate NY to get our hair done, and the commute is always worth it. Every stylist/staff is so positive and kind and they truly make a wonderful environment. They are always able to squeeze me in with only a couple days notice each time. They are always busy and all their clients come out with beautiful hair!! Definitely come to Mandyz salon 😊

My wife and I visited MANDYZ SALON for her haircut and a complete new hair color transformation. Since it was her first time coloring her natural hair, we were a bit unsure, but the staff was incredibly professional, friendly, and supportive throughout the entire process.
They patiently helped us choose the perfect shade that would suit her features and natural hair. The result was absolutely extraordinary—it enhanced her beauty in the most amazing way. A big thanks to Justin, the talented artist who gave her such a stunning new look. I truly feel like I've fallen in love with her all over again!
She absolutely loves her new hairstyle and color, and everyone has been complimenting her ever since. Highly recommended for anyone looking for expert styling and exceptional service!

I booked an appointment for my mom’s color and blowdry today so she can attend my uncle’s birthday bash later! It was our first visit! The salon is clean and the owner responded to all my questions prior to the appointment very quickly via SMS. The service was very personalized and cordial! Overall, my mom felt very good afterwards. Just one small criticism for potential improvement: it seems that not all the staff are well-aware of the price point. When we initially enquired about the prices on our daily afternoon stroll, one of the staff members advised us of the prices, but when we came to pay, it was slightly more expensive (15$ difference). It was just a small misunderstanding, but I should have reconfirmed with the owner myself when I spoke to her, so it was also on me! My mom loved John! She said he’s handsome and has magic hands! They were welcoming and very nice when I walked in with my puppy! We’ll definitely rebook here and come back again!

I'd never went to a hair salon before to cut my hair, but a few days ago I decided to go. Based on the good reviews i decided to try this salon and cut my hair (from medium-long to short hair with layers). On the first visit, they sent us home after waiting because the cut couldn't be done that day, which was fine, no problem. My partner made an appointment for another day,but the results were not what I expected,sadly. I think this transformation speaks for itself 😍😍 Salma did an amazing job coloring my hair without bleaching it, and I'm absolutely in love with the results!! name: Monarque
address: 406 Rue Saint-Jacques, Montréal, QC H2Y 1S1, Canada
reviews: Best meal we had in Montreal. This was in the brasserie, not the formal dining room. We were seated close to other diners on a fairly empty afternoon which seemed odd but then we realized it was so we could have a view of the kitchen which was very cool. Trout tartare with eggplant, miso, rice puffs and roe was magical. Steak frites was beyond- possibly the best frites we’ve ever eaten. Waitstaff were kind and helpful, and the wine was so good. Whole family was wowed.

Solid 4 stars resteraunt.  Food is good and wine list is extensive.  Service is good but the resteraunt can be very busy.  Highly recommend to make reservation ahead of time.  We have a group of 7 and we got seated in front of the kitchen.  Good atmosphere and everyone like the food.

Sat at the bar is the brasserie side. Make aure you have a reservation as it books up solid and there is no wait list for walk ins.
Steak frites and duck confit were absolutely amazing. Among the best, if not the best we have ever had. Grwat cheese and the pate / terrine / rillets were amazing.  The bartender chose awesome wine pairings too.  Gorgeous space as well.
We were a little reluctant about a spot in the touristy area, but so glad we went!

If you get the chance to book a table here, do it!
We ate in the brasserie and had a wonderful evening of delicious food and scrumptious cocktails.

The bone marrow and snails starter was particularly delicious, along with the lamb rump main. The bouillabaise was superb- I could have happily eaten a loaf of bread with the rouille, it was so tasty! We rounded the night off by sharing a maple and pecan éclair.

The service was great, and food was exceptionally prompt given it was a Friday night!

Our only feedback to improve on an already great experience would be to serve your table bread warm with slightly softer butter.

I love this restaurant from ambience, service to food. My table was served by 4-5 waiters/ waitress. A gentleman served water, another one served us wine, they let me taste my wine to make sure I’m satisfied with my choice before serving it! I picked Vin de Franz, white wine as I had seafood bouillabaisse for main course. We had a bone marrow and French snails cooked with red wine for appetizer, it was excellent. The bouillabaisse was amazing too! I will definitely come back for duck confit and lamb shoulder. Really highly recommended!

Had lunch here on a Tuesday around noon and the place was packed! So I guess that’s a testament to how good this restaurant is, which I can confirm, it was! The foie gras parfait was creamy and delicious. The bone marrow with snails was grilled well. The beef tartare had exceptional flavor. The salmon with zucchini sauce was buttery and so flavorful my toddler ate it all up. Old fashioned drink was nice and strong, and not too sweet. Service and decor inside was everything you would expect from a fine dining experience. Love the open kitchen concept and display of dry aging meats. Definitely a must try when in downtown Montreal!

Monarque was easily one of the strongest meals of the trip. The veal cheek was ridiculous, genuinely the clear standout and one of those dishes that makes the whole dinner worth it by itself. It was rich, tender, deeply savory, and had that slow-cooked comfort without feeling heavy or sloppy. 100/10 dish.
The cod croquettes were another highlight, crisp on the outside with a clean, salty bite, and the hummus was way better than a simple starter has any right to be. The side of mushrooms was also excellent, earthy and buttery in a way that fit the meal perfectly. The octopus was the only dish I had mixed feelings on. It was cooked beautifully, tender and clearly handled well, but the smoke was intense enough that it started to overpower everything else.

Service:
The meal felt polished and professional, with the kind of pacing you want from a nicer dinner without making the experience feel stiff.

Summary:
Monarque absolutely delivered. The veal cheek alone would bring me back, but the croquettes, hummus, and mushrooms all helped make this feel like a complete, memorable dinner. Only real knock was the overly smoky octopus, but even that was cooked perfectly. Overall, a standout.

Came here on a Monday night and it was still pretty crowded! But there was plenty of space in the back which was nice so it didn’t feel as claustrophobic.

The food was absolutely amazing!! My table shared the steak tartare but I personally got the Foie gras, ocean trout tartare, and oysters. My group also got the maple eclair and passion fruit pavlova for dessert. The presentation of each dish was beautiful. Our server Terry was attentive and gave us great recommendations. I also loved the atmosphere of the place, it’s sleek and modern. Can’t wait to come back!

name: Kouing Amann Bakery
address: 316 Mont-Royal Ave E, Montreal, Quebec H2T 1P7, Canada
reviews: This cozy and quaint little place completely stole my heart! As a tourist, I walked in and instantly fell in love with the vibe. Even the customers were so friendly and welcoming. One lovely man who happened to be a regular even shared his table with me since there are only two tables indoors, and we ended up chatting and getting to know each other for almost an hour. It was such a lovely, unexpected experience! I tried their famous dessert with an Americano, and it really hit the spot! 😍 The whole experience was such a wonderful surprise and definitely one of the highlights of my trip. I’d absolutely come back here the next time I’m in Montreal, even all the way from Vancouver! 💙

Amazing fresh pastries!                    A Must try is the  kouign-amann! An incredible taste that you will crave again once you’ve tried it. We came right in the morning and there was plenty available. The almond croissants were 10/10!

Kouign Aman Bakery IS Montreal.
Montreal is the best city in Canada, and this is the best place in Montreal, therefore...
The bakery products are ALL incredibly delicious. I just had croissants at Blé Sucré in Paris last year, and I thought I had found the best croissant in the world, but then I had an Almond Croissant from KAB and, oh boy, was that even better!
Regardless of this, if this is your first time visiting here, you HAVE TO get the Kouign Aman... possibly the best (IMHO) bakery product in the whole wide world. No need to say more about this.
And, as if all this wasn't enough... The service! You cannot find more friendly, helpful, and all around nice people than the girls at this place (the Monsieur baker is also super nice). Their service is genuine. You feel taken care of, not just in a transactional way, but they want you to leave satisfied with everything.
If you come to Montreal you cannot leave without coming here.

Went to Kouign Amann and tried their signature sliced kouign amann, and omg, it was genuinely one of the best pastries I’ve had. Perfectly flaky on the outside, soft and moist inside, with rich buttery layers and little bursts of caramelized sweetness in every bite.
The texture was incredible, crisp yet melt-in-your-mouth at the same time, and the flavor was so balanced without being overly sweet. You can really taste the quality and care put into it.
Honestly, it instantly became one of my favorite treats in the city. Definitely worth the hype and already craving another one.

I’m a huge fan of bakeries, and this is hands down the best bakery I’ve ever been to.

During my stay in Montreal, I visited four highly reviewed bakeries, but none of them came close to this place. Everything we tried was incredibly fresh, delicate, and absolutely delicious. It was so good that we finished an entire box of baked goods in about five minutes—and immediately went back in to buy more.

The customer service was also excellent—friendly, welcoming, and efficient. The shop itself was very clean and well kept, which made the experience even better.

One thing to note is that the indoor seating area is quite limited, so I’d recommend planning for takeout rather than dining in. Also, be sure to double-check their opening days and hours—they’re only open Wednesday through Saturday, and closed the rest of the week.

Highly recommend if you’re looking for top-tier baked goods.

Recommended items: chocolate croissant, kouing amann, cheese croissant, chocolate milk bread.

I went to Kouign Amann and tried their signature sliced kouign amann. It was one of the best pastries I’ve ever had—crispy on the outside, soft inside, and full of buttery, caramelized flavor. I highly recommend it.

I also tried the croissant. It was okay, but I expected it to be better. It wasn’t as crispy or flaky as I was hoping.

Crispy on the outside, fluffy and moist on the inside. It was slightly too oily (not buttery though) for my liking. But traditional butter cake that tasted delicious. Not my favorite but still a wonderfully well done pastry. Great experience to try.

If you’re in Montreal and love pastries, you absolutely have to try Kouign-Amann!

Hands down, this was one of the best pastries I’ve ever had. The Kouign-amann is simply amazing — perfectly caramelized sugar on the outside with rich, buttery layers on the inside. Crispy, sweet, and melt-in-your-mouth delicious.

We also tried the croissant and the almond croissant, and both were outstanding. The almond croissant is a must-try — flaky, buttery, and generously filled, with sliced almonds on top adding the perfect crunch.

It’s a small place and very busy, but that just shows how good it is. Totally worth the wait. A must-visit spot in Montreal for pastry lovers!

It was my first time here, and I had a great experience. Everyone was very friendly and professional, and Sanad did an excellent job.

name: Cocotte Bistro
address: 123 Metcalfe St, Ottawa, ON K1P 5L9, Canada
reviews:
Cocotte Bistro is one of the best French restaurants I’ve visited in Ottawa. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was elegant, warm, and inviting, making it the perfect place for a relaxing brunch or lunch.

I ordered the smoked salmon and avocado toast, and it was absolutely delicious. The smoked salmon was fresh and flavorful, the avocado was perfectly ripe, and everything was beautifully presented on fresh, crisp bread. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients and take pride in every dish.

The service was friendly, attentive, and professional, which made the experience even more enjoyable. The combination of exceptional food, beautiful ambiance, and outstanding hospitality makes Cocotte Bistro a place I’ll happily return to.

If you’re looking for authentic French-inspired cuisine in Ottawa, I highly recommend Cocotte Bistro. It’s a wonderful spot for a memorable meal and definitely deserves five stars.

I'm not usually a fan of French cuisine, but I've always wanted to visit a restaurant with a true French atmosphere and I'm so glad I chose this one. The staff were attentive and welcoming. They even asked whether we had any food allergies, which is something you don't often experience in restaurants.

The food was absolutely incredible. The Salmon Tartare was delicate, fresh and surprisingly filling. The French onion soup was fragrant, slightly sweet and wonderfully light in flavor.

The interior deserves special praise as well. The soft cream-colored tones made the whole place feel elegant and cozy, almost as if the design had been inspired by a classic French dessert like crème brûlée.

Keep up the amazing work! We would love to come back.

Beautiful resturant with excellent service. Regular visitor (maybe once every few months) and usually it’s pretty good. Some of the food I have really enjoyed. The last time I went though, some of the food like the avocado toast and brunch raclette weren’t my favourite. By no means a bad spot. Decent oysters and excellent wine.

I’ve now been to Coquette Bistro twice for brunch, and it’s quickly become one of my favourite spots in the city.

On my most recent visit, I tried the caviar and smoked salmon eggs Benedict, which was excellent—thoughtfully prepared and full of flavour. The complimentary pastries were a lovely touch, and I also enjoyed a mimosa followed by an iced coffee to finish.

Service was exceptional—attentive without being overbearing—and made the experience feel especially comfortable. The ambiance strikes a nice balance: stylish and inviting without feeling overly formal.

Overall, a standout brunch experience. Whether you’re going solo or celebrating something, it’s a spot I’d highly recommend.

Absolutely stunning spot!! Food I thought was not bad, nothing too overly impressive but not bad at all. When I came in w my daughter it took a little for someone to seat us and was half way through the meal when someone offered a high chair. But nevertheless was a nice morning. Maybe not bed place for toddler because it is fancy and also I think people were having business lunches so a yelling toddler isn’t fitting maybe. It’s a really beautiful location. Specifically the potatoes I think were crispy and yummy. Food was on the pricier end.

We stopped by for happy hour and had a fantastic experience! Their weekday happy hour, available from 2:30–5:00 p.m., is an excellent value, offering any three appetizers from the happy hour menu for $35. We also liked that you can still order from the regular lunch menu during happy hour, giving you even more variety to choose from.

The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish beautifully prepared and full of flavour. The service was superb—friendly, attentive, and efficient throughout our visit.

The restaurant itself is stunning, with a beautiful interior design that creates a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it a wonderful spot to relax and enjoy a meal.

Overall, we had a great happy hour experience and would definitely come back to try more of the menu. Highly recommended!

Very pleasant atmosphere, delicious food and nicd wait staff. I ordered the seared scallops which were delicious. I especially enjoyed the crispy tops on the mashed potatoes. For dessert I recommend the creme brule. It was fresh and very authentic.

Absolutely incredible experience at Cocotte Bistro! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm, elegant, and authentically French. The service was attentive without being overbearing, and every recommendation was spot on.

The food was simply outstanding—beautifully presented and full of rich, balanced flavors. Each dish felt thoughtfully crafted, from the appetizers to the desserts. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care that goes into every plate.

Whether you're going for a special occasion or just a memorable night out, this place delivers on every level. Easily one of the best dining experiences I’ve had in Ottawa. Highly recommend—5 stars all the way!

name: Mulberry Coffeehouse
address: 193 James St N, Hamilton, ON L8R 2L2, Canada
status: Espresso & light bites amid brick walls
reviews:
Visited yesterday just as another random stop. I must say it is a very cozy caffe, a hidden jem of Hamilton. Multiple food and drinks options with a variety of vegan food available as well. Staff is very professional and nicely spoken. Everything came out quick and fresh. Their chick pea smash wrap was one of my favourite ⭐️
Will highly recommend :)

After dropping a friend off at the Go station, I was in search of a coffee place. I am so happy I found mulberry coffee house! It is a very cozy atmosphere, with a very nice food menu. The barista was so friendly and happily answered all of my questions. I love the brand of flavour syrup they use for their lattes. They also don’t charge extra for oat milk!! Will definitely visit here again when in the area.

Staff at the counter were so nice, coffee is amazing too. 5 star service there.

I have celiac and asked if I could modify sandwiches with their gluten free bread. The woman at the counter said it should be okay if it doesn’t go through the toaster. She wrote notes for the kitchen staff and I felt pretty confident.

The sandwich came out toasted and the woman at the desk had left. I asked the kitchen if they toasted it and they looked confused. They had toasted it and when I asked if they could redo it, both kitchen staff started raising their voices about how they aren’t a gluten free kitchen. I asked if I could just get untoasted bread and they laughed and said “you want cold bread?”. Just super disrespectful and obviously didn’t listen to the notes from the counter staff.

Couldn’t eat the sandwich and feel like the kitchen staff were way over aggressive. Definitely don’t order food if you’re celiac/gluten free.

Once again, Coffee/Counter staff were very nice, probably great food if you don’t have any allergies!

It is a nice place for a coffee or lunch. The building of Mulberry Coffeehouse was constructed in 1887 as the Armory Hotel. Although it has been renovated over the years, the original brick walls, tiles, floorboards, and ceiling decorations have been preserved. Bathed in sunlight and filled with the aroma of coffee, time seems to slow down.
My bagel had mold and I feel sick. They didn’t offer a refund, just said sorry. It is unfortunate as I love the cafes location and decor. Never getting food there again :(

Love to visit Mulberry when we are in Hamilton! We always make a special stop. It's got that wonderful old factory vibe with excellent coffee and tons of menu options that make you sad you couldn't get everything. Great vibe and service too. I had the salmon plate which was light and varied in texture and flavor. Highlight was the very obviously fresh smoked salmon.

Sometimes the food is fantastic, and sometimes it tastes really old. I’ve had super bomb pastries there, other times it tastes like it should’ve been thrown out two days prior to me eating it. The atmosphere and vibe in this place are fantastic, it’s super relaxing and clean, staff are great at their job, just had a few too many misses with muffins to not mention it.
Love the vegan menu. Drinks and atmosphere are fantastic. Couldn't recommend more and definitely will be back.

name: The French
address: 37 King William St, Hamilton, ON L8R 1A1, Canada
status: Stylish French bistro with a patio
reviews:
The French offers a beautiful space with a clean, understated aesthetic and a noise level that makes conversation easy.

We started with the French onion soup and the salade maison, both of which were very enjoyable and set a positive tone for the meal. Our server was attentive throughout the evening and struck a good balance between being available and unobtrusive.

Unfortunately, the mains didn't quite live up to our expectations. The dishes were beautifully presented. The gnocchi was fluffy and the texture was perfect, but the dish was let down by the inclusion of raw mushrooms and the overall flavour of the sauce. The lamb sirloin was good, though the cook was somewhat inconsistent from piece to piece. Despite that, the dish remained fairly cohesive and enjoyable.

For dessert, we ordered the maple cake. While the flavour was pleasant, the texture was a little too dense and crumbly and the dish was too sweet to be a standout finish to the meal.

Overall, we had a good evening and enjoyed several aspects of the experience, particularly the atmosphere, and the starters. However,  we left feeling that the food fell just short of the standard we were expecting.

What a wonderful experience! I have an allergy to onions(and all their brothers and cousins) and they were able to very easily. My salad was fresh, bright, and beautiful. I had the monkfish for my main and it was cooked to perfection! So often people overcook it but this was absolutely spot on. I had the lemon tart for dessert and the curd was perfectly tart. Higher price point, but definitely worth the money for a lovely treat. The only thing was the noise level in the restaurant was wild. I was sat across a small table and my boyfriend and I had to shout to hear one another. There were also young children running around behind our table which was definitely not desired given the price point and date night atmosphere we were hoping for. Service was outstanding though!

We had such a fantastic experience here from start to finish. The food was absolutely outstanding — the croque monsieur was rich and perfectly balanced, the eggs Benedict were cooked beautifully with a silky hollandaise, and the crème brûlée had that ideal crisp top with a creamy, decadent center. The espresso ice cream was the perfect way to finish the meal — smooth, bold, and not overly sweet.

What really elevated the experience, though, was our waitress. She was warm, attentive, and incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. You could tell she genuinely understood the food and took pride in guiding us through it — her recommendations were spot-on and made the meal even more enjoyable.

The combination of exceptional food and such thoughtful service made this a standout dining experience. We’ll definitely be back!

I saw the winter eat menu and came here. My favorite was the first course, Tete de Cochon Croquette. It was absolutely delicious, thanks to the lady who recommended it. It looked normal on the surface. But once you bite into it, the tender pork knuckle accompanied by mustard, swept through my mouth. The pickled carrots that came with it cut through the greasiness. I was slightly disappointed with the second course. It got a bit too rich for me halfway through. The dessert was a nice end. I look forward to seeing the new menu next time.

Before we went to the Playhouse Theatre, we grabbed the meal at The French, a wonderful restaurant and in a beautiful area of a Hamilton. Our first time at this restaurant and we will be back! The hamburger and frites were amazing. Best hamburger I’ve had in a long time… Bacon, brie, caramelized onions, a fig compote… to die for. Michelle had the Duck a l’orange. After her first bite, you could see on her face and in her eyes. A definite winner!!
Victoria, our server was super pleasant and attentive to us, in a busy environment. The general manager was also super, Lauren, you do the restaurant proud! You’ve got to try this place.

I went here two years ago for a birthday dinner and had their steak and frites, and it was the best thing ever! I use to compare all the steaks I had to this restaurant and would constantly look for places that just MIGHT compare. I came back and it was unfortunately just not the same… their steak felt fake and rubbery and it was dry - definitely not like what I had two years ago… I’ve had better steak at chipotle or other fast food joints lol. It use to be so red and juicy (I get mine medium rare) and the meat MELTED in your mouth. Not anymore. I don’t know if it’s a change in inventory or change in chef but this was very disappointing for me. We also had the french onion soup which was way too salty - my partner and I didn’t even finish a quarter of it. My partner had the gnocchi and it was good for a few bites but the flavour was almost too much tha your taste buds just get tired. I’m giving two stars because the server , ambience and environment is nice though.

It has a very cozy and peaceful atmosphere, without loud music.
The staff are very kind and friendly.
We ordered a burger, ricotta gnocchi, and the maison salad.
The salad tasted amazing, and the burger had a unique and delicious flavor.
Service was excellent. We ordered the oysters, beef tartar, French onion soup, burger and duck.

name: Truscott Italian Bakery & Delicatessen
address: 2425 Truscott Dr Unit 28, Mississauga, ON L5J 2B4, Canada
status: Italian baked goods, coffee & deli fare
reviews:
I came into to find something to eat for lunch and was not disappointed! Truscott bakery is a local gem offering hot and ready food, deli sandwiches, bakery offerings, and a small section of prepackaged food items. The vibes are giving grocery store with much better food quality!

I had the Mortadello and Turkey sandwich and it was phenomenal! The focaccia bread was fresh and seasoned perfectly. The size was perfect to share for two people or for one really hungry person. The service was good although not the most knowledgeable of the products. Overall, I would definitely return for a bite

Large bakery right next to Clarkson Community Center. Features a dessert (cakes, donuts, pastries), hot table & cafe area, plus a seasonal outdoor patio. The desserts are made in house & are beautifully displayed. We took away a chicken parmesan sandwich & donuts (Oreo, Twix, Apple Fritter, Sugar Twist & Coconut). Everything was fresh & delicious!

Coffee (Americano with Milk) was perfect..just enough strong and frothy milk…the patio atmosphere is just what you want on a summer day relaxing, chilling or light work/study…
We had the lobster tail pastry and the custard filling was fantastic..made in house and not a Nutella type filling..
For coffee shop and bakery lovers, this is a gem!

I recently visited Trescott Italian Bakery for the first time to buy a birthday cake and it was truly a delightful experience.
Their selection is impressive, from classic pastries to custom cakes that look as good as they taste. The service was equally outstanding, friendly, attentive, and genuinely helpful.
Overall, Trescott Italian Bakery is highly recommended for special occasions or simply treating yourself!
We received these delicious cannoli'from our niece today. Must say very pleased that the cream filling was piped right through the cannoli. Delicious #1 in my books 5☆

Absolutely love their Tea Biscuit Muffins! Perfectly soft and crumbly without being dry, with just the right amount of raisins. You can still taste the wonderful aroma of the baked flour. Simple, fresh, and absolutely delicious. Paired with a shot of espresso, it’s absolutely perfect. One of my favorites!
What a wonderful experience! I loved sipping my latte on the patio after biking over to pick up some fresh-baked buns.

Truscott Bakery is a hidden gem in Mississauga, especially if you’re into Italian specialties. I stopped by to pick up a few ingredients for a homemade carbonara — they had guanciale, Pecorino Romano, and Grana Padano, all top quality and hard to find in regular grocery stores.
While I was there, I couldn’t resist ordering one of their freshly baked breads (made in-house) and some traditional sweets to take home. Everything was fresh and full of flavor.
I also enjoyed a perfect cappuccino right there — smooth, rich, and made just right. The staff were friendly and helpful, and you can tell they really care about quality and service.
The atmosphere is part of the charm - cozy and welcoming, with classic Vespas on display that give the place a distinctly authentic Italian vibe. It's like stepping into a little slice of Europe.
Whether you’re shopping for authentic ingredients, grabbing a coffee, or just want a taste of Europe, Truscott Bakery is absolutely worth the visit!

name: Mamie Clafoutis
address: 3660 R. Saint-Denis, Montreal, Quebec H2X 3L7, Canada
reviews: Stopped by this neat place for some coffee because of a strawberries pie sign :) it turned out to be a fresh bakery with coffee, fresh pastries, pies and a few other sweet things. Great staff, very helpful and friendly. Both our cold and hot coffees were good, so we're the pastries. It's not a cafe per se, it has no proper seating, but I'd come back for the bread,  it looks really good!

Amazing croissants and friendly staff! They have a wide variety of breads and pastries, and everything looked so good! The only thing I'd say is that I wish there had been a little more space to sit and eat. That said, I really enjoyed choosing from all the lovely pastries!

Self-served bakery with great variety of freshly baked croissants and bread. They’d toast them for you if asked.

We got classic croissant, oh mon dieu, chocolatine, olive bread and croissantella. The croissant variety were all super flaky, buttery and perfectly fluffy on the inside. The croissantella takes the cake though. Even not toasted it was super flaky.

10/10 would recommend. There’s no seating inside but there’s a park nearby to sit and enjoy the baked goods.

I visited Mamie Clafoutis last Saturday and everything we tried was delicious! We bought some amazing sugar-covered pastries and the meringues were absolutely incredible — light, sweet, and honestly some of the best I’ve had.

The bakery smells amazing when you walk in, and you can tell everything is fresh. I would say it feels more like a bakery than a café — even though they do sell coffee and have a couple of small tables inside, the space doesn’t really invite you to stay there for long. We were a group of 5, and there wasn’t enough room for us to sit comfortably, so we ended up just taking everything to go.

Still, the quality of the pastries made it completely worth it, and I’ll definitely be coming back!

Really enjoyed my chocolatine from here. The pastry was nice and flaky and had a good amount of chocolate. I appreciated the fact that they open early at 7 am, so I was able to grab breakfast before catching my train.

One of the best pastries shops in Montreal. Their O mon dieu is to die for, if you like chocolate and croissant, you must order it! It used to be a cosy and more of a bakery feel to it, now it feels more upscale and like those self service shops instead, which I did not like tbh. There used to be a cozy seating area upstairs, now it's gone. Too bad you now have to buy your pastries and find a place outside to enjoy them. It used to combine deliciousness and comfort, now it's just deliciousness.

This is hands down my favorite bakery in the neighborhood!

Staff are friendly and helpful, all their baked goods are delicious, i’ve tried so many but my favorite is their pudding bread. Their almond chocolatine are very popular as well.

I purchased a strawberry pie from them and it was well loved! really a hit :)

A truly artisanal boulangerie and pâtisserie with a unique charm. The decorations are beautiful, and the interior design is warm and inviting. The breads and confectionery are always fresh, carefully made, and full of flavor. The creative coffee machine adds a special touch to the experience. The attendant is friendly and welcoming, making each visit pleasant. A unique bakery that stands out and is well worth a stop.

name: Bakerbots Baking
address: 1242 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M6H 1N5, Canada
reviews: Phenomenal experience! This local bakery has such a wonderful selection of pastries, which are a little pricey, but great as a treat! They do also have Bang Bang Ice Cream flavours that were delectable & perfect if you don’t want to go to their location (that typically has a pretty long wait). The service was helpful and friendly, along with a reliable team that makes the line go fast! The seating is limited, but the window seats are really great for a small rendezvous. Overall, I’ll definitely be returning to Bakerbots Baking for another treat!

One of the most pillowy and delicious cinnamon buns I have evr had! The frosting is also perfect and not too sweet, truly one of the best. Apple pie was kind of mid, the crust is kind of thick and the apples were a little too sour to my liking. But definitely would come back to try the cakes! Staffs were really nice too, the café is rather small so not much seats for dining in, but they have chairs outside so you can sit there and enjoy your sweet treat!

After a work visit, I needed a good brew and a bite to eat so I ended up coming by this cute little cafe!

Stepping into this location, I was greeted immediately and given plenty of time for me to pick through their various options. Going with a misto, a everything cookie, a brownie and some banana pudding, I felt like I was stocked up.

I was allowed to decide how much water was going into my coffee and that was very welcome! Being told of the allergy notices as a heads up as I was picking through the different options was also very welcome.

The coffee was excellent, with a creamy finish from the milk but still stable and almost a malty note from the coffee itself. The cookie was excellent, almost black magic that it was chewy and held its consistency despite it being gluten free and vegan. The brownie was also decadent without it being cloyingly sweet, with a hint of a stout profile and a fudgy texture.

The banana pudding (despite the sign for 1 per customer) was a let down. Yes, the cream was perfect and even the slices of banana was even and almost mechanically precise, it was texturally lacking. Having some sort of crumb or anything like a banana tuile would elevate it and give it that right amount of crisp to it.

This is such a good spot to sit down and enjoy a brew and see the city of Toronto go by you. A slight misstep but still a lot of good offerings at this location!
Love their strawberry cake! Wonder where they bought the strawberries, good quality! Would love to come try other things next time

One of my fav bakery in Toronto. Simply amazing! My go to place for depression comfort treats. Their chocolate mayonnaise cake is a must try. Plus if you don’t want to line up at bang bang ice cream, they have some of their flavour too!!

A hidden gem on Toronto’s west side! I absolutely loved the cozy vibe and the adorable display area. I tried the espresso ice cream, and it was so impressive. Next time, I definitely want to try the creamy cinnamon roll!

I came on April 1st during the evening with my friend and was helped by the lady and gentleman. They were both Asian. I wouldn’t normally mention race but I wanted to find a way to identify them somehow. Nonetheless we had such a great customer service experience, the lady was very patient. And the gentleman came to our table to see how everything was and if we wanted a beverage. He was very sweet and cute! We had the Cinnamon bun, banana pudding and chocolate cake. The first two were a standout, that cinnamon bun was perfect in every way. Very soft, completely covered in a semi sweet icing. And the banana pudding was very banana-ey, I loved how the cream was more custard in texture rather than airy. The chocolate cake was very dense. I personally prefer more of a fudge chocolate vibe but it was still good!
Excellent bakery. Got the carrot cake, strawberry tart, key lime pie and butter tart with guava. My family enjoyed everything. The butter tart with guava was a fun spin on a classic.

name: Cadet
address: 1431 Boul. Saint-Laurent, Montreal, Quebec H2X 2S8, Canada
status: Stylish spot for small plates & wine
reviews:
A restaurant deserving of its place on Montreal’s BibGourmand.
The fried sea bass was among the better fish dishes I’ve ever had.
Every other dish was spiced really well. Salt and heat levels were perfect. It felt as though each element of the different dishes served an important purpose, contributing to the enjoyment of the whole.
Dishes came out hot, portions were good and the server gave excellemment recommendations through and through.
I hope to be able to eat here again!

Come as you are as this place is not pretentious but the food is top notch!  We had calamari, beef tartare, focaccia, lamb, black cod, and mushrooms and it was all amazing.  The sauces were unique and we soaked up every last bit of it!  Top that off with a bottle of Chardonnay and the evening was complete.  Although not inexpensive, I thought it was well priced for the food quality and quantity.  We will be back next time we’re in Montreal for sure.

Simply delicious- we ordered a variety of plates and shared them with 4 people, and definitely enjoyed it very much. Zucchinis super,  beetroots superb, potatoes yummy, and last but not least chicken wings, dream of a dream, really recommend them. Plus some calamaris, which were excellent. Service was very attentive and nice, the atmosphere is fine and if you want to plan to go there, you should definitely do reservations. Plan ahead !!! Pricing for 4 people no alcohol around 185 Canadian $

For being so expensive, the food kinda misses the mark. We got the beet salad, focaccia, the croquettes, the beef tartare & the lamb. Over all things were okay but the attention to details was missing. About half the lamb piece was fat which was kinda disappointing. The croquettes came with a sauce which was a little tasteless. Same with the sauce that came with the focaccia. We got a chocolate tart for dessert and it was okay. Not too bad. Can't go wrong with peanut butter & chocolate. The drinks were nice but the attention to detail was missing. Eg no cherries for old fashioneds. Like I get it different places make it different but if it's in the classic recipe and we're ordering a classic drink... would be nice to just include it in the drink. The service was wonderful and fast :)

Well!!

I dined here for the first time on the 3rd of March around 9pm.

Very much enjoyed the menu and tried a bit of everything.

My favourite was the focaccia with the sauce. Very delicious.

I also loved the giant fish with the sauce as well.

I enjoyed many things here but they could be more bold with the flavours.

Everything was light and airy but I’m more looking for something that makes my palate dance.

I didn’t do any research on this place before going.

But you are and that’s why I’m sure you’ll know what to expect.

Light, delicious, tasty, a bit lacking and very fancy with the portion sizes.

Thank you for reading ♥️

name: North & Navy
address: 226 Nepean St, Ottawa, ON K2P 0B8, Canada
status: Cozy locale for Northern Italian fare
reviews: We had a great experience here. The food was delicious and our server Rosheen was outstanding the entire meal. My only gripes are that it’s a little too dim inside the dining area, and I think the tiramisu donut is creative but needed a softer donut casing (and a bit less rum).

We came here in June 2025 for our ten year anniversary, and it was N&N’s 10 year as well, so they had a special tasting menu. We did that as well as the added wine tasting menu. The service was great and the food was really innovative. Not exactly what you think when you think Italian, because it’s truly more northern Italian inspired, which is very different from what we think as Italian. The wine was delicious and the atmosphere is really cool.
We came back last month for a birthday and had the private room upstairs. The food, cocktails and wine were really good, and we had great service. The ceiling in the room was arched so it was quite loud with a big group.

Adam & Chris's team hit it out of the park this evening. Our server Amanda was exceptional and can explain the menu right down to each ingredient. This was probably the finest Italian cuisine I have ever experienced in Canada. This is a must try if you are in Ottawa. We will be back. 10 stars

The food was delicious and the server was able to accommodate my partner and I as we are both vegans. We were limited on our options but we still enjoyed the dishes available to us. Hopefully North and Navy can explore more plant based dishes in the future!

We had the loveliest meal for a colleague last night. The food was stellar and the service perfect. We asked for a walk through of the menu and our waitress went through every item in amazing detail. We all loved our meal and will definitely be back!

The loveliest birthday dinner. Our waiter, Sebastian, was incredibly attentive and thoughtful. His passion for the menu made us want to order everything off it. His French was great, which was so helpful for my mom. The food was delish. Can’t want to come back!

It’s just good. Neither “old school” nor “too cool for school.”  Friendly, efficient service. Inventive cocktails, good wine, and delicious food. Our only problem was that it was TOO efficient.  We were in and out in about 90 minutes (cocktails and two courses), so we actually missed the waiting time. 😂

I had an amazing time at North and Navy! The food was incredible - I tried the white truffle pasta, the butternut squash mezzaluna, the halibut panne and gnocchi, and the tiramisu. All were amazing, but the truffle pasta and tiramisu were the highlights.

My server/bartender Quinn went above and beyond helping me choose food and wine, and suggested an amazing wine pairing for the truffle pasta. She was super knowledgeable about everything behind the bar (there are some bottles with cool stories back there!). She made the experience great!

name: Matari Coffee Co.
address: 3465 Platinum Dr Unit 97, Mississauga, ON L5M 2S1, Canada
reviews:
This Yemeni coffee shop in Mississauga is a great spot for anyone looking to enjoy high-quality coffee in a welcoming and modern space. The café is very clean, with beautiful, contemporary décor that makes it comfortable to sit in or stop by for a quick drink.

The service is excellent—friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. There’s an impressive variety of both hot and cold beverages, many with rich Middle Eastern flavours, along with a wide selection of desserts and cakes to choose from.

Parking is free, which is a plus, although it can be a bit challenging to find a spot at busy times. Prices are very reasonable for the quality and experience offered. Overall, it’s a solid choice and definitely worth visiting if you’re in the area.

We visited this café yesterday evening and had a wonderful experience. We tried their Yemeni Latte, Spanish Latte and Matari , and both were truly exceptional. The Yemeni Latte had a rich, aromatic flavor with a perfectly balanced sweetness, making it both comforting and unique. The Matari (like a Kashmiri Tea) on the other hand, was beautifully showcasing authentic depth and quality.
The ambiance of the café was nice and inviting, creating a perfect spot to enjoy a premium coffee experience. The staff were friendly and attentive, which added to the overall positive visit.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who appreciates high-quality, flavorful coffee. Looking forward to visiting again!

Beautiful cafe! Love the inside. Great spot for studying. The low rating is because of the prices. I got the iced caramel macchiato. It was 9 dollars plus an additional 1.50 to get it iced. That’s a bit ridiculous to me. The drink was pretty good although nothing special especially for that price tag.

Matari Coffee in Ridgeway Plaza is a great spot. The coffee was good, and they have a solid selection of snacks and desserts to go with it. The atmosphere is fantastic. It's easy to hold a conversation without fighting background noise, and it never felt too crowded. Whether you're meeting one person or getting together as a small or large group, the space works well. Convenient, comfortable, and a genuinely good coffee environment. Recommended..

I finally checked out Matari Coffee at Ridgeway Plaza and tried their House Frappe—and wow, I was completely blown away. I honestly wasn’t expecting it to be anywhere near this good, but it exceeded every expectation. The flavor was rich, perfectly balanced, and easily one of the best frappes I’ve had.

A huge shout-out to Amina and Hanin for their amazing service. They were incredibly welcoming, friendly, and made the whole experience even better. Great drinks, great atmosphere, and outstanding customer service. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend giving the House Frappe a try!

I visited Matari for the first time today and it was amazing! Marwa was honestly the highlight, super friendly, welcoming, and just made the whole experience 10x better. She helped us choose what to get and recommended the Vimto matcha, which was so good. Her service really stood out, you can tell she genuinely cares and goes all out. I’ll definitely keep coming back to try more drinks and for her amazing service.

I always hated matcha ever since I was a kid, but I have to admit that this is my 3rd visit in the past week to have their Vimto Matcha drink, and trust me IT IS SO GOOD! THE COMBINATION OF VIMTO AND MATCHA IS OUT OF THIS WORLD! This time I brought my friends as well to try it, and they loved it too! The staff are also super helpful and friendly which makes the experience 10x better! You guys have to check this place out!!

Matari's Adani Chai was absolutely outstanding! ☕️✨

Rich, aromatic, and perfectly spiced, every sip was warm and comforting. You can taste the care that goes into making it—the tea was smooth and well-balanced, with just the right amount of sweetness and traditional Yemeni flavors. It had that authentic homemade taste that makes you slow down and truly enjoy the moment.

If you're an Adani chai lover, Matari is definitely worth a visit. It's the kind of chai that stays with you long after the cup is empty and leaves you looking forward to your next visit.

Highly recommended for anyone craving a delicious, authentic cup of Adani chai! 🌿☕️❤️

The pistacho cake was really light and refreshing, just the right amount of sweetness - a must try.

5/5 — one of the best Adani chais I've had!

name: Zeko's Barbershop
address: 786 Concession St, Hamilton, ON L8V 1C9, Canada
reviews: I highly recommend this barbershop! I always leave with a fresh, clean cut. My go-to barber is Ahmet—he’s incredibly attentive to detail, consistently delivers amazing haircuts, and is great at suggesting different styles that end up looking fantastic. The entire team is professional and welcoming, and you can tell they genuinely care about their clients. I really appreciate the hard work they put into making us look our best. Thank you!

As a mom of two teen boys who regularly visit Zeko’s Barbershop, I can’t recommend it enough! The quality of work is consistently outstanding, and the atmosphere is warm and inviting. The staff is not only friendly but also incredibly professional and knowledgeable about the latest styles. It’s a relief to know my boys are in such good hands. If you’re looking for a reliable barbershop that treats its clients like family, Zeko’s is the place to go!

Been going to Ahmet for my kid's cut for a few months now and couldn't be happier!! Today my kiddo wanted to try a new style and he walked him through it, gave him styling advice and best of all makes my 10 year old feel in charge of his style while still making sure mom is happy:) The cut was exceptional, fast, and EXACTLY what my son wanted- as usual!
Highly recommend anyone at the shop, but especially Ahmet- all the kind people there make it an enjoyable experience! Also appreciate the sweet receptionist that always makes sure we get a candy and a smile on our way out :)

Zeko was absolutely amazing for my 15 month old’s first haircut! He was so patient and kind, and made the whole experience fun and stress free. The entire staff was super friendly and welcoming too. Couldn’t have asked for a better first haircut — 100% recommend! ❤️❤️❤️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Absolutely fantastic experience! I went in for a custom style haircut and beard trim, and the stylist exceeded my expectations. They took the time to understand exactly the look I was going for, paid attention to every detail, and delivered a clean, sharp, and professional result. The haircut suits me perfectly, and the beard trim was blended flawlessly. Great atmosphere, excellent customer service, and impressive skill. I left feeling confident and looking my best. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a top-quality haircut and beard grooming service!

Ps:- I didn’t get the stylist’s name. He was a bearded guy with a small ponytail.

I just moved to Canada and I was in search for a good barbershop for half a year, changed couple of them. Went to Zekos and they are amazing. Ahmet is my barber and I can only recommend him to everyone. Nice and clean job!

Zeko’s Barbershop is the best shop around! I’ve had family members and friends who have been going there since shortly after he opened who recommended Zeko’s to me years ago. I’ve been taking my husband there for almost 5 years now and recently got to bring my son there for his first haircut! Zeko is so friendly and professional, and his staff - no matter who - are clearly hand selected to meet his high standards. He was so great and patient with my son who started to get a bit cranky towards the end of his haircut and ensured to deliver nothing short of perfection. I also want to give a special mention to the receptionist Julie who makes everyone feel like family, she is always smiling and making you feel at home the second you walk in to the moment you leave. 100% recommend!
Amazing experience with Ahmet for our son’s first haircut. Highly recommend! They even sent us home with an official certificate as a keepsake. Thank you so much for being so great with him!

name: Pâtisserie Afroditi
address: 756 Rue Saint-Roch, Montreal, Quebec H3N 1L3, Canada
reviews: Lovely design and love the many options of cakes and desserts. Also have some Greek ingredients products like coffee, feta, olive oil etc. Clean and decorative. Very welcoming and pleasing to the eyes as you skim through the displays.

This pastry and bakery shop offers a chic ambiance while reflecting its Greek heritage. Upon entering, customers are greeted by the aroma of freshly baked goods and a well-organized space stocked with a wide selection of Greek specialties. The atmosphere is inviting and has a homelike charm. There may be a short wait during busy hours, but staff members provide friendly and attentive service☺️. Maria and Artemis definitely know how to leave a good first impression❤️. Maria was very helpful and patient, she guided me through the variety of pastries available. The ones I chose were well balanced in flavor with a reasonable dose of sugar! Their strawberry shortcake and cheesecake are a must try, trust me! They were both exceptionally delicious🥰. Overall, it is a gem worth to stop by and try their many dessert options.

Hello, I ordered a birthday cake for my husband. We usually get desserts from them, and everything has always been fine—I’ve ordered cakes from them before. But this time, I paid extra for them to decorate it with strawberries. As you can see, some of the strawberries are still green, and others are just rotten. I don’t understand what I paid extra for.

What a great find! The cozy atmosphere and fresh food made for a wonderful meal. I loved the balance of flavors in every dish. The staff were very attentive and provided great service. I’ll be sharing this place with everyone I know. It's truly a unique dining destination.

I have bought Afroditi cakes for years. But the last few times we have bought a cake i noticed the sponge is so dry inside. The chocolate ganache is good but if the sponge is dry it just ruins the cake. For the price you pay I am getting disappointed with their cakes.

name: Chiang Mai Mississauga
address: 285 Enfield Pl #100, Mississauga, ON L5B 3Y6, Canada
reviews: I visited Chiang Mai with my wife and her family to celebrate my father-in-law’s birthday, and we had a wonderful experience. The food was very good overall, and a few standouts were the soft shell crab, pineapple fried rice, and ube tiramisu. However, what really made this place excellent was the incredible service. Nancy, our server, was incredibly kind and helpful throughout dinner. Our dishes were cleared by the whole team in a timely fashion. The restaurant provided my father-in-law a surprise complimentary cheesecake with a birthday message.  And at the end of the night, the manager came by to speak with us to check in and make sure we enjoyed our experience. Would recommend for a fun night out!

This is most definitely a restaurant you need to visit!!! The food was absolutely delicious and perfectly presented. This is what we ordered and we were so satisfied. I'm missing photos of the lemongrass dumplings & the crying tiger steak which were out of this world too. Kudos to the staff who looked after our table, they are doing a phenomenal job!:)

My sister-in-law took me out with a few other people to Chiang Mai in Mississauga for my birthday, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The food was absolutely delicious, the service was attentive (thanks to our server Tyler), the valet parking was a great convenience (thanks to the valet guy), and the ambiance was beautiful and welcoming.
We had a reservation, and although we arrived late, the staff were very accommodating and were still able to seat us. I definitely recommend making a reservation in advance, as this place gets very busy. Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience, and I can't wait to come back!

Beautifully and aesthetically pleasing restaurant.
Food is delicious atmosphere is wonderful.
Our particular server this evening was a bit pushy, continuously rushing us to order and eat.
But other than that, it was good place to get together.
Would return and recommend.

Service: 9/10
Food: 5.5/10
Atmosphere: 8/10

If you want my complete honest review, the service was exceptional – food, not so much.

The chicken pad Thai was lacking flavor. If anything, the taste was not there. I was not aware of what I was eating. I have had numerous different pad Thais from several different restaurants, and this has been far the worst.

The restaurant manager noticed we were not touching the dish, and came to check on our table. We really appreciated the exceptional service, as the manager removed the dish from our table and off our bill, and offered to replace our meal. The reason why I am giving such a high rating is because this has been hands-down, the best service I have had at any restaurants in Mississauga.

Our server was attentive and consistently checking in to see how we were doing. The service was quick, and food came to our table in less than 10 minutes. Even though the food was lacking flavour (we ordered the chicken pineapple rice, chicken pad, Thai, and deep fried calamari), the service made up for it.

Aside from the food not tasting its best, the presentation was gorgeous. I will be willing to give this restaurant a second chance.

Sidenote – even though we went on a weekday, it was extremely busy. I would recommend either putting your name on a waitlist in advance or making reservations (online reservations require for you to input your card information). Another cool factor is that they provide complementary valet parking.

name: Donatello Restaurant
address: 37 Elm St, Toronto, ON M5G 1H1, Canada
status: Quaint choice for classic Italian dishes
reviews:
We enjoyed a Wednesday evening dinner with family at Donatello Restaurant. We chose to sit indoors to escape the heat, although the patio looked lovely. The restaurant has a warm Italian atmosphere, and my Blueberry Mojito was delicious.

Despite it being a busy evening, our server, Isabella, was very friendly, attentive, and provided excellent service. The owners were also welcoming, greeting and seating guests, which added a nice personal touch.

Our meals were satisfactory overall. Unfortunately, I wasn't feeling well later that evening, although it's hard to know whether it was related to the meal. I'm hopeful this was just an isolated experience.

The following day, I returned to the restaurant to retrieve a hat I had accidentally left behind. When I mentioned it to one of the owners, I was told that no hat had been found. However, I walked over to the table where we had been seated, and my hat was still on the floor where it had apparently fallen. I was happy to recover it, but I was surprised it hadn't been noticed.

One suggestion for diners is to review your bill carefully before paying, especially if you plan to leave an additional tip, just to ensure you're aware of any gratuity that may already have been included.

Overall, Donatello offers a pleasant atmosphere, warm hospitality, and attentive service, but there were a couple of aspects of my visit that could have been handled a little better.

Great atmosphere and delicious food. We started with a simple bread and butter appetizer, followed by a fresh and tasty Frutti di Mare. For the main course, we had Linguine alle Vongole and Gnocchi Donatello—both were excellent and full of flavor. The drinks were amazing as well.

Donatello is the BEST restaurant in Toronto!

Last year, I was in town for a conference and ended up eating here three nights in a row—ordering the same dish each time because it was just that good! I also received incredible service from Tibor, so when I returned this year, I was really hoping he'd be working. Sure enough, he was—and he even remembered me!

The food was every bit as amazing as I remembered. Since I was only in town for two nights this time, I made sure to eat at Donatello both nights. As an international speaker, I have the opportunity to dine all over the world, and this remains one of my absolute favorite dishes anywhere.

From the incredible food and drinks to the wonderful atmosphere, desserts, and exceptional customer service, everything about Donatello is outstanding. You can tell the entire team genuinely cares about creating a great experience—everyone pitches in and helps each other, which makes the service feel warm and personal. Even the owner is present, working, and taking the time to greet customers.

A very special thank you to Tibor for the incredible service and for making every visit so memorable. I can't wait to come back next summer and see you again!

If you're in Toronto, Donatello is a must-visit!

This restaurant was perfect for the patio dining experience we wanted that wasn't too far from the Chelsea hotel. The atmosphere is romantic and intimate, classic Italian. The food, drinks, and service were impeccable!! Would love to come back the next time I'm in Toronto!!

We had a great experience here! Located right across from Chelsea Hotel, this was fine dining-quality food & service while still accepting my family dressed down for city strolling. The food was phenomenal. Our server was accommodating & gave the best menu recommendations. He really listened to our tastes & gave great suggestions. We have some picky eaters & we all agreed the food was delicious. Also have a child with a severe allergy- they took it seriously which was reassuring. Cozy & inviting atmosphere as well.

Highly recommended you try this spot, you won’t be disappointed ! We will definitely be back :)

The servers here are all super friendly and funny. I finally found a garlic white wine clam pasta done right — it was amazing! Not too oily, not too salty, but still really flavorful. The portion was generous too. I absolutely loved it!

The service was very slow. We had to wait another 40 minutes after finishing our appetizers before our main courses arrived. Overall, both the food and the wine were mediocre. The chicken was enjoyable, but the gnocchi in the pasta section was very bland and tasteless—probably the worst gnocchi we’ve ever had. Unfortunately, due to the poor service and mediocre food, we won’t be coming back.

We stopped here for one drink and ended up spending about three hours enjoying different drinks and being treated like we were very special customers. Khaled honestly was amazing! And watching him interact with different tables made me realize they treat everyone like this. Our experience was one of a kind! I would recommend this restaurant to anyone, whether it is for drinks or dinner!

name: #Teashop
address: 52C Rue De la Gauchetière O, Montreal, Quebec H2Z 1C1, Canada
status: Basic stop for bubble tea drinks
reviews: Stopped by while exploring Chinatown and was really impressed! The bubble tea was fresh, perfectly balanced, and the tapioca pearls were soft and chewy. The staff were friendly, the service was quick, and there are so many unique flavors to choose from. Great quality for the price, and it’s definitely a spot I’ll be coming back to whenever I’m in the area. Highly recommend if you’re looking for one of the best bubble tea places in Montreal!

Wow—major respect to #Teashop for being the only 24/7 bubble tea shop I’ve come across. That alone deserves recognition.

Another huge plus is the promotions they run during certain hours, including buy-one-get-one offers, which add incredible value. But what really surprised me was the quality of the drinks themselves.

I had low expectations for a small, hole-in-the-wall, 24-hour tea shop, but #Teashop completely exceeded them. The milk tea was genuinely good, and the pearls were the biggest surprise—freshly cooked, perfectly chewy, and far better than I expected.

Located right in the heart of Chinatown, this place proves that you don’t need a fancy storefront to deliver a great bubble tea experience. Between the convenience of being open 24/7, the great promotions, and the surprisingly solid milk tea quality, this is a fantastic spot to keep in mind for a late-night craving or an affordable bubble tea fix.

Absolutely loved this bubble tea shop! The drinks were fresh, flavorful, and perfectly balanced—not overly sweet. The tapioca pearls were soft and chewy, and the ingredients tasted high quality. The staff were friendly, welcoming, and prepared my order quickly. The shop was clean with a nice atmosphere, making it a great place to stop by. I’ll definitely be coming back to try more flavours. Highly recommend to anyone looking for great bubble tea!

Late night stories were especially appreciated
This my favourite bubble tea shop for the r past 5 years. I really respect this people. Number 1 teashop. Always fresh tapioca and quality ingredients.

We got the passion fruit mango boba tea.
As usual, mini booba tea and bubble tea outlets on this road. Great choices. So it's whatever appeals, just walking gram. Drink to go.The taste was good and kids enjoyed it

name: Café OUI MAIS NON
address: 72 Rue Jarry E, Montreal, Quebec H2P 1T1, Canada
reviews:
I had the matcha latte, didn’t taste right.
The berry smoothie was also strange tasting and sour. The chili tasted good.

What an amazing place!! The atmosphere inside is very welcoming, the workers are extremely nice and it’s a quieter spot which was really appreciated by my friend and I. The food is so delicious while the prices are reasonable. Highly recommend the vegetarian chilli with chips and their white peach tea, both were a 10/10 for me. If you’re looking for comfort food spot with a peaceful cozy vibe this cafe is perfect. I loved it and will be returning :)
Good vibes only up in this place. Plenty of seating indoors and outdoors!

I like the atmosphere of this cafe. It’s located just beside the parc jarry. The baristas are friendly and helpful to guide me when i’m looking for the menu that’s already not being sold. Their latte is really good and taste not burn. The cafe decoration itself combining the cabin feeling and the classic cafe. It really suitable for people from just hanging out and relaxing to study and working.

I absolutely love Oui Mais Non. It is such a great coffee shop to have in the neighborhood. I have been here a few times now, and it has quickly become one of my go to spots when I want a good drink and a cozy place to relax or get some work done.

One thing that really stands out is how many drink options they have. Whether you are in the mood for coffee, espresso based drinks, hot chocolate, or even matcha, there is something for everyone. I recently got a large matcha latte and was pleasantly surprised by how big it was. It felt like great value and tasted really smooth and well balanced. I also tried their pineapple mango smoothie, and it was honestly delicious. It was super refreshing, full of flavor, and something I would 100% go back for on its own.

In the past, I have also had some of their soups and sandwiches, and those were just as impressive. They were fresh, tasty, and perfect for a light meal. It is nice to have a café that does both drinks and food well.

The atmosphere is another big highlight. The space is warm, inviting, and thoughtfully set up, with plenty of room to sit down, plug in your laptop, and work comfortably. I also really love that they feature cute local items for sale throughout the café. It adds a unique, community focused touch that makes the space feel even more special.

The staff here truly make a difference as well. The cashiers and workers are always so helpful when it comes to explaining the menu and offering recommendations. They are also consistently attentive about keeping the space clean, clearing empty glasses, and making sure everything feels comfortable and welcoming.

Overall, this place has a great vibe, great drinks, and consistently good food. I definitely recommend checking it out.

A place with a lot of character. We discovered this gem a few days ago when craving for late night coffee. It appears small but a lot of seating space inside and, from what I see in other reviews, even in the basement.
We went for a Dirty Chai Latte and a regular Latte (with non-dairy milks) along with their Panini Vege Sandwich and a Grill Cheese Sandwich. Love the food and the coffee and chai. Service is quick. There's no table service but the lady was so kind to bring it to the table to avoid food getting cold as we were seated far and didn't expect the sandwich to be ready so quick. A variety of seating space, we'd like to try something different next time.
There's street parking outside which is generally available. Definitely recommended!!
Darling and delicious!!! I had a pecan roll and a spicy Mocha drink. Both were fantastic. Wifi is free and everywhere is just so cute. I sat in the basement which was nice and secluded.

Love this café. It is so versatile and can be used for so many different things. You can just have a coffee and chill. Or you can come here after a long walk at the park and have some snack snacks. Or you could spend a whole afternoon working. And I have done all of these things and it is one of the best cafés in Montreal.

name: Pâtisserie Harmonie
address: 85 Rue De la Gauchetière O, Montreal, Quebec H2Z 1K1, Canada
reviews:
Hidden gem in Montréal Chinatown! 🥐🥤

Everything we tried was fresh and delicious. The buns were soft and fluffy, the hot dog buns were warm and tasty, and the cream puff was light with a generous amount of cream.

There was a great selection of both sweet and savory baked goods, all at reasonable prices.

The staff were friendly, and they even offer a loyalty card where you buy 6 slush drinks and get the 7th one free, which is a nice bonus.

We’ll definitely be back whenever we’re in Chinatown!

Pâtisserue Harmonie was so enticing that our group actually came back to get more treats after discovering it too close to breakfast. I picked out a warm bbq pork bun, a green tea red bean bun, a honeydew coconut mochi, a matcha steam cake, and a red bean moon cake. Then the cashier told me if you get six items, you can save on tax, so I got another moon cake for a friend. I also ordered a coconut boba drink. I ate two of the buns and the steam cake for lunch and saved the rest for later. While the bakery doesn’t have seating, it is down the street from an area with benches where we sat outside and enjoyed our food. Beware, the birds will be staring at you, waiting for you to drop something. Overall, a wonderful spot and I would go get more treats from this place!

When we visited the store, it was almost closing time, but the bread was still good. I especially liked the way they kept the bread warm. Also, when they packed the bread, each loaf was packed in a different bag.

I bought what was supposed to be an almond cheese cake for my daughter’s birthday and it was quite a huge disappointment. It was actually a vanilla almond sponge cake with a whole lot of thick cream layers inside out and fruits on top. At least the cream tasted nice and light but the sponge cake itself was a bit dry. For what it’s worth, it was overpriced.
Ordered a hot coffee, chicken teriyaki bun, and beef curry bun. Everything was absolutely delicious. Definitely come here if you are looking for a quick, cheap, and delicious meal

I cannot say enough good things about my experience with Fadi. I came in with my hair pitched a very dark, almost jet black, and I wasn't sure it could even be saved, let alone lightened the way I wanted. Fadi completely put my mind at ease. He helped me bring the colour back down to a beautiful brown, and the transformation was honestly better than I had hoped for.

What stood out most was how much time and care he took with every single step. He never rushed, never made me feel like just another appointment, and clearly took the time to understand exactly what I wanted. He's patient, genuinely kind, and you can tell he actually cares about his clients' wants and needs rather than just getting them in and out of the chair. That kind of attentiveness is rare.

I ended up coming back a second time to fix my roots, because I couldn't handle the burning sensation from the bleach the first time around. Even then, Fadi was incredibly understanding. He was gentle, patient, and made sure I was comfortable the entire time. He listened to my concerns and worked around them without any fuss, which I really appreciated.

I also have to give a huge shout-out to his colleagues, Sarab and Barbara, who helped take care of me as well. Both of them were so welcoming, warm, and friendly, and they made the whole experience feel relaxed and pleasant from start to finish. The hospitality across the board was lovely.

If you're even thinking about getting your hair done here, I cannot recommend Fadi highly enough. Whether it's a tricky colour correction or something simple, you'll be in genuinely caring, skilled hands. I'll absolutely be coming back.

Barbara is absolutely wonderful! ❤️ She is so talented, kind, and genuinely caring. Every appointment feels like a little treat, and I always leave feeling beautiful, refreshed, and so happy with my hair.
