address: 609 King St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1M5, Canada
status: Hip cafe with Italian-style baked goods
reviews: Freshly baked bread and rich, creamy sandwiches with deep umami flavor make this a standout spot ✨️🤍 The quality of the ingredients is excellent, and the overall taste is outstanding👌🏻. While the prices are on the higher side, the food and inviting atmosphere make it well worth a visit.

Being a big fan of Almond croissants for as long as I remember, I finally found something even better and can never go back now!
Forno Cultura’s Cornetto Mandolra is packed with roasted Almond and the pastry is so flakey and most importantly, just enough sweetness that doesn’t leave you feeling guilty and heavy. It is definitely superior and I’ll ditch almond croissants for this anytime! Please please please keep this recipe and keep making them fresh! Such a gem!

The bakery has a hip style seating and really appreciate the goods more when you can see the hardworking bakers put all their hearts and souls into their creations.

Ok, so I just finished my sandwich and damn, it’s really good. I had the Mortadella and the bread has a nice crunch and flavour. It’s also great seeing their bread being created too. I thoroughly enjoyed my experience.

This place is dangerously good!  Tucked off of the bustling King West neighbourhood, walk down a few steps to find this amazing spot.  Filled with incredible Italian sandwiches, pastries and cookies, it’s a sure bet to keep me coming back for more!  Daniel, the barista, makes incredible drinks!
The almond pastry was interesting. The americano was good for North American standards though not quite on a European level. Overall one of the better cafes in Toronto though.

address: 311 Rue Saint-Paul E, Montréal, QC H2Y 1J3, Canada
reviews: Amazing ambiance and very unique menu options.  I love the vibe, decor and location.  I like the menu options even if I found them slightly overpriced for what you get.  I absolutely loved the plantain burger with tarot chips, good portion and I would highly recommend.  The other items on the menu I will be trying the next visit, as recommended by my friends.  I felt welcome at this restaurant and they didn’t make us feel like we had a time limit, which most places do now.  We all loved the food and the DJ on Saturday night kept the vibes going.  Can’t wait to come back!!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

An amazing Haitian food experience! The dishes were soulful, authentic, and packed with incredible flavors that truly showcase the richness of Haitian cuisine. 🇭🇹🍽️

The highlights were the oxtail poutine — a creative and delicious fusion — and the fried pork (griot), which was flavorful, tender, and perfectly executed. The coleslaw added a nice kick with a bit of spice that balanced the meal beautifully. The portions were also very generous and satisfying.

The atmosphere was elevated by fantastic Haitian music, bringing great energy and warmth to the experience. The service was welcoming and friendly. During today’s brunch, service was a bit slower as there was only one waitress managing the room, but she remained attentive and did her best to take care of everyone.

I’ve also had the pleasure of visiting for a corporate winter event with amazing food and drink and it was beautifully organized from start to finish. The efficient reservation with AI on the phone was appreciated.

A wonderful place for authentic Haitian flavors, great music, and a memorable experience. Highly recommended! ✨

I was only in Montreal one night for a conference. When you come to Montreal you have to eat here, the food is absolutely outstanding, there is a great vibe and the service is beyond expectations. Our server Mahgi is superb!!!! He made recommendations, asked for allergies and checked in. He makes the most delicious cucumber tequila shot. All the meat is seasoned exceptionally and falls off the bone! You need to go and experience Kwizinn.
Mahdi and the crew were phenomenal! Great food, drinks, and experience! The goat and octopus were my favorites! Pairs well with the prosecco! Grown and sexy crowd for sure! Cheers!

Excellent food, superbly executed and varied flavors and dishes from a variety of countries from Lebanese Kibbeh to Haitian Patties.  Dessert was Mambo cake with hazelnut chocolate and this too was delicious and not too sweet.  Just a little pricey.

name: Caffè Italia
address: 6840 Boul. Saint-Laurent, Montréal, QC H2S 3C7, Canada
reviews:
Definitely a spot worth trying. Their cappuccino was very good. I also got their prosciutto sandwich - usually I am not a fan of prosciutto but this sadnwich was very good! And I got the mixed meat sandwich - another great contender. The bread they used for the sandwiches is light and toasty so it doesn't feel too heavy and doesn't hurt the roof of your mouth. The sandwiches don't have any sauce in them and yet they are flavourful. Next time I might ask them to make mine spicy as I was just missing some heat to round it all up.
Would recommend making a trip here. Parking was also easy to find on a Friday holiday morning. Could be busier on weekends.

When ever we are in Montreal and we want the real Italian coffee and flair that’s the place. Beautiful atmosphere, Bella italia in Montreal and super coffee. Nothing more to add, go and find out on your own.

A must try if you’re remotely near Little Italy or Jean-Talon.

The products they serve like coffees, espresso’s and cappuccino’s are above average. But I think the overall atmosphere really plays into your tasting experience.

It’s a must stop whenever my friends are in town, a great place to start your day or mid morning.

Last time I tried the sandwich without any expectations and it was great. The bread is toasted giving it a hard toasted outside but until you bite into it you feel the fluffy flavourful dough. The ingredients they use are fresh and top notch quality. The sandwich is nothing crazy but its simplicity and ratio of ingredients make it one of my favourite sandwich’s I’ve had.
Love coming here, the espresso is just perfect, every time. They also have all kinds of sandwiches, coffees and beverages, all very traditional, very good.

Elite vibes and sensational coffee. This place has a timeless charm that shows they’ve been doing things their way for decades. From the depth of the coffee to the sun-faded team soccer photos covering the walls, it radiates pure nostalgia. Definitely worth a stop for a sincere slice of Montreal’s Little Italy life. The small sandwiches are super tasty (more of a snack than a full meal) but the quality of ingredients makes every bite hit perfectly.

Caffè Italia!
Come have a café with the locals in Little Italy. Slow down and breathe and enjoy the wonderful community of Montreal. Barista Paolo is a wonderful human and gives you a warm welcome at the Caffè.

Been wanting to try this spot for a long time and I finally did. Easily best cappuccino in Mtl! Also the cortado is tasty. Tried the panini that the barista suggested and it was super delicious as well as the cheese ciabatta. The service is friendly fast and efficient and the cannolis were fresh and out of this world !

Caffè Italia is a charming, old-school gem that has stood the test of time—quite literally, since 1956. The moment you step inside, you’re greeted by a cozy, nostalgic atmosphere that feels like a slice of authentic Italian tradition.

I ordered their cannoli and latte, and both were absolute perfection,a perfect pairing.

Some places don’t need lengthy reviews because they speak for themselves, and Caffè Italia is one of them. If you appreciate timeless quality and old-world charm, this café is a must-visit.

address: 777 Blvd Robert-Bourassa Ste 105, Montreal, Quebec H3C 3Z7, Canada
reviews: Roland has been exceptional every time I’ve gone to him. He consistently delivers great cuts and really pays attention to detail. Today I came in wanting to try a completely new hairstyle, and he executed it perfectly without any hesitation. On top of that, he took the time to walk me through how to maintain the look and when to come back for touch-ups. Highly recommend! Professional, skilled, and genuinely cares about his clients.

I’ve been getting my haircut here for a few months now, and I’ve always gone with Roland. He’s definitely one of the best barbers I’ve ever had. Besides being very friendly, he’s extremely professional and pays great attention to detail. I’m really happy I found him. Highly recommended!

I’ve been to many barbers, but with Vid Jon you can feel the difference.
He takes his time, listens, and works with real precision.
Nothing rushed, nothing random, just clean and professional every time.
You can tell he takes pride in what he does.
Highly recommended. 👍

I trekked through concrete, grass, and potholes just to get to Meryem — and I’d do it again. She brings good energy and genuine vibes every visit. Best part? She visualizes exactly what you want and executes it perfectly. Clean, sharp, and always on point.

Thanks shortie.
R.
Thierry was a great barber! The fade is immaculate, and he paid attention to every detail. Super professional and I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

Jeric and Vaughn are my go-to barbers, no question. Every time I sit in their chair, I know I’m leaving fresh. They’re consistent, detail-oriented, and really take pride in their work. The fades are clean, the line-ups are sharp, and they never rush the cut.The shop is amazing too clean, great atmosphere, and just an overall good vibe. Always professional, always on point. If you’re looking for barbers you can trust every time, that’s them.

I’ve been going to Vid Jonh for a minute now and he never misses. Clean cuts every time, great attention to detail, and he’s really good at taking feedback and making sure you get exactly what you want. I highly recommend him for your next cut !!!

Been cutting with Roland for years. Was introduced to him through a friend and never looked back. Great service and the best barber in Montreal! Would highly recommend to anyone whether it be for scissors or clippers you’re in good hands.

reviews:
I had a great experience with DD today! He was very professional, friendly, and attentive to what I wanted. He did an excellent job with my haircut and made sure I was happy with the result. I really appreciated his attention to detail and the care he put into his work.

I highly recommend DD if you’re looking for a talented and professional hairstylist. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Took my son here for the first time. My son has been growing out his hair for a new look and Ali did a fantastic job giving him a cool new look. Ali is very kind and welcoming. So happy with the experience and so is my son. We will definitely return. Thank you Ali!

Amazing experience at Barbershop 89! DD and ALI are incredibly professional and talented — they really take their time to get every detail right. The atmosphere is clean, relaxed, and welcoming, and the service is always top-notch. I always leave feeling fresh and confident. Highly recommend Barbershop 89 to anyone looking for a perfect cut and great service!

Moe is an amazing barber! He’s professional, friendly, and always pays attention to every detail. The haircut comes out clean and exactly how you want it every time. Great service, great atmosphere, and definitely someone I’d recommend to anyone looking for a fresh cut. 10/10! 🔥💈

Great place. Friendly environment. The guys were welcoming and made it feel like I’ve been there before. It was my first visit. My Barber DD was fantastic. Gave me exactly what I asked for. Definitely gonna go back!

I have been coming to Barbershop 89 since they opened in my neighborhood.  The staff there are super friendly and professional.  I have had come in for walk-ins and I have booked appointments and the staff there have always accommodated me.  My usual barber DD is too notch.  He always makes sure I am happy with my cut and makes sure the style fits!  I really like the products they use as my wife always comments how good I smell coming back from the shop.  Highly recommended!!  5 stars!!

I’ve been to see DD twice now. Both times I’ve come in has been the most welcoming environment to walk into. DD always offers me a coffee or water when I arrive.

The haircut and beard trim are amazing. Great quality cut and the attention to detail is exactly what I’m looking for in a barber. To top it off, I always get a nice hot towel on my face to finish the main part of the cut. Aaaaand I’ve almost fallen asleep both times because it feels so relaxing and refreshing. 🤣🤦🏻‍♂️

Great attention to detail.  Great customer service. Very personable guy. BONUS! It’s 3 minutes from my house. I’m booking in with DD every 3 weeks!

Thank you for the great cuts my man 🙏🏻

I dropped in on a friend's recommendation, and wow, what a pleasant surprise! Mr. Moe worked magic, delivering on his promise to make me wedding-ready. Customer Service was exceptional too, forgot my shades and Ali assisted me with the retrieval. Can't wait for my next visit!

name: Gong Cha
address: 567 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 1Z2, Canada
reviews: Love this branch near our house! It's so accessible, being just walking distance from home, the library, and so many other establishments here in the downtown core. As usual, the drinks are topnotch,🧋 and so is the service. I'm digging the ambience too, as I can relax and even do some work on my laptop while sipping my drink. And oh, their croffles are divine too! 🧇😍

Gong cha is one of the staple bubble tea spots on Yonge and I think it does deserve its hype. The drinks are usually consistent and they have a wide range of options, suitable for any taste. Personally, my favourite drink here is the strawberry milk tea, 50% sugar and less ice with tapioca. It reminds me of my favourite bubble tea flavour growing up and it’s the only that’s got it right. Their fruit teas are also tasty, and their QQ peach is definitely worth a try if you’re into fruity drinks! There’s many seating options in this store and tables are always clean and well-maintained. The wifi connection is great as well if you’re looking to study. Finally, the store closes very late every day so it’s a great late-night study or hangout spot! I would highly recommend checking out this location, and I’ll definitely be back within the next few days!

Old review (May ? 2025)

Gong cha single-handedly brought back my strawberry milk tea craze that I’ve had since elementary school. It’s the only bubble tea store that makes it exactly how I like it. I swear I’ve increased their strawberry milk tea sales by 50% since I discovered them.

Anyway, this store was my go-to bubble tea spot in my first year of university. Particularly since it’s open until 2 AM on most days, which I took advantage of twice to finish assignments. I also enjoyed the abundance of seating inside the store (It still gets crowded at times and becomes completely full). Although the bubble tea here is not cheap and I will definitely have to cut my frequency of visits in second year in order to save money, I will definitely come back to study once in a while.

Great café! My wife loves your bubble tea and the Felix merchandise from Stray Kids - we only go to your location. The drinks are always fresh and delicious, especially the Pumpkin Spice Bubble Tea with Crème Brûlée Foam - perfectly balanced flavor and high quality. The service is fast and friendly. Thank you for keepin ~ch a high standard!
the bubble waffle was horrible, it was nothing like what i was expecting. do not come here if you are looking for hong kong style egg waffle.

Crave bubble teas than Gong Cha is the one. I always love to visit Gong Cha and its my favourite spot to have bubble teas. I never try anything other than Strawberry Chocolate earl grey milk tea, but this time i was tempted to order Thai Mango milk tea… and never disappointed for ordering it. Loved both the flavours. The staff is also friendly and quick.

reviews: Came back and had to go with the classic pork loin katsu and boy was I glad I did. This is the pork katsu I was looking for! I loved every bite. So tasty! I also ordered the crab croquette and this time I loved it! The tartar sauce was different since it was sweet but I liked it. Definitely coming back!

Ordered takeout from Katsuya Mississauga and tried the Carbonara Udon, Curry Katsu, and wings. Everything was fresh, well-prepared, and flavorful. The Carbonara Udon was rich and creamy, the Curry Katsu was crispy with a delicious curry sauce, and the wings were juicy and tasty.

Overall, the food was really good, and I'd definitely order from here again!

Delicious Japanese Katsudon and the portions are huge! We got the Japanese katsudon, chicken and pork, with a side of honey fries and cola slush. We enjoyed everything and were very satisfied with the amount of food for the price.

Tasty katsu served up in an authentic japanese restaurant atmosphere. Food is well prepared, great selection of katsu with various types of curry and sauces. The only thing that needs improvement is the service.  At times they seemed to be overwhelmed with uber eats orders which slows down service in the restaurant. Pretty annoying

Katsuya Mississauga is a popular Japanese-Korean fusion restaurant that specializes in highly customizable, premium tonkatsu (deep-fried cutlets).
Great service & delicious Chicken Katsu & Udon Carbo here at Katsuya  located at 1224 Dundas St W, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

i recommend if you want something refreshing to end your thrift shopping spree, as it’s right next to the metro mont royal!

Just went to their new location and tried the new menu, I was mesmerized! Truly delicious food, the sauces, the spring rolls and the chicken, the beef … EVERYTHING was super authentic and flavourful. I will definitely come back and this is one of the plateau recommendations I give to everyone.

i came in here expecting nothing at all, and ended up eating the besttt banh mi i’ve ever had ++ the couple who runs this place are the sweetest and most hospitable people ever (esp the lady)!! i don’t rlly leave google reviews, but this place is the best and the place was rlly calm! surely gonna be back with my friends 🫶

reviews: This was my first time getting highlights done at Shazam Salon, and I’m honestly so happy with the result! Shazam did an amazing job on my hair, and I absolutely love it. I’m so satisfied that I’ve become a regular customer of this salon. The rest of the salon staff were super friendly as well, and I really appreciated how clean and organized everything was. I 100% recommend Shazam Salon! ✨

This was my first time at this salon, and I was honestly so impressed! From the moment I walked in, the staff was welcoming and professional. The atmosphere was clean, relaxing, and friendly.

Shazam did an amazing job on my hair. It looks so healthy, refreshed, and beautifully styled. You can really tell he knows what he’s doing. He listened to what I wanted and delivered even better than I expected.

This is definitely my go-to place from now on. I’m so happy with the results and highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for great service and talented stylists!

Loved my haircut by Tasha! She actually listened (which is rare 😅) and gave me exactly what I asked for. Super considerate and easy to talk to. Definitely coming back!
She has a bright future as a hairapist 💇🏻‍♀️

This studio always gives me fantastic-looking hair. Tasha always does an outstanding job—she captured the exact color I wanted and revived my hair.
Whenever I need my hair done, I’ll always return here. The warm, inviting atmosphere makes each visit feel personal and genuinely enjoyable.

My wife Fatima got her haircut from Tasha today and she’s been in awe ever since. Here’s what shes’s saying
“Tasha was amazinggggg! She’s the most gentle person who ever touched my hair, she made me feel so comfortable throughout and I loved every bit of it! It was so therapeutic and I think I made a friend in Tasha as well, she’s the kindest/sweetest/gentlest human being I’ve ever met! I’ve been flaunting my hair ever since I came back. I got layers from her anda killer blow dry. The wash was so relaxing with warm water and I go to learn how to take better care of my hair.

This is my second time at the salon and I've loved my experience both times. Natalie is friendly, hospitable, punctual, and an amazing stylist. I've walked out of the salon with fantastic hair cuts. I've already booked a return appointment to get balayage done. Thanks!

I had fabulous balayage hair colouring today by sweet Irina… she is so talented …

I love it so much 🩷🩷 I would give her 10/10…

Will definitely come back again

I’m blown away!! I came in wanting some more dimension to my hair because it felt so flat and boring. Irina did an incredible job. My hair looks even better than the inspiration I showed her. I can’t stop looking at it! Love it!

address: 200 Laurier Ave W, Ottawa, ON K2P 1P1, Canada
reviews:
Charlotte did a phenomenal job!
I haven’t felt this confident in a hot minute but after she was done with my hair I’ve never felt better about myself!
She made me feel welcomed, comfortable, and beautiful!
I will also add that walking in, it feels like you are walking into one big warm hug! Everyone there is very friendly and engaging!!! I love it!
I will definitely be making a return!

They unfortunately destroyed my hair during a hair coloring service a few years back. It honestly took me a while to recover from this horror and speak about it. While they are so well rated, my stylist didn't seem experienced with darker hair and toned my hair way too deep compared to how much it had lifted. She also didn't account for the time it takes thicker and darker hair to lift and was rushing towards the end because it was past their closing time.

I would never go back again! After paying over $300, these were far from the results I excepted. A couple months later; I got my hair re-done and fixed at Glow studio which was a relief.

Leah was SO SWEET and very fun to talk to! She gave me great product recommendations for my frizzy hair and gave me some good advice to keep it healthy. My hair looks great, it’s never been so shiny and soft.
Her associate was also great, and was very welcoming. I enjoyed talking with her as well!
It’s been so long since I’ve been to a hair salon, so it was a great experience coming back into it.

I wish I could genuinely rate their hairstyling but I didn’t even get the chance to make it that far. I reached out to Rose & Rebel in the hopes they could fix a previous salon’s mistake on my hair. R&R responded with the suggestion that I go back to my previous salon and ask them to fix it. I explained that I didn't feel comfortable doing that and would be willing to pay R&R for their services since I had heard good things about them. Instead of doing the professional thing and either telling me they couldn’t offer services or they didn’t want to or they couldn’t fit me in, they ghosted me. I haven’t heard anything from them since. I really wanted to have a great experience here since I had heard good things about them but unfortunately will not be reaching out to them again.

My usual stylist is Ryan (who's 10/10!) so I was a bit nervous to schedule with a different stylist- but Grace was so wonderful that those nerves seem a bit silly now :) she listened attentively to what I wanted and worked with me to give me a great style. She was efficient, professional, and friendly. Rose and Rebel has the most welcoming and comfortable atmosphere of any salon I've been to, and I'm happy to keep coming back.

name: Al-Noor Bakery
address: 70 Wylie Ave, Ottawa, ON K2B 6M4, Canada
reviews: I ordered a dozen pizza and meat pies through DoorDash. They were tasty and delicious. Thank you for resolving the issue.
Amazing food and service I will always come back Abdul is amazing he always treats me well and respectfully and provides me with the best food in the city
Coming here from work for lunch breaks and really love the food and the vibe! People are super friendly as well.
The most delicious pastries in Canada, they’re all freshly made and very tasty. I highly recommend giving them a try.
This place stands out for quality of food, good prices and kind workers. They also open at 7:00 am. My kids love when we give them pie for school lunch. This plate is for just $12.

The veggies were fresh and spice level was nice, but the bread was SO stale. We ate half each and then ordered from somewhere else. 100% day old at least, and this is in the AM when you think things would be fresh out of the oven. It’s a shame. Went two stars instead of one because it’s cheap, but still wouldn’t go back.

I’ve had pies multiple times from here, never been disappointed until I ordered on Uber Eats. The cheese pie barely had any cheese in it, I ordered 4 and they all looked like the picture. There was barely any cheese on it, and super thin. Please don’t send out disappointing looking food to people on Uber Eats thinking people won’t notice and complain.

If I can give this place 0 stars I would. Haven’t been here for about 2 years because the pies are never fresh. Aladdin’s and Al farhats know how to run a business. So I walked in just when they opened after a long night of working, greeted the guy working and asked for 1 meat and cheese and one cheese pie. Thinking it’s just opened I’d get fresh ones. Guy puts my pies in the oven and I politely asked if the pies were fresh. He acted like he didn’t hear me and said huh so I repeated myself and he with an attitude answered they are from yesterday. So I asked when the fresh ones are coming out politely once again and he answers TOMORROW. I just ended up walking out. April 15th 7:15am if you are the owner of this shop speak to your employees if you were the owner serving me you need to work on your customer service and start making fresh pies for your customers. For me I will never visit again.

name: Solidaire Barbershop
address: 150 Dundas St W Unit: 102, Toronto, ON M5G 1C6, Canada
reviews: Needed a quick cut downtown. Stumbled across Abi and got taken care of to the fullest. He is great. Gave me the exact cut I asked for, was quick and efficient, and super kind. Literally can’t ask for more. Great dude, great spot. Will be coming back

Absolutely superb experience from start to finish! Hair cut and beard trim, ear and nose wax plus a head massage. One of the best experiences I have ever had! Great coffee served as well, so if you’re visiting the Toronto area and need this service then I would 110% recommend Solidaire. Such pleasant, genuine guys as well.

I had my boy’s hair cut here and they did amazing 🤩 my son is 2 and a half and very uncooperative 😆 They really tried to shake the fear off him and did a great cut while he moved a lot and he finished the appointment happily with a lollipop. Highly recommended!!

I had a great experience with hair cutter Sofien. I was afraid because I'm Brazilian and have. Big confidence in my Brazilian haircut, and I showed him an image of how I wanted my hair, and he did a perfect job! Thank you a lot and I recommend this place!

Just had a haircut and beard trim with Abi at Solidaire Barbershop, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.

What I thought would be a simple haircut turned into a complete grooming experience. Abi was incredibly skilled, professional, and clearly knowledgeable about hair and beard techniques. He took the time to understand exactly what I wanted and executed it perfectly.

A lot of downtown barbershops seem to rely on trendy interiors and fancy equipment to impress customers, but Solidaire is different. Not only does the shop look great, but the talent genuinely backs it up.

What stood out most was the atmosphere. As a family run business, you can feel the care they put into every customer. You’re treated with warmth, respect, and genuine hospitality from the moment you walk in.

If you’re looking for a barber who combines skill, professionalism, and great customer service, I highly recommend Abi. I’ll definitely be coming back.

reviews: The coffee is delicious and the owner made us feel extra special by remembering our order from the day before! Bonus point for the vegan cookie and for speaking French!

Didn't order any food, but our drinks (see photos) were really well made and delicious. Liked the overall vibe of the place, can be a bit tight if it's busy. Otherwise, seems like a wonderful find for barista made coffee, teas and in-house baked goods.

We absolutely loved the coffee and the snacks! A special thank you to Samir and Tracy for their warm hospitality — you made us feel very welcome. We had such a lovely time and would definitely come back.

Greetings from Germany,
Laura & Daniel

There were three different coffee blends, and we tried two of them. Both were tasty and unique. On top of that, the welcoming and lovely vibe of the people in the café made the visit even more enjoyable.

Delicious drinks, quick service, comfortable and calm ambiance. The london fog had strong tea flavour and was nice and foggy - one of the better ones in the city! Latte was also tasty and aromatic. Worth a try if you’re in the area!

Really enjoyed my experience at Fahrenheit Coffee. The coffee tasted fresh and smooth, and you can tell they actually care about quality here. The atmosphere was cozy, not too loud, and perfect for either relaxing or getting some work done. Staff was also super friendly and welcoming. Definitely one of the better coffee spots I’ve been to in Toronto.

Took my golden retriever Biscuit here a couple of weeks ago and was so relieved to find they actually welcome dogs on the patio — the staff even brought out a little water bowl without me asking. The cortado was genuinely excellent, one of the better ones I've had in the city. It's a relaxed, unpretentious spot with enough space that you don't feel like you're cramping anyone else's morning. Definitely adding Fahrenheit to our regular weekend route.
Soooo yummy, best coffee ever. I got The lemon currant scone and the chocolate babka, so pleasant. The staff is really nice too !

name: Ô Petit Paris Mont-Royal
address: 1592 Avenue du Mont-Royal E, Montréal, QC H2J 1Z2, Canada
reviews: We loved this bakery! We were in the area and I’ve had it saved to try, so glad I was finally able to. The croissants and flan we had were absolutely delicious. It was difficult to choose which dessert to get as they all looked incredible. The almond croissant was fresh, flavourful, light and perfectly flaky. We also took some baguettes to go and wow, they are excellent as well. The service was nice and quick. We will definitely return.

This is a wonderful bakery with an extensive offering of fresh breads, pastries, prepared sandwiches, and drinks. I especially love their canelé, it’s the perfect coffee companion. Whether you’re looking for daily staples or a special treat, this bakery will have you covered.

We had a wonderful experience at Ô Petit Paris Mont-Royal. The croissant, Souvenir de Suisse, and latte were all absolutely perfect. The service was warm and attentive, and the atmosphere was calm and relaxing—the perfect place to enjoy a coffee and pastry for breakfast. We’ll definitely be back!

Great presentation. I liked that it wasn’t too sweet and the base wasn’t too thick, so it didn’t feel heavy — the texture of the custard around it was really well done. It felt homemade and fresh. 93/100 compared to other flans I’ve had.

Oh I wish this place existed in Toronto. A croissant from a reputable bakery back home will run you $4.95+, here it's only $2.95 for a plain butter croissant and only $3.95 for a Kouign Amann. Everything was delicious and the staff are super friendly. There was a lineup out the door on a Monday mid morning and I definitely saw a healthy number of baguettes go out the door. They have a selection of pastries, desserts and bread. Def adding to my list of must visits for my future visits!

Such a lovely bakery on Mont-Royal Avenue! The variety of pastries is impressive and makes choosing a challenge :)
The service is very friendly. I tried the famous croissant, pecan cookie, and Cherie roll — everything was absolutely delicious, with a perfectly balanced level of sweetness. I’ll definitely be back to try more (and the bread!)

After arriving in Montreal, a local recommended Au Petit Paris for authentic Parisian pastries. Located on Mont-Royal Avenue, a vibrant pedestrian street full of cafes and restaurants, the bakery immediately impresses with its elegant interior and beautifully displayed, refined pastries.

The staff behind the counter were friendly, welcoming, and attentive, answering questions about the ingredients. They offer a wide variety of items, including cannelli, kouign-amann, fruit tarts, and cruffins. I tried a passion fruit cruffin ($4.00 CAD), kouign-amann ($4.30 CAD), and a Chocolate Noisette (~$4.00 CAD).

The Chocolate Noisette was excellent—crispy outside and soft, flavorful inside. The passion fruit cruffin was also very good, with a subtle fruit flavor and a tender texture. The kouign-amann, however, wasn’t my favorite; it was too crispy and crunchy throughout, but lacked softness inside, and I prefer the ones at Kouign-Amann Bakery right down the avenue.

There are a few small tables inside, and on the day I visited, it wasn’t crowded. There’s also a restroom for customers. Overall, the staff are friendly, the pastries are elegant and refined, and I enjoyed my visit. I would definitely return and recommend this bakery.
This boulangerie/patisserie is the best on Mont-Royal street. Try their pain suisse, chausson aux pommes or any patisserie. The breads are amazing too. Popular with tourists in Montreal.

name: La Rose Blanche
address: 2325 Rue Guy, Montreal, Quebec H3H 2L9, Canada
reviews: I was nervous about my last appointment because I was a client of Derya and she is taking some time off, so I was a bit nervous about switching to another hairstylist. But Lutfiye did a great job! She is one of Derya’s sisters and the whole family is taking great care to offer the same quality of service. Also Lutfiye has been well trained!  She did the touch up of my blonde roots and hair cut exactly as well as Derya. Also, Derya is still helping them get to know her clients so the transition to the other hair dressers is smooth. Thank you Lutfiye and Derya!

Over a month ago, I walked into this salon without an appointment after attempting to dye my hair myself… and, honestly, I had completely messed it up. 😅

They fixed it and gave me the most beautiful balayage! I truly appreciate it so much. I went from having a mix of different colors to having one beautiful, cohesive color.

I’m honestly so happy with the result and so grateful for the amazing work they did. 🤍

I can’t stop smiling. This is literally the best cut I ever got I’m OBSESSED!!!🙉😍 Derya is so knowledgeable, skilled, and talented. She took the time to even explain to me every step of the haircut and did EXACTLY what I wanted and MORE. She is the sweetest person and I am truly grateful to have found this place with such amazing & talented people🫶🏼❤️ thank you Derya and team for everything! Will definitely come back🤞🏼
Got a haircut & blowdry very satisfied with the results. I had Derya cut my hair and another staff member do the blowdry. I had a great experience & will definitely come back.

I’m truly happy that, for the second time, I had such a wonderful experience at your salon.
My highlights and haircut turned out exactly as I expected—if not even better! The highlights are delicate and perfectly even throughout my hair, with absolutely no brassiness.

I sincerely wish your amazing team continued success. Thank you so much!

I went to this salon about 3 months ago and honestly it was a disappointing experience. I had an appointment but still had to wait around 30 minutes.

I told the stylist (Emre)  that I have curly and thin hair and also hair fall, but he was very rough while handling my hair. I could see a lot of hair coming out while brushing.

I showed a reference picture for the haircut I wanted, but during the haircut he kept asking me if it was okay instead of clearly following it. It felt uncertain and not very professional.

At the end, they didn’t even dry my hair properly. I was told to leave because the diffuser wasn’t strong enough.

Overall, I don’t think this place is good for curly hair, maybe better for straight hair.

Farah is absolutely amazing! She is professional, kind, and truly talented. She listened carefully to what I wanted and delivered even better results than I expected. I felt comfortable throughout the entire appointment, and my hair turned out beautiful. I highly recommend Farah to anyone looking for a skilled hairstylist. Thank you, Farah!

I had such a wonderful experience at this salon! I got a balayage and a haircut by Polat, and I absolutely love the results. He is incredibly skilled, professional, and took the time to understand exactly what I wanted. The balayage looks so natural and beautifully blended, and the haircut is perfect. Everyone at the salon was friendly and welcoming, and I felt comfortable from start to finish. I highly recommend Polat to anyone looking for beautiful, high-quality hair. I’ll definitely be coming back!

address: 66 Commuter Dr #2, Brampton, ON L7A 0P8, Canada
reviews: First time visiting Bubble tea and chill .. we had the best Bubble tea, and cane juice. The empanadas was delicious, the kids also had the ramen noodles very delicious. I had the halo halo 😋 it was delicious.  We would definitely come again .. I would definitely recommend Bubble tea and chill .. if you have cravings for any of these this is the place to visit.. The owner is very friendly, great hospitality.   Definitely recommended !!

Went with my friend this evening and honestly didn’t expect much. We dropped by just to grab a bubble tea, but were pleasantly surprised to find authentic Nepali momos on the menu as well

The Halo Halo and Macchiato drinks were easily the highlights…both were absolutely delicious. The momos were authentic and flavorful, and the noodles were equally yummy. On top of that, the owner was incredibly friendly and even gave us extra sauce for the momos, which was such a thoughtful gesture.

Great drinks, delicious food, and warm service. We’ll definitely be coming back

I went here expecting your typical bubble tea place but was blown away by the amazing food and kind service! The owners were so sweet and kind, their smiles bring a smile to your face as well!

We got a Iced Taro Latte with cheese foam and Iced Caramel Cheesecake Macchiato. The Taro was so creamy and the best I have ever had (insane given my love for Taro), the other drink had the perfect balance of coffee and sweetness to balance all the flavors. We picked up a peach and mango tea with fresh mango! Along with an oreo milk tea, the drinks were just too good!

We also got the chicken and vegetable momos which came with the best spicy sauce that had us drooling!!!

Ended off our trip with a delicious red velvet cake and left with smiles and full bellies!! Truly love this place and am never disappointed!

Absolutely outstanding experience from start to finish. The service was warm and attentive, and the staff made the visit even more enjoyable. I tried the veggie Nepali momos and they  were perfectly made—fresh, flavorful, and incredibly satisfying.Easily one of the best spots I’ve visited for this kind of food. Highly recommended.

Mr. Arthur is truly amazing! His positive energy boosts your day and the drinks are just as amazing as Mr. Arthur is! Tried their mango slushi with fresh mango bits and the drink was just perfect and everything that I needed after being out for hours in this hot summer!
Kudos to Mr. Arthur!!
I love coming here. Staff are always happy to serve you. Their drinks are definitely delicious. Also their ramen.

Hands down the best boba tea! I had the caramel cheesecake latte with boba and cheesefoam, and it was amazing. The owner and his wife were so welcoming and provided great customer service. Will definitely visit again all the way from NY to Canada!

Tried this bubble tea & momo spot today and honestly one of the BEST momos I’ve had in the GTAA 🤤🔥
The taste felt exactly like India — authentic spices, fresh filling, and that real street-style flavor you usually can’t find here. The momos were juicy, perfectly cooked, and the exact same red spicy chutney with momo was next level 😮‍💨

Bubble tea was also super refreshing and made perfectly. Great vibe, friendly staff, and worth every dollar. If you’re craving authentic Indian taste in the GTAA, this place is a must try 🇮🇳❤️

name: Imperium Barbershop
address: 423 Queen St W #105, Toronto, ON M5V 2A5, Canada
reviews:
I recently had my first cut by Moe at Imperium Barbershop. The shop itself is nice, clean, comfortable. More importantly, my experience with Moe and the service I received was a step above what many other Toronto barbers can offer or have the ability to provide.

Beyond taking the time to understand the desired cut and style I hoped to walk out with, he also analyzed the work of the last barber who had done my fade and determined how that previous cut could have been approached differently to work better with my hair type, pattern and end goal.

The cut itself was, as expected, good. As many others have already written and reviewed. Additionally, He took the opportunity to offer recommendations and also to educate me a little bit more about ideal styling product. And I greatly appreciated the care and attention to detail he used throughout the appointment.

Skilled, knowledgeable and reasonably priced. I’ll be back and would definitely recommend.

My son has been to Moe twice now, and we couldn’t be happier. Moe is not only incredibly talented, but also so gentle, patient, and kind with my 6-year-old. He makes the whole experience comfortable and stress-free, which means a lot as a parent. The staff are welcoming and professional, and the location is perfect . there’s Green P parking just a one minute walk away, which makes visits super convenient. I highly recommend Moe and his team!

Booked with Moe after ChatGPT recommended Imperium, and I’m glad I did. I wanted a mid taper fade with a textured top and beard blend, and he absolutely nailed it. The fade is clean, the beard is blended perfectly, and the cut suits me much better than what I had before.

Moe was professional, detail-oriented, and took the time to make sure everything looked right. Great atmosphere and great service. Highly recommend booking with him if you’re looking for a quality fade in Toronto.

Even as a walk-in, Moe made me feel like a regular from the second I stepped through the door. He’s very friendly, attentive, efficient, and gave me one of the best haircuts I’ve had in a long time. It’s rare to find a barber who can pair such high-level technical skill with such an effortless, engaging atmosphere. See you next time, Moe!

Booked an appointment with Moe — haircut 10/10
Great conversations about all kinds of things and even got a free history class about the Nubian pyramids. 😄
And if you ever get tired of Toronto, feel free to open a shop in Germany! 😬
Really enjoyed meeting you — hope to see you again!

name: Grainery Bakery & Deli
address: 1 Stafford Dr, Brampton, ON L6W 1L3, Canada
reviews:
I’m honestly a bit embarrassed it took me this long to try this place… I feel like everyone in Brampton knew about Grainery except me! This bakery is an absolute gem. The breads, bagels, sweet loaves, and pies are insanely fresh and flavourful.

I grabbed one of their deli sandwiches too, and wow, also amazing.

The staff are super friendly and helpful, which just makes everything taste even better.

I clearly have a lot more to explore here… one happy bite at a time!

Dear Management,

I am writing to express my disappointment with the service I recently received at your bakery.

Please keep in mind that I am a long-time, regular customer and have been coming here for many years, dating back to when the business was still called Buns Master. I have spent thousands of dollars here over the years and have always considered myself a loyal customer.

During my most recent visit, I was extremely disappointed by the interaction I had with the employee preparing my two 12-inch subs. Her manner was extremely rude, unfriendly, and unwelcoming throughout the entire interaction. She did not smile, repeatedly sighed, and appeared visibly frustrated and angry.

When she put three tomatoes on the first sub, I pointed out that it normally comes with four. She told me that, due to the cost of tomatoes, they were now only providing three on 12 inch subs. I explained that I did not believe that was right, at which point she said she would give me one additional tomato without charging me.

On the second sandwich, I specifically asked for extra tomatoes on my sub and told her that I was happy to pay for them. Rather than putting the additional tomatoes on the sandwich as requested, she placed three small tomatoes in a separate bag and charged me 45 cents for them. This was not what I had asked for.

Unfortunately, this was not an isolated impression. I have noticed on previous visits that this employee has consistently been unfriendly, not only toward customers but also toward her coworkers. However, on this occasion, her attitude directly affected my experience as a customer.

I was also told when raising my concerns that the bakery has received multiple complaints regarding this employee. If that is the case, I strongly encourage management to address the situation. Whether that means providing additional customer-service training or reconsidering whether she is the right fit for a customer-facing position, something needs to be done. One employee's attitude can have a significant impact on both customers and the overall atmosphere for the rest of the staff.

As a loyal customer who has supported this business for many years, I feel I deserve to be treated with courtesy and respect. Unfortunately, this experience has left me so disappointed that I will not be returning.

I hope management takes this feedback seriously and uses it as an opportunity to improve the customer experience moving forward.

The Gainery Bakery in Brampton is the real deal.  A genuine, family‑run bakery where the owners actually care - and you feel it the second you walk in.  The staff is friendly in that effortless, sincere way that only happens when people love where they work and what they’re serving.

And the product… my goodness.  Everything is made with such care and attention to detail that it almost stops you in your tracks.  Their garlic cheese croutons are, without exaggeration, the best you will ever have in this world.  Full stop. Once you try them, you’ll understand. And the bread? There isn’t a single loaf in that place you won’t fall in love with. Truly.  And if you have never tried their sandwich bar you are missing out - this is the yummiest place you will find for a fresh, fast, healthy lunch!

Family‑run bakeries like this are hard to find anymore, but The Gainery shines. It’s warm, it’s honest, and it’s exceptional in every way.  Every product they sell has so much thought behind it so make sure to also check out their incredible selection of fresh cheese, jam and popcorn while you are there! 😉🫶🏻. Well done Grainery…a true Brampton gem!

I've been coming here for years and honestly the bakery is amazing, food is amazing and the overall atmosphere is fantastic.

The only issue I have with this place is which is why I gave it four stars on service is the cashier with the burgundy or dark red hair she's very selective in terms of her customer service and every encounter I've had with her she has been extremely rude no hello, no thank you or overall customer service but I have observed that she is quite approachable to select clients and I'll leave it at that.

Everybody else on the team is amazing

Love their fresh bread and baked goods. The soup and sandwich bar is also my favourite part of visiting this store too. I used to live in Brampton, moved to Bowmanville and still come here especially to buy and stock up on loaves of bread.

My wife and I have been frequenting this wonderful bakery for about a decade now.

The bakery goods are always fresh and delicious. I do miss the mini pizzas that they used to serve in the mini hot oven. But, nonetheless it takes nothing away from the overall experience.

However, I am not quite sure why I never tried their fresh made soup and sandwiches before. I will have to make a mental note of it to try them.

I guess that I am usually overjoyed 😁 from seeing all the fresh baked bread and desserts... it is mesmerizing.

The service is always helpful with a friendly smile.

I really recommend this place for bread and deli, It’s really good and very fresh. My go to place for breakfast needs. The staff working here are very sweet and helpful. If you’re new, they explain the products really well. The prices are reasonable and product quality is maintained. Do not miss this if you’re around Brampton.

It’s an awesome bakery. I was surprised to find local store in brampton and thrilled to visit the store. Breads are fresh and reasonable prices. Would encourage people to give a try and decide themselves.

name: Al's Barber Shop
address: 247 Queen St W, Brampton, ON L6Y 1M7, Canada
reviews:
We had a wonderful experience at Al's Barbershop for our son's first haircut! The barber was incredibly patient and worked quickly, which made the whole experience smooth and stress-free. They were great with our little one and made us feel comfortable throughout the appointment.
We especially loved the first haircut certificate and the keepsake lock of his hair—it was such a thoughtful touch and made this milestone even more special. We're so happy with the haircut and the memories from the day. Highly recommend Al's Barbershop for any child's first haircut! 😊✂️👶🏻

Amazing experience at Al’s Barbershop, as always. Every barber there is phenomenal — whether you’re looking for a classic cut, fade, kids haircut, or anything in between, you’re in great hands. This is a true traditional barbershop experience, and honestly, I’d say it’s one of the best barbershops in Brampton.
I was a walk-in and the shop was pretty busy, but they still had me in and out quickly. You could see all 6 barbers working hard and keeping things moving while still giving every customer proper attention and care.
What really stands out is the level of care they show to every client, especially kids and adults with special needs. You can tell the team genuinely cares about making everyone feel comfortable and welcomed. They really do it all, and they do it with a special level of professionalism and excellence.
All the barbers are great, and Rob has been cutting my hair — always a top-tier experience.

Warm, Detailed, Professional.
I recently visited Al's barbershop and was genuinely impressed by the entire experience. The atmosphere is clean, modern, and welcoming the moment you walk in. The barbers take their time to understand exactly what you want, offering suggestions without being pushy. My cut was precise, well‑blended, and honestly one of the best I’ve had in a long time. What stood out most was the attention to detail—from the fade to the lineup, everything was sharp. If you’re looking for a place that combines skill, professionalism, and great customer service, this shop delivers. Highly recommended.

My husband discovered this barbershop one day and loved it. Said the guys were super chill and welcoming. We've been getting our son's haircut here for the last two years and have had nothing but great experiences. They never made me feel awkward when my then 2 year old was squirming and reassured me that no screens were needed to keep him still because he's just being a normal kid. My kid is always leaving there with a smile and a lollipop. They also do amazing charity work for dog rescues each year. All around a great space with a great bunch of guys.

I first started bringing my son to get his hair cut at Al’s about 3 years ago based on the rave reviews!! We have been going to Rob ever since, he takes such pride in his work! And he’s such a fun guy to be around, my son loves going in thanks to his amazing customer service and attention to detail-Thank you Rob!!! You’re the best!!! 🤩

name: Urban Outfitters
address: 100 City Centre Dr Cru #1-116, Mississauga, ON L5B 2C9, Canada
status: Hip retailer for apparel & home decor
reviews:
Gigi, Reem, Mrudul and Dishani made my shopping experience exceptionally well. I am so grateful to them. I'm coming back for more shopping!
They do deserve recognition i.e. a promotion or a raise. Great management!

Urban Outfitters (UO) is a global lifestyle retailer targeting young adults with a curated mix of trendy and vintage clothing, accessories, beauty, and unique home goods, known for its eclectic style, music focus (vinyl/cassettes), and capturing youth culture through in-store experiences and online presence. It's part of the larger Urban Outfitters, Inc. (URBN) company, which also includes brands like Free People, Anthropologie, and the Nuuly rental service. Urban Outfitters is located in Square One Mall, 100 City Centre Dr Cru #1-116, Mississauga, Ontario, Canada.

I had a great experience thanks to Mason! I asked for help getting a shirt off a mannequin, which turned out to be a bit more difficult than expected. Despite that, Mason was incredibly patient and maintained such a positive attitude the whole time. They went above and beyond to help me, with a friendly and willing approach that really stood out. Excellent customer service!✨
Decent spot to get gifts, a little more on the expensive side, often items that are reduced priced are not the desireable ones

Urban Outfitters at Square One is a solid spot if you are into trendy and unique styles. The store layout is visually interesting and easy to browse, and there is always a mix of clothing, accessories and home items that stand out compared to other mall stores. You can usually find pieces that feel different and current, which makes it fun to walk through even if you are not planning to buy anything.

The quality is generally good, though some items feel a bit pricey for what they are. That said, when you find the right piece, it feels worth it. Staff were friendly when approached and let you browse without pressure, which I appreciated. The store can get busy, but it never felt overwhelming.

Overall, Urban Outfitters at Square One delivers a good shopping experience with stylish options and a relaxed atmosphere. A reliable stop if you like fashion that leans creative and modern.
Denzel has a good fashion and a sense of style. Great customer service and knowledgeable. He is honest and gives good advice for my style. Thank you! Store is very welcoming. 10/10 experience.
Shop with fashionable clothes for each season, for all the members of the family, diverse tastes, sizes, sale of shoes and accessories to dress and with constant offers. I recommend it.
Gigi at Square One was incredibly kind and helpful.

name: La Spaghett Pasta House
address: 970 Upper James St, Hamilton, ON L9C 3A5, Canada
reviews:
We had a wonderful experience at La Spaghett Pasta House last night. The atmosphere was absolutely perfect—warm, inviting, and comfortable—and the service was truly impeccable from start to finish.
The main dishes were absolutely delicious. Portions were spot on: generous without being overdone, offering real quality and value. We actually ended up taking leftovers home, which is always a great sign.
What really stood out to me was the personal touch. So many restaurants nowadays forget how much the small details matter, but here it clearly shows how much they care about customer service. In my opinion, this restaurant sets a great example of how it should be done.
I will definitely be back and will absolutely be recommending this location to others.

Great little place! Atmosphere is great as is the service.  Make sure to make a reservation as there are not many tables.  The food is hand made to order with pride and quality ingredients.  The service was impeccable! This is a must if you like pasta

Perfect spot for a date, very welcoming and relaxing ambiance, space is very limited maybe 10 tables, make sure to call in advance for reservation. Staff are very friendly, service was timely, and pricing is abit above average but totally worth it.

Most of choices are customizable and accommodating for dietary restrictions/perferances. Portions are extremely generous, high quality ingredients,  with great execution and presentation.
If you crave an authentic italian culinary experience with succlent taste and explosion of flavor, and  want to spoil your taste buds, look no more, but beware it is addictive.  We tried Bruschetta for starters , for entrees we got cream based (Cream Vongole) Linguine  and extra virgin olive oil based (Pollo Genovese) Penne.

Every bite was mesmerizing

It was our first time and definitely not our last  highly recommended ,great experience overall and you would be supporting local businesses.

This restaurant is the best place I’ve been in ages. The atmosphere was warm, so cozy- beautiful fresh tulips, the lighting was perfect. We made reservations- party of 3. Long overdue to catch up and enjoy some great food. Rabecca, the owner, and Kara, our server were just outstanding. So welcoming and inviting. It felt like home. We had some good laughs, and some wine. But the entrees were to die for. The Pollo Tuscany was chef’s kiss! All 3 of us were so happy with our choices. I’m so happy that I have some saved for lunch tomorrow.  As we stayed and talked for a bit, we decided against dessert…so full. But a few minutes later Kara walked out with some tasty desserts, 3 forks and a candle because it was my birthday!!!! How kind of them! La Spaghett is truly a gem in this city. Sooooo delicious. Thank you so much to the Chefs, Rabecca and Kara. ❤️❤️

Small charming plqc3 with excellent service.   A wide selection of pasta and other items on a well laid out menu.  The food came in enormous portions so plan on either leaving stuffed or having leftover.   I completely enjoyed my dining experience and would recommend.

Second time coming here and they didn't disappoint. Their portion sizes are generous, but that doesn't matter if you don't deliver on flavour, and they very much do just that! Everything was very delicious and I am very partial to the smaller size of the restaurant. Service fantastic, food amazing, truly a hidden gem.

Came here this past weekend with my wife and a couple of friends for our first visit, and we were blown away by the flavor and quality. We eat at a lot of Italian restaurants, but this one stands out. It feels like everything is homemade and prepared with genuine love.
All four of us ordered the chicken parmigiana, each with a different pasta pairing. My wife chose gnocchi with red sauce, while I went for penne with the lemon vodka sauce. That lemon vodka sauce was unbelievably rich and creamy. I’m still talking about it! I almost ordered some to go, but honestly, I doubt it would have made it home without me picking at it on the way home.
This place is truly a hidden gem, a cozy hole-in-the-wall worth discovering. The waitstaff was warm, friendly, and attentive, and there’s plenty of parking right outside. We can’t wait to come back and explore more of the menu. A definite 10/10 !

The best dining experience I have had in the city. The was service was amazing, kind, welcoming, and attentive without being in any way overbearing. The salad was immaculate and generously portioned, bread served warm and with seasoned butter, and the pasta was abundant and delectable. I was almost sad I couldn't finish everything on my plate until I realized I would get to enjoy it again as leftovers. To end the meal we also got a chocolate raspberry mouse cake that was again very generous in portion, and the last bites were taken home to enjoy the next day. I can't wait until I have another excuse to visit again. Thank you so much for the fine food and service!

name: Taurus Barbershop
address: 4120 Dixie Rd #7, Mississauga, ON L4W 4V8, Canada
reviews:
Not my first time here, and a good review is over due.
I asked for a fade, Joe knew and got it ABSOLUTELY MADE!
Tell these barbers what kind of style you're going for and just let the artists do the rest. You won't be disappointed.
Well done Joe. 10/10 would recommend this fine establishment.
🤌

If you’re looking for a barber shop that genuinely cares about its clients, Taurus Barbershop on Dixie Road in Mississauga is on another level.

From the moment you walk in, you can tell this place is built around the customer experience. The atmosphere is welcoming, professional, and incredibly well-organized. The team clearly takes pride in what they do, and it shows in every detail — from how they greet you, to how carefully they listen to what you want before the haircut even starts.

The barbers here are true craftsmen. They don’t rush you through the chair. They take their time, pay attention to the smallest details, and make sure the final result is exactly right. Whether it’s a classic cut, a fade, or something more modern, the precision is outstanding.

What impressed me most is how great they are with both men and boys. Getting a child’s haircut can sometimes be stressful, but the team here knows exactly how to make kids comfortable and confident. My boys walked out looking sharp and feeling proud of their haircuts — which says everything.

The place itself is spotless, the energy is positive, and the service feels genuinely personal. It’s rare to find a business that combines skill, professionalism, and real customer care this well.

Simply put: if you want one of the best haircuts in Mississauga, this is the place. Once you try it, you won’t want to go anywhere else.

I Highly recommend Taurus  Barber and Ben.  🙌 Ben cuts my toddler’s hair.  He is honestly amazing with children.  He’s patient, calm, and knows exactly how to make little ones feel comfortable.
On top of that, the haircut is always clean, neat, and very stylish. You can tell he really cares about both the kids and the quality of his work.
If you’re looking for someone great with children, he’s the one!

Great experience at Taurus Barbershop. The shop has a great atmosphere and very professional staff. Huge shoutout to Ben and Sam — both are true pros and know exactly what they’re doing. Clean fades, attention to detail, and great customer service every time. Definitely recommend checking them out!

Excellent service every time. They consistently exceed my expectations, and this is the only place I trust for haircuts. The staff are professional, friendly, and always make sure I leave happy with the result. I’ve had the best haircuts I’ve ever gotten here, and I wouldn’t go anywhere else. Highly recommend.

name: Restaurant de l'ITHQ
address: 3535 R. Saint-Denis, Montréal, QC H2X 3P1, Canada
reviews: Very nice room, professional staff.  Complex dishes with many components and ingredients but for me some of the ingredients did not work well together.  The deserts in particular were semi sweet and awkward.  The wine pairing was very nice as the selections went well with each dishs.
A Michelin guide rated restaurant. The food was excellent, the service was amazing and the army was wonderful!! All in all we loved it! Highly recommended

The atmosphere may have been sparse because of the heavy rain but the restaurant was pretty empty.  The service was excellent, attentive and friendly with explanations from the young staff.  The food was good and you have to bear in mind  that for this type of dining the good price was good. We found the offering a bit « bread heavy ».  Sourdough with the first delicate taster and bread on the starter as well as croutons on the main but this might be a Canadian thing.  Very glad we went.

My daughter and I enjoyed a wonderful lunch here during our visit. I ordered the Table d’hôte lunch, while my daughter chose a few items à la carte. Everything was delicious, thoughtfully prepared, and beautifully presented.

A few dishes really stood out. I especially loved the butter sauce served with my daughter's trout, and the rhubarb custard dessert was fantastic. Rhubarb and flan are two of my favorite things, so it felt like that dessert was made just for me!

Our server was excellent. Although she spoke limited English, she was gracious, patient, and able to answer all of our questions. We felt very well taken care of throughout the meal.

One helpful tip for fellow English-speaking visitors: this restaurant is separate from the culinary school's student dining program. I misunderstood that before our visit and thought they were the same thing, so I wanted to mention it in case it helps someone else avoid the same confusion.

Overall, we had a lovely experience and would happily return.

I have bookmarked this restaurant for a very long time and finally came here for a birthday celebration today.

The restaurant has a cozy décor and a lovely ambiance, enhanced by charming window shutters.

We ordered the following from the lunch menu:

Starters
•	Guinea fowl rillettes, brioche bread, mint, cucumber, and peas — 18 —> just ok
•	Chawanmushi (Japanese savory custard), Nordic shrimp, tapenade, and sea cucumber — 17 👎🏼 —> shouldn’t use the word “custard” as it was just steamed egg. This dish is not my cup of tea though.

Main Courses
•	Pan-seared trout, seasonal vegetables — 29 👍🏼👍🏼
•	Pork belly with sweet cicely, white bean ragout, cranberries, pink pepper sauce — 26 👍🏼👍🏼

Dessert
- Blanc en soufflé, crémeux noisette, compotée de poire, chiffon citron 10 👍🏼
- Gâteau étagé au café, crème au mascarpone et chocolat 11👍🏼

Drink
A glass of white wine from Portugal, one latte and one cappuccino

We’re not sure whether the kitchen was understaffed during lunch today, but the service was noticeably slow. It took approximately 30 minutes for the bread and butter to be served, and about an hour before the appetizers arrived.

Overall, we enjoyed both the food (except the appetisers) and the drinks. The small birthday gesture (two chocolate truffles) was a thoughtful touch and appreciated.

My husband had diarrhea the entire night. We both became ill shortly after our meal. It hit me within 30 minutes of leaving and affected my husband about an hour later, continuing through the evening.

As we shared all dishes and this was our first meal of the day, with no food allergies, it strongly suggests that the issue may have been related to something consumed at the restaurant…

The restaurant has a very convivial atmosphere and attentive wait staff.  We chose the tasting menu which had some excellent dishes such as the filet mignon and the cabbage and celery root salad.  Both were very flavourful and used unique combinations.  I was less enamoured with the amuse-gueule which was a corn and pea combination that was rather flat in flavour.  However I have previously dined there in February when the dinner overall was delicious.  It offers an excellent atmosphere and offers good value as well as some very tempting dishes.  Great for dining with friends and family

Waitress, waiter, and Sommelier all went the extra mile for tourists. Shown me the parking, help me avoid a ticket. And dine in perfect peace. Introduce all food & wines with enthusiasm.

Two of the scallops were giant size. Thus those didn't cook to perfection (IMHO). Scallops should be able to "stand tall straight" while still rare inside. Sorbet (Raspberry) too sour for my taste.

It's an amazing experience for the price. I would definitely re visit anytime I come back to visit Montreal.

The atmosphere, service and food are outstanding. Visiting this restaurant is a complete experience, so if you are a food lover and you want to impress someone or celebrate something special this fine dining will do the trick, as it is an internationally well recognized spot in the city. A highly recommended place for all the curious and wise palates.

reviews: Great service and personnel. The extended hours makes it alot easier for those who have limited time during working hours so it's easy to go during the evening. Very reasonably priced too.
Had a very bad experience here. The barber didn’t listen properly and ruined my haircut. It looks uneven and nothing like what I requested. Would not recommend.
I had a very nice experience I needed a haircut last minute and i came and got one in no time

Abdou is the best, after searching for a professional stylist i found him with keen perfection and professionalism. This place is highly recommended. Especially the way he shades the side is just perfect.  This place is going to be my regular spot for haircuts as I tend to trim and sharp when it comes to looks. So, Mr. Abdou thank you so much, see you twice a month. You have just earned a loyal customer.
Best in town no doubt better than others

I’ve been switching barbers for a long time until someone recommended me Abdou. The price and quality is unbeatable and he is very responsive . Thank you Abdou for taking care of your customers.

Sincerely,

Abdou is very professional and made sure my little brother was confortable. He listened and applied all what my brother requested. Plus, the place is very neat and clean. The decor is very nice and gives you sense of luxury. Prices are reasonable. Keep up the great job Abdou!
best barbershop in montreal, would definitely recommend.

reviews:
Went in on a total impulse because Ive been dealing with hair loss and honestly I expected just a quick haircut but the massage alone was worth the trip. It was so relaxing I almost fell asleep haha!

Nawras was super helpful, gave great suggestions and somehow brought life back into my very dull, straight, flat long hair. Now my only problem is figuring out how to keep it looking the way she styled it 🥹😹

Zak also did an amazing job cutting my husband’s hair! Both of them are talented, friendly and clearly know what they’re doing.

And a quick shoutout to Luka, the owner 💗 he’s very kind and welcoming!

Thank you guys! We’ll definitely come back 😉

ASK FOR SAM!

If you visit this salon for any reason at all, you have to ask for Sam!

I walked in with a botched balayage and a rainbow of colours in my hair. Sam was honest with the expectations and the results were far past that!

I thought my hair was ruined but Sam brought it back to life and gave me a hairstyle I could walk out proud with.

I can’t thank her enough she is my hair hero and I’ll never go to anyone else again.

I love you Sam!  🫂

Great Job by stylist  Zka!  🌟

Cut & styled ( high fade)  my son's hair exactly the way he wanted...he has wavey/curly hair. We have been here many times because they do such a wonderful job~ always professional, clean, and great attention to detail!!

Thank You! We will be back!

This is the best salon in the whole world , I  love ERINY love her services , she has the best prices soooo reasonable and affordable, 40 dollar for a blow dry !!! SHE DOES THE BEST  EYEBROWS EVER plus she does hair and everything else  , she been my lifesaver for 3 years now for everything . She is just the best . Come visit ♥️♥️♥️🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏 she is the sweetest  , inside is so nice and bright too

I am extremely satisfied with my blowout! Nawras did an amazing job and paid great attention to every detail. My hair looked beautiful, smooth, and exactly how I wanted it. She was professional, friendly, and made the whole experience enjoyable. The best blowout I've had in a long time. I highly recommend her services and will definitely be coming back. Thank you!

Most importantly, they genuinely care about their customers and treat people with sincerity. Thank you so much to Vi and the other male staff member as well! :)

Had an amazing experience at Baroness! We ordered the daily special: mango green tea with coconut jelly + aloe (I added tapioca). Delicious drinks with a great atmosphere, will definitely come back :)

2026 March 3★
Brown sugar and milk 7.25
Not sure why people would get this. If you really wanted to drink sweetened milk, you could buy a bag for about the same price. Apparently a best seller item and this was a let down.
Peach and aloe. 5.99
This is ok. Given the price and what it is. Though I'm not too sure if this is real peach juice.
Given it's location, it's got a decent amount of sitting space which is actually very nice.

Baroness, where they treat you to Royal Tea. Their Thai tea is so flavourful. Honestly, out of All the Bubble Tea shops in the city, theirs has The Freshest Pearl, which really makes the drink, hot or cold! So get your Festive On this December & whole winter! Kick back after all that downtown shopping 🛍 & relax with a hot cup of one of their many delicious tea/milk concoctions in the most Creatively, Seasonally, Warmly Decorated Environment! It's reminiscent of the downtown Eaton's Holiday Window Displays this time of year. Stunning! Ricki & Vivien are the Best! Cheers! 🍵 ☕️ 🫖 🧋 🍵

I cannot recall having a Chocolate Milk Tea better than the one I had here (I kept my sugar low)

But that’s just half the story…

The staff were so friendly. Willing to answer any questions on the drinks, make suggestions, even accommodate (the chocolate is technically only available in medium, but they were willing to upsize it). And they even told us to take a table and they’ll serve us there. That type of stuff goes for something

I’ll come here again in a heartbeat if I’m in the area and having another bubble tea craving

address: 3418b Av. du Parc, Montreal, Quebec H2X 2H5, Canada
reviews: Im do glad we stopped at this Cafe it has a very cute snd cozy atmosphere. The drinks were perfect and made just right. I had to try the famous pancakes and I was not disappointed they were amazing and were so fluffy and light and had lots of flavor it was sweet but not overly sweet I would definitely come back again.

Our family of six had breakfast here. We ordered matcha latte, iced matcha, macchiato, cappuccino ,  steak and egg sandwich, chicken sandwich , egg and ham sandwich, and pancakes. Their pancakes tasted really organic and fresh; all sandwiches were freshly made and delicious, but the steak sandwich was particularly tasty. The space is tight though. But I love the city small cafe atmosphere.

I tried the pancakes yesterday and came back for a smoothie and sandwich today 🧡 Very very good service and everyone there is really nice. I’m a huge pancake fan and I’d say the pancakes were 10/10. Strawberry banana smoothie was also good and the halloumi & egg sandwich too. The side potatoes are nice. Coffee was a bit too bitter for me. Recommending this place!

stopped into Mintar and had the halloumi egg sandwich, absolutely delicious. The bread was perfectly chewy, and the halloumi had that ideal salty, satisfying texture. What really pulled it together was the savory sauce, which added tons of flavor without being overpowering. The fresh, crisp lettuce and tomato balanced everything out beautifully.
I’d highly recommend this place. I was here about a year ago and had their banana strawberry smoothie bowl, which was also amazing. Definitely a spot worth coming back to!

Visited Mintar Café with my friends and my heart is still smiling 💗✨ It’s honestly one of the cutest, coziest little places I’ve ever been to — everything just felt so warm and full of love.

What made it truly special was the chef personally making and serving our food. You could feel the care, passion, and love in every single detail, and it made the whole experience so personal and unforgettable.

And the cotton cheese pancakes… oh my goodness 😍 they were pure heaven. So soft, fluffy, and melt-in-your-mouth delicious — every bite felt like a hug.
