reviews: Such a great find. The interior is very neat and you just grab a tray and tongs and help yourself! Staff are very kind especially a certain young lady but I do not remeber her name. Food and pasteries were delicious, I reccomend getting both savoury and sweet options to have a good mix. The only downside is that there isn't a lot of places to sit. The boba is not too special, especially for the price. I would go somewhere else if you want a drink. I was very satisified with the pasteries but not with the drinks. Overall, come here but skip the drinks.

Little bakery offering a large range of treats.
They have trays and tongs at the entry.  You grab those and then select your items.  Bring your tray to the cash to pay.  Tray and tongs are cleaned before they are put back out for use.
Prices seem pretty reasonable.

CoCo Bakery (Chinatown)
This place is chock-full of Asian baked delights.  If you think there’s only one way to do a coconut bun, think again — they’ve got every kind imaginable here.  Fillings range from fruit to whipped cream, custard, and who knows what else — all fresh and tempting.  You grab a tray, pick your favourites, and bring them to the till where they package everything up neatly.  Prices are extremely fair for what you get.  A must-stop in Chinatown — awesome spot.
The quality of the bread is good. It's a very busy store with a long waiting line. The taste is guaranteed that much. The taro milk tea was a little disappointing.

On a cold Saturday night i was craving some coco cheesecake. As i walk outside i ended up slipping on some black ice and snapped my knee💔 the cheesecake went flying, onto the cold hard musty ground. While waiting for assistance for my injury i was also worried about my dessert being ruined. Mark my words, the pastries at this place are like Nokia phones, INDESTRUCTIBLE. How on earth could a human bone snap but a box of cheesecake that just preformed an Olympic gymnastics routine stay completely intact. Anyways the cheesecake was fire and i love this place lol.

We were walking around Montreal’s Chinatown when we spotted this awesome bakery, Patisserie Coco. It’s definitely a haven for cake and pastry lovers! This bakery sells so many different kinds of delicious pastries and desserts too. They have breads, buns, puffs, cookies, biscuits, Swiss rolls, fruit cakes, steam cakes, muffins, flaky puff balls, green tea mochis, sponge cakes and many others. As for desserts, there’s different varieties of cheesecakes, mousse, bubble tea, smoothies, milk tea and etc. We bought some bubble milk tea, coffee buns and cookies. They tasted absolutely fresh and delicious!

*Update: We were visiting Montreal and decided to stop by Pâtisserie Coco, our favourite bakery in Chinatown! We got the Egg Tarts, Coconut Twist, Cookies, Cake Roll, Nutella Twist, Brioche Buns, Preserved Egg Puff, Almond Strawberry Tarts, Tiramisu and numerous Bubble Teas (Brown Sugar, Taro Milk Tea, Matcha Brown Sugar, Peach Oolong Tea, Mango Green Tea etc). Everything tasted absolutely delicious!

Patisserie Coco is a small, yet convenient bakery located in Chinatown Montreal. It’s a great place to buy some quick pastries and drinks when you’re out and about as a tourist like me!

The Lemon Iced Tea is very good for its large size and value. $4.93 including taxes is an excellent bargain when compared to most places (especially where I live)! Not to mention, the passion fruit donuts, which come in 3 pieces skewered, are delicious with passion fruit fillings.

Overall, amazing pastries and drinks at a very affordable price.

Stopped by Pâtisserie Coco for some takeaway pastries and everything we tried was delicious. You can tell they put care into what they make. The shop has a warm, inviting feel, and the staff were very helpful and welcoming, which made the visit even nicer. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in the area and craving something sweet.

name: ThirsTEA
address: 26 Dundas St E #3, Mississauga, ON L5A 1W2, Canada
reviews: Absolutely loved our experience at THIRSTea Dundas! 🧋 We ordered the taro with lychee and mango with coconut flavors, and they were all so yummy! 😍 The drinks were delicious and refreshing.

If you're in Mississauga, ThirsTea is definitely worth a visit! Everything we tried was so fresh and delicious, from the creamy matcha latte and refreshing fruit slushies to the warm waffle with ice cream and the rich, fudgy brownie cups.
Every bite (and sip!) was a treat. Highly recommend if you're looking to satisfy your sweet cravings!
Super delicious! Also very cute place, love the neon lights too. I almost got 10s on the dot, maybe next time!

ThirsTea is a hidden gem for the most delicious Bubble tea in Mississauga💌
Their menu is huge, with lots of variety and options- so there’s something for everyone.
Quite and cozy place to work/study and they also have lots of games, which is perfect for friends and family hangouts💗

This place is awesome. I went there tonight. Had a really bad day at work. Got there and my app on my phone wasn’t working to pay for it and these beautiful ladies gave me my drink for free. All I can say is thank you so much and I’m just making sure that I give you guys the rating that you deserve…. 10 but I can only give you 5 because thats the highest rating. Thank you.  Fyi I had the brown sugar coconut milk slush with brown sugar boba and mango popping boba!! It was killer good.

name: Pane Del Sole Bakery
address: 175 John St N, Hamilton, ON L8L 4P3, Canada
reviews: Pane Del Sol Italian bakery is located 175 John street North jn Hamilton. This is an absolutely amazing place to stop by for authentic Italian baked goods and sweet treats. They have everything from cannoli, Venetian squares, cookies, and croissants! In addition, they have a very nice deli which offers specialty meats and cheeses in addition to a wide variety of other imported, Italian and Mediterranean goods. They also have an indoor seating area for about 20 people. Great experience overall. Great value. Free parking is available. I highly recommend.

After a bad cake experience at another bakery we decided to give Pane del Sole a try and I cannot stop singing their praises. We’ve got cakes from there now for 3 birthdays- a strawberry shortcake, tiramisu and double chocolate and each one was absolutely delish.

Great place to grab a box of pastry or just stop in for a snack. Very friendly staff.  The Portuguese Tarts are amazing here.  The Lemon Squares are so tangy, like that.  No credit card surcharge. Find if you do not eat some things right away they get very hard fast.  Pretty Expensive.  Things really add up fast.

Pan del Sole should be everyone's go-to for fresh kaisers, sub buns, bread, or anything else from their bakery.  They are just that much better than nearby bakeries, as in better quality and better prices.  If you are looking for a particular Italian food product like pasta or sauce, check out the grocery aisles.  The Sicilian cannoli were as good as any I've had, and again, somewhat better than at least one other nearby competitor.  Staff are always friendly and cheerful, I just can't think of any negatives.  The only way to be disappointed would be to show up on a Monday!

Went and bought cheese bagels yesterday. Assumed they were fresh. Went to make one this morning and all of them are moldy. I've bought these before. Usually take 3 days to go bad so I'm assuming these were not fresh. Disappointed but I'll be back. Mistakes happen. Gelato is amazing, love the hot food selection.

I went in looking for an affordable lunch and left with nothing. Everything looked fresh but was way overpriced. I expected a sandwich for $5-6 but no luck. Over $10 for a sandwich when youre making your own buns and that. Too much.

I stopped in to pick out some dessert treats for a birthday dinner. I had a hard time picking because they had such a great selection. Everything I got was delicious and I’ll be back to try out everything else! All the staff were very friendly!

Pane del sole provides fresh food daily
With specials. Yesterday I had the
Meatloaf with mashed potatoes and
Veggies. I took half home.
Love the calabrese bread.
Cappuccino.
Needed bottle of water for the feast.
Home made cookies.
Torres and cakes 🎂 are the best
Love the raspberry bomb
Friendly staff.
Alaimo family takes great pride in
Their bakery.
Free parking.
Thanks. Ar

name: TeaHut Bubble Tea Café (Bubble Tea, Smoothies Juice & Snacks)
address: 100 Main St E Unit# 100, Hamilton, ON L8N 3W7, Canada
status: Bubble tea & Taiwanese dishes, open late
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, China Union Pay, MasterCard, VISA
reviews: Went here for the first time with my girtlriend two years ago. Love it and now come here all the time Have had their bubble tea, yakults, eel fried rice, Japanese style fries, takoyaki, shrimp wontons, hot dry noodles and many more. Highly recommend Tea Hut.
Great tea and desert offerings. Lots of bubble tea and hit tea and coffee flavours as well. Lots of both seating and washrooms are available.decor a bit in need of refreshing but clean overall

I first visited this place back in 2004, and it used to be one of my regular spots. Although I’ve been living out of town for many years, every visit back brings a deep sense of nostalgia and wonderful memories. It may not be the most modern or trendy bubble tea shop in town, but its nostalgic charm makes it truly special.

The food remains excellent—comforting and reminiscent of home-cooked meals. I especially enjoyed the popcorn chicken, Taiwanese sausage, and spiced chili chicken; all three are must-try dishes.

The bubble tea, however, tastes a bit on the syrupy side compared to the more tea-forward drinks now popular in the GTA area. Perhaps using less syrup could appeal to customers who are becoming more health-conscious and cutting down on sugar. Just a friendly suggestion.

Also, it would be great to see the return of the board games that used to be available—it added such a fun and cozy atmosphere.

Overall, I truly enjoyed my visit and would definitely come back again. Highly recommended for anyone seeking delicious food and a touch of nostalgia.

Great tasting bubble tea with great prices. The vibes are really nice as well as it has a few board games that you can play. Staff are very friendly and the service is great. The taro smoothie with boba is especially great.

We had such a great experience here! We tried the chicken noodle soup, squid balls, and the popcorn chicken rice. Everything was great, but the squid balls were the absolute star of the meal. Perfectly cooked, tasty, and something we’ll definitely be coming back for. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for comforting dishes with amazing flavor!

Love this place. I had a Taiwanese friend come with me and he vouched for the authenticity of the dishes though he said some were more Japanese. He was very satisfied. Ordering is done by scanning qr code at the table. Lots and lots of good bubble tea varieties.
Very nice staff and friendly, quick service. Ordered the Taiwanese Braised Pork bowl and it was very tasty. Would come again.
I ordered the shrimp fried rice. It tasted alright. Just a little bland but I enjoyed it. I would’ve like some veggies like corn or green onions. Overall J would come again for a late night treat.

name: Ciao Bella Hamilton
address: 26 Augusta St, Hamilton, ON L8N 0B7, Canada
reviews: Best service in 4 years in Canada! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐We were passing through the city for work and stopped by for dinner. It was the best choice! In all our 4 years in Canada, this is probably only the second time we’ve experienced such an incredible level of care.The waiter was very welcoming. When the pasta was served, he brought a spoon right away without even being asked. It was so nice to see such professionalism and attention to detail!All the dishes had a beautiful presentation and were delicious. The interior is well-thought-out, down to the smallest detail, and even the restroom is beautifully designed. We will definitely come back next time we are in this city. Highly recommended!

We had an amazing experience at Ciao Bella, and Nicole made our visit truly special. From the moment we walked in, she was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and personable. She has a wonderful energy that sets the perfect tone for the evening, and her attentive hospitality really stands out. The gorgeous interior creates such a beautiful, inviting atmosphere, and the food was absolutely delicious from start to finish. It is rare to find staff this genuine and warm. Thank you, Nicole, and the rest of the team—we will definitely be back!

We dined at Ciao Bella Hamilton yesterday and had such an amazing experience! Our server, Caitlin, was super friendly and gave us some great wine recommendations. The peach wine was definitely my favorite. Sweet, smooth, and absolutely delicious.

We started with the tuna tartare, which was incredible and so fresh, with no fishy taste at all. For the main course, we tried the gnocchi and the chicken parmigiana, and both dishes were amazing. And the tiramisu… honestly the best tiramisu we have ever had, absolutely to die for!

The entire staff was warm and welcoming, and I believe the manager even came over to check on us before we left, which made the experience feel even more special. Overall, excellent food, excellent service, and we’ll definitely be back!

Very tasty food and cocktails! Great service

Menu has nice variety of options. Would absolutely recommend: artichoke hearts, mussels, swordfish-- they did not disappoint!

For cocktails: red sangria is very flavourful (cinnamon autumn profile) and espresso martinis are made to perfection (great as dessert!).

Cute patio! Our server was kind, attentive, and prompt. Overall high-end quality service.

I had an amazing experience at Ciao Bella! From the moment we walked in, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. The food was absolutely delicious—fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Every dish we ordered exceeded expectations, especially the gnocchi and tiramisu. The portions were generous, and everything came out perfectly timed. You can really tell they take pride in both their service and quality. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great meal in Hamilton!

What an incredible restaurant and experience!!! We booked this restaurant for my graduation celebration dinner with a total of 5 guests. The service was outstanding and the food was even better!!! Hannah did such an incredible job and ensured we had everything we needed. We ordered quite a few appetizers, main courses and desserts. They created a new menu but were still able to offer us some dishes that were on the older menu since we had preordered them beforehand. We ordered a bottle of the house prosecco and the house red wine and both were incredible. Thank you so much for a lovely experience and I can’t wait to come back again soon!

We came to Ciao Bella to celebrate our engagement over dinner. Our server Jade was so friendly and welcoming!

We got the Bread and BETTER Focaccia, Cesare Insalata, Bella Meatballs, Chicken Paillard, Chicken Parmiagana, and a lemon cake for dessert. It was all delicious and we especially recommend the Focaccia and Chicken Paillard.

They made our celebration memorable and we hope to be back soon! ❤️

We really enjoyed our dinner last night. The food was delicious, especially the Caesar salad with anchovy. The service was excellent, and the gentleman who served us was very friendly and welcoming.

The only thing I didn’t really like was the pistachio drink, but overall everything was great. We had a wonderful experience and would definitely come back.

name: Presotea
address: 1811 Sainte-Catherine St. West, Montreal, Quebec H3H 1M2, Canada
reviews: My favorite drink in town, especially during the summer! The Real Mango Popsicle Mango Drink is absolutely delicious and tastes just like real mangoes. It’s refreshing, flavorful, and the perfect way to cool down on a hot day. I keep coming back for it every summer. Highly recommended!
Nice bubble tea shop. We got the taro slushes. Fresh bobas, great service. Wish you could adjust sweetness on the kiosks but I’m sure you could if you ask

Glass is filthy on door bathroom out of service for over 2 months going onto 3 which I think is a lie because places that do this just don’t want to to clean washrooms so they rather say it’s broken I think it should be illegal for any place serving clients to not have a (functional washroom) smoothies are good just ridiculous to expect me to believe employees have to leave to location to usé washroom what kind of working standard is that employee told me when they fix it customers break it so they stopped fixing it 🫤

We ordered a brown sugar pearl latte. Everything was tasty, but definitely not what I expected. The picture didn't show any ice, and in my understanding, a latte is coffee. However, it turned out there was no coffee in it, just tea with milk and bubbles 🥲. It's quite deceptive, considering that worldwide, a latte is coffee with milk.

By the way, when I asked why, either the manager or the owner came up and said that in their understanding, latte is milk. But if you use Google, elementary Wikipedia will show that latte is coffee. How can you not know this 🥲😖

And about the fact that there was a lot of ice in it, they should definitely inform customers. The name doesn't indicate that it comes with ice, and the picture doesn't show it either. I don't like ice and overly cold drinks. When I asked why it was like that, they didn't even offer to remake it without ice 😐. Especially since this information wasn't mentioned anywhere in advance. A drink should bring joy, not all of this.

On the plus side, there's a good variety of bubbles and reasonable sizes. It's just a pity that in the end, there's no coffee option with proper warm milk.

Very bad customer service. I walked into the store and stood at the cash for a couple of minutes while the employee kept looking at me without saying anything. After waiting for a long time, I finally asked if someone could take my order, and he told me I had to order using the self-checkout machine.

I went to the self machine, but the item I wanted was not available there. When I asked him about it, he told me they didn’t have it. Then suddenly he changed his mind and told me to wait for him. In the end, he took my order himself and I even paid cash at the register, which means what he told me at first was not true.

On top of that, his attitude was terrible and unprofessional. Honestly one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve had.
Great service! Great flavor, my order was excellent!! Congrats
I felt a super strong unpleasant smell In the store , Avocado slush was ok but i don’t think I’ll come back to this branch again. Not recommended.

This is one of the largest Presotea locations in downtown, featuring a spacious interior. The service is quick, and the drinks meet the usual standard. However, the customer service could be a bit more friendly.

name: Monaco Cuts
address: 216 King St E, Hamilton, ON L8N 1B5, Canada
reviews: I had a beard trim done in the weekend.  The place was clean and well maintained.  Everyone was professional and welcoming.  The gentleman who did my beard trim was phenomenal and I love the way it looks.   I will be back soon and highly recommend people get their hair needs dealt with by this great group of guys.

Hands down the best barber in town! Perfect fade, sharp beard trim, and incredible attention to detail. Great conversation, relaxed atmosphere, and excellent value for money. I left looking and feeling great. Highly recommend!

Had a great experience at Monaco Cuts Hair Salon. Booking an appointment was very easy and convenient. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience comfortable from start to finish.

The haircut and overall service were very professional, and the hygiene standards were excellent. The waiting area was clean, comfortable, and well maintained. I was really impressed with the attention to detail and the quality of the work done. Amazing service overall — definitely recommended!

I wanted to give this barbershop one more chance because I had been coming here for the past six months, and the owners had previously been nice to me and made it feel like a welcoming environment. I had a poor experience last time where my haircut was messed up, and to their credit, they gave me the haircut free. Because of that, I figured I would try again.

To be fair, the haircut itself this time was decent, and better than the last one. The young barber was polite enough, asked questions, and seemed like he had learned from the previous experience. That said, the overall experience in the shop was still disappointing and unprofessional.

I have a busy schedule and usually have to squeeze in a haircut whenever I can between other commitments, so I select “any availability” when booking online. The website lists three barbers, but both times I have selected that option, I have ended up getting cut by what appears to be a student or trainee rather than one of the listed barbers. On top of that, I was still charged full price, with no student discount or acknowledgment that I was being cut by someone less experienced.

When I walked in, it felt like nobody really knew what was going on. The barber took me somewhat awkwardly, while people were laughing and speaking in Arabic, so I had no idea what was being said. I was then brought to the corner of the shop, surrounded by several random teens who were vaping, talking loudly, and having inappropriate conversations. It felt less like a professional barbershop and more like I had walked into a group of kids hanging out.

The worst part was that, in the middle of my haircut, one of them started getting aggressive right in front of me over a vape. He was threatening people and saying he was going to mess them up if they didn’t give it back, all while I was sitting there in the chair. It was uncomfortable and very unprofessional. After he left, there was no apology and no effort to acknowledge it.

The haircut continued, and again, the barber himself was nice enough and did check to make sure I was happy with the cut. The haircut also wasn’t styled afterward, which I feel like is usually part of the experience at most barbershops or hairdressers, but I didn’t even care at that point because I just wanted to leave.

I still gave a 25% tip like I usually do, and I wasn’t even thanked. The barber just turned away and waited for me to walk out, which honestly summed up the whole experience.

I tried to give this place another chance after a poor previous visit, and I appreciated that they tried to make it right last time, but I think this will be the last time I come.

I always have a great experience at Monaco Cuts. The shop is clean, welcoming, and well-organized. The staff are professional, friendly, and really know their craft. They take their time to make sure every cut is perfect, and I always leave feeling fresh and confident. Consistently reliable service and attention to detail. Highly recommend!

I do not recommend this place at all. While the haircut itself was okay, they were extremely careless with the sides and especially with the razor. I ended up with several cuts on my face. If I had checked the mirror before paying, I would never have agreed to pay for such poor service.

When I called to complain, instead of taking responsibility, they tried to justify themselves by talking about the massage chair and shampoo. That is not what I paid for — I paid for a safe and professional haircut.

This place does not treat customers with care, and I strongly suggest avoiding it.

This barbershop is a total gem! From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and knew I was in good hands. The barbers are skilled, friendly, and really listen to what you want. I got one of the best haircuts I've ever had, and the atmosphere was super chill and comfortable. It's more than just a haircut; it's an experience. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for top-notch service and a great vibe.

​Monaco Cuts is hands down the best spot in the area. The staff is professional, the atmosphere is great, and the attention to detail is unmatched. I walked out feeling like a new person. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a sharp, high-quality cut!

name: ALORA Ottawa & ALORA Rooftop
address: 34 Clarence St., Ottawa, ON K1N 6Z5, Canada
reviews:
Had such a wonderful birthday celebration at Alora! The ambience was beautiful, the food was delicious, and the overall experience was amazing. A special shoutout to our server, Hannah, who was absolutely fantastic. She was so attentive, friendly, and made my birthday feel extra special.

I highly recommend Alora for a special occasion or even just a great night out. Great food, great ambience, and exceptional service! We will definitely be back!

If you are looking for some great tasting food and good atmosphere you should check out Alora! I had reservation for a Friday night dinner with some friends and we were not disappointed. Our waiter Jake was top notch with the service he provided. We also had the pleasure of meeting the owner Arash. I would definitely recommended Alora! Thanks for the amazing food and service!

I do recommend booking a reservation online for a larger party. Inside, there are stairs leading to the dinning section downstairs, the rooftop patio is only available for walk-ins. We really enjoyed our time, the music, the ambiance was all lovely.

In terms of food, the sharing appetizers were certainly appealing, we wanted to try most items on the menu.

The sliders are a decent proportions, they were juicy. The crunchy shrimp roll was also tasty. The seared salmon was not bad.

The service was good, food arrived in a timely manner.

Overall, I will return to try other items on the menu, we had a great time during our time here.

My best friend and I went to Alora restaurant in the ByWard Market in Ottawa on March 25, and I can't recommend it highly enough!

From start to finish, the experience was out of this world!! The hostess was incredibly friendly and welcoming, setting a great tone for the evening. Our server, Georgia, was absolutely amazing—attentive, knowledgeable, so friendly and just a joy. We got to meet one of the owners (after asking for a manager and reassuring Georgia that it was positive!) - she was a gem as well - we then understood why the place is the way it is with incredible staff and food. It truly is an experience!

As for the food, I don't think I can find the words to describe how delicious it was! Every dish was a delight, packed with flavour and texture - elegantly plated to please the eye before the tastebuds! Coupled with the fantastic atmosphere, it made for a truly memorable night. It is truly a must-visit! We are sure to go back!!!

From the moment we walked into Alora, we knew this wasn’t going to be just another dinner—it was going to be an experience.

My husband and I were celebrating our recent marriage and chose Alora for a special date night. From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. Every person we encountered—from the hostesses to the servers—treated us with such kindness, warmth, and genuine hospitality. It never felt forced; it felt as though they truly cared about making our evening special.

When they learned we were newly married, one of the owners (Arash) personally came over to introduce himself and took some time to chat with us. He further surprised us with complimentary champagne. It was such a thoughtful gesture that meant so much to us. We were also seated at one of the best tables in the restaurant before being invited to enjoy the breathtaking rooftop patio and its beautiful views. Every detail of the evening felt intentional and made us feel celebrated.

The food was absolutely exquisite. Every plate was beautifully presented and every bite was bursting with flavour. The cocktails were equally impressive—creative, stunning, and delicious. It was clear that so much passion and attention to detail goes into everything they serve.

What stood out most, though, was the people. Exceptional hospitality is becoming increasingly rare, and the team at Alora reminded us what it feels like to be truly cared for as guests.

Thank you for making our first date night as newlyweds one we’ll always remember. We left with full hearts, full stomachs, and already looking forward to our next visit.

Without hesitation, we would recommend Alora to anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience in Ottawa. It is a true gem, and we can’t wait to return!

Alora was the location for our first (blind) date. The atmosphere was perfect, elegant but understated, quiet, a perfect cross between formal and casual. The gorgeous servers were attentive to our needs and the manager even came out to check on us.

Our cocktails were perfect.

We ordered the sushi as an appetizer (amazing presentation and delicious), plus steak and lamb. The companion vegetables (roasted carrots and some sort of tasty broccolini) were divine. The meat was not exactly to spec (the lamb was a bit tough and the steak was more well-done than requested), but they immediately offered to change it for us.

If I were to offer you some advice for leveling up, since it does seem with the price point that you are shooting for gourmet sophistication, it would be this:
1. Put more precision into the timing of the meat (and keep the gorgeous presentation!)
2. Regularly check the bathrooms, especially the floors (not gross, but visibly neglected.)

I would recommend your restaurant for the service, the vibes and the food, in that order.

Nope.
Needed a nice dinner for a visiting guest from out of town, group of 8 people. Server did not tell us anything about the menu and when one person ordered the bruschetta, it would have been a good time to tell us that it is meant to be shared - a full loaf of bread arrived and was placed in front of him.  My tuna starter was delicious but then they made it seem like a huge favour to sub broccoli for potatoes with my steak.  The steak was inedible.  Not tender, not juicy, not tasty.  Server did not check on us.  I asked him for a box to take it home for my kids lunches and he told me the manager couldn’t do anything for me because I wanted to take it home.  I just didn’t want it to go to waste.  Server brought the bill without offering us dessert, then lied about having offered us dessert.  The broccoli was good.  Never again.  Embarrassing.  Pretentious without the follow-through.

Came across ALORA Ottawa & ALORA Rooftop completely by accident, and honestly, it turned out to be one of the best surprises of my trip. I originally had reservations at another restaurant across the street, but when I arrived, it was unexpectedly closed. ALORA was just a few steps away and immediately caught my attention because of the atmosphere and vibe from the outside, so I decided to give it a shot.

Even though I walked in pretty late around 9:45 PM, the staff still welcomed me in with no problem. I sat at the bar knowing the kitchen was probably winding down, so I ordered right away. I started with the crispy crab, which was excellent, and then ordered one of their top steak selections cooked perfectly and full of flavor.

The bartender stayed attentive the entire night and always made sure my drinks were on point. What made the experience even better was the gentleman sitting next to me at the bar. Super friendly, easygoing, and great to talk to. Later I found out he was actually the owner, which explained a lot about the hospitality and energy of the place.

This spot has the perfect balance of great food, upscale lounge atmosphere, and nightlife energy. It’s the type of place where you can have dinner, stay for drinks, and transition right into a fun night out without changing locations. Definitely a great option for date nights, dinners with friends, or even solo travelers looking for a solid experience.

If I’m back in Ottawa, I’ll definitely be returning.

reviews:

I actually went back the next day and got a chai slushie that was perfect for combatting the summer heat.
If you're in the Plateau and want to relax with some refreshing brew I highly recommend Cafe Nocturne.
I loved the atmosphere! I ordered a croissant and a cappuccino, and they were both delicious. I also loved open and relaxing space, so I added this cafe to my list of go-to places.
New fave coffee spot in Montreal ! Coffee is really good. They sometimes have drip. The almond pastries are insanely good and large ! Staff are friendly. Atmosphere is really nice.

One of the best espressos I’ve had, rich, and perfectly balanced

The place itself has a great boho-cozy atmosphere, the kind of café where you immediately want to slow down and enjoy your coffee

Definitely worth visiting

The croissants are perfect- flaky, crisp on top, soft. Buttery inside. Chai latte with cinnamon was one of the best I had in cafes. Nice place to sit, get some work done, people watch and sip on chai.

i absolutely adore this cafe. so cute, good coffee and amazing croissants. i think it was the largest croissant I’ve eaten that was actually good. it’s in the perfect area close to campus and entering on the plateau. come here for your morning pastry and coffee before walking around the plateau or to mount royal on the weekends. can also work from here on week days being that it’s close to campus.
Nice cafe and great coffee but I have a hard time with the garbage that is always beside and in front of the café. It’s pretty gross and I don’t understand why they put up with it.
Best espresso I found in my little area of Montreal while I was there for the week. The pistachio pastry was crazy good. Very friendly environment, too. Good place to open your book.

name: La Brioche Pastry & Bakery (Glebe)
address: 866 Bank St, Ottawa, ON K1S 3W2, Canada
reviews:
Every time I visit this pastries store, the staff is very nice and just so welcoming! Last time, they took their time describing items and repeating themselves for my blind friend. They were very patient overall, and genuine human beings. This time, the cashier noticed my enthusiasm for trying something new every time I come into the store, and suggested something. It didn’t disappoint!

The stores hold a great variety of French, Algerian, and Lebanese desserts at affordable prices. My favourite is the Pyramid Chocolate Pastry Cake. It looks like a cut piece of a chocolate and vanilla cake, with the point facing upward, and with hardened chocolate ganache dripping from the pointed end. The sides are not covered, which allows you to see the chocolate buttercream layers. It’s really, REALLY good! And such an original way to present a piece of cake!

Also, the store holds the best baklavas I’ve ever had! I love baklavas, but I’ve been wary of trying them wherever food stores sell them, because they are mostly dry and don’t taste as good as when I had real good ones. La Brioche didn’t deceive me. La Brioche won’t deceive you!

I’ve been coming here for the past few months, and it’s easily become my go-to spot for desserts. The pistachio baklava is, without a doubt, the best I’ve had anywhere in the city—I find myself coming back for it every couple of days!
I’ve also picked up desserts for friends, and they’ve absolutely loved them too. Everything is always fresh, delicious, and the service is fast.
The entire staff is so welcoming and kind, and they’ve even surprised me with complimentary sweets a few times, which is such a thoughtful gesture. A special shoutout to Maria, who always greets me with such warmth and makes every visit feel extra welcoming.
I can’t recommend this place enough. If you love great pastries and outstanding customer service, you have to stop by!💖

It was more than awful 😢. We ordered two pieces of cake and couldn’t finish them, with every bite the feeling was worse. The desserts were baked at least several days ago, stale, tasteless, margarine and sugar. It felt like you are chewing nothing but something very sugary. I asked before ordering if they use butter and cream. The answer was YES.
Unfortunately, it was a mistake to visit this place, rip off. Why is the rating 4+???
Always fresh baklava, best in town. Staff is very friendly and helpful.

Stopped in with my husband and son for a few baklava, eclair and macaroons. The new shop (on Hunt club) was nicely put together. The lady behind the counter was really  personable and super helpful. The desserts were really delicious and perfectly priced and they looked so amazing, beautifully created. Only negative would be that I think they could use more sitting area and perhaps some coffee choices. Highly recommend. We'll be back again soon. :)

name: The Styloria - Hair and Beauty Studio
address: 83 Clarence St, Brampton, ON L6W 1S5, Canada
reviews:
I recently visited Styloria for a haircut, and I had a great experience. My only request was to get a simple short haircut, but my hairdresser went a step further and suggested adding front bangs to give it a bit more style. I’m so glad I trusted her suggestion because the final result turned out even better than I expected!

She was very skilled, friendly, and clearly knew what would suit my face and hair. I’m really impressed with the outcome and how refreshed my hair looks now. I’ll definitely be visiting Styloria again. Highly recommend!

Extremely disappointed with the service.

This is the second time I’ve booked an appointment with Anita, only to arrive at the salon and find out she wasn’t available. The first time, my appointment was handled by Kay instead, and today the exact same thing happened again. After reaching the salon, I was told that Anita has been unavailable for the past two weeks.

What I don’t understand is why my appointment was accepted under Anita’s name if she wasn’t even available. The receptionist didn’t inform me when I checked in either—they simply asked me to sit with another stylist without any prior notice or apology.

If I’m paying the same price, I expect the service I specifically booked and a professional customer experience. If there are changes to an appointment, customers should be notified in advance so they can decide whether to reschedule or proceed with someone else.

Unfortunately, this happened on my birthday, and it completely spoiled what I was looking forward to. It’s not just about the haircut—it’s about respecting your customers’ time and preferences.

I hope the salon improves its appointment management and communication because this level of unprofessionalism is very disappointing.

I would rate this experience 1★, especially since it happened twice.

I found Styloria Salon through Instagram and was able to book a same-day appointment with Sukhi, which was already a great start. Sukhi is such a sweet soul—very polite, professional, and incredibly knowledgeable. She gave the best recommendations for my hair type and truly took her time, showing so much care while washing, cutting, and styling my hair.

The layers turned out absolutely perfect, exactly what I wanted. I never felt rushed, and the whole experience was relaxing and enjoyable. I will definitely be booking with Sukhi again for my next cut. Highly recommend booking with Sukhi if you’re looking for quality and great service!

I am very happy with the outcome of my balayage but there were some flaws when it comes to the service.

Although the person assigned to me is very talented, They were completely silent and would disappear without communication for at least 30 minutes at a time and I was left alone and confused.

I was there for nearly 8 hours!!!!! and no one seemed to bat an eye at my physical discomfort. It was very busy yet very short staffed.

Wow, I had the best hair cut ever. I was so impressed with their service. Saw real talent here. They know what they are doing. Superb. Aneetha and Suman were excellent, thank you sooo much both. Definitely coming back! Jayani

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an amazing experience with Sherry! From the moment I walked in, he made me feel welcomed and comfortable. He took the time to carefully assess my hair, explained everything step by step, and recommended the best option based on my hair’s condition instead of trying to sell unnecessary services.

Sherry was incredibly knowledgeable, honest, patient, and professional. He answered all of my questions, guided me through the entire process, and made sure I felt confident with my decision. I really appreciated that he recommended what was truly best for my hair and offered everything at a very reasonable price.

The entire experience was stress-free, and I could tell that Sherry genuinely cared about the health of my hair and making sure I was happy. I highly recommend Sherry to anyone looking for expert advice, outstanding customer service, and beautiful results. Thank you, Sherry, for such a wonderful experience—I’ll definitely be coming back!

Today I searched Google and found The Styloria salon. I called and spoke to Anita and asked for an appointment.Anita accommodated me immediately as she had an opening. Upon arrival, I asked her about the tools and brushes Sanitization and she assured me their due process. Anita even showed me how one of the staffs regularly clean all the brushes and when she wanted to use the brush on my hair she physically showed to me for reassurance–how wonderful it feels when your request is being taking seriously and you are accommodated accordingly. Anita gave a me a haircut and styled my hair today and in couldn't be happier, not only with her advanced skills but also with her lovely personality. For over 15 years, I drive all the way to Richmond Hill from Brampton to get my haircuts and I am so thrilled to find a hairstylist in Brampton that does such a professional and outstanding job when I don't feel the need to go to my previous stylist of 15 years as I really do not enjoy the long drive to Richmond Hill.

Anita even went to the length of trimming my child's bangs who was waiting for me in the Salon.

Thank you so much Anita for the wonderful experience today and the clean and stylish haircut and the style you gave me!!! I will definitely come back to you and your salon.

Had an amazing experience at the salon today! I got beautiful long layers with soft movement and it looks absolutely stunning. The stylist really understood what would suit my hair and face shape. My hair feels lighter, healthier and so stylish now. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a professional haircut!

reviews: I was in the hunt of the best cold coffee drink in the city and thought to give this spot a try because of the high ratings and it didn’t disappoint! Great spot in Ottawa,cozy place , friendly stuff with  great variety of drinks and desserts.
We ordered ice cream and was very tasty
Also we had Italian soda and espresso.
Really recommended to visit in Ottawa

Fantastic neighborhood cafe!! Their coffee and matcha is super smooth. They also have lots of unique desserts that were very tasty as well. Great place to hang out with a friend or get some work done. The dining area is very clean and there’s a quiet calm ambiance.

Visited this café yesterday. I LOVED it! The atmosphere is really nice and cozy, and the café is quite spacious with many seats and tables available. The place has a relaxing and calm vibe. All the pastries looked SO good that it was quite hard to choose. We tried the tiramisu (halal!), salted caramel cheesecake, and a fruit tart. All 3 were superrr good and definitely seemed very fresh. The cheesecake was amazing!! I had a hot chocolate that was pretty good too. I hope to come here again 😊

I had such an amazing experience at Expresso Cafe on my birthday! I hadn't chosen one of their cakes, but the staff kindly offered to have the chef make a fresh custom cake just for me. It took about an hour, and it was absolutely worth the wait.
The cake was exactly what I wanted, beautifully decorated with my name. It was incredibly fresh, and every bite melted in my mouth.
The staff were so kind, the atmosphere was lovely, and they truly made my birthday one of the most memorable I've ever had. A special thank you to Hinako ♥️for her outstanding service and kindness.
Highly recommended, and thank you for making my day so special!

Delightfully surprised by how good everything is here! The hot chocolate was rich and the desserts were perfect. The staff were really kind and helpful and the seating options were comfy and well placed.
Also, all the options are halal! 🤍
So pleasantly surprised to find tiramisu this good that’s also halal.
Can’t wait to go again!

I come here pretty often, and the service has consistently been amazing — but today honestly surprised me in the best way.

I had just parked outside and walked in, and before I even had a chance to order, they had already prepared my usual iced coffee and handed it to me. No questions asked. That level of attentiveness is rare.

It really shows how much they care about their regulars and how well they pay attention. Small detail, but it made my day.

Great coffee, even better service. This is exactly why I keep coming back.

I ordered a custom cake for my kid’s birthday and the cake was delicious, the design was beautiful and everyone loved it. While I was there, I also got millefeuilles and they were my Coup de Cœur ❤️ I haven’t had a millefeuille that good in a long time. We will be back to try more.

name: heytea (505 Yonge St)
address: 505 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 0J3, Canada
reviews:
I was really looking forward to trying this place, but unfortunately, the experience fell short of my expectations.

The two drinks I originally wanted to order were both unavailable, yet there was nothing on the menu indicating they were out of stock. It would have been much more helpful if unavailable items were clearly marked or temporarily removed from the menu. Instead, I felt like I had to settle for a third choice.

The service was also disappointing. I didn’t find the staff particularly welcoming or accommodating, and the overall interaction felt rather indifferent.

Despite there being no complicated order, the drinks took more than 10 minutes to prepare, which felt like a long wait considering the premium pricing.

The one bright spot was the drinks themselves—they were genuinely delicious and clearly well made. Unfortunately, good drinks alone weren’t enough to outweigh the overall experience.

With so many excellent cafés and specialty drink shops to choose from, customer service and the overall experience matter just as much as the product. While I enjoyed what I eventually ordered, I don’t see myself returning.

Placed a large order (30 drinks!) for a work event from heytea via Uber Eats and I’m so impressed! Not only was the order on time, but also their packaging was perfect - small cooling bags with 2 drinks each, each drink inside a cup holder. I wish I’d taken a photo of the packaging! ALSO - they gave us 6 free merch tote bags which are adorable! Also, the quality of tea is superior here - it’s so fresh! Earlier, I have tried their Pink Guava Jasmine Milk Tea, Kale Green Tea (which has chia seeds!), Coconut Mango tea, and Yuzu Oolong tea - all of which have been fantastic. This time we tried the classics - black milk tea, jasmine milk tea, and jasmine green tea - and then we added matcha jelly, coconut jelly and sago which they serve separately on the side. The jelly was like pudding and was SOOOO fresh and delicious. A must try! Highly recommend heytea! To the staff that worked on our order, thankyou for making our event slightly easier to organize by perfecting your delivery process.

This location is always clean and the atmosphere is great. It is recommended to use the app for one and go purchases and promos. I just recently had the king jasmine snowcap milk tea and was pleasantly surprised by how aromatic it was!

Their service is quite fast for what it is, and you're able to order ahead for pickup or pay at the store when you order. For a premium price I did expect more as it felt like just your average drink. Wouldn't mind trying a different one while given the discount pricing for downloading their app.

It’s my third day coming to get their drink. The last two days, the coconut mango drink was really nice and had a good amount of sago and jelly. So today I ordered three of the same drinks. However, I’m very disappointed because there weren’t many toppings inside. I waited in line for one hour just for this drink, but when I tried all three, they had much less filling than before. I’m really disappointed.

Great experience at Ako Barbershop! Dekan is very professional, friendly, and always takes the time to make sure everything is done exactly how you want it. His shop has a great vibe. He’s professional, easy to talk to, and genuinely cares about his clients. Every appointment is a great experience. Highly recommend!

Super clean spot with great vibes. Their attention to detail really stands out.

Ken was amazing! Went for haircut and beard, the best styling and detailing according my face. Thank you!

I’ve going to Ako Barbershop for years now, Hands down the best barbershop in the GTA. Ken and the team are incredibly professional, exceptional haircuts every time, and make the whole experience enjoyable. Great people, outstanding service, and highly recommended!

name: Mama's Boy Barbershop
address: 5125 Sherbrooke St W, Montreal, Quebec H4A 1T2, Canada
reviews: Vicky was amazing! She gave my son the coolest cut he ever got. The compliments keep on coming. She paid close attention to the natural way his hair grew and didn't try to fight it to fit a specific style. He also asked for designs on the sides and Guy was so amazing at jumping in to carve out a little bit of cool! The atmosphere was so chill, music was adjusted to cater to kids (no inappropriate language) and my son was not the only young one there. You could tell the staff just really like working there. The coffee was awesome too which is perfect for the sideline parent. All in all, would highly recommend. 👌🤌👍

I highly recommend Guilherme for anyone seeking a skilled and professional barber. He consistently provides excellent service, is courteous and attentive, and always delivers precise, high-quality haircuts.
Guilherme cuts both my hair and my child’s hair, and every visit has been a positive experience. What truly sets him apart is his ability to make children feel comfortable and at ease. My son is usually hesitant and fussy with other barbers, but he has complete trust in Guilherme and is always relaxed in his chair.
His professionalism, patience, and attention to detail are exceptional, and I would confidently recommend him to anyone looking for a dependable and talented barber.

Top experience! Fresh haircut and beard trim, but honestly it’s way more than that. An hour to switch off, relax, and recharge from the daily grind.

Great vibes and always looking sharp when you walk out. Highly recommend! 🔥💈
Amazing experience Vicky was great with our 3 year old son. She was patient and creative. She gave him a gorgeous mullet and would 10/10 recommend her - for sure we are going back

I stopped by Mama’s Boy Barbershop recently as a plus one for my foodie friend Sarah’s collab, and I was not expecting to stumble upon one of the coolest hidden cafés in the city.

BrewLab is tucked right inside the barbershop with no sign, no frills… just genuinely good drinks, warm vibes, and local art everywhere you look. I tried the Mango Affogato (tropical and creamy), the Cocowater Matcha (with real coconut slivers!), and the Freddo Cappuccino (perfect if you like your coffee bold and strong). They use Italian beans roasted right here in Québec, and you can taste the love.

Here’s a fun extra: they’re offering $3 affogato specials every Wednesday through the summer, with rotating gelato flavors. Definitely worth a mid-week stop if you’re nearby.

But what really makes this place feel special is the energy. They feature new local artists every month, the art is available for purchase, and BrewLab doesn’t take any commission. They also host community pop-ups, welcome dogs, and rent out the space for events.

The barbershop has been around for two years, but the café just launched in May. It already feels like a local favorite in the making.

Got my son’s first haircut here today from a stylist named noah. What a great experience. He was really nice and treated my 3 yo like a king. I highly recommend this place.
Ali did a great job with my new look. He was very patient with my haircut and beard, humble, professional, and really helpful. I’m very happy with the service and highly recommend him!

I came last week with my two boys for the first time. From the moment we walked in we received a warm reception. Jaleel cut both my boy's hair and did a great job! He did a an awesome job of executing what the boys wanted. He understood that time was of the essence with the little ones and did a great cut in no time at all. The coffee was great and the vibe was impeccable. One of my kids actually asked if we could get every haircut there from now on. Safe to say we will be back!

name: Restaurant Canada Best
address: 997 Av. Ogilvy, Montreal, Quebec H3N 2T3, Canada
reviews: As a Malaysian myself, I was so happy to be able to have a taste of home. As a person who live abroad a while, this ‘Nasi lemak’ is better than any other rice, highly recommend for someone new to Malaysian cuisine. Great food, nice people, and awesome drink(masala tea).

Cravings satisfied!
Tried their Nasi Lemak and Rendang for take out last February and back for Nasi goreng today and it hits the spot.
The Nasi lemakis as what you expect from a Malasian cook, rice fluppy and the the sambal is just at the right spicinness - being heat tolerance has reduced over the years.
The Rendang rempah is more on the  mamak version, less sweet and more savory but you can taste the kunyit leaves which was missing on other restaurant that serves rendang.
The nasi goreng was wow all the anchovies really makes it kampung style just missing the chopped chili padi but the sambal on the side complemented it.
The ambiance was 4 star just because parking in the area is a bit crowded.

Never have I thought I would be able to find authentic Malaysian-style Indian food in Canada, but I had it here. The food was very authentic both in taste and presentation, and if it weren’t for the snowy street outside, I would’ve very well thought I was at a restaurant back home in Singapore. The food was so good that I returned two days later for more — and the staff remembered me!!!

The Nasi Kandar (which is only served on Saturdays) was so huge in portion that I had to pack the leftover and had it for lunch the next day — and it still tasted so good! Amazing price - portion - quality ratio.

The Nasi Lemak was also delicious, and the sambal had just the right balance of spicy, sour and sweet.

The restaurant staff were also very welcoming, and the husband-wife chef even came out of the kitchen to chat with me after my meal!

Amazing restaurant!

Finally found a good place for Nasi Lemak in Montreal! We took the Nasi Lemak, Rendang Ayam Beef and the Chicken Noodles and they were all delicious! The hospitality we got from the owners was amazing, they were so nice to us. Honestly, it’s totally worth it to go support them, good food and good people! We’ll be back for sure! ❤️

This might be what home might feel like. I am not Sri Lankan nor Malaysian but this restaurant and its owners brought me and my friend a newfound sense of belonging and warmth.
The food was high in quality, good and with generous portions
The atmosphere almost felt like eating food cooked by your grandmother.
The owners are absolute gems!
This is a must in Montreal
Very nice hidden gem. Not many places to have Malaysian and this place was delicious. Very hospitable, homemade, momma poppa vibes. Servings are generous and food tasty. Will be coming back!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
We had a wonderful dining experience! The Malaysian food was absolutely delicious, fresh, and full of authentic flavors. Every dish we tried was amazing.
The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and helpful. They made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived and provided excellent service throughout our visit.
We have tried Malaysian food at many places across Canada, but this is by far the best Malaysian food we have ever had! Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and cooked to perfection.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for great Malaysian food and outstanding customer service. We will definitely be coming back!🥰🥰🥰🥰🥰
Authentic nasi lemak. The rice was so flavourful and you could taste the aroma of the coconut. Everything blended well together. Lassi drink was great too. Owners were friendly and welcoming.

name: Paris Baguette
address: 2401 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4P 3H1, Canada
reviews:
Update: We’ve been ordering from Paris baguette for awhile now. This time we got to try their Salted Caramel cake and other French pastries! They were so good both to look at and to savour !

Thank you Paris Baguette!

———
I recently ordered catering from Paris Baguette for a lunch training group, and as a new admin, it was my first time placing an order with them. I was extremely impressed from start to finish.

Jeesun was so helpful throughout the entire process. I simply told her how many people we were ordering for, and she was able to recommend the perfect amount of food for our group. The ordering process was easy, delivery was on time, and communication was excellent throughout.

The food was a big hit!! The sandwiches are fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. And now I’m officially hooked on their chocolate chip cookies!

Very happy with the experience and will definitely be ordering from Paris Baguette again.

Unfortunately, I did not take proper pics except for a video where I captured this little photo of the sandwiches.

I tried Paris Baguette for the first time in Canada, and it tasted exactly like the ones I eat in Korea. It was so delicious that my eyes widened in amazement. The sandwich was seasoned just right, crispy, fresh, and generous in portion. I think I would want to buy it again if I saw it next time. The donut wasn't too sweet like Canadian donuts, looked so pretty, and was chewy; I only intended to have a little taste, but I kept reaching for more and ended up eating the whole thing. I enjoyed it with Paris Baguette coffee, and it was a truly happy experience.

This is my absolute favorite café — I come here almost every day to sit, work, and unwind. The atmosphere is always welcoming, and the staff are genuinely friendly, which makes such a difference when you’re a regular.
Their pastries are always fresh and incredibly delicious and they go fast, which says everything about how good they are! you can really taste the quality. And the coffee? Always perfect. Consistent, smooth, and exactly what you need to get through the day.
Today was such a sweet surprise — they gave every customer a slice of chocolate cake, and wow… it was amazing! Little gestures like that make this place even more special.
I almost tried everything at this store, nutella cold brew and berries pastry with lemon cream are heaven !!
Highly recommend if you’re looking for a cozy spot with great vibes, great people, and even better treats 🤍

We went to Paris Baguette to work on a couple things and to get some pastries and drinks. When we walked in, all of the tables with the booth were taken. It seems like this is a popular place to work remote.

I got a hot Matcha latte with oat milk and my boyfriend got an Iced Matcha Latte with almond milk. Our drinks were pretty good, they were sweet, earthy, and creamy.

For pastries, we got a croissant and coffee bun. I really liked my coffee bun, it was pretty large for a pastry. And the coffee flavor was really nice, it was sweet but nailed the "not too sweet" sweetness level as well. I absolutely loved my coffee bun. They have a huge selection of pastries to choose from, from sweet to savory. Everything looked good.

For me and it seems like I'm not the only one, pricing was a little bit more expensive than I anticipated compared to other cafes in the area. Despite this, I would come back again. I don't think I'd be a regular here because it can get pricey. But I'd definitely come back to try their different pastries and cakes.

I would like to thank Mimi for her excellent customer service and professionalism. When my order was not ready as expected, she handled the situation quickly and efficiently. As a manager, she made a prompt decision to resolve the issue and ensured that I felt valued as a customer.

Her kindness, attention to customer satisfaction, and willingness to take immediate action left a very positive impression. Thank you, Mimi, for turning an inconvenience into a great customer experience.

The pastries here are so expensive for what you get! Anything here with the word "Korean" attached to the product name has a 20% markup. The Korean BBQ pizzettas are $8.59?! I could get a real slice of pizza and a pop for $5.  The Korean iced milk coffee is $4.99?! The drink is literally made up of 50% ice... you are not getting any value when you order here. It's a Korean style French bakery... everything looks beautiful but taste wise mediocre and can get way better value elsewhere.

Lots of variety. I went with the pepperoni pizzetta and curry croquette. Both were delicious. I got an iced latte, also very delicious. It’s a bit of a splurge but you get what you pay for. Staff were very friendly. The deserts looked delectable too.

Had high hopes for this Korean bakery chain at Yonge & Eglinton after seeing multiple GTA locations pop up. Visited on a Friday morning and left feeling genuinely disappointed with excellent baked goods held back by frustratingly inconsistent service.

WHAT WORKED: The space is beautiful and spacious with excellent lighting, which is rare for Toronto bakeries. The croissant was legitimately outstanding once heated (flaky, buttery, perfect technique). Red bean bread had that subtle sweetness that lets the flavour shine without being cloying like Western bakeries often make it. Reasonably priced at $30 for three drinks and three baked items.

SERVICE REALITY CHECK: This is where it fell apart. One staff member was warm and helpful explaining drink sizes; another at checkout was dismissive with no smile or attention to detail. Never asked if we were dining in or taking out. Had to specifically request our croissant be heated rather than it being offered.

THE REAL ISSUE: Self-serve coffee station for milk/sugar with ZERO signage or verbal explanation. Coming from Toronto’s coffee culture where drinks arrive ready to consume, this lack of communication was confusing and poorly executed. When we politely offered constructive feedback, got an almost annoyed response as if we were inconveniencing them.

DRINKS: Signature brewed coffee was decent but nothing special (slightly elevated Tim Hortons quality). Iced matcha latte disappointed – pale green, overly sweet, lacking that earthy matcha complexity. I noticed that people bringing their Starbucks/Tim’s drinks in just to buy pastries, which tells you something.

BOTTOM LINE: Genuinely impressive baked goods overshadowed by service that felt like staff were going through motions rather than creating welcoming experiences. In Toronto’s competitive café market, there’s no reason to compromise on service regardless of pastry quality.

Simple fixes would transform this: better signage for self-serve stations, consistent staff training on basic hospitality, actually confirming dine-in vs takeout orders, offering to heat pastries automatically.

Until those operational improvements happen, plenty of Toronto alternatives offer excellent baked goods WITH the service quality your Friday morning deserves.

📖 Want the full story? Head to my blog Jen’s One Fine Day for the complete review covering every item we tried, exactly what went wrong with service, and realistic suggestions for improvement. Link in my profile!

Showed Paul a picture of what I wanted and he did it even better. He's a great guy, good talks with him, a real professional. Excellent barber shop, I am extremely satisfied, I really really recommend this place!

I went to Paul and he was absolutely amazing! Extremely welcoming from start to finish, even turned off the heater for me for a few minutes because I was hot. Was visiting from New York and I felt right at home with Paul cutting my hair! Merci beaucoup Paul!
Paul Mikhael was excellent with my haircut. He has a lot of experience. It was my first time here in the barber shop and it went great! I recommend booking with him. Great service! Good vibe!

reviews: We've been to many Italian, Polish, Portuguese bakeries all over the city, we decided to give this establishment a try. We came in at 1:30 PM on a Wednesday and the lady serving us was in a rush, no patience, just yelling and not even giving us an opportunity to ask questions regarding our order for the hot bar and sandwiches. Can't speak for the baked goods or other products in the store but we can honestly say that the hot table food was mid at best and nothing special... Which would've been OKAY if the service wasn't bad.

Baked goods are great here, especillay the Canolli.  Crossiants are also very good.  The only issue I have is i've been going there for 14 years consistently, and its a small shop, i would stand out as a non-italian, never feel welcomed, or the owner says hello to me.  I don't know, maybe i'm being judgy, but sometimes just rubs me the wrong way.

My family and I have been loyal customers of this bakery for over 15 years. We’ve always enjoyed coming here, especially during the summer when we would grab pizza and bike back home together. Because of that long history, it’s very disappointing to have to write this review.
Recently, I called in the morning to ask if they could hold two slices of pizza for my mom. When I picked them up and brought them home (I live only two minutes away), I noticed they had been wrapped in a different type of paper than they used in the past. They used to wrap slices in foil/ parchment( parchment touching the food).  This time, they are usually a new paper wrapping that is red checked on one side and regular parchment on the other.  they wrapped the pizza red side up ( which is obviously wrong)and it leaked red dye onto the pizza. The entire bottom and sides were stained red. It was potato pizza — which has no red toppings — so it was very obvious something wasn’t right.
I immediately called the bakery, assuming it was an honest mistake. Instead of concern, I was met with attitude on the phone. I was told to bring it back, and they reassured me that the paper was “food grade” and “food safe.” While I understand that, it doesn’t change the fact that no one wants to eat pizza covered in red dye. Food-safe or not, it simply didn’t feel right.
When I returned, I was directed to the owner’s son. Unfortunately, the interaction only got worse. I was met with an unbelievable amount of attitude and the comment, “What do you want? I don’t see a problem.” There was little willingness to acknowledge the issue. After over a decade of supporting this business, I was shocked at how dismissive and rude the response was — especially over an $11 pizza a simple “ no problem let us replace it” would have sent me on my way happy.
This situation could have been handled so easily with a respectful attitude. I was fully prepared to move on from what I believed was an honest mistake. Instead, I was made to feel like I was being unreasonable and as if i was the crazy one… soo rude! In the end, I said thank you, and he simply turned his back and didn't acknowledge me.

Id also like to mention that i told them that i remember you guys use to use a different wrapper paper? And he quickly shut me up and said. “No we didn’t”
Which is a lie as im attaching photos of the old paper.
Also attaching photo of the pizza they gave us the second time to replace the potato one and would you look at that… paper leak all over hand lol. Very proud people who have a hard time admitting their faults. The owner should not let that younger kid speak for his business as he seems to have an anger problem/ cant take criticism from a CUSTOMER and also cant be honest about the old paper they use to have. McDonald's has better service. EATALY HAS better service and they are double their price and always willing to fix their mistakes. Shame shame.

It’s not about the $11. It’s about customer service and how loyal customers are treated. Sadly, because of this experience, they have lost not just one customer, but many members of my family as well as we all think this was simple matter however it was dealt with pride and arrogance.
Very disappointing

It is hilarious how you choose to respond…  with attitude, pride and lies. Confirms my point.

You never gave it to me for free, i paid. Let’s break it down: You first gave me a product that  had ink on it & i came back asked for a new one.

This was not a “character attack.” It was an honest account of how I felt during the interaction. A simple apology( that i never received) and respectful communication would have made this a non-issue. Instead, the tone both in person and in this response reinforces the dismissiveness I experienced.

It’s unfortunate that accountability and respectful customer service are being framed as unfair criticism. Just because you are “ small family business “ doesn’t mean you get away with poor custom services, you offer something and if you offer it poorly… you don't get service, shocker.

An Italian rum cake from Lazio Bakery, ordered for my girlfriend’s 50th birthday, was hands down the best cake ever had. It was moist, perfectly balanced, and not overly sweet. When sliced, you could see all the beautiful layers — and every bite melted in your mouth.

The cake was a showstopper, beautifully decorated with fresh-cut flowers, and every guest couldn’t stop raving about it. Lazio Bakery truly outdid themselves. Every morsel was devoured!

Honestly, I’ve always had a great experience here — their hot chocolate and other things usually exceed my expectations. That’s why I came back again for the hot chocolate. Unfortunately this time, it felt like very little cocoa mix was added, so the drink wasn’t creamy, rich, or chocolaty like it normally is.

I know they can do much better because I’ve had amazing things from them before. Hoping this was just a one-time mistake and the consistency improves because I genuinely enjoy this place.

Ernesto is awesome!! He is experienced and kind. You can never go wrong with him. I have been going to salon Solis for over 8 years now. name: Molly Tea (Downtown)
address: 604 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 1Z3, Canada
reviews:
We visited Molly Tea in downtown Toronto during our family holiday break, and it was a nice stop for drinks and a short rest while exploring the city. The shop has a clean, cute, and modern atmosphere, which made it feel relaxing and pleasant. The tea tasted fresh, and the menu had a good variety of options for different preferences.

It is a great place to visit if you like milk tea, fruit tea, or lighter tea-based drinks. The location is convenient, especially if you are walking around downtown. Overall, it was a lovely spot for a casual family treat and a quick break during the day.

I hadn’t had such a well-balanced milk tea in a long time. I ordered the Osmanthus Green Milk Tea, cold with 50% sugar, and it was ideal in my opinion. The sweetness level was just right and not overpowering. It was quite light to drink, and the green tea flavour really came through. The place wasn’t busy, so it was comfortable to sit. In terms of value for money, it’s not bad. Overall, it was a good experience. I’d recommend it.

I read great reviews on Molly Tea so we decided to try it while we were in the area. They were busy considering we got there in the middle of the day and in the middle of the week so our orders took quite some time. They also had some orders online to prepare which affected service time. The place was quite small and didn’t have a lot of seatings so most customers had to stand and wait for their drinks. We ordered the Gardenia Oolong Milk Tea (3/5) and the Premium Jasmine Oat Milk Tea (3/5). We were hoping for a strong earthy, floral and herbal flavour from both drinks. Unfortunately, both were quite mild and those flavours were not as prominent as we’d like them to be. I don’t take sugar in my teas and my partner does, and we both agreed on this. We did enjoy their crystal balls which were so bouncy and chewy. I’m not exactly sure if I’d come visit again. But maybe if I’m with a friend who wants to go and get a drink from this place, I wouldn’t say no.

Hands down one of the best refreshing drinks in downtown! Just tried the new Premium Jasmine Citrus and it completely lived up to the hype. The jasmine tea aroma hits you at first sip, and the real citrus fruit makes it taste so fresh and clean. If you want a drink that is high-quality and crisp, this is the one to get.

My holy grail. Got the premium jasmine milk tea (green tea) and single stem (oolong tea), which are my personal favourite. Their white champaca and milk foam drinks are super good too! I've had every single item on the menu 😅

reviews: Great shopping experience at Frontier Heritage.  Beautiful fabrics and helpful advisors.  Shout out to Raju's Tailor Shop for creating a customized sari for me in less than 24 hours!   Thank you!

The staff is incredibly kind and accommodating, and having an in-house seamstress takes away the stress of finding alterations elsewhere. I truly can’t recommend them enough. If you don’t want to spend your time chasing people for updates or worrying about details, this is the place to go. The entire process was stress-free, with outstanding customer service.

They truly cared about every detail and went above and beyond to ensure everything was perfect and completed based on my timeline. Highly recommend to any bride looking for exceptional service and genuine care.

They truly go above and beyond to offer the best pricing possible while still maintaining amazing quality products. It’s rare to find a place that consistently delivers both great service and great value. Highly recommend Frontier Heritage, and we’ll definitely continue coming back for years to come!

Ishan and his team made sure I was taken care of every step of the way, communicating with me, updating me with what’s happening with my outfit, and going above and beyond my expectations. They told me I’d get my outfit by August and I got it MUCH earlier! It’s rare to find a bridal boutique that actually cares about their brides and the process. They are customer service driven and ensure their clients are taken care of the best way possible. I’m  so excited to get my second bridal outfit from them. Highly recommend working with Ishan and the whole team at Frontier Heritage Brampton.

reviews:
This was my first time coming to Salon Pure, and overall I had a great experience. I came in for a cut and a blowout, and I would definitely come back.
Audrey did my hair, and she did an amazing job. She was very kind, warm, and friendly, and also gave me helpful tips. I was really happy with how my hair turned out and received many compliments afterwards.
If you visit, I would definitely recommend asking for Audrey.

I destroyed my hair trying to do my hair diy at home on black Asian hair, it turned into a catastrophe being neon orange/yellow with a bunch of dark spots. I was panicking and called salon pure. Audrey took in my call listening to my distress and reassured me she would take me in and fix my mess professionally. She explained super clearly and calmly what proceedures she would take to transform my hair. I felt in super good hands, taken care of and safe with her. She fixed my hair into a beautiful balayage, super natural and clean. She was extremely kind and really professional. 10/10 service, balayage. It turned out perfect and exactly what I wanted. She saved me!!

I have been seeing Stephane for my colour every 3 weeks for 15 years. He is reliable and professional. I am grateful to have him take good care of me every time! And Daria gives the best massage in shampoo!

Pure team is the best hair soon in Montreal. You will not go wrong with them.

After almost 15 years as a client of Salon Pur, I had known of Monia’s reputation as a colourist for years, but a few weeks ago I finally had my first appointment with her.

I was new to hair colour and wanted to brighten my natural blonde and blend in some grey while keeping everything subtle, classic, and natural. Knowing Monia’s credentials and experience, I knew I was in exceptionally qualified hands.

I was very comfortable with Monia; she really listens, patiently answered my questions, and lent her requested professional and creative input — what tones would suit my complexion, what would be most flattering, and how to achieve what I was struggling to describe. She has the combination of considerable technical knowledge and artistic judgement, while never losing sight of what the client actually wants.

She used highlights and lowlights to brighten my blonde and blend the grey without overprocessing it. The result was remarkably natural—I genuinely couldn’t distinguish my natural colour from what she had enhanced. It simply looked like my hair, only brighter, healthier, and better.

I was so pleased that I decided I wanted to go back and do even more. Before I could call, Monia made my day by calling me first, to make sure I was happy and comfortable with the result. I have never had a stylist follow up like that.

She takes enormous pride in her work and genuinely cares about her clients’ satisfaction. I know her experience will never steer me wrong.  I have so much confidence, and a newfound enjoyment in something I was dreading would be a tiresome trial-and-error burden! Now I’m looking forward to going back to experiment a little more…

Monia’s credentials and experience are seriously impressive, but she also makes me feel like she has my back, and wouldn’t leave me unhappy or miserable with something ill-suited. I trust Monia—and Salon Pur—with my hair implicitly.

Five stars, without hesitation.

I had such a wonderful experience at Pure Salon! My hairstylist, Audrey, was absolutely amazing. She really listened to what I wanted and gave me exactly the look I had in mind even better than I imagined.

She completely transformed my hair from a darker dirty blonde to a beautiful platinum blonde, and the result is stunning. You can tell she really knows what she’s doing—she took her time, paid attention to every detail, and made sure my hair still felt healthy and looked natural.

The salon itself is super clean and has a really welcoming vibe. Everyone there is so kind and professional, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable.

I’m so happy with my results and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend asking for Audrey if you visit!
