reviews:
I had such a wonderful visit to this bakery. The selection of fresh breads and pastries is truly impressive and everything looks absolutely delicious.

I picked up a box of assorted fruit danishes and they were perfection. The flaky pastry paired with the sweet fruit fillings was exactly what I was craving. It is clear that a lot of care goes into the baking here. I will definitely be back to try more of their offerings soon.

I love Harbord Bakery! Just found it on my lunch break from work and now I can’t stop going. They make the besssst cheese danishes and the veggie empanadas and vegan water challah are my fav 🤤 also great veggie salads and pasta!! makes sense why they have been here for 81 years!!

Also the staff are so generous they are always smiling and happy to see you, just feels like a much needed hug when you enter the store.

The stuff here have always been friendly to me and they're so helpful. I love the fact that a small and independently owned because you can see that the owners are doing something right. The big corpse should study them.
Delicious bread, great products and excellent layout. Really well thought out servicescape.

I love, love, love this bakery! Visited today and bought three different loaves of bread, some bagels and a sweet treat. All were fresh and amazing! The staff were so nice too! Looking forward to visiting again!

An institution if you ask me and of the nicest bakeries in Toronto. My partner and I always make the trip when we come over from the East End and are always amazed at how fresh the items are, the range of local products they carry and how efficient the staff are. A staple in the Jewish food scene and I hope they are around for decades more to come!

I have been coming to this bakery for 30 years. The selection of bagels and fresh breads, danish, blintzes, cookies, pies and cakes is based on a daily rotation. Normally, if it isn’t in stock tomorrow or the next day is the baking day I am told,  which means that they stick to par levels based on expected sales. It’s best to order ahead of there id something you require. The croissants include: cheese, almond, pistachio Nutella. There is a really good mixed chocolate and pistachio cookie I enjoyed. There are muffins, carrot cakes and pumpkin pies on hand right now. Prices are generally higher than the grocery with some breads actually fairly priced.

This bakery shop is one of the best around UofT. It offers a variety of baked goodies and special occasion cake. It also has a deli/salad bar. Customer service is not bad and inside of the store is clean and safe. Items presentation is not the greatest and they can definitely do better. They don’t have signs and the layout of the bakery section is a tad weird. I have it 4 because it doesn’t have vegan options and the prices are on the higher side. Otherwise, if you are around the area and feeling like having a a good muffin or cookies, give Harbord Bakery a try!
It's been an absolute institution and remains one of the best bakeries in the city. This place doesn't get nearly enough publicity/recognition. The pastries are second to none.

A bakery staple in Cabbagetown, and I simply couldn't resist when they took puff pastry dough and twisted it into a pretzel shape, filled with a sweet and fruity jam with crunchy almonds, stuck together with a layer of sticky syrup on the outside. The chocolate croissant sports a delicate, airy texture with a generous amount of dark chocolate inside.

A Must-Visit for the Serious Sweet Tooth
If you’re looking for a guaranteed "sugar fix,"

Absolute Bakery and Café is the place to be. It has become my go-to spot whenever I need a treat that actually hits the mark.

The selection is fantastic, but there are two absolute standouts that keep me coming back:

The Chocolate Brownie: This isn't your average brownie. It is incredibly rich, fudgy, and decadent exactly what you want when you're craving something deep and chocolatey.

The Eclair: A total classic done to perfection. The pastry is light, the filling is creamy, and the glaze adds that perfect final touch of sweetness.

the quality here is consistent and the treats are consistently delicious. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates a bakery that does the staples right!

$10 for a loaf of bread in a neighbourhood like this feels extremely overpriced.On the top of that, the bread was sliced and packed with BARE HANDS, which was very concerning from a hygiene perspective. Other bakeries I have been to use gloves and sell similar bread in the $5-$6 range, which feels much more reasonable and much cleaner. I will not be returning.

The place looks great after the recent renovations and the food  is amazing as always. It’s really hard to choose what to get bc everything is so good. I usually get a cherry cheese danish but they’ve added even more pastries recently so I guess I’ll be going more often. Apparently they even have sandwiches which I’m looking forward to trying. So glad they have lasted so long and I wish them many more years in business. Outstanding in every way!!!!

reviews:
The hairdresser cut my hair uneven. My instructions were very clear, to trim dead ends and cut layers on sides only. Instead she cut a random portion of my hair from the back very short so now i have an extra bit of short hair awkwardly hanging from the back. The stylist was stressed from start to finish and admitted multiple times that things were not going well. She even recommended I buy a SteamPod on Facebook Marketplace because I would "definitely need it" — which says it all.

I was overcharged with no prior discussion, pressured into leaving a larger tip than I offered, and when I raised my concerns, management dismissed everything and never bothered to follow up.

If you have thick or textured hair, look elsewhere. They will tell you they have the experience and knowledge but they don't!

It was amazing..I got my haircut done from Irene and I recommend everyone must have haircut from her as she listens very carefully to what client wants and also give advice.. Must come to her if you want your hair feel lively again

The one star earned is for the fact they gave us an appointment the same day.
We asked for a trim☆!TRIM!☆not much off the length, we showed the hairdresser a photo of a shorter version of the style but I personally told her on my young, quiet son's behalf 3 times before she started do not make it short like the picture pls just a LONGER version of this style and because he already had the layers and perm that looked great but just needed a TRIM. I even showed her where to trim...anyway 50 dollars for a super short cut he hated and was holding back tears...they would not take any responsibility for their mistake blaming both the picture shown and my son...we wanted a reasonable discount and after arguing like crazy with my fiance  they gave 5 dollars off🙄 WORST experience ever in a salon. name: Belgard Barbershop Montreal
address: 110 Rue Saint-Pierre, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 2L7, Canada
reviews:
I just walked out of Belgrade Barber Club in Old Montréal, and I can honestly say the experience was exceptional from start to finish.

From the moment you walk through the door until the moment you leave, the service is professional, welcoming, and genuinely attentive. I had the pleasure of being taken care of by Matt, who was incredibly thorough and detail-oriented throughout the entire appointment.

I booked both a haircut and beard service, and I absolutely loved the result. Matt took the time to understand exactly what I wanted, offered great recommendations, and delivered with precision and care. It's clear that he takes great pride in his craft.

Whether you're a Montréal local or visiting the city on vacation, I highly recommend stopping by Belgrade Barber Club. It's the kind of place that makes you feel refreshed, confident, and ready to enjoy the rest of your day.

And if you're staying at a hotel, don't forget to ask your concierge to make the reservation for you! After your appointment, you'll be perfectly set up to enjoy a fantastic dinner and explore everything Old Montréal has to offer.

Thank you, Matt, and the entire team for a truly outstanding experience. I will definitely be back!

Best barber I have set foot in a long time! Everyone was so friendly and very experienced! I had Matt and he could not have done a more splendid job, his technique and style was wonderful! The price seemed a bit high when I booked, but after the experience, it was worth every penny, if you want to get a hair cut or beard trimmed and feel relaxed and looked after all in one go, this is the place to be!!

Matt is hands down the best barber I have ever been to. He really understands exactly how I want my hair cut, and he consistently delivers. His scissor work is excellent, and you can tell he takes pride in precision and details.

What stands out the most is how meticulous he is throughout the whole process. He first cuts the hair and pre styles it to make sure everything looks right and that nothing is missed. Then he washes the hair to remove all the loose strands, dries it, and carefully checks everything again before finishing with styling. The final result always looks clean, balanced, and exactly how I want it.

You can tell he genuinely cares about doing the job properly and not rushing through it. I cannot recommend Matt enough. I have never had a better barber.

I stopped by recently and was genuinely impressed by the atmosphere and level of professionalism at Belgard. I could immediately tell the team takes pride in what they do. The barbershop was clean, welcoming, and had such a great vibe — friendly conversations, attention to detail, and excellent customer service all around. Every client who walked out looked extremely happy with their cut, and the barbers were clearly skilled and attentive. You can tell this is a place that values both quality and customer experience. Definitely a spot that leaves a great impression and I’d absolutely recommend checking it out!

I am extremely disappointed with the lack of professional courtesy and the predatory billing practices here.

I left the West Island a full hour early for my 5 PM appointment. Realizing traffic was at a standstill, I acted in good faith and called at 4:22 PM to give a heads-up, and again at 5:05 PM to officially cancel so they could free up the chair for a walk-in. Despite this constant communication, I was still charged the full $50.00, the 100% price of a service that was never performed.

To make matters worse, I attempted to call the shop seven times this morning during business hours to resolve this, and no one answered the phone. For a shop that demands perfect punctuality from clients, their own accessibility is non-existent.

The double standard is what really stings. On my first visit, I arrived perfectly on time but was left waiting in the lobby for 10 minutes before the barber was ready. Apparently, the grace period only works in one direction at Belgard.

As for the service, it’s average at best. They sell a nice ‘experience’ with the decor and the hot towels, but the technical skill doesn't justify this level of rigidity for what is ultimately a very basic cut.

Advice for fellow customers: Be aware that under Section 13 of the Quebec Consumer Protection Act, it is generally prohibited for a merchant to charge a fixed 100% penalty for a service not rendered. If you find yourself in a similar situation where a shop refuses to be reasonable or offer a credit for a documented delay, know your rights.

There are plenty of talented barbers in Montreal who value their clients' time and communication more than a quick cancellation fee.

Reply to Belgard’s comment:

38 minutes, given the circumstances, is totally reasonable. I honestly wish you all the best, and I hope that one day you’ll see and value your clients, their time and hard-earned money, and not just a dollar sign.

Excellent experience from start to finish. I got a clean fade, a sharp beard trim, and a fresh haircut overall, everything was done with precision and attention to detail. The fade was smooth and perfectly blended, and my beard was shaped exactly how I wanted it.

The vibe of the shop is very gentlemen-like,  classy, relaxed, and professional. You feel comfortable the moment you walk in. Definitely a place for men who appreciate quality grooming and a refined atmosphere. Highly recommend.

Had a great experience at belgard barbershop! Walid is awesome and professional, friendly, and incredibly skilled at what he does. He pays attention to detail and makes sure you leave looking your best. The atmosphere is welcoming, and the service is always top-notch. Highly recommend booking with Walid if you’re looking for a great haircut and excellent customer service!

My experience at a barbershop in Belgrade with « Matt » was excellent. Matt gave me a proper and neat haircut, paying close attention to detail and ensuring everything was perfectly shaped. The atmosphere was relaxed, and the staff was friendly, making the entire experience enjoyable. Matt took the time to listen to exactly what I wanted and offered professional advice to achieve the look I was aiming for. I left feeling refreshed and satisfied with the result. 🤟🏻🇮🇷

name: Cordi Italian Bakery
address: 1891 Rathburn Rd E, Mississauga, ON L4W 3Z3, Canada
reviews: All of the employees are incredibly kind and sweet! The prices are super affordable, $2.00-$2.40 for each cannoli, $2 for a nanaimo bar. We immediately ate the pistachio and ricotta cannolis in the car and went back in for a freshly ground americano, which was also delicious. The cannolis are beautifully made, with the perfect amount of sweetness. Their deli and bakery section had a plethora of options, and extremely competitive prices. I would recommend everyone to support this locally owned family business, whether it be at the deli counter or bakery, you can tell everything has been made with quality ingredients and love :)

Have been there four times now, the first three times I was unable to acquire donuts, today my luck was different.

The donuts are light, fluffy and airy. Not overly sweet, and very large. The cinnamon bun was my favourite. The blue berry filled pairs incredibly well with some peanut butter.

The staff has been very friendly each time I have gone, I will definitely he back for more.

The value proposition is incredible, I got 10 very large donuts for $22 (that is akin to Tim Hortons pricing for fresher, larger and far more delicious donuts!!!)

Pro tip - go BEFORE 12PM. They sell out after that.

Fantastic service, warm and welcoming for a first timer. The value of the donuts are spectacular. I have a crippling sweet tooth and had to try these. They are extremely generous with their fillings which is a rarity in this cruel world. 18 massive, fresh donuts for $38 - incredible. Some had a tiny bit of ‘old oil’ taste but few and far between. They are not greasy nor are they too overly sweet. Highly recommend and will return whenever I’m in the area. You can’t go wrong with any of the selection as I tried each of them!
The real deal. Best donuts and pastries in sauga. Definitely coming back. Reminds me of the Italian bakeries I grew up around in Toronto.

Older family style bakery.  Baked goods are insanely good.  Reasonably priced and always super fresh as they cant keep up with demand.  Went here after seeing some social media posts.  At times... I'm skeptical of influencer recommendations as most of them get perks or payments to post.  This local joint was bang on!  Word to the wise, show up early as they run out of donuts by early afternoon.

A hidden gem in Mississauga on the outskirts of Etobicoke.  Could possibly be the best bakery in the GTHA.

Been coming here for years with my mother and it’s about time I did a review.

The breads and buns are made fresh daily and are all delicious.  Wide selection of meats and cheeses.  And the baked goodies are to die for.  The donuts, twists, Portuguese tarts, Zeppole (seasonally), assorted cookies, cakes and pies and so much more! All made fresh daily with love and care you can tell with every delightful bite! :). I especially love the chocolate donuts, twists and canoli.

Marco and the entire staff are  extremely warm, welcoming and friendly. And the prices are very reasonable  given the time and care it takes to make fresh baked goods of this high quality.

If you ever are in the area or have some time for a nice drive and can find your way to this amazing, authentic Italian bakery I highly recommend it.  You won’t be disappointed.

First time visiting this unique shop that looks like an appliance store from outside. Favorite from the three was the strawberry cheesecake (without the green stem which I made a mess trying to remove). Would go back to try new sweets.

I went to Cordi’s on a recommendation from Google saying that it was the best donuts in the entire city. I went after my commute one Friday and checked it out. They were completely out of donuts, so I settled for a bunch of cannolis, hazelnut cream puffs and eclairs. Those cannolis were the best dessert I’ve ever had from a bakery in my life. The shell is fresh and crunchy, and the ricotta is sweet and perfectly textured. So much so, I woke up early the next day on Saturday to try the donuts. I got a bunch of cannolis as usual and got a cream filled donut, a cinnamon roll, and a regular dipped chocolate donut. They live up to the hype and I believe they are about 2$ each. The dough was so soft and chewy, but flavourful and fresh. The cream donut might be the best donut I’ve ever eaten. The service is also fantastic. The employees always say hello and come around the counter to take your order. I’d give 6 stars if I could. Even if you aren’t in the area, make the detour to get cannolis and donuts at Cordis.

address: 50 Peel Centre Dr, Brampton, ON L6T 3R5, Canada
reviews:
We've been buying milk tea here for a while and like their flavours. However, they've made mistakes on some of our previous orders and we let those pass.
But today was the last straw (pun intended). I don't understand how you can forget to add pearls to "Pearl Earl Grey Milk Tea."
I didn't see until we got home and took the drinks out of the bag.
C'mon dude, you had one job 🙄
Not likely going back here anymore.

✅ This is my regular spot for bubble tea. The menu offers a wide variety of options, as you’d expect from Kung Fu Tea.

The staff are friendly, polite, and provide quick service. 👏🏻

🧋🧋🧋The drinks taste great compared to other bubble tea brands, and even better than some other Kung Fu Tea locations.

I had a really great experience at Kung Fu Tea! The service stood out right away—Barista Soul was incredibly helpful and took the time to suggest some amazing flavor combinations I wouldn’t have thought of on my own. Everything she recommended turned out delicious.

I also love that they have a special drink that’s featured every day for the entire month. It makes each visit feel exciting and gives you something new to look forward to trying.

Overall, friendly service, great drinks, and a fun variety of options. Definitely a place I’ll keep coming back to!

Kung Fu Tea in Brampton offers a solid bubble tea experience that consistently delivers on flavour and customization. It's a reliable spot for your boba fix, whether you're a seasoned fan or new to the world of bubble tea.
The menu boasts a wide variety of options, from classic milk teas to refreshing fruit slushes and creative concoctions. Their Pearl Milk Tea is a popular choice, with perfectly chewy tapioca pearls that are often made fresh. For those who enjoy something a bit richer, the Oreo Black Warrior or the 38 Milk King (a trio milk tea with various jellies) are highly recommended and seem to be crowd favourites. They also offer excellent flexibility with sweetness and ice levels, allowing you to tailor your drink exactly to your preference.
While the ambiance is generally focused on quick service and takeout, it's a perfectly functional space to grab your drink. The staff are typically efficient and friendly, ensuring a smooth ordering process. Whether you're picking up a quick treat or settling in for a moment, Kung Fu Tea Brampton provides a consistently enjoyable bubble tea experience.

Top notch bubble tea store. I love when Celina is working she is the most friendly person and most hard working out of every worker there. She can definitely handle her own during a rush. Give her a raise!!

I’ve been coming here for quite a while now and have easily visited hundreds of times.

This Kung Fu Tea location has been my go-to bubble tea spot in Brampton and for good reason. The drinks are consistently amazing, and the menu has a ton of options so there’s always something new to try. No matter what I order, it’s always made perfectly. I especially love their iced teas; they never disappoint.

The staff deserve a shoutout as well. They’re always friendly and clearly take care in making each drink, which really shows in the quality.

The space itself is cozy and comfortable, whether you’re just stopping by or hanging out for a while on your own or with friends.

Overall, an easy 5/5. Absolutely love this place and will keep coming back.

I have been here at least 10 times, and I have NEVER been so disappointed. My family ordered 3 drinks and a waffle and none of the drinks nor waffle tasted/looked like advertised or ordered. First of all, the brown sugar pearl latte literally looked like a milk tea and was missing the cream cheese milk foam on top!! I love their cheese milk foam but they did not even include it this time. I’ve had their lattes before with the foam and i can promise you that the foam stayed on top of the drink for 2 hours till i finished the drink. Look at this picture below, does that look like a latte!? Second, we ordered a taro milk tea with half sweetness but it was extremely sweet. I have been here so many times and I know what the drink is supposed to taste like. This was not it. Do better. By the way, the drinks came like this, we didn’t even take a sip.

Great place to get drinks, scenery is very cozy. The only problem is I went today on the Friday and saw this girl handling the whole business by herself. Cashier was slow, and the other girl handing out drinks wasn’t as cooperative with her team. I work in the food industry and a sight like this is unprofessional and unacceptable. Understandable if they are new but if they are long time workers this is very unacceptable, especially during a rush.

reviews:
I’ve been going to Shann for a while now, and I can honestly say he’s more than just a barber he’s like a brother to me. Every time I sit in his chair, I know I’m going to leave with one of the best haircuts I’ve ever had. He’s consistent, skilled, and really pays attention to the details.

If you’re looking for someone who truly cares about their craft and their clients, Shann is the one. Highly recommend.

Whether you’re looking for a modern fade, sharp line-up, classic cut, or a professional beard trim, he always gets it exactly right. He takes the time to understand what you want and makes sure you leave looking your absolute best.
If you’re searching for a skilled barber, expert fades, clean cuts, or a reliable men’s grooming experience, I can’t recommend Shann enough. Great atmosphere, great conversation, and unmatched quality every single time. Easily the best barber I’ve ever had.

even as a woman, i feel super comfortable coming in. the vibe is chill, the place is clean, and shann (barber) actually listens to what you want. everyone i’ve recommended has never gone anywhere else since.

definitely worth it every time.

Sent my boyfriend to Shann for a haircut and it turned out really good. Clean cut, looks way better than before, and exactly what he asked for. You can tell he knows what he’s doing. Would definitely recommend if you’re looking for a solid barber in Hamilton!

If you're looking for a great haircut, Shann at Split Ave Barbershop is the best barber in Hamilton! Amazing service every time; fast, efficient and fair prices. Highly recommend booking with Shann for your next cut!

address: 870 Somerset St W, Ottawa, ON K1R 6R7, Canada
reviews: Thank you Thimble Bakery for making our wedding extra special! We placed a large order of mini cupcakes which we had delivered to our wedding. They set them up, and everyone LOVED them! So beautiful and tasted amazing. Will be back to order more soon ❤️

Wonderful bakery! Delish cupcakes. Good gluten free and vegan options, as well as non-gf, non-vegan options. Delicious ice cream or gelato (dairy and non-dairy coconut based ones). They also sell candles, cake toppers, coffees, etc.

Ordered cupcakes here for my son’s birthday, and the experience was wonderful (from online ordering to pickup). The lady who assisted me was incredibly kind and helpful (I forgot to ask her name). The cupcakes were delicious and a big hit with everyone. Highly recommend!

I was very disappointed with my visit to ThimbleCakes. I noticed multiple bugs on the cupcakes that were displayed uncovered at the front of the store and were being offered for sale to customers. Seeing insects on exposed food was very concerning and made me lose confidence in the bakery’s hygiene and food safety practices. I left without making a purchase. I hope they address this issue by keeping their baked goods properly protected and maintaining better sanitation.I was very disappointed with my visit to ThimbleCakes. I noticed multiple bugs on the cupcakes that were displayed uncovered at the front of the store and were being offered for sale to customers. Seeing insects on exposed food was very concerning and made me lose confidence in the bakery’s hygiene and food safety practices. I left without making a purchase. I hope they address this issue by keeping their baked goods properly protected and maintaining better sanitation.

I would like to share my extremely disappointing experience with this pastry shop in downtown Ottawa.
I chose this place for my birthday cake because I trusted the quality of their work, despite the already high price of $115. For me, the most important thing was the taste, but unfortunately, the result was a complete disaster.
The cake was simply inedible. Not only did it have absolutely no chocolate or raspberry flavor as requested, but it also had a strange and unpleasant taste, as if something was wrong with the ingredients. From the very first bite, my guests and I were shocked. We barely tasted it before we had to spit it out.
The whipped cream was even worse. It seemed overloaded with artificial red coloring to the point that the color stained hands and even clothes, and it would not wash off with water. Honestly, it was shocking and concerning.
The situation was so embarrassing that no one wanted to eat the cake. I had to order other desserts from a restaurant at my own expense just to have something to offer my guests. What was supposed to be a joyful and special moment was completely ruined. This pastry shop truly destroyed my birthday, to the point where I ended up crying during my own celebration.
What makes it even more disappointing is that on the same day, I took the time to send an email to the person handling my order, clearly explaining the situation, what happened, and how disappointed I was. It has now been quite some time since then, and I still have not received any response. No reply, no apology, no acknowledgment. ….
Honestly, for a cake of this size and at this price, this is completely unacceptable. I was willing to pay more expecting quality, but the result was nowhere near what was promised. I absolutely do not recommend this pastry shop.
We had the red velvet and black forest cupcakes with a mocha coffee and London fog! Delicious! One of the best I’ve ever had! Moist and not too sweet. They were perfect!

We had a couple of cupcakes, Holiday Party Pants and Chocolate Orange. We had the Homemade Hot Cocoa and the London Fog.
The cupcakes were great, very moist and tasty. The cocoa was also very good. We found the London Fog's brand of tea a bit bitter, but otherwise it was good.
The person that served us was friendly and efficient.
Bring cash for tips as their POS machine doesn't give that option.

I ordered a cake for my husband’s birthday, he’s gluten intolerant and the GF mocha mini cake was perfect! Pick up was smooth, service was friendly, and the cake was delicious! We will definitely be back!

I didn’t know milk tea could be beautiful like this! Impressive. And it tastes very good. Very thankful to the blonde hair girl, she’s so nice and made the exactly drink I love. I don’t even remember how many times I’ve come here. Love it!

reviews: I visited Azores Bakery on McMurchy for the first time this morning and had a wonderful experience. The shop smells amazing—like a warm oven full of fresh baked goods—and the gentleman working there was incredibly kind. They have a fantastic selection of traditional breads and a very authentic atmosphere. I bought four pastel de nata (custard tarts), and they were absolutely delicious. Fresh bread, great prices, great service. You can smell the non-stop fresh bread being baked as you walk in. The staff are very friendly and welcoming. The pastries are also amazing and all fresh and homemade. Lots of Portuguese products great selection of olive oils, seafoods, and grocery items. A hidden gem!

This Portuguese bakery has the best old-school vibes — it feels like stepping back in time in the best way. Everything is amazing, from the fresh bread to the cheese, all so fresh and delicious. The Portuguese custards are incredible, perfectly flaky and creamy, just how they should be.
And the owners are honestly the sweetest people. You can tell they really care. I drive all the way from Orangeville and it’s 100% worth it every time. Love this place!

It’s an old style bakery. Fresh hand made breads. Loved it. Not very pricy. It’s moving crowd. They don’t have sourdough bread. However, tarts, buns, breads , baguette’s and canoli are freshly made. It’s a busy place.

The best of the best in Brampton. A hidden gem! The owners feel like family and ALWAYS treat our young daughters so kindly by offering a chocolate. Thank you so much to the Azores bakery family for their delicious food and amazing service ❤️❤️

reviews:

Was thoroughly impressed with Le Tambour Tavern.  The whole vibe of this place is fantastic.
The building and what they have done inside is great.  It’s got a nice bar area to sit and have a meal or just enjoy the drink, the restaurant is otherwise cozy and warm, with plenty of things to look at on the walls, it truly has a French vibe.
The food was also very good, our group of 4 was super satisfied, the Cote de Boeuf was cooked to perfection, and the sides were delicious.
We had two teens with us as well and they loved the food.
Highly recommend you check this place out and also check out their specials.  We will be back.

Obviously I had to come here because of watching Heated Rivalry! Seeing the outside front door I was skeptical at first, but when I walked in I was pleasantly surprised. Everything inside was exquisite. The menu options were all high end. Full bar you could choose to sit at as well. The kitchen was also open so you could see where you food was being prepared. There was an outside seating area if you chose to sit out in the fresh air on a nice evening. Reservations could be made in advance so they must get busy.  (If you want one of the Heated Rivalry tables you can reserve them specifically too.) They have a few themed drinks from the show as well.

My only issue with the fries from the show was that the aoili that came with them was just put on in a glob on top rather than drizzled over all of the fries. Seems like a place with such high end food would have used a little more finesse in the presentation.

Very cute French resto!
Excellent! Sat at the bar— for brunch- had some great cocktails.
The bartender—- was excellent! Gin smash.. Cadillac drink! The ginger cake is top notch too! Will be back!

My sister and I ate here last weekend (because of Heated Rivalry, of course!) we had asparagus as an appetizer, I had the burger and fries, my sister had the wings and we had the ginger cake for dessert. I also had the “Russians don’t blush” cocktail, everything was 10/10. We were visiting from the US, but I would so come back again for that meal. Our waitress, Allie was awesome, we loved her, and she made our experience so great.

We went for a special dinner and our server was amazing and so attentive. We would 100% go again ( if we lived in the area). The fries were amazing. Potato-y yet crisp and perfectly cooked. The polenta made me want to go home and find the recipe to try to replicate it.

On an early spring evening my wife and I managed to get a date night booked. After leaving a patio that was overly busy and not serving food, we thought we'd give Le Tambour a try (we wanted to originally, but thought we'd need reservations) we were surprised to find it lively, but not overly busy, tables were available but we wanted to snag seats at the beautiful bar. It was perfect ambience, the front door was propped open for the spring breeze, the fire was blazing and the golden hour was setting in.

We had a great conversation with the woman overseeing the bar, who also made some great recommendations. The food was excellent, classic, comfort & rustic dishes (it was roast night!), but with their own unique twists. Great time.

Cool atmosphere and great service. The vibe was excellent and made for an enjoyable experience overall. However, the food felt quite pricey for what you get, especially considering the portion sizes. Still, the great ambiance is definitely a highlight.

A quick pit stop at the end of my personal mini Heated Rivalry tour before heading back to Toronto.

This quant small tavern has the best chips and aioli, the atmosphere and decor is enchanting and I wish I came later in the evening. The open kitchen is so beautiful. Also will be coming back for more food !!!!!

Great staff , great food and cocktails , such a great spot right by the Go Train as well.

Check this spot out asap❤️

reviews: I’ve had nothing but great experiences here. The barbers are talented, professional, and take their time to make sure every cut is perfect. Clean shop, friendly staff, and great customer service. I’ll definitely be coming back!

It is in basement of residential complex and accessed by a back alley behind Victoria street downtown Hamilton. It sounded a little sketchy but  I wanted to try out a new barber because mine wasn't open on a Sunday.

When I first went in there the place looks very clean and everyone dressed professionally. Everybody in white dress shirts with black pants and they wore black gloves. They were very friendly Sat me down a couch and even offered me a water as I waited for a barber. This place was cleaner and cooler than my regular barber I been going to for over a decade.

I am extremely pleased with my fade ans hair cut. They didn't just cut my hair. They cut it, washed it, trimmed my nose hairs and used a hot towel at the end to basically wash my face.  This is my first time having an experience like that. I'll definitely go back.

Thanks for the haircut boys!  You rock!

Cancun Barbershop is hands down the best barbershop I’ve ever been to. Every single barber here is talented, professional, and takes real pride in their work. The rates are great, and they go above and beyond by offering drinks and making you feel comfortable the moment you walk in.

The shop is always clean, the staff are respectful, and their uniforms give a professional touch you don’t see everywhere. What stands out most is how meticulous they are, they take their time, pay attention to detail, and never rush. They even wash your hair and finish with a massage with the machine.

It’s truly a 10 out of 10 experience every time. If you’re looking for the best cut and service, this is the place.

Highly recommended.  Excellent service.  With convenient business hours and welcoming walk-ins, Cancun Barber Shop is the place to go.
Ahmed delivered an excellent cut and shave in a relaxing and comfortable atmosphere . Will definitely be returning for his next cut!
Thanks Ahmed
Come to this place it’s a totally experience Daniel was very professional and clean in his job he did an amazing job. Five stars
Got a tattoo by alvart_tattoo awsome young up and coming artist. Very professional amazing artist, made my vision come to life. He works out of Cancun barber shop. Check him out on Instagram.

Ahmad is truly excellent! I’ve had both beard and haircut services with him, and he never disappoints. His attention to detail, professionalism, and friendly attitude make every visit a great experience. Highly recommend asking for Ahmad if you’re looking for top-notch grooming. One of the best barbers in Hamilton!

I had a great experience at Cancún Barber Shop! The shop was super clean and professional, and the barbers really knew what they were doing. They took their time with my haircut, made sure every detail was perfect, and absolutely met all my expectations. I left with a fresh, clean cut that I was really happy with. The customer service was also amazing—everyone was friendly, welcoming, and made me feel comfortable throughout the whole visit. You can tell they really care about their clients and take pride in their work. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to others!

address: 939 Somerset St W, Ottawa, ON K1R 6R6, Canada
reviews:
I’ve been searching for a great pastry shop in Ottawa for almost a year, and I finally found it!

Everything was absolutely delicious. The pastries were perfectly balanced. not overly sweet, just the way they should be. The service was warm, welcoming, and attentive.

I also had the pistachio ice cream, that was so good!! An absolute game changer. Easily one of the best ice cream I’ve had in town.

I highly recommend this place, and I’ll definitely be coming back.

If you are looking for authentic Italian treats, you have to check out Dolci Sapori. Every time I step inside, the atmosphere is so warm and welcoming, and the staff treat you like family. Their pastry case is absolutely incredible, but the absolute highlight is their cannoli—the shells are incredibly crisp, and the ricotta filling is perfectly sweet and authentic. It's the perfect neighbourhood spot to grab a beautifully made espresso and relax with a fresh cornetto or lobster tail. Whether you are stopping in for a quick morning coffee or picking up a box of pastries to share, this gem never disappoints!! Owners are amazing and really nice!!!!!!!!!!!

I wish I had found this place earlier! The ice cream was super delicious, I tried the pistachio and almond and it was the best. The vibe is so warm and the staff are so welcoming. 🍦🍨 #IceCream #Pistachio #Almond #Vibe #Staff

Authentic Italian dolce made with care and love! Nice place to sit down and have a cappuccino or espresso to complement the desserts! Highly recommended with lots of tasty selections and super friendly staff makes this a perfect place to satisfy your coffee and dolce fixes!

This is great Italian bakery with a nice selection of pastries and sandwiches. The coffee is fresh and flavorful. Seating is comfortable and cozy. Servers and staff are very friendly and helpful.
There is street parking in front of the cafe/restaurant. I wish I lived closer to this place.

Best Italian Desserts I've found in Ottawa so far!
Canollis are amazing! And they're Zeppolis around springtime were incredible as well!

Went in for a snack and had a cannoli and Zeppole, which were both very tasty.  Dolce had many tables of regular clients enjoying their coffee and conversation, always a sign of a good establishment.  A nice spot, and I'll be back.

This Italian café and pastry shop is an absolute delight for dessert and coffee lovers. The dessert must-tries include the Rocherro, Rafaelo, and the Bombaloni, Italian-style donuts that are perfectly soft and indulgent.
For coffee, I highly recommend the Italian Delight: a bold double espresso paired with hazelnut syrup and topped with whipped cream. It’s smooth, aromatic, and the perfect balance of strong and sweet.
A wonderful spot for a cozy coffee break or a sweet treat—highly recommended!

name: See You 喜又
address: 723 Central Pkwy W Unit102, Mississauga, ON L5B 4L1, Canada
reviews:
Recently visited See You Mississauga and was so impressed! We tried two different fruit bowls — the freshness of the fruit was incredible, and the combinations were both delicious and Instagram-worthy. We also ordered two of their teas: one caffeinated for a little pick-me-up, and a caffeine-free option. Both were perfectly brewed and refreshing.

Beyond the food, the service was friendly, quick, and welcoming. The atmosphere is clean, bright, and inviting — perfect for a healthy snack or drink break.

If you're looking for a spot that truly delivers on quality and vibe, this is it! Can't wait to come back and try more from the menu. Highly recommend!

My friend, who is also my co-worker, and I were having lunch last Wednesday. He told me about See You and raved about how much he loved the drinks here. I trust his recommendations and did a bit of research as we ate and talked.

I noticed that See You is on Fantuan (or should I say that I see you, See You, on Fantuan) and had half-priced drinks. Yes, please!

The green apple coconut latte caught my attention. It was such a cool combination that I had to try it.

This drink was regularly $8. I got it for $4 before taxes, which felt like I was running away with murder. I got it with my usual less ice. There was an option to make this drink hot. I'd rather have it iced.

The estimate was twenty minutes for my drink to be made. It was enough time for me to drive over here from my workplace.

My friend said that it was in a plaza with a T&T Supermarket. He steered me correctly over here. I'll need to visit this supermarket some other day. I was trying to get home before the hailstorm happened. I got caught in the middle of it.

See You is next to a malatang eatery. I'd love to go there sometime, too. There was lots of parking. I backed in to a spot near the entrance and walked in.

A friendly female greeted me. I let her know that I was picking up a Fantuan ordered and rattled off the last three digits of my order. My drink was on the counter and was ready. I thanked her, took a few photos of this aesthetically pleasing cafe, and headed to my car.

The photo on Fantuan showed this drink having coffee on top and green coconut beverage on the bottom. I didn't get the green part. It looked like white coconut beverage. It was a minor detail. However, what I saw on the menu versus what I got was a bit misleading.

I liked this drink a lot. As a fruit person, I was hoping that if you are leading with green apple in your drink's name that it's the prominent taste that you get. There were hints of green apple after I had stirred it. The coffee was much stronger, followed by the coconut beverage.

It was cold and yummy. I didn't mind the stronger coffee taste. Maybe it's because I've been drinking Vietnamese iced coffee more lately that it has prepared me for this drink.

I will probably fair better with a fruit-based drink, as that's my norm. I'll need to head back and get one.

This place also has yogurt bowls with fruit. I'd love to try one. It's $4 off a yogurt bowl on Fantuan. There's a yogurt- and coconut milk-based bowl. It looks large, so I may need to split it into two meals or bring a friends.

I'll be back!

Went here to try fruit bowl. Got one with coconut milk and all the fruits available. Fruits were fresh and plenty. Got Lychee jelly and mango crystal ball as toppings on the fruits. Worth to try atleast once. Restaurant is very clean and good customer service.

Love this place! 💖The drinks are delicious, and the yogurt bowl was such a pleasant surprise😍 fresh, light, and so tasty. The interior is absolutely gorgeous, very aesthetic and perfect for photos. Highly recommend🥰🥰

Ordered the furit bowl, mango matcha latte and regular hot matcha latte. Definitely one of the best mango match lattes I've had, super yummy. Fruit bowl is okay, looks better than how it tasted, little pricey for the bowl. Parking available for free in the lot at the front. Staff are friendly and helpful, quick service, no wait.
It's a good healthy dessert but you really gotta stuff that joint until the lid don't close to get your money's worth
Great service, variety of options, clean environment. We got the tiramisu latte and mango matcha and loved them. Will be back soon!

We got one of the coconut milk and one stretchy yogurt fruit bowl. What’s stretchy yogurt? We were told “it’s yogurt but stretchy” lol which was fair and there probably isn’t any other way to describe it.

The bowls are $13 each which is pretty steep. At least they REALLY pack the bowls. You can pick whatever fruits and toppings you want. It was delicious but the price was steep, I think it would be a good treat once in a while! The staff was nice.

name: Clean Cuts Barbershop
address: 2013 Danforth Ave, Toronto, ON M4C 1J7, Canada
reviews:
Update: I saw Inskip today and had a great experience. Really nice guy, and he had me walking out the door looking and feeling great. He took his time, made sure he understood what I was asking for, and did an even better job than the barber I'd been going to for the past 5 years. I'm glad I went back, and I will be back again.

Original review:
I believe that the barbers here are capable (I came here after looking at their work on Instagram), so I'm not sure why my haircut turned out so weird. I had asked for "a #2 on the side, with a fade, and a bit off the top". What I got was having my sideburns completely erased (something I did not ask for), running the clippers really high in the back, and trying to "square"  my face. Unfortunately, it's hard to give feedback once someone has already gone too far. I also had a ton of hair left on my face, which could have been addressed with a quick blow dry or towel before leaving. While I was getting my hair cut, there were 3 different staff that went separately rummaging around in my barber's workstation, all looking for the same thing. My barber also had to step away to help said staff look for this item, to answer the phone, and to greet walk-ins, which is a lot of distraction. I'm giving 2 stars because the staff we're nice and my haircut wasn't a complete disaster. I'm still really confused about what happened here, but I'll be asking someone else to fix my hair when it grows back in...

I've been going to Skip for many years. Best hair cut in town without question. Popped in for a quick hair cut recently and got a cut from Enayat as he was available, and he did a fantastic job! Took his time and ensured I was getting the cut that I wanted. My friends and family say it looks great, so I'm happy with it.

I had a great experience with Enayat at Clean Cut Barbershop. He’s professional, friendly, and pays close attention to every detail. He took his time to make sure my haircut was exactly how I wanted it, and the result was clean, sharp, and exceeded my expectations. The service was excellent from start to finish. I highly recommend Enayat to anyone looking for a skilled barber. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Went in to get a business style cut with them on a whim.  Inskip did a fantastic job taking the mop I walked in with and making something not only what I asked for, but with impressive technique and precision.  Thank you guys so much!  I’ll definitely be coming back!

Did quite a lot of one research and reviews and decided I’ll give this a shot. First time here and I’m impressed. The barber was very precise and made sure everything was clean, especially the hairline. The cut came out exactly how I wanted. I was also running late, but they were still accommodating and didn’t rush the process, which I really appreciated. Great atmosphere and professionalism I’ll definitely be back.

I was a walk-in today and the shop’s apprentice Danta cut my hair. He did an amazing job. He was professional, and delivered a great haircut. I had a mess of long hair going in, and came out with a super clean summer cut.

I just got an excellent cut by Inskip and I couldn't be happier. Overall experience was great from the moment I stepped into the barbershop. With a kind, attentive attitude, Inskip sought all information and indications he needed to get a clear sense of the cut I desired, then proceeded to execute it masterfully. Conversation was delightful and I am extremely satisfied with my haircut. Thanks so much!
Great experience at the barbershop. Enayat did an amazing job and really took his time to make sure the haircut was perfect. Highly recommend him

name: Al'deewan (Manak'eesh) Bakery (OTTAWA)
address: 1440 Bank St, Ottawa, ON K1H 8A7, Canada
reviews:
This was our first time visiting Al’deewan Bakery, and we were genuinely impressed.

First of all, it was such a pleasant surprise to find a place open late in Ottawa. That alone is greatly appreciated, especially when many places close early.

From the moment we walked in, the staff were incredibly welcoming, friendly, and helpful. They took the time to chat with us, answer our questions, and make recommendations since it was our first visit. We ordered several different mini pizzas/manakeesh as well as some sweets, and everything was fresh, delicious, and full of flavour.

What really stood out was the hospitality. After we finished our meal and mentioned it was our first time there, the owners shared one of their traditions with us and generously gave us a package of freshly baked goodies to take home. It was such an unexpected and thoughtful gesture that made us feel truly welcomed.

The food was excellent, the portions were generous, the quality was outstanding, and the prices offered great value. Most importantly, the warmth and kindness of the staff and owners made the experience memorable.

Highly recommended. We will definitely be back! 😊🍕🥐✨

Usually stop by here in the mornings and the food is always super fresh. You can tell they bake everything right there. The lahmacun and za’atar manakeesh are my go-to’s, always taste great. Plus, the people working there are really nice. Definitely a solid breakfast spot.

First time at this restaurant and we were really impressed! We were going to take our food to go, but decided to eat in and we didn’t regret it. There were so many great choices, the food was delicious, and the service was amazing. The place was also very clean. We’ll definitely be coming back again. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a great meal and experience!

These people are amazing! I come here a lot and also brought my friends and family. Their customer service is top notch. I asked for some olives after I placed my order and the man there was so sweet he put some on both. I appreciate this customer service. They also have condiments on the table which make the experience much nicer. They are always courteous and I come here for a quick snack. Their prices are very good and quality is amazing.
Pies are fresh out of the oven and manaesh are thin and perfectly cooked — both are really good! Highly recommend if you’re craving fresh Middle Eastern baked treats and pies. Will definitely be back

I honestly cannot say enough good things about this place! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with a warm, inviting atmosphere that makes you feel right at home. The restaurant is always clean, comfortable, and filled with the delicious aroma of freshly baked mana2eesh.

The food is absolutely outstanding. Every mana2eesh is made fresh, perfectly baked, and packed with flavor. Whether you’re ordering a classic za’atar, cheese, or one of their specialty options (my favourite is their mortadella and cheese), the quality and taste are consistently amazing. You can truly tell they put care and passion into everything they make.

What really sets this place apart, though, is the staff and customer service. Everyone is incredibly friendly, respectful, and attentive especially their cashier Deema. They greet customers with genuine smiles, make you feel valued, and always go above and beyond to ensure you have a great experience. It’s rare to find a restaurant where the food and service are both this exceptional.

This has become my go-to spot, and I recommend it to everyone I know. If you’re looking for authentic, delicious mana2eesh, outstanding customer service, and a welcoming atmosphere, this place is an absolute gem. Five stars isn’t enough they definitely deserve ten!
Amazing food and experience. Very friendly staff. Very recommended!

I visited Al Deewan Bakery and had 2 different manakeesh, and it was really good. They offer a great variety of meat options, all halal, at very reasonable prices.

The food tasted very traditional and honestly reminded me of the Middle East. Everything felt freshly made and full of flavor.

The staff were very kind, hospitable, and fast, which made the experience even better.

I would definitely come back again and highly recommend this place to anyone looking for authentic, tasty halal food.

Machi Machi Salon de Thé is hands down the best boba tea spot in Montreal so far! The drinks are consistently delicious, refreshing, and made with great quality ingredients. You can really taste the difference.

reviews: I normally don’t leave reviews because as a busy mom of two, I rarely have the time, but this one is absolutely deserved! This was our second time with Ismael, and once again he was incredible. He took such great care of my son and was so gentle, patient, and kind throughout the entire haircut. It was the calmest I’ve ever seen my son while getting his hair cut, which shows how comfortable he is with him. The haircut is perfect and really suits his head shape. He looks so handsome! The shop has such a warm and welcoming atmosphere, and everyone is so friendly, even with my two little ones. We couldn’t be happier and will definitely be back. Highly recommend Ismael!

One of the sickest Barbershops I’ve been to in the city! It’s got a nice vibe, with couches and tables to chill at; they always have good music playing, but most importantly, my barber Nick is one of the coolest barbers I have ever met! Not only is he great at what he does, but he's also super genuine and always down to give you advice on styling, skincare, and life in general. If you’re getting cut by Nick, you can fully trust that you’re in perfect hands.

Had a great experience here. The vibe was super chill, and I really appreciated Ismael’s attention to detail. I went in without a clear idea of exactly what I wanted, but Ismael made some great suggestions based on what would work for me. I ended up leaving with a haircut I really liked and, just as he said, it works really well for me. Definitely coming back!

Ismael did an amazing job with my cut and hair pattern. I had a long week of flying around the US and this experience made my trip to Toronto 5 star.  Merci pour toot. From the welcome to the atmosphere, it felt like the old school barbershops that I’m used to attending as a child. Job well done!

Just got a cut from here. Bringen was very kind, and I kind of just let him decide the style rather than bringing in a reference. I was really surprised and satisfied with the result, never felt this confident walking out of a haircut. Actually goated barber 🗣️The place also had a chill atmosphere, and can definitely see why it has such a high rating. Will definitely be coming back!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve been going to Peter for years now, and I can genuinely say that he is so much more than just a great barber. Since becoming part of our community, he has made a lasting impression on so many people, not only because of his talent, but because of his kindness, generosity, and the way he treats everyone who walks through his door.

Over the years, I’ve had everything from regular buzz cuts and fades to completely different, longer hairstyles, and his work has consistently been some of the best I’ve ever experienced. What really sets him apart is his versatility and knowledge. Whether you have short hair, long hair, or you’re looking to try something completely new, he takes the time to understand what will actually suit you. He has helped me discover hairstyles I probably never would have considered on my own, and I’ve always been impressed by his advice, experience, and attention to detail.

For him, barbering clearly isn’t just a job—it’s a craft and an art form. You can see the passion he has for what he does in every haircut. He takes pride in his work, continues to perfect his craft, and genuinely cares about making sure you leave his chair looking and feeling your best.

But as talented as he is, what makes him truly special is the person behind the clippers. He is well known and respected in our community for his warmth and selflessness, and that says just as much about him as the quality of his work.

After all these years, I honestly don’t know what I would do without him as my barber. Finding someone with this combination of skill, experience, passion, versatility, and genuine character is rare. If I could give more than five stars, I would. He deserves every one of them and more. Highly recommended.

Peter is one of the most professional barbers I’ve ever met. He genuinely cares about his clients and takes pride in delivering exceptional service. Before my wedding, he gave me one of the best fades and beard trims I’ve ever had, and the attention to detail was outstanding.

Barberhood has an incredibly welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable and at home from the moment you walk in. Great experience, great haircut, and an even better person. Highly recommend.

Peter consistently delivers a clean, professional haircut every time. He’s extremely meticulous, pays great attention to detail, and takes pride in his work. His overall skills are outstanding, and you can tell he genuinely cares about making sure every cut is perfect. I highly recommend Peter to anyone looking for a talented, reliable barber!

name: Mane Attraction Hair Studio
address: 389 Main St N, Brampton, ON L6X 1N7, Canada
reviews:
What the skilful guys  Anmol and Denial always there for you to provide rich quality of haircut. Im their regular customer since 4 years now and we are like a family.
Highly recommendable.

I was in Wednesday May 24th to have a my hair cut.  It had been 4 years since my last cut and Jenn was fantastic.  She was accommodating from the start, easy to talk to, and asked for any inspiration I might have.  She was communicative through the entire processed and checked in to ensure I was still happy with my service and ensured I understood her process.  I was extremely happy with the result and would highly recommend Jenn, or any of the staff at this Salon.  They're welcoming, kind, and care about the product they produce.

Great hairdresser but WAY TOO SLOW. I was there for 7 hours. Blew my entire day. It should not take that long, I couldn't even get my hair dried, I had things to do. And no eating for 7 hours is ridiculous. Oh and be prepared to listen to Punjabi rap/hip hop the whole time. And if you dont speak the language they will talk in their language and you have no idea what they are saying. Will never go here again.

My new hair salon! I had Clarissa, who is a senior stylist do my hair. I specifically chose her because she specialises in balayage and colour correction. It was my first time at the salon and I was unsure of what exactly I wanted to do. I showed her 2-3 hair pics to give her an idea of what I liked. I ended up leaving the cut and colour up to her as she's the professional and would be able to envision the style and colour on me with my skin tone. I'm so happy I put all my trust in her! My hair was completely transformed and I've never been so happy leaving a hair salon! Definitely going back and I've already shared the company's IG page with friends and family.
I also chatted with a couple other employees while I was there. They were all so friendly and kind, and helpful to each other. It's definitely a great atmosphere to be in, it almost feels like you're just hanging out with some friends.
And one more thing, I was also offered snacks and drinks while I was there! Bonus!!!

I had my hair appointment today with Hardeep. I have NEVER been more disappointed, if I could give 0 stars, I would.
She didn't even get close to my inspiration picture, and she botched my hair cut so badly, I had to go to another salon to have it fixed, as one side was about 3 inches longer than the other after the 'Cut".
I did NOT pay for my services today. I lost 12 inches of hair today due to inexperience.

If the other stylists are anything like the women who did my hair today, I don't see this place lasting very long. New ownership is NOT very good. I witnessed one of the barber's CLIENTS today, reach into the barber's drawer, take out a trimmer, and start shaving his arm hairs off..... I didn't feel comfortable the whole appointment.

name: The Local by Masrawy
address: 2275 Britannia Rd W #20, Mississauga, ON L5M 2G6, Canada
reviews:
A beautiful Middle Eastern–inspired café and a perfect spot to catch up with friends or host a client meeting over coffee and snacks.

The staff are fantastic with recommendations and incredibly easy to talk to. I especially love their seasonal drinks Sahlab and the Tiramisu Iced Latte are absolute favorites and I’ll definitely keep coming back.

They also feature an in-house butcher shop and offer local products, which really highlights their commitment to supporting the community. Their vision truly shines through in every detail.

Absolutely love this cafe! The quality of the coffee is consistently good. You can tell the baristas care about the drinks they make. The pastries are also great, my favourite being the zaatar croissant. It can get pretty busy on the weekend and it might be difficult to get a table but if you go during the weekdays it’s not too bad in the daytime. I find the tables feel a little close together and cramped but overall it has a nice ambiance. Would highly recommend!

Such a cute place! Lovely atmosphere, lots of seating available, and they have a prayer room! The staff were friendly and welcoming.

The mango matcha was very nice, smooth, not too sweet, and good flavour. Will definitely come back to try the pastries :)

Very nice place to sit. A bit crowded with the tables very close to each other. Got the 'local special' which is brown sugar shaken espresso with cinnamon. Coffee is a bit strong but it was decent. Cheese croissant is also good.

The Local by Masrawy is a fantastic café with a cozy atmosphere and great vibes. The coffee was excellent, the pastries were fresh, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. It’s the perfect place to relax, work, or catch up with friends. Highly recommend! ☕✨

Loved the atmosphere and the coffee too.

They have good bakery menu options to choose from.  Tried the spinach feta and it was so buttery and fresh.

Good seating and the service was pretty quick.

Beautiful addition to masrawy restaurant. Luckily, when we went to order the owner was there. Such a kind person and very welcoming. This cafe wasn’t as over priced as many other which makes me want to go back more. Their drinks, croissants and cookies are amazing and 100% worth it. The atmosphere was beautiful with great decorations, comfortable seating and nice music. However their space is a little small for the capacity they can hold at once. Definitely a great spot to study or even to go out with friends. They also include a butcher shop. Along with local businesses selling high quality products and beautiful display. definitely recommend🙏❤️🔥

Needing a good book nook, I saw this location pop up on TikTok and wanted to give it a try! It was definitely a busy spot with all the parking spots filled up and quite a few patrons as I entered.

The service wa super quick and was able to answer my questions about the sweets, baked goods and coffees. I got a Dubai cookie, a spinach pastry and a latte to go with that.

Finding a spot was doable but something I recommend you plan out first. The coffee was a good pull, with great depth but still creamy and no sourness from what I've seen in other cafes. The Dubai cookie was a bit on the too buttery side and was closer to a texture of a shortbread. The spinach pastry was also a bit too buttery.

It's a very good location for coffee and some nibbles but if you want a quiet workspace, it might not be the spot. Definitely a place for company or catching up with people!

name: The Mango Place - Hui Lau Shan Hamilton Boba + Desserts
address: 35 King St E, Hamilton, ON L8N 4A9, Canada
reviews:
Great drinks, cozy atmosphere, and clean areas

We bought jasmine watermelon and mango slush with mango jelly. It is my first purchase here. Drinks were delicious, satisfying, prepared well, and great. We are happy with our purchases and satisfied our sweet drink craving. It is located in the heart of downtown hamilton.

We will definitely buy here again.

Delightful surprise!

First try. Not too sweet. Delicious flavours. Chunks of mango. Yummy tapioca balls.

Nice staff. Sketch neighbourhood though.

Delicious! We loved this as an alternative to milk bubble tea. The coconut mango combination was really tasty, we recommend the mango coconut tapioca drink. The fresh mango is so flavourful. There is no option to change the sugar levels, but it isn't overly sweet. Cant wait to be back.

I loved mango drink but customer service was terrible and only because of the service I might not return. I reached around 10:50 and gently asked if they’re still taking orders since they close at 11.
The girl working there made the face and took order.In addition, when they were making the order, that girl went to another staff member and started whispering, the other looked at me. Lastly, when the order was ready, they simply placed it on counter, no communication- nothing!!

The place is really aesthetic and had a great variety of fruity drinks and snacks on their menu. Got the Mango Mochi and it was delicious! I enjoyed the coconut coating and fresh mango piece on the inside. Will definitely come back and try their drinks!

Such a good bubble tea shop with fresh mangoes. The desserts are awesome!.

*** Beware*** please be careful at night around this area. It's gotten quite bad to the point where people on the influence off the streets may come inside the shop and cause problems. Recently me and my friends went on a weekday around 9. :00 at night. There were other customers inside the shop. But two guys hiding their faces in their jackets came up to the cashier bugging them about something. They were intoxicated .  We immediately left, not knowing what happened after. It was scary because we did not know if they had a weapon or not under their jackets. Very unpredictable. It's unfortunate this area has gotten so bad at night.

Staff and customers, please be careful

Awesome place to have bubble tea and mango special drinks and desserts.

We bought watermelon slush with honey jelly and mango coconut drink.

Both are just awesome. Would really recommend to try this place.

Staff is super friendly.

The only thing you need to consider before visiting this place is parking would be an issue. As there no parking available there

The drinks are very tasty, definitely a nice refreshment. It is quiet loud in the store and hard to speak to the cashier over the glass.
Can not call to place an order for a pick up - strange. (I was able to place an order once tho)

name: Supermarché Mizan
address: 2120 Rue Guy, Montreal, Quebec H3H 2N4, Canada
reviews: I highly recommend Supermarché Mizan in Montreal. The store offers a great variety of halal products and Middle Eastern groceries. The meat is fresh and high quality, and the baby chickens are especially excellent, fresh, tender, and well prepared. The staff are friendly and helpful, and the prices are reasonable compared to many other stores.
Nice store with Arabic and Indian sub continent items. Halal meat also available and is good. Nice to have this in the downtown vicinity and close to Metro.  Parking can be tricky.

I honestly find myself coming here every few days because I just enjoy it that much. It’s become part of my routine without even realizing it. The atmosphere is so warm and welcoming, it really feels like a homey place. The staff are all incredibly kind, especially the hijabi girls at the cashier, they’re always so sweet, friendly, and make every visit feel nice. Even the management is amazing; anytime I ask about a product or suggest something new, they actually bring it in, which shows how much they care about their customers.
If I could reply to the negative comments, I honestly would, because my experience has been completely the opposite. This place is full of kind, respectful people who genuinely make an effort, and it definitely deserves appreciation.

I had a great experience at this supermarket. The store is very well stocked, you can find pretty much any product you’re looking for, which makes shopping easy and convenient.
I especially want to highlight the cashier who I believe is named Sara. She was incredibly welcoming, friendly, and attentive. She greeted customers warmly and handled everything with professionalism and a positive attitude. It really made a difference in my experience.
Excellent service overall, I will definitely be coming back!

Overall, it is an excellent grocery store with a variety of products and very clean butchery and meat.

Unfortunately and for the first time, I had a very unpleasant experience with an Iranian cashier TODAY who was not fluent in English or didn’t want to speak in English and responded in Farsi, threw the purchased stuff, including breads that even she didn’t need to touch as they don’t have a barcode to scan, delayed finalizing the purchase by talking on the phone for a non-urgent call. She didn’t bother to apologize either.

It is a shame that such unprofessional behaviour of one person affects the hard work of others.

Very disappointed with my recent purchase from Supermarché Mizan. The minced meat had a strong, unpleasant smell and did not seem fresh. After eating it, I became unwell.

This raises serious concerns about their food quality and hygiene standards. I hope management improves their quality control to prevent health risks for customer
The best Servisse customer and this store and they have a nice stuff halal food I love this and I will appreciate diya for help me find my stuff

My experience so racism towards me. I gave to vendor 10$ and she accuse me that fake money in very rude way and again asked her i will pay by card and after she said i will not sale anything to you. such a shame for this kind of person

name: MS Barbershop
address: 416 McArthur Ave., Ottawa, ON K1K 1G6, Canada
reviews:
I needed to see a barber for the first time in over 20 years due to an accident.
After walking past this place many times and hearing good things about it from a couple of neighbours, figured this would the best place to go.
I didn't have to wait at all and the gentleman sat me in the chair immediately.
The place is exceptionally clean and very well kept.
He did a great job on my hair and I was in and out of there in less than twenty five minutes.
Great friendly service and helpful did a great job! Since I will most likely need one more haircut before I can start doing it again myself, I will certainly be going back here.

i have never felt less confident about a haircut, intimidating atmosphere as well i couldn’t even really give them my 2 cents on the cut without being scared of what they’ll think. Use me as an example and do NOT come here for cuts lol. habeeb fix up bro…
Hadn't gotten a haircut in a long time. Wasn't too sure what to get. Mo was patient and encouraging, definitely my new barber from now on.

Owner operator here is awesome. Good barber, nice guy, good clean store. Reliable.

And he’s found an another good barber too so you don’t wait as long.

Good business.
Great Barbershop!! My boys got hooked and they make me drink from south keys to here!! You won't be disappointed!!
Been cutting my hair now here for over a year , very good service .
Best barbershop ever in town highly recommend, very knowledgeable and polite employees….
Worst haircut of my life! I requested and received a refund for the the amount of the haircut and not the tip. Other barbers had never seen these techniques.

name: Glamour Hair Salon and Barber shop
address: 377 Burnhamthorpe Rd E Unit 32, Mississauga, ON L5A 3Y1, Canada
reviews: Absolutely loved my wife first experience with Glamour Hair Salon. . So far it's looking amazing and I will be back for future haircut .They were very friendly and treated me so well. Thank you again

I had an absolute great experience here. Hanna understood exactly what I wanted for my hair and made sure I understood everything, she carefully walked me through and explained what she will be cutting so that I am aware how much of hair she is going to trim. That is truly someone who is passionate about what they do and care about their clients. 💕

I went for highlights on my dark hair. I wasn't sure how it will turn out as my hair has such stubborn color. However I was stunned by the transformation. Hanna was honest and upfront about the possible outcome and she showed great sincerity. I could see that Hanna was in alot of pain and could not stand comfortably ,her lovely assistant Alvira was a God sent who immediately came to help Hanna. It took almost 3 and a half hours but the results were stunning. I am moved by the truthfulness, dedication and efforts of both of the ladies. I left like a different person. Still getting compliments from friends and family. Thank you Hanna and Alvira.

Expert Hands, Effortless Layers – Hannah Delivers!

I got a haircut done recently by Hannah, and I couldn’t be happier with the result. She’s been in the industry for 28–29 years, and it really shows — her technique is flawless, and she works with such confidence and precision.
What I appreciated most was how quick she was without sacrificing quality. She knew exactly what would suit my face with the type of my hair and delivered it effortlessly. If you're looking for someone experienced, efficient, and truly talented, I highly recommend Hannah!
Thank you

Hannah is a magician!

I had extremely dry and damaged hair due to coloring and hair color had faded and become yellowish.
Like it was hideous and unmanageable.

Hannah did my root touch up, hair toning, hair mask and cut. She was very patient and gave me full attention exclusively.

Extremely happy with the results. Her hair bonding products in toner and mask really worked well for me. Hair became softer and shinier. Results have lasted even after shampooing later on.

Hannah is an expert! She knows what she is doing. And she does it well and her prices are also good comparatively.

name: Peggy's
address: 171 Advance Blvd #1, Brampton, ON L6T 4Z7, Canada
reviews:
Needed somewhere to grab a quick bite. The young lady from Canada Pneumatics recommended Peggy’s in the same plaza as them. Ordered a cheeseburger and medium coffee. Very reasonably priced. Wonderful, friendly staff and not long of a wait. The cheeseburger was SO GOOD. Nice, thick, juicy, handmade patty and with the works on it. Coffee was as ordered - nice and hot.
I highly recommend Peggy’s!🤩

I’ve been a customer for many years.
There is a lot of regular customers.
The food is really GOOD!
For Breakfast baked in-house : doughnuts, muffins, apple strudel. Along with ol’ time favourites omelette, bacon, sausages
Daily lunch specials.
Fried rice is absolutely phenomenal

Absolutely amazing!! We order fairly often here for the office and it rarely disappoints. I usually get a BLT but today got a full breakfast and I’m very happy with my order. I got a breakfast with home fries and eggs and it’s so yummy

The staff are incredibly nice and every time I’m in the store, I always hear regulars !! Great restaurant, highly recommend

This place is a hidden treasure when it comes to food & customer service. They know everyone by names it’s shocking. Soon as you walk in they great you like a friend and they even remember what you want to have. It’s insane. I give them 10+. It’s a family owned business. Must try their home chicken fingers. Great food, excellent staff
Check them out!

July 21, 2022

We had an exceptional experience at Peggy’s this morning. Definitely a restaurant in an area you wouldn’t expect it to be in!

The food was quite delicious and served fairly quick. The prices were very reasonable and the atmosphere was on the cozier side, but still ample seating.

I would absolutely come back to Peggy’s!

This was our second time at Peggy's for breakfast and we enjoyed it as much as our first time. The food is delicious, the place is small but clean and the staff are very friendly and helpful. The area is an industrial area so it's not an usual place for us to go for breakfast but we went there for the good food. I ate the breakfast with toast, pea meal bacon and eggs and my husband ate the one with 3 pieces of grilled chicken. We also had a coffee each. This time we were very happy that we got a chance to speak with the owner Peggy herself and learn about her family history, her current family and her entrepreneur zeal. She has also studied and taken the license and opened Peggy's opticals just beside her restaurant. She spoke of how much hard work is put behind the fresh cooked food that is sold at the restaurant. What also struck us as we were leaving was a plaque in the wall that was received by Peggy's this June from Sickkids for being a monthly donor for 9 long years. That is a business with a heart and I will always come back to support fabulous restaurants like this!

You know that place that's near your work and you've been going there because you love their food you love the people well Peggy's is one of the places I haven't been here since 2010. And I always got Peggy's stuff beef patty. Well today I had the time.

I came across this hidden gem today and am so glad I decided to stop by and grab lunch. This was easily one of the best clubhouse sandwiches I’ve ever had, as the chicken was shredded and plentiful (as you can see in the picture). The bacon was crispy and added a nice texture with every bite. Not to mention, the fries that came with it were golden and crispy and had me craving more! Will definitely be back as the staff were very welcoming and friendly.
