name: Thai Express Restaurant Ottawa
address: 330 W Hunt Club Rd, Ottawa, ON K2E 0B7, Canada
reviews: Hello, I came here for lunch with my girlfriend and I must say the customer service is amazing. The food is exceptional. I strongly recommend this place and the lady at the cash. Lana made our experience even better.

Google says it's open until 3am and surprisingly it is. You can even dine in that late. I asked the move man behind the counter if the spice scale was wypipo spicy or Asian spicy- he recommended a "70% spice" level if I liked things hot on the Asian scale. It was very mild. Apparently Canada spicy is way below Texan spicy which is way below Asian spicy. I think I'd order 200% next time to match 4/5 in the Thai joints I eat around the Dallas area. Good was still good. Spring roll and soup were tossed in. Spring roll obviously mass produced but decent, and the hot and sour was good as expected for a quick fire Asian food place. Great service, decent food, eating space nothing special but clean. Would come again for late night munchies.
Terrible portions compared to other locations. Very sad. Buyer beware. Update: no remeditian is offered after they "reached out" Still awful. Beware.

Great location, and lots of parking spots around. The food was very delicious. We ordered 2 general Thai chicken, 1 chicken pad sew, and 1 chicken pad.Thai. Hubby and I both enjoyed the food a lot and there were a lot of leftovers. We used a buy 3, get 1 free coupon so the final bill came to $36 including tax. Also, the cashier lady was super friendly and polite. I'll definitely go back again.

This was our first time to this location of Thai Express.
I would give them 5 stars on customer service and friendliness, note that there was one person ahead of us one behind us and we had a pretty large order of 7 meals coming to over $80.
Given the size of the order, it did not that long to receive our food.
It looked like they were doing renovations at the time as the side walls had exposed plywood.
I give the food a high 3 or low 4. We have been to number of other Thai Express locations and the food here was meh, not as good and tasty as others.
The friendly cashier offered us some treats as our order was so large, unfortunately I feel it was the left overs for the day as the quality of the food was below par (dumplings, wings, spring rolls and the deep fried bananas). It was still nice if her to offer.

As always, portion size was perfect as we all got a meal and a half out of it.

This Thai Express really stands out in terms of customer service and employee kindness. We go every few months and no matter who is working, service is 10/10. They hustle when it’s busy and the food always slaps
Harman at this Thai Express location is awesome! Very friendly, fast, and made sure my order was perfect. Definitely made my meal better. Thanks:)

My favourite Thai Express location in the city. The portions are always fresh and filled to the max, and the customers service is excellent. I like how clean the dine in area is as well. I always look forward to coming.

name: THE CORNER ROOM — Award Winning Boutique Hair Salon
address: 1403 King St E, Hamilton, ON L8M 1H7, Canada
reviews:
I have been seeing Bronté for years and followed her to The Corner Room from her previous salon.

From the first day I met her, I felt so comfortable in her chair, and it was like talking to an old friend from the start. She is extremely friendly and bubbly, and has a gift of making people feel welcome and comfortable. She is the only person I trust to touch my hair! She has done several different colours/highlights etc. on my hair over the years and I have always been blown away. I have naturally very curly hair and have never been disappointed with my cut. She is truly an artist.

The Corner Room overall is a nice space and feels welcoming and chill.

I have been going to Bronté at The Corner Room for over a year now for both cut and colour, and she makes me feel amazing everytime. My friends (and strangers) often ask me where I get my hair done, and I always happily recommend Bronté!

Okay, I've been avoiding this as I don't like giving bad reviews, but it's necessary. In September 10 I had a haircut booked with Chelsey, and she pretty much ruined my hair. She was incredibly lovely, sweet, and professional. This has nothing to do with her personally or the way I got treated, is about the service they provide that did not meet what I asked.

From beginning I said how nervous I was, how I had terrible experiences with people cutting my curly hair and not doing what I wanted, so she assured me she had experience with textured hair, and suggested this curly cut, where they cut your hair wet, following the curl patterns. She seemed like she knew what she was doing, and I trusted it. What I asked for was cascade effect layers, not too close to each other in the front so it doesn't get too puffy. I even said I don't mind if the first layer is a bit shorter- close to my chin- as long as they have some distance between them to create that cascade effect.

And instead, this is what I got. No shape whatsoever, the front layer somehow is longer than a few in the back. I have no idea what she did, but is not what I asked for.
I strained the hair to show the cut I got, but when I see it natural, I want to cry. It took me so long to grow it back from the previous haircut I got, and now I'll have to do it all over again.
I'm an actor, I had headshots booked that I had to cancel, my birthday that was 2 weeks after this appointment, I had my hair up on a ponytail and avoided taking pictures.
I got a refund from this chewed up cut I got, but this should stay there as a warning for wavy/curly hair girls. For the price they charge, this is unacceptable.

I’ve been a client for a while now and I truly can’t say enough good things. Thank you, Bronte! This time she dyed my hair red and WOW—it’s perfect. The tone is vibrant but still classy, and my hair feels healthy and shiny. It has taken me a long time to find a salon where I feel safe and welcome, and not judged. Bronte and all other staff always takes their time, explains everything, and makes sure I’m comfortable with the process. You can tell she genuinely cares about her clients and her work. If you’re thinking about booking with her, do it, you won’t regret it!
I booked with Bronté(@thefoilfairy). She is absolutely amazing at what she does! I was listened to and safe in her care! Left with exactly what I wanted and my hair looks great :)

I don’t often leave reviews but I’m pretty disappointed with the haircut I got from the owner of the salon itself. I went in wanting an intro into curtain bangs, with Sherrai knowing that I leave my hair to airdry as it has a wavy texture. My hair feels just chopped. There is so much short hair, pretty far back on my head and it looks ridiculous when it air dries as well as when I style it. I’m not sure how the owner of a salon can be so careless with a dramatic hair change like this. I’m very upset as this is going to be a nightmare to manage and those locks of hair far back on my head will take about 6 months to get to a reasonable length and work with my hair texture and pattern. Again, this is something the owner should have been mindful of. I’ve contacted the salon expressing how upset I am and I haven’t heard back from anyone. I tipped while my hair was fully salon styled and it hid these errors. Out 140$ and avoiding mirrors for a while.

Last February I had a haircut done by Sherrai. I asked for curtain bangs and a lob - longer in the front, shorter in the back - a shaped lob if you will.
I left thinking it looked ok but went to another salon for a colour with someone I trusted and she asked what happened with my hair and why it looked like it did at the back. It was longer at the back, shorter at the front with weird layers - kind of like a mullet. I went back to have the back fixed but it didn’t look much better. Then the nightmare of trying to style the mess of it began. She thinned the layers around my face taking the curtain bangs back further than they should have been. It took a year for me to grow the weird layers back to a length where I could get a good cut again. My original stylist is definitely worth the drive back to Mississauga every 6 weeks.
Why review over a year later? Because a new friend of mine had the same thing happen to her when she went to Sherrai a few days ago. This is not acceptable. Two similar experiences with the owner of the salon? Please do better.

Highly recommend! All of the team members are beyond talented. Bobbie-Jean is a master of her craft. I tried bangs for the first time, and she styled them with complete perfection. Thank you very much for your fantastic service!

reviews: Jasmine Bakery is absolutely amazing! The food is fresh, delicious, and full of authentic flavor. Everything we tried was excellent, and you can really tell they care about the quality of their products. The staff is friendly and welcoming, and the service is great.

I pulled over into this strip mall to google close by restaurants for my dinner, didn't even realize that I was parked rite outside this hidden gem... the owner was very friendly and gave ne free samples to try while i waited for my shawarma to cook. Not being sarcastic at all when I day I am very impressed with the freshness and flavors of both the pastries and the shawarma...I wish I got 2! Lol
Very good, different than most ither shawarmas aroubd in a good way, ill defianetly be comming back.

I love small businesses when the owner thrives to make their customers happy, I would recommend this to anybody wanting to try something new and delicious. 5 stars

:)

First time visiting Jasmine bakery it was a quick decision googled closest meat pie store and this one came up and I must say it was a fantastic meat and cheese. I will be back. Thank you again and love the atmosphere and the water fountain feature in the middle, it’s a little far distance for me to get to, but the drive would be very much worth it.

Kind personnel, and delicious baked goods.

Nicely decorated interior

First time trying this place and it’s amazing! Probably the tastiest and most unique meat pie in the city. My husband went and picked some up to go and he said the service was also amazing (really kind people). Ottawa folks, this place is a must try!
An excellent bakery with consistently delicious products across the board. The standout is the Meat Shamia Safiha—tender, flavorful meat topped with rich pomegranate sauce. Easily the best in Ottawa!

The decor is definitely amazing, one of the bets decorated pies shop in the city.. service super friendly and kind generous as well. They miss calculated the pies I ordered so got me one for free! I haven’t gone through all of them, cheese was super oily and not as cheesy as I hoped. Loved the idea of musakhan pie and the 2 meat options .. on top of it all, their dough is nice and thin! Wish them all the best.. if you are in the area definitely check them out!

The most authentic Syrian manaqish in the whole city of Ottawa،This is a wonderful family bakery which welcomes all and works with fresh ingredients to produce authentic and very flavourable  cuisine ،Amazing vegan grapes leaves and their cheese pies are absolutely delicious!!!The taste is amazing and the freshness is unbeatable. Most of the time your meal will be coming straight out of the oven right in front of you. The seating area is small but A beautiful and calm،you need to try them.

reviews:
Small, cute little bakery with a lot of options. We especially loved the tart  and the chocolate croissant, and we also took some cream cheese buns and tiramisu home. Everything was exceptionally good.  They were not too sweet, but they had a yummy taste to it.

Very welcoming atmosphere and storefront! Great selection of pastries (will try a tart and cream cheese bun one day!), the chocolate croissant was one of the softest things I have ever had. I imagine this shop would be amazing in the summertime, and the cashier was the sweetest 🥐🍰

Worth checking out if you are in the area.

This café is lovely! It truly feels like being at home rather than in a public place. The Asian lady is incredibly friendly, caring, and kind. They offer a great variety of fresh pastries, and everything here feels so cozy and comforting.

One of the cleanest and highest quality barber shops in the area. The staff are friendly, punctual, and the workmanship is truly excellent. I highly recommend it🙏🏼
The only place you need to go in Montreal is for a fantastic haircut; customer satisfaction is high, and the staff are friendly. Try it; I was very pleased.
I've been looking for a barber who would give me a good haircut for months. I finally found him. I recommend him to everyone.🫵🏻🙏
I've tried a lot of barbers so far, but this place is different from all of them. They can do cuts of any style and produce excellent results upon request. This is my new go-to barber from now on.

Hana K is absolutely amazing! Always so friendly, providing top-notch service every single time. Her cuts are honestly the best, and the vibes at this place are unbeatable. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a fantastic experience!

Hana is the best! She’s cut my hair in various styles over the years. Fade, buzzcut or more elaborate.

name: Kim's Convenience
address: 252 Queen St E, Toronto, ON M5A 1S7, Canada
reviews: When in Toronto, you pay respect where respect is due and if you enjoyed this TV series as much as I did, you go visit the convenience store that brought us CBC’s Kim’s Convenience! The owners are so so friendly and happy to answer any questions about the show! The store has everything you would find in a convenience store and more. I, of course, purchased several items and got a bag! #okseeyou!

This should be a part of the Toronto tourist experience, as this is the actual store that inspired the Netflix show with the same name. The area around this store is very sketchy, however there is a large police parking lot behind the store. Exactly as per the show, the store is owned by a Korean family, who take turns to run the store. Met with the lady who was super nice and shared a lot of information about the show. There is a full section on the wall with pictures of the store owner with the cast of the Netflix show.
Overall this is a typical neighborhood convenience store that is fully stocked and what’s even best is that nothing is overpriced. They are also selling the store branded T Shirts and reusable cloth bags. Enjoyed my visit to the store and chat with the owner lady.
of the store is such a wonderful amazing lady who
Love this show, and now it was super cool to see it in person! They sell tote bags for $4! 😊

For anyone who loves the show, this is a no brainer place to visit. Visit during the day time as the surrounding area is a little sketchy. I never felt unsafe, but it’s just a heads up so you know what to expect.

The store itself is tiny but well stocked and the lady behind the counter (I assume she is the owner) was very friendly and welcoming. I bought a souvenir shirt (unfortunately, she only had size small left but bought one anyway) and she put it in a complimentary Kim’s Convenience bag.

Overall, it’s a fun and quick no brainer side visit!

The store is clean and well-stocked with a great selection of useful goods. The owner is very kind and made us feel welcomed on our first day visiting Toronto. The owner, my family, and I bonded over our Korean heritage. He is very humble and generous.
The owner also shared some fun facts about the actors from the show "Kim's Convenience Store". Visiting the store was the highlight of my time in Canada.

For fans of Kim’s Convenience TV show, this is a must visit in Toronto. Stopped in today and bought a few snacks. Will be flying back to San Francisco tomorrow, where we will be seeing the ACT production of Kim‘s cConvenience, the play.

As a fan of Kim Convenience, I enjoyed visiting and taking pictures of the store from inside and outside. It was located just a few mins down from the hotel. I even purchased a T-shirt as a souvenir and a bag!

Ok, so yet another Aussie tourist seeks out this store for the novelty factor after enjoying the Kim's Convenience series on Netflix. Obviously only the external shots were filmed here but you could see the influence of the interior too. The real 'Mrs Kim' who works there was very friendly and not bothered by our questions and photo taking (so long as you take photos of the shop without her in it). Thankyou for being a good sport. "okay, seeyou!!"

reviews: Absolutely loved shopping here! The collection of lehengas was stunning with beautiful designs, great quality, and perfect fitting options. The staff was very helpful, patient, and made the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. I found exactly what I was looking for at a reasonable price. Highly recommend this store for anyone looking for elegant ethnic wear and bridal outfits! ✨

Walking into this store felt like stepping into a designer fashion dream ✨
Every lehenga had its own charm — elegant, royal, and beautifully crafted. The staff understood exactly what I wanted and helped me pick an outfit that made me feel confident and special. Amazing collection, premium quality, and a shopping experience that truly stands out. Can’t wait to shop here again! 👑💫

I purchased several outfits from here for my niece’s wedding and other events, including her engagement, and I couldn’t be happier. The quality of the suits is truly high-end and exceeded my expectations. The customer service is exceptional unlike anything I’ve experienced elsewhere. The owners are incredibly knowledgeable and helped guide me on choosing the right materials based on my preferences. I highly recommend this shop to anyone looking for premium clothing and outstanding service.

We came here in search of a sangeet and reception outfit for my mom and sister. The staff was kind and helpful. They have a great selection of outfits to browse through. We ended up finding both outfits and were pleasantly surprised by the entire service, the cost, and the fact that they have an in-house tailor, which made our lives easier. Definitely will be back in the future if we need any other outfits.

I had a truly delightful experience shopping at JK Fashion. The selection of clothing was absolutely stunning, with a wide variety of styles to choose from. The quality of the garments I purchased exceeded my expectations, and they feel wonderfully comfortable to wear. I was particularly impressed with the attentive and friendly customer service I received. I wholeheartedly recommend JK Fashion for anyone seeking stylish and well-made apparel.

I recently purchased a beautiful suit from JK Fashions, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. The customer service was excellent, and everyone was so kind and helpful. A special thank you to the tailor aunty, who did an amazing job with the alterations the fit was absolutely perfect. I highly recommend JK Fashions for their beautiful clothing and outstanding service!

I had such a wonderful experience with JK Fashion! They created a beautiful custom lehenga for my sister’s jaggo, and it turned out even better than I imagined. From the very beginning, they really took the time to understand exactly what I wanted, and their attention to detail truly shows in the final outfit. The design, stitching, and overall quality are absolutely stunning.

I was especially impressed with how quickly everything was completed without sacrificing quality at all. The entire process was smooth and stress-free, and their customer service was exceptional everyone was so friendly, helpful, and professional throughout.

I’m beyond excited to wear my lehenga and can’t wait to show it off at the event! I’ve received so many compliments already. I will definitely be coming back to JK Fashion for future outfits and highly recommend them to anyone looking for custom pieces. Thank you again for such an amazing experience!

I had an amazing experience at this store. I bought a beautiful lehanga and also two outfits for my mother and sister which I sent to India. Even they loved the outfits and especially quality. Staff is very cooperative and assisting.I would surely recommend to everyone looking for Indian wear in GTA.

name: Hair Treatment and Spa Mtl
address: 1455 Rue de l'Église, Saint-Laurent, QC H4L 2H5, Canada
reviews:
The pictures show my natural hair, my hair right after the treatment (March 27), and how it looks now (April 8) both immediately after washing and air-drying, and after sleeping.

For maintenance, I use a sulfate-free shampoo and conditioner, and I apply a bit of oil to the ends after air-drying. My hair is naturally thin and wavy slavic type, so it’s usually hard to keep it looking smooth and hydrated. This treatment made a huge difference for me.

The price is reasonable,they use organic products, which is a big plus. The effect is supposed to last up to a year. I just had the treatment, so I can’t confirm yet, but my colleague said hers lasted about a year (she has naturally straight hair).

A big thank you to Dyhia, she was incredibly patient and very thorough. We spent about 5 hours on my hair, and it was my first time doing this kind of treatment, so I really appreciated her care.

A colleague at work recommended this place, and I’m really glad I did it. So far, so good. I feel much more confident now 💛
I'm so happy with my hair botox treatment! My hair is noticeably softer, shinier, and much easier to manage. Great service and a wonderful experience!

Very professional and friendly service. They were extremely patient and took great care with my hair throughout the entire appointment. I got the protein straightening treatment, and the results were amazing. My hair was left feeling incredibly silky, and shiny.

The only thing I'd mention is that the appointment took quite a bit longer than the 3 hours I was initially told. If you have long and thick hair like mine, I'd recommend keeping the rest of your day free, as it may take longer than expected. But the results are 100% worth it. I would definitely recommend this salon!

I recently went back to this salon for a protein smoothing treatment, and once again, I had an amazing experience. The team is very professional, kind, and understanding, making you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in.I first came here about two years ago, and I was so impressed with the results that I decided to return. Not only did my hair look incredibly smooth and beautiful, but it was also noticeably healthier after the treatment.I am extremely happy with the results and highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for quality hair treatments and excellent service. 100% recommended!

Amazing experience! They really listened to what I wanted and recommended the perfect treatment for my hair. My hair feels so soft and healthy, and I loved their professionalism and follow-up after the treatment. I’m very happy with the results and will definitely be coming back! 🙌🏻

I came all the way from Michigan to get my hair treatment done here, and I can honestly say it was 100% worth the trip! From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and taken care of. The treatment was absolutely amazing, and I’m so happy with how my hair turned out. My hair feels healthier, smoother, shinier, and looks so beautiful!

You can truly tell that they care about their work and take the time to make sure everything is done perfectly. I wouldn’t hesitate to make the trip from Michigan again. If you’re considering booking an appointment, DO IT—you won’t regret it! Highly recommend! ❤️

Had an amazing experience getting a protein silk hair treatment! The staff was so patient and polite throughout the entire process. My hair feels absolutely incredible now. Thank you for the great service—I will definitely be back!
Couldn’t recommend more!!! I’ve been getting my hair done for a couple of years now and keep coming back because of the amazing results of the treatment and the professional and kind staff.

name: Gerrard St. Bakery
address: 635 Gerrard St E, Toronto, ON M4M 1Y2, Canada
reviews:
I had the best time picking up some treats from this spot on Gerrard Street. Everything looked so fresh and inviting sitting on the shelves.

I picked up one of their lovely tarts and some of their handmade cookies. The quality is truly impressive. It is rare to find such a charming local bakery that puts so much care into their presentation. I will definitely be back for more soon.

Came back again, with fingers crossed, hoping that they still make that Buttertart-Nanaimo bar thing that I loved so much years ago. I didn't see it right away and my heart sank.

But then, all I had to do was ask, and there it was! I just hadn't seen it. My beautiful, delicious baby.

And, it's maybe even better than it used to be.

Staff are amazing, baked goods are awesome, butter tarts are the best in the area. I'm so glad this place is still around. It deserves that 5-star now.

Original review (2020), 4-stars:

Decided to check this place out and they sure have some good sweets! The atmosphere is a bit odd (it feels bare and a bit dark inside?), but no ones really coming here for ambience. We got every kind of tart, plus the Eh! Bar and a chocolate cake. I'm not entirely sold on the raspberry or apple crumble tarts, but I do appreciate the different tart crust than usual. The chocolate cake is flourless so once you get over the slightly different texture/dryness, the flavour is great. The lemon tart is deceivingly lemony and it's great too. The butter tarts are different than I'm used to but that's a good thing, it turns out! I loved the bit of crunch, and the distinct flavour. It's got such a perfect texture and flavour balance. My favourite however is their Eh bar, a mix between a Nanaimo bar and butter tart! Fantastic!! And awesome prices too! Only $3 for a good sized Eh bar! I am definitely going to come back.

I recommend it if you're in the area, and even if you're not but looking for a good buttertart or to try the Eh bar! :D

Gerrard St. Bakery makes an excellent butter tart! The crust is a perfect soft texture, and I like how they don't overdo the filling — you get a nice mouthful from each bite, but it isn't overwhelming. This is a good butter tart for people who usually don't like them because there's too much filling.

I am a returning customer who has been buying her birthday cakes for friends at the Gerrard St Bakery for about 4 years.
I usually stick to the smaller cakes: recently I was able to delight one of my friends by getting his 2 favourite flavours when he couldn't decide.🤣
This week I collected my first big cake and it was a huge hit. 🥳
Thank you for your magic, creativity and hard work, Gerrard St Bakers! ✨️✨️✨️

The lemon tart was perfectly balanced. Not overly sweet or sour. The brownie was incredibly rich and had perfect texture. Both were the best I've had!

The solo lady working was also very friendly.

name: Taste of Amritsar
address: 27 Main St N, Brampton, ON L6X 1M8, Canada
reviews: Tried this place recently and had a really good experience. The tawa parathas were amazing, especially the aloo paratha—it genuinely reminded me of home. The kulchas were really good too. Overall, the food was delicious, but what made the experience even better was Simar. He was very welcoming, helped us choose our order, and made us feel comfortable. Will definitely be coming back!

Best ever kulcha we had in Brampton so far, we went with our friends (Kirat and Naman recommended this place) and truly it was delicious and crunchy. Ras malai I would not prefer to have again from here but yeah for kulcha with desi ghee definitely going again. Owner was very welcoming and some of us wanted it less spicy and he served accordingly. Please do parking behind this food court, there was 2 hour free parking. On front it is bit difficult to park

Delicious Kulcha Chole! 😍

Had the kulcha chole from Taste of Amritsar and absolutely loved it! The kulchas were crispy, flavorful, and the chole was delicious. Great taste and satisfying portions. Definitely worth trying!

I have had quite a few kulcha, but this is my first Amritsar Kulcha. It was good. Tucked away in a little food court, there was a little line, and it’s worth the wait. Not too expensive and a large portion.
The food is so good: Soya Nutri curry is so tasty, chole is just average, Kulcha is too good. Tandoori Paneer is awesome. The Kulcha could have been more bigger.

I am extremely disappointed with my experience.

I booked a digital perm after a consultation where I specifically requested very loose curls. I paid approximately CAD 400 for the service and followed all of the aftercare instructions, including waiting 48 hours before washing my hair.

Unfortunately, after my first wash and once my hair was completely dry, the result was largely straight with significant frizz and very little visible curl. It did not resemble the result I had discussed during my consultation or what I would reasonably expect from a professional digital perm.

I returned to the salon to give them the opportunity to assess my hair in person. During the assessment, they dampened my hair and pointed out that a curl pattern was visible when the hair was wet, particularly at the back, and concluded that the perm had been successful. However, my concern was never how my hair looked while wet—it was how it looked once dry, which is how I have to wear it every day. The front of my hair had little to no visible curl when wet, and once dry the overall result remained mostly straight and frizzy.

The salon acknowledged in writing that the final dry result did not fully meet my expectations, but maintained that the chemical process had technically worked and therefore refused to consider it a failed service. Their final offer was a 30% goodwill refund, which I did not feel fairly reflected the outcome.

I appreciate that they took the time to see me again and assess my hair. However, I am disappointed that the focus was on whether the chemical process technically "took" rather than whether the service actually delivered the result that was discussed and paid for.

I am sharing my experience so that future clients understand that, if the final result does not match what was agreed upon, the salon may still consider the service successful if the hair shows a curl pattern while wet.

name: Mezzaluna Bakery & Pastry
address: 585 Montréal Rd, Ottawa, ON K1K 4K4, Canada
reviews:
Our breakfast at Mezzaluna Bakery was nothing short of enchanting. Its name means “half-moon” in Italian, and each golden, crescent-shaped pastry felt like a little piece of the moon—delicate, beautiful, and almost too perfect to disturb.

From the moment we arrived, the staff welcomed us with such genuine warmth and sweetness that we immediately felt at home. Every creation was prepared with remarkable care, melting effortlessly in the mouth and carrying us on a wonderful culinary journey with each bite.

The pecan cinnamon rolls were soft, rich, and irresistible, while the spinach and artichoke croissant was delicately savoury and bursting with flavour. The mushroom truffle croissant was aromatic and indulgent, and the cheese croissant was buttery, comforting, and baked to perfection.

For something sweeter, the cookie dough croissant was an absolute delight. Even the classic plain croissant was extraordinary—flaky, airy, and beautifully layered—while the pain au chocolat offered the perfect harmony of delicate pastry and rich chocolate.

Their coffee is equally impressive: smooth, aromatic, and clearly made with high-quality beans. They also sell their beans, making it possible to take a little of the Mezzaluna experience home with you.

Everything at Mezzaluna feels thoughtfully crafted and made with passion. Like its beautiful half-moon name, this Ottawa gem shines with warmth, artistry, and a little touch of magic. We cannot recommend it highly enough.

Mezzaluna is an Ottawa gem that's hidden in plain sight.  Easily one of the best pastry spots in the city, with a wide selection of exquisite desserts.  Then there's the bakery, with daily made fresh breads that can easily compete with world-class bakeries.

Seating is limited, but it adds to the cosy atmosphere of the place. From beautiful floor tiles to European café style walls, the space is welcoming, and the customer service is top notch.  The staff are very friendly and proud of the pastry and baked goods offered, so they answer your questions with passion and a smile.

I highly recommend trying Mezzaluna.  It has a very hight Google Maps rating for a reason.

The pictures look so good and it turns out, in person is even better!! We tried a croissant, pistachio NY roll and a slice of basque cheese cake! The cheesecake was rich and light at the same time. Not too sweet and satisfying. The croissant looked stunning and tasted as good with a creamy filling. The pistachio NY roll rounded out the experience nicely as each selection was different and all excellent! Added to our favourites list and planning our next visit!!

Mushroom Truffle Danish - oh man, I’m a savoury girl and this hit the spot!!!
Spinach and Artichoke Croissant - layers of flakey pastry and a delicious filling.

Plus, the staff were all incredibly friendly with warm smiles! Will definitely be stopping in on a regular basis!!

A Must-Visit Gem!

Everything I sampled was exceptional, with fresh, high-quality ingredients and expert craftsmanship. Whether you're looking for something sweet or savory, they have clearly mastered their craft. I’m already looking forward to my next visit!

The cheesecake is the best I’ve had in Ottawa, rich and perfectly balanced. The sourdough bread is soft with an amazing crust, and the croissants are flaky, buttery, and absolutely delicious. If you’re searching for a must-visit bakery in Ottawa for fresh sourdough, croissants, and desserts, this is it. Highly recommend.

Who knew I love thrifting? I was dragged there by my teenage daughter but i ended up loving the place as much more than her. Found great vintage bags and 1970 oversized sunglasses. I love the store so much that we went back again the morning before we catch our flight back. home. Also love the decoration of the place, is cozy with good lighting, good smells ( not to be a snob but i hate the smells of some thrift stores). The owners Feliz and Owen were super friendly. too. Good job guys, will visit again next time we are in town :)

Recently visited Courage My Love for the first time while visiting Toronto for a couple days and had such a lovely time at this shop!
Went in hoping to find a new sterling silver ring to add to my collection and came out with 2 gorgeous pieces that I will be wearing all the time now!
If you are looking for good quality jewelry or rings in particular, definitely check this place out. The woman who helped us was also super friendly and extremely helpful in guiding my partner and I while we shopped at the jewelry counter. She really made our experience a great one :)
Aside from the awesome jewelry, they also have some very nice clothing pieces and various other treasures to browse through as well.
Overall I would highly recommend this shop it is absolutely lovely, the staff are so kind and helpful and the vibe is just so cool!
I will definitely visit again in the future to purchase some more gorgeous rings.

Beautiful store I was really looking forward to visiting on my trip to TO, left very disappointed.

Shortly before we were finished browsing the staff seemed to be preparing to close- I would have appreciated if they'd said something to us rather than silently putting out a "get out" vibe.

When we were rung up, my friend and I's totals were both significantly higher than what we'd expected, but we just paid and left. Upon looking at the receipts we were both charged amounts way higher than the listed price, when the beads were mainly advertised as $1 or less. For a 4-set of buttons ($5.50, the most expensive item I picked up), five button pins, a locket ($4), and four beads, I was charged $45. I was wondering how they'd know how much everything is at the cash, but it seems they just make up whatever price they feel like. I know none of my items matched the $9 or $12 charges on the receipt. I regret not speaking up at the time. Shady business, I will absolutely not be returning.

reviews:
I have never done anything on my hair other than a basic haircut, so having a perm is something I was extremely nervous about.
But, with Olivia's knowledge and years of experience, she made me comfortable. I mean, look at the pictures. Her pricing are reasonable. she takes time explaining the process, styling and taking care of the perm. She never rushes you out. Beautiful location as well. Would highly recommend!
Olivia really did a great job to what Ive requested! Not too short and just right! She even explained how to take care of your hair and how to style it! Will definitely keep coming back!

Not only am I getting an amazing hair cut (for an affordable price!) - Olivia has been sharing so much hair care advice with me every time I visit that my hair has gotten so healthy and long! She is so incredible that I’ve been bringing all my family members to visit her one by one. So happy to have found you Olivia ❤️
Olivia did a great job transforming my hair from flat and heavy to now having life and texture. Thank you Olivia, will be returning. 👍🏼
Late review but I got a perm for the first time and Olivia did not disappoint! She gave me pointers on how to maintain it. Great service and would give 10 stars if I can

Amazing salon I went to for the first time, knew how to work with Asian hair.

Would recommend if you live near the area or are looking for a new stylist to try out.

She was very polite and ensured I liked my cut before she chopped it off ^^ will definitely come back here

I have been coming here ever since I was a little kid, also during high school and after I graduated, I have been coming to oliva to get my perm re done, and she always kills it, especially with the consistency and how she handles your hair to your desired look and finish, olivas customer service is outstanding, would recommend her to anyone!!!

Absolutely loved the haircut experience! The stylist really listened to what I wanted and gave great suggestions too. The haircut turned out even better than I expected — clean, stylish, and easy to manage. The staff was friendly, the place was neat, and the overall vibe was super comfortable.✂️ Highly recommend!

reviews:
If you want a barber that cares about the finer details, this is your stop. Haircut, beard, hot towel, eyebrow threading, face mask and hair wash everything included for a great price.
He’s a young shop owner that’s on track to do great things with his business. You’ll leave the shop happy with what you paid for.

"Top-notch service and a great atmosphere. The precision and skill of the stylists here are impressive. If you're looking for a fresh, clean cut in Hamilton, this is the place to go. 5 stars!

Mast hair cut Kare che
Must visit.....
First time customer here and I was blown away by the haircut. I gave them an idea and they absolutely nailed it. Totally worth it, and I'll definitely be back.
Great cut by a nice young man starting his own business, highly recommend supporting him and going for quality cut.

Have been looking for a reliable quality saloon in Hamilton which gives more than a hair cut. Finally found these great guy Mohammad and Ahmed. Their men full grooming package is incredibly affordable and quality and takes full care of everything. Loved kid cuts too. Highly recommend these guys.
Great service!! Got a perfect haircut i had in my mind. Affordable prices too.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ MORE THAN 5 STARS!

I recently chose this wonderful little family-run barbershop in Hamilton, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience.

No fuss, no muss — just great old-fashioned service, genuine hospitality, and excellent work from two outstanding young Syrian gentlemen, Mohamed & Ahmed.

From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed and appreciated. And with the Syrian music playing in the background, I almost felt like I had been transported straight to Syria! 🇸🇾🎶

There was such an abundance of warmth and hospitality — the kind that makes you feel less like a customer and more like an invited guest.

Mohamed & Ahmed were friendly, professional, attentive, and clearly take tremendous pride in their work and in treating people well. My experience was easily MORE than 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐+

I’m especially happy to support a hardworking local family-run business and two young gentlemen building their future here in Hamilton.

I highly recommend Mohamed & Ahmed to anyone looking for excellent service, genuine hospitality, and a barbershop experience with some real heart and soul.

You’ve definitely earned a new loyal customer! 💈❤️👏

“I had such a wonderful experience at Chatime! The vibes were so great and beautiful, making it a really enjoyable place to relax. The staff greeted me warmly and made me feel welcome right away. My drink was absolutely perfect—just the way I like it.

name: Laila’s Hair & Beauty
address: 565 Queenston Rd, Hamilton, ON L8K 1J7, Canada
reviews: Laila is absolutely amazing! A hijabi friendly salon is difficult to find, and I’m so happy to have trusted her with my hair. It really needed love, and she transformed it into a beautiful style that made me instantly feel more confident. I will definitely come back!

I rarely leave reviews, but after my experience with Laila, I felt compelled to share.

For years I have been very cautious about who touches my hair because it had been chemically damaged and over-processed. When my regular hairstylist cancelled on me yet again, I decided to take a chance and walk into Laila's Hair & Beauty. Looking back, it was one of the best decisions I've made.

Laila took the time to assess the condition of my hair and recommended a combination of highlights and lowlights that turned out absolutely beautiful. The colour is natural, rich, and expertly blended. She also suggested a new haircut and style that suits me perfectly and is incredibly easy to manage.

What has impressed me most is the condition of my hair a week later. Normally, after colour services, my hair feels dry and fragile. Instead, it feels healthier, softer, and stronger than it has in years. It honestly looks and feels better than I ever expected.

Laila is talented, knowledgeable, professional, and clearly passionate about what she does. She has earned a client for life, and I can confidently say she is now my hairstylist of choice.

Thank you, Laila, for giving me beautiful, healthy hair and restoring my confidence!

Laila truly has an incredible eye for detail and style! I had such a wonderful experience and would 100% recommend her! I called feeling desperate for a haircut, and she was so kind to fit me in within an hour 🥲 That alone meant so much to me.

As a hijabi, I’ve been searching for a place where I feel completely comfortable and understood for years, and I finally found it. Laila creates such a respectful, welcoming, and safe environment where you can truly relax and trust her work.
She is not only talented but also genuinely kind and professional. I left feeling confident and so happy with my new look.

Highly recommend Laila if you’re looking for someone who truly knows how to bring out your best.

Thank you so much Laila Jan,I really appreciate your kindness and amazing work❤️❤️

I’ve been to this hair salon twice now, and it has been a great experience both times. Laila is a lovely person—very accommodating and attentive. She listens to exactly what you want and is truly skilled at what she does. I also really appreciated her positive attitude and the helpful advice she gave me for hair care at home. I will definitely keep coming back. Thank you, Laila!

I recently had such a wonderful experience at Laila’s Hair & Beauty and I truly felt it deserved a glowing review!

From the moment I walked in, Laila welcomed me with warmth and genuine kindness. The atmosphere is clean, relaxing, and beautifully set up—it instantly made me feel comfortable and cared for.

What truly stood out was Laila herself. With her many years of experience in the beauty industry, her expertise is immediately noticeable. She takes the time to listen carefully, understands exactly what you need, and works with such confidence and precision. You can really tell she has a deep passion for her work and a strong commitment to her clients.

The results exceeded my expectations—everything was done with care, skill, and attention to detail. I left feeling confident, refreshed, and very happy with the outcome.

If you’re looking for someone highly experienced, professional, and genuinely dedicated, I highly recommend Laila. I will definitely be coming back! ✨

Laila is such a professional and experienced individual who is also very kind,  warm and friendly.  She makes sure she knows exactly what you are looking to achieve and asks questions and pays attention to details to ensure client is absolutely satisfied.  I have done many services with her and she never disappointed me.  She discusses charges openly from the very beginning so there are no surprises.  I like getting my hair cut,  color and keratin   with her because I know my head and and hair are both in the safest hands.  I am looking forward to my next visit this week.  Thank you Laila!
She is a wonderful person!! We had some amazing chats. My hair…I was blessed. The best haircut I’ve ever had, and with an amazing person :) THANK YOU!

Laila is so wonderful she is very friendly and does exactly what you ask for if possible. I had an amazing experience here back in September and will be returning for a trim and shaping. For context of what my hair was like before the hair cut it was very long hair and was extremely tangled and matted. She did a phenomenal job and I really appreciated her patience.

reviews:
Gong Cha never disappoints and this location is no exception. Great selection of drinks, nice clean space inside and the staff were friendly and efficient. Really convenient spot too, right next to the metro station which makes it an easy stop whether you’re coming or going.

Solid bubble tea in a well placed location, hard to ask for more.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

First time visiting GongCha Mont Royal and I absolutely loved it! The aesthetic is minimalist and super cute. The staff were incredibly kind and friendly—they gave us amazing drink suggestions. I mentioned I love coconut, and they recommended the taro coconut with crème brûlée on top and oat milk since I’m lactose intolerant. I also tried their croffles—one with cold foam and one with crème brûlée—and WOW. So good, I was genuinely jaw-dropped. Both were 5/5!

Overall, a wonderful GongCha experience with top-notch customer service. Highly recommend!

Amazing spot to try bubble teas and other types of drinks we also tried the croffles its pressed croissants with garnishes on top and pancake like items which are very delicious, make sure to check them out if you are nearby!

Thanks to the cashier Raf he was very helpful and nice when we were served!
I love their strawberry matcha. Everytime. There are a few strawberry chunks at the bottom and its always good.

Brand new, clean and nice bubble tea place. Staff is nice and helpful. I tried the Croffles (croissant cook in waffle machine) and brown sugar bubble milk tea (one of their bestseller). The croffle surprisingly nice, warm, fluffy and make the whole place smell so good. I should try the cold drink instead of hot, since the hot drink is nothing special compare to other places. Overall, it’s a nice experience.
Great experience. Very welcoming location, friendly staff, comfortable, warm and inviting seating. I love the collaboration with other brands!

No line up.
Friendly service
Super cute place.
They had no problem making me a sugar free bubble tea and it was  good!!

Will definitely  go back to try more stuff

The service was great everybody was so willing to help and find the correct sizing no matter the time, the prices on the other hand are also very well chosen, and lastly the massive variety of kurta's and suits helps you with weddings and anything else you need.

Experience with George was amazing! I came in with images and vocalized some of my concerns with past haircuts and he immediately understood my vision and what I was going for. Well worth and will be coming here regularly after trying different salons in Toronto. Thanks again!

name: Bitten Cupcakes, Butter Tarts & Cookie Tacos
address: 219 Locke St S, Hamilton, ON L8P 4B6, Canada
reviews:
We just moved to Hamilton. My granddaughter wanted cupcakes 🧁 for her birthday. I called and was greeted on the phone and guided through the menu. I chose my dozen and went and picked them up. 5 star excellent service 👏 quality product 👌
Thanks Glen ☺️

I found my new cupcake spot 😍 I ordered a few dozen for my daughter's first birthday and was super impressed with the taste and quality. Will definitely reorder for future events. Also love the fun signature green packaging 💚
Got a delicious bunch of baked goods from them. Definitely going back for more. The red velvet cupcake was amazing.

Visited Locke Street to bring some baked item to a Real Estate office, so it has to look really nice. Bitten brought me in compared to the other bakeries because of the Whoopie Pies Approved by Bobby Orr sign. Wow. Everything looked so good. I got 5 different types of "tacos" and of course, one for myself. Oh my goodness. Yum.  Very sweet, but not too much that I regretted eating the whole thing in one sitting. I will definitely purchase again!

I ordered 30 cupcakes for a baby shower and was very disappointed with how they tasted. While the cupcakes looked beautiful, the cake itself was dry and crumbly. As soon as I took a bite, the cupcake completely fell apart. I followed the instructions not to refrigerate them, but it didn’t make a difference. For the price, I expected much better quality. This was my first time ordering from here, and unfortunately, it will be my last.

Our  cupcake was amazing! Pleasant & friendly staff , everything went great.  I was very impressed! The frosting was perfect! Not too sweet and did not distract from the flavors of the cake! I highly recommend Bitten

I'd be lying if I said I didn't have my doubts about the value of buying a single cupcake. I mean, I can make 24 for $4 with a mix and tub from Walmart. Right? WRONG! That crap is NOT cupcakes. Trust me. I now known cupcakes.

I would buy these cupcakes any day of the week, 100 times on Sunday.

I can't even describe how moist, rich, perfect, and insanely amazing these cupcakes are. I am converted.

I got the Salted Caramel cupcake. Get it!!!

Even the butter tart was mind blowing. So gooey. The crust was so buttery and flaky!

Please, do your mouth a flavour favour and go there.

Update:
I just got a Red Velvet Cupcake, and I am in heaven!

The Salted Pecan butter tart is to die for!!!! Soooooo ooey gooey with the perfect balance of sweet n' salty!

The Banana Cake was decent. It wasn't very moist, it didn't have a strong banana flavour (like banana bread) and there was no caramel injected in the cupcake itself...but I still ate it.

The Brown Butter Chocolate Chunk cookies are to die for!
The salted pecan butter tart was incredible! I wish I’d picked up a dozen. I’m definitely coming back the next time I’m in Hamilton.

address: 592 Upper Wellington St, Hamilton, ON L9A 3P9, Canada
reviews:
Had a wonderful experience at Shady Grove Lukaya Cafe in Hamilton. From the moment I walked in, I was impressed by the classy and welcoming atmosphere. The decor and overall vibe make it a great place to relax, enjoy a coffee, or spend time with friends.

A special mention goes to the lady working there—she was incredibly kind, friendly, and made us feel right at home. Excellent customer service like that really makes a difference and adds to the overall experience.

The cafe has a warm, elegant feel, and the hospitality was outstanding. If you’re looking for a cozy spot with a classy ambiance and genuinely friendly service, Shady Grove Lukaya Cafe is definitely worth a visit. Highly recommended!

Very cool little shop. Hole in the wall vibes. super earthy, rustic, laid back, wonre and lived in. They have an outdoor seating section that is very nice too. Coffee and tea otiona are decent. They have some decent baked good snacks for sale too. I got banana bread, pecan butter tart, caramel butter tart and a cappuccino. Delicious. Very Very good.
Great coffee and such a friendly, sweet staff! The atmosphere is calm and welcoming, making it the perfect place to read, study, or get some work done. Highly recommend Shady Grove Cafe!  ♥️

We had an amazing relaxing time here, we ordered a honey coconut tea, scones and mini pecan tart. All delicious... My friends and I had a very good experience.  Definitely we'll be back. We enjoyed the atmosphere and had our amazing night at the patio.  Thank you to Shady Grove Lukaya Cafe ❤️

48 million plus views on my Google reviews
Level 9 Google expert  Guide

Shady Grove Lukaya Cafe is a cozy, eclectic spot with a friendly, welcoming vibe. Julie, the owner, named the café after her daughter, Lukaya and you can feel that family owned touch throughout.

The decor is charming and unique shelves of teas, mismatched teacups, and a relaxed, hippie-inspired atmosphere. They serve Relay Coffee, and the baked goods are delicious the biscuits are huge and worth trying!

With free Wi-Fi, front window seating for people watching, and even Tuesday Open Mic nights with live music and poetry, it’s a great community cafe
A lovely place to stop in for a treat and enjoy the warm, personal atmosphere

There is a baby changing table in the washroom, which is a bonus
Paid parking or street parking free around the corner 2 hours

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had an amazing experience at Shady Grove Lukaya Cafe! We ordered a cappuccino, a hazelnut latte, and a vanilla latte — all of them were absolutely perfect. The taste was 10/10! The ambiance is cozy and filled with charm, with many small articles, a piano, and lots of unique decor that adds to the vibe. The prices were very reasonable, making it a great value for the experience. Overall, the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. I’ll definitely be adding this to my list of favorite spots. Highly recommend!

Excellent baked goods and coffee! Friendly staff that make you feel welcomed.  Although the main reason I come here is for the music, they are such a supportive venue for the local artists.  Talent abounds here.

Love, love, love this place! The vibe and decor are amazing. Café hopping and exploring new cafés wherever I go is my little hobby, and today I chose to work from this one……and I’m so glad I did.
I was a bit worried about the WiFi, but it worked perfectly, so no issues getting work done. The décor is stunning, the coffee is great (food options are limited but decent), and parking is super reasonable, $1 per day or $6 for unlimited.

I’ll definitely choose this spot again whenever I’m in the area!

reviews: I loved their food plus the prices were so reasonable. The taste was amazing. I loved it and I had tried their special Pakodas which I was really craving for, and I got the same taste. I am coming again to for the masala chai and sandwiches.

Had a great experience at Chai Bar! The food was excellent, especially the paratha and the burger—both were fresh, flavorful, and really satisfying. The seating area is spacious, clean, and comfortable, making it a nice place to relax and enjoy a meal. The tea was okay, not as impressive as the food, but overall the quality of the food and the pleasant atmosphere made it a very enjoyable visit. I’d definitely come back for the parathas and burgers!
Really enjoyed our visit to The Chai Bar! We tried the Elaichi Tea, Gur Wali Chai, cheese toast, and veg samosa — everything was fresh and tasty. Definitely worth a visit! ☕️😊

I visited Chai Bar on West Drive , Brampton today, after seeing many positive Google reviews, so I was expecting a little more. We ordered Kashmiri tea, Kadak tea, a paneer burger, fries and veg pakora. Both teas were good and definitely the highlight of our visit. However, the rest of the food was served cold, which was disappointing, especially since we were dining in. I feel that dine-in food should be served warm and fresh. The veg pakora also had quite a lot of oil. Overall, the food was okay, but nothing stood out for me apart from the tea. In my opinion, the restaurant could focus more on improving the food quality and serving temperature rather than the tea, which was already quite good. The store itself has a nice layout, with interesting pictures and canvas artwork that create a pleasant atmosphere. Overall, an average experience not bad, but not as good as I expected from the reviews.

name: Kung Fu Tea
address: 55 R. Notre Dame O, Montreal, Quebec H2Y 1S5, Canada
reviews:
I honestly feel a bit bad leaving a 2-star review because the staff were genuinely kind and welcoming throughout our visit.

That said, I’ve tried hundreds of bubble tea shops over the years—it’s practically an everyday indulgence for me and my family so I admit that I’m very hard to impress. Unfortunately, Kung Fu Tea didn’t quite meet my expectations. Probably that’s why they also shutdown in Vancouver around 2025.

We tried the mixed fruit tea, the brown sugar milk tea, and the the milk tea with ice cream. The mixed fruit tea was okay, while the other drinks were average at best. The one thing I really enjoyed was the pearls— at the very least they were fresh, nicely cooked, and had a great chewy texture which is a pass.

For me, some of the drinks lacked balance in flavor and didn’t stand out from what you’d expect from a large chain operation. Since it’s a major chain originating from New York, I assume a lot of the recipes and preparation are highly standardized, which may explain the consistency but also the lack of uniqueness.

The location itself is fantastic, especially being so close to the cathedral and right in the heart of Old Montreal. The surrounding atmosphere is beautiful and adds a lot to the experience. Unfortunately, I found the interior design quite underwhelming. It felt disconnected from the charm and character of Old Montreal, and for me, it diminished what could have been a much more memorable experience. So another reason to downvote.

Overall, it wasn’t a bad experience by any means, and the excellent service deserves recognition. However, based on the drinks and overall ambiance, I personally wouldn’t return and support.

If you’re in the area, Kung Fu Tea on Notre-Dame Road is a must-visit for boba tea. The drinks are consistently great, and our personal favorites are the A1 and A2 they never disappoint.

The customer service really stands out too. The staff are always friendly, welcoming, and quick, which makes the whole experience even better. So far, this is hands down the best boba spot we’ve tried in Montreal.
Wonderful spot, would recommend if you need a drink. Solid pricing, good location, clean, and great service
Went there to get some Boba tea while visiting the cathedral and they had a wide selection of them! Staff was really helpful when we had questions about the menu. The ambience was great too!

They offer a wide variety of choices, but they use honey instead of sugar which is not my preferred choice, there is also too much ice, I recommend you ask for less. Overall the place is nice and clean and the drinks are good, but I feel like there's better ones.

A great bubble tea place in the old port. A good variety of drinks to pick from. The place is very well decorated and has a good amount of places to sit. The bubbles tea were pretty good, but the egg waffle was disappointing. The batter seems to be some kind of premixes and a little bit too sweet for our taste. It is very difficult to find parking nearby as the area is usually filled with tourists.

Somehow clean but a bit worn down. Weird sticky smell , probably the floor cleaner. Overall okay . Not fav Boba place tho.

name: Ardglen Bakery
address: 85 Clarence St, Brampton, ON L6W 1S5, Canada
reviews: These Portuguese and Coconut tarts have the same crunchy and delicate base that is easy to bite into and consume. It’s very light. It is hard to eat just one. The ratio between filling to tart is perfect. Not overly sweet. I highly recommend the coconut tarts. Enjoy!

There is always something special about a quaint neighbourhood mom and pop bakery that leaves an indelible imprint on you. And this was the case as soon as I walked in. Every patron knew the owner and so forth.
So in my mind, I had a feeling that the baked goods will be a bonafide hit !!! Yeah :-)

COVID protocols are in place because only 4 customers are allowed inside at any given moment. Some reviewers mention that it is small. But I like to think of Ardglen Bakery as cozy compared with say Lazar Bakery.
Lazar is a vast expanse by comparison. However, I feel that size takes nothing away from here.

This was my first visit. I have seen their sign many times as I travel down the street to my favourite Portuguese chicken restaurant. But I never did stop to check it out until today.

Service as friendly and efficient. I really decided upon several items to try because I will definitely be returning.

I decided upon: Fresh croissants, Bolo Levedo, Portuguese donut-Malassadas, A Baguette, and some Portuguese dinner rolls ( Papo Secos).

A++ experience here.

I’ve driven past this little spot on Clarence Street a million times and finally stopped in last weekend. It’s definitely a "hidden gem"-super tiny and unassuming, but the smell of fresh bread hits you immediately. I grabbed a few of their famous custard tarts (natas) and a coconut tart, and they were incredible-flaky pastry and perfectly creamy without being too sweet. The fresh rolls were a total steal, too. The only minor downside is the size; it’s extremely cramped inside, so if there's a lineup, it feels a bit chaotic. Authentic, delicious, and unbeatable prices.

Service was great, the employee explained every single item to us patiently and let us take our time to decide. Plus, the prices are great. The entire picture below costed less than $12 after tax, which is mind blowing in 2023’s economy. Never been to this place until now, but I’m sure I’ll be back. Everything was delicious and unique too - the pistachio cannoli was unlike anything I’ve had before, and that croissant in the picture had a great apple cinnamon flavour. 5/5 recommend.
My sister and my mom love the Malassada and I’m a fan of Pistachio and also Custard Croissant

reviews: I had a wonderful experience at Silk and Gold Boutique while shopping for a three-piece suit for a henna party. They had a great selection of beautiful outfits, lots of available sizing, and the prices were very reasonable. Amarjeet and Rita were incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout the entire experience. They truly went out of their way to help me find the perfect outfit and made the whole process enjoyable and stress-free. I would highly recommend this boutique to anyone looking for partywear or special event outfits!

I have been a loyal customer of Silk N Gold Boutique for over 15 years, and I cannot recommend them enough. Over the years I have had the most beautiful custom-made lehengas crafted here, collected five to six stunning kundan sets, picked up gorgeous Kashmiri bangles, saris, and so much more — each piece truly unique and special.

One of the things I love most is that even if you come in without a specific jewellery piece in mind, just bring your outfit and they will help you find the perfect match. They carry an incredible variety of colours — I personally own sets in emerald green, fuchsia pink, baby pink, deep red, maroon, and classic gold, and every single one is unique in its design. No two sets look alike, which speaks to just how much variety they carry.

Uncle Amarjeet and his wife are absolutely wonderful — warm, welcoming, and genuinely passionate about what they do. What sets this boutique apart is the combination of exceptional quality, very reasonable pricing that is competitive with the market, and the ability to do fully custom orders. Whether you know exactly what you want or need guidance, they will take care of you.

If you are looking for authentic South Asian fashion and jewellery with a personal touch, this is the place. A hidden gem I am so grateful to have found — and kept coming back to for 15+ years!

address: 102 Peter St, Toronto, ON M5V 2G7, Canada
reviews:
A newly opened bubble tea shop inside Bestco.
The menu is surprisingly huge with lots of interesting drinks to choose from.
Menu at the end.

👉 Mochi Jello Milk Green Tea ⭐️⭐️⭐️✨ ($6.7)
Daily special. Ordered with no sugar.

The milk tea has a very rich milk candy flavor, with a strong non dairy creamer taste.
The mochi and jelly are actually the best part, both have great texture.

Next time I would probably order a different tea and still keep the toppings.

👉 Apple Ice Tea ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ ($8.2)
Ordered at 75 percent sugar and it was pleasantly refreshing.
The apple flavor tastes fresh rather than artificial.

A classic fruit tea topped with cheese foam.
Hard to go wrong with this combination.

I already know this place is going to be one of my new go-to spots when I want to treat myself. I recently tried their Apple Jasmine Milk Tea and it did not disappoint. I got it at 75% sweetness, which was perfect for me. They also use plastic straws, which I really appreciate so I can actually drink the boba properly ✨

ITS TEA has finally opened a Downtown Toronto location, and it did not disappoint. The store is conveniently located inside FoodyWorld at 102 Peter St, making it easy to grab a drink while grocery shopping or before catching a movie at Scotiabank Theatre.

The drinks are excellent — the Fresh Taro Storm is a standout, made with real taro instead of powder, rich and smooth like a dessert. The Fresh Taro Matcha Storm and Mochi Taro Milk Tea are also must-tries for taro lovers.

I also enjoyed the Creamy Mango & Pomelo Smoothie, which comes with real fruit and a refreshing balance of flavors.

What sets ITS TEA apart is the strong tea base, reasonable sweetness, and quality ingredients. The fruit portions are generous, and nothing tastes artificial. For anyone who loves bubble tea, this new DT location is a game-changer. Highly recommend!

Really yummy boba and I’ve gotten it from here 3 times. I get the pearl milk tea at 25% sugar but sometimes it’s still a bit too sweet for my liking.

I am mostly writing this review because I’m not sure what is in the tea at this place but I haven’t been able to sleep the last 5 hours even though I had the boba 9 hours ago. Maybe if you are sensitive to caffeine, avoid getting a tea-based drink. 😭 I don’t usually have this issue at chatime so I didn’t think it would be a problem here.

Overall: 6/10

I got the “Cake Mouse” boba 50% sugar. It was ok. Not much flavor but also not horrible.
The watermelon tea slush with ice cream is so good. Staffs are really nice and friendly as well. Would definitely recommend.

I tried their Mango tea, OMG, it’s mind blowing good!! From using the entire mango to high quality tea, hands down the best I’ve ever had!!! The tea shop is very organized and clean, staff is super friendly and professional, also the surrounding environment is convenient and well-functioning one stop shop, I really enjoyed my experience !! Absolutely top notch with 6-star service!!! I can’t wait to come back to try different drinks!!!

name: Parliament Café
address: 189 Sparks St., Ottawa, ON K1P 5A4, Canada
reviews: We visited Parliament Café with our family and had a wonderful experience. The coffee was excellent, and both the tiramisu and New York cheesecake were absolutely delicious. The café has a beautiful ambiance and a warm, welcoming atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer. The staff were amazing, friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. A perfect spot to relax and enjoy great food and drinks with family. We’ll definitely be coming back!
"This is truly one of the best coffee places I've ever visited. The coffee is excellent, and the service is warm and welcoming. You can really feel the passion behind every cup. Highly recommended!"

Loved everything about this place! The matcha was smooth, the mocha was rich and comforting, and the barista surprised me with an adorable cat latte art. The staff were so welcoming, and the cozy vibe and cute patio

Going in here, I was a bit wary/skeptical of the "no laptop" policy. It felt weirdly restrictive of a café. Walking in and sitting though put it in perspective.
The place feels warm and much like a relaxing place to sit outside of home and work - like an actual third space. There are no real signifiers for work(especially downtown, I can imagine laptops being a signifier for office/academic work, and in 2026, a signifier for online job boards), so it helps lend the space to be a more relaxing space, where you can ease your shoulders.
Even if you are segregated to your own respective social group, the white noise of other groups helps the café feel more relaxing, paired with the warm Eurocentric visual aesthetic of the café(this is invalid if you particularly hate loud crowd noise; luckily, I went when the volume was manageable, so mileage may vary).
Plus, the café IS actually quite small; while the patio space helps spread out the traffic in the Spring and Summer, I can see the space being cramped if people were allowed to use their laptops in the space in the Winter.
Ideally, I'd like a compromise. The no-laptop policy and its signage implies no working or real loitering (you can't draw, write, or read).
But I do appreciate the tone the café sets out to do, having actually visited and sat in the space.

The menu is pretty typical of a café - while you won't get any flashy drinks like you would a Starbucks, there are some pretty staple options for a café.
The cookie was pretty nice for $3; while I would prefer to taste the salt a WEE bit more, the chocolate was moist, and the cookie itself was decently crunchy while maintaining moisture.
The iced latte felt a bit TOO milky for me - apparently they used 3.8% milk(Henrietta, if anyone was curious; I saw it off the corner of my eye), but it was still really easy to drink. Also, there is a water dispenser available for customers, which I always appreciate.

The service was pretty nice - the barista lady brought over our drinks, which was a nice touch. We asked for it to go, but the tableware and cups seemed pretty (if you were planning to dine in).

Wonderful café with the friendliest staff!
Had a great visit to Parliament Café. The coffee and atmosphere are lovely, but what really made the experience special was how friendly and welcoming the staff were. They were warm, attentive, and genuinely kind — it felt like they truly care about every customer. A perfect spot near Parliament Hill. Highly recommend!

This place has some of the best lattes I’ve had! So far, I haven’t tried a single drink here that I didn’t enjoy. My favorites are the Cloud Mocha, Hazelnut Latte, Banana Latte, and Salty Mocha (all iced).
One thing I really appreciate is the portion size. Their drinks come in large and 1-liter options, and the cups are actually filled with coffee instead of being packed with ice.
A couple of things to keep in mind: it’s primarily a grab-and-go spot, so don’t expect seating or dedicated parking. The entrance can also be a little hard to find at first since it shares an exterior door with a vape shop. That said, the drinks are absolutely worth seeking out.

Buy 1 get 1 free special on now for a grand opening deal!

Small place but fast service despite long line up. Great customer service and excellent latte drinks!

Great place to get some quick coffee. Don’t request more than a 10% tip which is crazy and the barista was extremely kind and made me one of the best iced mochas I’ve had in a while. 10/10 would recommend.
adorable coffee shop with extremely various drink options ! the cheesecake is a bit expensive for the taste but overall amazing spot ! incredible pear matcha and coconut coffee

When we saw that Togo had their own version of a banana latte, we just had to go try it!

WOW! Pure nostalgia is the best way to describe it. From the very first sip, you get that classic banana syrup flavour. It is the exact kind you used to get at the ice cream truck or in a classic banana pudding. It’s so good! Even once mixed together, the banana flavour comes through beautifully.

You’ve definitely gotta come try a drink here. They have so many other unique flavours to choose from, too! 🧋

This place is delicious! They have such interesting and fun drink combinations - both coffee and teas(bubble tea style). They also have dairy alternatives so I was able to get everything with oat milk(extra $1). I’ve been here a few times and so far I’ve tried the orange milk tea, pear matcha and hazelnut latte. Orange milk tea was my favourite, so delicious! The pear matcha was decent - I found the matcha flavour was very mild (probably watered down with the amount of milk). Hazelnut latte was solid - I just wished there was a touch more hazelnut syrup, just a personal preference though. Would highly recommend! Can’t wait to try the other drinks on the menu!

We saw them on Tiktok and had to try it out! You can’t see the inside of the shop from the storefront, but it’s bright and cute inside. We had the banana latte and hazelnut latte, both were phenomenal! They were made very quickly, we didn’t wait long at all. They had a massive menu so we’ll be back to try other things! For the volume that you get, it’s definitely cheaper than other coffee shops.

name: CHICHA San Chen
address: 112 Elizabeth St #3, Toronto, ON M5G 1P5, Canada
credit_cards_accepted: American Express, China Union Pay, MasterCard, VISA
reviews: Gorgeous place with authentic, Taiwanese milk tea. Honestly, the boba is absolutely delicious and the tea is the real deal.. you can smell the roasted black tea before you even open the door! I try a lot of bubble tea places and this is the best Milk Tea I have found in Toronto. I ordered it with low sugar and whole milk. A must try!!!

Good atmosphere and okay drinks. But has a corporate policy where we can’t add extra toppings (ie: extra tapioca) even at an extra cost.

Chicha San Chen seems to be the only bubble tea shop with the rigid no additional topping policy, as every other place I’ve been do allows you to add it at an extra cost.

Can’t really recommend it if you like adding toppings or customizing your drinks and I don’t think I’ll be back. There are plenty other other places that let you do this.
Had the lemon wonderland! Tastes like a key lime pastry! The cafe vibes are super cute—loved their book collection/decor!

Great location, easily accessible, well placed.
Nice vibe and decors, some seatings available.
Good variety and selection to choose from. Some popular reconnections, or personalize your own drink is an option too.
Great flavoring, not too sweet for those looking for a refreshing drink.

Ordered the milk tea and it was really tasty. No sugar. You can really taste the quality of the black tea.

Cute little shop worth to stop by.
Great tea scents and drinks! The atmosphere is cozy and the drinks are very customizable. I had an oolong milk tea with konjac jelly and it was satisfying. Great staff.

Many people have the misconception that Chicha San Chen is a Michelin-starred bubble tea brand. It’s actually rated by the International Taste Institute and given what is claimed to be an “equivalent of 3 Michelin stars”. I think the bubble tea here is amazing but I think it’s also important to set the facts straight.

I got the bubble milk tea with less sugar and no ice and it was great! Tea tasted good but the tapioca was what made it above and beyond! The tapioca had a floral taste, which was very unique and was super chewy. The packaging for the tea is also so pretty! Their automatic tea brewing machine was very cool. They have a couple of seats at this location, but they are not the comfiest for sitting a long time. It can also get quite squishy when there are a lot of people. Chicha San Chen is definitely on the pricier end of bubble teas, but it’s a different experience compared to other franchises. Great to try once in a while!

Lovely bubble tea spot, cozy ambiance, aesthetic seating, drinks are absolutely delicious (recommend getting light sugar if you don’t have a huge sweet tooth). Quality is consistent with other Chicha locations - one of my favourite bubble tea chains in terms of taste overall although on the pricey end.

This particular location has books in store where you can read if you’d like, which is a nice touch. Worth a stop if you’re nearby!

I found out that they stop serving sandwiches after 2:00PM. I was looking 👀 to try them. But no worries 😉 because I still scored on some scones and other baked delights + some drinks 🥤.

The baked goods are all very good and delectable.

The drinks were made with skill and they were enjoyable for sure.

Please 🙏 drop in and support the local mom and pop businesses 😇.

Happy eats everyone 😎

Everything about this place is great apart from the most important thing, their coffee. Ordered a cappuccino and i could not drink it for at least 15 minutes because it was scorching hot. The barista was helpful & redid my drink and that’s when i saw the espresso pour out from the machine and it was just brown water, not even close to a decent espresso pull. Honestly, ended up dumping out the coffee and grabbed a nice cup of coffee from Mcdonald’s nearby and safe to say but that was a million times better than whatever they’re serving people here.
TLDR: If you like good coffee, please do not go here for that. Vibes, food & staff is actually awesome!
