reviews: I can't say enough great things about the quality of service and the personable care provided by Sarah and the team at Salon Bliss. I felt the difference the moment I walked in. I was warmly greeted, escorted to my chair, and offered a beverage. Sarah went above and beyond, taking the time and paying close attention to every detail to make me look and feel my best. Nothing felt rushed or cookie-cutter. The entire experience felt personalized, well thought out, and meticulously executed. I left feeling like the best version of myself—confident, refreshed, and as though I had just spent the day at a spa with friends. This is definitely more than just a job for them; it's their passion.

Kayla and Sara as well as Richard were amazing!  I highly recommend going to Salon Bliss for all your hair care needs.  For the attention to details, the customer service and the warmth.  I have rarely seen people who care this much about clients.

Had a terrible experience with who sounds like a receptionist rather than a stylist. To be fare, I booked very last minute so my expectations were low to start with. But I expected a junior stylist who'd have basic understanding about coloring roots. I got someone who argued with me the entire time. First, she insisted I need a different number from the one I requested (because the brand is different), then she said that coloring the roots at the front first (where it colors the fastest) is a standard procedure, and it is also dependent on the brand. As a result, I came put with almost black roots near my face, instead of natural blonde. Poor communication, and 0 knowledge of coloring techniques. I had to use a shampoo that stripped my toner and treatment off. Will not go back to this place.

This is, hands down, the BEST place to get a curly perm! I have been going here for a couple years now, and Sarah and Kayla are honestly fantastic. My perms always turn out exactly how I want them to, because Sarah takes the time to do test strands and ask a lot of important questions before she perms my hair. Kayla also gives the best head massages! If you have straight, thin hair and are looking for curls, this is truly the best place to go :)

Sarah also gave my mom a cut and style after her chemotherapy that made her feel so much better about her short hair. She even kept the salon open late for her appointment. Truly such great people at Salon Bliss!

I have taken a few days to enjoy my new hair style.

I am new to hair colour and style and I was nervous about going out and getting something I wouldn't like. I had my spouse find a few different places and we settled on calling Salon Bliss.

To my surprise, I was booked with Sarah within a couple days of calling in and explaining a bit of what I wanted.

Upon arriving, Sarah and the staff offered me something to drink, and I was seated for a consultation. Once we finally decided on colour and style, Sarah was actually available right then to do it! (My luck with another cancellation).

The evening was a bit of a blur, I was so excited and amazed at the whole process. The process that Sarah has at her salon is not just your average haircut or dye, it is an experience. Relaxing and refreshing!

It's been a week now, and I am still so happy about the outcome. I can't wait to go back again.

Thank you so much to Sarah and the staff at Salon Bliss!!! <3

address: 103 Queen St N, Hamilton, ON L8R 2V5, Canada
reviews:
I just got my haircut today afternoon it was good in the first place until I found out that my head was cut during the lining process, I saw it after he finishes the hairline the trimmer was been pushly hard that causes bleeding into my head.
I hope the barber be more watchful and aware next time he do it so no one will get hurt for the next customer. I’m saying this to improve your service and not to blame your shop

I had gotten a haircut at this salon before, and since a few family members also go here, I was excited to come for a trim because my hair needed one. Before the appointment, I clearly explained that I wanted curtain bangs and long layers. Unfortunately, I left feeling disappointed with my experience. My hair was uneven on both sides, and the cut wasn’t what I had asked for. Even now, I have difficulty putting my hair up in a claw clip because layers fall out in an uneven way, which doesn’t look how I’d like. I wasn’t happy with the result and wanted to share my experience honestly.

AMAZING PLACE!!!
Went there on the weekend, it was quite busy.

The woman who coloured my hair was absolutely amazinggg, she told me in advance on how I shouldn’t dye my hair a certain colour since I’ll kill my hair, I followed her advice and it turned out beautifully. Since it was quite busy she would go back and forth, I felt really bad it seems like she’s the only one who knows how to coloured. She was so sweet and kind! I had to tip her! Her service was amazing!
And the prices, so CHEAP!!! For colour, everywhere else I went to is so expensive! Their price is amazing and so is that woman’s service! If you have her as ur stylist you’re in good hands! Please be kind to her❤️❤️

First time doing the treatment and im so happy with it, seconding time in the place but definitely I’ll be regular for anything about my hair care. Thank you Chanal and her husband for doing such a wonderful service/job to my stubborn hair.
Cut my bangs way too short. Giving 2 stars instead of 1 because the price is so cheap compared to other barbers. Next I'm gonna try Star Salon on John St. since they advertise $15 haircuts.

name: Avondale Barber Shop & Hairstylists
address: 46 Avondale Blvd, Brampton, ON L6T 1H3, Canada
reviews: Hubby always looks forward to seeing his favourite barber here.  This location has been in this same spot for over 10 years; changed its name, but the quality of service remained outstanding.  Thanks guys, you have made your customers happy!

Thank Jay for always doing a great job, for paying attention to detail and always giving your best👌 Keep it up!! Milad and Ray and awesome as well. They have a great team working here. Much love and blessings!!

$35 for a haircut yess just haircut. And then expect a tip. Rip off. Store is outdated From 1960s. I come home with rashes and pimples on my head. They dont sanitize properly and make it look like they are. All barbers pretend to be nice but theyre always cranky and fed up with their job. Guaranteee if u get a fade you are getting red scalp pimples form and its not sensitive skin. Even if it is sensitive , they should be extra careful but theyre not.

Definately not worth it.

This place is a Brampton staple. An old school barber shop accommodating any new school trends you desire. Truly a Gem. I’ve been getting my cuts here for years and soon my two children will continue the tradition. Owner and staff are very kind and humble people who take their time making sure everyone leaves looking and feeling good. Can’t recommend enough honestly. See y’all soon I’m due for a buzz!

Ray and Milad are fantastic barbers. I've been to a few in the Vaughan / Brampton area and they are amongst the best. Reasonably priced as well.
The only thing is that they don't do reservations or bookings but I call in advance to see if they're busy so I'm never waiting.

Great shop, good cut and nice people.

Update: I stopped going there a year or so back, they more than doubled the price and have done nothing to update the place. Drawers are falling apart, some don't even close and just hang there. If you go there everyday for one year, they still treat you like they've never seen you before. I believe they hire new people who are learning and force you to use them, got many crappy haircuts this way.

They did have a good thing going but need to cater to the people paying their wages!

This place is highly recommended! My boyfriend has been getting his haircut by Ray for years at his previous location. Now him and our son come here to get their services done together once a month!

This place is super clean, friendly staff, just a nice chill environment to get your monthly upkeep done! We always tip because they have the best service. We tried another place before but places aren’t like this anymore. Again, highly recommended!!!

Yeah I like this place. The price is good, 22 dollars for a cut, about what you'd expect to be paying and the guys know what they're doing. I've been looking for a barber shop for a long time now and I've settled on Avondale. I have a mix of wavy and dry hair and it's not as thick as it once was but I leave here and my hair looks great and it's exactly the way I want it. Good fades are really important to me and they can fade!  Excellent spot

name: Railroad Coffee Co.
address: 50 Sussex Gate, Mississauga, ON L5B 3C2, Canada
reviews: I love going here , this is one of the spots in town that feels like home to me , a small lowkey coffee shop that’s independent which is the exact vibe I look for. I frequently make sure to come here for the staff service and my personal favourite : a chai latte or if you’d like to switch it up: a delicious chocolate mocha to go with the typical Canadian rainy or cold weather. The staff really treats each customer with such curiosity and hospitality that is so family like and unlike any other place I’ve been to. The treatment , consistent welcoming with smiles followed by a warm chai latte made perfectly with joy never fails to lift my mood whenever I need it. I highly recommend this place if you’re passing by Mississauga or if you’re just looking for a new independent coffee shop with a mellow vibe to try out or if you simply need a recharge.

The Railroad coffee is located inside the Sussex centre atrium.
I ordered a Turkey and cheese bagel sandwich which was really amazing. No fuss , No frills. You get what you pay for. The bagel was toasted and had a wonderful spread of mustard sauce, Turkey breast, lettuce and cucumber slices with a single cheese slice. I would have loved it more if there was one more cheese slice as the sandwich was pretty heavy on the lettuce 🥬.
However it was fresh and I would definitely try their coffee too next time
They also have vegetable samosa which I will try in my later visit.
Service is quick and efficient.

Extremely friendly and great service. Very clean place. I bought two different types of pastry and coffee. Unfortunately the pastries were not fresh at all and the coffee was too watered down. It's such a shame.

Absolutely horrible. I tried q samosa, it was so stale or horrid. I had a chocolate chip cookie it was so hard I could barely break it. Service is extremely bad there's no place to sit. While I was at it and I guess it was my day to waste my money I decided to buy a chai and she does it out of the cabinet with some sort of a syrup. I mean these people have zero quality and zero idea of good food. Such a mistake and I will never ever go there and I recommend everybody to not waste their time either.
Lovely little spot found near my work. Tried a Decaf Cinnamon Mocha Latte and Blueberry Scone. Highly recommend the scone. No line at 8am. Parking in front of the building worked for me.

Absolutely subpar experience!
Was hoping to get a proper, specialty level coffee based on the reviews, and shop description.

Ordered a cappuccino with oat milk. Firstly, the drink was so hot, that I could barely drink it even after a 25 (!) minute ride home.
Second, the beans tasted absolutely burnt, somewhere on the level of Tim Hortons coffee.

Absolutely horrible experience, do not recommend this coffee to anyone, stay away!

I love coming to this place for breakfast or lunch when I’m staying across the street at the Delta hotel. The sandwiches are wholesome and tasty, coffee is good, pastries excellent and the staff are very nice and friendly.

Good pastries and overall selection but unfortunately their espresso drinks leave much to be desired. Their cortado was completely off mark and tasted like really hot and sour diner coffee with lots of oversteamed (hot and watery) yet undertextured milk. Too bad because they advertise local small-batch roasts and have a very good espresso machine. Needs better dialling in.

reviews: Great selection of Ghost energy drinks and bunch of other exotic drinks. 10/10 collection
Very convenient location with everything I needed. The store is clean, well-organized, and the staff are friendly and helpful. Great place to stop by!
I feel that the worker had an attitude. Also would not let me use a credit card. Only debit card.

Quik Shop is an absolute standout among convenience stores. The staff is consistently helpful and welcoming, making every visit smooth. What really sets it apart is the incredible selection—rare chocolates, unique gummies, and snacks you won’t find elsewhere. It’s a fun, satisfying experience every time. Highly recommended!

Probably the best candy shop around. They have stuff that you can not find anywhere else in the city. I live in the area and always swing by here when I'm looking for a little snacky-poo! The owner is also such a beauty and always has some killer music playing when you go in! Recommend this place if you're looking to change up your snack game!
They have excellent collection of candies and drinks from states u cannot find anywhere else. Always love to go there because always find something new and innovative.

THEY ONLY ACCEPT DEBIT CARD FOR THE MINIMUM PURCHASE OF 5 DOLLARS.

BE AWARE THAT EVERYTHING FROM THIS STORE IS AT KEAST 40% MORE EXPENSIVE THAN ANYWHERE ELSE

Variety of candies and amazing collection of chocolate bars...imported stuff from all over the world.
Always love to go. Thank you guys for bring amazing candies.

address: 6111 Mayfield Rd Unit 16, Brampton, ON L6P 4R9, Canada
reviews:
Today we went to  Boba Shack.
The food was so amazing and delicious.
Everything was at top notch 👌.

Awwab and Ismail served us and were very polite and soft spoken.

The interior  was very beautiful to look at. 😍 🤩
The atmosphere was very clean! I really appreciate it!💗

My kids enjoyed it so so much..🥰🥰

The staff were super nice, and the food and drinks were delicious! Lots of selection! The food took a little while to be prepared, but if you're not in a rush this is a great place to get lunch, they even have board games to play while you wait!:)
Good food, most outstanding service! I visited with my friends and Cookiee took great care of us

Amazing bubble tea spot. The drinks are super fresh, perfectly balanced, and not overly sweet. You can tell they use quality ingredients. Service was fast and friendly too. Definitely one of my go-to spots now.

6$ for 5.5 onion rings maybe 6? Are we rationing here??? Soggy and cold after a 5 minute drive definitely check your food before leaving. And the burger just looks sad and taste is mediocre at best. Genuinely disappointed.

name: The Cake Studio by Sana
address: 52 Wandering Trail Dr, Brampton, ON L7A 1T3, Canada
reviews: Found Sana by a Google search and decided to go with her for my daughter’s birthday cake. Gave her an inspo pic and she responded very quickly. She was very professional, gave me her most common flavours kids usually like. She was accommodating of our nut allergies as well. The cake turned out absolutely beautiful!! The cake was moist, flavourful and not too sweet as a lot of cookies and cream cakes are. Super impressed! I would definitely recommend Sana and would order more cakes!

I ordered a cake from Sana for my Sister’s  50th birthday, and she did an amazing job! The chocolate tuxedo flavor was absolutely delicious—rich, moist, and perfectly balanced. Not only did it taste incredible, but it also looked beautiful and made the celebration extra special. Highly recommend her if you’re looking for both great taste and presentation!

Hi Sana,Omg!The cake was absolutely delicious and looked so beautiful! 😍 The buttercream and the strawberry flavorwere to die for. Everyone took a second round of cake and was all gone lol. The little one absolutely loved the soccer theme, and every little detail was done so perfectly and neatly. Thank you so much for putting so much care into every detail and making his day so special. I’ll definitely be coming back very soon to order more. Highly recommend you to everyone! ❤️🎂⚽

The absolute best choice for my baby’s  first birthday cake!!!
We ordered our baby's 1st birthday cake from The Cake Studio by Sana. This was our first time here and she completely blew us away! The design was exactly like the reference photo we provided.
We went with the Strawberry Shortcake flavor, and it was incredible—layers of light, fluffy cake filled with fresh strawberries and cream that tasted so fresh and delicious. It wasn't overly sugary, making it the perfect crowd-pleaser for both our adult guests and the little ones.
Sana is incredibly professional and made the whole pickup process entirely stress-free.She was also very accommodating. If you want a milestone cake that looks stunning and tastes like heaven, this is the place in Brampton. We will definitely be back for future birthdays!

We ordered a Toy Story–themed cake and it was absolutely beautiful. The design fit the theme perfectly and looked stunning next to our backdrop. So many of our guests commented on how incredibly moist and delicious the cake was. We will definitely be ordering from Sana for future events!

name: R Kitchen Restaurant - Mississauga
address: 2295 Battleford Rd, Mississauga, ON L5N 2W8, Canada
reviews:
Went here for a Sunday late lunch. We were accommodated right away. No waiting time during our visit. Our server was very pleasant and she's very attentive.

Ordered appetizers and mains. Enjoyed everything we ordered. Most of the dishes are really generous. Their pricing is really great. Very affordable and the quality is superb.

Overall, happy with the food and service that we got.

Highly recommend the calamari with the delicious sauce. Smashed burger was good, but needed cheese. Pasta with chicken Parmesan lacked seasoning. Prices and portions were good. Just strange that there were no take out containers for the sauce so I had to dump breaded calamari and onion rings with the sauce into one container… what a mess.

My mom, my sister and I had an amazing experience at RKitchen. The food and drinks was absolutely delicious—flavorful  and beautifully presented. Every dish we ordered exceeded our expectations, and I personally love the Shirley Temple and Piña Colada.

The service was just as impressive. The staff was friendly, attentive, and made us feel truly welcome from the moment we walked in. They were knowledgeable about the menu and offered great recommendations - since my sister was vegetarian.

The atmosphere was warm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed meal after an afternoon of playing in the casino. I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending it to friends.

R Kitchen is tucked inside Rama Gaming House, so getting past the casino front desk was a bit odd, but once we're seated the vibe wasn't bad. I came for the beef stew and mashed potatoes. Their stew was hearty and savoury (just a tad bit dry), and their smooth and buttery mash really hit the spot. The double smash burger was good and well-seasoned as well. Overall, the food was solid and reasonably priced. Not related, but I could do without the casino front desk trying to sign us up for promos on the way out.

Received a flyer so was keen on knowing where this new place was so dropped in.

The server was very courteous and friendly.

Lots of seating and a well lit place which also has a bar area and dining area.

Food was very average taste wise but the presentation was nice.

Since it is inside Casino Rama parking can be a challenge on a busy day but lots at the other far end or park on the road

name: Euphoria Cake & Dessert
address: 258 Dupont St, Toronto, ON M5R 1V7, Canada
reviews: I was in town from Miami visiting Toronto and needed a cake to celebrate my girlfriends birthday. I opened google and Euphoria came up nearby and the reviews were great. I decided to make a U-Turn and go look at their cakes. I’m glad we did. We got a Dubai Chocolate Ball thing that was real good. Also a Hazelnut chocolate cake and Caramel Cheesecake thing. All of them great and flavorful. I would definitely recommend. And we met the owner and she was very nice and welcoming.
The carrot cake was a knockout! Light and fluffy icing with a coconut dusting and perfectly baked thin cake layers. Not what I was expecting - but it was so much better!

Apparently a Michelin starred chef said this was the best red velvet cake in Toronto, this must have been from a long time ago. $13 for a square plastic case of what was essentially just cream cheese. The cake itself was non existent and had practically no sweetness.

Wouldn’t get again.

Europhia offers great desserts — perfect sizes, not too sweet, and really delicious flavors. I especially love their strawberry shortcakes.

Today I went in to grab two shortcakes for Valentine’s Day. However, their customer service was awful. The girl working there did not even say hi to me. She clearly seemed very annoyed that I came in and looked like she did not want to be there at all. She didn’t say thank you or bye or anything — even after I left a tip. She was in such a bad mood, which made me feel uncomfortable as I left.

I truly love their desserts, and I really hope they can improve their customer service to match the quality of their products.

I stopped in here to grab a quick drink, something refreshing. This cafe doesn’t take cash, only card. I ordered an ice chai tea latte and it was terrible. The drink was made in a rush and mostly tasted like water, not very considerate at all.

I had to throw it away immediately because one of the tea bags broke and I kept accidentally sipping up tea bag herbs. I was really disappointed I wasted seven dollars on this! The cashier(or owner?) was quite cold towards me aswell... I most likely won’t ever go back but the cakes do certainly look delicious!

I stumbled upon this place by chance, and I am so glad I did. I bought a coffee and a madelaine - both were so good, I didn't even stop to take a picture. Their collection looks great and I wish I could try them all at once!

I have been looking for a carrot cake my friend would enjoy for years. This place has it. Cream cheese frosting and it’s not too sweet. The cake itself has a really nice flavour. Will be ordering again

My daughter ordered a full-sized Black Forest Cake (my favourite) for my recent birthday. The cake from Euphoria Cake & Dessert was, by far, THE BEST Black Forest Cake I have ever had. It was absolutely delicious and so beautiful! Whoever made it did not scrimp on any of the ingredients, as the cherries, chocolate, and fresh whipped cream were all abundant. I will definitely order from them again and will recommend them to anyone who asks, without hesitation. Thank you for making my birthday extra special!

name: 101barbershop
address: 1440 Bank St #5, Ottawa, ON K1H 8A7, Canada
reviews:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I had an excellent experience at 101 Barbershop. Malek is a highly skilled barber who pays great attention to detail and makes sure every haircut is done perfectly. He is professional, friendly, and always takes the time to understand exactly what you want. The shop is clean, welcoming, and the service is outstanding. I always leave feeling confident and satisfied with my haircut. I highly recommend Malek and 101 Barbershop to anyone looking for a top-quality barber.

This isn’t just a barber shop — it’s an experience. From the moment you walk in, the focus is on making you feel relaxed, looked after, and leaving at your absolute best. The attention to detail is second to none, and every visit consistently delivers an incredible experience. If you’re looking for someone who genuinely takes pride in their craft and goes above and beyond every single time, this is the place to be.

What really sets it apart is everything they offer beyond haircuts and shaves. They provide a full men’s grooming experience with services like massage, facial scrubs, hot wax treatments for the face, nose, and ears, and more — things a lot of men don’t even realize are available in a barber setting. The pricing is fantastic for the level of service you receive, and for me it’s an easy 11/10. I’ve never had a bad experience, not once. In my opinion, this is the place men in Ottawa should know about.

The best barber I’ve ever had! Abu Hamza is incredibly talented, professional, and always pays attention to every detail. Every haircut is perfect, and the service is outstanding. Highly recommended—if you want the best, go to Abu Hamza! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amazing experience from start to finish. The staff were very welcoming, friendly, and attentive. The hospitality was excellent, and we really appreciated the refreshments they offered. Malik was especially kind and caring with my son, making him feel comfortable throughout the haircut. The service was professional, the shop was clean, and the haircut turned out great. We will definitely be coming back. Highly recommended!

We went there to get my 2-year-old nephew’s haircut, and they were amazing. So patient, gentle, and really took their time to make him comfortable. The whole experience was smooth and stress-free. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a great place for kids’ haircuts!

name: Boulangerie Mr Jreech
address: Exit Stanley, 1461 Rue Stanley Métro Level, Montreal, Quebec H3A 1P4, Canada
reviews: The best Lebanese 🇱🇧 Manakish 😋 fresh and good prices 👌🏻 highly recommend it 👌🏻

Hidden gem, everything was freshly handmade, tasted incredible and at low price. Located in a subway station so it’s very handy for coming in or out of the station. Hits the spot after a long day and it’s 100% halal as well. I will definitely be coming back here next time I pass by :)

A Hidden Gem: The Coziest Bakery at Peel Metro - Mr. Jreech

If you're ever passing by Peel Metro and haven't stumbled upon Mr. Jreech, you're truly missing out on a delightful experience! This charming underground bakery has become my go-to for the best food to grab on the go. The menu is packed with delicious options, and everything I've tried has been a testament to their unbeatable quality and freshness.

Ahmad, the owner, is the heart and soul of the place. His warm and generous nature adds a personal touch to every visit. He often surprises me by adding a little extra to my order—such a thoughtful gesture that keeps me coming back.

Now, let’s talk about the food! The variety here is incredible, and I’ve almost worked my way through the entire menu. The Epinard, Sambousek, Halloum, Kebbe, and Manakish are all bursting with flavor. And don’t even get me started on the desserts, the Tiramisu at Mr. Jreech is hands-down the best I’ve ever had. Their drinks pair perfectly with the food and add to the overall experience.

One thing that truly stands out is the unbeatable value for money. The price, quantity, and quality at Mr. Jreech are simply the best. You’ll leave feeling satisfied, both in taste and portion size, without breaking the bank.

If you’re looking for a place with amazing food, a cozy vibe, and top-notch service, Mr. Jreech is a must-visit. Thank you, Ahmad, for creating such a welcoming spot! I’ll definitely keep coming back to indulge in more of your culinary magic. 🥐✨

THIS IS ALI NOOR & THIS IS MY REVIEW

I recently had the pleasure of savoring a Lebanese Manakeesh, and it was an absolute delight! The crispy yet tender dough, topped with a flavorful blend of za'atar, tomatoes, olives, and Labneh, created a mouthwatering symphony of flavors. The presentation was beautiful, and the friendly staff added to the overall enjoyable experience. If you're seeking an authentic and delicious culinary adventure, I highly recommend trying this Lebanese Manakeesh. Bon appétit!

Excellent traditional Lebanese food. The owner is very nice and will help you decide what you want to eat if you're not familiar with the food. The dough is very healthy (all grain), and the food is very clean and tastes amazing. It'll put a smile on your face, highly recommended!!!
Small bakery / sandwich shop with a couple of tables outside and space to eat in but primarily a take away… good array of sandwiches although not cheap (around $15 each)
A good range of Middle Eastern pastries and savouries. Strongly recommended!

Delicious food!
We got the best pies (Mouajjanat) from Mr Jreech for my son’s birthday! Spinach, hot dogs, pizza, halloum! Everything was amazing!
I also often have lunch there: best lahmajoun in town!

reviews: The bubble tea flavour was good but the amount of pearls they add is horrible. Why are they cutting back on the pearls? My daughters were so excited until we saw the portions. This is totally unacceptable. Please add more and do better.
Too much waiting time only one worker handle the shop it's hard for him

Monday, August 4, 2025

I ordered my usual yakult green tea with aloe vera in the regular size. This has always been my favourite drink, and I like to treat myself to it occasionally from this exact location. Unfortunately, this time I found a ladybug inside the drink when I got home. I had to throw it out. It made me wonder what I may not have seen in the past with drinks that aren’t as light and clear.

This is very disappointing and raises concerns about hygiene and quality control. I’m not sure if I feel safe coming back, and I hope management takes this seriously.

I’ve included a video that shows the sticker with the order details and a full view around the seal to confirm that it had not been opened.

I can honestly say I have never had a negative experience at this location. Staff are always friendly and patient. Today my sister and I were served by Dylan, who was very knowledgable, he helped us my offering great drink suggestions and even helped us to modify our drinks. Would definitely recommend 10/10

Avoid this location for slow service. the drinks are very good but why do they only hire one person to work especially on the weekend? I came in today and the worker was trying to run the register and make the drinks. If someone calls in sick, there should be at least 2 people there to run the register and make the drinks. There was over 10 people waiting inside because one person can’t make drinks, take uber orders and run the register all at once. Disappointing for the managers here for creating a stressful environment for the workers and they should really fix this or they will keep losing customers. I will find a new place to go to without having to wait 15+ minutes for one drink.

name: Hero Tea Hamilton
address: Canada, Ontario, Hamilton, King St E, Hero Tea Hamilton邮政编码: L8N 1B5
reviews:
I was pleasantly surprised with how well their matcha and mango drink tasted (it's called 'something in Kyoto' ).

Service was a little passive and the space was a little cluttered at the time, but this place came recommended from a friend so I don't want to believe that's their default setting.

A lovely bubble tea shop! They have a huge selection of drinks, so there’s something for everyone. The service is always fast, and the staff are friendly and welcoming. A great place to stop by if you’re craving bubble tea or looking to try something new🧋

Extremely disappointing experience with Hero Tea.

My latest order was a fruit tea. After placing it in my refrigerator overnight, I woke up to find that the entire drink had leaked out. The cup had a visible crack at the bottom, and I provided photos showing the damage.

Instead of acknowledging that the cup could have been defective, I was repeatedly told that the cup was “fine when packed” and that a leak would have been noticed at the store. This explanation makes no sense. A crack is not the same as a hole. A cracked cup can leak slowly over time, which is exactly what happened.

What frustrated me most was how quickly responsibility was pushed back onto the customer despite clear photo evidence.

Your staff kept saying it was fine when it was ready, what's she trying to imply? I damaged the drink and want the money??? Disgrace. Have you ever checked how many times I have ordered? I also ordered on other platforms. I have never reported any issue before.

Unfortunately, this was not my first disappointing experience with this location. On a previous order, I requested no ice because I was sick. The options have extra ice and less ice without no ice. So I left a note saying I want no ice. The drink arrived without ice, but instead of filling the cup, a large portion of the drink was simply missing. The cup looked only about two-thirds full. It felt like the volume removed was based on the amount of extra ice rather than a normal adjustment, which was honestly shocking for a premium-priced fruit tea.

After multiple experiences like these, the overall impression is that customer satisfaction is not a priority. I’ve ordered from Hero Tea many times, but these experiences have made me seriously reconsider ordering again.

I hope management takes these issues seriously.

the matcha drink was good, but i was disappointed that i was not able to sit down and lounge with the drink i purchased, in fact i recommend other customers to view this place as a “take out” spot — they do not have any washroom available for paying customers! despite this, the cafe has several seats and tables to sit down. but why would i invite my friends to relax at this cafe when there is no washroom for us to use? and there are no publicly available washrooms in the nearby area either? it is unrealistic. when you are drinking tea and matcha, you’ll have to pee eventually! also, isn’t it illegal in Ontario to not offer a washroom for your *customers* if you are a “dine-in” cafe that obviously has available seating?

I’ve been a regular ever since Hero Tea opened in Hamilton! Stopped by recently, and their drinks are still absolutely amazing.
My top picks are the white peach cream tea, olive fruit tea and taro milk tea. You can really taste the tea, it’s never too sweet, and every cup tastes the same every time. I’ll definitely keep coming back!

As a long time Hero Tea fan, this opening in Hamilton feels like the universe finally answering my prayers. Before, the closest Hero Tea was in Mississauga and since I don’t drive, every drink meant multiple bus rides, GO Train transfers, and a dramatic journey home while trying not to spill boba everywhere. Friends called me “crazy” for traveling that far just for tea but they clearly have never tasted true happiness.
For me, that happiness has a name: Watermelon Delight. The moment that bright pink drink hits my hand, life is instantly better. Fresh, juicy, perfectly balanced, it’s like summer in a cup, but somehow even better. The pearls are always the perfect chew, the tea base is spot on, and the flavor makes you forget every bad day you’ve ever had.
Now, I don’t have to plan a half-day trip for my favorite drink. I can just stroll over, grab my Watermelon Delight, and watch the world instantly feel brighter. The staff here are so friendly, the shop is clean and welcoming, and every sip reminds me why I fell in love with Hero Tea in the first place.
Hamilton, we are officially in our Hero Tea era and I couldn’t be happier🧋🍉✨

As a jasmine tea fiend I am writing this after taking two sips of my jasmine whisper milk tea I doordashed because it is genuinely one of the best Jasmine milk tea in Hamilton I've had yet. Consider you gain a big back fan and I WILL come back!!!!!!

Finally a opened up a store in hamilton! I’ve been going to their other locations and i’d say the quality here is just as good. Interior is super cute and staff was friendly, they offered to give recommendations when we couldn’t decide on a drink

name: HERO TEA OTTAWA
address: 399 Dalhousie St, Ottawa, ON K1N 9K4, Canada
reviews: I tried this place for the first time and really enjoyed it. I’m not much of a pearl milk tea drinker, but I really like this one.

My friend and I finally got a chance to check this new bubble tea place out! I’m so glad we did because it’s easily one of the best we’ve had in Ottawa so far. The drinks are delicious, and there’s a great variety to choose from. I’m already excited to come back and try more flavors! Just a heads-up, the seating is very limited and it may be a short wait on your order (around 10-15 minutes).
Every drink I’ve tried here has been delicious. Highly recommend! Yifan is vey friendly.

Delicious teas with strong potent tea flavour. No sugar really means no sugar here, not like some places that sneak sugar into their tea base. So I like  30% sugar, which gives just a hint of sweetness. The konjac jelly is fantastic. Really springy and chewy. Osmanthus Blossom was great. White Orchid Jade was a little too rich and creamy for my liking. Staff were nice.

Nice little spot away from the busy street walk areas of downtown.  Every sip is packed full of flavour and refreshing at the same time.   I highly recommend their Tiramisu drink and other blend-teas.. both hot and cold.  Shout out to Jimmy for making our experience and drinks pleasurable!

Solid little tea house. Place feels clean and calm, easy to just sit with a book. Gongfu-style tea has this deep Chaoshan aroma, lingers nicely. Staff spoke gently, helped me pick a tea, price felt fair for the quality.
Soo many unique drinks to try

Great service, clean store and super good tea as well as great attention to detail- they used loose leaf tea and i highly enjoyed the teochew tea leaves cold brewed as i like my tea stronger didnt experience long wait as previous reviews said 10/10

reviews: Shireen is the best! We always go to her for my husband's and our 2 sons haircuts. She is professional and makes sure to do it just how we want and her work is consistent. Thank you for fitting us in your busy schedule this week.

I’ve been seeing Shireen since 2014 for all my barbering needs and it’s been a pleasure to see her get to her own space after all these years. She’s talented, hard working and I make the trip in from downtown every 2-3 weeks given all the years of top service. Her Lorne Park location is clean and well located. You can trust her for everyday cuts up to the most important life events such as weddings and interviews.

I had such a great experience at Loren park barbershop from the moment I walked in the vibe was welcoming and professional the attention to detail is next level she really takes the time to understand exactly what you want and make it happen.

My cut came out clean fresh and exactly how I pictured it.

Shireen Thank you.
I've been getting my hair cut by Robin for a while now. He always does a great job and is great to chat with. If your looking for a quality hair cut call Lorne Park Barber Shop!

I’ve been getting haircut from Shireen for a few years and definitely recommend this place! She knows how to give an awesome fade and to shape a beard. She’s very thorough and gives a great cut every time.

name: Song Tea
address: 1448a Rue St Mathieu, Montreal, Quebec H3H 2H9, Canada
reviews: Was recommended by a friend and I am so happy I visited. By far the best bubble tea I've ever tasted. So many choices and they're all delicious! Got the osmanthus tea jelly and my partner got the oreo pearl milk tea - super fresh! Can't wait to come back. And the decorations are super cute. The staff was also so very kind.

Customers must descend several stairs to access this lovely shop and its delicious taro bubble tea! Note that the taro is an actual powdered taro root and not fake purple gloop. It has a very distinctive texture and taste, unusual but good. The decor had a charming DIY feel, and the signage in the restroom gave me a laugh!

Best frozen yogurt I’ve had! Packed with real fruit and incredibly fresh. They peel and cut the fruit fresh out of the fridge so it’s definitely worth the wait. Pro tip: you can reserve in advance for pickup, but that’s kind of an insider secret 🤫🤫
This is fantastic , why didn’t I come earlier?! New favourite. They have mochi topping which I really like and they’re generous with it

Song The is a true hidden gem for bubble tea lovers! Their milk tea and fruit tea are absolutely delicious, with a perfect balance of flavors that will leave you craving for more. The interior is stunning and whimsical, straight out of an Alice in Wonderland scene—it’s like stepping into a magical wonderland!
The service at Song The is exceptional—everyone is so friendly and attentive. The staff, especially the lovely girls working there, are not only beautiful but also incredibly sweet and welcoming. They make you feel right at home and always have a smile on their faces. It’s clear they take pride in providing a wonderful experience for every customer.
Whether you’re there for the drinks or the enchanting decor, this place is a must-visit. Can’t wait to go back!

The menu is big and have a big variety of different drinks and toppings. The sizes of cups are quite large but nothing special for the price you’re paying. I’ve been twice and every time they tell me the wait time is 35min?! For what?! I’d rather just get the same drink at the Shuyi next door. It’s worth trying once for the more exotic drinks but I would not go again. The whole place smells like floral air freshener for a bathroom as well.

I’ve ordered takeout from them and the drinks are good (I like the mochi drinks) but it always takes ~1 hour to arrive. The one time I tried to go in person when they opened (at 12 pm), I was told they weren’t ready?? Not a great experience and they should be more prepared with their business hours.

The reviews were a bit low so I entered rather afraid. But I left pleasantly surprised. The fruit tea bubble tea here is genuinely so good I still think about it months later. I don't usually leave reviews on bubble tea stores but this one strawberry rose flower wtv tea they had so utterly blew me away I came back to leave a review. It's sweet but not too sweet, containing a right proportion of "tea-ness" with a wonderful dash of flowers, not too much as to overshadow or too little as to be ignored. Service was slow. Other flavours are probably not of the same quality, with my friends mostly remarking that theirs were mid.
Oh and the decor was very beautiful albeit cluttered

This bubble tea place is so wonderful, with a delicious variety of drinks! The owner and the employees are always very friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend visiting here 😊

Very convenient location as I can easily stop by after coming out of the metro. Their drinks were so good especially their mango litchi jelly boba and their brown sugar milk tea boba was amazing. The service is also amazing, the staff were very welcoming and always smiling warmly.

This small boba spot tucked in the metro station is perfect for satisfying cravings on the go. The drinks are tasty, with just the right chew in the pearls, and service is quick and friendly. Great pit stop for a refreshing treat during your commute!

I saw this new bubble tea shop open up near my house and wanted to try it and I wasn’t disappointed at all! The owner was very kind and explained everything to us. The service was very quick and the bubble tea itself was amazing. I had the passionfruit mango flavour and im definitely coming back to try out different flavours

Good bubble tea, super busy so you know the bubbles are fresh. Interesting selection too.
Only slight negative: after adding bubbles, tax and tips, $9 for a small cup of bubble tea (not sure if it’s good ingredients or cheap powder BUT it does tastes decent).

Positives: tastes decent, plenty of fresh bubbles, clerk is friendly and diligent. A homeless guy came in for some water and the clerk was polite even towards him. Great place 👏 good vibes.

Stopped by here while passing through Plamondon metro station. I got myself an iced-frappé and it was lovely!
The girl who served was very sweet, too.

Good store with lots of options, run by an honest, hardworking man. If you’re looking to support local small businesses then look no further. Remac beside uottawa is an amazing convenience store to stop by for all your needs. It had a lot of items you’d find at a grocery store and the guy who works there is great to deal with.
Kumar is a GREAT cashier. Great customer service. Great prices. Absolutely love supporting this local shop.

Over the past decade I've been deeply suspicious of your prices and cleaning standards but today's incident was the last straw and I needed to finally say something.
I’ve been coming here for years. The gentleman who runs the store is so friendly and helpful!

Ive been coming to this store for 3 years now and it’s my favorite store to go to every time. Kumar the owner is a very kind & nice man dedicated to his store and serving the neighbourhood with love for a long time now. The store has everything you need essentially and even hot food ready to go. It’s absolutely welcoming too I’ll be definitely continuing to shop there for a while and it doesn’t have that corporate feeling which is great. This store is genuine in general and family owned which I love.

I love getting samosas from this store—they’re always fresh and delicious! The owner is incredibly friendly, always greeting me with a smile and ready to help.

I used to live nearby and once needed help opening a can, and they didn’t hesitate to assist me. Little moments like that make this place feel like more than just a store—it’s a part of the community.

They have a great selection of products, whether you’re looking for a quick snack, essentials like milk, or something new to try. I’ve been coming here since I started at uOttawa, and even after I leave Ottawa, I know I’ll be stopping by whenever I visit. Highly recommend!

Had a nice light dinner with family after celebrating at home. A very good place to chill out and unwind after a long day. Our host was Ms. ASH, a very polite and smiling host. reviews: Nice clothes, but unfortunately their return policy is not reflective of good customer service. I bought a necklace there and brought it to return (they only offer exchange or store credit which is totally fine) 2 days later, never worn. I was told no to exchange or store credit for jewelry. It was not communicated to me at the time of the sale. I try to support local stores but with their inflexibility of service, why bother. It is too bad as I liked the store and now I won’t be back because they couldn’t exchange or give me a store credit for $72.

Fig Tree Boutique – A One-Stop Style Haven

Fig Tree Boutique is truly a hidden gem for fashion lovers. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted by Ranka and Visnja with a warm welcome and personalised attention that sets this boutique apart. It has quickly become my go-to spot for chic outfits and enjoyable shopping, and it’s easy to see why this boutique is a one-stop shop for all style needs.

Highlights
•	Friendly, expert staff: Ranka and Visnja offer great style tips and personalised fashion advice.
•	Brand selection: A curated range of stylish European and Canadian brand names you won’t find in typical stores.
•	Charming location: Nestled in a lovely, picturesque Bloor West village that makes the shopping experience even more delightful.
•	Head-to-toe fashion: Carries everything from clothing and shoes to accessories, so you can complete your entire look in one visit.

Personalized & Friendly Service

One of the first things you’ll notice at Fig Tree is the exceptional service. Visnja and Ranka are not only incredibly helpful but also genuinely passionate about style. They take the time to get to know your taste and needs. On my last visit, I was unsure about which outfit suited an upcoming event, but they offered fantastic style tips and even suggested combinations I wouldn’t have thought of myself. Their personalized fashion advice made me feel like I had my own stylist – they truly go above and beyond. Whether you need a second opinion in the fitting room or ideas on how to accessorize, these ladies have you covered with warmth and expertise.

Curated European Brands & Quality Finds

The selection of fashion at Fig Tree is impressive, especially if you love European style. They carry a strong collection of European brand names and unique labels that add a special touch to your wardrobe. I spotted pieces from some of my favorite designers (like Mos Mosh and Part Two among others) – brands that are hard to find elsewhere in the city. Every item feels hand-picked with care, from elegant dresses to cozy knitwear. The quality of the clothing is outstanding, and you can tell they focus on timeless fashion with a modern twist. Whether you’re looking for a statement piece that stands out or high-quality basics for everyday wear, Fig Tree’s curated selection makes shopping a pleasure. It’s the kind of boutique where you find something new and delightful each time you visit.

Lovely Location & Atmosphere

Fig Tree Boutique is located in a lovely Bloor West village, which only adds to its charm. The area around the store is picturesque and inviting – perfect for a leisurely shopping trip. You can enjoy a coffee nearby and then browse at Fig Tree. The boutique itself has a warm, welcoming atmosphere with a tasteful interior that’s chic yet comfortable. Soft lighting, well-organized racks, and a cozy fitting area make the whole experience relaxing and fun. You never feel rushed here; instead, you feel at home. The combination of a beautiful location and a friendly vibe inside the shop turns a simple shopping trip into a delightful outing.

Overall, I can’t recommend Fig Tree Boutique enough. Visnja and Ranka, the unique European fashion finds, and the charming location make it a must-visit for anyone seeking a stylish and enjoyable shopping experience. Whether you’re a local or just visiting, do yourself a favour and stop by Fig Tree – it’s the perfect boutique to refresh your wardrobe and leave with a smile.

My favourite boutique in Toronto. Their new location is spacious and fabulous! Such a great selection of unique and capsule wardrobe pieces. They carry all of my favourite brands such as Suncoo, Indi and Cold, Faithfull the Brand and Yerse. Really great collection of sustainable clothing - a true hidden gem!

Bloor West Village is home to this unique one-stop fashion shop, The Fig Tree Boutique.  You will find your next special occasion dress here, or a super soft cozy sweater and buttery soft jeans.  Owners and fashion pros Ranka and Visnja offer a beautiful collection of merchandise  and their welcoming and down to earth nature allows for an easy and pleasant shopping experience. The Fig Tree Boutique carries quality euro clothing, footwear, and accessories that you won't easily find anywhere else.  I especially love their stylish accessories, bags, purses, belts, scarves, that simply tie a look together.  They have an excellent 'sale' section to choose from too.  Wrapped within the charm of one of the city's best neighbourhoods, The Fig Tree Boutique is the perfect place for a girlie shop after a nearby cup of coffee or lunch.  Just go! Thank me later......

Love, love, love this boutique! Absolutely stunning pieces, every item is so stylish and unique. Visnja and Ranka are the kindest, always making the shopping experience warm and enjoyable. Their new location is beautiful, and the selection just keeps getting better!! Never disappoints - I highly recommend.

Fig Tree is a treasure trove of a boutique in Toronto’s Bloor West Village and Visnja and Ranka are gems! The selection of clothing they carefully curate from beautiful European brands is truly beautiful and level of service you receive cannot be compared to anywhere else. I highly recommend Fig Tree to anyone, especially those who favour European clothing combined with a high level of service and expertise.
Wonderful energy and wonderful service from Ranka and Višnja. Excellent quality! Highly recommended! 🤍

My favorite clothing store for its elegance and style. Truly a place where you can transform your every day clothing into unique style with beautiful fit. The ladies in the store are so helpful and generous with their time helping you find the perfect fit and size for your body. My favorite part is that most of the brands they offer are environmentally conscious while providing the best natural fabrics from cotton and linen to wool and cashmere for the colder months. Never disappoints, fig tree is always a go to for me.

name: Salon Gamme
address: 6562 Boul. Saint-Laurent, Montreal, Quebec H2S 3C6, Canada
reviews: I go to this salon every couple months for a discolouration with Minh :)) He’s so patient and sweet and makes the whole experience so much better, but the best part is he does platinum so well!! He doesn’t damage my hair and he always makes sure the risks of everything is as minimal as possible by always staying honest with me and telling what we can do and can’t do. I’ve been blonde for 4 years and Minh saved my hair from so much breakage!! I would definitely recommend

I recently got my hair done with Theary, and she did a color correction to achieve an ashy blonde balayage. She was so attentive throughout the entire process and made me feel incredibly comfortable and welcomed. She’s super friendly, sweet, and professional, and she gave me my dream hair! Everyone at Salon Gamme is so nice and welcoming too, amazing staff!

I had a wonderful appointment with Minh as I always do! I have done my hair with Minh a few times now, and I am so impressed by his colour work. I came in to do a highlight touch-up on my roots while adding some subtle colour, as well as a beautiful cut. Pictured below!

Minh always does a great job, and improves every time I see him. The highlights and colour he did on me last time faded out beautifully. I’m grateful that he helped me decide on a look that would flatter me both times I went.

On top of my satisfaction with my hair, I just enjoy coming back to catch up with Minh. We’ve built a great rapport already! Always looking forward to seeing him. 💖

Alexandra:
The best compliment I can give her is that she just gets it.

She's incredibly talented, has an amazing eye, and understands what you need almost immediately. Even when I struggle to explain what I'm envisioning, she somehow gets it and always delivers something that feels like me.

She's also genuinely one of the sweetest people, always smiling, welcoming, and she makes every appointment feel effortless.

The salon overall:
The entire team creates such a warm, welcoming environment. It never feels intimidating or pretentious, it's just laid back and kind. As someone with Asian hair, I've always felt understood and completely confident that I'm in good hands.

Amazing service!! Malina exceeded my expectations during my bridal hairstyle trial. We ended up finding the perfect look, and I absolutely fell in love with it. She is incredibly talented and has a great ability to understand her clients’ tastes and preferences.

I highly recommend Salon Gamme. The staff is not only talented but also very hospitable, especially Minh, who made sure everything went smoothly during my appointment.

Excellent staff and outstanding service!

Giving 2 stars because the owner Malina seems like a genuinely good person and I was refunded for this mess...

However, my hair is absolutely butchered after having Alexandra work on it. I entered the salon with 3 years of previous highlight work from a higher end salon in a different country. They would always foil my hair and gradually got me to a nice level of blonde.

I really struggled to find a good salon since moving to Montreal and put A LOT of research (and trust) into google reviews. I finally settled on Gamme. At this point I had about 1 year of regrowth to give my hair some time from damaging it further from the bleach.

When I entered the salon my hair was down to my lower back and when I left the salon it was barely past my shoulders and half the thickness. Instead of foiling my hair Alexandra decided to apply bleach all over my head completely... no technique, no foils.. just bleach all over like any of us could do at home.

She went over all previously highlighted hair and just bleached away. The whole time she seemed more concerned with talking about gossip in her life rather than focusing on my hair. I thought she was friendly so I didn't mind chit chatting but when I realized she was not even paying attention or caring about my hair it started to annoy me.

After 8 hours of bleaching/toning/drying my hair, the great reveal was a mess of yellow pee blonde roots to about 4 inches down for it to change to a harsh line dividing it into a copper orange color. A harsh line dividing a mix of 5 different colors which all are muddy and ugly. Of course she was smiling and pretending like it's just part of the process, I voiced that I didn't like the spots in my hair, her solution was to tone it a second time to the orange color to make it match, I said no I don't want that color and she told me she would tone it a blonde that's neutral and would make it match but she wanted to cut it first.

After chopping off a bunch of hair as well as more than 6 inches of my hair was falling she tried to throw a towel over the hair on the floor to hide it and she was throwing the hair that was coming out from my head onto her brush to the side to hide that too. Then she tones it and kept suggesting that I should let her put curls in my hair even though I didn't want curls. She says she wanted to do it for her instagram story (but now I know it was to try to hide the mismatch colors).

At the end I could visibly see it was and orange mess, I still paid out of pure shock but even my optimistic boyfriend couldn't cover his pure shock of why anyone in a salon would do that to someone's hair and let them walk out like that.

When I got home I realized she even cut the hair uneven, she never parted it down the middle when she did cut it, it was more like her chopping and hacking away in a panic to hide her botched job. I honestly sit here wondering how this girl ever became a hairstylist.

I would never suggest anyone to go to her if you go to this Salon. I feel bad leaving the review because Malina was so nice but I CANNOT let anyone go through this. At minimum it'll cost me thousands to fix but mostly it's cost me not being able to go out in public or feel good about myself, years of hair growth lost and probably will have to go back to dark hair that I can't dye blonde for years as well. Worst hair experience of my life.

LAST TWO PHOTOS ARE BEFORE THE APPOINTMENT

I booked a haircut with Alexandra and showed reference photos, simply asking to keep my length and add layers.
This was my first time with her and unfortunately the overall experience felt somewhat cold and it was a noticeable lack of attention to detail🙂‍↕️
Despite asking to keep my length, I lost about five inches of hair, and the final result looks boxy and much shorter than expected. I left not saying anything because the damage was already done but feeling disappointed, especially as a service provider myself due to the lack of professionalism.
First photo is my hair now, second is my reference pic😞
Last picture was my hair before 😞😞😞

I visited Salon Gamme after struggling to find a hair colorist that I could trust. In this salon, they did not disappoint. Minh was really kind, professional and amazing to talk to throughout the whole session. He did a fantastic job on my hair, like look at that raccoon tail! I will most definitely come back here; it was exactly what I was looking for. :)

reviews: I got blonde highlights and I thought they looked very good at first until I got home and noticed there is a very distinct harsh line. Like it was not blended well. So I called and went back, they said they could do a root tap, which they did, and it looked sorta similar to how it was when she was done but I brushed it up to being the lighting. But when I got home I noticed it looked the exact same still. Very nice people that work there, I just am not happy with the way my hair turned out, especially after spending $400. Everytime I go out, I try and hide the line with a headband

I took a chance booking with Robert for a bob/lob cut, and I am so glad that I did! He did such an amazing job, and I couldn’t be happier with my new hair.

Robert was patient, communicative, knowledgeable, and incredibly kind. He took the time to really talk with me about what I wanted and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the process. What I appreciated most was the time he spent teaching me how to style my new haircut so that I would feel confident recreating the look at home.

I’m so grateful that I found Robert and decided to take a chance. I would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a talented stylist who genuinely takes the time to listen, communicate, and make sure you leave feeling happy and confident!
Hilton achieved a beautiful blonde colour on me. So cute! Great service and experience overall, atmosphere is friendly and I enjoyed relaxing quietly and letting him do his thing, it was nice.

This is my second time at this salon - all the positive reviews are accurate! I booked a last minute color with Hilton (I saw Galya last time and she was also amazing but she was booked the day I needed otherwise I would have booked her again initially) and Hilton was INCREDIBLE! He has a great personality as well. He gave me a blowout that was perfect / exactly how I wanted and lasted 4 days still looking great. I will definitely see him again moving forward!!!! I think you could book anyone here and they would all be great. Prices are also fair!

The service is excellent. Every stylist in there I've seen has been great.

It is a big thing for me though that there is no way for me to leave a tip when I cash out at the end. I know it might cost a bit to add the extra step to the checkout process, but you have talented staff giving great service on your behalf. I don't go to Reflections Salon for whoever happens to own it (no offence), I come because the staff is friendly and good at what they do. I come to see them, not the building.

They deserve the same access to this additional income that every other salon gives it's staff.

​I have been hesitant to post this, but after much reflection, I feel it is important to share my experience. I paid nearly $600 for what was advertised as "Master Stylist" level expertise, but the results were frankly unacceptable.
​Key Points:
​Total Loss of Natural Tone: As a natural redhead, I requested a warm auburn. Instead, my hair was processed to an extremely dark, near-black shade. There is now no trace of red left in my hair, which is incredibly disappointing given my natural coloring.
​Technical Errors in Cutting: I asked for a precision gradient cut. What I received was a blunt bob that was cut significantly shorter than agreed upon and left visibly uneven.
​Lack of Professionalism: At this premium price point, one expects a high level of technical skill and attention to the client's specific requests. Unfortunately, the execution failed to meet even basic expectations for both color and shape.
​I specifically sought out the owner based on recommendations, but the outcome was a total mismatch with the "master" pricing. I cannot recommend this salon for technical color or precision cutting.

Elisabeth is an outstanding stylist and person, she gave my husband the best haircut he’s ever had. And she styled my hair beautifully. So lucky to have had an opportunity to have our hair done by her.
Yesterday I had my first haircut with Hilton and couldn’t be happier. The salon has a very nice atmosphere, friendly staff and convenient location. Highly recommended!

reviews: Stopped by for two Strawberry Bobo Yogurts and they were so good! Fresh, creamy, and not overly sweet. The strawberry flavor tasted natural, Service was friendly and the drinks came out quickly. Definitely a spot I’ll come back to whenever I’m in Chinatown. Highly recommend!
We came here twice on our trip visiting Montreal. The service was good and the drinks use real fruit and were all made fresh! I recommend stopping by if you’re in Chinatown. ❤️

Very nice people and the drinks are good. We dont drink coconut milk and had ordered a drink without knowing it had coconut milk in it. We told them after receiving the drink that we dont drink coconut milk and they replaced the drink for us. Impeccable service!

There are places that simply serve drinks, and then there is Shuyi Tealicious. From the very first sip, it was clear that this was bubble tea crafted with care—perfectly balanced, delightfully refreshing, and worth every penny.
What truly elevated the experience, however, was the young Chinese gentleman behind the counter. He carried himself with remarkable professionalism and warmth, serving every customer with genuine kindness and effortless efficiency. It's rare to encounter someone whose hospitality leaves as lasting an impression as the product itself, yet he managed exactly that.
A great drink may bring you through the door, but exceptional service is what invites you back. Shuyi Tealicious has both in abundance. If excellence could be poured into a cup, this establishment has mastered the recipe.

I bought a hot grass jelly drink, but the grass jelly tasted like medicine—very gross. They also added dried raisins, which made it even worse. The only good part was the chewy taro, and the guy who served me was nice. However, I will never spend a cent on that disgusting drink again. 🤮

This is just a review for the mango pomelo sago. It’s a great drink!

I wanted a medium size, but they only had large cups at the time. It was $8.25 CAD for the large drink. They made it so quickly. This is a pick up and leave type of place. No seating; no bathroom.

Credit card accepted. This is located in Chinatown. It’s a small storefront, so it’s easily missed.
Loved the milk tea here! Super rich flavor and perfect for this freezing Montreal weather. Glad we found this place near the snow. Highly recommend if you want a good warm drink!

We took our drinks to go home and got the watermelon crush tea. The person forgot to put the lychee jelly in it so there is no sweetness in the drink. Paid almost $10 to just drink watermelon tea juice :/

They should use clear cups instead of these solid white cups, can’t even see if our drink is correct or not

reviews: A fun shop with plenty of vintage pieces. The variety of prints and styles is spectacular - there seems to be something for everyone! The owners and employees are very welcoming and made my visit to the shop stand out as an experience rather than just a shopping trip. Prices are high but the pieces are in great shape and, again, beautifully curated. A must visit for vintage fashion lovers and regular fashion folk hoping to spice their wardrobe up a little!

Definitely a lovely store with lots of beautiful options. I’ve visited a few times, and while the selection is great, I’ve had a couple of uncomfortable experiences with staff comments about my body and a friend’s body that felt unnecessary.
On one visit, I was trying on a dress that was a bit tight and asked a friend to help zip it up. I understand the need to protect the clothing, but the employee made a point of repeatedly expressing concern about the dress breaking, which felt a bit excessive and awkward in the moment.
As a women owned business that serves women, I think it’s important to be mindful of how comments like this can come across. I hope this feedback is helpful moving forward
Incredible selection, beautiful pieces, cute matching sets. The prices usually are around 70-100$

Bellwethers vintage has one of the finest curated selections of vintage clothing you will find in the country. They have an item for every style, that will surely define your wardrobe. Each item is hand selected by the owner to ensure both accuracy of period and quality. The shop is beautifully decorated, it is a guarantee that you will leave wishing you could take the whole store with you.
Gorgeous store, not within my price range but still nice to appreciate the lovely clothing. Almost like a fashion lovers museum. Hope to pick up a nice piece in the future.

Hands down my favourite vintage shop anywhere. Bellwethers is expertly curated and impeccably presented! Take a trip back in time to the most colourful and inspiring wardrobes of the past. You’ll always find something you love. Owner Madison has an eye for beautiful fabrics and a wonderful knowledge of vintage clothing that will leave you feeling like you’ve just had the most fun fashion history tour ever. Keep an eye on their socials for amazing sales too!

So happy this is so close to home! What a wonderful shop with really lovely and helpful staff! I was helped to pick out the cutest shoes and a fur cover for a 50s themed party. The stuff I’ll be able to wear beyond just the one party & im quite excited. My boyfriend also got a wonderful jacket and tie he can definitely use a bunch of times. We’ll definitely be back as they have a ton of things and the prices are good for the quality of what they have!

Unique selection of pieces. Super friendly and kind staff. Definately a GEM in Ottawa. Styles varies from the 80s to early 90s. Found a couple East Asian clothing as well (casual kimono and hanfu [chinese] outwears). Generally, a really pleasant experience and love the vibes of the interior design too!

One additional great bonus is that this shop is super clean, neat, and carries no "smell" of vintage. Definately something a lot of Toronto vintage shops didn't master yet ;)

name: Kin Kin bakery and Bubble Tea
address: 499 Main St S, Brampton, ON L6Y 1N7, Canada
reviews:
Very disappointing experience. I ordered fresh orange juice for $7 plus tax, but was served a cup that was almost half foam from the machine instead of actual juice (see photo).

When I politely questioned it, the staff member said, “that’s how we serve,” and was quite rude. I calmly asked if the foam could be removed, but she only partially drained it and topped it up — still leaving a lot of foam. She then went into the kitchen and avoided coming back until I was about to leave.

For the price paid, I expected a full cup of juice and respectful customer service. Unfortunately, I received neither. I hope management addresses both product quality and staff behavior.

Yes i can share the details it was happened on 27 January 2026 Tuesday around 6pm.

Very tasty buns, also the price on the tags is the exact price you pay!

My favourite bun is the Coconut Dome Bun!
It goes especially well with Hot Chocolate!

Great ubereats order. Buns were delivered in cute brown bags, and each was individually wrapped. They went so far as to label each item. The extra effort was very much appreciated. Thank you for a great experience.
Hands down the best bakery and bubble tea. All of this for $12. A nice light snack and drink! Reasonable prices for bubble tea. Unlike the other over expensive businesses

Mango diamond smoothie stood upto its name and fame! The prices are better than other bubble tea spots and the flavors are fresh! I have become part of the kin Kin nation!

PS: I wish the owners knew if the coconut pineapple buns had lard or other animal products.. They looked so good!

EDIT: the establishment confirmed through email that the buns had a lard coating on top and not suitable for vegetarians or those looking to avoid animal ingredients in them

reviews:
This was my first time visiting this barbershop, and I couldn’t be happier! The price is amazing, and Eric has magic hands. He gave me one of the best haircuts I’ve ever had, clean, detailed, and exactly what I wanted. The quality of his work for the price is unbelievable. I’ve been to many barbershops that charge much more, but Eric delivers exceptional service at an amazing price.

I highly recommend this barbershop, and I encourage everyone to come and see Eric. You won’t be disappointed! I’ll definitely be coming back.

Thanks again! You guys really brought a smile to my face. ✌🏽🙏🏾

Professional & Positive

Golden Hand Barbershop truly lives up to its name. The barbers are highly skilled, professional, and pay great attention to detail. The atmosphere is clean, welcoming, and comfortable, and you can tell they really care about customer satisfaction. I always leave feeling confident and refreshed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality service and a great haircut.
First time here and mostly likely will be seen more often professional, clean and most importantly they know how to give a proper fade

I just hot my haircut there; the service is great, the staff was professional and gave me the best haircut I ever had since I moved to Ottawa.
I strongly recommend that place.
Thank you Aisha,  you have been a great barber, thank you for the nice treatment you always give me, when I come to cut my hair.

Amazing Experience at Oredi Barbershop!
I’ve been to many barbershops, but Oredi truly stands out. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with a friendly vibe and a clean, stylish atmosphere. The barbers are professional, skilled, and really take their time to make sure you get exactly the look you want.

I left with a fresh, sharp cut that got me a lot of compliments. They pay attention to detail, and it shows in the final result. Whether you need a quick trim or a full restyle, this is the place to go. Definitely recommend Oredi to anyone looking for top-quality service and a great experience.

Unfortunately it was not a good experience for me. There were the owners  kids running around everywhere in the barbershop, not a very professional setting.

But most importantly the guy who cut my hair/ beard did a terrible job with my beard. I had to correct him several times since the beard was uneven. The end result was that the beard was too short.

Terrible experience not going back !
Wonderful barber! Professional, clean and friendly service. They really know how to cut and style women’s hair, as well as men’s hair. I have been more than satisfied each time with my haircut.

address: 145 Clarence St Unit18, Brampton, ON L6W 1T2, Canada
reviews:
I found Nafisa Boutique online when I needed a saree for a wedding I would be attending. As soon as I walked in I was welcomed with openness and excitement. I recieved so much help understanding how to wear a saree and spotted the most beautiful one on the wall. The owner took one look at me and found a petticoat and top to wear with them that were exactly my size and dressed me. I swear, it's like it was made for me! She then took the time to steam the pleats of the saree for me, and she added some pins so I would know which parts went where as I dressed myself for the wedding. I recieved so many complements on the saree itself, and a lot of praise that I had been shown how to properly wear it.
The entire experience was so wonderful. I left Nafisa Boutique feeling giddy with excitement and confident I could dress myself in the saree. I would recommend Nafisa Boutique to anyone who is looking for a saree. I know I will be going back next time I find myself in need of another outfit for an Indian wedding or event! Thank you very much Nafisa Boutique for helping me!!

Saree ironing/pleating, draping and blouse stitching services are great. My saree blouses always fit like a glove. Most importantly, the lady who runs the business was very kind and accommodating. She even went out of her way to help us when we needed something unexpectedly. Had a wonderful experience!

Excellent place for traditional dresses and jewelry. Sugani was so helpful in selecting the dresses and jewelry. I did have my dress stitched here which was stitched to perfection. Perfect choice for traditional Indian Sri Lankan dresses.

Had my saree blouse stitching and saree ironing and pleating done and I was completely satisfied with the service, turn around time and friendly staff. I had such a great experience, I will definitely be bringing back more saree blouses to stitch here. Their saree and jewellery collections are also great!

I had an amazing experience at this boutique! They have beautiful, traditional sarees and jewelry. Nafisa is a very hardworking and caring person with a wonderful personality. Her guidance and knowledge about the traditions was amazing. The customer service was truly fantastic!
Come and experience it yourself to feel how special it is.

address: 1305 Wellington St. W, Ottawa, ON K1Y 3B1, Canada
reviews: Ver nice little cafe with excellent service.  The cafe latte was very good as was my scone.  My friend had a cold matcha drink which she enjoyed as with the red velvet cake.  Nice place. I will go back.

Today I went to this very cozy cafe. Food was extremely delicious and on top of that their service was excellent. Price was very reasonable. I had very good experience. Owner was very welcoming and kind. I would recommend it to anyone who’s looking for great food of good quality.

Went there around lunch time, space is very limited and 5 outs of the 7 tables had one person with a laptop working.. I suggest with the limited seating they need to have a policy for laptops or a limited time.. we ordered caramello coffee and tiramisu coffee both iced.. they were good, their espresso is really good… croissants was nice as well.. parking is paid on the street.. they said their hours will be extended to 9 pm in the summer which is a great thing!

Stopped into Caramello Cafe during a morning walk and was really impressed.

I ordered a Turkish coffee and a chocolate chip cookie, both were excellent. The coffee was rich and full of flavour, and the cookie hit that perfect balance of soft and fresh.

What really stood out, though, was the atmosphere.  The space is quiet, calm, and genuinely warm, one of those places where you can slow down and enjoy the moment.

A wonderful addition to the neighbourhood. I’ll definitely be back.

I really like mango with Matcha and the stuff is very friendly
And the price appropriate
I’d really recommend this place and don’t forget to try that mango that Macha

Caramello is a hidden gem that you should try. The complete experience was great, from the ambience to the service and coffee. We enjoyed it so much and we will definitely make this coffee shop our go to whenever we want to have a morning chill.
Worth the try!

I recently visited Caramello Caffè, and I had such a great experience. The vibes were honestly so cute, and I especially loved the cozy corner seating it made the whole place feel warm and inviting.

The coffee had a really rich taste, and you could genuinely tell the quality was there. I also tried the tiramisu, and it was amazing you could taste the coffee in it, which made it even better and gave it such a deep, authentic flavor.

On top of that, the service was very welcoming and sweet, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

Definitely a spot I’d come back to!

Everything here is so good! The grilled chicken sandwich was perfect (no photos because it was so good I forgot to take any). They also have a large variety of desserts and drinks. My fav is the tiramusu latte and the ice mint lemonade with real mint, blended with crushed ice. I would honestly gate keep this place but the people are so nice so im leaving a review.
