reviews: Great store i have been going for years. Have good selection ofthings and prices are good. The staff are very friendly. I there fresh sandwhiches and i like to get my lottery there as well  easy parking if you need it.

The prices are amazing. Some items are even cheaper than going to the grocery store. Staff is amazing very friendly and helpful. Even my little dog loves coming here cause they always have a smiling face and a treat for him. Just a great community store in our neighborhood. Such a caring store to their customers Truly, a gem in the community

Can’t say enough good things about this store.

There are no grocery stores in walking distance of this neighbourhood. Thankfully,  Abbas Grocery keeps its shelves stocked with all the basics, as well as fresh produce and a number of other important household items. It’s also very affordable (in a time where major grocery stores jack up their prices at will) and the staff are all wonderful. Every one of them, owner included, are friendly and helpful.

Some weeks, I’m in this store almost every day, and that doesn’t bother me at all. Happy to support this business and can safely say living in this neighbourhood would be much more difficult without it.
Best neighbourhood store hands down. Feels like they take care of us. Fair/low prices, friendliest staff, amazing owner. I go out of my way to support them. ♥️

I have never written a review for corner store but this place is so great! They have such a great selection (including some produce) for a corner store. The prices are also on par or cheaper than the grocer store.

Last but not least - very kind and friendly folks!

Living near this convenience store is beyond helpful. They have pretty much everything you’d need in a pinch at reasonable prices (especially in this economy), and the owner and his family are so kind and welcoming. I always looks forward to my interactions with them. Also the different flavours of cheesecake they have are soooooo good, highly recommend! I hope they know how much their little store means to our community. :)
Friendly staff, good product range and good pricing for a corner store. The sandwiches are yummy. Abbas is the hub of the Glebe Annex. Everyone goes there.

Best damn convenience store in the city. Neighborhood is a food desert, and this place stocks fresh veggies & a variety of foods. A lot of the residents are poor; the store owner has gone above & beyond to keep prices low, and has a "pay me when you can" policy with regulars who are a bit short on funds. Love it.

address: 50 Rideau St Ste 201B, Ottawa, ON K1N 9J7, Canada
reviews:
I ordered the matcha mango special. It was pretty good but they included too much ice even after I asked for less ice. The prices are slighlt more than other bubble tea places. Too be fair, I'm still undecided if the extra cost is worth it. Gong Cha has different drinks than other bubble tea places, which is refreshing.  Staff were very friendly but they either didn't listen when i asked for less ice or they didn't couldn't alter the amount of ice in that specific drink. There is one self-service ordering stand.

This particular location is inside the Rideau Centre. So parking is an extra cost but it's within walking distance from a lot of great Ottawa destinations. If I was already in the mall, I would probably get a drink from here, but I wouldn't go specifically to the mall for a drink at this restaurant.

$10.62 for a regular sized drink is honestly way too expensive, especially when there was nothing special about it. The drink was just average and definitely not worth over $10. Very disappointing for the price.
The staff is very friendly and welcoming, the drinks are made quickly. They have got some really good pumpkin drinks as well.

This location was pretty busy in waves and I think they just had one self serve kiosk so it was pretty crowded to order. I got the Mango Milk Tea with Kanten Jelly. It was pretty good but gone in no time cos it’s mostly ice. 😕

Is a great place to have bubble tea Mayur any types of drinks you would like to have. The store is a little bit difficult to find, but it is right  inside the ridieu center.

We tried their Matcha latte with strawberry .
The drink was good not much sugar was added. Quantity was adequate and price point was optimal.  You can buy a drink from here and walk the awesome area nearby such as canal Parliament, etc..
Gong Cha is my favourite bubble tea. The tea flavour is strong and delicious. I enjoy following their Instagram, and I can see the owner puts a lot of effort into running the business. Cheers!

Best Honeydew smoothie ever! I love honeydew drinks but I always end up finding them overly sweet for my taste.The staff was very welcoming and helpful. I love how we can adjust the sweetness of our drinks. It ended up perfect with the suggestions of the staff.
I took the strawberry lemonade, very refreshing. I like the additional lemon zest put into it. It enhanced the flavor.

reviews: i stopped by lina’s pastries and coffee and really enjoyed it. there are so many different pastries, cookies, tarts, and baked goods to choose from that it’s hard to decide what to get. i tried the portuguese egg tart, and it was so tasty. they ask if you want it warmed up, and i would definitely recommend saying yes because it tastes even better warm. they also have a small indoor seating area if you want to sit down and enjoy your food. such a friendly family business!!
Amazing little husband and wife team, him doing all the exotic coffees and she making the pastries. The aromas were amazing and tasted great too.

Ive always bought cookies here, ginger bread and biscotti. My first time to try affogato♥️😍
Loved it!!
Even funny coincidence was seeing mom there and she got me this nice treat😁 thanks mom♥️🙏

This was our first time at Hamilton Market. I’m usually not that into sweets but these treats looked well-made and smelled heavenly. We tried them the next day and OMG we should’ve bought more seriously the raspberry tart is the best! 10/10 would buy 10 more.
The owner was super nice and accommodating. Brought my friend here to try their Portuguese egg tarts, it’s fluffy and not too sweet. Highly recommend this place when you want to grab a sweet treat!

name: Naveen Fashion
address: 116 Kennedy Rd S Unit #1, Brampton, ON L6W 1E7, Canada
reviews: Naveen Fashion is a wonderful place to shop for stylish and quality clothing. The collection is diverse, featuring trendy designs and options for various occasions. The staff is friendly, patient, and always ready to help with selections. I was impressed with the quality of the outfits and the reasonable pricing. The overall shopping experience was smooth and enjoyable. I highly recommend Naveen Fashion to anyone looking for fashionable clothing and excellent customer service.
I've been shopping here for years and never been disappointed - By far my favorite place to shop for Indian clothes. Also I love the ladies there, they are so friendly.

I recently purchased one lehanga and a pre-stitch saree from them. The entire staff was extraordinarily helpful in understanding my needs and budget, demonstrating excellent customer service. Despite my not having the measurements for both outfits readily available, they patiently worked with us - offering alterations for both outfits for an additional fee. Impressively, these alterations were executed to perfection within just a couple of hours.

My daughter was scheduled to arrive on the eve of the party, and Nikhil, exemplifying their exceptional customer service, was considerate enough to provide his personal number. He offered to pick up the tailor and bring her to the store in the event that the outfit did not fit perfectly on the day of the party. His willingness to go above and beyond was truly impressive.
Luckily, the outfit fit well, and we didn't require any further adjustments. I would undoubtedly recommend them and their exceptional customer service.
I would definitely recommend them.

Super disappointed with the experience here. At first, I was excited because it seemed that they had a lot of options when I was looking around, and seemed that they had what I was looking for, including the colors. I tried a couple of outfits on, and chose a nice blue gharara. There were some noticeable stains on the scarf, which should have been my first red flag, but they were able to wash it out to show us that it’s not permanent. They blamed the workers back home for making the dress, and guessed that maybe some food or drinks had spilt—I have never seen such stains and dirty marks on desi clothes like this while out shopping, let alone making poor excuses for them. In the moment, I really liked the style and how the dress fit but I also felt like I was settling because I had already bought my  jewelry beforehand and the colors were matching together. That’s on me. However, the quality of the clothing at this store is horrible. There were many rips and missing seams in the fabrics, but I had already bought the dress before I noticed the rest of the rips. And the stains!!! Even after discussing the issues about the dress, the workers did not give us much of a discount. It was not worth the $200 she was asking for. We had to negotiate and bargain for good reason, and she only took $5 off. I regretted it instantly on the drive back home. The fancier lehengas next door at Simer Kollections were of higher quality, at much lower prices. When I got home, I noticed more bigger stains on the inside of the gharara I bought from Naveen, including some big ones on the separate sleeve fabrics. I wish I had taken pictures for this review, but my mom had already washed them out, which took her a while. We ended up getting a few outfits at Simer Kollections instead, & I even went back a couple days after my experience at Naveen to replace my dress. I can’t return the gharara so I decided to wear it for the mehndi rather than the wedding. The workers were very friendly, and very helpful in finding me options, but I felt they were not honest about the value and worth of what they sold me, the quality is terrible, and I was definitely overcharged. FYI, I paid $240 for a beautiful big lehenga, 2 pairs of gorgeous bangle sets, and fancy jewelry including head piece next door at Simer Kollections.

This was my first visit to Naveen Fashions Kennedy location.  They have a nice collection of Indian dresses.  I bought a beautiful elegant suit for my daughter, she's super happy about it, loves it and it's a perfect fit.  The owner was very calm, pleasant and friendly.  No sales pressure.  Prices are competitive.  I will definitely consider shopping here again in the future.

name: 茶宴 CHAYAN TORONTO
address: 407 Spadina Ave., Toronto, ON M5T 2G6, Canada
reviews:
Such a calm and elegant tea shop.
The space is surprisingly large with plenty of seating, making it a nice place to slow down for a while.

Menu at the end.

👉 Jasmine Lemon Tea ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️✨ ($7.99)
Wow.

Even ordered with no sugar, it still has a gentle natural sweetness.
It has that clean mineral water kind of finish with a refreshing lingering sweetness.

The jasmine aroma is beautiful without being overpowering.
This is officially my favorite lemon tea so far.

In my heart… it beats Da Ning Lemon. 😭

👉 A Stroll Through the Garden ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️✨ ($8.29)
This one surprised me too.

The cream top is light and airy, but they are incredibly generous with it.
The peach flavor is really nice, and even at regular sweetness it is well balanced.

Somehow this version just tastes better than similar drinks from other places.

I Just tried their new drink! Honestly, the taste is average, the tea flavor isn't very strong or fresh; i felt the taste could be highly impacted by the sugar level I chose . On the bright side, the atmosphere is great and the staff is super friendly. I expected a larger size for the price, but the convenient location makes up for it. Overall, it was a good experience:)

Chayan is such a fun spot if you're looking for something a little different from your typical bubble tea shop. Its located close to Kensington Market, it's the perfect stop if you're already exploring Chinatown and want something refreshing. Parking can be a bit tricky, but it's an easy place to walk to if you're in the area.

We tried the Longjing Cream Cloud with Oat Popping Pearls (soooo good), Rose Tea Cream Cloud, and Matcha Cloud Latte, and what stood out most was how balanced all of the drinks were. None of them were overly sweet, which allowed the tea flavours to really shine.

Our favourite was easily the Longjing Cream Cloud. The yogurt foam was smooth and creamy, while the tea underneath stayed light and refreshing. The oat popping pearls were also surprisingly fun, especially as the drink got colder and developed a slightly icy texture.

The Rose Tea Cream Cloud was floral and refreshing without tasting artificial, while the Matcha Cloud Latte delivered a rich matcha flavour that would definitely appeal to matcha fans.
We also appreciated that the toppings weren't just there for presentation. The garnishes, foams, and pearls all added something meaningful to the overall drinking experience.

The space itself is beautiful, with a calming green aesthetic and a cute photo booth that fits perfectly with the vibe. It's a little pricey, but fun if you're visiting with friends.
The staff were genuinely lovely throughout our visit and helped make the experience feel even more welcoming.

It feels like a blend of a tea house, café, and bubble tea shop, making it a great stop if you're wandering around Chinatown and want something refreshing.

Decent spot for bubble tea if you love a stronger tea flavour. Cute cups and standard Toronto pricing. Wish the mango tea had a stronger mango flavour but was still satisfied having this refreshing drink on a hot summer day.
Yummy drinks, kind staff, very nice seating area with soft lighting and outlets. The little ears and cat stickers are so cute.

reviews: Oh man this place is so good. The coffee is really strong and smooth. I got the affogato and my wife got the mocha cookie crumble frappuccino. Both were fantastic. We had the blueberry slush too which was likewise fantastic.

We really enjoyed the waffle with the strawberry icecream (it’s huge!!) and the chocolate oreo cake. The latte and the Americano were very nice too. On top of that, the smashed lemon iced tea is so refreshing. My husband loves it so much. The decor here is so cozy, perfect for a small gathering to chill and relax. Amazing service!

this is my favourite study spot. they have really comfy chairs with charging ports, free wifi, and their playlist is amazing too!! there’s a nice variety of things on the menu, and the drinks are really good. the person working there is so friendly and honestly the sweetest.
Such a cute cafe with lots of seating and outlets, perfect for studying! The ambience is lovely and the workers are so sweet. The food and drinks are soso yummy and well-made. Great pricing as well!

name: Agucci Studio hair salon & spa
address: 5025 Heatherleigh Ave, Mississauga, ON L5V 2Y7, Canada
reviews: I recently had the pleasure of having my hair done by Agnes at Agucci Studio, and I can’t say enough good things about her! My hair is quite challenging—it’s long, thick, and there's a lot of it. Finding a stylist who can manage it while still delivering the style I want has always been difficult. But Agnes took on the challenge with ease and expertise. From the moment I sat in her chair, she made me feel comfortable and listened closely to what I was looking for. She not only handled my hair with confidence but also made it look absolutely stunning! The layers and texture she created were exactly what I wanted, giving my heavy hair beautiful movement and life. Agnes is a true professional with a keen eye for detail and an undeniable talent for working with even the most difficult hair types. Her warm personality and dedication to getting everything just right made the entire experience even better. If you’re looking for a stylist who knows how to tackle long, thick hair while making you feel pampered and valued, Agnes is the one to see. Highly recommend!

I had a great experience after switching from my previous salon to Agucci Studio! Agnes did my hair color, and I’m really happy with her service. She took the time to consult with me, explained everything in detail, and made sure I was satisfied with the color at every step.

Nabida did a fantastic job washing and blow-drying my hair. She was very professional and took great care to ensure my hair looked and felt amazing.

So glad I made the change—Agucci Studio is definitely my new go-to salon! Highly recommend!

Found this salon in my area by going off of Google review stars and reading the reviews. I had been box dying my hair which got to the point where it was dry and two-toned colored. I was able to get an appointment next day and I was seen by Elaine. She is knowledgeable, fun, outgoing and professional. She was able to choose the right shade for my coloring, and cut and styled my hair to the point that it is no longer dry and frizzy. I also had interactions with Bob, both of them made my entire experience comfortable and great. I originally thought that I would have needed a keratin treatment but I got such a great cut and color that my hair looks fresh and healthy again. Thank you Elaine, I'll be back!

Came here for a fresh haircut. Elaine took wonderful care of me. She was very kind, gave good advice and gave me a much needed beautiful cut.
I have had a haircut here once before and also left very happy.
I highly recommend this salon.
Everyone is kind and takes their job seriously/professionally and is passionate in what they do
Elaine did great job with my curly hair.. absolutely recommend her 🙂

I got the hot shave and the moments he lays he's hands on your face with the hot towel it's you feel the black belt level of experience. God bless you Paulie thank you so much for the rejuvenating experience of your hot shave and amazing fade!

I was in a pinch needing a haircut before a wedding. I saw the sign and decided to pop in. It was the best decision I ever made. Paulie is the best barber I've ever had the pleasure of dealing with. Whether you want a fade or a hot shave, he's your guy. Would highly recommend.
Paulie is a true professional, has always given me a great haircut and beard trim, and has great advice on styling. Best barber in the city!

We booked Prime Choice Barber for our wedding party and couldn’t be happier with the experience. He took care of the entire group of groomsmen and made sure every single one of us looked sharp and confident for the big day. The attention to detail was next level—fades were clean, lineups were perfect, and he brought a calm, professional vibe that really set the tone for the morning.

Not only did he deliver top-notch cuts, but he also created an atmosphere where everyone felt relaxed and enjoyed themselves. By the time we left the chair, we all felt like a million bucks. If you’re looking for someone who’s reliable, skilled, and knows how to make a big day even better, look no further. Prime Choice Barber is the real deal.

Highly recommend for weddings, events, or just your weekly cut—you won’t be disappointed!

I’ve been to many barbers, but this one really knows how to do a proper fade. The transition is clean, smooth, and sharp every time. He pays close attention to detail, takes his time to make sure everything looks perfect, and really understands different styles. If you want a crisp fade that actually lasts and grows out nicely, this is the place to go. Highly recommend!

Great experience at Prime Choice Barber! Pauly is amazing—skilled, friendly, and really takes his time to make sure the cut is perfect. You can tell he cares about his work and his clients. Highly recommend him if you’re looking for a fresh, clean look!
First met Pauly in Alberta, and was ecstatic when I learned he was opening a shop here in Hamilton! Clean shop and clean cuts! I look forward to my monthly trip to Prime Choice.
Great barber first time there, I’ll be back for sure!

name: Lazy Panda
address: 174a Rideau St, Ottawa, ON K1N 9P1, Canada
reviews:
very kind staff, however the food and drinks were very disappointing. we ordered a banana milk tea and brown sugar pearl milk tea. both drinks were very plain and tasted like milk (you can see how pale it is in the photo). there was barely any tea flavour + the tapioca was not soaked in brown sugar. we also ordered the beef brisket curry rice and black pepper shrimp noodles. the beef brisket portion was small with watery gravy and bland meat. similar to the shrimp dish, the meat was not seasoned properly. just dunked in sauce. i do not think salt was used either. i suppose it was healthy..

overall, it is a cute study space and very kind owners, but i think there is some work that can be done on the items. nothing quite special and in a competitive downtown ottawa area, i don’t see myself returning.

Lazy Panda is honestly one of my favourite places. Mika, the owner, is an angel — kind, generous and incredibly patient. She really makes everyone feel welcome.

The bubble teas are amazing. My mom loves their kumquat lime green tea — super sour and citrusy (a bit too intense for me 😅), while I love trying new flavours every time I go. I’ve been there hundreds of times and I’m still discovering new combinations I haven’t tried yet.

They also serve really good fried rice (chicken, shrimp, pork, etc.). If you walk past the drink counter, you’ll find a sign with the full food menu — definitely worth checking out. They sometimes run nice promotions too, like getting a regular drink for free when you buy a meal.

Great drinks, good food, and an always welcoming atmosphere. Highly recommend! ⭐

I visited Lazy Panda on Rideau Street in Ottawa with a friend, for the first time this week.
Unfortunately, while eating my meal, I discovered what appeared to be a dirty human fingernail in my food. I had actually chewed on it before realizing what it was, which was extremely upsetting and honestly made me feel sick to my stomach.
I spoke with a staff member at the time, who kindly offered to replace my meal. While I appreciated the offer, I declined because I had completely lost my appetite and was too disgusted to continue eating.
The server suggested it was not a fingernail, but likely the shell of a shallot. It was not! It was a nail that had clearly been cut off , likely with scissors.
I reached out to the business again afterwards because I preferred to resolve this matter directly with the restaurant rather than leaving a negative public review. Given what happened, I felt  that a full refund for my meal would have been the most appropriate resolution. This did not happen.
I understand that mistakes happen, but I hoped the owner/manager could appreciate how distressing this experience was. I have not been contacted back despite my request on Instagram messages ( I could find no other means of contact after leaving the restaurant) .

I only recently discovered that Lazy Panda offers hot food on UberEats — what a game changer!

Their steamed dishes are absolutely delicious, reasonably priced, and perfect for a quick and satisfying lunch at work. (I love that they include a fried egg) I've ordered a few times now, and the quality has been consistently great.

Definitely recommend giving them a try if you're craving something tasty and convenient!
hidden gem! Drinks are so great, paired with a huge study chill area. Good vibes, nice music, clean & renovated and they're working on expanding their kitchen. Wish I knew about this place earlier.

Used to be prestotea, now it’s Lazy Panda. The drinks (bubble tea) are amazing, and now there’s authentic Chinese food! One of my regular places

The food is priced very fairly. Perfect place to have a casual meal and bubble tea downtown. Open late as well.

Consistently have great drinks with a wide variety of flavours and toppings.

The owners and staff are very friendly and sweet.

Not only do they serve amazing drinks, but their food menu is unexpectedly fantastic. From crispy chicken (perfectly seasoned!) to savory dim sum  and amazing fried rice every bite is packed with flavour. The portions are generous, and everything tastes fresh and authentic.

Not worth $9 dollars. I went in and ordered only to realize after I paid that the place changed brands. I got their signature or base milk tea, “Lazy Panda Milk Tea” and it’s nothing special. Maximum I’d pay for this would be $7. Also a little too sweet even after I got “less sugar” and I typically like a sweet milk tea. Pearls are ok. It is consumable but does not have the quality of Preso. The size of their regular is pretty good but it doesn’t really matter when the tea its self is just meh.

name: Salon DiSalvo
address: 684 Upper James St, Hamilton, ON L9C 2Z6, Canada
reviews:
I’ve now been to this salon twice, and both experiences were absolutely incredible.

The first time I came in, I already had a great experience, but this second visit was right before my wedding, so I was honestly really nervous about coloring and cutting my hair. I also had hair extensions that arrived incorrectly and were final sale, which added even more stress. Anthony and Angela went above and beyond from the very beginning. They did a phone consultation with me first, then took the time to meet with me in person to talk through a plan.

They were both absolutely spectacular. They explained the entire process, double-checked everything with me, and made sure I felt comfortable every step of the way. I don’t know much about hair extensions or the technical side of coloring and cutting, so I really relied on their expertise. I showed them what I was planning for my wedding hair, and they helped guide me on what would work best in terms of color, length, texture, and style.

The end result was exactly what I wanted honestly even better. The attention to detail is beyond a 10/10.

Everyone in the salon is also incredibly friendly and welcoming. You can genuinely feel that they care about their clients and take pride in their work. Both times I visited, they took their time and never rushed the process, even though I was the last person to leave the salon.

I’ve been to other salons in the past where I paid two or three times as much and left with completely botched hair. That is absolutely not the case here. The pricing is very fair, and the quality of work and care you receive is amazing.

I’m honestly so thankful they took the time to make sure my hair looked beautiful for my wedding. The patience, the strand testing, checking in constantly to make sure I liked everything, and helping guide decisions along the way made such a difference.

I’ll actually be moving out of Hamilton soon, but I would genuinely drive back here no matter where I live. They’ve absolutely earned a lifelong client.

If you’re looking for a new salon or just haven’t found the right place yet, I can’t recommend them enough. Anthony, Angela, and the whole team are incredible.

Thank you so much!!! Will update soon with wedding photos 🥰

I recently made the decision to make the switch from barbershops to a salon for the first time after a lifetime of never being happy with my hair cuts. I'm a man with thick and heavy curls that often become frizzy by the end of each day. I've always struggled to find a professional who actually understands how to cut them or how to provide sound advice on maintaining them.

I had a scheduled cut with Anthony (Jr.) on April 2nd and it's changed everything. I'm usually a pretty wound up guy before a hair cut, but I immediately felt welcomed. Anthony took the time to listen to my past frustrations and addressed all of my concerns. For the first time, I felt comfortable enough to ask for a stylist’s expertise when it came to making decisions.

He gave me a cut I'm actually proud of, answered all my questions regarding routine, and introduced me to clarifying products and how to use them. A few days later, the cut still looks great, and Anthony's advice has stuck with me. I finally feel confident with my curls, and love that they look and feel healthy. If you have difficult hair or you're a guy looking for a scissor cut, I can't recommend Salon DiSalvo enough. The stylists listen and clearly know their craft. The least I can do is leave my thoughts, and I'll definitely return in the future.

Thanks again!

What can I say about this establishment and more importantly the amazing people that work there...to be honest, I can't say enough good things about Salon DiSalvo as a whole.
About 16 years ago now, my current hairdresser started working at Salon DiSalvo (Marissa). She was great but unfortunately she ended up choosing a different career path. But because of her, I was fortunate myself for getting to partake in the Salon DiSalvo experience. I loved the atmosphere of the salon immediately, but the real gem of this place is the people. It is a family owned business with the Dad (Joe), Mom (Josie) and their son (Anthony). Since my hair stylist left, I was very fortunate to obtain Anthony as my new hair stylist...and I can honestly say now, he is a brother to me!!! My first haircut with Anthony was absolutely perfect and I can honestly say he has NEVER given me a bad haircut...ever!!! Anthony was I believe only 21 when he started with me but already was an extreme professional and new exactly what he was doing!! As we both got older and my hair started disappearing...boo...he was able to adjust my look and again...could not be happier!!! So as a hair stylist, I could not praise Anthony enough!!! Absolutely top-notch and amazing...EVERYTIME!!!
But to be perfectly honest...it is really the place in general that is such an amazing experience!! The owners and all staff are absolutely amazing people and make the whole experience absolutely worth it every time!!! Joe and Josie are now my surrogate parents...and then there is Misha, Angela and Anthony No. 2 (LOL). Everybody is truly amazing and so friendly, it really does make a simple haircut an actual experience. I honestly can go on forever about Salon DiSalvo and the staff, but this review is already long enough...lol!!!
In closing, I will say...with absolute certainty...that going to Salon DiSalvo will be the best decision you have ever made, for both your hair and your soul!!! By far the best Hair Salon anywhere!!! You will never be disappointed!!!! Trust me!

2 cappuccinos later and Anthony fixed my hair right up. I went in with orange hair from box dye and Anthony fixed my colour and cut. Thank you so much, I am so pleased and feel like myself again. Such a lovely experience and family, thank you to Mischa (likely spelt that wrong my apologies) for the yummy cappuccinos and lovely hair washing service. 10/10 would return/recommend :)

It’s always nerve wracking when you move and you have to find a new hair stylist but I visited the salon for the first time today and I am so happy I did! Misha was so attentive and sweet and did a fantastic job with my color. I loved the cut and blow out and the beautiful head massage too. Thanks so much 🙏🏻 I’ve found my new salon!

I always have a wonderful experience here. Today I got a hair color done with Misha! I absolutely love my hair color and couldn’t be happier with how it turned out. She was so patient, warm, and attentive throughout the entire appointment.

I have been a long time customer here and what always stands out to me about Salon DiSalvo is how effortlessly Anthony understands exactly what I want without me having to over-explain ever. His experience and expertise truly show in both his work and the care he gives his clients. You can tell they genuinely want what’s best for you. Highly recommend!

This review is a bit late but no less heartfelt.  Jan 19 I was set to fly to Vegas.  First vacation in 10 years.  A few days prior to departure I booked a hair appointment.  A massive winter storm came through the night before and almost everything was closed.  The airport was shovelling out and my flight was still on time for that evening.  Anthony from the salon called me first thing that morning, asked if I still wanted my hair done (it had been 6 years) and when I said yes if at all possible, he said he would meet me there in half an hour.  Not only did the open the salon just for me, Anthony gave me one of the best haircuts ever, and took so much time showing me how to talk care of my curls.  And the best part?  I was a new customer.  Anthony and Salon DiSalvo went so far above and beyond, and made me feel like it was absolutely no trouble.  Highly, highly recommend.

Such a great salon! I had Angela as my stylist and got blonde highlights and low lights and she did a fantastic job. All the employees are super friendly and very knowledgeable in hair care. Definitely 5 stars and will come back for my next appointment!
